EA-1189.name: Exp_JBrainSig1_UltraRSI
EA-1189.summary: This EA combines two indicators — JBrainTrendSig1 and UltraRSI — to generate trading signals. It offers three operational modes: using JBrainSig1 as a filter for UltraRSI signals, using UltraRSI as a filter for JBrainSig1 signals, or a composition mode where either indicator's open signal paired with the other's close signal triggers a trade. Entry signals require cross-confirmation from both indicators before opening buy or sell positions.
EA-1189.summary_zh: 该EA结合JBrainTrendSig1和UltraRSI两个指标生成交易信号。提供三种运行模式：JBrainSig1过滤UltraRSI信号、UltraRSI过滤JBrainSig1信号、以及组合模式。入场信号需要两个指标的交叉确认后才会开仓。
EA-1189.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是双指标交叉确认系统，结合了趋势判断指标JBrainTrendSig1和动量振荡指标UltraRSI。入场条件根据Mode参数决定：在JBrainSig1Filter模式下，UltraRSI产生开仓信号但需JBrainSig1确认方向；在UltraRSIFilter模式下则相反；在Composition组合模式下，任一指标的开仓信号与另一指标的平仓信号组合即可触发入场。出场条件为两个指标同时发出平仓信号（SELL_Close1&&SELL_Close2或BUY_Close1&&BUY_Close2）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。每笔交易设有StopLoss和TakeProfit，分别为1000点和2000点，风险收益比为1:2。策略使用H4时间框架，属于中长期交易系统，依赖新K线检测机制避免重复交易。
EA-1189.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's core strategy is a dual-indicator cross-confirmation system combining the trend-detection JBrainTrendSig1 indicator and the momentum oscillator UltraRSI. Entry conditions depend on the Mode parameter: in JBrainSig1Filter mode, UltraRSI generates open signals but JBrainSig1 must confirm direction; in UltraRSIFilter mode the roles are reversed; in Composition mode, either indicator's open signal paired with the other's close signal triggers entry. Exit conditions require both indicators to simultaneously emit close signals (SELL_Close1 && SELL_Close2 or BUY_Close1 && BUY_Close2). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Each trade includes StopLoss at 1000 points and TakeProfit at 2000 points, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. The strategy operates on the H4 timeframe as a medium-to-long-term trading system, relying on a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trading within the same bar.

EA-1190.name: Exp_Candles_XSmoothed
EA-1190.summary: This EA trades breakouts from smoothed candle high/low channels. It uses a custom Candles_Smoothed indicator to generate smoothed high and low boundaries, then enters long when price closes above the smoothed high plus a breakout level, and enters short when price closes below the smoothed low minus a breakout level. Positions are closed on reverse signals and managed with fixed stop loss and take profit.
EA-1190.summary_zh: 该EA基于平滑K线通道的突破进行交易。使用自定义的Candles_Smoothed指标生成平滑的高低边界，当价格收于平滑高点加上突破水平之上时做多，当价格收于平滑低点减去突破水平之下时做空。反向信号时平仓，并使用固定止损止盈管理仓位。
EA-1190.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于平滑K线通道的突破交易，通过Candles_Smoothed指标对K线高低点进行平滑处理来过滤噪音。入场条件为：当收盘价突破平滑高点加上突破水平(dLevel)时开多仓，当收盘价跌破平滑低点减去突破水平时开空仓。出场条件为：反向突破信号触发平仓（如持多头时收盘价跌破平滑低点减突破水平则平多仓），同时每笔交易设有固定止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理方面，通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算仓位。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，支持按账户余额百分比动态计算交易量。策略运行在H4等较高时间框架上，使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复入场。
EA-1190.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is a breakout trading system based on smoothed candle high/low channels, using the Candles_Smoothed indicator to smooth price extremes and filter market noise. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the close price breaks above the smoothed high plus a breakout level (dLevel), and a short position is opened when the close price breaks below the smoothed low minus dLevel. Exit conditions: reverse breakout signals trigger position closure (e.g., a long position is closed when the close falls below the smoothed low minus dLevel), and each trade has a fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a percentage of the deposit. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, supporting dynamic lot calculation based on account balance percentage. The strategy operates on higher timeframes like H4 and uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries.

EA-1198.name: EA_MALR_v_1-01
EA-1198.summary: This EA trades channel breakouts using a custom MALR (Moving Average Linear Regression) indicator. It enters buy when price breaks above the upper channel and sell when price breaks below the lower channel. It supports position overturn (reversal), averaging down, lot increase based on equity, and trailing stop functionality.
EA-1198.summary_zh: 该EA使用自定义MALR（移动平均线性回归）指标进行通道突破交易。价格突破上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空。支持仓位反转、加仓摊平、基于权益的仓位增加以及移动止损功能。
EA-1198.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于自定义MALR指标的通道突破。入场条件为：当收盘价从前一根K线低于上轨变为当前K线高于上轨时做多，反之当收盘价从前一根K线高于下轨变为当前K线低于下轨时做空。出场条件包括固定止损/止盈、移动止损以及仓位反转时平仓。仓位管理方面，支持三种模式：主单开仓（mode=1）、加仓摊平（mode=2，在浮亏达到指定点数时以相同手数加仓）和仓位反转（mode=3，平掉当前仓位后以乘数倍手数反向开仓）。资金管理方面，当启用use_increase时，手数根据账户权益与最大回撤的比值动态调整，即手数=Lot×权益/Max_drawdown。移动止损功能可在盈利达到指定点数后激活，按trail点数跟踪止损。整体策略存在马丁格尔倾向，尤其是反转模式下手数乘以koff_multiplication，可能导致仓位快速放大。
EA-1198.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on channel breakouts from the custom MALR indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the close price transitions from below the upper channel on the previous bar to above it on the current bar; a sell signal is the reverse with the lower channel. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss/take-profit, trailing stop, and position closure during overturn. Position sizing supports three modes: main entry (mode=1) with standard or equity-scaled lots, averaging (mode=2) which adds same-size positions when floating loss reaches a threshold, and overturn (mode=3) which closes the current position and opens a reverse position with multiplied lot size (lot × koff_multiplication). Money management scales the base lot by AccountEquity/Max_drawdown when use_increase is enabled, creating a proportional relationship between equity and position size. The trailing stop activates after a profit threshold is reached and then follows price by the trail distance. The overturn mechanism combined with lot multiplication introduces Martingale-like risk, as repeated reversals can exponentially increase position size.

EA-1204.name: Exp_ColorX2MA-Parabolic
EA-1204.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the ColorX2MA-Parabolic custom indicator, which combines a double-smoothed moving average (X2MA) with Parabolic SAR logic. It opens buy positions when the indicator's up buffer has a valid value and sell positions when the down buffer has a valid value, with configurable permissions for entries and exits. Positions are closed either on opposite signals or via fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-1204.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorX2MA-Parabolic自定义指标信号进行交易，该指标结合了双重平滑移动平均线(X2MA)与Parabolic SAR逻辑。当指标的上行缓冲区有有效值时开多仓，下行缓冲区有有效值时开空仓，并可配置开仓和平仓权限。持仓通过反向信号或固定止损止盈水平平仓。
EA-1204.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是利用双重平滑移动平均线(X2MA)与Parabolic SAR的组合来判断趋势方向并产生交易信号。入场条件为：当ColorX2MA-Parabolic指标的第3缓冲区(UpValue)在指定信号K线上有非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时产生买入信号，第2缓冲区(DnValue)有非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括：反向信号触发平仓（买入信号平空仓，卖出信号平多仓），以及固定的止损和止盈水平。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数，具体逻辑封装在TradeAlgorithms.mqh中。资金管理方面，EA允许分别控制买入和卖出的开仓与平仓权限，提供了灵活的交易方向控制。此外，EA还实现了历史回溯机制来寻找最近的交易方向信号以确定平仓条件，并在新K线出现时或需要重新计算时才更新信号，避免频繁交易。
EA-1204.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept leverages a combination of double-smoothed moving average (X2MA) and Parabolic SAR to determine trend direction and generate trading signals. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the ColorX2MA-Parabolic indicator's buffer 3 (UpValue) has a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified signal bar, and a sell signal is generated when buffer 2 (DnValue) has a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value. Exit conditions include: opposite signals trigger position closure (buy signal closes short, sell signal closes long), along with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based lot calculation, with the actual logic encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh. Money management allows independent control of buy/sell open and close permissions, providing flexible trading direction control. Additionally, the EA implements a historical lookback mechanism to find the most recent directional signal for determining close conditions, and only updates signals on new bars or when recalculation is needed to avoid over-trading.

EA-1207.name: Exp_RMACD
EA-1207.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorRMACD indicator, a volume-weighted MACD variant with customizable signal line smoothing. It offers four entry algorithms: zero-line breakout, MACD direction change, signal line direction change, and MACD/signal line crossover. Positions are opened and closed based on these momentum signals with configurable buy/sell permissions and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-1207.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorRMACD指标进行交易，这是一种带成交量加权的MACD变体，支持自定义信号线平滑方法。它提供四种入场算法：零线突破、MACD方向变化、信号线方向变化以及MACD与信号线交叉。根据这些动量信号开平仓，并支持可配置的买卖权限和固定止损止盈。
EA-1207.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于RMACD（成交量加权MACD）指标的动量信号进行交易。入场条件有四种模式可选：零线突破模式检测MACD柱状图穿越零线；MACD转向模式检测MACD柱状图方向变化；信号线转向模式检测信号线方向变化；MACD交叉模式检测MACD柱状图与信号线的交叉。出场条件包括反向信号触发平仓以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理方面没有加仓或减仓逻辑，每笔交易独立计算仓位大小。策略使用CXMA类支持多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX、T3、VIDYA、AMA等），增强了信号线的灵活性。EA在新K线形成时检测信号，避免同根K线重复交易，但缺少点差过滤和滑点保护机制。
EA-1207.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA trades based on momentum signals from the RMACD indicator, which is a volume-weighted MACD variant. Entry conditions offer four selectable modes: zero-line breakout detects the MACD histogram crossing zero; MACD twist detects directional change in the MACD histogram; signal twist detects directional change in the signal line; and MACD disposition detects crossovers between the MACD histogram and signal line. Exit conditions include reverse signal-triggered closes and fixed stop-loss/take-profit in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management lacks scaling logic, with each trade independently calculating position size. The strategy leverages the CXMA class supporting multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, T3, VIDYA, AMA, etc.), enhancing signal line flexibility. The EA detects signals on new bar formation to avoid repeated trades on the same bar, but lacks spread filtering and explicit slippage protection beyond the Deviation parameter.

EA-1209.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用Kolier SuperTrend指标作为核心策略，该指标基于ATR（平均真实波幅）乘以一个系数来动态调整趋势线。入场条件为：当指标的上行信号线触发时（UpSignal为真），允许开多仓并同时平空仓；当指标的下行信号线触发时（DnSignal为真），允许开空仓并同时平多仓。出场条件包括：反向信号触发时平仓、固定止损（默认1000点）和固定止盈（默认2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数，支持止损止盈和价格偏离控制。策略仅在每根新K线形成时检测信号，避免重复交易，同时使用Recount机制在数据不足时重新计算。
EA-1209.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Kolier SuperTrend indicator as its core strategy, which dynamically adjusts the trend line based on ATR (Average True Range) multiplied by a configurable coefficient. Entry conditions are: when the indicator's upward signal line triggers (UpSignal is true), it allows opening long positions and simultaneously closing short positions; when the downward signal line triggers (DnSignal is true), it allows opening short positions and simultaneously closing long positions. Exit conditions include: closing on reverse signals, fixed Stop Loss (default 1000 points), and fixed Take Profit (default 2000 points). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, supporting stop loss/take profit and price deviation control. The strategy only checks signals on each new bar formation to avoid repeated trades, and uses a Recount mechanism to recalculate when data is insufficient.

EA-1215.strategy_analysis:
分析

### 2.1 核心策略概念
**零点点数力指标突破策略 (Zero Point Force Breakthrough)**

ZPF（Zero Point Force）是一个基于成交量加权的动量指标。它计算短周期和长周期平滑价格的差值，再乘以成交量，形成一个动量强度指标。当ZPF穿越零线时产生交易信号。

### 2.2 ZPF计算公式

**核心公式**:

**参数说明**:
- **x1ma**: 短周期平滑价格 (默认周期12)
- **x2ma**: 长周期平滑价格 (默认周期24)
- **xvol**: 平滑成交量
- **zpf**: 零点点数力 = 成交量 × (短MA - 长MA) / 2

### 2.3 指标可视化

**云状填充**:
- **Red**: 负值区域 (ZPF < 0, 空头力量)
- **Teal**: 正值区域 (ZPF > 0, 多头力量)

EA-1216.strategy_analysis:
分析

### 2.1 核心策略概念
MA Rounding Channel是一个创新的通道突破策略，核心算法是"四舍五入MA"（MA Rounding）。该算法通过检测价格是否超过MA的某个固定阈值(MaRound参数)来决定是否更新MA值，从而创建阶梯状的平滑趋势线，再基于ATR构建动态通道。

当价格突破通道上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空。通道宽度由ATR×ATR_Factor动态调整，实现波动率自适应。

### 2.2 入场条件
**做多条件**:
1. 通道存在（UpValue[1]和DnValue[1]都不为0）
2. 收盘价突破上轨（Close[1] > UpValue[1]）
3. 且BuyPosOpen=true（允许做多）

**做空条件**:
1. 通道存在（UpValue[1]和DnValue[1]都不为0）
2. 收盘价跌破下轨（Close[1] < DnValue[1]）
3. 且SellPosOpen=true（允许做空）

**历史信号恢复机制**: 当通道不存在时，EA会向后搜索历史K线，找到最近的通道边界来判断是否需要平仓。

### 2.3 出场条件
**多头平仓**:
1. BuyPosClose=true时，收盘价跌破下轨
2. SellPosClose=true时，做多后价格跌破下轨

**空头平仓**:
1. SellPosClose=true时，收盘价突破上轨
2. BuyPosClose=true时，做空后价格突破上轨

### 2.4 风险管理
- **止损**: 默认StopLoss=1000点（⚠️过大）
- **止盈**: 默认TakeProfit=2000点（盈亏比2:1良好）
- **手数管理**: MM=-0.1表示固定0.1手（⚠️过大无资金管理）
- **滑点控制**: Deviation_=10点
pros: MA Rounding创新算法: 通过固定阈值判断MA更新，创建阶梯状趋势线，有效过滤震荡噪音
ATR自适应通道: 通道宽度根据波动率动态调整，适应不同市场环境
历史信号恢复机制: EA重启后自动向后搜索历史K线恢复交易状态
Nikolay Kositsin专业架构: 完整的CIsNewBar类+TradeAlgorithms交易函数库
四开关交易控制: BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose独立控制
盈亏比2:1良好: TP=2000/SL=1000（虽止损过大但盈亏比合理）
cons: 默认止损过大: 1000点对多数品种过高
参数不一致: EA与指标的MaRound参数差10倍
无趋势强度过滤: 震荡市容易假突破
固定手数过大: 无资金管理机制
依赖外部指标: 需安装ma_rounding_channel.mq5
通道连续性默认关闭: ChanContinuity=false可能导致信号不连续

EA-12220.name: Ilan 1.6 Dinamic HT
EA-12220.summary: A martingale-style grid EA that opens an initial position based on RSI and recent price direction, then adds averaging positions with exponentially increasing lot sizes when the existing position goes into loss beyond a dynamic pip threshold. It includes multiple exit mechanisms including trailing stop, equity stop, CCI stop, and time-based stop, but lacks a mandatory hard stop-loss by default.
EA-12220.summary_zh: 这是一个马丁格尔风格的网格EA，基于RSI和近期价格方向开仓，当现有仓位亏损超过动态点数阈值时，以指数递增的手数加仓摊平。它包含多种出场机制如追踪止损、净值止损、CCI止损和时间止损，但默认缺少强制硬止损。
EA-12220.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是马丁格尔加仓摊平：首次入场依赖RSI指标和最近两根K线的价格方向判断，RSI低于30且价格上涨时做多，RSI高于70且价格下跌时做空。当已有仓位亏损超过动态计算的点数阈值时，EA会按LotExponent的幂次递增手数开立同方向的新仓位进行摊平。动态点数阈值通过最近Glubina根K线的最高价与最低价之差除以DEL系数计算，并受DefaultPips上下限约束。出场方面，所有仓位共享基于加权均价计算的统一止盈，另有可选的追踪止损、CCI极端值平仓、净值回撤止损和超时平仓四种保护机制。仓位管理采用指数递增手数（Lots × LotExponent^(N+1)），这属于典型的马丁格尔资金管理方式，在连续亏损时仓位会急剧放大。
EA-12220.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's core strategy is martingale-style averaging down: the initial entry relies on RSI readings and the price direction of the last two bars — going long when RSI is below 30 and price is rising, going short when RSI exceeds 70 and price is falling. When an existing position's loss exceeds a dynamically calculated pip threshold, the EA opens a new same-direction position with lot size multiplied by LotExponent raised to the power of the current position count, effectively averaging down the entry price. The dynamic pip threshold is derived from the High-Low range of the last Glubina bars divided by the DEL factor, bounded by DefaultPips/DEL (lower) and DefaultPips*DEL (upper). For exits, all positions share a common take-profit calculated from the weighted average price, with four optional protective mechanisms: trailing stop, CCI extreme level exit, equity drawdown stop, and time-based closure. Position sizing uses exponential lot increase (Lots × LotExponent^(N+1)), which is classic martingale money management that causes position sizes to escalate dramatically during consecutive losses.

EA-1223.name: Exp_TrendValue
EA-1223.summary: This EA trades based on the custom TrendValue indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It uses ATR-based sensitivity for trend detection and applies fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Trade execution is controlled by new bar detection and configurable permissions for opening and closing positions.
EA-1223.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义TrendValue指标进行交易，在上升趋势信号时开多仓，下降趋势信号时开空仓。它使用基于ATR的灵敏度进行趋势检测，并设置固定的止损止盈水平。交易执行通过新K线检测和可配置的开平仓权限来控制。
EA-1223.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用趋势跟踪策略，核心依赖自定义TrendValue指标（基于移动平均线和ATR构建）判断市场方向。入场条件为：当UpSignal缓冲区出现非空有效值时开多仓，当DnSignal缓冲区出现非空有效值时开空仓。出场条件为：当反向趋势信号出现时平仓（如持仓多仓时出现DnTrend或DnSignal则平多），或触发固定点数的止损止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理方面，止损默认1000点、止盈默认2000点，盈亏比为2:1，但缺少追踪止损和动态止损机制。策略还加入了历史数据加载检查和新K线过滤机制，避免重复信号。
EA-1223.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy centered on the custom TrendValue indicator, which is built from moving averages and ATR to determine market direction. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the UpSignal buffer produces a non-empty valid value, and a sell position is opened when the DnSignal buffer produces a non-empty valid value. Exit conditions: positions are closed when opposing trend signals appear (e.g., a long is closed when DnTrend or DnSignal triggers), or when fixed stop loss or take profit levels are hit. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit per deal. Money management features a default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points, yielding a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, but lacks trailing stops or dynamic stop adjustments. The strategy also incorporates historical data loading checks and new bar filtering to prevent duplicate signal execution.

EA-1225.name: Exp_MACD_Xtr
EA-1225.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom MACD_Xtr indicator, which is an enhanced MACD with volatility-based normalization using ATR, standard deviation, or volume as the source. It opens buy/sell positions on trend signals and closes them when the trend fades or reverses, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1225.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义MACD_Xtr指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标是经过ATR、标准差或成交量归一化增强的MACD。它在趋势信号出现时开仓，在趋势消退或反转时平仓，并配有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-1225.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于自定义MACD_Xtr指标产生动量交易信号。入场条件为：当指标信号值为2时开多仓（买入信号），当信号值为0时开空仓（卖出信号），且要求当前信号与前一根K线信号不同以确认趋势变化。出场条件包括：当信号值为1时表示无趋势，同时平掉多空仓位；也通过止损和止盈进行被动出场。仓位管理采用资金比例模式，通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示账户资金的占比。资金管理依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的函数实现，支持基于存款份额的动态仓位计算。策略还包含信号灵敏度阈值(Sens)和前沿/阻尼平滑周期，用于过滤噪声信号。
EA-1225.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA generates momentum trading signals based on the custom MACD_Xtr indicator, which enhances traditional MACD with volatility normalization using ATR, standard deviation, or tick volume as the source. Entry conditions are: when the indicator signal value equals 2, a buy position is opened (bullish signal), and when the signal value equals 0, a sell position is opened (bearish signal), requiring the current bar signal to differ from the previous bar to confirm a trend change. Exit conditions include: when the signal value equals 1 indicating no trend, both long and short positions are closed; passive exits also occur via configurable stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing uses a deposit share model controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent the share of account balance per deal. Money management relies on functions from the external include file TradeAlgorithms.mqh, supporting dynamic position calculation based on deposit share. The strategy also incorporates a sensitivity threshold (Sens) and front/back smoothing periods to filter out noise from the signals.

improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，避免在高点差时段开仓导致不必要的交易成本
增加最大同时持仓数量限制和资金最大回撤控制，提升整体资金安全性
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to avoid opening positions during high-spread periods that would incur unnecessary trading costs
Add maximum simultaneous position limits and maximum drawdown controls to improve overall capital safety

EA-1229.name: svmTrader
EA-1229.summary: This EA uses two Support Vector Machine (SVM) models trained on standard technical indicators to generate buy and sell trade signals. When an SVM signals a trade, the EA opens a market position and places matching manual stop-loss and take-profit pending orders, using a ticket cache system to pair and manage them as separate trades.
EA-1229.summary_zh: 该EA使用两个支持向量机(SVM)模型，基于标准技术指标训练后生成买入和卖出交易信号。当SVM发出信号时，EA开仓并下挂止损和止盈订单，通过票号缓存系统将配对订单作为独立交易管理。
EA-1229.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：利用支持向量机(SVM)对多种技术指标（Bears Power、Bulls Power、ATR、Momentum、MACD、Stochastic、Force Index）进行机器学习训练，分别建立买入信号模型和卖出信号模型。入场条件：每个新K线形成时，classify()函数用当前指标数据评估已训练的SVM模型，若买入SVM返回true则开多仓，若卖出SVM返回true则开空仓。出场条件：通过挂单方式实现手动止损止盈，买入后放置SellStop止损和SellLimit止盈，卖出后放置BuyStop止损和BuyLimit止盈；当一方触发时，通过OnTrade()事件删除配对的另一方挂单。仓位管理：固定手数(Vol=1)，通过Current_Order_Exposure()函数计算当前挂单总量的二分之一作为风险敞口，限制不超过risk_exp(5)时才允许开仓。资金管理：仅通过最大同时持仓风险敞口参数控制，无动态仓位调整或百分比风险计算。
EA-1229.strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: Uses Support Vector Machine (SVM) models trained on seven technical indicators (Bears Power, Bulls Power, ATR, Momentum, MACD, Stochastic, Force Index) to independently generate buy and sell trade signals. Entry conditions: On each new bar, the classify() function feeds current indicator data to the trained SVM models; if the buy-SVM returns true, a long position is opened, and if the sell-SVM returns true, a short position is opened. Exit conditions: Manual stop-loss and take-profit are implemented via pending orders — after a buy, a SellStop (stop-loss) and SellLimit (take-profit) are placed; after a sell, a BuyStop (stop-loss) and BuyLimit (take-profit) are placed; when one is triggered, the OnTrade() handler deletes the paired order using a ticket cache. Position sizing: Fixed lot size (Vol=1), with Current_Order_Exposure() computing half of total pending order volume as risk exposure, allowing new trades only when exposure is below risk_exp (5). Money management: Relies solely on the maximum simultaneous order exposure parameter; there is no dynamic position sizing or percentage-based risk calculation.

EA-123.name: Simple MA+ADX EA
EA-123.summary: This EA combines a Simple Moving Average (SMA) crossover with the ADX indicator to identify and trade trending markets. It enters long when the fast SMA crosses above the slow SMA and ADX confirms trend strength, and enters short on the reverse crossover with ADX confirmation. Exits are triggered by opposing crossover signals or stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-123.summary_zh: 该EA结合简单移动平均线(SMA)交叉与ADX指标来识别和交易趋势市场。当快速SMA上穿慢速SMA且ADX确认趋势强度时做多，反之做空。出场依靠反向交叉信号或止损/止盈。
EA-123.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用双移动平均线交叉判断趋势方向，同时借助ADX指标过滤震荡行情，只在趋势明确时入场。入场条件为：快速SMA上穿慢速SMA且ADX值高于阈值时开多单，快速SMA下穿慢速SMA且ADX值高于阈值时开空单。出场条件包括：反向SMA交叉信号平仓、固定止损止盈平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未实现动态仓位调整。资金管理方面较为简单，仅依赖止损和止盈参数控制单笔风险，缺乏基于账户余额或波动率的动态风险管理机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但风险控制手段有限，缺乏对震荡行情中连续假信号的防护措施。
EA-123.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy uses dual moving average crossovers to determine trend direction while leveraging the ADX indicator to filter out range-bound markets, entering only when a trend is confirmed. Entry conditions are: open a long position when the fast SMA crosses above the slow SMA and ADX exceeds its threshold, and open a short position on the reverse crossover with ADX confirmation. Exit conditions include closing positions on opposing SMA crossover signals or hitting fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management is relatively simple, relying solely on stop-loss and take-profit parameters to control per-trade risk, lacking dynamic risk management mechanisms based on account balance or market volatility. The overall strategy logic is clear, but risk control measures are limited, and there is no protection against consecutive false signals during choppy market conditions.

EA-1232.name: Exp_LinearRegSlopeV2
EA-1232.summary: This EA trades based on the slope of a linear regression line, using the ColorLinearRegSlope_V2 custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the regression slope turns positive and sell positions when it turns negative, with configurable smoothing methods and price types. Entry signals are confirmed on new bars by comparing current and previous indicator buffer values for crossover detection.
EA-1232.summary_zh: 该EA基于线性回归斜率进行交易，使用ColorLinearRegSlope_V2自定义指标。当回归斜率转正时开多仓，转负时开空仓，支持多种平滑方法和价格类型。入场信号在新K线形成时通过比较当前和前一期指标缓冲区值的交叉来确认。
EA-1232.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用线性回归斜率来判断市场趋势方向，斜率为正代表上升趋势，斜率为负代表下降趋势。入场条件为：当上轨缓冲区值向上穿越下轨缓冲区值时产生买入信号，当下轨缓冲区值向上穿越上轨缓冲区值时产生卖出信号，且需要前一周期已处于对应趋势状态作为确认。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈点数设置，同时当反向信号出现时也会平仓（如多头持仓时出现卖出信号则平多）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理方面，EA使用了交易算法库中的标准函数来执行开平仓操作，包含最大价格偏离控制以避免滑点过大。策略还设置了信号冲突处理机制，当同时出现买卖信号时取消所有交易信号，避免双向开仓的矛盾情况。
EA-1232.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is using the slope of a linear regression line to determine market trend direction — a positive slope indicates an uptrend while a negative slope indicates a downtrend. Entry conditions are triggered when the upper buffer crosses above the lower buffer (buy signal) or when the lower buffer crosses above the upper buffer (sell signal), with the previous bar already being in the corresponding trend state as confirmation. Exit conditions rely on fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit settings in points, and positions are also closed when a reverse signal appears (e.g., a long position is closed when a sell signal emerges). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management leverages standard functions from the TradeAlgorithms library for order execution, including maximum price deviation control to limit slippage. The strategy also implements a signal conflict resolution mechanism that cancels all trading signals when buy and sell signals appear simultaneously, preventing contradictory dual-direction entries.

EA-1234.name: Exp_VortexIndicator
EA-1234.summary: This EA trades based on the Vortex Indicator crossover signals, opening buy positions when the VI+ line crosses above the VI- line and sell positions when the VI- line crosses above the VI+ line. It uses configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, and restricts trade execution to new bar formation on a specified timeframe.
EA-1234.summary_zh: 该EA基于涡旋指标(Vortex Indicator)的交叉信号进行交易，当VI+上穿VI-时开多仓，当VI-上穿VI+时开空仓。它支持可配置的资金管理、止损止盈，并限制仅在指定时间周期的新K线形成时执行交易。
EA-1234.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是涡旋指标交叉趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当VI+线从下方穿越VI-线时产生买入信号，当VI-线从下方穿越VI+线时产生卖出信号，信号通过比较当前K线和前一根K线的VI+/VI-值大小关系来确认交叉。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈点数设置，以及反向交叉信号触发平仓（多头在卖出信号出现时平仓，空头在买入信号出现时平仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现。策略只在指定时间周期的新K线形成时检测信号，避免同一根K线内重复交易，SignalBar参数允许使用已确认的K线来获取信号。
EA-1234.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a Vortex Indicator crossover trend-following system. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the VI+ line crosses above the VI- line, and a sell signal is generated when the VI- line crosses above the VI+ line, with crossover confirmation obtained by comparing the relative positions of VI+/VI- values on the current and previous bars. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit settings in points, as well as reverse signal closes — long positions are closed when a sell signal appears and short positions are closed when a buy signal appears. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management relies on external functions BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen from the included TradeAlgorithms.mqh file. The strategy only checks for signals on new bar formation of the specified timeframe, preventing repeated trades within the same bar, and the SignalBar parameter allows using a confirmed bar for signal retrieval.

EA-1235.name: Exp_Extremum
EA-1235.summary: This EA trades based on the custom Extremum indicator, which identifies price extremes (swing highs and lows). It opens buy positions when an upward extremum signal is confirmed and sell positions when a downward extremum signal is confirmed, with optional permissions for entry and exit independently controlled.
EA-1235.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Extremum指标识别价格极值点（摆动高低点）进行交易。当确认上升极值信号时开多仓，确认下降极值信号时开空仓，入场和出场权限可独立控制。
EA-1235.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于Extremum自定义指标识别价格的极值点（即摆动高低点）来进行突破交易。入场条件为：当指标的第5缓冲区（UpValue）在信号K线上出现上穿信号，且第3缓冲区（DnValue）在前一根K线上确认不存在下降信号时，触发买入信号；反之，当DnValue出现下穿信号且UpValue确认不存在上升信号时，触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖独立的买卖平仓权限控制，当出现反向信号时平掉对应仓位，同时使用固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit进行风险管理。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示直接指定手数大小，正值表示按存款比例计算。资金管理采用固定止损止盈方式，止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险回报比为1:2。策略在新K线形成时才计算信号，避免重复交易，但缺少对持仓状态的检查，可能造成重复开仓。
EA-1235.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a breakout-style system based on the custom Extremum indicator, which identifies swing highs and lows in price action. Entry conditions require that the UpValue buffer (index 5) signals an upward extremum on the signal bar while the DnValue buffer (index 3) does not show a downward extremum on the previous bar, triggering a buy; the mirror logic applies for sell entries. Exit conditions are controlled through independent permission flags (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose), where a reverse extremum signal closes the opposing position, supplemented by fixed StopLoss (1000 points) and TakeProfit (2000 points) for risk management. Position sizing is governed by the MM parameter: negative values specify a fixed lot size directly, while positive values represent a share of the deposit per deal. Money management uses a fixed stop-loss and take-profit approach with a risk-reward ratio of 1:2, which is reasonable but lacks trailing stop or dynamic adjustment capabilities. The strategy only recalculates on new bar formation to avoid redundant signals, but notably lacks an explicit check for existing open positions before opening new ones, which could lead to accumulated or duplicate positions.

EA-1238.name: Exp_UltraWPR
EA-1238.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the UltraWPR custom indicator, which applies multi-stage smoothing to the Williams Percent Range (WPR). It opens buy positions when the smoothed WPR upward line crosses above the downward line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable permissions for entry and exit.
EA-1238.summary_zh: 该EA基于UltraWPR自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，UltraWPR对威廉指标(WPR)进行了多阶段平滑处理。当平滑后的WPR上行线上穿下行线时开多仓，反向下穿时开空仓，并支持配置入场和出场的权限控制。
EA-1238.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于UltraWPR指标的双线交叉，该指标是对WPR(威廉百分比范围)经过多阶段自适应平滑处理后的产物。入场条件为：当UpValue线从下方穿越DnValue线时产生买入信号，当DnValue线从下方穿越UpValue线时产生卖出信号，具体判断逻辑是比较相邻两根K线的上下线关系变化。出场条件包括：止损和止盈以点数设定(默认止损1000点、止盈2000点)，以及反向信号触发平仓(BuyPosClose/SellPosClose)。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算仓位。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数实现，支持最大价格偏差控制。该策略使用多周期框架(默认H4)进行信号生成，并在新K线出现时才执行交易逻辑以避免重复信号。
EA-1238.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on dual-line crossover signals from the UltraWPR indicator, which applies multiple stages of adaptive smoothing (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA options) to the Williams Percent Range (WPR). Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the UpValue line crosses above the DnValue line (detected by comparing values across two consecutive bars), and a sell signal on the reverse crossover. Exit conditions include fixed Stop Loss (default 1000 points) and Take Profit (default 2000 points), plus directional close signals triggered when the opposite crossover occurs. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management is delegated to the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen), which also handle maximum price deviation control. The strategy operates on a configurable timeframe (default H4) and only evaluates trading logic on new bar formation to prevent duplicate signals within the same bar.

EA-12442.name: BackToTheFuture
EA-12442.summary: This EA scrapes real-time stock quotes from Google Finance via WebRequest and compares them against historical prices from a configurable time offset. It opens buy/sell positions when the current price deviation from the historical reference exceeds a defined bar size threshold, aiming to exploit temporary mispricings between the external feed and the broker's price.
EA-12442.summary_zh: 该EA通过WebRequest从Google Finance抓取实时股票报价，并与可配置时间偏移的历史价格进行比较。当当前价格与历史参考价的偏差超过设定的阈值时，开立买入或卖出仓位，旨在利用外部数据源与经纪商价格之间的临时定价偏差。
EA-12442.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA属于统计套利类型，通过从Google Finance获取外部股票报价，与自身记录的历史价格进行对比，寻找价格偏离机会。入场条件：当当前报价与历史参考价格（可配置回溯分钟数前的价格）的差值超过BarSize阈值时入场——差值大于HistoryPrice+BarSize时做多，差值小于HistoryPrice-BarSize时做空。出场条件：采用固定的止盈和止损（TpPips/SlPips），同时还有一个基于延迟时间（DeelayPosition）的超时平仓机制，当持仓时间超过从历史数据推算的延迟时间后强制平仓。仓位管理：使用固定手数（Lots参数），并通过Count参数限制最大开仓次数，每天重置计数器。资金管理：无明显资金管理策略，固定手数交易，止损设置极大（SlPips=5000），而止盈极小（TpPips=10），风险收益比极不对称。
EA-12442.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is statistical arbitrage, scraping external stock quotes from Google Finance and comparing them against internally recorded historical prices to detect pricing deviations. Entry conditions: A buy is triggered when the current quote deviation exceeds HistoryPrice + BarSize, and a sell when it falls below HistoryPrice - BarSize, where HistoryPrice is the price from a configurable number of minutes ago. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit (TpPips) and stop-loss (SlPips), plus a time-based exit mechanism where positions are closed after a delay period derived from historical price timestamps. Position sizing uses fixed lots with no dynamic adjustment, and the Count parameter caps the maximum number of trades per session, resetting daily. Money management is essentially absent — the default SL is 5000 ticks while TP is only 10 ticks, creating an extremely asymmetric and dangerous risk-reward ratio.

EA-1245.name: Exp_AnchoredMomentum
EA-1245.summary: This EA trades based on the Anchored Momentum custom indicator, opening buy positions when momentum crosses above the upper level and sell positions when it crosses below the lower level. It uses a custom indicator handle with configurable SMA/EMA periods and threshold levels for signal generation. Position sizing uses a deposit share mechanism with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit in points.
EA-1245.summary_zh: 该EA基于Anchored Momentum自定义指标进行交易，当动量突破上轨时开多仓，跌破下轨时开空仓。使用可配置的SMA/EMA周期和阈值水平生成信号，仓位管理采用存款比例机制并配合固定的止损止盈点数。
EA-1245.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于锚定动量指标（Anchored Momentum）的突破交易。入场条件为：当指标值从上方穿越上轨（UpLevel=+0.025）时产生买入信号，当指标值从下方穿越下轨（DnLevel=-0.025）时产生卖出信号，采用的是穿越确认而非单纯阈值判断，避免假信号。出场条件包括：持有多头时指标跌破下轨则平多仓，持有空头时指标升破上轨则平空仓，同时每笔交易设有固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现。策略使用新K线检测机制（IsNewBar）来避免同根K线重复交易，但也允许SignalBar=0时逐tick执行。默认H4周期配合动量指标，属于中长线动量突破策略。
EA-1245.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on breakthrough trading using the Anchored Momentum indicator. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the indicator value crosses above the upper level (UpLevel=+0.025) from below, and a sell signal is generated when the indicator value crosses below the lower level (DnLevel=-0.025) from above, using crossover confirmation rather than simple threshold comparison to avoid false signals. Exit conditions include: closing long positions when the indicator falls below the lower level while holding long, and closing short positions when the indicator rises above the upper level while holding short, with each trade also having fixed Stop Loss (1000 points) and Take Profit (2000 points). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based lot calculation. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen for execution. The strategy uses a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated trades on the same bar, but also allows tick-by-tick execution when SignalBar=0. With a default H4 timeframe and momentum indicator, this is a medium-to-long-term momentum breakout strategy.

EA-1246.name: dde_example
EA-1246.summary: This EA is a DDE (Dynamic Data Exchange) example that demonstrates how to exchange data between MetaTrader 5 and external applications via the DDE protocol. It does not implement any trading strategy but serves as a technical utility for inter-process communication. The EA likely publishes or subscribes to market data and account information through DDE topics.
EA-1246.summary_zh: 该EA是一个DDE（动态数据交换）示例，演示了如何在MetaTrader 5与外部应用程序之间通过DDE协议进行数据交换。它不实现任何交易策略，而是作为进程间通信的技术工具。该EA可能通过DDE主题发布或订阅市场数据和账户信息。
EA-1246.strategy_analysis: 此EA不包含任何交易策略，它是一个DDE通信工具。DDE（动态数据交换）是Windows平台上一种进程间通信机制，允许MT5与外部程序（如Excel）实时共享数据。该EA的核心功能是建立DDE连接，将MT5中的行情数据、账户信息等通过DDE话题（Topic）暴露给外部应用程序。它不涉及任何入场条件、出场条件或仓位管理逻辑。资金管理方面也没有相关实现，因为该EA纯粹是数据传输工具。风险方面，由于不执行交易，因此不存在交易风险，但DDE连接本身的稳定性需要注意。
EA-1246.strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not contain any trading strategy; it is a DDE communication utility. DDE (Dynamic Data Exchange) is an inter-process communication mechanism on the Windows platform that allows MT5 to share data in real-time with external programs such as Excel. The core functionality of this EA is to establish DDE connections and expose MT5 market data, account information, and other data through DDE topics to external applications. It does not involve any entry conditions, exit conditions, or position sizing logic whatsoever. There is no money management implementation since the EA is purely a data transmission tool. In terms of risk, since it does not execute trades, there is no trading risk, but the stability of the DDE connection itself should be noted.

EA-12528.name: Exp_FisherCyberCycle
EA-12528.summary: This EA trades based on the FisherCyberCycle custom indicator, generating buy signals when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell signals when it crosses below. It uses a configurable money management system with multiple margin modes and supports independent control of position opening and closing for both buy and sell directions.
EA-12528.summary_zh: 该EA基于FisherCyberCycle自定义指标进行交易，当指标线上穿信号线时产生买入信号，下穿时产生卖出信号。它采用可配置的资金管理系统，支持多种保证金模式，并可独立控制多空方向的开仓和平仓。
EA-12528.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于FisherCyberCycle指标，这是一种将Fisher变换应用于网络周期（CyberCycle）振荡器的技术指标，旨在产生更平滑、更锐利的转折信号。入场条件为：当指标线（Ind）高于信号线（Sign）且前一根K线上指标线低于或等于信号线时开多仓；当指标线低于信号线且前一根K线上指标线高于或等于信号线时开空仓。出场条件同样基于指标交叉信号，当多头信号消失时平多仓，空头信号消失时平空仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的可用保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1，配合MMMode选择计算方式。EA还采用了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线内重复交易，但仅在SignalBar为0时或新K线出现时才重新计算信号。
EA-12528.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the FisherCyberCycle indicator, which applies the Fisher Transform to a CyberCycle oscillator to produce smoother and sharper turning point signals. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the indicator line (Ind) is above the signal line (Sign) and the previous bar's indicator line was at or below the signal line; a sell position opens when the indicator line is below the signal line and the previous bar's indicator line was at or above the signal line. Exit conditions are also based on indicator crossovers: long positions close when the bullish signal disappears, and short positions close when the bearish signal disappears, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points. Position sizing supports five margin modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default of 0.1, combined with MMMode to select the calculation method. The EA also employs a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated trading within the same bar, recalculating signals only when SignalBar is 0 or a new bar appears.

EA-12529.name: Exp_RangeExpansionIndex
EA-12529.summary: This EA trades based on the Range Expansion Index (REI) indicator, opening buy positions when REI crosses above the lower threshold from below and sell positions when REI crosses below the upper threshold from above. It uses configurable money management modes, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and processes signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant entries. The strategy is a mean-reversion system that enters when the indicator exits extreme zones.
EA-12529.summary_zh: 该EA基于范围扩张指数(REI)指标进行交易，当REI从下方向上穿越下限时开多仓，从上方向下穿越上限时开空仓。它支持多种资金管理模式、固定止损止盈，并在新K线形成时处理信号以避免重复入场。该策略属于均值回归系统，在指标脱离极端区域时入场。
EA-12529.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Range Expansion Index（REI）指标，该指标衡量价格范围扩张的程度，属于DeMark指标家族。入场条件为：当REI从下方穿越-60下限向上时开多仓，当REI从上方穿越+60上限向下时开空仓，本质上是在指标从超卖/超买区域回归时入场，属于均值回归逻辑。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓：当REI高于-60时平多仓，低于+60时平空仓，同时设置固定止损1000点和止盈2000点作为额外保护。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例、以及固定手数，通过MarginMode枚举选择。资金管理参数MM控制下单比例或手数大小，默认0.1在固定手数模式下表示0.1手。策略还允许通过输入参数单独控制买卖方向的开启和平仓，提供灵活的交易控制。
EA-12529.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Range Expansion Index (REI) indicator, which measures the degree of price range expansion and belongs to the DeMark indicator family. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when REI crosses above the -60 lower level from below, and open a sell position when REI crosses below the +60 upper level from above, essentially entering when the indicator reverts from extreme zones, which is a mean-reversion logic. Exit conditions are triggered by reverse signals: close buy positions when REI is above -60, close sell positions when REI is below +60, with fixed stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points as additional protection. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size, selectable via the MarginMode enumeration. The MM parameter controls the trading proportion or lot size, defaulting to 0.1 which means 0.1 lots in fixed lot mode. The strategy also allows independent control of buy/sell direction opening and closing through input parameters, providing flexible trading control.

EA-1253.name: Exp_GG-RSI-CCI
EA-1253.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the GG-RSI-CCI custom indicator, which combines RSI and CCI with multi-layer smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2), sell positions on a downtrend signal (value=0), and optionally closes positions on a flat signal (value=1). Position sizing uses a deposit share model with configurable stop loss and take profit.
EA-1253.summary_zh: 该EA基于GG-RSI-CCI自定义指标的信号进行交易，该指标结合了RSI和CCI并经过多层平滑处理。当指标发出上升趋势信号（值=2）时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号（值=0）时开空仓，并在可选的平盘信号（值=1）时平仓。仓位管理采用存款比例模型，配有可配置的止损和止盈。
EA-1253.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于GG-RSI-CCI指标，该指标将RSI和CCI两个动量振荡器结合，通过用户可选择的多层平滑算法（SMA、EMA、SMMA、JJMA、JurX等十种方法）进行双重平滑处理。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值为2时产生买入信号，值为0时产生卖出信号，且当前信号与前一根K线信号不同时才开仓，避免重复入场。出场条件分为两种模式：MODE_FLAT模式下，指标值为1时同时平多仓和空仓；MODE_TREND模式下，仅在反向信号出现时才平仓（买入信号平空仓，卖出信号平多仓）。仓位管理采用MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表存款比例。资金管理通过StopLoss和TakeProfit参数实现固定点数止损止盈，同时设有价格偏差限制防止滑点过大。策略使用多周期框架，指标可在不同于图表的时间周期上运行，增强了灵活性。
EA-1253.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the GG-RSI-CCI indicator, which combines two momentum oscillators (RSI and CCI) and applies double smoothing using a user-selectable algorithm from ten available methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 value equals 2, a sell signal when it equals 0, and positions are only opened when the current signal differs from the previous bar's signal to prevent duplicate entries. Exit conditions operate in two modes: MODE_FLAT closes both long and short positions when the indicator value is 1 (flat/neutral), while MODE_TREND only closes positions on opposing trend signals (buy signal closes shorts, sell signal closes longs). Position sizing uses the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management is implemented through fixed-point StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters, with a price deviation limit (Deviation_) to prevent excessive slippage. The strategy supports multi-timeframe operation, allowing the indicator to run on a timeframe different from the chart, enhancing flexibility in signal generation.

EA-12543.name: Exp_Ozymandias
EA-12543.summary: This EA trades based on the Ozymandias custom indicator, which signals trend direction changes via buffer values of 0 and 1. It opens buy positions when the indicator switches from 0 to 1 and sell positions when it switches from 1 to 0, with configurable stop loss and take profit. Position management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms library for both opening and closing trades.
EA-12543.summary_zh: 该EA基于Ozymandias自定义指标进行交易，该指标通过缓冲区值0和1来发出趋势方向变化信号。当指标从0变为1时开多仓，从1变为0时开空仓，并可配置止损和止盈。仓位管理委托给TradeAlgorithms库来执行开仓和平仓操作。
EA-12543.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于Ozymandias指标的趋势跟踪，该指标通过平滑移动平均和价格通道计算来识别趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区值从0变为1时开多仓，表示上升趋势确立；当指标缓冲区值从1变为0时开空仓，表示下降趋势确立。出场条件包括：反向信号触发时平仓（多仓在指标变为0时平仓，空仓在指标变为1时平仓），以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理采用MM参数控制仓位大小，支持手数模式和保证金比例模式两种资金管理方式。EA仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算，提高了执行效率。然而，策略缺乏加仓和减仓逻辑，止盈止损为固定点数而非基于ATR等动态指标，在波动性变化大的市场中可能不够灵活。
EA-12543.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is trend following based on the Ozymandias indicator, which identifies trend direction through smoothed moving averages and price channel calculations. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the indicator buffer switches from 0 to 1, signaling an uptrend establishment; a sell position opens when the buffer switches from 1 to 0, signaling a downtrend establishment. Exit conditions include: closing on reverse signal (longs close when indicator becomes 0, shorts close when indicator becomes 1), plus fixed-pip stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both lot-based mode and margin-based percentage mode for money management. The EA only calculates signals on new bar formation rather than every tick, which improves execution efficiency by avoiding redundant recalculations. However, the strategy lacks position scaling logic (no add-to or reduce-from existing positions), and the stop loss/take profit are fixed pip values rather than dynamically calculated using ATR or similar volatility-based indicators, which may be inflexible in markets with varying volatility conditions.

EA-12548.name: Exp_ElderImpulseSystem
EA-12548.summary: This EA implements Alexander Elder's Impulse System, which combines a 13-period EMA with MACD histogram direction to determine trend impulse. It opens buy positions when both EMA and MACD histogram are bullish, opens sell positions when both are bearish, and closes positions when the impulse reverses. The system uses the custom ElderImpulseSystem indicator buffers to read color-coded signal values for entry and exit decisions.
EA-12548.summary_zh: 该EA实现了亚历山大·埃尔德的冲动系统，结合13周期EMA和MACD柱状图方向来判断趋势冲动。当EMA和MACD柱状图同时看涨时开多仓，同时看跌时开空仓，冲动反转时平仓。系统通过自定义ElderImpulseSystem指标的缓冲区读取颜色编码的信号值来做出入场和出场决策。
EA-12548.strategy_analysis: 该EA基于亚历山大·埃尔德的冲动系统策略，核心概念是同时使用趋势指标（EMA）和动量指标（MACD柱状图）来确认趋势冲动。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区值为2（看涨冲动）且前一值为1或0时开多仓；当值为1（看跌冲动）且前一值为0或2时开空仓。出场条件为：当冲动信号反转时平仓——看涨冲动出现时平空仓，看跌冲动出现时平多仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或保证金比例模式（MM参数），支持LOT和FREEMARGIN两种模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制，默认0.1表示10%的可用保证金用于开仓。止损和止盈分别默认设为1000点和2000点，风险回报比为1:2。系统仅在信号柱发生变化或新K线出现时重新计算信号，避免重复交易。
EA-12548.strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements Alexander Elder's Impulse System strategy, whose core concept combines a trend indicator (EMA) with a momentum indicator (MACD histogram) to confirm trend impulses. Entry conditions: when the indicator buffer value is 2 (bullish impulse) and the previous value is 1 or 0, a buy position opens; when the value is 1 (bearish impulse) and the previous value is 0 or 2, a sell position opens. Exit conditions: positions close when the impulse signal reverses — sell positions close on bullish impulse, buy positions close on bearish impulse. Position sizing uses either fixed lot or margin percentage mode (MM parameter), supporting LOT and FREEMARGIN modes. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter, defaulting to 0.1 meaning 10% of available margin is used for opening positions. Stop loss and take profit default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. The system only recalculates signals when the signal bar changes or a new bar appears, preventing redundant trades.

EA-12549.name: Exp_Modified_Optimum_Elliptic_Filter
EA-12549.summary: This EA trades based on the Modified Optimum Elliptic Filter indicator, opening buy positions when the filter values are rising and sell positions when they are falling. It uses a new-bar check to generate signals and applies configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management settings. The strategy is a trend-following system that enters in the direction of the filter's slope.
EA-12549.summary_zh: 该EA基于修正最优椭圆滤波器指标进行交易，当滤波器数值上升时开多仓，下降时开空仓。它使用新K线检测生成信号，并支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理参数。策略属于趋势跟踪系统，沿滤波器斜率方向入场。
EA-12549.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用修正最优椭圆滤波器（Modified Optimum Elliptic Filter）作为核心趋势判断指标，通过比较滤波器在连续三个数据点上的值来确定趋势方向。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（滤波器上升）且Value[0]>Value[1]（持续上升）时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（滤波器下降）且Value[0]<Value[1]（持续下降）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈设置，同时当反向信号出现时也会平仓（如上升趋势中出现下降信号则平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制手数比例，支持LOT和MARGIN两种模式。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms库中的标准化函数进行买卖操作，包含偏差控制以应对滑点。策略使用新K线检测来避免重复信号，确保每个K线周期只产生一次交易信号。
EA-12549.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Modified Optimum Elliptic Filter as its core trend-determination indicator, comparing three consecutive filter values to identify trend direction. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] (filter rising) and Value[0]>Value[1] (continuing to rise); a sell position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] (filter falling) and Value[0]<Value[1] (continuing to fall). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings, and opposing signals also trigger position closes (e.g., a sell signal closes any open buy position). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting both LOT and MARGIN modes through the MarginMode enumeration. Money management uses standardized functions from the TradeAlgorithms library for buy/sell operations, including deviation control to handle slippage. The strategy employs a new-bar check via the CIsNewBar class to prevent duplicate signals, ensuring only one trading signal per bar period.

EA-1255.name: Exp_DSSBressert
EA-1255.summary: This EA trades based on the DSS Bressert double smoothed stochastic indicator, opening buy positions when the smoothed stochastic crosses upward and sell positions when it crosses downward. It uses a crossover of two indicator buffer lines (UpValue/DnValue) on a configurable timeframe to generate entry and exit signals, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1255.summary_zh: 该EA基于DSS Bressert双平滑随机指标进行交易，当平滑随机指标向上交叉时开多仓，向下交叉时开空仓。它在可配置的时间周期上使用两个指标缓冲区线的交叉来生成入场和出场信号，并设有固定的止损和止盈水平。
EA-1255.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于DSS Bressert双平滑随机指标的交叉信号。入场条件为：当UpValue线从下方穿越DnValue线时产生买入信号，当DnValue线从下方穿越UpValue线时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括：持有多头时DnValue上穿UpValue触发平多仓，持有空头时UpValue上穿DnValue触发平空仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理方面，止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，风险回报比为1:2。EA仅在新增K线时检测信号，避免重复交易，并使用SignalBar参数允许在第0根或第1根K线获取信号。
EA-1255.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on crossover signals from the DSS Bressert double smoothed stochastic indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the UpValue line crosses above the DnValue line, and a sell signal is generated when the DnValue line crosses above the UpValue line. Exit conditions include closing long positions when DnValue crosses above UpValue, and closing short positions when UpValue crosses above DnValue, along with fixed stop loss at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a proportion of the deposit. Money management features a 1:2 risk-reward ratio with 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit. The EA only checks for signals on new bars to avoid redundant trades, and uses the SignalBar parameter to allow signal retrieval from either bar 0 or bar 1.

EA-1256.name: Exp_UltraFatl
EA-1256.summary: This EA trades based on the UltraFatl custom indicator, a multi-period smoothed trend-following oscillator. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from below 5 to above 4, and sell positions when it transitions from above 4 to below 5, using the signal bar crossover logic. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels, with optional position closing on reverse signals.
EA-1256.summary_zh: 该EA基于UltraFatl自定义指标进行交易，该指标是一个多周期平滑的趋势跟踪振荡器。当指标从5以下穿越到4以上时开多仓，从4以上穿越到5以下时开空仓。使用固定止损和止盈管理仓位，并可选择在反转信号时平仓。
EA-1256.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于UltraFatl指标的趋势跟踪系统。UltraFatl指标使用了双重平滑算法：首先对价格进行多步进周期（nStep×nStepsTotal）的初始平滑（支持JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等多种方法），然后再对结果进行二次平滑处理，最终生成一个0-10范围内的振荡值。入场条件：当指标值从低于5的区域穿越到高于4的区域时产生买入信号（Value[1]>4且Value[0]<5且Value[0]非零），当指标值从高于4的区域穿越到低于5的区域时产生卖出信号（Value[1]<5且Value[1]非零且Value[0]>4）。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），以及反向信号平仓权限。仓位管理使用存款份额或固定手数（MM参数为负时表示固定手数）。资金管理采用简单的比例仓位或固定手数模式，没有动态调整机制。策略仅在新K线形成时检测信号，避免重复交易。
EA-1256.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the UltraFatl indicator. The UltraFatl indicator employs a dual smoothing algorithm: first applying multi-step period (nStep×nStepsTotal) initial smoothing to the price using various methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA, etc.), then applying a secondary smoothing to produce an oscillator value in the 0-10 range. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator value crosses from below 5 to above 4 (Value[1]>4 and Value[0]<5 and Value[0] non-zero), while a sell signal is generated when the indicator crosses from above 4 to below 5 (Value[1]<5 and Value[1] non-zero and Value[0]>4). Exit conditions include fixed Stop Loss (1000 points) and Take Profit (2000 points), plus optional reverse signal position closing permissions. Position sizing uses either a deposit share percentage or fixed lot size (negative MM parameter means fixed lot). Money management follows a simple proportional or fixed lot scheme without dynamic adjustment. The strategy only checks signals on new bar formation to avoid duplicate trades.

EA-12560.name: Exp_Leading
EA-12560.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom 'Leading' indicator, which uses two EMA-like smoothing lines with configurable alpha coefficients. It opens buy positions when Ma1 crosses above Ma2 and sell positions when Ma1 crosses below Ma2, with optional close-on-reverse-signal functionality and fixed stop loss/take profit levels.
EA-12560.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Leading'指标的均线交叉信号进行交易，该指标使用两个可配置alpha系数的类EMA平滑线。当Ma1上穿Ma2时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，支持反向信号平仓及固定止损止盈。
EA-12560.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于Leading指标的两条平滑线交叉来判断趋势方向，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当Ma1[1]>Ma2[1]且Ma1[0]<Ma2[0]时，检测到金叉信号，开启买入；当Ma1[1]<Ma2[1]且Ma1[0]>Ma2[0]时，检测到死叉信号，开启卖出。出场条件包括固定止损（1000点）和固定止盈（2000点），以及反向交叉信号触发的平仓功能。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持手数模式和保证金比例模式两种资金管理方式。资金管理采用固定的止损止盈比例（1:2），风险回报比合理。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，同时通过SignalBar参数允许选择信号来源K线的位置。
EA-12560.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on the crossover of two smoothed lines from the Leading indicator to determine trend direction, making it a classic trend-following system. Entry conditions: when Ma1[1]>Ma2[1] and Ma1[0]<Ma2[0], a golden cross is detected and a buy position is opened; when Ma1[1]<Ma2[1] and Ma1[0]>Ma2[0], a death cross is detected and a sell position is opened. Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss of 1000 points, a fixed take profit of 2000 points, and optional closing on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both lot-based mode and margin-based percentage mode for money management. The risk-reward ratio is set at 1:2 (stop loss 1000 vs take profit 2000), which is reasonable. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting which bar's data to use for signal generation.

EA-12573.name: Exp_HLRSign
EA-12573.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom HLRSign indicator, which identifies overbought and oversold conditions using Highest Low Range levels. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable entry/exit logic and money management modes.
EA-12573.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义HLRSign指标的信号进行交易，该指标通过最高低价范围(HLR)水平识别超买和超卖状态。在向上信号时开多仓，向下信号时开空仓，具有可配置的入场/出场逻辑和资金管理模式。
EA-12573.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于HLRSign指标，该指标利用最高低价范围(HLR)计算超买超卖水平，当指标值突破上轨(HLR_UpLevel=80)时产生买入信号，突破下轨(HLR_DnLevel=20)时产生卖出信号。入场条件分为两种模式：MODE_IN表示指标从信号线内穿越到外部时入场，MODE_OUT表示从外部穿越到信号线时入场。出场条件支持反向信号平仓，即当出现买入信号时同时平掉卖出仓位，反之亦然，也可以通过遍历历史K线寻找最近的反向信号来确认平仓。仓位管理提供了五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、含浮亏自由保证金比例、含浮亏余额比例和固定手数，默认使用固定手数0.1手。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险敞口大小，并设置了1000点止损和2000点止盈来限制单笔交易的风险。该EA还包含新K线检测机制，避免在同一根K线上重复交易，并通过Deviation参数控制滑点容忍度。
EA-12573.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the HLRSign indicator, which uses the Highest Low Range (HLR) to calculate overbought and oversold levels, generating buy signals when the indicator breaks above the upper level (HLR_UpLevel=80) and sell signals when it breaks below the lower level (HLR_DnLevel=20). Entry conditions come in two modes: MODE_IN triggers when the indicator crosses from inside the signal zone outward, while MODE_OUT triggers when it crosses from outside into the signal zone. Exit conditions support reverse-signal closing, where a buy signal simultaneously closes sell positions and vice versa, and the EA can also iterate through historical bars to find the nearest reverse signal for confirmation. Position sizing offers five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size, defaulting to a fixed lot of 0.1. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter to regulate risk exposure, with a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit set to limit per-trade risk. The EA also implements a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate trades on the same bar and uses a Deviation parameter to control slippage tolerance.

EA-12581.name: Exp_simple_trading_system
EA-12581.summary: This EA implements a simple trend-following trading system based on a custom indicator called 'simple_trading_system' that generates up/down arrow signals. It opens buy positions on up signals and sell positions on down signals, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels, and supports multiple money management modes including lot-based and margin-based sizing.
EA-12581.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标'simple_trading_system'生成的上下箭头信号实现简单的趋势跟踪交易系统。在上涨信号时开多仓，在下跌信号时开空仓，支持可配置的止损止盈水平，并提供包括固定手数和保证金比例在内的多种资金管理模式。
EA-12581.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于自定义指标simple_trading_system产生的趋势方向信号进行顺势交易，该指标内部使用EMA移动平均线作为核心计算基础。入场条件为：当指标第1缓冲区（UpValue）在指定信号K线上产生非零非空值时开多仓，当第0缓冲区（DnValue）产生非零非空值时开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置，以及反向信号的平仓逻辑——当同时开启开仓和平仓权限且当前无平仓信号时，EA会回溯历史K线查找最近的反向信号来决定是否平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制比例或手数大小，MMMode参数选择具体的计算模式，整体策略逻辑清晰但较为简单，缺乏对市场波动性和交易成本（点差）的考虑。
EA-12581.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend-following signals generated by the custom 'simple_trading_system' indicator, which internally uses EMA as its core calculation foundation. Entry conditions are: a buy position is opened when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar, and a sell position is opened when buffer 0 (DnValue) produces such a value. Exit conditions include hard stop loss and take profit levels, plus a reverse-signal closing logic — when both opening and closing permissions are enabled and no close signal exists, the EA backtracks through historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal to determine whether to close positions. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for ratio or lot size and the MMMode parameter for selecting the specific calculation mode. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively simple, lacking consideration for market volatility and trading costs such as spread.

EA-12586.name: Exp_TrendlessAG_Hist
EA-12586.summary: This EA trades based on the TrendlessAG_Hist custom indicator, which applies double smoothing to a detrended price oscillator. It opens buy positions when the histogram rises and sell positions when it falls, with configurable signal bar and smoothing parameters.
EA-12586.summary_zh: 该EA基于TrendlessAG_Hist自定义指标进行交易，该指标对去趋势价格振荡器进行双重平滑处理。当直方图上升时开多仓，下降时开空仓，具有可配置的信号K线和平滑参数。
EA-12586.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于TrendlessAG_Hist指标的双重平滑去趋势振荡器，通过第一层平滑去除价格趋势，再通过百分比归一化和第二层平滑生成交易信号。入场条件为：当直方图值从下方穿越前一周期值时开多仓（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]），当直方图值从上方穿越前一周期值时开空仓（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）。出场条件为反向信号触发平仓，即多头信号时平空仓，空头信号时平多仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理采用基于账户保证金的百分比计算手数，支持固定手数和保证金比例两种模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制仓位大小，但缺乏最大持仓限制和账户权益保护机制。
EA-12586.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the TrendlessAG_Hist indicator, a double-smoothed detrended oscillator that first removes price trend via smoothing, then normalizes by percentage and applies a second smoothing layer to generate signals. Entry conditions: buy when the histogram rises above its previous value (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and sell when the histogram falls below its previous value (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions are triggered by reverse signals — closing sell positions on buy signals and closing buy positions on sell signals, with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points. Position sizing uses a margin-based percentage calculation controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot and margin ratio modes via MMMode. Money management is basic, lacking maximum position limits, equity protection, or drawdown controls, relying solely on the MM fraction and fixed SL/TP for risk containment.

EA-12594.name: Exp_NRatioSign
EA-12594.summary: This EA trades based on the NRatioSign custom indicator signals, which is a normalized ratio oscillator with configurable smoothing and price inputs. It opens buy positions when the indicator's upper buffer signals and sell positions when the lower buffer signals, with separate controls for entry and exit. The EA supports multiple money management modes and fixed stop loss/take profit levels.
EA-12594.summary_zh: 该EA基于NRatioSign自定义指标信号进行交易，NRatioSign是一个带可配置平滑和价格输入的归一化比率振荡器。当指标上轨发出信号时开多仓，下轨发出信号时开空仓，入场和出场可独立控制。支持多种资金管理模式和固定止损/止盈。
EA-12594.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于NRatioSign指标的动量信号，该指标通过平滑算法对价格比率进行归一化处理，产生超买超卖信号。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号K线上出现非零且非空值时，触发买入开仓和卖出平仓；当下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）出现有效信号时，触发卖出开仓和买入平仓。出场条件包括：固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向指标信号触发的平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于自由保证金、余额、减亏损自由保证金、减亏损余额的比例计算，以及固定手数。EA还具有反向信号扫描机制——当开仓和平仓同时启用但当前K线未产生平仓信号时，会向后遍历历史K线寻找最近的反向平仓信号，以减少持仓时间。整体策略属于信号驱动的系统化交易，依赖单一指标的多参数配置。
EA-12594.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on momentum signals from the NRatioSign indicator, which normalizes price ratios through configurable smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, etc.) to generate overbought/oversold signals. Entry conditions: when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) shows a non-zero, non-empty value on the specified signal bar, it triggers buy entry and sell close; when the lower buffer (buffer 0) shows a valid signal, it triggers sell entry and buy close. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus reverse indicator signal closes. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, balance, balance minus loss, free margin minus loss, or fixed lot size. The EA also features a reverse signal scanning mechanism — when both open and close flags are enabled but no close signal appears on the current bar, it scans backward through historical bars to find the nearest reverse close signal, reducing position holding time. The overall strategy is a signal-driven systematic trading approach relying on a single indicator with extensive parameter configuration.

EA-126.name: AutoRKD EA
EA-126.summary: AutoRKD EA is an automated trading system that uses the RKD (Random Key Derivation) custom oscillator indicator to generate buy and sell signals. It enters trades when the RKD indicator crosses key overbought and oversold threshold levels, operating systematically without manual intervention. The EA typically applies fixed lot sizing and includes basic stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms for trade management.
EA-126.summary_zh: AutoRKD EA是一个基于RKD自定义振荡器指标生成买卖信号的自动化交易系统。当RKD指标穿越关键超买和超卖阈值水平时开仓交易，无需人工干预地系统化运行。该EA通常采用固定手数并包含基本的止损和止盈机制进行交易管理。
EA-126.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心基于RKD自定义振荡器指标，该指标类似于随机指标但采用不同的计算方法来衡量价格动量。入场条件为：当RKD指标从超卖区域向上穿越时产生买入信号，当RKD指标从超买区域向下穿越时产生卖出信号，典型的超买超卖阈值分别为70-80和20-30。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，部分版本可能在RKD指标回到中性区域时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，根据用户设定的参数确定每笔交易的手数，未发现基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，EA依赖止损止盈比率来控制单笔交易风险，但缺乏整体账户级别的风险控制如最大回撤限制或连续亏损保护。策略整体属于动量反转混合型，在超买超卖区域寻找反转信号入场。
EA-126.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the RKD custom oscillator indicator, which is similar to the Stochastic oscillator but uses a different calculation method to measure price momentum. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the RKD indicator crosses upward from the oversold zone, and a sell signal is generated when the RKD indicator crosses downward from the overbought zone, with typical overbought/oversold thresholds at 70-80 and 20-30 respectively. Exit conditions rely on preset stop-loss and take-profit levels, and some versions may close positions when the RKD indicator returns to the neutral zone. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach determined by user-set parameters, with no dynamic position adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management relies on stop-loss and take-profit ratios to control per-trade risk, but lacks account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or consecutive loss protection. The strategy overall is a momentum-reversal hybrid type, seeking reversal signals in overbought and oversold zones for entry.

EA-12606.name: Exp_AFL_WinnerSign
EA-12606.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom AFL_WinnerSign indicator, which identifies momentum-based buy and sell signals. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options. The EA includes both entry and exit logic driven by the same indicator, supporting position reversal or independent close signals.
EA-12606.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义AFL_WinnerSign指标的信号进行交易，该指标识别基于动量的买卖信号。在上升信号时开多单，下降信号时开空单，具有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。EA包含由同一指标驱动的入场和出场逻辑，支持仓位反转或独立平仓信号。
EA-12606.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用AFL_WinnerSign指标识别动量方向并顺势交易。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）在指定信号K线上产生非零且非空值时，开多单并平空单；当缓冲区0（DnValue）产生有效信号时，开空单并平多单。出场条件分为两类：一是反向信号出场（指标发出反向信号时平仓），二是止损/止盈出场（默认SL=1000点，TP=2000点）。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金等5种资金管理方式。策略还包含一个回溯逻辑：当开仓和平仓同时启用但当前K线未产生平仓信号时，会向前遍历历史K线寻找最近的反向信号以决定是否平仓。该EA默认在H6周期运行，使用可配置的平滑算法（SMA/EMA/JJMA等）和多种应用价格类型。
EA-12606.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses the AFL_WinnerSign indicator to identify momentum direction and trade with the trend. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE signal on the specified signal bar, a buy position is opened and sell positions are closed; when buffer 0 (DnValue) produces a valid signal, a sell position is opened and buy positions are closed. Exit conditions come in two types: first, reverse-signal exits where the indicator issues an opposite signal triggering closure; second, stop loss/take profit exits with default SL=1000 points and TP=2000 points. Position sizing leverages TradeAlgorithms.mqh with five money management modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, loss-based balance, and loss-based free margin. The strategy also includes a lookback logic: when both open and close flags are enabled but no close signal appears on the current bar, the EA scans forward through historical bars to find the nearest reverse signal for closure decisions. The EA defaults to H6 timeframe and supports configurable smoothing algorithms (SMA/EMA/JJMA etc.) with multiple applied price types.

EA-12641.name: RiskManager
EA-12641.summary: RiskManager is a utility EA designed to monitor and manage risk across open positions and the overall account. It provides real-time risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits, position size validation, and automated protective actions when risk thresholds are breached. The EA does not open trades based on its own signals but acts as a safeguard layer for other trading strategies.
EA-12641.summary_zh: RiskManager是一个工具型EA，用于监控和管理持仓及账户整体风险。它提供实时风险控制，包括最大回撤限制、仓位大小验证以及在风险阈值被突破时自动执行保护性操作。该EA不会基于自身信号开仓，而是作为其他交易策略的安全防护层。
EA-12641.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是风险监控与管理，而非主动交易。入场条件方面，EA不主动开仓，而是在检测到现有持仓风险超标时触发干预。出场条件方面，当账户回撤达到设定阈值、单笔亏损超限或总持仓风险过高时，EA会自动平仓或缩减仓位。仓位管理方面，EA提供仓位大小校验功能，确保新建仓位符合账户风险承受能力。资金管理方面，通过设定最大允许亏损比例、最大持仓量等参数来控制整体资金暴露。该EA的运作逻辑是持续扫描账户状态，对比用户设定的风险参数，一旦触发预警或止损条件即执行相应保护操作，如部分平仓、全部平仓或发送警报通知。
EA-12641.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is risk monitoring and management rather than active trading. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not open positions on its own but triggers interventions when it detects that existing position risk exceeds predefined thresholds. For exit conditions, when account drawdown reaches a set threshold, a single position loss exceeds its limit, or total position risk is too high, the EA automatically closes or reduces positions. In terms of position sizing, the EA provides position size validation to ensure new positions align with the account's risk tolerance. For money management, it controls overall capital exposure by setting maximum allowed loss percentages, maximum position sizes, and other risk parameters. The operational logic involves continuously scanning account status, comparing against user-defined risk parameters, and executing protective actions such as partial closes, full closes, or alert notifications whenever warning or stop-loss conditions are triggered.

EA-1268.name: Exp_XMA_Ichimoku_Channel
EA-1268.summary: This EA trades breakouts of the XMA Ichimoku Channel, buying when price closes above the upper channel border and selling when price closes below the lower channel border. It uses customizable smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) to construct the channel from averaged high/low prices with percentage-based band offsets. Exit signals are generated when price re-enters the channel after a breakout.
EA-1268.summary_zh: 该EA基于XMA一目均衡通道的突破进行交易，价格收盘突破上轨时买入，跌破下轨时卖出。通道由可配置的平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA等）对高低价进行平滑后加百分比偏移构建，价格重新回到通道内部时触发平仓信号。
EA-1268.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是基于XMA平滑一目均衡通道的突破交易，通道由对高低价时间序列进行平滑处理后加上下百分比偏移构建而成。入场条件为：当收盘价突破上轨时产生买入信号（需前一根K线未突破上轨以确认突破），当收盘价跌破下轨时产生卖出信号（同理需前一根K线未跌破下轨确认）。出场条件为：持有多头时价格回到通道内部触发平多信号，持有空头时价格回到通道内部触发平空信号，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理方面，策略依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数执行实际交易，包含最大滑点控制。策略在新K线形成时或SignalBar为0时进行信号判断，避免逐tick重复计算。
EA-1268.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is breakout trading based on the XMA Ichimoku Channel, which is constructed by smoothing high/low price time series with configurable algorithms and adding percentage-based upper and lower band offsets. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the close price breaks above the upper channel border (confirmed by the previous bar's close being at or below the upper border), and a sell signal is generated when the close price breaks below the lower channel border (with similar confirmation logic). Exit conditions: when holding a long position and price re-enters the channel, a close-long signal is triggered; similarly for short positions when price rises back into the channel, plus fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based lot calculation. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for actual trade execution, including maximum slippage control via the Deviation parameter. The strategy evaluates signals only on new bar formation or when SignalBar is 0, preventing redundant per-tick calculations.

EA-12711.name: Exp_ForexProfitBoost_2nb
EA-12711.summary: This EA uses a custom indicator ForexProfitBoost_2nb, which combines two moving averages with Bollinger Bands, to generate buy and sell signals. It opens and closes positions based on the intersection of upper and lower indicator buffer signals, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels. The EA operates on a new bar basis and supports independent control of buy/sell opening and closing.
EA-12711.summary_zh: 该EA使用自定义指标ForexProfitBoost_2nb，结合两条移动平均线和布林带来生成买卖信号。根据指标上下缓冲区信号的交叉来开仓和平仓，支持可配置的资金管理和止损止盈。EA以新K线为基础运行，并支持买卖开仓和平仓的独立控制。
EA-12711.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双移动平均线与布林带的组合指标ForexProfitBoost_2nb，属于趋势跟踪型策略。入场条件为：当上轨信号缓冲区(Up)出现非空值且下轨信号缓冲区(Dn)前一值也为非空值时开多仓；当下轨信号缓冲区(Dn)出现非空值且上轨信号缓冲区(Up)前一值也为非空值时开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈（默认分别为1000和2000点），以及反向信号触发平仓（BUY_Close和SELL_Close逻辑）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数和百分比模式（LOT和MARGIN模式）。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数，统一处理开仓和平仓逻辑。策略仅在新的K线出现时计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算，提高了效率。
EA-12711.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a combination indicator ForexProfitBoost_2nb that merges two moving averages with Bollinger Bands, classifying it as a trend-following system. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the upper buffer (Up) shows a non-empty value and the lower buffer (Dn) previous value is also non-empty; a sell signal is generated when the lower buffer (Dn) shows a non-empty value and the upper buffer (Up) previous value is also non-empty. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively), as well as reverse signal-triggered closing (BUY_Close and SELL_Close logic). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot size and margin-based percentage modes (LOT and MARGIN). Money management leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions for unified handling of opening and closing positions. The strategy only calculates signals on new bar formation rather than every tick, improving computational efficiency.

EA-1278.name: Exp_XMA_Range_Bands
EA-1278.summary: This EA trades breakouts from the XMA_Range_Bands channel indicator. It opens buy positions when price closes above the upper band and sell positions when price closes below the lower band, with optional permissions for entry and exit. Positions are managed using fixed stop loss and take profit levels with configurable money management.
EA-1278.summary_zh: 该EA基于XMA_Range_Bands通道指标进行突破交易。当价格收盘突破上轨时开多仓，跌破下轨时开空仓，支持入场和出场的独立权限控制。持仓使用固定止损止盈和可配置的资金管理方式。
EA-1278.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XMA_Range_Bands通道的突破交易。XMA_Range_Bands指标由一条移动平均中轨和上下两条通道带组成，通道宽度由K线振幅的平滑值乘以偏差系数决定。入场条件为：当收盘价从通道内突破上轨时触发买入信号，从通道内跌破下轨时触发卖出信号，且要求前一根K线的收盘价仍在通道内以确保是真正的突破而非已经处于通道外。出场条件依赖固定的止损止盈点数，同时当反向突破信号出现时也会主动平仓（如价格跌破下轨时平多头，突破上轨时平空头）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值为固定手数，正值代表存款比例。策略默认使用H4周期，结合多种平滑算法（SMA、JJMA等），适合捕捉中长期趋势的启动阶段。
EA-1278.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a breakout system based on the XMA_Range_Bands channel indicator. The XMA_Range_Bands consists of a moving average center line and upper/lower bands calculated from smoothed candle range multiplied by a deviation factor. Entry conditions trigger a buy signal when the close price breaks above the upper band from inside the channel, and a sell signal when the close price breaks below the lower band from inside the channel. The EA requires the previous bar's close to still be within the band to confirm a genuine breakout rather than an existing outside position. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit in points, while counter-breakout signals also trigger position closure — a break below the lower band closes longs, and a break above the upper band closes shorts. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. The strategy defaults to the H4 timeframe with configurable smoothing algorithms (SMA, JJMA, etc.), making it suitable for catching the early stages of medium-to-long-term trends.

EA-1279.name: Exp_AsimmetricStochNR
EA-1279.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom AsimmetricStochNR indicator, which is an asymmetric Stochastic with noise reduction. It opens buy positions when the Stochastic main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with independent permissions for entry and exit.
EA-1279.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义的AsimmetricStochNR指标（非对称噪声过滤随机指标）的交叉信号进行交易。当随机指标主线向上穿越信号线时开多仓，向下穿越时开空仓，入场和出场权限可独立配置。
EA-1279.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用非对称噪声过滤随机指标（AsimmetricStochNR）作为核心策略引擎，该指标融合了短周期（默认5）和长周期（默认12）的%K线计算，并通过可配置的平滑方法（默认SMA）生成%D信号线。入场条件为：当Stoch[1]>Sign[1]且Stoch[0]<Sign[0]时，主线从下方穿越信号线向上，触发买入信号；反之Stoch[1]<Sign[1]且Stoch[0]>Sign[0]时触发卖出信号。出场条件独立于入场，通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制是否允许平仓，当反向交叉信号出现时平掉对应仓位。仓位管理通过MM参数实现，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。止损和止盈分别默认为1000点和2000点，风险回报比为1:2。该策略运行在H4周期上，仅在新K线出现时计算信号，避免逐tick重复交易。噪声过滤参数Sens默认为7点，有助于减少虚假信号。超买超卖水平（80/20）传入指标但未在EA逻辑中直接用于过滤。
EA-1279.strategy_analysis_en: The EA uses the AsimmetricStochNR indicator as its core strategy engine, which combines short-period (default 5) and long-period (default 12) %K calculations and generates a %D signal line via a configurable smoothing method (default SMA). Entry conditions: when Stoch[1]>Sign[1] and Stoch[0]<Sign[0], the main line crosses above the signal line from below, triggering a buy signal; conversely, Stoch[1]<Sign[1] and Stoch[0]>Sign[0] triggers a sell signal. Exit conditions are independent from entries, controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters—when a reverse crossover occurs, the corresponding position is closed. Position sizing is handled via the MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot size, while positive values represent deposit share percentage. StopLoss defaults to 1000 points and TakeProfit to 2000 points, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. The strategy operates on H4 timeframe by default and only calculates signals on new bars to avoid tick-level redundant trading. The noise reduction parameter Sens defaults to 7 points, helping reduce false signals. Overbought/oversold levels (80/20) are passed to the indicator but not directly used as entry filters in the EA logic.
