EA-1354.name: Exp_ColorLeManTrend
EA-1354.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorLeManTrend indicator, which uses three moving averages (Min/Mid/Max) smoothed by an EMA to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator's up-line crosses above the down-line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, while providing configurable permissions for entry and exit. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels in points.
EA-1354.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorLeManTrend指标进行交易，该指标使用三组移动平均线（最小/中间/最大）经EMA平滑后判断趋势方向。当指标上线穿越下线时开多仓，反之开空仓，同时提供可配置的入场和出场权限。仓位使用固定的点数止损和止盈进行管理。
EA-1354.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于ColorLeManTrend指标的趋势跟踪系统，核心概念是利用三组不同周期（13/21/34）的移动平均线经EMA（周期3）平滑后的交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当UpValue[1]>DnValue[1]且前一根K线UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0]时产生买入信号，即上线从下方穿越下线；反之当上线从上方穿越下线时产生卖出信号。出场条件由两个部分组成：一是趋势反转时自动平仓（多头在卖出信号出现时平仓，空头在买入信号出现时平仓），二是使用固定的止损1000点和止盈2000点进行风险管理。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，当MM为负值时直接作为手数使用，当MM为正值时作为资金比例计算手数。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，支持按存款比例或固定手数两种方式，但缺乏加仓、减仓等动态仓位调整机制。
EA-1354.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is a trend-following system based on the ColorLeManTrend indicator, whose core concept uses crossovers of three moving average groups (periods 13/21/34) smoothed by an EMA (period 3) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when UpValue[1]>DnValue[1] and the previous bar's UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0], meaning the up-line has just crossed above the down-line; conversely, a sell signal occurs when the up-line crosses below the down-line. Exit conditions consist of two parts: automatic closing on trend reversal (long positions close when a sell signal appears, short positions close when a buy signal appears), and fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) for risk management. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter: negative values are used directly as lot size, while positive values represent a share of the deposit to calculate lot size. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, supporting both deposit-proportion and fixed-lot approaches, but lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms such as scaling in or out.

EA-13547.summary_zh: 该EA基于DiNapoli随机指标进行交易，当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓。支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，以及多空两侧开仓和平仓的独立开关。仅在新增K线时执行交易以避免重复信号。
EA-13547.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用DiNapoli随机指标作为核心交易信号源，属于动量交叉策略。入场条件：当指标线(%K)上穿信号线(%D)时产生买入信号，当指标线下穿信号线时产生卖出信号，具体通过比较相邻两根K线的指标值与信号值来判定交叉。出场条件：多头持仓在指标线下穿信号线时平仓，空头持仓在指标线上穿信号线时平仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制仓位大小比例，MMMode参数选择计算方式。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，同时通过BarsCalculated检查指标数据是否就绪。
EA-13547.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the DiNapoli Stochastic indicator as its core trading signal source, implementing a momentum crossover strategy. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator line crosses above the signal line, and a sell signal is generated when it crosses below, determined by comparing indicator and signal values across two consecutive bars. Exit conditions: long positions are closed when the indicator line crosses below the signal line, and short positions are closed on the opposite crossover, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for sizing ratio and the MMMode parameter for the calculation method. The EA employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing redundant trade entries, and verifies indicator data readiness via BarsCalculated before processing.

EA-1355.name: Exp_ColorTrend_CF
EA-1355.summary: This EA trades trend reversals detected by the ColorTrend_CF custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator's upper line crosses above the lower line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management settings.
EA-1355.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorTrend_CF自定义指标的趋势反转信号进行交易。当指标上线穿越下线时开多仓，反之开空仓，支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理参数。
EA-1355.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorTrend_CF指标的双线交叉判断趋势方向，属于典型的趋势跟踪型策略。入场条件为：当上线从下方穿越下线时产生买入信号，当上线从上方穿越下线时产生卖出信号，使用SignalBar参数指定的K线来获取信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发时平仓（如买入信号出现时平空仓，卖出信号出现时平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，没有在代码中直接看到更细致的风控逻辑。策略仅在出现新K线时检测信号，避免同一K线内重复交易，这是一个较好的设计。
EA-1355.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover of two lines from the ColorTrend_CF custom indicator to determine trend direction, making it a classic trend-following system. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the upper line crosses above the lower line, and a sell signal is generated when the upper line crosses below the lower line, using the bar specified by the SignalBar parameter for signal retrieval. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus closing positions on opposite signals — long positions close on sell signals and short positions close on buy signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent a fixed lot size and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, with no finer risk control logic visible in the code itself. The strategy only checks signals on new bar formation, preventing repeated trades within the same bar, which is a sound design choice.

EA-13554.name: Exp_DigVariation
EA-13554.summary: This EA trades based on the DigVariation custom indicator, which applies digital smoothing to a moving average. It opens buy positions when the smoothed value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
EA-13554.summary_zh: 该EA基于DigVariation自定义指标进行交易，该指标对移动平均线应用数字平滑处理。当平滑值向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并提供可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
EA-13554.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于DigVariation指标的趋势跟踪系统。DigVariation指标通过数字平滑算法（0-10级平滑强度）对移动平均线进行处理，减少噪音并识别趋势转折点。入场条件：当指标值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当指标值从上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），以及反向信号平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额比例、基于净值比例等。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险报酬比为1:2，属于中长线趋势跟踪风格。
EA-13554.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the DigVariation indicator. The DigVariation indicator applies a digital smoothing algorithm (0-10 smoothness levels) to a moving average, reducing noise and identifying trend reversal points. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator value turns from declining to rising (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]); a sell position is opened when the indicator value turns from rising to declining (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), as well as closing on opposite signals. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance-based proportion, equity-based proportion, etc. The strategy uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades. Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points yields a risk-reward ratio of 1:2, consistent with a medium-to-long-term trend-following style.

EA-13588.name: Exp_EMA-Crossover_Signal
EA-13588.summary: This EA trades based on the EMA-Crossover_Signal custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward crossover signals and sell positions on downward crossover signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggle controls for opening and closing positions on both sides. The strategy operates on new bar events with a historical bar lookup to determine if opposing positions should be closed.
EA-13588.summary_zh: 该EA基于EMA-Crossover_Signal自定义指标进行交易，在向上交叉信号时开多仓，在向下交叉信号时开空仓。它支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，以及买卖双边开平仓的独立开关控制。策略在新K线事件触发时运行，并通过历史K线回溯判断是否应平掉反向持仓。
EA-13588.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于两条不同周期的移动平均线交叉信号，快速MA上穿慢速MA产生买入信号，下穿产生卖出信号。入场条件为EMA-Crossover_Signal指标在指定SignalBar位置输出非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的信号值，UpValue触发做多、DnValue触发做空。出场条件包括止损和止盈参数控制，同时在开启反向平仓时，EA会遍历历史K线寻找更早期的反向信号来决定是否平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制交易手数比例，支持五种资金管理模式：自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后自由保证金、扣除亏损后余额和固定手数。资金管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准化模块，提供从固定手数到基于不同保证金计算方式的动态仓位调整。
EA-13588.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a crossover of two moving averages with different periods, where the faster MA crossing above the slower MA generates a buy signal and vice versa for sell signals. Entry conditions require the EMA-Crossover_Signal indicator to output a non-zero and non-EMPTY_VALUE signal at the specified SignalBar position, with UpValue triggering long entries and DnValue triggering short entries. Exit conditions include configurable stop loss and take profit in points, and when reverse-close toggles are enabled, the EA scans historical bars to find earlier opposing signals to determine whether to close existing positions. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the lot ratio, supporting five money management modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. The money management leverages the standardized TradeAlgorithms.mqh library module, providing dynamic position sizing ranging from fixed lots to margin-calculated approaches based on different equity metrics.

The EA supports multiple money management modes and allows independent control of entry and exit for both long and short positions.
EA-13589.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义EMA_Prediction指标的信号进行交易，该指标使用快速和慢速两条EMA线来预测价格方向。当出现向上预测信号时开多仓，出现向下预测信号时开空仓，支持可配置的止损止盈及仓位关闭逻辑。EA支持多种资金管理模式，并允许独立控制多头和空头的入场与出场。
EA-13589.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于EMA预测指标的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件：当EMA_Prediction指标的上行信号线（buffer 1）在指定信号柱上产生非零且非空值时开多仓；当下行信号线（buffer 0）产生非零且非空值时开空仓。出场条件：当指标在历史柱中反向出现信号时触发平仓，同时也通过固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit参数进行止损止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数五种模式。EA还实现了新柱检测机制以避免同一柱内重复开仓，并在信号柱为零时允许每tick都进行信号检查。当同时启用开仓和平仓且当前无平仓信号时，EA会回溯历史柱寻找更早的反向信号来决定是否平仓。
EA-13589.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the EMA_Prediction indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator's upward signal line (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-empty value on the specified signal bar; a sell position is opened when the downward signal line (buffer 0) produces a non-zero, non-empty value. Exit conditions: positions are closed when the indicator produces a reverse signal on historical bars, and also through fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting five modes: by free margin, by balance, by free margin after losses, by balance after losses, and fixed lot size. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated entries within the same bar, and allows per-tick signal checking when the signal bar is set to zero. When both entry and exit are enabled and no current close signal exists, the EA backtracks through historical bars to find earlier reverse signals for closing decisions.

EA-13603.name: Exp_Ergodic_Ticks_Volume_Indicator
EA-13603.summary: This EA trades based on the Ergodic Ticks Volume Indicator, which is a momentum oscillator derived from tick volume data smoothed through multiple averaging layers. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable position closing on signal reversals.
EA-13603.summary_zh: 该EA基于Ergodic Tick成交量指标进行交易，该指标是通过多层平滑算法处理tick成交量数据得出的动量振荡器。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿信号线时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
EA-13603.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Ergodic Tick成交量指标，这是一种利用tick成交量数据经过六层平滑处理（XLength1-XLength6）构建的动量振荡器，类似于MACD但基于成交量而非价格。入场条件为：当指标线（Ind）上穿信号线（Sign）时开多仓，当指标线下穿信号线（Sign）时开空仓，仅在信号交叉发生的新K线或SignalBar指定的K线上触发。出场条件包括：多仓在指标线跌破信号线时平仓，空仓在指标线上穿信号线时平仓，同时支持固定点数的止损（StopLoss_=1000）和止盈（TakeProfit_=2000）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），并支持多种资金管理模式（MMMode），包括基于自由保证金、余额、损失后保证金和固定手数等模式。资金管理依赖于TradeAlgorithms.mqh中封装的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数，结合偏差控制（Deviation_=10）来管理滑点风险。策略使用新K线检测机制（IsNewBar）避免重复信号，但缺乏对持仓量的检查、点差过滤和追加止损机制。
EA-13603.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Ergodic Ticks Volume Indicator, a momentum oscillator constructed from tick volume data processed through six smoothing layers (XLength1-XLength6), similar to MACD but volume-based rather than price-based. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator line (Ind) crosses above the signal line (Sign), and a sell position opens when the indicator line crosses below the signal line, triggered only on new bars or the bar specified by SignalBar. Exit conditions include closing buy positions when the indicator drops below the signal line and closing sell positions when the indicator rises above the signal line, with configurable fixed stop-loss (StopLoss_=1000) and take-profit (TakeProfit_=2000). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) with multiple money management modes (MMMode) including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin-based, and fixed lot sizing. Money management relies on BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, with deviation control (Deviation_=10) to manage slippage risk. The strategy uses a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to avoid duplicate signals, but lacks position count checks, spread filters, and trailing stop mechanisms.

EA-13610.name: Exp_Ergodic_Ticks_Volume_OSMA
EA-13610.summary: This EA trades based on the Ergodic Ticks Volume OSMA indicator, opening buy positions when the oscillator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward. It uses a multi-layer smoothed volume-based oscillator to generate trend-momentum signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy enters on signal bar crossovers and closes opposing positions on reversals.
EA-13610.summary_zh: 该EA基于Ergodic Ticks Volume OSMA指标进行交易，当振荡器向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓。它使用多层平滑的成交量振荡器生成趋势动量信号，并配备可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。策略在信号线交叉时入场，并在反转时平掉反向头寸。
EA-13610.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Ergodic Ticks Volume OSMA指标，该指标是经过7层平滑处理的基于成交量的动量振荡器，本质上是TVI（Ticks Volume Indicator）的OSMA变体。入场条件为：当Ind[1]<Ind[2]（振荡器从下降转为上升）且Ind[0]>=Ind[1]（当前值确认上升）时开多仓；当Ind[1]>Ind[2]（振荡器从上升转为下降）且Ind[0]<=Ind[1]时开空仓。出场条件为：开多信号触发时平空仓，开空信号触发时平多仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MarginMode枚举支持5种模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数。资金管理参数MM控制风险比例（默认0.1），结合止损距离计算具体手数。策略支持新K线检测避免重复交易，并使用SignalBar参数允许回溯信号确认。
EA-13610.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Ergodic Ticks Volume OSMA indicator, which is a volume-based momentum oscillator processed through 7 layers of smoothing, essentially an OSMA variant of the TVI (Ticks Volume Indicator). Entry conditions: a buy is opened when Ind[1]<Ind[2] (oscillator turns from decline to rise) and Ind[0]>=Ind[1] (current value confirms upward move); a sell is opened when Ind[1]>Ind[2] (oscillator turns from rise to decline) and Ind[0]<=Ind[1]. Exit conditions: opposing positions are closed on reversal signals (sell closed on buy signal, buy closed on sell signal), with fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing supports 5 modes via MarginMode enum: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management parameter MM controls the risk ratio (default 0.1), calculating specific lot size combined with the stop loss distance. The strategy implements new bar detection to prevent repeated trades on the same bar and uses the SignalBar parameter to allow lookback signal confirmation.

EA-13620.name: Exp_Fast2
EA-13620.summary: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy using the custom Fast2 indicator, which applies two smoothing algorithms with configurable methods and periods. It opens buy positions when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with optional position closing on reverse signals and configurable stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-13620.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Fast2指标实现双均线交叉策略，使用两种可配置平滑算法和周期的移动平均线。当快速均线向上穿越慢速均线时开多仓，反之开空仓，支持反向信号平仓及可配置的止损止盈。
EA-13620.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双移动平均线交叉的经典趋势跟踪方法，使用Fast2自定义指标计算两条平滑线。入场条件为：当Ma1在上一根K线高于Ma2且当前K线Ma1低于Ma2时产生买入信号（即快速均线从上方穿越到下方），反之当Ma1从下方穿越到上方时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设定，以及当反向交叉信号出现时可选的平仓操作。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金比例，支持固定手数和保证金比例两种模式（LOT模式和其他MarginMode）。资金管理基于账户余额的比例计算仓位大小，配合固定点数的止损和止盈来控制单笔风险。策略使用了可配置的平滑方法（SMA、EMA、SMMA、LWMA、JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA），提供了较高的灵活性。信号仅在新的K线形成时或首次加载时计算，避免了逐tick重复计算的问题。
EA-13620.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the classic dual moving average crossover trend-following approach, using the custom Fast2 indicator to compute two smoothed lines. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Ma1 was above Ma2 on the previous bar and Ma1 falls below Ma2 on the current bar (fast MA crossing from above to below), and conversely a sell signal when Ma1 crosses from below to above. Exit conditions include hard stop-loss and take-profit levels, plus optional position closing on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which defines the money management ratio, supporting both fixed lot and margin-based lot sizing modes via the MMMode enum. Money management calculates position size as a proportion of account balance, paired with fixed pip-based stop-loss and take-profit to control per-trade risk. The strategy leverages configurable smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) providing high flexibility. Signals are only calculated on new bar formation or on initial load, avoiding redundant per-tick recalculation.

EA-13626.name: Exp_FatlMacd
EA-13626.summary: This EA trades based on the FatlMacd custom indicator, which is a smoothed digital filter (FATL) combined with a MACD-like oscillator. It opens buy positions when the FatlMacd histogram turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.
EA-13626.summary_zh: 该EA基于FatlMacd自定义指标进行交易，该指标是FATL数字滤波器与类MACD振荡器的结合。当FatlMacd柱状图转向上时开多仓，转向下时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。
EA-13626.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于FatlMacd指标的方向变化，该指标通过FATL数字滤波器计算价格再用可选平滑方法（如T3、JJMA、JurX等）进行二次平滑处理，本质上是一个高级动量振荡器。入场条件为：当指标值Value[1]<Value[2]（下降趋势中）且Value[0]>Value[1]（开始上升）时触发买入信号；当Value[1]>Value[2]（上升趋势中）且Value[0]<Value[1]（开始下降）时触发卖出信号。出场条件包括固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向信号平仓选项。仓位管理支持多种资金管理模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金比例计算手数，以及固定手数模式。默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，止盈是止损的两倍，体现了趋势跟踪中让利润奔跑的思路。策略使用SignalBar参数允许在当前K线或指定偏移K线上判断信号，并有新K线检测机制避免重复开仓。
EA-13626.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on directional changes in the FatlMacd indicator, which applies a FATL digital filter to price and then smooths it with a selectable method (T3, JJMA, JurX, etc.), functioning as an advanced momentum oscillator. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when Value[1]<Value[2] (downtrend) and Value[0]>Value[1] (histogram turns up); a sell signal triggers when Value[1]>Value[2] (uptrend) and Value[0]<Value[1] (histogram turns down). Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points, plus optional opposite-signal position closing. Position sizing supports multiple money management modes: based on free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted margin, or fixed lot size. Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points reflects a trend-following philosophy of letting profits run. The SignalBar parameter allows signal detection on the current or offset bar, and a new bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate entries.

EA-13628.name: Exp_FineTuningMA
EA-13628.summary: This EA trades based on the FineTuningMA custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator values show an uptrend (Value[0]>Value[1]<Value[2]) and sell positions when a downtrend is detected (Value[0]<Value[1]>Value[2]). It uses configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and processes signals only on new bars for efficiency.
EA-13628.summary_zh: 该EA基于FineTuningMA自定义指标进行交易，当指标值显示上升趋势时开多仓，显示下降趋势时开空仓。它支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，并且仅在新K线形成时处理信号以提高效率。
EA-13628.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于FineTuningMA自定义指标的趋势跟踪，该指标通过三个rank参数和三个shift参数对移动平均线进行精细调节。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>Value[1]时开多仓，表示指标从下降转为上升即趋势向上反转；当Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空仓，表示趋势向下反转。出场条件依赖固定的止损止盈设置，同时也通过反向信号触发平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的自由保证金、扣除亏损后的余额以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1，配合MarginMode选择具体的计算方式。策略仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算，提高了运行效率。
EA-13628.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is trend following based on the FineTuningMA custom indicator, which fine-tunes a moving average using three rank parameters and three shift parameters for adjustable smoothing. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>Value[1], indicating the indicator has turned from declining to rising (uptrend reversal); a sell signal triggers when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1], indicating a downtrend reversal. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit settings, with additional exit signals triggered by opposing trend signals (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose). Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) combined with the MarginMode selection for specific calculation methods. The strategy only calculates signals on new bar formation rather than every tick, improving computational efficiency and reducing unnecessary trade operations.

EA-1363.name: Exp_CorrectedAverage
EA-1363.summary: This EA implements a breakout trading system based on the CorrectedAverage custom moving average indicator. It enters long when price breaks above the moving average by a specified level, and enters short when price breaks below. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with optional permissions for buy/sell entry and exit.
EA-1363.summary_zh: 该EA基于CorrectedAverage修正均线指标实现突破交易系统。当价格突破均线上方指定点位时做多，跌破均线下方指定点位时做空。使用固定止损和止盈管理仓位，并可独立控制买卖方向的入场和出场权限。
EA-1363.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于CorrectedAverage修正均线的突破策略，核心概念是当价格偏离均线达到指定突破水平(Level点)时确认趋势启动并入场。入场条件为：当前K线收盘价高于均线值加突破水平时触发做多信号，前一根K线收盘价低于均线值加突破水平以确保是突破而非持续偏离；做空条件对称。出场条件包括固定止损(StopLoss)和止盈(TakeProfit)点位，以及反向信号触发平仓——即做多信号出现时若允许则平空仓，做空信号出现时若允许则平多仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算仓位。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数执行，止损止盈以点数设定。策略仅在新K线形成时检测信号(SignalBar=0除外)，避免重复交易，同时使用Recount机制确保数据获取失败时重新计算。
EA-1363.strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a breakout strategy based on the CorrectedAverage custom moving average indicator. The core concept is to confirm a trend initiation when price deviates from the moving average by a specified breakthrough level (Level points) and enter accordingly. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the current bar's close exceeds the indicator value plus the breakthrough level, with the previous bar's close at or below that threshold to confirm a fresh breakout rather than a continued deviation; sell conditions are symmetrical. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points, plus counter-signal exits — a buy signal closes short positions if permitted, and a sell signal closes long positions if permitted. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot sizes, while positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions for execution. The strategy only checks for signals on new bar formation (unless SignalBar=0), preventing duplicate trades, and uses a Recount mechanism to retry data fetching on failure.

EA-13635.name: Exp_Force_DiverSign
EA-13635.summary: This EA trades based on divergence signals from the custom Force_DiverSign indicator, which identifies bullish and bearish divergences in the Force Index. It opens buy positions on bullish divergence signals and sell positions on bearish divergence signals, with configurable close-on-opposite-signal logic for position management.
EA-13635.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Force_DiverSign指标的发散信号进行交易，识别Force Index中的牛熊背离。在牛背离信号时开多仓，在熊背离信号时开空仓，并可通过反向信号平仓来管理仓位。
EA-13635.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用Force Index（强力指数）的背离信号进行交易。Force Index由价格变动幅度和成交量计算得出，结合两条不同周期的移动平均线（默认EMA3和EMA7）来识别背离。入场条件为：当指标buffer 1输出非零非空值时产生牛背离信号，开多仓并可选平空仓；当指标buffer 0输出非零非空值时产生熊背离信号，开空仓并可选平多仓。出场条件依赖反向背离信号平仓或固定的止损止盈（默认SL=1000点，TP=2000点）。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的自由保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例。额外逻辑会在当前bar无平仓信号时，向后搜索历史bar查找平仓信号，确保不遗漏反向信号。默认在H4周期运行，SignalBar=1表示使用前一根已完成K线的信号。
EA-13635.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy trades divergence signals from the Force Index, which combines price change magnitude with volume. The Force_DiverSign indicator uses two moving averages (default EMA period 3 and 7) to detect divergence between price and Force Index. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 1 outputs a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE, a bullish divergence is detected, triggering a buy open and optional sell close; when buffer 0 triggers, a bearish divergence opens sell positions and optionally closes buys. Exit conditions rely on opposite divergence signals or fixed StopLoss (1000 pts) and TakeProfit (2000 pts). Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, and percentage of balance minus floating loss. An additional logic scans historical bars backward for close signals when the current bar has none, ensuring opposite divergence signals are not missed. Default timeframe is H4 with SignalBar=1, using the most recently completed bar for signal evaluation.

EA-13636.name: Exp_ForecastOscilator
EA-13636.summary: This EA trades based on the ForecastOscilator custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward oscillator signals and sell positions on downward signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggles for entry and exit signals. The strategy is a signal-based momentum system with optional reverse-signal exit logic.
EA-13636.summary_zh: 该EA基于ForecastOscilator自定义指标进行交易，在指标上穿信号时开多仓，下穿信号时开空仓。支持多种资金管理模式、止损止盈设置，以及独立的入场和出场信号开关。策略属于基于信号的动量系统，带有反向信号出场逻辑。
EA-13636.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ForecastOscilator振荡器指标的信号判断，该指标通过T3平滑算法和可配置的长度参数生成趋势动量信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区3（上穿信号）有效时触发买入开仓，缓冲区2（下穿信号）有效时触发卖出开仓，每个方向的开仓和信号检测可独立开关控制。出场条件包含两种逻辑：一是反向信号出场（买入平仓由下穿信号触发，卖出平仓由上穿信号触发），二是止损止盈出场。仓位管理通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库实现，支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、含亏损的自由保证金比例、含亏损的余额比例和固定手数。资金管理方面，MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1即10%，配合MMMode选择具体计算方式。出场逻辑中还有一个历史回溯机制：当同时允许开仓和平仓且当前无平仓信号时，会向前遍历历史K线查找更早的反向信号以决定是否平仓，这增加了策略的灵活性但也增加了回测与实盘的一致性风险。
EA-13636.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ForecastOscilator custom indicator, which generates trend momentum signals using a T3 smoothing algorithm with configurable length and volume factor parameters. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 3 (upward crossover signal) is valid, a buy position is opened; when buffer 2 (downward crossover signal) is valid, a sell position is opened, with each direction's entry and signal detection independently toggleable. Exit conditions include two mechanisms: reverse-signal exits (buy close triggered by downward signal, sell close triggered by upward signal) and stop loss/take profit exits. Position sizing is handled via the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library supporting five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk ratio (default 0.1 = 10%) combined with MMMode to select the specific calculation method. The exit logic includes a historical lookback mechanism: when both entry and exit are enabled but no current exit signal exists, the EA traverses historical bars to find earlier reverse signals for exit decisions, adding flexibility but also introducing backtest-vs-live consistency risks.

EA-13644.name: Exp_FractalAMA_MBK
EA-13644.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the FractalAMA_MBK custom indicator, which is a fractal-adaptive moving average. It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit.
EA-13644.summary_zh: 该EA基于FractalAMA_MBK自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标是一种分形自适应移动平均线。当主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，从上方穿越时开空仓，支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。
EA-13644.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于FractalAMA（分形自适应移动平均）指标的趋势跟踪，利用指标主线与信号线的交叉作为趋势转折信号。入场条件：当指标主线大于信号线且前一根K线主线小于等于信号线时，产生做多信号；反之当主线小于信号线且前一根主线大于等于信号线时，产生做空信号。出场条件通过反向交叉信号触发平仓，同时配合固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）进行风险管理。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的自由保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例、以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，MMMode默认为LOT固定手数模式。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，同时通过Recount标志在CopyBuffer失败时重新获取数据。
EA-13644.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is trend following based on the FractalAMA (Fractal Adaptive Moving Average) indicator, using crossovers between the indicator main line and signal line as trend reversal signals. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the main line is above the signal line and the previous bar's main line was below or equal to the signal line; conversely, a sell signal is generated when the main line is below the signal line and the previous bar's main line was above or equal to the signal line. Exit conditions are triggered by reverse crossover signals for position closure, combined with fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) for risk management. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1, and the MMMode defaults to LOT (fixed lot) mode. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, and employs a Recount flag to retry data retrieval when CopyBuffer fails.

EA-1365.name: Exp_VininI_Trend
EA-1365.summary: This EA trades based on the custom VininI_Trend indicator, which uses multiple smoothed moving averages with variable depths. It supports two entry algorithms: level breakthrough (BREAKDOWN) and direction change (TWIST), with configurable buy/sell permissions and position closing options.
EA-1365.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义VininI_Trend指标进行交易，该指标使用多层级平滑移动平均线。支持两种入场算法：水平突破(BREAKDOWN)和方向扭转(TWIST)，并可配置买卖许可和平仓权限。
EA-1365.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是VininI_Trend指标，它通过多步深度递增的移动平均线平滑（MA_Step递增，MA_Count步数）后再经第二层平滑生成趋势信号。BREAKDOWN模式下，当指标值从下方突破UpLevel时产生买入信号，从上方突破DnLevel时产生卖出信号。TWIST模式下，当指标方向由下转上时买入，由上转下时卖出。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表存款比例。止损和止盈分别固定为1000点和2000点。EA仅在新增K线时检测信号（SignalBar=0除外），避免重复交易，同时支持分别控制开仓和平仓权限。
EA-1365.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on the VininI_Trend indicator, which generates signals by applying multiple smoothed moving averages with incrementally increasing depths (MA_Step increments over MA_Count steps), followed by a second-layer smoothing. In BREAKDOWN mode, a buy signal triggers when the indicator crosses above UpLevel from below, and a sell signal triggers when it crosses below DnLevel from above. In TWIST mode, a buy signal occurs when the indicator direction changes from downward to upward, and vice versa for sell signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Stop Loss and Take Profit are fixed at 1000 and 2000 points respectively. The EA only checks for signals on new bars (unless SignalBar=0), preventing repeated trades, and supports separate permissions for opening and closing positions.

EA-1366.summary: This EA trades based on the VininI_Trend_LRMA custom indicator, which uses a Linear Regression Moving Average with multi-step smoothing. It supports two entry modes: level breakout and direction change (twist), and optionally filters entries using the ChangeOfVolatility indicator in the version with the second handle. Positions are opened and closed systematically with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management.
EA-1366.summary_zh: 该EA基于VininI_Trend_LRMA自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用线性回归移动平均结合多步平滑算法。支持两种入场模式：水平突破和方向扭转，部分版本还使用ChangeOfVolatility指标作为波动率过滤。系统化地开平仓，配有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理。
EA-1366.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，基于VininI_Trend_LRMA指标生成交易信号。该指标通过线性回归移动平均（LRMA）配合多步指数平滑（支持SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX等多种平滑方法）来识别趋势方向。入场条件有两种模式：BREAKDOWN模式要求指标值突破UpLevel/DnLevel水平线，且前一根K线的指标值未突破该水平；TWIST模式要求指标方向发生扭转，即从下降转为上升或从上升转为下降。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发时平仓。仓位管理方面，通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示占用存款比例。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数执行开平仓操作。在带下划线后缀的版本中，还额外使用ChangeOfVolatility指标过滤信号，要求趋势波动强度超过MaxTrendLevel才允许入场。
EA-1366.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, generating trading signals based on the VininI_Trend_LRMA custom indicator. This indicator identifies trend direction through a Linear Regression Moving Average combined with multi-step exponential smoothing, supporting various smoothing methods including SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, and others. Entry conditions operate in two modes: BREAKDOWN mode requires the indicator value to cross above UpLevel or below DnLevel, with the previous bar's value not yet having crossed that level; TWIST mode requires the indicator direction to reverse, changing from declining to rising or vice versa. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as position closure triggered by opposing signals. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent the share of deposit per deal. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions for executing opens and closes. In the version with the underscore suffix, an additional ChangeOfVolatility indicator filters signals, requiring trend volatility strength to exceed MaxTrendLevel before entry is permitted.

EA-13678.name: negative_spread_FORTS
EA-13678.summary: This EA exploits negative spread conditions (when bid > ask) on the FORTS (Russian derivatives) market by placing pending limit orders at the favorable side of the book. It opens a SELL_LIMIT at bid when negative spread is detected, then immediately attempts to close the position with a BUY_LIMIT at ask, capturing the inverted spread as profit. The strategy relies on order book depth events rather than technical indicators.
EA-13678.summary_zh: 该EA利用FORTS市场上出现的负价差（买价>卖价）异常情况，在买价挂卖单、在卖价挂买单，从而捕获倒挂价差作为利润。策略基于订单簿深度事件触发，而非技术指标，属于市场微观结构套利策略。
EA-13678.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA利用市场订单簿中出现负价差（bid > ask）的罕见异常情况进行套利交易。入场条件：在OnBookEvent事件中检测订单簿的最低卖价(ask)与最高买价(bid)，当ask-bid<0时触发入场。FORTS版本使用挂单（SELL_LIMIT在bid价位），而普通版本直接市价卖出。出场条件：FORTS版本在持仓后立即在ask价位挂BUY_LIMIT平仓，形成买卖价差锁定；普通版本在持仓后直接调用PositionClose平仓。仓位管理：固定手数由Lots参数控制，无动态仓位调整或资金管理逻辑。资金管理：完全不设动态风控，TP和SL设为5000点但实际值对于FORTS版SELL方向未设置TP，且挂单被迅速撤销或成交，止损止盈形同虚设。风险方面，EA在等待成交时使用while循环阻塞，可能导致程序卡死或超时。
EA-13678.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept exploits rare negative spread anomalies in the market order book where bid exceeds ask, creating a risk-free arbitrage opportunity. Entry conditions are triggered in OnBookEvent when the best ask minus the best bid is less than zero, detected by iterating through MqlBookInfo entries. The FORTS version places a SELL_LIMIT pending order at the bid price, while the standard version immediately sends a market sell order. Exit conditions differ between versions: the FORTS version places a BUY_LIMIT at ask to close the position, while the standard version uses CTrade.PositionClose to close immediately after opening. Position sizing is fixed via the Lots input parameter with no dynamic adjustment or risk-based sizing. Money management is essentially absent — TP and SL are set to 5000 points but the FORTS version does not set TP for sell orders, and orders are either quickly filled or deleted, making stop-loss and take-profit largely irrelevant. A significant risk is the blocking while-loop that waits for position changes, which could freeze the EA or cause timeout issues during periods of market stress.
pros: 利用市场微观结构异常（负价差）进行套利，理论上是低风险策略
基于订单簿深度数据（Level 2）触发，响应速度快于普通tick驱动策略
FORTS版本使用挂单而非市价单，可以更好地控制成交价格和时机
pros_en: Exploits market microstructure anomalies (negative spread) for arbitrage, theoretically a low-risk strategy
Triggered by order book depth data (Level 2), enabling faster response than typical tick-driven strategies
FORTS version uses pending limit orders instead of market orders, providing better price control and execution timing
cons: 使用阻塞式while循环等待成交，可能导致EA卡死或超时，属于严重编程缺陷
FORTS版本的SELL_LIMIT订单未设置止盈(TP)，且止损止盈参数对快速成交/撤销的挂单几乎无实际作用
缺乏频率控制和去重机制，同一负价差可能触发大量重复下单
负价差在实际市场中极其罕见且转瞬即逝，策略实用性极低
cons_en: Blocking while-loops waiting for execution can freeze the EA or cause timeout errors — a critical programming flaw
FORTS version does not set TP for sell orders, and the SL/TP parameters are practically useless for quickly filled or cancelled pending orders
Lacks frequency control and deduplication — the same negative spread event could trigger a flood of duplicate orders
Negative spreads are extremely rare and fleeting in real markets, making the strategy's practical utility very limited
improvements: 将阻塞式while循环替换为非阻塞状态机模式，使用OnTrade或OnBookEvent回调处理成交确认，避免EA卡死
添加订单频率限制和去重逻辑，防止同一事件重复触发下单；增加订单簿数据有效性检查和超时保护
improvements_en: Replace blocking while-loops with a non-blocking state machine pattern using OnTrade or OnBookEvent callbacks for execution confirmation to prevent EA freezing
Add order frequency limiting and deduplication logic to prevent duplicate orders from the same event; implement order book data validity checks and timeout protection

risk_points: 阻塞式while循环可能导致EA无响应，在市场剧烈波动时无法及时处理
缺乏订单频率限制，负价差持续时可能短时间内发出大量订单，面临交易所风控处罚
SELL_LIMIT订单未设置TP，如果挂单成交后平仓失败，将形成无保护的单边持仓
risk_points_en: Blocking while-loops can cause EA unresponsiveness, preventing timely action during extreme market volatility
No order frequency limiting — sustained negative spread could trigger a flood of orders, risking exchange penalty or ban
SELL_LIMIT orders lack TP — if the close order fails after fill, an unprotected naked position remains open

EA-1370.name: Schnick_Demo
EA-1370.summary: This EA is a demonstration script for a Support Vector Machine (SVM) learning tool. It generates synthetic training data based on a predefined 'Schnick' classification function, trains two SVMs (one with clean data and one with randomly inserted errors), then tests and compares their classification accuracy. It does not execute any actual trades.
EA-1370.summary_zh: 该EA是一个支持向量机(SVM)学习工具的演示脚本。它基于预定义的'Schnick'分类函数生成合成训练数据,训练两个SVM(一个使用无误差数据,另一个使用随机插入误差的数据),然后测试并比较它们的分类准确率。该EA不执行任何实际交易。
EA-1370.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于支持向量机(SVM)的二元分类,通过7个输入特征(身高、体重、腿数、眼数、臂长、平均速度、叫声频率)来判断一个虚拟生物'施尼克'是否属于特定物种。入场条件并不涉及真实市场交易,而是在OnInit中一次性生成5000个训练样本,每个样本包含7个随机生成的特征值。出场条件同样不适用,因为该EA仅执行分类测试后在初始化阶段结束。仓位管理和资金管理完全不存在,因为这是一个纯粹的机器学习演示工具,不涉及任何金融交易逻辑。该EA通过对比无误差训练数据和含500个随机误差训练数据下的SVM准确率,展示了SVM对噪声数据的鲁棒性。分类决策边界由isItASchnick函数硬编码的多维度范围判断定义,本质上是一个多维超矩形分类问题。
EA-1370.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is based on Support Vector Machine (SVM) binary classification, using 7 input features (height, weight, number of legs, number of eyes, arm length, average speed, call frequency) to determine whether a fictional creature 'Schnick' belongs to a specific species. Entry conditions do not involve real market trading; instead, 5000 training samples are generated once during OnInit, each containing 7 randomly generated feature values. Exit conditions are not applicable since the EA only performs a classification test and terminates during initialization. Position sizing and money management are completely absent, as this is a purely machine learning demonstration tool with no financial trading logic. The EA demonstrates SVM robustness to noisy data by comparing classification accuracy between clean training data and training data with 500 randomly inserted errors. The classification decision boundary is defined by the hard-coded multi-dimensional range checks in the isItASchnick function, which is essentially a multi-dimensional hyperrectangle classification problem.

EA-13715.name: Exp_ColorHMA
EA-13715.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorHMA (Hull Moving Average) indicator, opening buy positions when the HMA slope turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward. It uses the color changes of the HMA to detect trend reversals and manages positions with configurable stop loss, take profit, and multiple money management modes. Trades are only executed on new bars to avoid redundant signals.
EA-13715.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorHMA（赫尔移动平均线）指标进行交易，当HMA斜率向上翻转时开多仓，向下翻转时开空仓。它利用HMA的颜色变化来检测趋势反转，并通过可配置的止损、止盈和多种资金管理模式来管理仓位。交易仅在新K线形成时执行以避免重复信号。
EA-13715.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于赫尔移动平均线（HMA）的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当HMA值从前一根到当前一根上升（Value[0]>Value[1]）且前一根低于更前一根（Value[1]<Value[2]）时，产生买入信号；当HMA值从前一根到当前一根下降（Value[0]<Value[1]）且前一根高于更前一根（Value[1]>Value[2]）时，产生卖出信号。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈设置，同时支持反向信号平仓——当出现卖出信号时平掉多头仓位，出现买入信号时平掉空头仓位。仓位管理方面，支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按可用保证金扣除浮亏比例、按余额扣除浮亏比例、以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制下单量。EA还使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免在同一个K线上重复开仓。SignalBar参数允许用户选择使用哪根K线的值来计算信号，默认为1即最近完成的K线。
EA-13715.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following approach based on the Hull Moving Average (HMA). Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when HMA values rise from the previous bar to the current bar (Value[0]>Value[1]) and the previous bar's value is below the bar before it (Value[1]<Value[2]); a sell signal is generated when HMA values decline from the previous bar to the current bar (Value[0]<Value[1]) and the previous bar's value is above the bar before it (Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit settings in points, and also support reverse-signal closing — long positions are closed when a sell signal appears, and short positions are closed when a buy signal appears. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration. The EA also uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries on the same bar. The SignalBar parameter allows users to select which bar's values to use for signal calculation, defaulting to 1 (the most recently completed bar).

EA-13719.name: HVR
EA-13719.summary: HVR (Historical Volatility Ratio) is a custom indicator for MT5 that calculates the ratio of 6-period historical volatility to 100-period historical volatility, displayed in a separate window. It uses log returns of a selectable applied price and computes annualized standard deviation (assuming 52-week basis) for both short and long windows. The HTF version allows displaying this indicator on a higher timeframe while viewing a lower timeframe chart.
EA-13719.summary_zh: HVR（历史波动率比率）是一个MT5自定义指标，在独立窗口中计算6周期历史波动率与100周期历史波动率的比值。它使用可选应用价格的对数收益率，分别计算短期和长期窗口的年化标准差（假设52周基数）。HTF版本允许在低周期图表上显示高周期的指标数值。
EA-13719.strategy_analysis: HVR指标的核心概念是计算短期（6周期）与长期（100周期）历史波动率的比率，用于衡量市场波动性的相对变化。该指标首先对选定价格取对数收益率（ln(P_t/P_{t-1})），然后分别计算6周期和100周期窗口内的样本标准差，并乘以7.2111（即√52，用于年化周波动率）进行年化处理。最终指标值为hv6/hv100，当该比值大于1时表示短期波动率高于长期波动率，市场可能处于剧烈波动阶段；小于1时则相反。该指标本身不包含任何入场或出场条件，也不涉及仓位管理和资金管理，仅作为波动率分析工具使用。HTF版本通过iCustom调用基础HVR指标，实现多周期显示功能，方便交易者在低周期图表上观察高周期波动率比率变化。
EA-13719.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the HVR indicator is to calculate the ratio of short-term (6-period) to long-term (100-period) historical volatility, measuring relative changes in market volatility. The indicator first computes log returns (ln(P_t/P_{t-1})) of a user-selected applied price, then calculates sample standard deviations over 6-period and 100-period windows respectively, multiplying by 7.2111 (which is √52, for annualizing weekly volatility) to produce annualized figures. The final indicator value is hv6/hv100; a ratio above 1 indicates short-term volatility exceeds long-term volatility, suggesting the market may be in an active phase, while below 1 suggests the opposite. The indicator itself contains no entry or exit conditions, nor any position sizing or money management logic — it serves purely as a volatility analysis tool. The HTF version calls the base HVR indicator via iCustom, enabling multi-timeframe display so traders can observe higher-timeframe volatility ratio changes on lower-timeframe charts.

EA-13720.name: Exp_DecEMA
EA-13720.summary: This EA trades based on the DecEMA (Decimal EMA) custom indicator, opening buy positions when the DecEMA value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward. It uses a crossover of three consecutive DecEMA buffer values to detect trend direction changes and applies configurable money management for position sizing with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-13720.summary_zh: 该EA基于DecEMA（十进制EMA）自定义指标进行交易，当DecEMA值转向上时开多仓，转向下时开空仓。它通过三个连续DecEMA缓冲区值的交叉来检测趋势方向变化，并使用可配置的资金管理进行仓位管理，设有固定止损和止盈水平。
EA-13720.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用DecEMA指标的方向变化来捕捉趋势的转折点。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（指标下降）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值回升）时，视为上升趋势开始，开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（指标上升）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前值回落）时，视为下降趋势开始，开空仓。出场条件依赖固定止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），同时当反向信号出现时会先平掉反向持仓再开新仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金比例、余额比例、亏损保证金比例、亏损余额比例和固定手数五种模式。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供的标准化函数来执行开平仓操作，确保交易逻辑的一致性。策略默认在H8周期运行，使用SignalBar=1意味着基于上一根已收盘K线的信号进行交易，避免未完成K线的信号抖动。
EA-13720.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to capture trend reversals using directional changes in the DecEMA indicator. Entry conditions are: when Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator declining) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current value rising), an uptrend is detected and a buy position is opened; when Value[1]>Value[2] (indicator rising) and Value[0]<Value[1] (current value falling), a downtrend is detected and a sell position is opened. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), and when a reverse signal appears, the opposing position is closed before opening a new one. Position sizing is controlled through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-free margin percentage, loss-balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management uses standardized functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library to execute open and close operations, ensuring consistency in trading logic. The strategy defaults to H8 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1, meaning signals are based on the last closed bar to avoid signal flickering from incomplete bars.

EA-13729.name: Exp_i-BandsPrice
EA-13729.summary: This EA trades Bollinger Bands price crossovers using a custom i-BandsPrice indicator that applies additional smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator value crosses down below level 4 and sell positions when it crosses up above level 0, with configurable exit signals based on threshold levels.
EA-13729.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义i-BandsPrice指标进行布林带价格交叉交易，对布林带信号进行了额外平滑处理。当指标值从4下穿时开多仓，从0上穿时开空仓，并通过阈值水平配置出场信号。
EA-13729.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于布林带均值回归原理，使用自定义i-BandsPrice指标将布林带位置转换为离散状态值（0-4），其中4代表上轨上方极度超买区域，0代表下轨下方极度超卖区域。入场条件为：当指标值从4下穿时产生买入信号（价格从超买区回落），当指标值从0上穿时产生卖出信号（价格从超卖区反弹）。出场条件为：买入平仓信号在指标值小于2时触发，卖出平仓信号在指标值大于1时触发，这是基于均值回归逻辑的提前出场机制。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持多种保证金模式（余额、净值、自由保证金、固定手数）。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms库的标准化开仓函数，包含止损和止盈设置，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点。
EA-13729.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bollinger Bands mean reversion, using the custom i-BandsPrice indicator which converts Bollinger Band position into discrete state values (0-4), where 4 represents extreme overbought territory above the upper band and 0 represents extreme oversold territory below the lower band. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the indicator value crosses down from 4 (price retreating from overbought zone), and a sell signal is generated when the indicator value crosses up from 0 (price bouncing from oversold zone). Exit conditions are: buy close signal triggers when indicator value drops below 2, and sell close signal triggers when indicator value rises above 1, representing an early exit mechanism based on mean reversion logic. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter which adjusts risk proportion, supporting multiple margin modes including balance, equity, free margin, and fixed lot. Money management uses the standardized TradeAlgorithms library opening functions with configurable stop loss and take profit, defaulting to 1000 points SL and 2000 points TP.

EA-13777.strategy_analysis:
分析

### 2.1 核心策略概念

这是一个**布林带与移动平均线双重过滤的趋势跟踪策略**。策略使用自定义i_Trend指标作为信号源，该指标通过计算价格相对于布林带的位置与价格相对于MA的偏离度来生成交易信号。

**核心算法逻辑**：
1. **指标计算**（i_Trend指标）：
   - Buffer A = 价格 - 布林带值（价格偏离布林带的程度）
   - Buffer B = -(最高价+最低价-2×MA)（价格相对于MA的波动范围）

2. **信号生成**：
   - 当Buffer A > Buffer B时，市场处于上升趋势
   - 当Buffer A从上方穿越Buffer B向下时，产生买入信号（回调入场）
   - 当Buffer A从下方穿越Buffer B向上时，产生卖出信号（回调入场）

### 2.2 入场条件

**买入条件**：
1. 前一柱：Ind[1] > Sign[1]（趋势向上）
2. 当前柱：Ind[0] <= Sign[0]（指标线交叉确认）
3. BuyPosOpen参数为true
4. 没有多头持仓

**卖出条件**：
1. 前一柱：Ind[1] < Sign[1]（趋势向下）
2. 当前柱：Ind[0] >= Sign[0]（指标线交叉确认）
3. SellPosOpen参数为true
4. 没有空头持仓

### 2.3 出场条件

**平多仓**：
- 当产生卖出信号时（Ind从上方穿越Sign向下）
- SellPosClose参数为true

**平空仓**：
- 当产生买入信号时（Ind从下方穿越Sign向上）
- BuyPosClose参数为true

**止损/止盈**：
- 固定止损：1000点（默认）
- 固定止盈：2000点（默认）
- 风险比：1:2（合理）

### 2.4 风险管理

- **止损/止盈逻辑**：固定点数止损止盈，风险比1:2
- **手数管理**：支持5种资金管理模式
  - FREEMARGIN：按可用保证金计算
  - BALANCE：按账户余额计算
  - LOSSFREEMARGIN：按可用保证金亏损计算
  - LOSSBALANCE：按余额亏损计算
  - LOT：固定手数
- **其他风控**：
  - 新柱检测（避免同一柱重复交易）
  - 交易时间级别检查
  - 经纪商止损级别验证

EA-13787.name: Exp_iAnchMom
EA-13787.summary: This EA trades based on the iAnchMom (Anchored Momentum) custom indicator, which combines SMA and EMA to measure momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when momentum turns upward and sell positions when momentum turns downward, with configurable entry/exit toggles for each direction. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.
EA-13787.summary_zh: 该EA基于iAnchMom（锚定动量）自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合SMA和EMA来衡量动量变化。当动量向上反转时开多仓，动量向下反转时开空仓，每个方向的开仓和平仓均可独立配置。仓位管理支持多种保证金模式，包括固定手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比。
EA-13787.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于iAnchMom锚定动量指标的方向性交易。入场条件为：当指标值Value[1]<Value[2]（动量从下降转为上升）且当前值Value[0]>=Value[1]时，开多仓；当指标值Value[1]>Value[2]（动量从上升转为下降）且当前值Value[0]<=Value[1]时，开空仓。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓，即持有多仓时若出现动量下降信号则平多仓，持有空仓时若出现动量上升信号则平空仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额、基于可用保证金、基于扣损后可用保证金、基于扣损后余额。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现，设有止损和止盈参数分别为1000和2000点。策略仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算，但缺乏额外的趋势过滤器或波动率过滤器来过滤震荡行情中的假信号。
EA-13787.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is directional trading based on the iAnchMom (Anchored Momentum) custom indicator, which combines a 34-period SMA with a 20-period EMA applied to a selectable price type. Entry conditions are: when indicator values show Value[1]<Value[2] (momentum shifting upward) and the current value Value[0]>=Value[1], a buy position is opened; when Value[1]>Value[2] (momentum shifting downward) and Value[0]<=Value[1], a sell position is opened. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals triggering position closure — a long position is closed when a downward momentum signal appears, and a short position is closed when an upward momentum signal appears. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with five margin modes: fixed lot size, balance-based, free margin-based, loss-adjusted free margin, and loss-adjusted balance. Money management is implemented through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen) with configurable stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points. The strategy only recalculates signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant per-tick computations, but lacks additional trend or volatility filters to screen out false signals during choppy, range-bound market conditions.

EA-13788.name: Exp_Ichimoku_Osc
EA-13788.summary: This EA trades based on an Ichimoku Oscillator custom indicator that smooths the difference between Tenkan-sen and Kijun-sen using configurable smoothing algorithms. It opens buy positions when the oscillator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with optional position closing on reverse signals. Trade sizing is handled via multiple money management modes with fixed stop loss and take profit.
EA-13788.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义的Ichimoku振荡器指标进行交易，该指标使用可配置的平滑算法对Tenkan-sen与Kijun-sen的差值进行平滑处理。当振荡器向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并可选择在反向信号时平仓。交易仓位通过多种资金管理模式配合固定止损止盈来控制。
EA-13788.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Ichimoku振荡器，即Tenkan-sen与Kijun-sen之差的平滑值，本质上是将一目均衡表的趋势信号转化为动量振荡器形式。入场条件为：当振荡器值从下降转为上升（Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>=Value[1]）时开多仓，当振荡器值从上升转为下降（Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<=Value[1]）时开空仓。出场条件包括固定止损（1000点）和固定止盈（2000点），以及反向信号触发的平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制投入比例，默认0.1即10%。信号仅在新区块或指定信号柱上计算，避免重复开仓，但缺乏对已有同方向仓位的检查机制。
EA-13788.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on an Ichimoku Oscillator which smooths the difference between Tenkan-sen and Kijun-sen, essentially converting Ichimoku trend signals into a momentum oscillator form. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the oscillator turns upward (Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>=Value[1]), and a sell position opens when it turns downward (Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<=Value[1]). Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss of 1000 points, a fixed take profit of 2000 points, and reverse signal closing controlled by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter at a default of 0.1 (10%), and the MMMode parameter selects the calculation method. Signals are only calculated on new bars or the specified signal bar to prevent repeated entries, but the EA lacks a check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially leading to multiple overlapping entries.

EA-13793.name: Exp_HullTrendOSMA
EA-13793.summary: This EA trades based on the HullTrendOSMA custom indicator, which applies Hull moving average smoothing to an OSMA-style oscillator. It opens buy positions when the oscillator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable money management and separate open/close controls.
EA-13793.summary_zh: 该EA基于HullTrendOSMA自定义指标进行交易，该指标对OSMA震荡器应用Hull移动平均平滑处理。当震荡器向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并提供可配置的资金管理和独立的开平仓控制。
EA-13793.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于HullTrendOSMA震荡指标的趋势转折信号，通过双重平滑算法（XMA_Method和XMA_Method1）减少噪音产生交易信号。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（震荡器下降趋势）且Value[0]>=Value[1]（开始回升）时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（震荡器上升趋势）且Value[0]<=Value[1]（开始回落）时开空仓。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等方式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择仓位计算模式，但缺乏根据市场波动性动态调整的机制。
EA-13793.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend reversal signals from the HullTrendOSMA oscillator indicator, which uses double smoothing algorithms (XMA_Method and XMA_Method1) to reduce noise and generate trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] (oscillator declining) and Value[0]>=Value[1] (starting to rise); a sell position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] (oscillator rising) and Value[0]<=Value[1] (starting to fall). Exit conditions rely on reverse signals triggering position closure, supplemented by fixed pip-based stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing supports multiple modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode for lot calculation mode, but lacks dynamic adjustment based on market volatility.

EA-13796.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagHLR oscillator, a zero-lag composite momentum indicator built from five weighted HLR (High-Low Range) components. It opens buy positions when the oscillator crosses upward and sell positions when it crosses downward, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. Trading signals are processed only on new bars to avoid redundant entries.
EA-13796.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagHLR振荡器进行交易，该振荡器是由五个加权HLR（高低范围）分量合成的零滞后动量指标。当振荡器向上交叉时开多仓，向下交叉时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。交易信号仅在新K线形成时处理以避免重复入场。
EA-13796.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于零滞后HLR振荡器，该指标通过五个不同周期（8、21、34、55、89）的HLR分量按不同权重（0.05、0.10、0.16、0.26、0.43）加权合成，旨在消除传统技术指标的滞后性。入场条件为：当振荡器主线在SignalBar位置从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，从上方穿越信号线时开空仓，即经典的振荡器交叉策略。出场条件包括：反向交叉信号触发平仓（多头平仓由BuyPosClose控制，空头平仓由SellPosClose控制），以及固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持手数模式和保证金比例模式，由MMMode参数决定。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中封装的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现，信号仅在IsNewBar检测到新K线时生成，避免同一K线内重复交易。
EA-13796.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Zero-Lag HLR oscillator, which combines five HLR components with different periods (8, 21, 34, 55, 89) and weights (0.05, 0.10, 0.16, 0.26, 0.43) to eliminate the lag inherent in traditional technical indicators. Entry conditions are classic oscillator crossover: a buy signal is generated when the main oscillator line crosses above the signal line at the specified SignalBar, and a sell signal is generated on the opposite crossover. Exit conditions include reverse crossover signals that trigger position closing (controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose flags), plus fixed stop-loss at 1000 points and take-profit at 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either lot-based or margin-per-lot modes as determined by the MMMode parameter. Money management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen), which encapsulate order execution logic. Signals are only generated when IsNewBar detects a new bar formation, preventing redundant trades within the same bar.

EA-13798.name: Exp_i-AMMA
EA-13798.summary: This EA trades based on the i-AMMA (Adaptive Modified Moving Average) indicator, opening buy positions when the AMMA value rises and sell positions when it falls. It uses a crossover-like logic comparing the current and previous bar indicator values to determine trend direction and generate entry/exit signals. Position sizing is configurable through multiple margin modes, and it includes stop loss and take profit for risk management.
EA-13798.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-AMMA（自适应修正移动平均）指标进行交易，当AMMA值上升时开多仓，下降时开空仓。它通过比较当前和前一K线的指标值来判断趋势方向并生成入场/出场信号。仓位大小可通过多种保证金模式配置，并包含止损止盈功能。
EA-13798.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于自适应修正移动平均线(i-AMMA)的趋势跟踪系统，通过比较连续三根K线的指标值来判断趋势方向和动量变化。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（指标从下降转为上升或下降减缓）且Value[0]>Value[1]（近期值大于前一期值，确认上升趋势）时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空仓。出场条件与入场方向相反：多头持仓时若指标转为下降则平多仓，空头持仓时若指标转为上升则平空仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的可用保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制每笔交易的风险比例或固定手数，止损1000点和止盈2000点提供了2:1的盈亏比。
EA-13798.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a trend-following system based on the Adaptive Modified Moving Average (i-AMMA) indicator, determining trend direction and momentum changes by comparing three consecutive bar values. Entry conditions: open a buy position when Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator transitioning from decline) and Value[0]>Value[1] (confirming upward momentum), and open a sell position when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1]. Exit conditions are the reverse of entry: close a long position when the indicator turns downward, and close a short position when it turns upward. Position sizing supports five margin modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the risk percentage or fixed lot per trade, while the 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit provide a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio.

EA-138.name: Puria
EA-138.summary: Puria is a trend-following EA that uses a triple Moving Average crossover system combined with MACD confirmation to generate buy and sell signals. It enters long when the fast EMA(5) crosses above two slow LWMA(75,85) with MACD above zero, and enters short on the inverse condition. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels, and only one position at a time is allowed.
EA-138.summary_zh: Puria是一个趋势跟踪EA，使用三重移动平均线交叉系统结合MACD确认来生成买卖信号。当快速EMA(5)上穿两条慢速LWMA(75,85)且MACD大于零时做多，反之做空。仓位使用固定止损和止盈管理，同一时间只允许持有一个头寸。
EA-138.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用三重移动平均线交叉策略作为核心概念，结合MACD指标进行趋势确认。入场条件为：做多时，EMA(5)必须同时高于LWMA(75)和LWMA(85)，前一根K线收盘价高于EMA(5)，且MACD值大于零；做空条件则完全相反。出场条件完全依赖固定的止损和止盈水平，没有追踪止损或其他动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，不根据账户余额或风险比例动态调整。资金管理方面存在明显不足，没有最大回撤控制、没有仓位比例计算，且止损止盈点数较小，在5位报价平台上会乘以10但整体风险敞口仍然较大。
EA-138.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a triple moving average crossover strategy as its core concept, combined with MACD confirmation for trend validation. Entry conditions for a buy require EMA(5) to be above both LWMA(75) and LWMA(85), the previous bar's close price above EMA(5), and MACD above zero; sell conditions are the exact inverse. Exit conditions rely entirely on fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels, with no trailing stop or other dynamic exit mechanisms. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach without any dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management is noticeably deficient—there is no maximum drawdown control, no risk-based position sizing, and the relatively small SL/TP values (14/15 pips) combined with the one-position-at-a-time constraint limit both risk and reward potential.

EA-13823.name: Exp_Instantaneous_TrendFilter
EA-13823.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the Instantaneous TrendFilter indicator, which uses an Ehlers-style alpha smoothing constant. It opens buy positions when the trend filter oscillator crosses above its signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-13823.summary_zh: 该EA基于Instantaneous TrendFilter指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标使用Ehlers风格的alpha平滑常数。当趋势滤波振荡器上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿信号线时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-13823.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用Instantaneous TrendFilter指标作为核心策略，这是一个基于John Ehlers瞬时趋势滤波理论的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：指标缓冲区1上穿缓冲区0时产生买入信号，缓冲区1下穿缓冲区0时产生卖出信号，采用相邻两根K线的交叉判定方式。出场条件包括：反向交叉信号触发平仓（买入信号时平卖仓，卖出信号时平买仓），以及固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，默认为0.1手或账户资金的0.1%，支持手数模式和资金比例模式两种仓位计算方式。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现，允许用户通过BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen和BuyPosClose/SellPosClose参数分别控制开仓和平仓的启用状态。策略使用SignalBar参数控制信号确认的延迟，默认为1表示使用前一根已收盘K线的信号，避免未收盘K线的信号漂移问题。
EA-13823.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the Instantaneous TrendFilter indicator as its core strategy, which is based on John Ehlers' instantaneous trend filter theory for trend following. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 crosses above buffer 0, and a sell signal is generated when buffer 1 crosses below buffer 0, using a two-bar crossover detection method comparing consecutive bars. Exit conditions include: reverse crossover signals trigger position closure (buy signal closes sell positions, sell signal closes buy positions), along with fixed stop loss at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, defaulting to 0.1 lots or 0.1% of account funds, supporting both lot mode and margin proportion mode for position calculation. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, allowing users to separately enable/disable buy/sell opening and closing through BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and BuyPosClose/SellPosClose parameters. The strategy uses the SignalBar parameter to control signal confirmation delay, defaulting to 1 to use the previously closed bar's signal, avoiding signal drift issues from unclosed bars.

EA-1384.name: Exp_ColorXADX
EA-1384.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXADX custom indicator, which enhances the standard ADX with advanced smoothing algorithms. It enters buy positions when the DI+ line crosses above DI- with ADX above a threshold, and sell positions on the opposite crossover, both confirmed by trend strength. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1384.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXADX自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用高级平滑算法增强了标准ADX。当DI+上穿DI-且ADX高于阈值时开多仓，反之开空仓，均需趋势强度确认。持仓使用固定止损和止盈管理。
EA-1384.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ADX趋势强度指标与DI方向线的交叉来判断趋势方向和入场时机。入场条件为：做多信号需DI+上穿DI-（即前一根DI+小于DI-，当前DI+大于DI-）且ADX值高于ExtraHighLevel阈值；做空信号则相反，DI+下穿DI-且ADX高于阈值。出场条件分为两种：止损止盈出场使用固定的点数设置（StopLoss和TakeProfit），信号反转出场则在DI线交叉时平掉反向仓位。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，但缺少最大持仓数量限制和账户权益保护机制。策略使用T3平滑方法处理ADX数据，减少噪音信号，并通过SignalBar参数允许用户选择信号获取的K线位置。
EA-1384.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ADX trend strength indicator combined with DI directional line crossovers to determine trend direction and entry timing. Entry conditions require: a buy signal triggers when DI+ crosses above DI- (previous DI+ was below DI-, current DI+ is above DI-) and ADX exceeds the ExtraHighLevel threshold; a sell signal triggers on the opposite crossover with the same ADX filter. Exit conditions are twofold: fixed stop loss and take profit in points handle standard exits, while signal-based exits close opposite positions when DI lines cross. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management relies on functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library but lacks maximum position count limits and account equity protection mechanisms. The strategy employs T3 smoothing on ADX data to reduce noise, and the SignalBar parameter allows users to select which bar index to use for signal extraction.

EA-13850.name: Exp_ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle
EA-13850.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle custom indicator, which combines JJRSX (Jurik Relative Strength Index) with Schaff Trend Cycle logic. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions on downtrend signals, with configurable money management and stop loss/take profit levels.
EA-13850.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了JJRSX（Jurik相对强弱指数）和Schaff趋势周期逻辑。当指标发出上涨信号时开多仓，发出下跌信号时开空仓，具有可配置的资金管理和止损止盈设置。
EA-13850.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle指标，该指标融合了JJRSX（Jurik相对强弱指数的平滑变体）与Schaff趋势周期的振荡器逻辑，用于识别市场动量的方向变化。入场条件为：当指标颜色值大于5且前一值小于6时开多仓，当颜色值小于2且前一值大于1时开空仓，本质上是在捕捉趋势周期的转折点。出场条件分为主动出场和被动出场：主动出场根据指标反向信号平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose），被动出场依赖固定的止损和止盈参数。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的多种模式，包括按自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金比例或固定手数计算，默认使用固定手数模式（LOT）。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，但缺乏基于波动率或ATR的动态仓位调整机制。该策略具有新K线检测机制避免重复交易，并使用SignalBar参数允许在指定K线上判断信号以减少延迟。
EA-13850.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle indicator, which combines JJRSX (a smoothed variant of the Jurik Relative Strength Index) with Schaff Trend Cycle oscillator logic to identify directional shifts in market momentum. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the indicator color value exceeds 5 and the previous value was below 6, while a sell position opens when the color value drops below 2 and the previous value was above 1, essentially capturing turning points in the trend cycle. Exit conditions include both active and passive exits: active exits close positions based on opposing indicator signals (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose flags), while passive exits rely on fixed stop loss and take profit parameters. Position sizing leverages multiple modes from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, including calculation based on free margin, balance, post-loss margin percentage, or fixed lot size, with the default using fixed lot mode (LOT). Money management is controlled by the MM parameter at a default risk ratio of 0.1, but it lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms based on volatility or ATR. The strategy incorporates a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate trades and uses the SignalBar parameter to evaluate signals on a specified bar to reduce latency.

EA-13854.name: Exp_ColorZerolagJJRSX
EA-13854.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagJJRSX custom indicator, a zero-lag composite JJRSX oscillator. It opens buy positions when the fast oscillator crosses above the slow one and sell positions when the fast crosses below the slow one, with configurable position closing on reverse signals.
EA-13854.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorZerolagJJRSX进行交易，该指标是一个零滞后复合JJRSX振荡器。当快速振荡线向上穿越慢速线时开多仓，向下穿越时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。
EA-13854.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用ColorZerolagJJRSX零滞后复合振荡器的双线交叉进行动量交易。入场条件为：当Osc1（主线）从下方穿越Osc2（信号线）时产生买入信号，当Osc1从上方穿越Osc2时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数平仓，以及反向交叉信号触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数和按资金比例两种模式（由MMMode决定）。振荡器由5个不同周期（8,21,34,55,89）的JJRSX加权组合而成，各因子分别为0.05,0.10,0.16,0.26,0.43，旨在消除滞后性。策略支持独立的买卖开仓和平仓开关，允许灵活控制交易方向。
EA-13854.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses the ColorZerolagJJRSX zero-lag composite oscillator's dual-line crossover for momentum trading. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Osc1 (main line) crosses above Osc2 (signal line), and a sell signal when Osc1 crosses below Osc2. Exit conditions include fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points, plus reverse crossover signal-triggered position closing. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot and margin-proportional modes (determined by MMMode). The oscillator is a weighted composite of 5 JJRSX indicators with different periods (8,21,34,55,89) and factors (0.05,0.10,0.16,0.26,0.43), designed to eliminate lag. The strategy supports independent buy/sell open and close switches, allowing flexible control over trading direction.

EA-13871.name: GlobalVariable
EA-13871.summary: This EA is a utility demonstration of MQL5 global variable functions (GlobalVariableSet, GlobalVariableGet, GlobalVariableCheck). It creates a client-side global variable with a calculated random value on init and updates it on deinit, with no trading logic whatsoever.
EA-13871.summary_zh: 该EA是一个MQL5全局变量功能的工具演示，展示了GlobalVariableSet、GlobalVariableGet、GlobalVariableCheck的用法。它在初始化时创建全局变量并存入随机计算值，在反初始化时更新该值，没有任何交易逻辑。
EA-13871.strategy_analysis: 该EA不具备任何交易策略，它纯粹是一个展示MQL5全局变量操作的示例工具。策略概念上，它演示了如何在终端全局变量池中创建、检查和读取变量。入场条件无，因为它不执行任何交易操作；出场条件同样不存在。仓位管理和资金管理完全缺失，因为该EA不涉及任何订单或头寸。核心逻辑是：初始化时检查全局变量是否存在，不存在则通过MathRand计算随机值并创建，存在则读取已有值；反初始化时重新计算值并更新全局变量。变量命名采用前缀加魔数的方式（main_id_1010458），以确保唯一性。
EA-13871.strategy_analysis_en: This EA has no trading strategy at all; it is purely a demonstration tool for MQL5 global variable operations. In terms of strategy concept, it illustrates how to create, check, and read variables in the terminal's global variable pool. There are no entry conditions since it does not execute any trading operations, and likewise no exit conditions exist. Position sizing and money management are completely absent because the EA does not involve any orders or positions. The core logic is: on initialization, it checks if the global variable exists; if not, it calculates a random value via MathRand and creates it; if it exists, it reads the existing value. On deinitialization, it recalculates the value and updates the global variable. Variable naming uses a prefix plus magic number pattern (main_id_1010458) to ensure uniqueness.

EA-13875.name: Exp_ColorZerolagJCCX
EA-13875.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the ColorZerolagJCCX oscillator, a zero-lag composite momentum indicator built from five weighted JCCX components with JJMA smoothing. It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable options for entry and exit on each signal direction.
EA-13875.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagJCCX振荡器的交叉信号进行交易，这是一个由五个加权JCCX分量和JJMA平滑构建的零滞后复合动量指标。当主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，反向穿越时开空仓，并支持对每个方向的入场和出场进行独立配置。
EA-13875.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于ColorZerolagJCCX零滞后动量振荡器的双线交叉系统。入场条件为：当主线Osc1上穿信号线Osc2时产生做多信号，同时若主线从上方下穿信号线则触发卖出开仓；交叉方向的反转自动触发反向仓位的平仓信号。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），以及交叉信号的反转平仓机制。仓位管理采用基于资金比例（MM=0.1）和可切换的LOT/FREE_MARGIN/LOT_STEP模式，通过TradeAlgorithms库的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数执行。资金管理方面，MM参数控制每笔交易的资金比例，默认0.1表示较保守的仓位规模。策略还引入了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线内重复开仓，并使用SignalBar=1确保信号确认后再入场，减少假突破风险。
EA-13875.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a dual-line crossover system based on the ColorZerolagJCCX zero-lag momentum oscillator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the main line Osc1 crosses above the signal line Osc2, while a sell signal fires on the reverse crossover; the crossover direction reversal automatically triggers closing of the opposing position. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points), plus the crossover reversal close mechanism. Position sizing uses a money percentage approach (MM=0.1) with switchable LOT/FREE_MARGIN/LOT_STEP modes, executed through the TradeAlgorithms library's BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter, with a default of 0.1 indicating a relatively conservative position size relative to account equity. The strategy also incorporates a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated entries within the same bar, and uses SignalBar=1 to ensure signal confirmation before entry, reducing false breakout risk.

pros: 零滞后指标设计减少了传统动量指标的延迟问题，使信号更及时

pros_en: The zero-lag indicator design reduces the delay problem of traditional momentum indicators, making signals more timely
Independent buy/sell open and close switches provide flexible strategy control, allowing single-direction trading only
New bar detection and SignalBar confirmation mechanism effectively prevent repeated entries within the same bar and false signals

cons: 缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在高点差时段可能产生不利入场

止损1000点和止盈2000点在H4周期上偏大，可能承受较大浮亏
依赖外部自定义指标ColorZerolagJCCX，若该指标未正确安装则EA无法运行
cons_en: Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, which may lead to unfavorable entries during high-spread periods
No trailing stop or dynamic stop mechanism; fixed stop-loss cannot adapt to changing market volatility
No position check logic; may repeatedly open positions in the same direction when one already exists
Stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are relatively large on H4 timeframe, potentially enduring significant drawdowns

improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在流动性差的时间段入场

Introduce trailing stop or ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit to adapt to different market volatility environments

risk_points_en: No position count check; may repeatedly open same-direction positions leading to excessive leverage
Fixed 1000-point stop-loss can still be gapped over in extreme market conditions causing larger losses
Lacks effective spread and slippage protection; Deviation_=10 may be insufficient during volatile periods

EA-13879.name: Exp_ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle
EA-13879.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle indicator, a Schaff trend cycle oscillator built on JCCX (Jurik Composite Color eXtended) with JJMA smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator color changes to bullish (above +5) and sell positions when it changes to bearish (below +2), with corresponding close signals. Position sizing is configurable via money management modes including lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.
EA-13879.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle指标进行交易，该指标是构建在JCCX（Jurik复合彩色扩展）上的Schaff趋势周期振荡器，并使用JJMA平滑。当指标颜色变为看涨（高于+5）时开多仓，变为看跌（低于+2）时开空仓，同时发出对应的平仓信号。仓位管理支持基于手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比等多种模式。
EA-13879.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Schaff趋势周期指标，该指标结合了JCCX动量振荡和JJMA自适应平滑，通过颜色变化识别趋势转折。入场条件为：当指标颜色索引从非看涨（≤5）变为看涨（>5）时开多仓，当颜色索引从非看跌（≥2）变为看跌（<2）时开空仓。出场条件为：看涨信号触发时平空仓，看跌信号触发时平多仓，同时设有止损1000点和止盈2000点。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于亏损后可用保证金、基于亏损后余额的比例计算。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1。指标使用SignalBar参数决定信号读取位置，默认为1（前一根已收盘K线），有助于避免未收盘K线的信号反复。EA还使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，防止同K线内重复交易。
EA-13879.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Schaff Trend Cycle indicator, which combines JCCX momentum oscillation with JJMA adaptive smoothing to identify trend reversals through color changes. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator color index transitions from non-bullish (≤5) to bullish (>5), and a sell position opens when the color index transitions from non-bearish (≥2) to bearish (<2). Exit conditions: a bullish signal triggers the closing of sell positions, while a bearish signal triggers the closing of buy positions, with a stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, and percentage of balance after losses. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The indicator uses the SignalBar parameter to determine which bar to read signals from, defaulting to 1 (the last closed bar), which helps avoid signal fluctuation from unclosed bars. The EA also employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing repeated trades within the same bar.

EA-1389.name: Exp_EF_distance
EA-1389.summary: This EA trades based on the EF_distance indicator, which measures the efficiency of price movement to detect trend direction. It opens buy positions when the EF_distance values indicate an upward trend (Value[0]>Value[1]<Value[2]) and sell positions when they indicate a downward trend, with an optional Flat-Trend volatility filter in the full version.
EA-1389.summary_zh: 该EA基于EF_distance指标进行交易，该指标衡量价格运动的效率来检测趋势方向。当EF_distance值显示上升趋势时开多仓，显示下降趋势时开空仓，完整版还包含Flat-Trend波动率过滤器。
EA-1389.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于EF_distance指标，该指标通过计算价格移动的效率来衡量趋势强度和方向。入场条件为：做多时要求EF_distance的前两个值递减（Value[1]<Value[2]）且当前值回升（Value[0]>Value[1]），同时完整版要求Flat-Trend波动率指标值大于等于设定的波动率阈值；做空则相反。出场条件通过反向信号触发，即做多持仓时出现做空信号则平多仓，做空持仓时出现做多信号则平空仓，同时设置了固定的止损和止盈点数。仓位管理方面，通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，但没有动态调整止损止盈或追踪止损的机制。完整版(exp_ef_distance.mq5)额外引入了Flat-Trend指标作为波动率过滤器，只有在市场波动率足够时才允许开仓，提高了信号质量。
EA-1389.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the EF_distance indicator, which measures the efficiency of price movement to determine trend strength and direction. Entry conditions for buy positions require the EF_distance values to show a descending pattern over the prior two bars (Value[1]<Value[2]) with the current bar reversing upward (Value[0]>Value[1]), and the full version additionally requires the Flat-Trend volatility indicator to meet or exceed the configured volatility threshold. Sell entry conditions are the mirror opposite, requiring an ascending pattern that reverses downward. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals — a long position is closed when a sell signal appears and vice versa, with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management is handled through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, but there is no dynamic adjustment of stop-loss, take-profit, or trailing stop mechanism. The full version (exp_ef_distance.mq5) adds the Flat-Trend indicator as a volatility filter, only allowing entries when market volatility is sufficient, which improves signal quality.

improvements: 将固定止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态止损止盈，使风险管理适应市场波动
