EA-13895.name: Exp_KalmanFilter
EA-13895.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the KalmanFilter custom indicator, which uses a Kalman filter algorithm to estimate price trends. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward trend and sell positions on downward trends, with configurable entry/exit switches and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels. The strategy supports two signal modes: trend-based and Kalman-based, operating on a user-defined timeframe.
EA-13895.summary_zh: 该EA基于KalmanFilter自定义指标的信号进行交易，利用卡尔曼滤波算法估计价格趋势。当指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，下降趋势信号时开空仓，并配有可配置的入场/出场开关和固定止损止盈。策略支持两种信号模式：趋势模式和卡尔曼模式，在用户定义的时间周期上运行。
EA-13895.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于卡尔曼滤波器指标，卡尔曼滤波是一种递归最优估计算法，能够从含噪价格数据中提取趋势信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值为1时（上升趋势），若前一个值为0则触发买入信号；当值为0时（下降趋势），若前一个值为1则触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖独立的买卖平仓开关，分别在趋势反转时触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后余额、亏损后自由保证金及固定手数五种模式计算仓位大小。资金管理方面，EA使用固定点数止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），止盈是止损的两倍，具有正期望比。策略还引入了新柱检测机制（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线上重复交易，同时通过SignalBar参数允许用户选择回溯的信号柱位置。
EA-13895.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the Kalman Filter indicator, which uses a recursive optimal estimation algorithm to extract trend signals from noisy price data. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 1 equals 1 (uptrend) and the previous value was 0, a buy signal is triggered; when the value equals 0 (downtrend) and the previous value was 1, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions rely on independent buy/sell close switches that trigger position closure upon trend reversal. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-free margin, loss-balance, and fixed lot size. For money management, the EA uses fixed stop-loss (default 1000 points) and take-profit (default 2000 points), yielding a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio with positive expectancy. The strategy also implements a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated trading on the same bar, and allows users to select the signal bar offset via the SignalBar parameter for backtesting flexibility.

EA-13916.name: Exp_derivative
EA-13916.summary: This EA trades based on the derivative (rate of change) of a price series, entering positions when the momentum derivative signals a directional shift. It calculates the mathematical derivative of price to detect acceleration or deceleration in trend movement, opening trades when the derivative crosses key thresholds. The strategy aims to capture early trend momentum shifts before they become visually apparent on the chart.
EA-13916.summary_zh: 该EA基于价格序列的导数（变化率）进行交易，当动量导数信号出现方向性转变时开仓。它通过计算价格的数学导数来检测趋势运动的加速或减速，在导数穿越关键阈值时开仓交易。该策略旨在捕捉趋势动量转变的早期信号。
EA-13916.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于价格导数（即价格变化的速率）来判断市场动量的方向和强度。入场条件为当价格导数从负转正时做多，从正转负时做空，这代表着动量方向的拐点。出场条件则是在导数信号反转时平仓，或通过止损/止盈参数控制风险。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理依赖于输入参数中的止损和止盈设置来控制每笔交易的风险敞口。该策略的理论优势在于能够提前捕捉趋势的启动点，因为导数变化先于价格本身的显著移动。然而，在震荡市中导数信号频繁翻转可能导致连续亏损，缺乏过滤机制是其主要短板。
EA-13916.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is based on the price derivative (rate of price change) to determine the direction and strength of market momentum. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the price derivative crosses from negative to positive, and a short position when it crosses from positive to negative, representing inflection points in momentum direction. Exit conditions close positions when the derivative signal reverses, or through stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or an equity-based calculation method. Money management relies on the input parameters for stop-loss and take-profit to control risk exposure per trade. The theoretical advantage is the ability to capture early trend initiation points since derivative changes precede significant price movements. However, in ranging markets the derivative signal can flip frequently, leading to consecutive losses, and the lack of a filtering mechanism is a notable shortcoming.

EA-1392.name: Exp_MultiTrend_Signal_KVN
EA-1392.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom MultiTrend_Signal_KVN indicator, which identifies trend direction changes. It opens positions only when the signal indicates a trend reversal from the opposite direction, and closes existing positions when the trend signal flips. Position sizing is controlled via a deposit share or fixed lot input parameter.
EA-1392.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义MultiTrend_Signal_KVN指标的交易信号进行操作，识别趋势方向变化。仅在信号表明从相反方向发生趋势反转时才开仓，并在趋势信号翻转时平仓。仓位大小通过存款份额或固定手数输入参数控制。
EA-1392.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于MultiTrend_Signal_KVN指标的趋势跟踪交易系统。入场条件为：当指标在SignalBar上产生买入信号且上一趋势为下跌趋势时开多仓，当产生卖出信号且上一趋势为上涨趋势时开空仓，确保只在趋势反转时入场。出场条件包括：止损和止盈分别设为1000点和2000点，同时当反向信号出现时主动平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。策略还通过向后搜索历史K线确定最近趋势方向，作为入场过滤条件，只有趋势反转信号才会触发开仓。
EA-1392.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following trading system based on the custom MultiTrend_Signal_KVN indicator. Entry conditions require a buy signal on the SignalBar when the last detected trend was bearish, or a sell signal when the last trend was bullish, ensuring positions are opened only on trend reversals. Exit conditions include a Stop Loss of 1000 points, a Take Profit of 2000 points, and active position closing when an opposing signal appears. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit calculated proportionally. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades on the same bar. The strategy also performs a backward search through historical bars to determine the last trend direction, serving as an entry filter that only permits trades on confirmed trend reversals.

EA-13928.name: Exp_KPrmSt
EA-13928.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover of two buffers from the custom KPrmSt indicator. It opens buy positions when the first buffer crosses above the second and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position management settings.
EA-13928.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义KPrmSt指标的两个缓冲区交叉信号进行交易。当第一缓冲区上穿第二缓冲区时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，支持止损、止盈和仓位管理配置。
EA-13928.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于KPrmSt自定义指标的双线交叉趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当Ma1[1]>Ma2[1]（前一根K线第一缓冲区在第二缓冲区之上）且Ma1[0]<=Ma2[0]（再前一根K线第一缓冲区在第二缓冲区之下或相等）时，产生买入开仓信号，即金叉确认。卖出入场条件相反，为死叉确认。出场条件由反向交叉信号触发，分别关闭多头和空头仓位，同时设置了固定点数的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数(LOT)和保证金比例两种模式。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，并通过BarsCalculated检查指标数据是否就绪。总体而言，这是一个典型的双均线交叉类趋势跟踪系统，逻辑简洁明了。
EA-13928.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual-line crossover trend-following strategy based on the custom KPrmSt indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Ma1[1]>Ma2[1] (the first buffer is above the second on the previous bar) AND Ma1[0]<=Ma2[0] (the first buffer was at or below the second on the bar before that), confirming a golden cross. Sell entry is the reverse — a death cross confirmation. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing crossover signals, where a bullish crossover closes short positions and a bearish crossover closes long positions. Fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) are applied to all trades for risk management. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot size (LOT mode) and margin-based sizing. The strategy uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades, and checks BarsCalculated to verify indicator data readiness before processing. Overall, this is a classic dual-moving-average crossover trend-following system with straightforward logic.

EA-13943.name: Exp_TEMA_CUSTOM
EA-13943.summary: This EA trades based on a Triple Exponential Moving Average (TEMA) custom indicator with configurable smoothing methods for each of the three MA layers. It opens buy positions when the TEMA value is rising (Value[0]>Value[1] with Value[1]<Value[2]) and sell positions when falling, closing opposite positions on signal reversal.
EA-13943.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义三重指数移动平均线(TEMA)指标进行交易，支持为三个MA层分别配置平滑方法。当TEMA值上升时开多仓并平空仓，当TEMA值下降时开空仓并平多仓，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。
EA-13943.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于自定义TEMA指标的趋势跟踪，TEMA通过对三层数据分别应用不同的平滑算法来减少滞后性，从而更灵敏地捕捉趋势变化。入场条件为：当指标值从下降转为上升（Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>Value[1]）时开多仓，当指标值从上升转为下降（Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<Value[1]）时开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置，以及反向信号触发时平掉对应仓位。仓位管理方面，EA支持多种资金管理模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数。EA使用了IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免逐tick重复交易，同时通过SignalBar参数允许用户选择使用哪根K线的信号。风险控制依赖于固定的止损止盈点数，但没有考虑滑点过滤、点差过滤和持仓数量限制等额外风控措施。
EA-13943.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is trend following based on a custom TEMA indicator, which applies three separate smoothing algorithms to reduce lag and more sensitively capture trend changes. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator transitions from declining to rising (Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>Value[1]), and a sell signal when it transitions from rising to declining (Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1]). Exit conditions include hard stop-loss and take-profit levels in points, as well as closing opposite positions when a reversal signal is triggered. Position sizing supports multiple money management modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. The EA employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing repeated trades on every tick, and the SignalBar parameter allows users to choose which bar's signal to use. Risk control relies on fixed stop-loss and take-profit points, but lacks additional safeguards such as spread filtering, slippage protection beyond Deviation_, and maximum position count limits.

EA-13944.name: Exp_XDerivative
EA-13944.summary: This EA trades based on the XDerivative custom indicator, which calculates a smoothed derivative of price. It opens buy positions when the derivative turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable money management and separate buy/sell open/close controls.
EA-13944.summary_zh: 该EA基于XDerivative自定义指标进行交易，该指标计算价格的平滑导数。当导数向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，支持可配置的资金管理和独立的买卖开平仓控制。
EA-13944.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XDerivative指标的导数变化来判断价格动量的转折。入场条件：当Value[1]<Value[2]（指标下降趋势中）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值回升）时，产生买入信号；当Value[1]>Value[2]（指标上升趋势中）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前值回落）时，产生卖出信号。这本质上是捕捉动量的拐点，属于动量反转交易策略。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit进行风险控制。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除亏损后的可用保证金比例、按扣除亏损后的余额比例、以及固定手数。指标使用JJMA等高级平滑算法对价格导数进行平滑处理，减少了噪声干扰但可能引入滞后。
EA-13944.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the derivative changes of the XDerivative indicator to identify price momentum turning points. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator in downtrend) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current value rising), meaning the derivative is turning up from a decline; a sell signal is generated when Value[1]>Value[2] (indicator in uptrend) and Value[0]<Value[1] (current value falling), meaning the derivative is turning down from a rise. This is essentially capturing momentum inflection points, classifying it as a momentum reversal trading strategy. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals, with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit providing risk control. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. The indicator uses advanced smoothing algorithms like JJMA to smooth the price derivative, reducing noise but potentially introducing lag.

EA-13962.name: Exp_XKRI_Histogram
EA-13962.summary: This EA trades based on the XKRI_Histogram custom indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram rises and sell positions when it falls. It uses configurable money management, fixed stop-loss and take-profit, and provides separate toggles for opening and closing positions on both sides. Signal generation occurs on new bar formation with a one-bar signal delay by default.
EA-13962.summary_zh: 该EA基于XKRI_Histogram自定义指标进行交易，当直方图上升时开多仓，下降时开空仓。它使用可配置的资金管理方式、固定止损止盈，并分别提供多空两侧的开仓和平仓开关。信号默认在K线形成时生成，使用一根K线延迟。
EA-13962.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于XKRI_Histogram指标的动量变化进行交易。入场条件为：当直方图值从前期下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当直方图值从前期上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定止损（默认1000点）和固定止盈（默认2000点），同时支持基于反向信号的平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按净自由保证金比例、按净余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1。指标本身结合了KRI周期、MA平滑方法、XMA平滑算法等多个参数，具有较强的可调性。信号生成仅在新K线形成时触发，避免了逐tick计算的冗余，但SignalBar设为0时会在每个tick都执行信号判断。
EA-13962.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's core strategy trades on momentum changes detected by the XKRI_Histogram indicator. Entry conditions: a buy is opened when the histogram value rises from a prior decline (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell is opened when the histogram value falls from a prior rise (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss (default 1000 points) and take-profit (default 2000 points), with optional signal-based position closing via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose toggles. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, net free margin percentage, net balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The indicator itself combines KRI period, MA smoothing method, and XMA smoothing algorithm with multiple configurable parameters. Signal generation triggers only on new bar formation by default, avoiding redundant per-tick computation, though setting SignalBar=0 enables tick-level signal evaluation.

EA-1397.name: BreakoutBarsTrend_EA
EA-1397.summary: This EA trades trend reversals detected by the custom BreakoutBarsTrend_v2 indicator. It enters a position when the indicator signals a trend direction change, optionally waiting for a configurable number of consecutive negative (losing) trend reversals before entering. Stop Loss and Take Profit are calculated based on either pips or percentage mode.
EA-1397.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标BreakoutBarsTrend_v2检测趋势反转信号进行交易。当指标发出趋势方向变化信号时入场，可选择在连续出现指定次数的亏损反转信号后才入场。止损和止盈可按点数或百分比模式计算。
EA-1397.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于BreakoutBarsTrend_v2指标检测趋势突破与反转。入场条件为：指标值从正变负（趋势向下反转）时做空，从负变正（趋势向上反转）时做多。此外，EA提供了一个负信号过滤机制——当InpNegatives大于0时，只有在前N次趋势反转信号均为亏损（即价格未能朝预期方向运动）的情况下才会开仓，这是一种逆向入场思路，试图在连续失败后捕捉成功的反转。出场条件有两种：一是当指标再次发出反向信号时平仓，二是触发止损或止盈。仓位管理采用固定手数（InpLot），仅做成交量边界校验和步长规范化。资金管理方面，止损和止盈可按点数或百分比两种模式设定，同时考虑了经纪商的最小止损水平限制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，缺乏动态仓位调整和风险敞口控制。
EA-1397.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on detecting trend breakouts and reversals using the BreakoutBarsTrend_v2 custom indicator. Entry conditions: the EA opens a buy when the indicator value crosses from negative to positive (trend reversal upward) and opens a sell when it crosses from positive to negative (trend reversal downward). Additionally, the EA implements a negative signal filter — when InpNegatives is greater than zero, it only enters after N consecutive losing reversal signals, which is a contrarian approach attempting to catch a successful reversal after a string of failures. Exit conditions include closing the position when the indicator issues an opposing reversal signal, or when the hardcoded stop loss or take profit levels are hit. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (InpLot) with only basic volume boundary validation and step normalization against broker limits. Money management allows stop loss and take profit to be set in either pips or percentage mode, and accounts for the broker's minimum stop level. The overall strategy logic is straightforward but lacks dynamic position sizing and overall risk exposure control.

EA-13971.name: Exp_LaguerreFilter
EA-13971.summary: This EA trades based on the Laguerre Filter indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator's signal line crosses above the filter line and sell positions when it crosses below. It uses a custom LaguerreFilter indicator with a gamma parameter to control smoothing, and includes configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and position sizing. The strategy is a trend-following system that enters on crossover signals and exits on reverse crossovers or SL/TP.
EA-13971.summary_zh: 该EA基于Laguerre滤波器指标进行交易，当信号线上穿滤波线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓。它使用自定义LaguerreFilter指标，通过gamma参数控制平滑程度，并包含可配置的止损、止盈和仓位管理。该策略属于趋势跟踪系统，在交叉信号时入场，在反向交叉或止损止盈时出场。
EA-13971.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Laguerre滤波器指标作为核心策略，利用其两条线（信号线和滤波线）的交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当信号线从下方穿越滤波线上方时开多仓，当信号线从上方穿越滤波线下方时开空仓，使用SignalBar参数指定信号确认的K线位置。出场条件包括反向交叉信号平仓以及固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金比例（默认0.1），并支持LOT和MARGIN两种仓位模式。资金管理方面，EA使用iCustom调用自定义指标，通过CopyBuffer获取指标数值，采用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的趋势跟踪交叉系统，但缺少加仓、减仓和移动止损等高级资金管理功能。
EA-13971.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Laguerre Filter indicator as its core strategy, utilizing crossovers between its two lines (signal line and filter line) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the signal line crosses above the filter line from below, and a sell position opens when the signal line crosses below the filter line from above, with the SignalBar parameter specifying the bar offset for signal confirmation. Exit conditions include closing on reverse crossover signals and fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points) levels. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) supporting both LOT and MARGIN modes for lot calculation. Money management relies on the custom LaguerreFilter indicator accessed via iCustom, with values retrieved through CopyBuffer, and an IsNewBar mechanism ensuring signals are calculated only once per bar to prevent duplicate trades. The overall strategy logic is clear and follows a typical trend-following crossover system, but lacks advanced money management features such as pyramiding, partial closes, or trailing stops.

EA-13997.name: Exp_Laguerre_ADX
EA-13997.summary: This EA trades based on the Laguerre_ADX custom indicator, opening buy positions when the Up line crosses above the Dn line and sell positions when the Dn line crosses above the Up line. It uses a crossover signal on a specified timeframe with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels.
EA-13997.summary_zh: 该EA基于Laguerre_ADX自定义指标进行交易，当Up线上穿Dn线时开多仓，当Dn线上穿Up线时开空仓。它在指定时间周期上使用交叉信号，并配置了资金管理、止损和止盈参数。
EA-13997.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Laguerre_ADX指标的趋势跟踪策略，Laguerre_ADX是对传统ADX指标的拉盖尔滤波改进版本，通过gamma参数控制平滑度。入场条件为：当Up[1]>Dn[1]（当前柱Up线高于Dn线）且前一柱Up[0]<Dn[0]（Up线从下方穿越Dn线）时开多仓；反之当Up[1]<Dn[1]且Up[0]>Dn[0]时开空仓。出场条件通过交叉反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的止损1000点和止盈2000点。仓位管理采用MM参数控制资金比例，默认0.1，支持手数模式和保证金模式两种资金管理方式。EA在每个新K线到来时计算信号，使用IsNewBar机制避免重复交易，SignalBar参数允许选择回溯柱数进行信号确认。
EA-13997.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy using the Laguerre_ADX indicator, which is a Laguerre-filtered improvement over the traditional ADX indicator, with the gamma parameter controlling the smoothing level. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when Up[1]>Dn[1] (current bar Up line above Dn line) and Up[0]<Dn[0] (Up line crossed from below), while a sell position opens when Up[1]<Dn[1] and Up[0]>Dn[0]. Exit conditions are triggered by the reverse crossover signal closing the opposing position, combined with a fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points. Position sizing uses the MM parameter to control the capital ratio with a default of 0.1, supporting both lot mode and margin mode for money management. The EA calculates signals on each new bar arrival using the IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades, and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting a lookback bar for signal confirmation. The crossover logic essentially detects trend direction changes in the Laguerre-filtered ADX lines.

EA-14009.name: Exp_LinearRegSlope_V1
EA-14009.summary: This EA trades based on the Linear Regression Slope indicator, opening buy positions when the slope crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below. It uses customizable smoothing methods and price types, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management parameters. The strategy is a systematic trend-following system that enters in the direction of the linear regression slope crossover.
EA-14009.summary_zh: 该EA基于线性回归斜率指标进行交易，当斜率上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓。它支持多种平滑算法和价格类型，并具有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理参数。该策略是一个系统性的趋势跟踪系统，按照线性回归斜率交叉方向入场。
EA-14009.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA使用线性回归斜率（LinearRegSlope_V1）指标来判断市场趋势方向，斜率为正表示上升趋势，斜率为负表示下降趋势。入场条件：当上轨线（UpValue）在上一根K线高于下轨线（DnValue）且当前K线发生交叉（UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0]）时触发买入信号；当下轨线高于上轨线且发生反向交叉时触发卖出信号。出场条件：买入信号触发时同时平掉卖出仓位，卖出信号触发时同时平掉买入仓位；此外还有独立的止损和止盈机制。仓位管理：使用MoneyManagement（MM）参数控制仓位大小，负值表示风险百分比模式，支持固定手数或比例仓位。资金管理：通过MM参数实现，默认-0.1表示使用风险百分比计算仓位，止损和止盈分别默认为1000和2000点。信号在每根新K线生成时计算，使用SignalBar参数控制信号延迟，并通过Recount机制确保数据可靠性。
EA-14009.strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA uses the Linear Regression Slope indicator to determine market trend direction, with positive slope indicating an uptrend and negative slope indicating a downtrend. Entry conditions: A buy signal is triggered when the upper line (UpValue) was above the lower line (DnValue) on the previous bar and a crossover occurs on the current bar (UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0]); a sell signal is triggered when the lower line was above and a reverse crossover occurs. Exit conditions: A buy signal simultaneously closes sell positions, and a sell signal simultaneously closes buy positions; additionally, there are independent stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms. Position sizing: The MoneyManagement (MM) parameter controls lot size, with negative values indicating risk percentage mode, supporting both fixed lots and proportional sizing. Money management: Implemented via the MM parameter, default -0.1 means using risk percentage to calculate position size, with default stop-loss and take-profit of 1000 and 2000 points respectively. Signals are calculated on each new bar using the SignalBar parameter for signal delay, and a Recount mechanism ensures data reliability when CopyBuffer fails.

EA-14046.name: Exp_LSMA_Angle
EA-14046.summary: This EA trades based on the LSMA (Least Squares Moving Average) Angle indicator, opening buy positions when the angle crosses upward above threshold and sell positions when it crosses downward. It uses a custom indicator handle to read angle values (0-4 scale) and generates signals on new bar formation, with configurable money management and separate open/close controls for long and short positions.
EA-14046.summary_zh: 该EA基于LSMA（最小二乘移动平均线）角度指标进行交易，当角度向上突破阈值时开多仓，向下突破时开空仓。它通过自定义指标句柄读取角度值（0-4标度），在新K线形成时生成信号，并具有可配置的资金管理和多空独立开关控制。
EA-14046.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是基于最小二乘移动平均线（LSMA）的斜率角度来判断趋势方向和强度。入场条件为：当指标值从4以下突破到4时开多仓（上升趋势确立），当指标值从0以上跌破到0时开空仓（下降趋势确立）。出场条件为：当多头指标值低于2时平多仓，当空头指标值高于1时平空仓。仓位管理依赖于TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数，支持多种资金管理模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损后余额/保证金、固定手数）。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode选择计算模式，止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险收益比为1:2。
EA-14046.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is based on the slope angle of the Least Squares Moving Average (LSMA) to determine trend direction and strength. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator value crosses up to 4 (uptrend confirmed), and a sell position is opened when the indicator value crosses down to 0 (downtrend confirmed). Exit conditions: long positions are closed when the indicator value drops below 2, and short positions are closed when the indicator value rises above 1. Position sizing relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library's BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions, supporting multiple money management modes including free margin, balance, loss-adjusted balance/margin, and fixed lot. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode for calculation mode, with a 1000-point stop loss, 2000-point take profit, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio.

EA-14064.name: Exp_ColorSchaffDeMarkerTrendCycle
EA-14064.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffDeMarkerTrendCycle custom indicator, which combines fast and slow DeMarker oscillators with a cyclical trend component. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a downtrend color zone to an uptrend zone, and sell positions on the reverse transition, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-14064.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffDeMarkerTrendCycle自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了快慢DeMarker振荡器和周期性趋势分量。当指标从下跌趋势颜色区域转换到上涨趋势区域时开多仓，反向转换时开空仓，并带有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-14064.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Schaff趋势周期指标，该指标融合了快速DeMarker(周期23)和慢速DeMarker(周期50)的双重振荡器计算，并叠加周期为10的趋势循环分量来识别趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标颜色缓冲区值大于5（上升趋势确认）且前一值小于6（刚从非上升趋势转换）时开多仓；当颜色缓冲区值小于2（下降趋势确认）且前一值大于1（刚从非下降趋势转换）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)设置，同时当反向信号出现时会平掉对应仓位（如上升趋势信号时平空头）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，并支持五种资金管理模式（自由保证金、余额、损失后自由保证金、损失后余额、固定手数）。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准化函数实现买卖仓位开平操作，包含滑点偏差控制。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根已收盘K线的信号来避免重绘。
EA-14064.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Schaff Trend Cycle indicator, which integrates dual DeMarker oscillators (fast period 23 and slow period 50) with a cyclical trend component (period 10) to identify trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator color buffer value is above 5 (uptrend confirmed) and the previous value is below 6 (just transitioned from non-uptrend); a sell position opens when the color buffer value is below 2 (downtrend confirmed) and the previous value is above 1 (just transitioned from non-downtrend). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points) settings, while opposing signals also trigger closing of corresponding positions (e.g., uptrend signal closes sell positions). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1, supporting five money management modes: free margin, balance, loss-based free margin, loss-based balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is implemented through standardized functions in the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for opening and closing buy/sell positions, with slippage deviation control. The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1, meaning it evaluates the previously closed bar's signal to avoid repainting issues.

EA-1408.strategy_analysis:
分析

### 2.1 核心策略概念
这是一个**纯追踪止损管理EA**，而非完整的交易策略。它不执行任何开仓操作，只对已存在的持仓进行止损追踪管理。

**核心逻辑**：
- 使用CandleStop指标计算动态止损位
- CandleStop指标基于最近N根K线的最高价和最低价
- 对于多头：止损追踪最低价的极值
- 对于空头：止损追踪最高价的极值
- 只在价格有利方向移动时移动止损，锁定利润

### 2.2 入场条件
**⚠️ 此EA不执行入场操作！**

EA仅在检测到已有持仓时运行，无法自动开仓。需要配合其他开仓策略或手动开仓使用。

### 2.3 出场条件
**止损追踪逻辑**：

#### 多头持仓止损追踪：
1. 获取DnValue（最近DnTrailPeriods根K线的最低价极值）
2. 如果持仓没有止损（SL=0）：
   - 取DnValue[0]和DnValue[1]的最小值作为新止损
   - 确保止损低于当前Ask价格
3. 如果已有止损：
   - 仅当新止损位置 > 旧止损位置时才移动（追踪盈利）
   - 每根新K线检测一次

#### 空头持仓止损追踪：
1. 获取UpValue（最近UpTrailPeriods根K线的最高价极值）
2. 如果持仓没有止损（SL=0）：
   - 取UpValue[0]和UpValue[1]的最大值作为新止损
   - 确保止损高于当前Bid价格
3. 如果已有止损：
   - 仅当新止损位置 < 旧止损位置时才移动（追踪盈利）
   - 每根新K线检测一次

### 2.4 风险管理
- **止损追踪**：基于K线极值的动态追踪
- **止损距离控制**：通过StopCorrect函数检查SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL
- **滑点控制**：Deviation参数（默认10点）
- **订单预检查**：OrderCheck()确保请求有效

EA-14084.name: EA_TPSLpanel
EA-14084.summary: This EA provides a visual TP/SL panel on the chart that allows traders to manually set take-profit and stop-loss price levels for an existing open position. When the market price reaches the specified TP or SL level, the EA automatically closes the position by executing a reversing market order. It does not generate its own trading signals or open new positions independently.
EA-14084.summary_zh: 该EA在图表上提供一个可视化的止盈/止损面板，允许交易者手动为现有持仓设置止盈和止损价格水平。当市场价格达到设定的止盈或止损水平时，EA会自动通过执行反向市价单来平仓。它不会自行产生交易信号或独立开仓。
EA-14084.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是作为已有持仓的辅助管理工具，通过图表面板手动设置虚拟止盈止损价位。入场条件方面，EA本身不进行入场，而是依赖用户已有持仓，仅在检测到有未平仓仓位时才允许激活TP/SL监控。出场条件为当当前价格触及用户设定的止盈或止损价格时，EA执行一笔反向市价单来平掉原有仓位——对于买单触及TP时卖出，触及SL时也卖出；对于卖单反之亦然。仓位管理方面，平仓时使用固定的手数（LotSize参数），而非根据原始仓位手数自动匹配，这可能导致部分平仓或过度平仓的问题。资金管理方面，EA没有任何资金管理逻辑，不计算风险比例、不检查账户余额、不设置最大亏损限制。止盈止损并非通过服务器端挂单实现，而是通过客户端Ontick轮询检测价格，这存在断连漏单的风险。
EA-14084.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is to serve as an auxiliary management tool for existing positions, allowing users to manually set virtual take-profit and stop-loss levels via a chart panel. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not initiate entries itself; it relies on the user having an existing open position and only allows TP/SL monitoring activation when an open position is detected. The exit condition is that when the current price reaches the user-specified TP or SL price, the EA executes a reversing market order to close the original position — selling when a buy position hits TP or SL, and buying when a sell position hits TP or SL. For position sizing, the closing trade uses a fixed lot size (LotSize parameter) rather than automatically matching the original position's volume, which can lead to partial close or over-close issues. There is no money management logic whatsoever — no risk percentage calculation, no account balance check, and no maximum loss limit. The TP/SL is not implemented via server-side pending orders but through client-side OnTick polling, which carries the risk of missed executions during disconnections.

pros: 提供直观的图表面板界面，用户可通过点击图表设置止盈止损价格，操作便捷

Supports three modes — TP only, SL only, or both TP and SL — offering good flexibility

cons: 止盈止损通过客户端OnTick轮询实现而非服务器端挂单，断连或EA停止运行时止盈止损将失效，存在重大风险
平仓手数使用固定LotSize参数而非自动匹配原始持仓手数，可能导致平仓手数不正确
GetBarPrice函数中'close'价格实际返回的是bid价格而非真正的收盘价，函数命名和逻辑存在误导
ObjectFind返回值使用有误——ObjectFind返回0表示找到对象，但代码中用if(ObjectFind(...))来判断对象存在，逻辑恰好相反
ORDER_FILLING_FOK填充模式可能在某些经纪商处不被支持，缺乏对填充模式兼容性的检查
cons_en: TP/SL is implemented via client-side OnTick polling instead of server-side pending orders, meaning TP/SL will fail if the connection drops or the EA stops — a significant risk
The closing trade uses a fixed LotSize parameter instead of automatically matching the original position's volume, which can result in incorrect closing lot sizes
The GetBarPrice function returns bid price when 'close' is requested, which is misleading — the function name and logic don't match
ObjectFind return value is used incorrectly — ObjectFind returns 0 when an object is found, but the code uses if(ObjectFind(...)) to check existence, inverting the logic
ORDER_FILLING_FOK filling mode may not be supported by all brokers, and there is no compatibility check for the filling mode
improvements: 应使用服务器端止损挂单（SL/TP字段或止损限价单）替代客户端轮询，确保断连时止盈止损仍然有效
平仓时应自动读取原始持仓手数而非使用固定参数，确保完全平仓
应修复ObjectFind的返回值判断逻辑，并增加对订单填充模式的自动适配
improvements_en: Should use server-side stop orders (SL/TP fields or stop-limit orders) instead of client-side polling to ensure TP/SL remains effective during disconnections
Should automatically read the original position's volume when closing instead of using a fixed parameter, ensuring complete position closure
Should fix the ObjectFind return value check logic and add automatic adaptation for order filling mode compatibility

risk_points: 客户端轮询止盈止损，网络断连或EA崩溃时止盈止损完全失效
平仓手数不自动匹配原始持仓，可能只部分平仓导致风险敞口

risk_points_en: Client-side polling for TP/SL means complete TP/SL failure during network disconnection or EA crash
Closing lot size doesn't auto-match the original position, potentially leaving residual risk exposure from partial closes
No slippage protection, no spread filter, and no retry mechanism — order failures only generate alerts without retry attempts

EA-1409.name: Exp_RD-TrendTrigger
EA-1409.summary: This EA trades based on the RD-TrendTrigger custom oscillator indicator, supporting two entry modes: oscillator direction change (twist) and level breakthrough (disposition). It opens buy/sell positions when the oscillator signals momentum shifts and manages exits via stop loss, take profit, and closing signals from the indicator.
EA-1409.summary_zh: 该EA基于RD-TrendTrigger自定义振荡指标进行交易，支持两种入场模式：振荡器方向变化（twist）和水平突破（disposition）。当振荡器发出动量转变信号时开仓，通过止损、止盈及指标平仓信号管理出场。
EA-1409.strategy_analysis: 策略基于RD-TrendTrigger振荡器，该指标结合线性回归和T3平滑算法生成动量信号。入场有两种模式：twist模式检测振荡器方向变化，当连续三个值形成先上升后下降（或先下降后上升）时产生卖出（或买入）信号；disposition模式检测振荡器突破高/低水平线（+50/-50）时产生信号。出场方面，twist模式下方向反转时触发平仓信号，disposition模式下振荡器回升至低水平线以上时平空仓，同时所有仓位都设有止损和止盈保护。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表存款比例，由TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数处理。该EA仅在新的K线形成时检测信号（SignalBar=0除外），避免同一根K线重复交易，但对disposition模式下的多头平仓信号缺失是一个逻辑缺陷。
EA-1409.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on the RD-TrendTrigger oscillator, which combines linear regression with T3 smoothing to generate momentum signals. Entry has two modes: twist mode detects oscillator direction changes, generating sell signals when three consecutive values form a rise-then-fall pattern (or buy signals for fall-then-rise); disposition mode generates signals when the oscillator breaks through the high/low levels (+50/-50). For exits, twist mode triggers closing on direction reversal, while disposition mode closes short positions when the oscillator rises above the low level; all positions have stop loss and take profit protection. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share percentages, handled by the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library. The EA only checks signals on new bar formation (except when SignalBar=0), preventing repeated trades on the same bar, but there is a logic gap in disposition mode where buy position closing signals are missing.

EA-14095.name: Exp_MA_Rounding_Candle
EA-14095.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the MA_Rounding_Candle custom indicator, which applies a rounding mechanism to a smoothed moving average to generate trend signals. It opens buy positions when the trend shifts upward and sell positions when the trend shifts downward, with configurable money management and position closing logic.
EA-14095.summary_zh: 该EA基于MA_Rounding_Candle自定义指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标对平滑移动平均线应用舍入机制来生成趋势信号。当趋势向上转变时开多仓，趋势向下转变时开空仓，并具有可配置的资金管理和仓位关闭逻辑。
EA-14095.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于MA_Rounding_Candle指标的趋势跟踪，该指标通过多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA等）计算移动平均线，并对其进行舍入处理以生成更清晰的趋势信号。入场条件为：当指标第4缓冲区的TrendValue从非2变为2时开多仓，从非0变为0时开空仓，这代表了趋势方向的转变。出场条件为：当趋势反转时分别关闭多头和空头仓位，同时设置了固定的止损和止盈（默认1000点和2000点）。仓位管理采用多种资金管理模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数模式。EA使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，只在趋势确实发生转变时才触发交易，减少虚假信号的影响。
EA-14095.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on the MA_Rounding_Candle indicator, which calculates a moving average using multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) and applies a rounding mechanism to generate cleaner trend signals. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the TrendValue from the indicator's buffer 4 transitions to 2 from a value less than 2, and a sell position is opened when it transitions to 0 from a value greater than 0, representing a shift in trend direction. Exit conditions: long and short positions are closed when the trend reverses, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively). Position sizing supports multiple money management modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage after loss, and fixed lot size. The EA employs a new bar detection mechanism to avoid duplicate signals, only triggering trades when a genuine trend shift occurs, which helps reduce false signals.

EA-14103.name: Exp_FrAMACandle
EA-14103.summary: This EA trades based on the FrAMACandle custom indicator, which combines Fractal Adaptive Moving Average (FRAMA) logic to detect trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options. Entry and exit are controlled by boolean flags for each direction, and trade execution only occurs on new bars to avoid repeated signals.
EA-14103.summary_zh: 该EA基于FrAMACandle自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了分形自适应移动平均线(FRAMA)逻辑来检测趋势方向。当指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。买卖双向的入场和出场均可通过布尔开关独立控制，交易执行仅在出现新K线时触发以避免重复信号。
EA-14103.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于FrAMACandle自定义指标的分形自适应移动平均线(FRAMA)趋势判断，利用指标的缓冲区4（TrendValue）读取趋势状态值0、1、2来决定交易方向。入场条件为：当TrendValue从非2变为2时触发买入信号（需BuyPosOpen开启），当TrendValue从非0变为0时触发卖出信号（需SellPosOpen开启），趋势转变即入场。出场条件为：当趋势从上升转为其他状态时平多仓（需BuyPosClose开启），当趋势从下降转为其他状态时平空仓（需SellPosClose开启），同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制交易手数或资金比例，支持五种模式包括固定手数、按余额百分比、按净值百分比等。资金管理使用枚举类型MarginMode选择不同的计算方式，默认为固定手数模式(LOT)，整体风险控制依赖固定止损止盈而非动态调整。
EA-14103.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Fractal Adaptive Moving Average (FRAMA) implemented via the FrAMACandle custom indicator, which adapts its smoothing speed based on market fractal dimension to better follow trends. Entry conditions are triggered when the indicator's buffer 4 (TrendValue) transitions to 2 for buy signals (if BuyPosOpen is enabled) or transitions to 0 for sell signals (if SellPosOpen is enabled), requiring a change from a different state to confirm trend initiation. Exit conditions close long positions when the uptrend signal disappears (BuyPosClose enabled) and close short positions when the downtrend signal disappears (SellPosClose enabled), supplemented by fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with five money management modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance, and loss-adjusted free margin. Money management defaults to the LOT (fixed lot) mode and overall risk control relies on static stop-loss and take-profit values rather than dynamic adaptation to market volatility or ATR-based calculations.

EA-14107.name: Exp_TriXCandle
EA-14107.summary: This EA trades based on the TriXCandle custom indicator, which is a TRIX-based momentum oscillator rendered as candlesticks. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward momentum shift and sell positions on a downward shift, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-14107.summary_zh: 该EA基于TriXCandle自定义指标进行交易，该指标是基于TRIX的动量振荡器并以K线形式呈现。当指标发出向上动量转变信号时开多仓，向下动量转变时开空仓，具有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-14107.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用TriXCandle指标作为核心策略信号源，TriXCandle是基于TRIX动量振荡器的自定义指标，以K线形态显示趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的值为2且前一值小于2时，产生买入开仓信号；当值为0且前一值大于0时，产生卖出开仓信号。出场条件包括：买入信号出现时同时平掉卖出仓位，卖出信号出现时平掉买入仓位，以及固定的止损和止盈水平。仓位管理采用5种模式（FREEMARGIN、BALANCE、LOSSFREEMARGIN、LOSSBALANCE、LOT），默认使用固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1。EA还使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，并通过Recount标志处理指标数据未就绪的情况。
EA-14107.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the TriXCandle indicator as its core signal source, which is a custom indicator based on the TRIX momentum oscillator displayed in candlestick form to show trend direction. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 4 value equals 2 and the previous value is less than 2, a buy open signal is generated; when the value equals 0 and the previous value is greater than 0, a sell open signal is generated. Exit conditions include: closing sell positions when a buy signal appears, closing buy positions when a sell signal appears, and fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing supports 5 modes (FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE, LOT), defaulting to fixed lot mode. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The EA also uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, and employs a Recount flag to handle cases where indicator data is not yet ready.

EA-14112.name: Exp_CHOWithFlat
EA-14112.summary: This EA trades based on the Chaikin Oscillator with Flat (CHOWithFlat) custom indicator, which combines Bollinger Bands with a smoothed Chaikin Oscillator to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when the oscillator's upper line crosses above the lower line and sell positions when the opposite occurs. The EA includes configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggles for entry and exit signals.
EA-14112.summary_zh: 该EA基于带平坦区的蔡金振荡器（CHOWithFlat）自定义指标进行交易，结合布林带与平滑蔡金振荡器来检测动量转换。当振荡器上线上穿下线时开多仓，反之下穿时开空仓。EA包含可配置的资金管理、止损止盈以及独立的入场/出场信号开关。
EA-14112.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用CHOWithFlat自定义指标作为核心交易信号源，该指标本质上是蔡金振荡器（Chaikin Oscillator）与布林带平坦区过滤的结合体。入场条件：当指标上线(Up)在下线(Dn)之上且前一周期上线低于下线时，触发买入信号；当上线在下线之下且前一周期上线高于下线时，触发卖出信号。出场条件分为主动出场和信号出场两种：主动出场由止损和止盈参数控制，信号出场则由买卖仓位关闭开关与反向交叉信号共同决定。仓位管理采用基于资金的模式，通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持LOT和PERCENT两种保证金模式。资金管理方面，使用固定手数或百分比模式，配合1000点止损和2000点止盈，风险回报比为1:2。策略在信号生成时还引入了新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓，但缺少对现有持仓的检查逻辑。
EA-14112.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the CHOWithFlat custom indicator as its core signal source, which is essentially a combination of the Chaikin Oscillator with Bollinger Band flat-zone filtering. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator's upper line (Up) is above the lower line (Dn) and the previous period's Up was below Dn, indicating a bullish crossover; conversely, a sell signal triggers on a bearish crossover. Exit conditions are twofold: mandatory exits are governed by stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), while signal-based exits are controlled by the BuyPosClose/SellPosClose toggles which close positions on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing uses a money management model controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1), supporting both LOT and PERCENT margin modes via the MMMode enumeration. The risk-reward ratio is set at 1:2 with a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit. The strategy incorporates a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate entries within the same candle, but critically lacks a check for existing open positions before sending new orders, which could lead to position accumulation.

EA-14136.name: Exp_DigitalF-T01
EA-14136.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom DigitalF-T01 indicator, which outputs two oscillator lines. It opens buy positions when oscillator 1 crosses above oscillator 2 and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-14136.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义DigitalF-T01指标的双线交叉信号进行交易。当振荡器1上穿振荡器2时开多仓，反之开空仓，并配有可配置的止损止盈水平。
EA-14136.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于自定义数字滤波器指标DigitalF-T01的双线交叉信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：当Osc1在上一根K线上穿Osc2时（Osc1[1]>Osc2[1]且Osc1[0]<Osc2[0]），产生买入信号；当Osc1下穿Osc2时，产生卖出信号。出场条件包括反向交叉信号触发平仓以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持手数模式和保证金比例模式两种资金管理方式。策略使用了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），确保每个K线周期只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。指标使用了半通道参数（halfchanel=25）和多种应用价格类型，增强信号灵活性。
EA-14136.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on crossover signals from the custom DigitalF-T01 digital filter indicator with two oscillator lines. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter supporting both lot-based and margin-based money management modes. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades. The indicator uses a half-channel parameter (halfchanel=25) and multiple applied price types for signal flexibility.

EA-1414.name: Exp_StepSto_v1
EA-1414.summary: This EA trades based on the StepSto_v1 custom indicator, which appears to be a stepped stochastic oscillator. It opens buy positions when the fast line crosses above the slow line above the 50 level, and sell positions when the fast line crosses below the slow line below the 50 level. Positions are closed on opposing signals, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1414.summary_zh: 该EA基于StepSto_v1自定义指标（阶梯随机振荡器）进行交易。当快速线在50水平以上向上穿越慢速线时开多仓，当快速线在50水平以下向下穿越慢速线时开空仓。反向信号出现时平仓，并使用固定止损和止盈。
EA-1414.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于阶梯随机指标（StepSto_v1）的动量交叉策略。入场条件为：当慢速线Ma2大于50时，若快速线Ma1从下方穿越Ma1向上则买入开仓；当慢速线Ma2小于50时，若快速线Ma1从上方穿越Ma2向下则卖出开仓。50水平线作为多空分界线，高于50为多头区域，低于50为空头区域。出场条件依赖反向交叉信号平仓，同时配合固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，策略本身未包含加仓或减仓逻辑。信号仅在NewBar时检测，避免同一根K线内重复触发。
EA-1414.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a momentum crossover strategy based on the StepSto_v1 custom stepped stochastic indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the slow line Ma2 is above 50 and the fast line Ma1 crosses above Ma2; a sell signal triggers when Ma2 is below 50 and Ma1 crosses below Ma2. The 50 level serves as a bull/bear threshold, with values above 50 considered bullish territory and below 50 bearish. Exit conditions rely on opposing crossover signals for position closure, supplemented by fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values calculate lots as a share of the deposit. Money management is delegated to the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions. The strategy lacks position scaling logic such as pyramiding or partial closes. Signal detection only occurs on new bars, preventing repeated triggers within the same candle.

EA-14229.name: Exp_JMACandleSign
EA-14229.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom JMACandleSign indicator, which generates buy/sell signals based on JMA-smoothed candlestick patterns. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable position closing logic and money management options.
EA-14229.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义JMACandleSign指标的信号进行交易，该指标根据JMA平滑的K线形态产生买入/卖出信号。它在上涨信号时开多仓，在下跌信号时开空仓，具有可配置的平仓逻辑和资金管理选项。
EA-14229.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于JMACandleSign自定义指标，该指标使用JMA（Jurik移动平均）平滑算法处理K线数据并生成方向性信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）在指定信号K线上出现非零非空值时开多仓，当缓冲区0（DnValue）出现非零非空值时开空仓。出场条件分为两类：反向信号平仓（如上涨信号出现时平空仓，下跌信号出现时平多仓）以及固定的止损/止盈平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按减去亏损后的自由保证金比例、按减去亏损后的余额比例、以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算模式，默认使用固定手数模式（LOT）。EA还包含历史数据加载机制和新K线检测逻辑，避免在同一K线内重复交易。当开仓和平仓条件同时启用但未检测到平仓信号时，EA会回溯历史K线寻找最近的反向信号作为平仓依据。
EA-14229.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the JMACandleSign custom indicator, which uses the JMA (Jurik Moving Average) smoothing algorithm to process candlestick data and generate directional signals. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar, and a sell position opens when buffer 0 (DnValue) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE. Exit conditions fall into two categories: reverse-signal closing (e.g., closing sell positions when an up signal appears, closing buy positions when a down signal appears) and fixed stop-loss/take-profit closing. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by free margin minus losses percentage, by balance minus losses percentage, and fixed lot mode. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio and the MMMode parameter for calculation mode, defaulting to fixed lot mode (LOT). The EA also includes a history data loading mechanism and new bar detection logic to prevent repeated trading within the same bar. When both opening and closing conditions are enabled but no closing signal is detected, the EA backtracks through historical bars to find the most recent reverse signal as a closing basis.

EA-14234.name: Exp_XMA_Range_Channel
EA-14234.summary: This EA trades breakouts from the XMA_Range_Channel indicator, opening buy positions when price breaks above the upper channel and sell positions when it breaks below the lower channel. It uses configurable smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) for the channel calculation and includes money management, stop loss, and take profit controls. Signal filtering is done via a color buffer system from the custom indicator.
EA-14234.summary_zh: 该EA基于XMA_Range_Channel指标进行通道突破交易，价格突破上轨时开多仓，突破下轨时开空仓。支持多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA等）计算通道，并包含资金管理、止损止盈控制。信号过滤通过自定义指标的颜色缓冲区系统实现。
EA-14234.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XMA_Range_Channel指标的通道突破交易。入场条件方面，当指标的颜色缓冲区（buffer 8）值大于1时产生买入信号，同时前一值小于2或为空值时确认突破上轨开多仓；当颜色缓冲区值小于2且不为空值时产生卖出信号，前一值大于1或为空值时确认突破下轨开空仓。出场条件方面，买入信号触发时同时平掉卖仓，卖出信号触发时同时平掉买仓，此外还有独立的止损和止盈设置（默认止损1000点，止盈2000点）。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准函数，支持按自由保证金、余额、减去亏损后的余额或固定手数等多种模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），配合MMMode选择资金管理模式。该策略使用SignalBar参数允许在第1根已收盘K线上检测信号，避免未完成K线的虚假信号，同时通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号。
EA-14234.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a channel breakout system based on the XMA_Range_Channel indicator. For entry conditions, when the indicator's color buffer (buffer 8) value exceeds 1, a buy signal is generated, and if the previous value is below 2 or empty, it confirms an upper channel breakout for a long position. Conversely, when the color buffer value is below 2 and not empty, a sell signal is generated, with the previous value above 1 or empty confirming a lower channel breakout for a short position. For exit conditions, a buy signal simultaneously triggers closing of sell positions, and a sell signal triggers closing of buy positions, supplemented by independent stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points) settings. Position sizing uses standard functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, supporting multiple modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot sizing. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter (default 0.1 risk ratio) combined with the MMMode selector for the margin calculation method. The strategy uses the SignalBar parameter to detect signals on the 1st completed bar, avoiding false signals from incomplete bars, and employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar.

EA-14235.name: LastPrice
EA-14235.summary: This EA monitors the market depth (order book) and places limit orders based on the last traded price relative to the bid/ask spread. It scalps by entering BUY when the last price is above ask plus an interval threshold, and SELL when below bid minus the interval, then manages existing positions by attempting to close or reverse them when the price returns to favorable levels. Trading is restricted to specific intraday time windows and filtered by volume and spread conditions.
EA-14235.summary_zh: 该EA通过监控市场深度（订单簿）和最新成交价与买卖价差的关系来放置限价单进行剥头皮交易。当最新价格高于卖价加间隔阈值时买入，低于买价减间隔阈值时卖出，并在持仓时根据价格回归水平尝试平仓或反向操作。交易限制在特定的日内时段窗口，并通过成交量和点差条件进行过滤。
EA-14235.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于订单簿深度数据和最新成交价的偏移来捕捉短期价格波动。入场条件：无持仓时，若最新价高于卖价加间隔值则买入，若最新价低于买价减间隔值则卖出，同时要求成交量在[minVolume, maxVolume]范围内且点差不超过Spread参数。出场条件：持仓时通过放置反向限价单来平仓，若持买单且最新价回落至买价或卖价以下，则放置卖出限价单；持卖单则相反。仓位管理采用固定手数(Lots参数)，无动态仓位调整。资金管理仅通过固定止损(SlPips)和日单时间限制来控制风险，无追踪止损或动态止盈。策略还包含订单冻结处理逻辑：当市场价格偏离下单价格时，会删除原限价单并重新下单。
EA-14235.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy exploits short-term price dislocations by monitoring the order book depth and the deviation of the last traded price from the current bid/ask. Entry conditions: when no position exists, a BUY limit order is placed if the last price exceeds ask plus a configurable interval, and a SELL limit order if last price falls below bid minus the interval, provided volume is within [minVolume, maxVolume] and spread is within the Spread threshold. Exit conditions: when holding a position, a reverse limit order is placed to close it—BUY positions are closed with a SELL limit at bid when the price retreats, and vice versa for SELL positions. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (Lots parameter) with no dynamic adjustment. Money management relies solely on a fixed stop loss (SlPips converted to price) and restricted trading time windows, with no trailing stop or dynamic take-profit mechanism. The EA also implements a frozen-order handling loop that deletes and potentially replaces limit orders when the market price drifts from the order price.

EA-1424.name: Exp_TrendEnvelopes
EA-1424.summary: This EA trades based on the TrendEnvelopes custom indicator, opening buy positions when an upward trend signal is detected and sell positions when a downward trend signal is detected. It uses configurable money management with lot sizing or deposit share, and applies fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels to all trades. The strategy processes signals only on new bars to avoid redundant calculations.
EA-1424.summary_zh: 该EA基于TrendEnvelopes自定义指标进行交易，在检测到上升趋势信号时开多仓，检测到下降趋势信号时开空仓。它使用可配置的资金管理方式（固定手数或存款比例），并对所有交易设置固定的止损和止盈。策略仅在新K线出现时处理信号，避免重复计算。
EA-1424.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用TrendEnvelopes指标跟踪趋势方向进行交易。TrendEnvelopes指标基于移动平均线（支持多种MA方法，默认EMA）加上基于ATR的自适应偏差构建上下轨道，当价格突破上轨时产生买入信号，突破下轨时产生卖出信号。入场条件：当UpSignal缓冲区有有效值（非零且非EMPTY_VALUE）时开多仓，当DnSignal缓冲区有有效值时开空仓；同时如果仅处于趋势轨道内（UpTrend或DnTrend有效但无新信号），则只平反向仓位不开新仓。出场条件包括：固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向信号触发时平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数大小，正值表示存款占比。资金管理方面，EA调用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数处理开仓逻辑，包括信号时间戳、偏差控制和止盈止损设置。策略仅在新K线形成时或SignalBar为0时重新计算信号，减少不必要的频繁交易。
EA-1424.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is to follow trend direction using the TrendEnvelopes indicator for trading decisions. The TrendEnvelopes indicator is built on a moving average (supporting multiple MA methods, defaulting to EMA) with an ATR-based adaptive deviation to construct upper and lower envelopes. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the UpSignal buffer contains a valid value (non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE), and a sell position is opened when the DnSignal buffer contains a valid value. When price is merely within the trend envelope (UpTrend or DnTrend valid without a new signal), only the opposite position is closed without opening a new one. Exit conditions include fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit in points, plus closing on reverse signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent a fixed lot size and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management is handled through the BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, which incorporate signal timestamps, slippage control, and stop loss/take profit settings. The strategy only recalculates signals on new bar formations or when SignalBar is set to 0, reducing unnecessary frequent trading activity.

EA-14250.name: Exp_MomentumCandleSign
EA-14250.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom MomentumCandleSign indicator, opening buy positions on bullish momentum signals and sell positions on bearish momentum signals. It includes configurable buy/sell open and close logic, with the ability to scan historical bars for counter-signals to close existing positions. Money management supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot sizing.
EA-14250.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义MomentumCandleSign指标的信号进行交易，在看涨动量信号时开多仓，在看跌动量信号时开空仓。它支持可配置的买卖开平仓逻辑，并能扫描历史K线寻找反向信号来平仓。资金管理支持多种保证金模式，包括固定手数。
EA-14250.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用自定义指标MomentumCandleSign作为核心信号源，该指标基于动量概念生成买卖信号。入场条件为：当指标的上行缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号K线上产生非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时，开多仓；当下行缓冲区（buffer 0）产生有效值时，开空仓。出场条件有两种方式：一是通过反向信号平仓（买入信号平空仓，卖出信号平多仓），二是通过固定的止损和止盈参数平仓。EA还包含一个独特的逻辑：当同时允许开仓和平仓且当前没有平仓信号时，会向历史K线回溯扫描寻找最近的反向信号来触发平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后的自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后的余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例或固定手数，止损默认1000点、止盈默认2000点。
EA-14250.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the custom MomentumCandleSign indicator as its core signal source, which generates buy and sell signals based on momentum concepts. Entry conditions: when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified signal bar, a buy position is opened; when the lower buffer (buffer 0) produces a valid value, a sell position is opened. Exit conditions operate in two ways: first, through reverse signal closure (buy signal closes sell positions, sell signal closes buy positions), and second, through fixed stop loss and take profit parameters. The EA includes a unique logic: when both opening and closing are allowed for the same direction and no close signal exists on the current bar, it scans backward through historical bars to find the nearest counter-signal to trigger position closure. Position sizing supports five margin modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio or fixed lots, with default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points.

EA-1426.name: Exp_ColorSchaffTrendCycle
EA-1426.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffTrendCycle indicator, a momentum-based oscillator that combines moving average convergence/divergence with stochastic smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses above the upper threshold and sell positions when it crosses below the lower threshold, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1426.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffTrendCycle指标进行交易，该指标是将移动平均线收敛/发散与随机平滑相结合的动量振荡器。当指标上穿上限阈值时开多仓，下穿下限阈值时开空仓，配有可配置的止损止盈。
EA-1426.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Schaff趋势周期指标，该指标本质上是将MACD的收敛发散特性与随机振荡器的平滑技术相结合的动量类指标。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值大于6时产生买入信号，此时若前一根K线的值也大于等于6且允许买入，则开多仓；当指标缓冲区1的值小于2时产生卖出信号，同理若满足条件则开空仓。出场条件依赖于止损和止盈参数，同时也通过反向信号平仓——买入信号时平空仓，卖出信号时平多仓。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于存款比例的动态手数（MM参数为负值时表示固定手数，正值时表示存款比例）。资金管理通过MM参数控制，支持两种模式：负值作为固定手数大小，正值作为存款占比。EA仅在新K线形成时检测信号（SignalBar=0时），避免同根K线内重复交易，同时使用Recount机制确保数据获取失败时重新计算。
EA-1426.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Schaff Trend Cycle indicator, which essentially combines the convergence/divergence characteristics of MACD with the smoothing technique of a stochastic oscillator, making it a momentum-type indicator. Entry conditions: when buffer 1 of the indicator exceeds 6, a buy signal is generated; if the previous bar's value is also >= 6 and buying is permitted, a long position is opened. When buffer 1 falls below 2, a sell signal is generated; similarly, if conditions are met, a short position is opened. Exit conditions rely on stop loss and take profit parameters, as well as counter-signal exits — closing short positions on buy signals and closing long positions on sell signals. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or a deposit-proportion-based dynamic lot (negative MM value means fixed lot size, positive value means deposit share). Money management is controlled via the MM parameter supporting two modes: negative values as fixed lot sizes and positive values as deposit percentage shares. The EA only checks signals on new bar formation (when SignalBar=0), avoiding repeated trades within the same bar, and uses a Recount mechanism to ensure recalculation when data retrieval fails.

EA-14260.name: Exp_ColorXCCXCandle
EA-14260.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXCCXCandle custom indicator, which uses dual-smoothed candle coloring to identify trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns bullish (color=2) and sell positions when it turns bearish (color=0), with configurable entry/exit switches for each direction. Position sizing is managed through multiple money management modes including lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.
EA-14260.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXCCXCandle自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用双重平滑的K线着色来识别趋势方向。当指标转为看涨（颜色=2）时开多仓，转为看跌（颜色=0）时开空仓，每个方向均可配置入场/出场开关。仓位管理支持多种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比。
EA-14260.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorXCCXCandle指标的趋势方向判断，该指标通过两重平滑算法（分别用于价格和趋势动量）对K线进行着色分类，颜色值为2代表看涨趋势，0代表看跌趋势，1代表中性。入场条件为：当信号K线的颜色值从非2变为2时开多仓，从非0变为0时开空仓，且需要前一K线的颜色状态发生变化才触发信号，体现了趋势转折的确认逻辑。出场条件包括：当趋势反转时根据配置自动平仓（多仓在看跌信号时平仓，空仓在看涨信号时平仓），同时设置了固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比、基于扣除亏损后的余额百分比和基于扣除亏损后的可用保证金百分比，通过MM参数控制风险比例。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms库中的标准化函数，每笔交易都有明确的止损和止盈设置，风险收益比为1:2，且支持滑点容忍度设置。
EA-14260.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ColorXCCXCandle indicator's trend direction identification, which classifies candles through dual smoothing algorithms (one for price and one for trend momentum), where color value 2 represents bullish trend, 0 represents bearish trend, and 1 represents neutral. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the signal bar's color value changes from non-2 to 2, and a sell position opens when it changes from non-0 to 0, requiring the previous bar's color state to have shifted, which provides trend reversal confirmation logic. Exit conditions include: automatic position closing on trend reversal based on configuration (long closes on bearish signal, short closes on bullish signal), with fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) set for each trade. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, balance after loss percentage, and free margin after loss percentage, controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio. Money management uses standardized functions from the TradeAlgorithms library, each trade has explicit stop loss and take profit with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio, and slippage tolerance is configurable via the Deviation parameter.

EA-14269.name: Exp_Super_Trend
EA-14269.summary: This EA trades based on the Super_Trend custom indicator, which uses CCI to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the upper trend signal appears and sell positions when the lower trend signal appears, with optional stop-loss and take-profit. The EA includes money management modes and configurable position open/close switches for both directions.
EA-14269.summary_zh: 该EA基于Super_Trend自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用CCI判断趋势方向。当出现上方趋势信号时开多仓，出现下方趋势信号时开空仓，支持止损止盈设置。EA包含多种资金管理模式和买卖方向的开平仓开关配置。
EA-14269.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Super_Trend指标的趋势跟踪，该指标内部使用CCI（商品通道指数）判断趋势方向，当CCI突破指定水平时产生信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区2（UpValue）非零且非空值时产生买入信号，同时可作为卖出平仓信号；当缓冲区3（DnValue）非零且非空值时产生卖出信号，同时可作为买入平仓信号。出场条件分两层：一是趋势反转时的信号平仓（UpValue/DnValue触发反向平仓），二是止损止盈的固定点数平仓（StopLoss_=1000, TakeProfit_=2000）。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，MMMode默认为LOT固定手数模式。策略还包含一个额外的历史回溯检查逻辑，当开仓和平仓条件同时启用且当前无平仓信号时，会遍历历史K线查找趋势延续中的平仓触发点，避免在趋势中途遗漏平仓机会。
EA-14269.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is trend following based on the Super_Trend indicator, which internally uses CCI (Commodity Channel Index) to determine trend direction, generating signals when CCI crosses a specified level. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 2 (UpValue) is non-zero and non-empty, a buy signal is generated which also serves as a sell close signal; when buffer 3 (DnValue) is non-zero and non-empty, a sell signal is generated which also serves as a buy close signal. Exit conditions operate on two levels: first, signal-based closing on trend reversal (UpValue/DnValue triggering opposite direction closes); second, fixed pip stop-loss and take-profit (StopLoss_=1000, TakeProfit_=2000). Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) with MMMode defaulting to LOT (fixed lot). The strategy also includes an additional historical lookback check: when both open and close conditions are enabled for a direction and no close signal is currently present, it iterates through historical bars to find trend continuation close triggers, preventing missed exit opportunities during ongoing trends.

EA-14270.name: Exp_Dots
EA-14270.summary: This EA trades based on the custom 'Dots' indicator, which generates color-coded trend signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator switches from bearish to bullish color and sell positions when it switches from bullish to bearish color, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
EA-14270.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Dots'指标进行交易，该指标生成颜色编码的趋势信号。当指标从空头颜色切换为多头颜色时开多仓，从多头颜色切换为空头颜色时开空仓，并提供可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
EA-14270.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于自定义Dots指标的颜色变化来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标颜色数组Clr[1]从1变为0（即从空头转多头）时开多仓，当Clr[1]从0变为1（即从多头转空头）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈设置，同时在趋势反转时也会主动平仓（如多头信号出现时平空仓，空头信号出现时平多仓）。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于扣除浮亏后的可用保证金、基于扣除浮亏后的余额、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1。策略使用SignalBar参数决定信号检测位置，默认为1即前一根已收盘K线，这是一种合理的做法以避免未收盘K线的信号反复。EA还实现了新K线检测机制IsNewBar()，避免在同一根K线上重复交易。
EA-14270.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on color changes of the custom Dots indicator to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator color array Clr[1] changes from 1 to 0 (bearish to bullish), and a sell position is opened when Clr[1] changes from 0 to 1 (bullish to bearish). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit settings in points, and the EA also actively closes opposite positions on trend reversal signals. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, free margin minus floating loss, balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default risk fraction of 0.1. The strategy uses the SignalBar parameter to determine which bar to check for signals, defaulting to 1 (the last closed bar), which is a sound practice to avoid repainting signals from unclosed bars. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism via IsNewBar() to prevent duplicate trades on the same bar. Additionally, it includes a history loading mechanism LoadHistory() to ensure sufficient bar data is available before signal calculation.

EA-14300.name: Exp_breakeven_trailing_SL
EA-14300.summary: This EA is a position management utility that automatically moves stop loss to breakeven when a position reaches a specified profit threshold, then applies a trailing stop to lock in further gains. It does not open any trades itself; it only modifies existing stop loss levels via CTrade::PositionModify. It supports filtering by symbol and magic number.
EA-14300.summary_zh: 该EA是一个仓位管理工具，当持仓达到指定盈利点数时自动将止损移至保本价位，随后应用追踪止损锁定更多利润。它不自行开仓，仅通过CTrade::PositionModify修改现有持仓的止损水平，支持按品种和魔数筛选。
EA-14300.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是保护已获利润，分为保本和追踪止损两个阶段。入场条件不适用，因为该工具不会自行开仓，仅管理已有持仓。出场条件方面，保本阶段：当买价（Bid）超过开仓价加PlusPoints_breakeven点数时，将止损移至开仓价加StepSL_plus_breakeven点数；卖单类似。追踪止损阶段：当价格继续有利移动超过PlusPoints_trail点数时，止损按StepSL_plus_trail步长跟随移动。仓位管理不涉及，因为不负责开仓。资金管理同样不涉及，但该工具通过逐步锁定利润来间接保护资金。止损修改时考虑了SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL最小止损距离限制，防止因止损距离过近被拒绝。
EA-14300.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this EA is profit protection, divided into breakeven and trailing stop phases. Entry conditions are not applicable since this utility does not open positions; it only manages existing ones. For exit conditions, in the breakeven phase: when Bid exceeds open price plus PlusPoints_breakeven points, the SL is moved to open price plus StepSL_plus_breakeven points; sell positions work symmetrically with Ask. In the trailing phase: when price continues favorably beyond PlusPoints_trail points, the SL follows in steps of StepSL_plus_trail. Position sizing is not applicable as the EA does not open trades. Money management is also not directly applicable, but the tool indirectly protects capital by progressively locking in profits. The stop loss modification respects SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL minimum distance requirements, preventing rejection due to stops being too close to current price.

pros_en: Dual protection mechanism: breakeven first then trailing, with clear layered execution logic

cons: 缺少PositionModify返回值检查，无法确认止损修改是否成功执行

Parameters use raw points rather than point value, requiring separate tuning per instrument
No spread filter, so large spreads could immediately trigger breakeven or trailing logic
improvements: 添加PositionModify返回值检查和错误日志记录，确保止损修改成功执行
引入新bar检测或定时器机制，减少不必要的频繁遍历和行情请求
增加点差过滤和滑点保护，避免在点差异常时进行止损修改
improvements_en: Add PositionModify return value checking and error logging to confirm stop modifications succeed
Introduce new bar detection or timer mechanism to reduce unnecessary frequent iteration and quote requests
Add spread filter and slippage protection to avoid stop modifications during abnormal spread conditions

EA-14307.name: sentiment_ea
EA-14307.summary: This EA trades based on market sentiment by comparing the ratio of buy vs sell orders and volumes from the order book. It opens positions when one side significantly dominates the other in both trader count and volume, and closes when the sentiment ratio reverses or weakens. Trading is restricted to a specific weekday and intraday time window.
EA-14307.summary_zh: 该EA基于市场情绪进行交易，通过比较订单簿中买卖订单数量和成交量的比率来决策。当一方在交易者数量和成交量上均显著占优时开仓，当情绪比率反转或减弱时平仓。交易仅限特定工作日和日内时间窗口。
EA-14307.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于市场深度数据中的买卖订单不平衡来判断市场情绪方向，属于订单流/情绪分析策略。入场条件要求买卖交易者数量比和成交量比同时超过设定阈值，且买方或卖方任一方的交易者数量和成交量需分别达到最低要求（MinTraders和MinVolume），仅在CheckTradingTime()定义的交易时段内开仓（周一至周五10:15:30至23:35:30）。开仓后会将阈值切换到较低的维持阈值（MinDiffVolumesEx和MinDiffTradersEx），这是一种滞回机制，避免频繁开平仓。出场条件为：当持仓方向对应的情绪比率跌破维持阈值，或者不在交易时段内时，平仓并重置阈值为开仓阈值。仓位管理为固定手数（Lots参数），无加仓减仓逻辑。资金管理方面仅依赖固定点数的止损和止盈（SlPips和TpPips），无动态调整或比例风险控制。
EA-14307.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on detecting buy-sell order imbalance from market depth data to gauge market sentiment direction, classifying it as an order flow/sentiment analysis strategy. Entry conditions require both the trader count ratio and volume ratio between buy and sell sides to exceed configured thresholds simultaneously, with at least one side meeting minimum trader count (MinTraders) and minimum volume (MinVolume) requirements, all within a defined trading session (Mon-Fri 10:15:30 to 23:35:30). After opening a position, the thresholds switch to lower maintenance levels (MinDiffVolumesEx and MinDiffTradersEx), implementing a hysteresis mechanism to avoid frequent open-close cycles. Exit conditions trigger when the sentiment ratio for the held position falls below the maintenance threshold, or when outside the trading session, at which point the position is closed and thresholds reset to entry levels. Position sizing is fixed lot-based (Lots parameter) with no scaling logic. Money management relies solely on fixed-pip stop loss and take profit (SlPips and TpPips) with no dynamic adjustment or proportional risk control.

Hysteresis mechanism (separate entry vs maintenance thresholds) reduces overtrading and transaction costs
Trading session filter effectively avoids low-liquidity periods and weekends
cons: OnTick中使用Sleep()阻塞主线程，严重时会导致终端卡顿或错过行情

EA-1431.name: MACDWaterlineCrossExpectator
EA-1431.summary: This EA trades based on MACD crossing its zero (water) line, expecting momentum continuation after the crossover. It opens buy positions when MACD crosses above zero and sell positions when it crosses below zero, using the signal line crossover as confirmation or timing mechanism. The strategy is a classic momentum approach that capitalizes on shifts between bullish and bearish momentum regimes.
EA-1431.summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD跨越零线（水面）进行交易，预期交叉后动量将持续。当MACD上穿零线时开多仓，下穿零线时开空仓，利用信号线交叉作为确认或时机选择。这是一个经典的动量策略，旨在捕捉多空动量转换的时刻。
EA-1431.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是MACD零线交叉，即MACD指标从负转正或从正转负时，代表市场动量方向发生了根本性转变。入场条件为MACD上穿零线时做多，MACD下穿零线时做空，部分变体可能结合信号线交叉作为额外确认以减少假信号。出场条件通常包括反向零线交叉平仓、固定止盈止损、或基于ATR的动态止损机制。仓位管理方面，该EA可能使用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，由于MACD零线交叉属于中长周期信号，持仓时间可能较长，因此需要合理的止损设置来控制单笔风险。策略的弱点在于震荡市中MACD会频繁穿越零线导致连续假突破和亏损，因此趋势过滤器或波动率过滤器的加入对策略表现至关重要。
EA-1431.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is the MACD zero-line crossover, which signals a fundamental shift in market momentum direction when MACD transitions from negative to positive or vice versa. Entry conditions are buying when MACD crosses above zero and selling when it crosses below zero, with some variants potentially using signal line crossovers as additional confirmation to reduce false signals. Exit conditions typically include closing positions on reverse zero-line crossovers, fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or ATR-based dynamic stop mechanisms. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or proportional sizing based on account balance. Money management requires reasonable stop-loss settings to control per-trade risk since MACD zero-line crossovers generate medium-to-long-term signals with potentially extended holding periods. The strategy's weakness lies in choppy markets where MACD frequently oscillates around zero, generating consecutive false breakouts and losses, making trend or volatility filters critical for strategy performance.

EA-14312.name: Exp_VolatilityQuality
EA-14312.summary: This EA trades based on the Volatility Quality indicator, which identifies momentum shifts by analyzing price volatility patterns. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from bearish to bullish and sell positions when it transitions from bullish to bearish, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-14312.summary_zh: 该EA基于Volatility Quality指标进行交易，通过分析价格波动率模式来识别动量转换。当指标从看跌转为看涨时开多仓，从看涨转为看跌时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-14312.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Volatility Quality指标作为核心信号源，该指标通过平滑算法（支持多种平滑方法如SMA、EMA、LWMA、JJMA等）对价格波动率进行计算，以识别市场动量的方向性转变。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1从值0变为值1时（Col[1]==0且Col[0]==1），产生买入信号；当指标缓冲区1从值1变为值0时（Col[1]==1且Col[0]==0），产生卖出信号。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），同时支持基于信号的反向平仓（BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制）。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的多种资金管理模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、损失后自由保证金、损失后余额或固定手数模式。策略在H4时间框架上默认运行，使用SignalBar参数控制信号偏移（默认为1，即前一根K线），并通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只处理一次信号，避免重复交易。总体而言，这是一个基于波动率质量判断的动量跟踪系统，通过波动率的变化来捕捉趋势的起始和结束。
EA-14312.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Volatility Quality indicator as its core signal source, which calculates price volatility through various smoothing algorithms (supporting SMA, EMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) to identify directional shifts in market momentum. Entry conditions are: when indicator buffer 1 transitions from value 0 to value 1 (Col[1]==0 and Col[0]==1), a buy signal is generated; when it transitions from value 1 to value 0 (Col[1]==1 and Col[0]==0), a sell signal is generated. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), while also supporting signal-based position closing controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing leverages multiple money management modes from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot sizing. The strategy operates by default on the H4 timeframe, uses the SignalBar parameter to control signal offset (default 1, meaning the previous bar), and employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure each bar is processed only once to prevent duplicate trades. Overall, this is a momentum-tracking system based on volatility quality assessment, capturing trend initiation and termination through changes in volatility characteristics.

EA-14314.name: Exp_ColorBears.mq5
EA-14314.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBears custom indicator, which uses dual-smoothed bearish momentum to generate buy and sell signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from bearish to bullish color (0→2) and sell positions when it transitions from bullish to bearish color (2→0), with configurable position closing on signal reversals.
EA-14314.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBears自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用双重平滑的熊市动量来生成买卖信号。当指标颜色从熊市转为牛市(0→2)时开多仓，从牛市转为熊市(2→0)时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
EA-14314.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于ColorBears指标的双重平滑动量判断，通过两层不同平滑算法（第一层用于指标本身的平滑，第二层用于信号线的平滑）来过滤市场噪音。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1在SignalBar位置值为0（无熊市动量）且缓冲区0值为2（牛市信号色）时开多仓；当缓冲区1值为2（熊市动量）且缓冲区0值为0（无牛市动量）时开空仓。出场条件依赖信号反转：当出现相反信号时，根据BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数决定是否平仓，同时设有固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额、基于净值、基于可用保证金和基于亏损后余额计算。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择具体的资金管理方式，但没有动态调整或加仓减仓机制。
EA-14314.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on the ColorBears indicator's dual-smoothed momentum assessment, using two layers of different smoothing algorithms (the first for the indicator itself, the second for the signal line) to filter market noise. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 1 at SignalBar equals 0 (no bearish momentum) and buffer 0 equals 2 (bullish signal color); a sell position opens when buffer 1 equals 2 (bearish momentum) and buffer 0 equals 0 (no bullish momentum). Exit conditions rely on signal reversal: when an opposite signal appears, positions close based on BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters, with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance-based, equity-based, free margin-based, and loss-adjusted balance calculation. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode for the specific calculation method, but there is no dynamic adjustment or scale-in/scale-out mechanism.

EA-14317.name: Exp_ColorBulls
EA-14317.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBulls custom indicator, which uses a two-stage smoothing system to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from neutral to bullish (color change to 2) and sell positions when it transitions from bullish to neutral (color change to 0), with separate controls for entry and exit on each side.
EA-14317.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBulls自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用两级平滑系统来检测动量变化。当指标从中性转为看涨（颜色变为2）时开多仓，从看涨转为中性（颜色变为0）时开空仓，并可分别控制多空方向的入场和出场。
EA-14317.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于ColorBulls指标的颜色变化来捕捉动量转换点。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区从0变为2时触发买入信号，当从2变为0时触发卖出信号，这实际上是在捕捉动量从无到有和从有到无的转折点。出场条件与入场信号对称：买入信号触发时同时平空仓，卖出信号触发时同时平多仓，形成反转式出场机制。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举实现，支持按自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的保证金或固定手数等多种模式计算仓位大小。资金管理方面，EA使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数处理下单逻辑，并设有止损和止盈参数（默认分别为1000和2000点），偏差控制为10点。策略使用了两层平滑算法（第一层和第二层分别可配置不同平滑方法和周期），通过SignalBar参数可选择信号触发所在的K线索引，默认使用前一根K线以避免重绘。
EA-14317.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on detecting momentum shifts via color changes in the ColorBulls indicator, which applies a two-stage smoothing process to price data. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the indicator buffer transitions from 0 (neutral) to 2 (bullish), and a sell signal is triggered when it transitions from 2 (bullish) to 0 (neutral), effectively capturing momentum inflection points. Exit conditions are symmetric with entries: when a buy signal fires, existing sell positions are closed, and when a sell signal fires, existing buy positions are closed, creating a reversal-style exit mechanism. Position sizing is handled through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting multiple modes including percentage of free margin, balance, margin after losses, or fixed lot size. Money management leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions for order placement, with configurable stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), plus a slippage deviation control of 10 points. The strategy employs two smoothing layers (each configurable with different smoothing methods and periods from SMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA), and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting which bar index triggers signals, defaulting to the previous bar to avoid repainting issues.
