risk_points_en: No stop-loss or take-profit, unlimited loss per trade
Always-in strategy can endure massive floating losses during violent market moves
Position sizing based only on free margin without considering exposure from existing positions

EA-15567.name: Exp_VWAP_Close
EA-15567.summary: This EA trades based on the VWAP_Close custom indicator, generating buy signals when VWAP values are rising (trend up) and sell signals when VWAP values are falling (trend down). It uses configurable money management modes, fixed stop loss and take profit levels, and processes signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant trades. The strategy is a systematic trend-following approach that enters in the direction of the VWAP momentum.
EA-15567.summary_zh: 该EA基于VWAP_Close自定义指标进行交易，当VWAP值上升时产生买入信号，VWAP值下降时产生卖出信号。它支持可配置的资金管理模式、固定止损止盈水平，并在新K线形成时处理信号以避免重复交易。这是一个系统化的趋势跟踪策略，沿VWAP动量方向入场。
EA-15567.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于VWAP（成交量加权平均价格）指标的趋势跟踪。入场条件：当Value[1]<Value[2]（VWAP从下降转为上升或持续下降但趋缓）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值大于前一根值，即VWAP上升），产生买入信号；当Value[1]>Value[2]（VWAP从上升转为下降）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前值小于前一根值，即VWAP下降），产生卖出信号。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）进行风险管理。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例、固定手数。信号处理采用新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线上重复入场。指标使用3个缓冲区值进行比较，SignalBar参数控制从哪根K线开始读取数据。
EA-15567.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on the VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price) indicator. Entry conditions: when Value[1]<Value[2] (VWAP declining or bottoming) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current VWAP rising above previous), a buy signal is generated; when Value[1]>Value[2] (VWAP rising or topping) and Value[0]<Value[1] (current VWAP falling below previous), a sell signal is generated. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals for position closure, combined with fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) for risk management. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Signal processing uses a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated entries on the same bar. The indicator reads 3 buffer values for comparison, and the SignalBar parameter controls which bar to start reading data from, allowing signal offset configuration.

EA-158.name: Multik_SMA_Exp
EA-158.summary: A multicurrency Expert Advisor that trades up to 12 currency pairs simultaneously using SMA slope direction. It generates buy signals when the SMA is rising for two consecutive periods and sell signals when the SMA is falling, with position management handled independently per symbol.
EA-158.summary_zh: 这是一个多货币智能交易系统，同时交易最多12个货币对，基于SMA斜率方向生成信号。当SMA连续两个周期上升时产生买入信号，SMA连续两个周期下降时产生卖出信号，每个品种独立管理仓位。
EA-158.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于简单移动平均线（SMA）的斜率变化来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当SMA在第2-3根K线和第1-2根K线的差值均为正时（即SMA连续上升两个周期），产生买入信号（DnSignal为true，命名反直觉）；当差值均为负时（SMA连续下降），产生卖出信号。出场条件为：当SMA在第1-2根K线的差值由正转负时关闭多头仓位，由负转正时关闭空头仓位。仓位管理方面，每个品种独立管理，同一品种最多持有一个仓位，通过PositionSelect检查是否已有持仓。资金管理采用动态手数计算（Money_M函数），根据账户可用保证金按比例计算手数，并限制在0.1到5手之间。该EA支持最多12个货币对同时运行，每个品种有独立的参数配置。
EA-158.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the slope change of the Simple Moving Average (SMA) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: when the SMA differences for bars 2-3 and bars 1-2 are both positive (SMA rising for two consecutive periods), a buy signal is generated; when both differences are negative (SMA falling), a sell signal is generated. Exit conditions: when the SMA difference for bars 1-2 turns negative, the long position is closed; when it turns positive, the short position is closed. Position management is handled independently per symbol, with a maximum of one position per symbol checked via PositionSelect. Money management uses dynamic lot sizing via the Money_M function, calculating lot size proportionally from free margin and clamping between 0.1 and 5 lots. The EA supports up to 12 currency pairs running simultaneously, each with independent parameter configuration for period, applied price, and MA method.

EA-159.name: GurooEx01
EA-159.summary: A random-entry expert advisor that simulates coin tosses to decide trade direction. It opens either a buy or sell position based on a random number, with fixed stop-loss and profit-target levels. The EA is explicitly for educational purposes and warns against live trading.
EA-159.summary_zh: 一个基于随机入场信号的专家顾问，通过模拟抛硬币决定交易方向。它根据随机数开多或空单，设有固定止损和止盈水平。该EA明确仅用于教育目的，警告不要用于实盘交易。
EA-159.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是使用随机数生成器模拟抛硬币来决定交易方向，完全不考虑任何技术指标或基本面分析。入场条件为：当MathRand()返回值小于16384时做多，大于等于16384时做空，这相当于50%的概率选择方向。出场条件依赖于固定点数的止损（10000点）和止盈（1000点），止盈远小于止损，属于大止损小止盈的逆风险回报比设计。仓位管理采用固定手数（0.1手），没有任何资金管理或动态仓位调整逻辑。资金管理方面完全缺失，GetSize()函数直接返回固定的Lots参数，不考虑账户余额或风险比例。该EA在每次平仓后会重新初始化系统状态，再次等待随机入场信号。
EA-159.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA uses a random number generator to simulate coin tosses for trade direction, completely ignoring any technical indicators or fundamental analysis. Entry conditions are: go long when MathRand() returns a value below 16384, go short when 16384 or above, effectively a 50/50 probability direction choice. Exit conditions rely on fixed point-based stop-loss (10000 points) and profit-target (1000 points), with the profit target far smaller than the stop-loss, resulting in an unfavorable risk-reward ratio. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (0.1 lots) with no dynamic position adjustment logic whatsoever. Money management is entirely absent — the GetSize() function simply returns the fixed Lots input parameter without considering account balance or risk ratios. After each position closes, the system reinitializes its state and waits for the next random entry signal.

EA-15906.name: Exp_PChannel_System
EA-15906.summary: This EA trades based on the PChannel_System custom indicator, opening buy positions when price breaks above the channel and sell positions when it breaks below. It uses a price channel system with configurable period and shift to generate breakout signals, with independent controls for opening and closing positions on each side.
EA-15906.summary_zh: 该EA基于PChannel_System自定义指标进行交易，在价格突破通道上方时开多仓，在价格跌破通道下方时开空仓。它使用可配置周期和偏移的价格通道系统生成突破信号，并可独立控制多空方向的建仓和平仓。
EA-15906.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于价格通道（Price Channel）突破系统，使用PChannel_System自定义指标识别通道上下轨的突破。入场条件：当指标缓冲区8的第1根K线值大于2且第0根K线值小于3时，触发做多信号；当缓冲区8的第1根K线值小于2且第0根K线值大于1时，触发做空信号。出场条件分为两种：一是通过反向信号触发平仓（如做多时出现做空信号则平多仓），二是通过固定点数的止损和止盈平仓。仓位管理采用5种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等。策略默认使用H4周期，止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险回报比为1:2。信号仅在出现新K线时计算，避免重复交易，但缺乏对已持仓方向的检查。
EA-15906.strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is based on a Price Channel breakout system using the PChannel_System custom indicator to identify upper and lower channel breaks. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when indicator buffer 8's bar 1 value is greater than 2 and bar 0 value is less than 3; a sell signal triggers when buffer 8's bar 1 value is less than 2 and bar 0 value is greater than 1. Exit conditions are twofold: positions close on reverse signals (e.g., a buy position closes when a sell signal appears), and fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points. Position sizing supports five money management modes including fixed lots, balance-based percentage, and free margin-based percentage. The default timeframe is H4 with a 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. Signals are only calculated on new bar formation to prevent duplicate trades, but the EA lacks checking for existing positions in the same direction before opening new ones.

EA-15907.name: Exp_DarvasBoxes_System
EA-15907.summary: This EA implements the Darvas Boxes trading system, which identifies box-shaped trading ranges and trades breakouts from those ranges. It uses the custom DarvasBoxes_System indicator to detect upward and downward breakout signals, then opens buy or sell positions accordingly. The system includes configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and separate controls for opening and closing positions on both sides.
EA-15907.summary_zh: 该EA实现了Darvas箱体交易系统，通过识别箱体形态的交易区间并在突破时进行交易。它使用自定义的DarvasBoxes_System指标来检测向上和向下突破信号，然后相应地开立买入或卖出仓位。系统包含可配置的资金管理、止损止盈以及双边开仓和平仓的独立控制。
EA-15907.strategy_analysis: 该EA基于Darvas箱体理论，这是一种经典的突破交易策略，由Nicolas Darvas提出。策略通过DarvasBoxes_System自定义指标识别价格形成的箱体区间，当价格向上突破箱体顶部时产生买入信号（Col[1]>2且Col[0]<3），当价格向下突破箱体底部时产生卖出信号（Col[1]<2且Col[0]>1）。入场条件完全依赖指标的缓冲区数值判断，指标的第6个缓冲区提供信号数据，Col[1]判断突破方向，Col[0]确认突破强度。出场方面，EA使用固定的止损和止盈（默认1000和2000点），同时当反向突破信号出现时会主动平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种模式，包括按自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的保证金比例以及固定手数。EA还实现了新K线检测机制避免重复信号，并通过SignalBar参数允许用户选择信号触发位置。
EA-15907.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is based on the Darvas Box theory, a classic breakout trading strategy proposed by Nicolas Darvas. The strategy identifies box-shaped trading ranges through the DarvasBoxes_System custom indicator and trades breakouts from those ranges. When price breaks above the box top, a buy signal is generated (Col[1]>2 and Col[0]<3), and when price breaks below the box bottom, a sell signal is generated (Col[1]<2 and Col[0]>1). Entry conditions rely entirely on the indicator's buffer values, where buffer index 6 provides signal data with Col[1] determining breakout direction and Col[0] confirming breakout strength. For exits, the EA uses fixed stop loss and take profit levels (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively), and also actively closes positions when opposing breakout signals appear. Position sizing supports multiple modes through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, including percentage of free margin, balance, margin after deducting losses, and fixed lot size. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism to avoid duplicate signals and allows users to select the signal trigger bar via the SignalBar parameter.

EA-15947.summary: This EA trades based on the ADXDMI custom indicator, which appears to be an ADX/DMI-based trend following system with signal line crossovers. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-15947.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义ADXDMI指标进行交易，属于ADX/DMI趋势跟踪系统，通过指标线与信号线的交叉来产生交易信号。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈。
EA-15947.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于ADXDMI指标的趋势跟踪策略，核心逻辑是指标线(Ind)与信号线(Sign)的交叉判断。入场条件为：当上一根K线的Ind大于Sign（即处于上升趋势中），且前一根K线的Ind小于等于Sign（即刚刚发生金叉）时，开多仓；反之当Ind下穿Sign时开空仓。出场条件通过独立的买卖平仓开关控制，当趋势反转信号出现时平掉反向仓位。仓位管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的MarginMode枚举，支持按自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的余额等比例下单，也支持固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，MMMode默认为LOT（固定手数）。止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，盈亏比为2:1。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，同时通过SignalBar参数可选择使用哪根K线的信号。
EA-15947.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend following strategy based on the custom ADXDMI indicator, with the core logic centered on crossover signals between the indicator line (Ind) and the signal line (Sign). Entry conditions: when the previous bar's Ind is above Sign (confirming an uptrend) and the bar before that had Ind below or equal to Sign (a fresh golden cross), a buy position is opened; conversely, when Ind crosses below Sign, a sell position is opened. Exit conditions are handled through independent buy/sell close flags that trigger when the trend reverses, closing the opposing position. Position sizing leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library's MarginMode enumeration, supporting lot sizing based on free margin, balance, balance minus floating loss, or fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) with MMMode defaulting to LOT (fixed lot). Stop loss is set to 1000 points and take profit to 2000 points, yielding a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting which bar's signal to use for execution.

EA-1596.name: Exp_TrendContinuation
EA-1596.summary: This EA trades trend continuation signals generated by the custom TrendContinuation indicator. It detects crossovers between the indicator's upper and lower buffer lines to open buy or sell positions, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. Trading is restricted to new bar formation on the specified timeframe to avoid redundant signals.
EA-1596.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义TrendContinuation指标的趋势延续信号进行交易。通过检测指标上下两条线的交叉来开仓做多或做空，支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。交易信号仅在指定时间周期的新K线形成时生成，以避免重复入场。
EA-1596.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于趋势延续，即当TrendContinuation指标的两条线发生交叉时，认为当前趋势将会延续。入场条件为：当上线上穿下线时开多单，当上线下穿下线时开空单，信号在指定SignalBar上检测并通过前一根K线的比较确认交叉。出场条件包括固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向信号平仓（多单在卖出信号时平仓，空单在买入信号时平仓）。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按自由保证金亏损比例、按余额亏损比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制投入比例，MMMode参数决定具体的资金分配方式。策略使用了多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、T3等）对价格进行预处理，提高了信号的平滑度。
EA-1596.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend continuation, where crossovers of the TrendContinuation indicator's two buffer lines signal that the current trend will persist. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the upper line crosses above the lower line, and a sell position opens when the upper line crosses below the lower line; signals are confirmed by comparing the current and previous bar values at the specified SignalBar index. Exit conditions include fixed-point stop loss and take profit levels, plus reverse-signal closing where long positions close on sell signals and short positions close on buy signals. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin share, balance share, loss share from free margin, loss share from balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for deposit share and MMMode parameter for the specific allocation method. The strategy employs multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, T3, etc.) for price preprocessing, which improves signal smoothness and reduces noise.

EA-1598.name: NarrowestRangeSignal EA
EA-1598.summary: This EA places bracket stop orders (buy stop above and sell stop below) when the NarrowestRangeSignal indicator identifies a narrow price range. When one side triggers, the opposite pending order is deleted, implementing an OCO (One-Cancels-Other) breakout strategy from narrow range consolidation.
EA-1598.summary_zh: 该EA基于NarrowestRangeSignal指标识别窄幅价格区间后，在区间高低点两侧设置止损挂单（买止损和卖止损）。当一侧挂单成交后，删除另一侧挂单，实现窄幅整理后的OCO突破策略。
EA-1598.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于窄幅整理突破，当NarrowestRangeSignal指标检测到指定周期内出现最窄K线范围时发出信号。入场条件为指标发出信号后，在区间最高价加上indent偏移处挂买止损单，在区间最低价减去indent偏移处挂卖止损单，形成双向突破挂单。出场条件依靠止盈参数平仓，止损设在区间对侧（买止损单的止损在最低价下方，卖止损单的止损在最高价上方）。仓位管理支持固定手数和固定百分比两种模式，百分比模式根据可用保证金和杠杆计算手数。资金管理方面，CalculateLot函数会检查最小最大手数限制并规范化手数精度，但缺少止损的独立风险控制，且没有追踪止损或移动止损机制。
EA-1598.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on narrow range breakout, where the NarrowestRangeSignal indicator detects the narrowest bar range within a specified period to generate a signal. Entry conditions involve placing a buy stop order above the range high plus an indent offset and a sell stop order below the range low minus an indent offset when the indicator fires, creating bracket stop orders on both sides. Exit conditions rely on a fixed take profit parameter for closing positions, with stop loss set on the opposite side of the range (buy stop SL below the low, sell stop SL above the high). Position sizing supports two modes: fixed lot and fixed percentage, where the percentage mode calculates lot size based on available free margin and account leverage. Money management includes lot validation against broker min/max limits and step normalization via CheckLotValue, but lacks independent risk control for stop loss sizing, and there is no trailing stop or break-even mechanism.

EA-160.name: Pipser
EA-160.summary: Pipser is a semi-automated trading utility that places Buy and Sell orders via on-chart buttons. It executes market orders with a fixed lot size and configurable stop loss, but has no take profit, no strategy logic, and no automated entry signals — the trader manually decides when to click the buttons.
EA-160.summary_zh: Pipser是一个半自动交易工具，通过图表上的按钮手动下单。它以固定手数和可配置止损执行市价单，但没有止盈、没有策略逻辑、没有自动入场信号——完全由交易者手动决定何时点击按钮。
EA-160.strategy_analysis: Pipser本质上不是一个自动化策略EA，而是一个半手动交易辅助工具。入场条件完全依赖交易者主观判断，通过点击图表上的Buy或Sell按钮触发市价单。出场条件仅设置了止损（SL参数），且止损会根据品种的小数位数自动调整（5位/3位报价时SL扩大10倍），但没有设置任何止盈目标，盈利出场完全依赖交易者手动平仓。仓位管理方面使用固定手数（Lot参数），没有任何基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位计算。资金管理几乎不存在，没有最大持仓限制、没有账户权益保护机制、没有回撤控制。整体而言，该EA将交易决策权完全交给交易者，仅提供了便捷的下单界面和基础止损保护。
EA-160.strategy_analysis_en: Pipser is fundamentally not an automated strategy EA but a semi-manual trading aid. Entry conditions rely entirely on the trader's subjective judgment, triggered by clicking Buy or Sell buttons on the chart. Exit conditions only include a stop loss (SL parameter), which auto-adjusts for 5/3-digit quote symbols by multiplying SL by 10, but there is no take profit target — profitable exits depend entirely on the trader manually closing positions. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (Lot parameter) with no dynamic calculation based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management is virtually nonexistent — there are no maximum position limits, account equity protections, or drawdown controls. Overall, this EA delegates all trading decisions to the trader and only provides a convenient order execution interface with basic stop loss protection.

EA-16027.name: ZZFiboTrader
EA-16027.summary: This EA uses a custom ZigZag Fibonacci indicator to identify key Fibo price levels, then enters trades on breakouts confirmed by candlestick patterns. It manages open positions with a parabolic SAR-style trailing stop loss system, dynamically adjusting the stop as the trend progresses.
EA-16027.summary_zh: 该EA使用自定义的ZigZag斐波那契指标识别关键斐波那契价位，在K线形态确认突破后入场交易。持仓期间采用类抛物线SAR追踪止损系统，随趋势发展动态调整止损位。
EA-16027.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ZigZag斐波那契回撤水平识别支撑阻力位，当价格突破某个斐波那契水平后等待确认再入场。入场条件要求：价格突破斐波那契水平、当前K线方向与交易方向一致、前一根K线收盘价在突破水平另一侧、最新K线收盘价回到突破水平的交易方向一侧。出场条件依赖类抛物线SAR追踪止损系统，该系统使用加速因子（AF）逐步收紧止损，加速因子从AFStep开始每次新bar增加，上限为AFCap。仓位管理方面，固定手数为1手，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理仅做了保证金检查（CheckMargin函数），确保账户有足够保证金才下单，但缺少最大风险敞口控制和亏损保护机制。
EA-16027.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on identifying support and resistance levels via ZigZag Fibonacci retracement levels, entering trades after breakout confirmation by candlestick patterns. Entry conditions require: price breaking through a Fibonacci level, the current bar direction aligning with the trade direction, the previous bar closing on the opposite side of the broken level, and the latest bar closing on the trade-direction side of the level. Exit conditions rely on a parabolic SAR-style trailing stop system, which uses an acceleration factor (AF) that starts at AFStep and increments each new bar up to AFCap, progressively tightening the stop loss. Position sizing is fixed at 1 lot with no dynamic lot calculation based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management only includes a margin check via the CheckMargin function to ensure sufficient free margin before opening a position, but lacks max drawdown controls, equity protection, or risk-based position sizing.

EA-16029.name: Exp_i-CAiChannel_System_Digit
EA-16029.summary: This EA trades based on the i-CAiChannel_System_Digit custom indicator, which generates digit-based channel signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward breakout (digit value > 2) and sell positions when it signals a downward breakout (digit value < 2), with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-16029.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标i-CAiChannel_System_Digit的通道数字信号进行交易。当指标发出向上突破信号（数值>2）时开多仓，当发出向下突破信号（数值<2）时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-16029.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于i-CAiChannel_System_Digit指标的数字通道突破系统。入场条件方面，当指标缓冲区8的第二根K线值大于2且第一根K线值小于3时触发买入信号，当第二根K线值小于2且第一根K线值大于1时触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖固定的止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点）水平，同时支持基于反向信号的平仓功能。仓位管理采用多种模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、亏损自由保证金和亏损余额的资金管理，以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），并结合MMMode选择具体的仓位计算方式。策略使用多平滑算法（SMA/EMA/JJMA等）构建通道，通过Dev参数设定通道偏差，Digit参数控制数字量化精度，整体属于通道突破型系统化交易策略。
EA-16029.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a digit-based channel breakout system using the i-CAiChannel_System_Digit indicator. For entry conditions, a buy signal is triggered when buffer 8's second bar value exceeds 2 and the first bar value is below 3, while a sell signal triggers when the second bar value drops below 2 and the first bar value exceeds 1. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points) levels, with additional support for signal-based position closing via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing supports multiple modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot sizing. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) which sets the risk ratio, combined with MMMode to select the specific lot calculation method. The strategy employs multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) to construct the channel, with Dev parameter for channel deviation and Digit parameter for digit quantization precision, constituting a systematic channel breakout trading approach.

EA-1606.name: ASCTrendND
EA-1606.summary: This EA trades based on ASCTrend indicator signals, filtered by NRTR and TrendStrength indicators to confirm trend direction. It uses ASCTrend signal values as stop loss levels and manages open positions via a trailing stop mechanism with no take profit target.
EA-1606.summary_zh: 该EA基于ASCTrend指标信号进行交易，并通过NRTR和TrendStrength指标过滤确认趋势方向。它使用ASCTrend信号值作为止损水平，通过追踪止损管理持仓，不设止盈目标。
EA-1606.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是ASCTrend指标产生主交易信号，当卖出信号缓冲区或买入信号缓冲区出现有效值时触发入场。入场信号需经过两层过滤：NRTR指标确认趋势方向（买入需NRTR上升趋势确认，卖出需NRTR下降趋势确认），TrendStrength指标进一步验证趋势强度。出场完全依赖追踪止损机制，不设固定止盈。仓位管理采用固定手数，资金管理模块声明未实现（lotsMode=0）。止损基于ASCTrend信号值，并受限于经纪商的止损水平要求。仅在新K线形成时检查信号，避免重复交易。同时只持有一个仓位，通过Magic Number识别。
EA-1606.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core relies on the ASCTrend indicator to generate primary trade signals, triggered when valid values appear in the sell or buy signal buffers. Entry signals must pass through two filter layers: the NRTR indicator confirms trend direction (buys require NRTR uptrend confirmation, sells require NRTR downtrend confirmation), and the TrendStrength indicator further validates trend strength. Exit relies entirely on a trailing stop mechanism with no fixed take profit target. Position sizing uses fixed lots, as the money management module is explicitly declared unimplemented (lotsMode=0). Stop loss is based on ASCTrend signal values, constrained by the broker's stop level requirements. Signals are checked only on new bar formation to prevent repeated trades. Only one position is held at a time, identified by Magic Number.

EA-16087.name: SARTrailingSystem
EA-16087.summary: This EA implements a Parabolic SAR-style trailing stop system that manages open positions by dynamically adjusting the stop-loss based on an acceleration factor mechanism. It opens random trades (buy or sell with equal probability) on a timer interval, then trails the stop-loss using SAR logic with configurable acceleration step and cap. The strategy has no directional bias for entries and relies entirely on the SAR trailing mechanism for exits.
EA-16087.summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于抛物线SAR风格的追踪止损系统，通过加速因子机制动态调整持仓的止损位。它在定时器触发时随机开仓（买卖各50%概率），然后使用SAR逻辑配置加速步长和上限来追踪止损。该策略入场无方向性偏好，完全依赖SAR追踪机制出场。
EA-16087.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于抛物线SAR指标原理，使用加速因子(AF)和极值点(EP)来动态追踪止损。入场条件极为简单：当RandomTrade开启且TimerFlag为true时，以50%概率随机选择买入或卖出，初始止损设为固定点数(StopLoss参数)。出场条件完全依赖SAR追踪止损：对于多头，当价格创新高时提高EP并增加AF，计算delta=AF*(EP-当前SL)来上移止损；对于空头反之亦然。仓位管理方面，固定1手交易量，无任何仓位调整逻辑。资金管理仅包含简单的保证金检查(CheckMargin函数)，确保可用保证金充足后才下单。策略缺乏真正的入场信号逻辑，随机入场意味着没有任何市场分析，完全依赖SAR追踪来捕获趋势利润，这在震荡市中会造成频繁止损。
EA-16087.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Parabolic SAR indicator principle, using an acceleration factor (AF) and extreme point (EP) to dynamically trail the stop-loss. Entry conditions are extremely simple: when RandomTrade is enabled and TimerFlag is true, the EA randomly selects buy or sell with 50% probability, with an initial stop-loss set at a fixed point distance (StopLoss parameter). Exit conditions rely entirely on SAR trailing: for long positions, when price makes a new high, EP is raised and AF increases, calculating delta=AF*(EP-current SL) to move the stop-loss up; for short positions the reverse applies. Position sizing uses a fixed 1 lot volume with no adjustment logic whatsoever. Money management includes only a basic margin check (CheckMargin function) to ensure sufficient free margin before placing orders. The strategy lacks genuine entry signal logic—random entry means no market analysis at all, relying completely on SAR trailing to capture trend profits, which will cause frequent stop-outs in ranging markets.

Good parameter configurability with AFStep and AFCap allowing users to adjust trailing sensitivity based on different instruments and market volatility
Includes basic margin checking to avoid placing orders when funds are insufficient
Uses new bar detection logic (BarTime) to prevent repeated SL modifications on the same bar, reducing trade frequency
cons: 入场逻辑完全随机，没有任何技术分析或市场判断，相当于赌博式开仓，长期胜率无保证
固定1手交易量，无视账户规模和波动率，缺乏动态仓位管理，大资金下风险不可控
止损修改缺少StopLevel最小距离检查，可能因距离当前价格太近而被服务器拒绝
没有止盈机制，盈利完全依赖追踪止损，在快速反转中可能回吐大量利润
没有考虑点差和滑点，在点差较大的品种上随机入场成本高昂
cons_en: Entry logic is completely random with no technical analysis or market judgment—essentially gambling-style entries with no long-term win rate guarantee
Fixed 1 lot position size ignores account size and volatility, lacking dynamic position sizing—risk is uncontrollable with larger accounts
SL modification lacks StopLevel minimum distance checking, potentially being rejected by the server if too close to current price
No take-profit mechanism—profits depend entirely on trailing stops, which may give back significant profits during rapid reversals
Does not consider spread and slippage—random entry on high-spread instruments incurs significant costs
improvements: 添加基于技术指标的入场信号（如MA交叉、趋势过滤器）替代随机入场，提高策略的逻辑性和胜率
实现动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和ATR波动率计算合理手数，同时添加StopLevel距离检查确保止损修改有效
添加止盈逻辑或时间过滤（避开重要新闻时段和低流动性时段），减少不利条件下的交易
improvements_en: Add technical indicator-based entry signals (e.g., MA crossover, trend filter) to replace random entries, improving strategy logic and win rate
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account balance and ATR volatility, and add StopLevel distance checking to ensure SL modifications are valid
Add take-profit logic or time filters (avoiding major news events and low liquidity sessions) to reduce trading under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 随机入场无任何方向性优势，在震荡市中SAR追踪会频繁触发止损导致持续亏损
固定1手仓位不考虑账户规模，小账户可能因单笔亏损过大而爆仓
缺少止损修改的最小距离检查(StopLevel)，可能导致订单被拒绝后止损未能及时移动
risk_points_en: Random entry provides no directional edge—SAR trailing will trigger frequent stop-outs in ranging markets leading to continuous losses
Fixed 1 lot position ignores account size—small accounts may face account blow-up from excessive single-trade risk
Missing minimum distance check (StopLevel) for SL modifications may cause order rejections, leaving stops unadjusted

EA-162.name: TicksFile
EA-162.summary: This EA is a data-logging utility that records tick data and bar data to a CSV file in real time. It captures completed bar OHLCV data alongside incoming tick details (ask, bid, last, volume) and writes them to a timestamped file. It does not open, manage, or close any trading positions.
EA-162.summary_zh: 这是一个数据记录工具EA，实时将tick数据和K线数据写入CSV文件。它捕获已完成K线的OHLCV数据以及到达的tick详情（ask、bid、last、volume），写入带时间戳的文件中。该EA不进行任何开仓、管理或平仓操作。
EA-162.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个纯粹的数据采集工具。其核心功能是在每次tick到达时，将已完成K线的开高低收成交量数据与当前tick的报价信息一并写入CSV文件，供后续离线分析使用。入场条件方面，当diskret参数为true时，仅在新K线开盘时才记录数据，实现降采样；为false时则每个tick都记录。出场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理与资金管理均不涉及。该工具的价值在于为量化研究提供高质量的逐tick历史数据，便于策略回测和统计分析。其文件命名规则包含品种、周期和起始时间，便于数据管理。
EA-162.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a pure data collection utility. Its core function is to write completed bar OHLCV data alongside incoming tick quote information (ask, bid, last, volume) to a CSV file on each tick arrival for offline analysis. Regarding entry conditions, when the diskret parameter is true, it only records data at new bar openings for downsampling; when false, it records every tick. Exit conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute any trading operations. Position sizing and money management are not involved whatsoever. The utility's value lies in providing high-quality tick-by-tick historical data for quantitative research, facilitating strategy backtesting and statistical analysis. Its file naming convention includes symbol, timeframe, and start time, which facilitates data management and organization.

parameters.description_en: 是否仅在K线开盘时记录数据，true为降采样模式

parameters.description: CSV文件中的字段分隔符，若输入空格则自动替换为制表符

pros: 提供逐tick级别的高精度数据记录，适合量化研究
支持降采样模式（diskret=true），可按K线周期记录以减少数据量
文件名自动包含品种、周期和时间信息，便于数据归档与检索
pros_en: Provides tick-level high-precision data recording suitable for quantitative research
Supports downsampling mode (diskret=true) to record by bar period and reduce data volume
File names automatically include symbol, timeframe, and time info for easy archiving and retrieval
cons: 无文件写入错误处理，若FileOpen失败后仍继续调用FileWrite可能导致异常
缺少文件大小监控，长时间运行可能生成超大文件导致磁盘空间不足
FileOpen返回值检查有误（hF<-1），正确应为hF==INVALID_HANDLE即hF<0
cons_en: No file write error handling; if FileOpen fails, subsequent FileWrite calls may cause undefined behavior
No file size monitoring; long-running sessions may generate extremely large files exhausting disk space
FileOpen return value check is incorrect (hF<-1); should be hF==INVALID_HANDLE which is hF<0
improvements: 修正FileOpen返回值检查逻辑，应使用hF==INVALID_HANDLE进行判断
增加文件大小限制或自动分割机制，避免单个文件过大
增加SymbolInfoTick和CopyRates失败时的重试机制
improvements_en: Fix FileOpen return value check logic; should use hF==INVALID_HANDLE for validation
Add file size limit or auto-split mechanism to prevent excessively large single files
Add retry mechanism for SymbolInfoTick and CopyRates failures

risk_points: FileOpen返回值检查逻辑错误，可能在文件打开失败时继续写入导致未定义行为
长时间运行无文件大小控制，存在磁盘空间耗尽风险
risk_points_en: FileOpen return value check logic error may cause undefined behavior if file open fails and writes continue
No file size control during long-running sessions poses disk space exhaustion risk

EA-1620.name: Demo_FileWriteArray
EA-1620.summary: This EA is a file-writing utility that collects bid/ask price data and datetime stamps on every tick, storing them in a structured array. Once the array reaches its capacity (20 elements), it writes the accumulated data to a binary file and resets the counter. It serves as a demonstration of MQL5's FileWriteArray function for persisting structured data to disk.
EA-1620.summary_zh: 该EA是一个文件写入工具，在每个tick上收集买价/卖价及时间戳数据，存储到结构体数组中。当数组填满20个元素后，将累积数据写入二进制文件并重置计数器。它作为MQL5的FileWriteArray函数的演示，用于将结构化数据持久化到磁盘。
EA-1620.strategy_analysis: 该EA没有交易策略概念，它不执行任何入场或出场操作，仅作为数据记录工具运行。在每个tick到来时，它获取当前服务器时间、当前品种的买价和卖价，并将这些数据存入一个预分配大小为20的prices结构体数组中。仓位管理和资金管理在此EA中完全不适用，因为它不涉及任何交易行为。当数组计数器达到预设大小时，EA调用WriteData函数将整个数组通过FileWriteArray以二进制格式写入文件，随后将计数器归零继续采集。在EA反初始化时，如果数组中还有未写满的数据（count小于size），也会将剩余数据写入文件以防数据丢失。整体逻辑简单直接，是一个纯粹的数据采集与文件I/O演示程序。
EA-1620.strategy_analysis_en: This EA has no trading strategy concept; it does not execute any entry or exit operations and functions solely as a data logging tool. On each incoming tick, it retrieves the current server time, the current symbol's bid and ask prices, and stores this data into a pre-allocated prices struct array with a size of 20. Position sizing and money management are entirely inapplicable since the EA does not involve any trading activity. When the array counter reaches the preset size, the EA calls the WriteData function to write the entire array to a file in binary format via FileWriteArray, then resets the counter to continue collecting data. During deinitialization, if the array contains unsaved data (count less than size), it also writes the remaining records to the file to prevent data loss. The overall logic is straightforward and simple, serving as a pure data collection and file I/O demonstration program.
pros: 结构体数组批量写入文件，利用FileWriteArray高效序列化二进制数据
在OnDeinit中处理未满数组的剩余数据写入，避免数据丢失
代码简洁清晰，作为FileWriteArray的官方示例具有良好的教学价值
pros_en: Batch writing of struct arrays to file using FileWriteArray for efficient binary serialization
Handles remaining unsaved data in OnDeinit to prevent data loss on EA shutdown
Clean and concise code serving as an excellent official demonstration of FileWriteArray functionality
cons: 没有文件写入失败的详细错误处理，仅打印错误码而无恢复机制
数组大小硬编码为20，缺乏灵活性，用户无法通过参数调整缓冲区大小
缺少数据去重或防重复写入机制，若EA重启可能导致文件中出现重复或残缺数据
cons_en: Lacks detailed error handling for file write failures; only prints error code without recovery mechanism
Array size is hard-coded to 20 with no input parameter for user-configurable buffer size
No data deduplication or repeat-write protection; EA restart may cause duplicate or incomplete records in the file
improvements: 将数组缓冲区大小(size=20)改为可配置的输入参数，提升灵活性
增加文件写入成功与否的验证逻辑，写入后读取校验或记录写入字节数以确认完整性
improvements_en: Make the array buffer size (size=20) a configurable input parameter for greater flexibility
Add write verification logic such as read-back validation or logging the number of bytes written to confirm data integrity

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，无资金风险
文件操作使用FILE_READ|FILE_WRITE模式，在多实例场景下可能存在文件访问冲突
risk_points_en: The EA performs no trading operations, posing no financial risk
File operations use FILE_READ|FILE_WRITE mode which may cause file access conflicts in multi-instance scenarios

EA-16350.name: NightScalper
EA-16350.summary: A multi-symbol night scalping EA that trades Bollinger Band mean reversion signals during specific time windows. It opens buy positions when price touches the lower band and sell positions when price touches the upper band, provided band width is below a threshold. Positions are closed when the trading session ends and new trades are only opened on new bars.
EA-16350.summary_zh: 一个多品种夜间剥头皮EA，在特定时间窗口内基于布林带均值回归信号交易。当价格触及下轨时买入，触及上轨时卖出，且要求布林带宽度低于阈值。交易时段结束时平仓，仅在新K线时开仓。
EA-16350.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于布林带均值回归的夜间剥头皮策略，利用夜间市场波动率降低时价格在布林带上下轨之间回归的特性进行交易。入场条件为：当价格低于布林带下轨且布林带宽度（上轨与下轨之差）小于设定的Razmah阈值时做多，当价格高于布林带上轨且带宽小于阈值时做空。出场条件包括止损和止盈，以及当当前时间早于设定的Start时间时强制平仓所有仓位。仓位管理方面，所有品种使用固定手数Lot，没有任何动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，完全没有资金管理逻辑，不根据账户余额或风险比例调整仓位大小。该EA支持最多9个品种同时交易，每个品种有独立的布林带参数、止损止盈和交易时间设置。
EA-16350.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a night scalping approach based on Bollinger Band mean reversion, exploiting the tendency of prices to revert within the bands during low-volatility nighttime sessions. Entry conditions are: go long when the Ask price is below the lower Bollinger Band and the band width (upper minus lower) is less than the Razmah threshold in points, and go short when the Bid price is above the upper band with the same band width filter. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, plus a forced close of all positions on a symbol when the current time is before the Start hour (which effectively defines a time window boundary). Position sizing uses a fixed lot size for all symbols with no dynamic adjustment based on volatility or account equity. Money management is completely absent, as there is no logic to scale position size based on account balance, risk percentage, or any other equity-based metric. The EA supports up to 9 symbols simultaneously, each with independent Bollinger Band parameters, stop loss/take profit, and session start time settings.

pros: 多品种支持，可同时交易最多9个品种，分散风险
布林带宽度过滤确保只在低波动率环境下交易，符合夜间剥头皮逻辑
新K线判断机制避免重复开仓，减少过度交易
每个品种参数独立可调，灵活性高
有时间窗口控制，非交易时段自动平仓
pros_en: Multi-symbol support for up to 9 instruments simultaneously, enabling risk diversification
Bollinger Band width filter ensures trading only in low-volatility environments, aligning with night scalping logic
New bar check prevents duplicate entries and reduces overtrading
Independent parameter sets per symbol offer high flexibility for optimization
Time window control with automatic position closure outside trading hours
cons: 止损远大于止盈（如品种1止损370点对止盈20点），风险报酬比极差
没有点差过滤，夜间低流动性时段点差可能很大，导致不利成交
固定手数无资金管理，不根据账户规模调整仓位
BBHandle指标句柄在每次SymbolTrade调用时重新创建，造成资源泄漏
时间逻辑有缺陷：只检查当前时间大于Start时间就开仓，没有结束时间限制，平仓条件是时间小于Start意味着只在新的一天Start之前才平仓
CloseAll函数在循环中按Symbol平仓但PositionClose可能改变持仓索引导致遗漏
不支持魔法号(Magic Number)过滤，可能与其他EA冲突
cons_en: Stop loss far exceeds take profit (e.g. Symbol1: 370 vs 20 points), resulting in extremely poor risk-reward ratio
No spread filter, which is critical since nighttime low-liquidity sessions often have wide spreads leading to unfavorable fills
Fixed lot size with no money management, position size does not adapt to account equity
BBHandle indicator handle is recreated on every SymbolTrade call, causing resource/memory leak
Time logic is flawed: only checks if current time > Start for entries with no end time, and closes only when time < Start which means closures happen in the pre-Start hours of a new day
CloseAll function iterates positions and closes by symbol, but PositionClose may alter position indices causing skipped closures
No Magic Number filtering, so it may conflict with other EAs running on the same symbol
improvements: 添加点差过滤，当点差超过阈值时不开仓，避免夜间高滑点成交
在OnInit中预创建所有品种的指标句柄并缓存，避免每次tick重复创建导致资源泄漏
添加结束时间参数和完整的时间窗口逻辑，替代当前有缺陷的单边时间判断
添加Magic Number以区分本EA的仓位与其他EA的仓位
加入基于账户余额或ATR的动态仓位管理
修复CloseAll函数，使用倒序遍历并在每次平仓后重新检查持仓总数
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to prevent opening positions when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unfavorable fills during nighttime low liquidity
Pre-create and cache all indicator handles in OnInit instead of recreating them on every SymbolTrade call to prevent resource leaks
Add an end time parameter and implement proper time window logic to replace the flawed single-direction time check
Add Magic Number support to distinguish this EA's positions from other EAs running on the same symbols
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity or ATR for better risk management
Fix CloseAll function to properly handle position index changes after closing, using reverse iteration with re-checking of PositionsTotal

risk_points: 止损远大于止盈，需要极高的胜率才能盈利，一次亏损可抵消多次盈利
夜间交易无点差过滤，可能在高点差环境下开仓导致额外损失
指标句柄泄漏可能导致终端资源耗尽
CloseAll函数可能遗漏平仓，导致非预期持仓过夜
无Magic Number可能导致误平其他EA的仓位或误判持仓数量
固定手数无资金管理，大账户小手数浪费机会，小账户大手数过度风险
risk_points_en: Stop loss far exceeds take profit, requiring extremely high win rate to be profitable; one loss can wipe out many wins
No spread filter for night trading may result in entries during wide spreads causing additional losses
Indicator handle leak may exhaust terminal resources over time
CloseAll function may skip positions due to index shifting, leaving unintended overnight positions
No Magic Number may cause accidental closure of other EAs' positions or miscounting of open positions
Fixed lot size with no money management wastes opportunity on large accounts and over-risks small accounts

EA-1637.name: Profit Loss Calculator
EA-1637.summary: This EA is a profit/loss calculator utility that creates a graphical panel on the chart for computing potential profit and loss values. It does not open trades or implement any trading strategy, serving purely as a calculation and visualization aid for traders.
EA-1637.summary_zh: 该EA是一个盈亏计算器工具，在图表上创建一个图形面板用于计算潜在的盈利和亏损值。它不会开仓交易或实现任何交易策略，纯粹作为交易者的计算和可视化辅助工具。
EA-1637.strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略EA，而是一个实用工具类EA。它通过CProfitLossCalculator类创建一个图形界面面板，允许用户在图表上输入交易参数来计算潜在盈亏。入场条件和出场条件不适用于此EA，因为它不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理方面，该工具可能帮助用户计算不同手数下的盈亏情况，但本身不进行仓位管理。资金管理方面，它作为一个计算辅助工具，可能提供基于账户余额和风险的盈亏模拟功能。整体而言，这是一个纯计算展示工具，不涉及任何自动交易逻辑。
EA-1637.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy EA but rather a utility tool. It creates a graphical interface panel through the CProfitLossCalculator class, allowing users to input trade parameters on the chart to calculate potential profit and loss. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since it does not execute any trading operations. Regarding position sizing, the tool may help users calculate profit and loss under different lot sizes, but it does not perform position management itself. For money management, it serves as a calculation aid that may provide profit and loss simulations based on account balance and risk parameters. Overall, this is a purely computational display tool with no automated trading logic involved.
pros: 提供直观的图形界面进行盈亏计算，便于交易者快速评估交易机会
作为独立工具EA运行，不干扰其他交易策略的执行
代码结构清晰，采用面向对象设计(CProfitLossCalculator类)，便于维护和扩展
pros_en: Provides an intuitive graphical interface for profit/loss calculation, enabling traders to quickly evaluate trading opportunities
Runs as a standalone utility EA without interfering with other trading strategies
Clean code structure using object-oriented design (CProfitLossCalculator class), making it maintainable and extensible
cons: 缺少输入参数的灵活性，面板尺寸和位置硬编码在OnInit中
错误处理较为简单，仅在创建失败时打印错误码，未提供用户友好的反馈
依赖外部头文件ProfitLossCalculator.mqh，无法从当前代码判断核心计算逻辑的可靠性
cons_en: Lacks flexibility in input parameters, with panel dimensions and positions hardcoded in OnInit
Error handling is simplistic, only printing error codes on creation failure without user-friendly feedback
Depends on external header file ProfitLossCalculator.mqh, making it impossible to assess core calculation logic reliability from the current code alone
improvements: 将面板的位置和尺寸参数化为可配置的输入变量，增强灵活性
添加更详细的错误处理和用户提示信息，例如在面板创建失败时显示消息框
improvements_en: Parameterize panel position and dimensions as configurable input variables for greater flexibility
Add more detailed error handling and user notification, such as displaying a message box when panel creation fails

risk_points: 该EA为纯工具类，不执行交易操作，无交易风险
图形面板创建失败时EA返回-1初始化失败，但未清理可能已分配的资源
risk_points_en: This EA is purely a utility tool with no trading operations, posing no trading risk
When graphical panel creation fails, the EA returns -1 for initialization failure but does not clean up potentially allocated resources

EA-1640.name: Exp_CandleTrend
EA-1640.summary: This EA generates trading signals based on a simple candlestick trend pattern: it opens a buy position when a configurable number of consecutive bullish candles appear, and a sell position when the same number of consecutive bearish candles appear. It includes stop loss, take profit, and multiple money management modes via the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library.
EA-1640.summary_zh: 该EA基于简单的K线趋势形态生成交易信号：当出现指定数量的连续阳线时开多仓，当出现相同数量的连续阴线时开空仓。它包含止损、止盈功能，并通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供多种资金管理模式。
EA-1640.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于连续同向K线的趋势确认，认为连续N根阳线代表强势上涨趋势，连续N根阴线代表强势下跌趋势。入场条件为：当指定数量（CandleTrendTotal，默认3）的K线全部为阳线时买入，全部为阴线时卖出。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损（StopLoss_=1000）和止盈（TakeProfit_=2000），同时在反向信号出现时允许平仓。仓位管理提供了五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、亏损自由保证金比例、亏损余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制仓位比例（默认0.1），结合MMMode选择具体的计算方式。信号仅在指定时间周期的新K线形成时检测，避免重复计算，但SignalBar=0时每tick都会重新计算。
EA-1640.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend confirmation via consecutive same-direction candles, assuming that N consecutive bullish candles indicate strong upward momentum and N consecutive bearish candles indicate strong downward momentum. Entry conditions: buy when all candles in the lookback window (CandleTrendTotal, default 3) are bullish (close > open), sell when all are bearish (close < open). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), with optional position closing on reverse signals enabled by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing offers five modes: free margin share, balance share, loss-based free margin share, loss-based balance share, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MM parameter (default 0.1) to control position proportion, combined with MMMode to select the calculation method. Signal detection occurs only on new bars of the specified timeframe, preventing redundant calculations, though setting SignalBar=0 triggers recalculation on every tick.

EA-1641.name: Exp_FigurelliSeries
EA-1641.summary: This EA trades based on the Figurelli Series indicator, which uses a basket of Moving Averages with varying periods to determine trend direction. It opens positions at a specified start time and closes them either by opposing signals or at a specified stop time. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot, free margin, and balance-based calculations.
EA-1641.summary_zh: 该EA基于Figurelli Series指标进行交易，该指标使用不同周期的移动平均线组合来判断趋势方向。EA在指定时间开仓，并通过反向信号或指定时间平仓。仓位管理支持多种保证金模式，包括固定手数、可用保证金和余额比例等。
EA-1641.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Figurelli Series指标，该指标通过计算多条不同周期的移动平均线（从iStartPeriod开始，以iStep为步长，共iTotal条）来综合判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标值大于0时产生买入信号，当指标值小于0时产生卖出信号，但仅在用户指定的开仓时间（StartHour:StartMinute）才实际执行开仓。出场条件包括两种：一是收到反向指标信号时平仓，二是到达指定的平仓时间（StopHour:StopMinute）时强制平仓所有仓位。仓位管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数，支持固定手数和基于保证金比例的动态手数计算。资金管理通过MM参数控制投入比例，并支持多种保证金计算模式（FREEMARGIN、BALANCE、LOSSFREEMARGIN、LOSSBALANCE、LOT）。EA还设置了止损和止盈参数，以及最大价格偏差限制来控制滑点风险。
EA-1641.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Figurelli Series indicator, which calculates multiple Moving Averages with varying periods (starting from iStartPeriod, incrementing by iStep, totaling iTotal MAs) to synthesize trend direction. Entry conditions: when the indicator value is greater than 0, a buy signal is generated; when less than 0, a sell signal is generated, but actual trade execution only occurs at the user-specified opening time (StartHour:StartMinute). Exit conditions include two mechanisms: closing on opposing indicator signals, and forced closing of all positions at the specified stop time (StopHour:StopMinute). Position sizing uses the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, supporting both fixed lot sizes and dynamic lot calculation based on margin ratios. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter which sets the deposit share per deal, with multiple margin calculation modes available (FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE, LOT). The EA also implements stop loss and take profit parameters in points, along with a maximum price deviation setting to control slippage risk.

EA-1645.name: Exp_QQECloud
EA-1645.summary: This EA trades based on the QQECloud indicator, which uses a smoothed RSI with variable smoothing methods to generate trend signals. It opens buy positions when the upper cloud line is above the lower cloud line and sell positions when the reverse is true, with time-restricted entry and exit windows. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes and includes configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-1645.summary_zh: 该EA基于QQECloud指标进行交易，该指标使用平滑RSI配合多种平滑方法生成趋势信号。当上轨云线高于下轨云线时开多仓，反之开空仓，并设有时段限制的入场和出场窗口。仓位管理支持多种保证金模式，并包含可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-1645.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是QQECloud指标，它基于RSI周期计算上轨和下轨两条云线，通过多周期平滑（支持SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等9种方法）生成信号。入场条件为：当上轨线高于下轨线时产生买入信号，当上轨线低于下轨线时产生卖出信号，仅在用户指定的小时和分钟（StartHour:StartMinute）才实际开仓。出场条件包括：反向指标信号触发平仓、时间窗口结束（StopHour:StopMinute）强制平仓、以及止损止盈触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制交易份额，支持自由保证金、余额、亏损份额、固定手数等多种模式。资金管理还包含最大价格偏差（Deviation）控制滑点，以及通过BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose四个布尔开关精细控制多空开平仓权限。
EA-1645.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is the QQECloud indicator, which calculates upper and lower cloud lines based on an RSI period, smoothed using one of nine available methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA, SMMA). Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the upper cloud line exceeds the lower cloud line, and a sell signal when the upper line falls below the lower line; however, actual trade execution is restricted to the user-specified hour and minute (StartHour:StartMinute). Exit conditions include: reverse indicator signal triggering position closure, forced closure at the end of the time window (StopHour:StopMinute), and stop-loss/take-profit triggered exits. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter governing trade share, supporting multiple margin modes including free margin, balance, loss share, and fixed lot. Money management also incorporates a maximum price deviation (Deviation) parameter to control slippage, plus four boolean toggles (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) for granular control over long/short entry and exit permissions.

EA-1648.name: Exp_Color3rdGenXMA
EA-1648.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the Color3rdGenXMA custom indicator, which uses a third-generation moving average with configurable smoothing methods. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0), with time-based entry filtering and position holding duration limits.
EA-1648.summary_zh: 该EA基于Color3rdGenXMA自定义指标信号进行交易，该指标使用第三代移动平均线并支持多种平滑方法。当指标值为2时开多仓，为0时开空仓，同时具有基于时间的入场过滤和持仓时长限制功能。
EA-1648.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于第三代指数移动平均线（Color3rdGenXMA）的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值等于2时产生买入信号，等于0时产生卖出信号，中间值1表示无方向信号。入场时间受到严格控制，仅在用户指定的特定小时和分钟（StartHour:StartMinute）才允许开仓，这是一种时段交易过滤机制。出场条件包括：指标反向信号触发平仓（需开启BuyPosClose/SellPosClose），以及基于持仓时间的强制平仓（TimeMin参数，默认720分钟）。仓位管理通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库实现，支持五种资金管理模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、自由保证金亏损比例、余额亏损比例和固定手数。EA还支持最大价格偏差（滑点）控制和历史数据加载以确保指标计算正确性。
EA-1648.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the third-generation moving average indicator (Color3rdGenXMA). Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 equals 2, and a sell signal when it equals 0, with the value 1 representing no directional signal. Entry timing is strictly controlled, only allowing new positions at a user-specified hour and minute (StartHour:StartMinute), functioning as a session-based trade filter. Exit conditions include: indicator reversal signals triggering position closure (if BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are enabled), and forced closure based on position holding time (TimeMin parameter, default 720 minutes). Position sizing is managed through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, supporting five money management modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, free margin loss share, balance loss share, and fixed lot size. The EA also implements maximum price deviation (slippage) control and history data loading to ensure correct indicator calculations.

EA-1649.name: Rock-Trader-Neuro
EA-1649.summary: This EA uses a single-layer artificial neuron with hyperbolic tangent activation to generate trading signals from Bollinger Band indicator values. It normalizes the ratio of Bollinger Band width to base line across 7 bars as neuron inputs, buys when the neuron output is negative, and sells when positive. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1649.summary_zh: 该EA使用单层人工神经元（双曲正切激活函数）基于布林带指标值生成交易信号。它将7根K线的布林带宽度与基准线的比值归一化后作为神经元输入，神经元输出为负时买入，为正时卖出，并使用固定止损止盈管理仓位。
EA-1649.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于单层感知器神经网络，利用布林带的上轨、下轨和基准线数据作为输入特征。入场条件为：当神经元输出值小于0时开多单，大于0时开空单。神经元输入是对布林带宽度（上轨减下轨）与基准线之比进行归一化处理后的值，共7个输入对应14个数组元素（每个输入配一个权重）。出场条件完全依赖固定止损（30点）和止盈（100点），没有动态止盈或移动止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数（默认1手），没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面仅检查是否已有同方向持仓，防止重复开仓，但未考虑总仓位风险或最大回撤控制。权重参数(w0-w13)为硬编码输入参数，缺乏自适应训练或优化机制。
EA-1649.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a single-layer perceptron neural network using Bollinger Band upper, lower, and base line data as input features. Entry conditions are: open a buy when the neuron output is less than 0, and open a sell when the neuron output is greater than 0. The neuron inputs are normalized values of the Bollinger Band width (upper minus lower) divided by the base line across 7 bars, with 7 inputs mapped to 14 array elements (each input paired with a weight). Exit conditions rely entirely on fixed stop loss (30 pips) and take profit (100 pips), with no dynamic trailing stop or partial close mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (default 1.0 lot) with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management only checks for existing same-direction positions to prevent duplicate entries, but does not consider total portfolio risk or maximum drawdown limits. The weight parameters (w0-w13) are hardcoded input parameters with no adaptive training or optimization mechanism.
pros: 使用神经网络概念进行信号生成，具有一定的创新性

cons_en: Single-layer perceptron is too simplistic with limited expressiveness, unable to capture non-linear market features
Only 7 of 14 inputs are effectively mapped — odd-indexed elements of the inputs array are never assigned, causing a mismatch between input and weight array sizes
No neural network training mechanism — weights rely entirely on manual setting with no adaptability to market changes

improvements: 修复inputs数组赋值逻辑，确保所有14个元素都有有效值，或调整为7输入7权重的匹配结构
添加点差过滤机制，在点差超过阈值时禁止开仓

实现反向信号自动平仓功能，在多空转换时平掉现有持仓
improvements_en: Fix the inputs array assignment logic to ensure all 14 elements receive valid values, or restructure to a 7-input/7-weight matching architecture
Add a spread filter mechanism to prevent opening positions when spread exceeds a threshold
Introduce online neural network training or periodic optimization so weights can adapt to changing market conditions

EA-165.name: tootrix
EA-165.summary: This EA uses two TriX indicators with different periods to generate trading signals, combining momentum reversal detection with a martingale position sizing system. It opens buy/sell positions when TriX shows a V-shaped reversal pattern and the second TriX confirms momentum direction, while doubling lot size after losses via the included Martingail library.
EA-165.summary_zh: 该EA使用两个不同周期的TriX指标生成交易信号，将动量反转检测与马丁格尔仓位管理系统相结合。当TriX呈现V形反转形态且第二个TriX确认动量方向时开仓，亏损后通过内置马丁格尔库加倍仓位。
EA-165.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于TriX指标的三重平滑动量反转检测。入场条件：快速TriX出现V形底反转（t[0]>t[1]且t[1]<t[2]）且慢速TriX上升时做多；快速TriX出现倒V形顶反转（t[0]<t[1]且t[1]>t[2]）且慢速TriX下降时做空。出场条件依赖固定止损和止盈，止损500点止盈1500点，盈亏比3:1。仓位管理采用马丁格尔策略，通过Martingail库在亏损后加倍手数，DML参数控制初始手数大小，Ud参数控制加倍次数。资金管理方面，使用全局变量保存马丁格尔状态，确保EA重启后能恢复加仓进度。该策略仅在无持仓时开仓，每次只持有一个头寸。
EA-165.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on TriX indicator triple-smoothed momentum reversal detection. Entry conditions: go long when the fast TriX shows a V-bottom reversal (t[0]>t[1] and t[1]<t[2]) and the slow TriX is rising; go short when the fast TriX shows an inverted V-top reversal (t[0]<t[1] and t[1]>t[2]) and the slow TriX is falling. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit, with 500-point SL and 1500-point TP, yielding a 3:1 reward-to-risk ratio. Position sizing uses a martingale strategy via the Martingail library, doubling lot size after losses, where DML controls initial lot sizing and Ud controls the number of doubling steps. Money management persists the martingale state using global variables so the EA can resume its progression after restarts. The strategy only opens positions when no existing position is held, maintaining at most one position at a time.

EA-1654.name: Exp_F2a_AO
EA-1654.summary: This EA uses a multi-timeframe approach combining a higher-timeframe trend filter (daily candlestick direction) with the F2a_AO custom indicator signals on a lower timeframe (H12) to generate buy and sell entries. It opens long positions when the trend is bullish and the F2a_AO oscillator gives an up signal, and short positions when the trend is bearish and a down signal appears, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-1654.summary_zh: 该EA采用多周期策略，结合高周期趋势过滤（日线K线方向）和F2a_AO自定义指标在低周期（H12）上产生的买卖信号。趋势向上时配合指标上信号开多，趋势向下时配合指标下信号开空，并设有可配置的止损止盈。
EA-1654.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是多周期趋势跟踪，使用日线级别K线的收盘价与开盘价之差判断大趋势方向。F2a_AO指标是基于三重MA过滤（MA_Filtr=3, MA_Fast=13, MA_Slow=144）的自定义振荡器，当上信号缓冲区有值时产生买入信号，当下信号缓冲区有值时产生卖出信号。入场条件要求大周期趋势方向与振荡器信号方向一致——Trend>0时才允许开多，Trend<0时才允许开空。出场条件包括止损止盈的硬性设置，以及振荡器反向信号触发平仓，还通过回溯历史K线寻找最近的反向信号来补充平仓逻辑。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额、基于净值、基于亏损占比等，默认使用固定手数模式（LOT）。资金管理通过MM参数控制投入比例，默认0.1。
EA-1654.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a multi-timeframe trend-following system that uses the difference between the daily candle's close and open prices to determine the macro trend direction. The F2a_AO indicator is a custom oscillator based on triple MA filtering (MA_Filtr=3, MA_Fast=13, MA_Slow=144), generating buy signals when the upper signal buffer has a value and sell signals when the lower signal buffer has a value. Entry conditions require alignment between the macro trend and oscillator direction — longs are only opened when Trend>0 and shorts only when Trend<0. Exit conditions include hard stop-loss and take-profit levels, oscillator reversal signals triggering position closes, and a supplementary lookback mechanism that scans historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal for closing. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance-based, equity-based, loss-share-based, and free-margin-based, defaulting to fixed lot mode (LOT). Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 share of deposit.

EA-166.name: BolBands
EA-166.summary: This EA trades Bollinger Bands mean reversion signals confirmed by a DEMA trend filter. It buys when a bullish candle crosses above the lower Bollinger Band while DEMA is rising, and sells when a bearish candle crosses below the upper Bollinger Band while DEMA is falling. Positions are closed on opposite band crossing signals.
EA-166.summary_zh: 该EA基于布林带均值回归信号并结合DEMA趋势过滤进行交易。当看涨K线从下穿越下轨且DEMA上升时买入，当看跌K线从上穿越上轨且DEMA下降时卖出。持仓在反向穿越信号出现时平仓。
EA-166.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是布林带均值回归，利用价格触及布林带上下轨后回归中轨的统计特性。入场条件：买入需前一根K线收盘价高于下轨且开盘价低于下轨（即K线从下轨下方穿越至上方），同时DEMA连续三期上升确认上升趋势；卖出则相反，需K线从上轨上方穿越至下方且DEMA连续下降。出场条件：多头持仓在K线从上轨上方穿越至下方时平仓，空头持仓在K线从下轨下方穿越至上方时平仓。仓位管理方面，使用固定手数（Lot参数），无动态仓位调整机制。资金管理存在严重缺陷——止损和止盈均设为0，完全依赖信号平仓，无任何风险保护。DEMA使用日线周期而布林带使用30分钟周期，构成多周期确认，但周期差异较大可能导致信号不同步。
EA-166.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on Bollinger Bands mean reversion, exploiting the statistical tendency of prices to return to the middle band after touching the upper or lower bands. Entry conditions: a buy requires the previous bar's close above the lower band and open below it (bullish candle crossing from below the lower band), while DEMA must be rising over three consecutive periods confirming an uptrend; the sell condition is the mirror opposite with a bearish candle crossing below the upper band and DEMA declining. Exit conditions: long positions close when a bearish candle crosses below the upper band, and short positions close when a bullish candle crosses above the lower band. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (Lot parameter) with no dynamic sizing or risk-based adjustment. Money management has critical flaws—both stop loss and take profit are set to zero, relying entirely on signal-based exits with no risk protection whatsoever. The DEMA uses a daily timeframe while Bollinger Bands use M30, creating a multi-timeframe confirmation, though the large timeframe disparity may cause signal desynchronization.

EA-1676.name: Exp_MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud
EA-1676.summary: This EA trades based on the MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud custom indicator, which generates buy signals from its upper cloud buffer and sell signals from its lower cloud buffer. It opens and closes positions on new bar signals with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy also searches historical bars to determine the last trading direction for position closing when no immediate close signal is present.
EA-1676.summary_zh: 该EA基于MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud自定义指标进行交易，从指标云图上轨缓冲区生成买入信号，下轨缓冲区生成卖出信号。它在新K线出现时根据信号开仓和平仓，支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。当没有即时平仓信号时，策略还会搜索历史K线来确定最后的交易方向以获取平仓信号。
EA-1676.strategy_analysis: 策略基于MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud自定义指标的动量信号进行交易决策。入场条件：当指标第4缓冲区（上轨云图）在指定K线上出现非零非空值时触发买入信号，当第5缓冲区（下轨云图）出现非零非空值时触发卖出信号。出场条件：买入信号同时触发空头平仓，卖出信号同时触发多头平仓；若当前无直接平仓信号，则回溯历史K线寻找最近一次反向信号作为平仓依据。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金使用比例，支持多种保证金模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损比例、固定手数）。资金管理采用固定止损1000点和止盈2000点的简单点数方式，配合最大滑点限制。策略仅在H4等多周期时间框架上运行，以新K线出现为触发条件，避免逐tick重复交易。
EA-1676.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy trades based on momentum signals from the MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud custom indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when buffer 4 (upper cloud) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar; a sell signal is triggered when buffer 5 (lower cloud) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE. Exit conditions: a buy signal simultaneously triggers short position closure, and a sell signal triggers long position closure; if no direct close signal exists, the EA searches backward through historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal for closing. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which determines the share of financial resources, supporting multiple margin modes including free margin, balance, loss share, and fixed lot. Money management uses simple fixed stop loss at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points, combined with a maximum price deviation of 10 points. The strategy operates on higher timeframes like H4 and only executes trades on new bar appearances to avoid redundant per-tick trading.

EA-16994.name: Bollinger Bands (xoiper)
EA-16994.summary: This EA trades Bollinger Bands mean-reversion signals, selling when price breaks above the upper band and buying when it breaks below the lower band. It uses a fixed take-profit and stop-loss based on point distances, with an optional lot-sizing mechanism that scales position size proportionally to account balance. Order management is performed on each tick, closing positions when profit or loss thresholds are hit.
EA-16994.summary_zh: 该EA基于布林带均值回归信号交易，价格突破上轨时卖出，突破下轨时买入。采用固定的止盈止损点数距离，并提供基于账户余额的动态仓位调整选项。每个tick检查持仓盈亏，达到阈值时平仓。
EA-16994.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是典型的布林带均值回归：当价格偏离布林带上轨一定距离时做空，偏离下轨一定距离时做多，假设价格会回归均值。入场条件为收盘价高于上轨加额外偏移量时SELLme=true触发卖出，收盘价低于下轨减额外偏移量时BUYme=true触发买入。出场条件有两种：当持仓浮盈达到ExtProfitMade点数时止盈平仓，当浮亏达到ExtLossLimit点数时止损平仓，同时也设置了SL/TP挂单保护。仓位管理方面，支持固定手数和基于余额的动态手数两种模式，动态模式下手数随账户余额线性增减，上限500手。资金管理较为粗糙，仅基于余额比例调整手数，没有最大回撤控制或风险百分比计算。策略使用PRICE_OPEN计算布林带，周期仅4，属于非常短的参数设置，容易产生频繁信号和过度交易。
EA-16994.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is classic Bollinger Band mean reversion: it sells when price breaks above the upper band by a threshold distance and buys when price breaks below the lower band, assuming price will revert to the mean. Entry conditions trigger SELLme when close price exceeds upper band plus ExtBDistance points, and BUYme when close falls below lower band minus ExtBDistance points. Exit conditions are dual: positions are closed in-code when unrealized profit reaches ExtProfitMade points or loss reaches ExtLossLimit points, while SL/TP orders are also placed at order open for broker-side protection. Position sizing offers two modes: fixed lots or dynamic lots that scale linearly with account balance relative to starting balance, capped at 500 lots. Money management is rudimentary, relying solely on a balance-ratio lot calculation without drawdown limits or percentage-of-equity risk sizing. The Bollinger Band uses PRICE_OPEN with a very short period of 4, which is likely to generate excessive signals and lead to overtrading.

EA-17044.name: ExpPricePosition
EA-17044.summary: This Expert Advisor trades based on a multi-indicator confluence system combining PricePosition and StepUpDown indicators across multiple timeframes. It uses SMMA/SMA moving average crossovers and price position relative to signal lines to generate buy/sell signals, with dynamic lot sizing, trailing stops, and opposite-signal closing capabilities.
EA-17044.summary_zh: 该EA基于PricePosition和StepUpDown指标的多指标共振系统进行交易，结合多个时间周期的SMMA/SMA均线交叉和价格相对于信号线的位置来产生买卖信号，具备动态仓位、追踪止损和反向信号平仓功能。
EA-17044.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于PricePosition指标判断价格方向和StepUpDown指标判断趋势走向的双重确认机制。入场条件要求多个条件共振：PricePosition方向(1或-1)、StepUpDown趋势方向一致、当前K线为阳线(买入)或阴线(卖出)、价格回踩至快速SMMA均线附近、快速均线方向确认、以及多周期动量比较(pwr0>pwr1)。出场条件包括：追踪止损触发、反向信号平仓(CloseByOppositeSignal)、以及StepUpDown方向反转时盈利平仓。仓位管理支持固定手数和动态手数两种模式，动态模式根据账户余额和风险百分比计算手数，并按持仓数量均分。资金管理方面，止损基于风险百分比和tick价值计算，止盈为止损的TPvsSLRatio倍，默认3倍，同时设有38pip的最小止损距离保护。
EA-17044.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual-confirmation mechanism using the PricePosition indicator for price direction and the StepUpDown indicator for trend direction. Entry conditions require multiple confluences: PricePosition direction alignment (1 or -1), StepUpDown trend agreement, current candle being bullish (for buy) or bearish (for sell), price pulling back to the fast SMMA line, fast MA direction confirmation, and multi-timeframe momentum comparison (pwr0 > pwr1). Exit conditions include: trailing stop activation, closing on opposite signal (CloseByOppositeSignal), and profitable closing when StepUpDown direction reverses. Position sizing supports both fixed lot and dynamic lot modes, where the dynamic mode calculates lot size based on account balance and risk percentage, distributed across open positions. Money management calculates stop loss based on risk percentage and tick value, with take profit set as a multiple (TPvsSLRatio, default 3x) of the stop loss, and a minimum 38-pip stop loss distance as protection.

EA-1771.name: SimpleHedgePanel
EA-1771.summary: This is a hedging panel utility EA that provides a graphical interface for managing hedge positions. It delegates all logic to the CHedgePanel class and serves as a thin wrapper handling initialization, deinitialization, and chart events.
EA-1771.summary_zh: 这是一个对冲面板工具型EA，提供图形界面来管理对冲仓位。所有逻辑委托给CHedgePanel类，本身仅作为初始化、反初始化和图表事件的轻量封装。
EA-1771.strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个对冲管理面板工具，本身不自动产生交易信号或开仓，而是依赖用户通过面板界面手动或半自动操作。策略概念围绕对冲交易设计，允许用户同时持有多空仓位以降低方向性风险。入场条件和出场条件完全由用户通过面板交互决定，EA不包含自动入场或出场逻辑。仓位管理方面，用户通过InpBoxes参数设定盒子数量（默认3个），可能用于分组管理不同对冲组合。资金管理方面，该EA没有内置的资金管理规则，所有风险控制依赖于用户的手动判断和操作。整体而言，这是一个交互式工具而非自动化交易策略。
EA-1771.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a hedging management panel utility that does not automatically generate trading signals or open positions; instead, it relies on user interaction through the panel interface for manual or semi-automated operation. The strategy concept revolves around hedging, allowing users to hold both long and short positions simultaneously to reduce directional risk. Entry and exit conditions are entirely determined by the user through panel interaction, with the EA containing no automatic entry or exit logic. For position management, the user configures the number of boxes via the InpBoxes parameter (default 3), which likely groups different hedge combinations. Money management is absent from the EA itself, with all risk control depending on the user's manual judgment and operations. Overall, this is an interactive tool rather than an automated trading strategy.

EA-1772.name: RenkoLineBreakVsRSI_EA
EA-1772.summary: This EA trades based on the RenkoLineBreak indicator trend direction confirmed by RSI divergence from the 50 level. It places buy stop or sell stop pending orders when the RenkoLineBreak shows a sustained trend and RSI is sufficiently far from the midpoint. Positions are closed when the trend reverses or RSI crosses the opposite threshold.
EA-1772.summary_zh: 该EA基于RenkoLineBreak指标的趋势方向并结合RSI偏离50中线的程度进行交易。当RenkoLineBreak显示持续趋势且RSI远离中点时，放置买入止损或卖出止损挂单。当趋势反转或RSI穿越相反阈值时平仓。
EA-1772.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用RenkoLineBreak指标判断趋势方向，并结合RSI指标作为过滤条件。RenkoLineBreak指标通过自定义指标缓冲区2的值来判断趋势状态：正值表示上升趋势，负值表示下降趋势，趋势转换用TO_UP和TO_DOWN表示。入场条件为：当趋势为UP且RSI低于50减去垂直偏移量时开多单，当趋势为DOWN且RSI高于50加上垂直偏移量时开空单，这是一种趋势确认加动量回调的策略逻辑。出场条件为：当趋势转为TO_DOWN或RSI超过50加偏移时平多仓，当趋势转为TO_UP或RSI低于50减偏移时平空仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，通过挂单（Buy Stop/Sell Stop）入场，挂单价格基于前3根K线的高低点加上偏移量确定。止损设在前3根K线的极值处加减偏移量，止盈为固定点数。资金管理方面提供了固定手数和固定百分比两种模式枚举，但实际代码中仅使用了固定手数InpVolume，未实现MoneyFixedLot的调用。
EA-1772.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses the RenkoLineBreak custom indicator to determine trend direction, confirmed by RSI divergence from the 50 midpoint as a filter. RenkoLineBreak reads buffer index 2 values: positive indicates uptrend, negative indicates downtrend, with TO_UP/TO_DOWN representing trend transitions. Entry conditions are: open a buy stop when trend is UP and RSI is below 50 minus the vertical shift, or open a sell stop when trend is DOWN and RSI is above 50 plus the vertical shift — this is a trend-confirmation-with-momentum-pullback logic. Exit conditions are: close longs when trend transitions to TO_DOWN or RSI exceeds 50 plus the shift, and close shorts when trend transitions to TO_UP or RSI falls below 50 minus the shift. Position sizing uses a fixed lot volume specified by InpVolume, with pending stop orders placed at prices derived from the high/low of the previous 3 bars plus an indent offset. Stop loss is set at the extreme of the previous 3 bars plus/minus indent, and take profit is a fixed pip distance. Although the code declares an MM_MODE enum with FIXED_LOT and FIXED_PERCENT options and includes MoneyFixedLot.mqh, it never actually instantiates or uses the money management class, relying solely on the input volume parameter.

EA-1805.name: InverseReaction_EA (IREA)
EA-1805.summary: IREA (Inverse Reaction EA) trades the idea that unusual price impulses will be corrected by an inverse reaction. It uses a custom InverseReaction indicator to detect bars whose absolute change exceeds a confidence threshold, then opens a counter-direction trade expecting mean reversion. Entries are filtered by minimum and maximum bar size criteria, and each trade has a fixed stop loss and take profit.
EA-1805.summary_zh: IREA（逆向反应EA）基于异常价格冲击将被反向修正的理念进行交易。它使用自定义InverseReaction指标检测绝对变动超过置信阈值的价格棒，然后开反向单预期均值回归。入场受最小和最大棒尺寸条件过滤，每笔交易设有固定止损和止盈。
EA-1805.strategy_analysis: IREA的策略概念是均值回归：当价格出现异常大幅波动时，预期市场会产生反向修正。入场条件由自定义InverseReaction指标生成信号——当最近一根K线的绝对变化量（IRC）大于置信水平（IRL）且处于MinCriteria和MaxCriteria之间时，视为有效信号。具体逻辑要求第一根K线（sign[0]）必须满足条件，且两根K线不能同时满足（避免连续异常），同时IRC为负时做多、为正时做空，即逆势交易。出场条件依赖固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（250点），止盈远小于止损，说明策略依赖较高的胜率来弥补不利的盈亏比。仓位管理采用固定手数（TrVol=1.0），没有动态仓位调整或资金管理逻辑。资金管理方面完全缺失，没有回撤控制、没有最大持仓限制、没有资金百分比下单机制。
EA-1805.strategy_analysis_en: IREA's strategy concept is mean reversion: when price exhibits an unusually large impulse move, the market is expected to produce an inverse corrective reaction. Entry conditions are generated by a custom InverseReaction indicator — a signal is valid when the absolute bar change (IRC) exceeds the confidence level (IRL) and falls between MinCriteria and MaxCriteria. The specific logic requires the first bar (sign[0]) to satisfy the condition while both bars must not simultaneously satisfy it (avoiding consecutive anomalies), and a negative IRC triggers a buy while a positive IRC triggers a sell, trading against the impulse direction. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (250 points), with the TP being much smaller than the SL, meaning the strategy depends on a high win rate to compensate for the unfavorable risk-reward ratio. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (TrVol=1.0) with no dynamic position adjustment or money management logic. Money management is completely absent — there is no drawdown control, no maximum position limit, and no percentage-of-equity sizing mechanism.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于均值回归理念有理论依据
设有最小和最大K线尺寸双重过滤，避免在极端行情和微小波动中入场

EA-1812.name: MaSarADX
EA-1812.summary: This EA combines a 100-period Simple Moving Average, ADX directional indicators, and Parabolic SAR to identify and trade trend-following signals. It opens buy positions when price is above the MA, ADX+ is greater than ADX-, and price is above SAR; sell conditions are the mirror opposite. Positions are closed when price crosses back below/above the Parabolic SAR, and lot sizing is dynamically calculated based on account free margin and recent loss history.
EA-1812.summary_zh: 该EA结合100周期简单移动均线、ADX方向指标和抛物线SAR来识别趋势跟踪交易信号。当价格在MA上方、ADX+大于ADX-且价格在SAR上方时开多仓；做空条件相反。当价格反向穿越SAR时平仓，仓位根据账户可用保证金和近期亏损历史动态计算。
EA-1812.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于三重确认的趋势跟踪系统，结合移动均线判断趋势方向、ADX判断趋势强度与方向、SAR作为跟踪止损和确认信号。入场条件方面，做多要求收盘价高于SMA(100)、ADX+线大于ADX-线且收盘价高于SAR值，三个条件同时满足才开仓；做空为镜像对称条件。出场条件仅依赖SAR反转信号——多头持仓时收盘价跌破SAR则平仓，空头持仓时收盘价涨破SAR则平仓，没有设置固定止损止盈。仓位管理采用基于账户可用保证金和最大风险比例的动态手数计算，并通过递减因子根据连续亏损次数缩减仓位，同时对交易量进行最小最大值和步长规范化。资金管理方面虽然考虑了风险比例和亏损递减，但开仓时止损止盈均为0，完全依赖SAR作为隐含跟踪止损，存在一定风险敞口。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为简单，缺乏对震荡行情的过滤机制和更完善的风险控制。
EA-1812.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a triple-confirmation trend-following system combining a moving average for trend direction, ADX for trend strength and direction, and Parabolic SAR as a trailing stop and signal confirmation. For entry, a buy requires the close price above SMA(100), ADX+ greater than ADX-, and close above SAR—all three conditions must align simultaneously; sell conditions are the exact mirror. Exit relies solely on SAR reversal—long positions close when price falls below SAR, short positions close when price rises above SAR, with no fixed stop-loss or take-profit configured. Position sizing dynamically calculates lot size based on account free margin and a maximum risk percentage, then reduces size proportionally based on consecutive losing trades via a decrease factor, while normalizing volume to symbol step/min/max constraints. Although money management considers risk ratio and loss-based reduction, the PositionOpen call sets both stop-loss and take-profit to 0, relying entirely on SAR as an implicit trailing stop, which creates a meaningful risk exposure. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively simplistic, lacking a ranging-market filter and more robust risk controls.

EA-1814.name: MA.mq5
EA-1814.summary: A dual moving average crossover EA that uses a fast 3-period LWMA and a slow 57-period EMA to generate trend-following signals. It enters buy positions when both MAs are rising and price closes above the slow MA, and sell positions when both MAs are falling and price closes below the slow MA, with fixed SL/TP and 5-digit broker adjustment.
EA-1814.summary_zh: 双均线交叉趋势跟踪EA，使用3周期LWMA快线和57周期EMA慢线生成信号。当两均线上升且收盘价在慢线上方时做多，当两均线下降且收盘价在慢线下方时做空，固定止损止盈并支持5位报价经纪商调整。
EA-1814.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双均线趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是利用快线(3周期LWMA)与慢线(57周期EMA)的方向一致性和价格相对位置判断趋势。入场条件分为买入和卖出两组：买入需满足慢线连续3根K线上升、快线连续3根K线上升、收盘价高于前一根慢线值、以及慢线在快线之上；卖出条件为慢线连续3根K线下降、收盘价低于前一根慢线值、快线连续3根K线下降、慢线在快线之下。出场条件完全依赖固定止损止盈，止损和止盈均为100点（5位报价自动放大10倍）。仓位管理采用固定手数1.0手，无动态仓位调整或资金管理逻辑。该策略仅在新建时执行交易逻辑，使用了新K线检测机制避免重复开仓，同时仅允许单方向持仓。
EA-1814.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual moving average trend-following strategy, using the directional consistency of a fast 3-period LWMA and a slow 57-period EMA along with price relative position to identify trends. Buy entry requires four conditions: the slow MA rising for 3 consecutive bars, the fast MA rising for 3 consecutive bars, the close price above the previous slow MA value, and the slow MA above the fast MA. Sell entry mirrors this with declining conditions. Exit relies entirely on fixed stop loss and take profit of 100 points each (auto-adjusted by 10x for 5-digit brokers). Position sizing is a fixed 1.0 lot with no dynamic sizing or money management logic. The strategy only executes on new bars to avoid redundant signals, and it restricts to one position at a time per direction.

EA-186.name: Promart
EA-186.summary: This EA uses dual MACD crossover signals for entry and implements a Martingale position-sizing system that doubles the lot size after each loss. It opens buy or sell positions with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, reverting to signal-based entry only after a winning trade and doubling lots after a loss.
EA-186.summary_zh: 该EA使用双MACD交叉信号作为入场条件，并采用马丁格尔仓位管理系统，在每次亏损后加倍手数。它以固定止损和止盈开仓，仅在盈利后根据信号入场，亏损后则加倍手数反向开仓。
EA-186.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双MACD指标的交叉信号判断趋势转折点入场，同时结合马丁格尔资金管理。入场条件是MACD1的信号线发生转折（t[0]与t[1]、t[2]比较检测极值点）且MACD2方向确认（k[1]与k[0]比较）。出场条件依赖固定止损500点和止盈1500点。仓位管理采用马丁格尔法则，亏损后加倍手数（由Ud参数控制加倍次数），盈利后恢复初始手数。资金管理通过DML参数设定初始手数规模，并使用全局变量持久化马丁格尔状态。当没有历史订单时完全依赖信号入场，有历史订单时根据上一笔交易盈亏决定是否使用信号或直接反向开仓。
EA-186.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on dual MACD crossover signals to identify trend reversal points for entry, combined with a Martingale money management system. Entry conditions require MACD1 signal line to show a turning point (comparing t[0], t[1], t[2] to detect extrema) and MACD2 direction confirmation (comparing k[1] vs k[0]). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss of 500 points and take-profit of 1500 points. Position sizing follows the Martingale principle, doubling lot size after each loss (controlled by the Ud parameter for doubling count), and reverting to the initial lot size after a win. Money management uses the DML parameter to set the initial lot scale and persists the Martingale state via global variables. When there are no historical orders, entries are purely signal-based; when historical orders exist, the system checks the last trade's profit/loss to decide whether to use signals or immediately reverse with a doubled lot.

pros: 双MACD确认机制可以减少虚假信号入场
止盈大于止损（1500 vs 500），盈亏比为3:1，单笔盈利可覆盖多笔小亏损
使用全局变量持久化马丁格尔状态，EA重启后不会丢失仓位管理信息
OnTester函数提供了自定义回测优化指标，有助于参数优化
pros_en: Dual MACD confirmation reduces false signal entries
Take-profit exceeds stop-loss (1500 vs 500), yielding a 3:1 reward-to-risk ratio where one win can cover multiple small losses
Global variable persistence for Martingale state prevents loss of position management info on EA restart
Custom OnTester metric provides meaningful backtest optimization criteria
cons: 马丁格尔策略在连续亏损时手数指数增长，可能导致爆仓
亏损后不依赖信号直接反向开仓（poz=1或poz=-1的硬编码），缺乏市场方向判断
没有检查OrderSend返回结果，订单可能发送失败但程序无感知
