cons_en: Martingale position sizing causes exponential lot growth during consecutive losses, risking account blowup
After a loss, entries are hardcoded reversals (poz=1 or poz=-1) without signal confirmation, lacking market direction judgment
OrderSend return value is not checked, so failed orders go unnoticed
The tick_volume>1 filter is unreliable as tick volume data varies significantly across brokers
Only a single position is allowed (PositionSelect check), limiting strategy flexibility
improvements: 增加马丁格尔最大加倍次数限制和最大手数上限，防止无限加倍导致爆仓
亏损后也应检查MACD信号再决定方向，而非盲目反向开仓
增加OrderSend返回值检查和错误重试机制
添加新K线检查（isNewBar）替代tick_volume过滤，避免重复信号
improvements_en: Add a maximum Martingale doubling count limit and maximum lot cap to prevent unlimited doubling and account blowup
After a loss, still check MACD signals before deciding direction instead of blindly reversing
Add OrderSend return value checking and error retry logic
Replace tick_volume filter with a new bar check (isNewBar) to avoid duplicate signals

risk_points: 马丁格尔仓位管理在连续亏损时手数指数增长，极易导致账户爆仓
亏损后不依赖信号直接反向开仓，属于赌博式交易
没有最大手数或最大亏损限制的安全机制
risk_points_en: Martingale position sizing causes exponential lot growth during consecutive losses,极易导致账户爆仓
Post-loss entries are blind reversals without signal confirmation, essentially gambling
No safety mechanism such as maximum lot size or maximum drawdown limit exists

EA-1862.name: multicurrea
EA-1862.summary: This EA is a multi-currency trading system that analyzes multiple currency pairs simultaneously across different timeframes to generate trading signals. It uses a combination of trend and momentum indicators to identify entry opportunities across correlated or diverging currency pairs. The EA manages positions independently for each symbol it monitors.
EA-1862.summary_zh: 这是一个多货币交易系统，同时分析多个货币对在不同周期上的走势以生成交易信号。它结合趋势和动量指标来识别相关或背离货币对的入场机会，并为每个监控的品种独立管理仓位。
EA-1862.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用多货币多周期分析策略，通过同时监控多个相关货币对来捕捉跨市场的趋势机会。入场条件基于多个时间周期的趋势方向一致性确认，当短周期和长周期的信号方向一致时触发交易。出场条件包括固定的止盈止损以及趋势反转信号。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位计算方式。资金管理方面设有最大同时持仓数限制和单笔最大风险控制。策略核心思想是通过多货币的联动分析来提高信号的可靠性，避免单一货币对上的假突破。
EA-1862.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a multi-currency multi-timeframe analysis strategy, monitoring multiple correlated currency pairs simultaneously to capture cross-market trend opportunities. Entry conditions are based on trend direction consistency confirmation across multiple timeframes, triggering trades when short-term and long-term signals align. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as trend reversal signals. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or account-balance-proportional calculation methods. Money management includes limits on maximum simultaneous positions and per-trade maximum risk control. The core strategy idea is to improve signal reliability through multi-currency correlation analysis, avoiding false breakouts on single currency pairs.
pros: 多货币同时监控提高了信号的可靠性和交易机会的数量
多周期确认机制减少了假信号和假突破的风险
独立的仓位管理和风险控制适合多品种同时运行
止盈止损设置完整，包含移动止损功能
多货币关联分析有助于捕捉跨市场趋势
pros_en: Multi-currency simultaneous monitoring improves signal reliability and increases trading opportunities
Multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism reduces false signals and false breakout risks
Independent position management and risk control suitable for multi-symbol operation
Complete take-profit and stop-loss setup including trailing stop functionality
Multi-currency correlation analysis helps capture cross-market trends
cons: 多货币同时运行可能导致账户风险集中，特别是在高相关性货币对上
策略逻辑较为复杂，参数众多，优化困难且容易过拟合
缺乏动态仓位调整机制，固定手数在不同市场波动下可能不合适
未考虑点差和滑点对多货币交易的综合影响
多品种同时交易对VPS性能和连接稳定性要求较高
cons_en: Multi-currency simultaneous operation may concentrate account risk, especially on highly correlated pairs
Complex strategy logic with many parameters makes optimization difficult and prone to overfitting
Lacks dynamic position sizing mechanism; fixed lots may not suit varying market volatility
Does not account for comprehensive impact of spread and slippage on multi-currency trades
Multi-symbol simultaneous trading demands high VPS performance and connection stability
improvements: 增加货币对相关性过滤，避免在高相关品种上重复开仓
引入动态仓位管理基于ATR或账户风险比例来适应不同市场波动
improvements_en: Add currency pair correlation filtering to avoid duplicate positions on highly correlated symbols
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account risk percentage to adapt to different market volatilities

risk_points: 多货币同时持仓可能导致风险集中，尤其是在相关货币对上
固定止损在极端行情下可能因滑点而失效
参数过多可能导致过度优化和曲线拟合
risk_points_en: Multi-currency simultaneous positions may concentrate risk, especially on correlated pairs
Fixed stop-loss may fail due to slippage during extreme market conditions
Too many parameters may lead to over-optimization and curve fitting

EA-1896.name: Long/Short ExpertMACD
EA-1896.summary: This EA is a MACD-based long/short trading expert that extends the standard MQL5 CExpert framework with a custom CLongShortExpertModified class. It generates trade signals from MACD crossover logic and allows the user to restrict trading to long-only, short-only, or both directions. The EA uses no trailing stop and no money management module, relying solely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels for trade exits.
EA-1896.summary_zh: 该EA是基于MACD指标的多空交易专家，通过自定义的CLongShortExpertModified类扩展了标准MQL5 CExpert框架。它根据MACD交叉逻辑产生交易信号，并允许用户限制仅做多、仅做空或双向交易。该EA不使用移动止损和资金管理模块，仅依赖固定的止盈止损水平来退出交易。
EA-1896.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于MACD指标的动量信号，通过快线与慢线的交叉来判断市场方向并产生入场信号。入场条件由CSignalMACD模块决定，当MACD主线上穿信号线时做多，下穿时做空，同时受Inp_Allowed_Positions参数控制是否允许双向交易。出场条件采用固定止盈和止损值，分别由Inp_Signal_MACD_TakeProfit和Inp_Signal_MACD_StopLoss参数设定，没有使用移动止损（CTrailingNone）。仓位管理方面，由于使用CMoneyNone模块，EA不执行任何动态仓位调整或资金管理，手数需在EA属性中手动设置。资金管理完全缺失，这意味着交易者需要自行控制风险敞口，EA不会根据账户余额或风险比例自动计算仓位大小。整体来看，这是一个结构清晰但功能相对基础的MACD动量跟踪系统。
EA-1896.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is based on momentum signals from the MACD indicator, using crossover of the fast and slow MACD lines to determine market direction and generate entry signals. Entry conditions are determined by the CSignalMACD module: a long position is opened when the MACD main line crosses above the signal line, and a short position when it crosses below, with the Inp_Allowed_Positions parameter controlling whether long, short, or both directions are permitted. Exit conditions use fixed take-profit and stop-loss values set by Inp_Signal_MACD_TakeProfit and Inp_Signal_MACD_StopLoss respectively, with no trailing stop functionality (CTrailingNone). Position sizing is not dynamically managed since the EA uses CMoneyNone, meaning lot size must be manually configured in the EA properties. Money management is entirely absent, so the trader must manually control risk exposure as the EA does not auto-calculate position sizes based on account balance or risk ratios. Overall, this is a cleanly structured but relatively basic MACD momentum-following system.

parameters.description: 允许的持仓方向（仅做多/仅做空/双向）
parameters.description_en: 允许的持仓方向（仅做多/仅做空/双向）

pros: 基于标准MQL5 Expert框架开发，代码结构清晰规范，易于理解和维护
支持多空方向控制（Inp_Allowed_Positions），灵活性高，可适应不同市场观点
使用标准库模块（CSignalMACD等），模块化设计便于替换或扩展信号源、止损追踪和资金管理组件
pros_en: Built on the standard MQL5 CExpert framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to understand and maintain
Supports position direction control (Inp_Allowed_Positions), offering high flexibility to adapt to different market views
Uses standard library modules (CSignalMACD, etc.) with a modular design that makes it easy to replace or extend signal, trailing, and money management components
cons: 完全没有资金管理模块（CMoneyNone），不会根据账户风险自动调整仓位大小
没有移动止损机制（CTrailingNone），盈利交易无法通过追踪止损锁定浮动利润
止损点数（20）小于止盈点数（50）但比例偏低，MACD信号在震荡市中容易产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏点差过滤和新K线检测机制，在流动性差或点差大的环境下可能产生不利成交
cons_en: No money management module at all (CMoneyNone), so position sizes are never auto-adjusted based on account risk
No trailing stop mechanism (CTrailingNone), meaning profitable trades cannot lock in floating gains through trailing stops
Stop-loss (20) is smaller than take-profit (50) but the ratio is modest, and MACD signals can generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks spread filtering and new bar detection, which may result in unfavorable fills in low-liquidity or high-spread environments
improvements: 添加动态资金管理模块（如MoneyFixedMargin或MoneyFixedRisk），根据账户余额和风险比例自动计算仓位大小
添加移动止损模块（如TrailingFixedPips或TrailingMA），以在趋势行情中锁定更多利润
增加点差过滤和新K线检测逻辑，避免在高点差或同一K线内重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a dynamic money management module (e.g., MoneyFixedMargin or MoneyFixedRisk) to auto-calculate position sizes based on account balance and risk ratio
Add a trailing stop module (e.g., TrailingFixedPips or TrailingMA) to lock in more profit during trending moves
Add spread filtering and new bar detection logic to avoid opening positions during high spreads or repeated entries within the same bar

risk_points: 无资金管理模块，仓位大小完全依赖手动设置，存在过度杠杆风险
无移动止损，趋势反转时可能将盈利交易变为亏损
MACD在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号导致频繁止损
risk_points_en: No money management module means position sizing relies entirely on manual configuration, posing over-leveraging risk
No trailing stop means profitable trades can turn into losses when the trend reverses
MACD tends to generate false signals in ranging markets, leading to frequent stop-outs

EA-1921.name: Moving Averages
EA-1921.summary: This EA trades based on a simple moving average (SMA) crossover signal. It opens a buy position when the bar opens below and closes above the MA, and opens a sell when the bar opens above and closes below the MA. Position sizing is dynamically calculated based on account free margin and a maximum risk percentage, with lot reduction after consecutive losses.
EA-1921.summary_zh: 该EA基于简单移动平均线(SMA)交叉信号进行交易。当K线开盘价在MA下方且收盘价在MA上方时开多仓，反之开空仓。仓位根据账户可用保证金和最大风险比例动态计算，并在连续亏损后缩减仓位。
EA-1921.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于价格与简单移动平均线(SMA)的交叉关系来判断趋势方向并跟随趋势交易。入场条件为：当一根K线的开盘价低于MA且收盘价高于MA时产生买入信号，当开盘价高于MA且收盘价低于MA时产生卖出信号，这实际上是一种单K线穿越MA的突破入场方式。出场条件采用对称逻辑：持有多仓时若出现卖出信号则平仓，持有空仓时若出现买入信号则平仓，本质上是一个反转策略——平仓即反向开仓。仓位管理采用基于账户可用保证金的比例风险模型，根据MaximumRisk参数计算初始手数，并使用DecreaseFactor在连续亏损后递减仓位以控制回撤。资金管理方面，手数经过步长规范化处理并受最小/最大手数限制，但策略未设置止损和止盈，完全依赖反向信号平仓，风险较大。
EA-1921.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover relationship between price and a Simple Moving Average (SMA) to determine trend direction and follow the trend. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when a bar opens below the MA and closes above it, and a sell signal is generated when a bar opens above the MA and closes below it — effectively a single-bar MA breakout entry. Exit conditions use symmetric logic: a long position is closed when a sell signal appears, and a short position is closed when a buy signal appears, making this essentially a reversal strategy where closing and opening are coupled. Position sizing uses a percentage-risk model based on account free margin with the MaximumRisk parameter, and the DecreaseFactor reduces lot size after consecutive losses to control drawdown. Money management normalizes lot size to the broker's volume step and enforces min/max volume limits, but the strategy has no explicit stop-loss or take-profit, relying entirely on reverse signals for exits, which poses significant risk.

EA-193.name: Perceptron
EA-193.summary: A perceptron-based neural network EA that uses 5 technical indicators (MA crossover, RSI, CCI, MA slope, Awesome Oscillator) as inputs to 5 sub-neural-networks, which are then combined by a meta-network to produce buy/sell signals. The synaptic weights are adjusted online using a simple reward/punishment mechanism based on whether the last trade was profitable or not.
EA-193.summary_zh: 一个基于感知器神经网络的EA，使用5个技术指标（MA交叉、RSI、CCI、MA斜率、动量震荡器）作为5个子神经网络的输入，再由元网络组合产生买卖信号。突触权重根据上一笔交易是否盈利进行简单的奖惩在线调整。
EA-193.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用多层感知器架构，由5个子神经网络和一个元网络组成。每个子神经网络接收4个指标信号作为输入（留一法），通过加权求和产生中间输出，元网络再将5个子网络输出加权求和得到最终决策值。入场条件为：元网络输出大于0时买入，小于0时卖出，同时要求无持仓且与上一交易方向不同。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈，止损默认100点，止盈默认40点。仓位管理为固定0.1手，没有根据账户资金或风险动态调整。突触权重调整采用简单的奖惩机制：盈利时增强正确方向的权重，亏损时反向调整，权重被限制在SinMin到SinMax范围内。
EA-193.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a multi-layer perceptron architecture consisting of 5 sub-neural-networks and one meta-network. Each sub-network takes 4 out of 5 indicator signals as input using a leave-one-out scheme, producing intermediate outputs via weighted summation, and the meta-network combines all 5 sub-network outputs into a final decision value. Entry conditions: buy when meta-network output is positive, sell when negative, with the additional constraint that no position is open and the trade direction differs from the last trade. Exit relies on fixed stop loss (default 100 points) and take profit (default 40 points). Position sizing is fixed at 0.1 lots with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or risk. The synaptic weight adjustment uses a simple reward/punishment mechanism: profitable trades strengthen weights in the correct direction while losing trades reverse-adjust, with weights clamped between SinMin and SinMax bounds.

EA-1933.name: Exp_BlauCMI
EA-1933.summary: This EA trades based on the BlauCMI (Ergodic CMI) indicator, a momentum-based oscillator with triple smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator rises and sell positions when it falls, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1933.summary_zh: 该EA基于BlauCMI（ergodic CMI）指标进行交易，这是一个经过三重平滑的动量振荡器。当指标上升时开多仓，指标下降时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-1933.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于William Blau的CMI（累积动量指标），通过对动量值进行三重平滑来过滤噪音，生成更稳定的交易信号。入场条件为：当指标值逐根上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓，当指标值逐根下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），以及在反向信号出现时平仓（多仓在下降信号时平仓，空仓在上升信号时平仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持按存款比例或固定手数两种模式。资金管理使用MarginMode枚举来决定手数计算方式，MM默认0.1表示使用存款的10%。策略使用多周期设计，指标可在不同于图表的时间框架上运行，增强了灵活性。
EA-1933.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on William Blau's CMI (Cumulative Momentum Index), which applies triple smoothing to momentum values to filter noise and generate more stable trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator value rises consecutively (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell position opens when the indicator value falls consecutively (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), as well as closing positions on opposing signals (long positions close on a declining signal, short positions close on a rising signal). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either deposit percentage or fixed lot size modes. Money management uses the MarginMode enumeration to determine lot calculation, with MM defaulting to 0.1 representing 10% of the deposit. The strategy employs a multi-timeframe design where the indicator can run on a different timeframe than the chart, enhancing flexibility.

EA-1935.name: Exp_BlauCMomentum
EA-1935.summary: This EA trades based on the BlauCMomentum custom indicator, which applies triple-smoothed momentum analysis. It supports two entry modes: zero-line breakdown (crossover) and direction change (twist), with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit management.
EA-1935.summary_zh: 该EA基于BlauCMomentum自定义指标进行交易，该指标应用三重平滑动量分析。支持两种入场模式：零线突破和方向扭转，配有可配置的仓位管理和止损/止盈设置。
EA-1935.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用William Blau的C-Momentum指标作为核心信号源，该指标对动量进行三次平滑处理以消除噪声。入场策略提供两种模式：breakdown模式在指标值穿越零线时入场，Value[1]>0且Value[0]<=0时买入，Value[1]<0且Value[0]>=0时卖出；twist模式在指标方向改变时入场，Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>=Value[1]时买入，Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<=Value[1]时卖出。出场条件包括止损和止盈，以及在反向信号时平仓（如持仓多单时出现卖出信号则平多）。仓位管理支持固定手数或按存款比例计算手数，通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制。资金管理方面，MM参数为正值时表示存款比例，为负值时直接表示手数大小。该EA还包含新K线检查机制，避免在同一根K线上重复交易，并通过Recount标志在数据复制失败时重试。
EA-1935.strategy_analysis_en: The EA uses William Blau's C-Momentum indicator as its core signal source, which applies triple smoothing to momentum values to filter out market noise. The entry strategy offers two modes: breakdown mode triggers when the indicator crosses the zero line — buying when Value[1]>0 and Value[0]<=0, selling when Value[1]<0 and Value[0]>=0; twist mode triggers on direction change — buying when Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>=Value[1], selling when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<=Value[1]. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points, plus counter-signal exits where an opposing signal closes the current position. Position sizing supports either a fixed lot size or a percentage-of-deposit approach, controlled by the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration. Money management uses the MM parameter where positive values represent deposit share and negative values directly specify lot size. The EA implements a new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated trades on the same bar, and uses a Recount flag to retry when data copy operations fail.

EA-19503.name: LarryConnersRSI2
EA-19503.summary: This EA implements Larry Connors' RSI-2 strategy, a well-known mean reversion system. It enters long when RSI(2) is oversold below 6 while price is above the 200 SMA, and enters short when RSI(2) is overbought above 95 while price is below the 200 SMA. Exits are triggered when price crosses above or below the 5-period SMA, providing a quick mean-reversion exit.
EA-19503.summary_zh: 该EA实现了Larry Connors的RSI-2策略，这是一个著名的均值回归系统。当RSI(2)低于6且价格在200 SMA上方时做多，当RSI(2)高于95且价格在200 SMA下方时做空。当价格穿越5周期SMA时触发出场，提供快速的均值回归退出机制。
EA-19503.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于Larry Connors的RSI-2均值回归系统，核心理念是在大趋势方向上捕捉短期超卖/超买的回撤入场机会。入场条件：做多要求RSI(2)低于6（极度超卖）且收盘价位于200周期SMA上方（确认长期上升趋势）；做空要求RSI(2)高于95（极度超买）且收盘价位于200周期SMA下方（确认长期下降趋势）。出场条件：做多持仓时，当收盘价上穿5周期SMA即平仓；做空持仓时，当收盘价下穿5周期SMA即平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数，没有根据账户资金或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈选项，默认止损30点、止盈60点，但止盈逻辑与策略的均值回归本质存在冲突——策略原意是依赖SMA穿越出场而非固定止盈。此外，EA没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线内重复触发信号。
EA-19503.strategy_analysis_en: This strategy implements Larry Connors' RSI-2 mean reversion system, whose core concept is to capture short-term oversold/overbought pullback entries in the direction of the major trend. Entry conditions: long requires RSI(2) below 6 (extremely oversold) with close above the 200 SMA (confirming long-term uptrend); short requires RSI(2) above 95 (extremely overbought) with close below the 200 SMA (confirming long-term downtrend). Exit conditions: for long positions, close when the close price crosses above the 5-period SMA; for short positions, close when the close price crosses below the 5-period SMA. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management provides optional stop loss and take profit with defaults of 30 and 60 pips respectively, though the fixed take-profit logic conflicts with the strategy's mean-reversion nature—Connors' original design relies on SMA crossover exits rather than fixed targets. Additionally, the EA lacks a new-bar check mechanism, risking repeated signal triggers within the same candle.
pros: 策略基于Larry Connors的量化研究，有历史回测数据支撑，逻辑清晰可靠
使用200 SMA作为趋势过滤，有效避免逆势交易，提高胜率
出场逻辑基于价格穿越短周期SMA，符合均值回归策略的快速退出原则
提供了止损和止盈选项，有基本的风险控制框架
代码结构清晰，入场和出场规则分离，易于理解和修改
pros_en: Strategy is based on Larry Connors' quantitative research with historical backtesting support and clear logic
Uses 200 SMA as trend filter, effectively avoiding counter-trend trades and improving win rate
Exit logic based on price crossing the short SMA aligns with mean reversion's quick-exit principle
Provides stop loss and take profit options with a basic risk control framework
Clean code structure with separated entry and exit rules, easy to understand and modify
cons: 缺少新K线检查机制，同一根K线内每个tick都可能触发交易信号，导致重复开仓风险
固定手数没有动态仓位管理，无法根据账户规模或市场波动率调整风险敞口
止损/止盈与SMA穿越出场逻辑冲突——Connors原始策略不使用固定止盈，应依赖SMA穿越退出
做空入场时使用currentAsk作为卖出价格而非currentBid，存在逻辑错误
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大时入场可能导致不必要的滑点损失
cons_en: Missing new-bar check mechanism—every tick within the same candle can trigger trading signals, risking duplicate entries
Fixed lot sizing without dynamic position management, unable to adjust risk exposure based on account size or market volatility
Stop loss/take profit conflicts with SMA crossover exit logic—Connors' original strategy does not use fixed take-profit, relying on SMA crossover exits instead
Sell entry uses currentAsk as the sell price instead of currentBid, which is a logic error
No spread filter—entering during high-spread periods may cause unnecessary slippage losses
improvements: 添加新K线检查机制（IsNewBar函数），确保每根K线只执行一次信号判断，避免重复交易
修正做空入场价格错误，将currentAsk改为currentBid作为卖出开仓价格
实现动态仓位管理，基于账户权益百分比或ATR波动率调整手数，而非固定手数
移除或默认关闭固定止盈，让SMA穿越作为主要出场机制，更忠实于Connors原始策略
添加点差和交易时间过滤，避免在点差过大或流动性不足的时段交易
improvements_en: Add a new-bar check mechanism (IsNewBar function) to ensure signal evaluation occurs only once per candle, preventing duplicate trades
Fix the sell entry price error—change currentAsk to currentBid for sell position opening
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage or ATR volatility instead of fixed lots
Remove or disable fixed take-profit by default, letting SMA crossover serve as the primary exit mechanism to stay faithful to Connors' original strategy
Add spread and trading session filters to avoid trading during high-spread or low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查，可能同一K线内重复触发交易信号导致过度交易

risk_points_en: Missing new-bar check may cause repeated signal triggers within the same candle, leading to overtrading

EA-1954.name: Exp_BlauCSI
EA-1954.summary: This EA trades based on the BlauCSI (Blau CSI - Cumulative Swings Index) custom indicator, which applies triple-smoothed momentum calculations. It supports two entry modes: breakdown (zero-line crossover) and twist (direction change), and manages both long and short positions with configurable stop loss and take profit.
EA-1954.summary_zh: 该EA基于BlauCSI自定义指标进行交易，该指标采用三重平滑动量计算。它支持两种入场模式：突破（零线穿越）和转向（方向改变），并通过可配置的止损和止盈管理多头和空头仓位。
EA-1954.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用William Blau的CSI（累积摆动指标）作为核心交易信号源，CSI是对两组价格常数之间的动量进行三重平滑处理后得到的指标。策略概念基于动量方向变化或零线穿越来捕捉趋势的起始和反转。入场条件有两种模式：breakdown模式中，当CSI值从负变正时开多仓，从正变负时开空仓；twist模式中，当CSI从下降转为上升时开多仓，从上升转为下降时开空仓。出场条件包括反向信号触发平仓以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理方面，支持多种资金管理模式，包括基于可用保证金、账户余额、亏损比例或固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制每笔交易占用的资金比例，MMMode参数决定具体的计算方式。EA还使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线周期只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，同时通过SignalBar参数允许使用当前K线或已完成K线的信号。
EA-1954.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses William Blau's CSI (Cumulative Swings Index) as its core trading signal source, which is derived from triple-smoothed momentum calculated between two price constants. The strategy concept is based on capturing trend initiation and reversal through momentum direction changes or zero-line crossovers. Entry conditions operate in two modes: in breakdown mode, a long position opens when CSI crosses above zero and a short position opens when it crosses below zero; in twist mode, a long opens when CSI shifts from declining to rising and a short opens when it shifts from rising to declining. Exit conditions include closing on opposing signals and using fixed stop loss and take profit levels specified in points. Position sizing supports multiple money management modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-fraction-based, and fixed lot sizing. The EA employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation happens only once per bar cycle, preventing duplicate trades, while the SignalBar parameter allows using either the current bar or a confirmed bar for signal generation.

EA-197.name: YTG ADX v1
EA-197.summary: This EA uses the ADX Wilder indicator to generate trading signals. It opens a buy position when the +DI line crosses above a configurable level and a sell position when the -DI line crosses above its level. Only one position per symbol is allowed at a time, controlled by magic number filtering.
EA-197.summary_zh: 该EA使用ADX Wilder指标生成交易信号。当+DI线从下方突破配置的水平时开多仓，当-DI线从下方突破配置的水平时开空仓。每个品种同一时间只允许持有一个仓位，通过魔术编号进行过滤。
EA-197.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于ADX Wilder指标的DI线穿越水平线的信号。入场条件为：当+DI线在指定shift根K线前从下方突破level_p水平时，产生买入信号(+1)；当-DI线在指定shift根K线前从下方突破level_m水平时，产生卖出信号(-1)。出场条件仅依赖固定止损和止盈，分别为SL和TP点数，没有移动止损或部分平仓机制。仓位管理采用固定手数(Lots参数)，不考虑账户余额或风险比例的动态调整。资金管理方面，EA通过ExtPos函数检查是否已有同魔术编号的持仓，避免重复开仓，但只允许单方向持仓，即有仓时不允许反向开仓。整体策略逻辑简单直接，属于典型的趋势跟踪型EA，依赖DI线突破水平来判断趋势启动。
EA-197.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the ADX Wilder indicator's DI lines crossing above configurable threshold levels. Entry conditions: a buy signal (+1) is generated when the +DI line crosses above the level_p threshold from below at the specified shift bars ago; a sell signal (-1) is generated when the -DI line crosses above the level_m threshold from below. Exit conditions rely solely on fixed stop loss and take profit values (SL and TP in points), with no trailing stop or partial closing mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (Lots parameter) without any dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage. In terms of money management, the EA checks for existing positions with the same magic number via the ExtPos function to prevent duplicate entries, but only allows one position at a time per symbol regardless of direction. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, representing a typical trend-following EA that relies on DI line breakouts above threshold levels to identify trend initiation.

EA-1987.name: Exp_BlauErgodicMDI
EA-1987.summary: This EA trades based on William Blau's Ergodic MDI (Mean Deviation Indicator) using three distinct signal modes: zero-line breakout, histogram direction change, and signal cloud color crossover. It opens and closes positions systematically on the indicator's momentum signals with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1987.summary_zh: 该EA基于William Blau的Ergodic MDI（均值偏差指标）进行交易，提供三种信号模式：零线突破、柱状图方向变化和信号云颜色交叉。它根据指标的动量信号系统地开仓和平仓，并配有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-1987.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于William Blau的Ergodic MDI动量指标，该指标通过多级平滑处理价格偏差来识别趋势动量。入场条件有三种模式可选：零线突破模式（柱状图穿越零线时入场）、方向变化模式（柱状图方向反转时入场）和信号云变色模式（信号线上下轨交叉时入场）。出场条件由反向信号触发平仓，同时配合固定的止损和止盈参数。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，可选择固定手数或按存款比例计算手数。资金管理支持LOT和MARGIN两种模式，由MMMode枚举决定。信号仅在出现新K线时计算，避免逐tick重复触发，SignalBar参数允许选择当前K线或已确认K线作为信号源。
EA-1987.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on William Blau's Ergodic MDI momentum indicator, which identifies trend momentum through multi-stage smoothing of price deviation. Entry conditions offer three selectable modes: breakdown mode (histogram crossing the zero line), twist mode (histogram direction reversal), and cloudtwist mode (signal cloud upper/lower band crossover). Exit conditions are triggered by opposite signals closing existing positions, supplemented by fixed stop loss and take profit parameters. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either fixed lot size or deposit share-based calculation. Money management supports LOT and MARGIN modes as determined by the MMMode enumeration. Signals are calculated only on new bar formation to avoid per-tick repeated triggers, and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting between the current or confirmed bar as the signal source.

EA-200.name: ch2010structure
EA-200.summary: A multi-currency, multi-timeframe EA that trades five currency pairs (USDCHF, GBPUSD, AUDUSD, USDJPY, EURGBP) using a class-based architecture. It executes day trades on new daily bars and intraday trades on new 30-minute bars, with built-in order validation and volume capping logic.
EA-200.summary_zh: 这是一个多货币、多周期EA，使用类架构交易五个货币对（USDCHF、GBPUSD、AUDUSD、USDJPY、EURGBP）。在新日线形成时执行日内交易，在新30分钟线形成时执行日内短线交易，并内置订单验证和成交量限制逻辑。
EA-200.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用多周期策略，在日线上进行日间交易决策，在M30上进行日内短线交易决策。策略核心封装在CExp类中，通过getTP()获取止盈、getVol()获取交易量、getOrderType()获取订单类型、getDB()获取某个基准值来决定入场条件。出场条件通过getTP()返回的止盈价格实现。仓位管理方面，DebugOrderSend函数实现了严格的仓位控制：单一方向总持仓量不超过15手，单笔最大5手，最小0.1手，且限制挂单总数为12个。资金管理通过检查SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN和SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX确保交易量合规。然而，代码中未见到明确的止损逻辑，这是一个重大风险隐患。IsNewBar函数确保每个周期只在第一个tick执行交易逻辑，避免了重复开仓的问题。
EA-200.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a multi-timeframe strategy, making day trading decisions on new daily bars and intraday trading decisions on new M30 bars. The strategy core is encapsulated in the CExp class, which determines entry conditions through getTP() for take-profit, getVol() for trade volume, getOrderType() for order type, and getDB() for a baseline value. Exit conditions are realized via the take-profit price returned by getTP(). Position sizing is managed by the DebugOrderSend function with strict controls: total directional exposure capped at 15 lots, single trade maximum of 5 lots, minimum of 0.1 lot, and pending orders limited to 12 total. Money management ensures volume compliance by checking SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN and SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX. However, no explicit stop-loss logic is visible in the code, which represents a significant risk. The IsNewBar function ensures trading logic executes only on the first tick of each new bar, preventing duplicate entries.

EA-2009.name: Exp_BlauTStochI
EA-2009.summary: This EA trades based on the BlauTStochI (Blau Thermal Stochastic Indicator), a triple-smoothed momentum oscillator. It enters positions when the indicator either crosses zero (breakdown mode) or changes direction (twist mode), and manages trades with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-2009.summary_zh: 该EA基于BlauTStochI（Blau热随机指标）进行交易，该指标是一个三重平滑的动量振荡器。当指标穿过零轴（突破模式）或改变方向（扭转模式）时开仓，并使用固定的止损和止盈管理交易。
EA-2009.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用BlauTStochI动量振荡器生成交易信号。BlauTStochI指标对价格动量进行三次平滑处理（分别使用XLength1、XLength2、XLength3三个周期），消除了短期噪音并捕捉中期动量趋势。入场条件分为两种模式：突破模式（breakdown）下，当指标从负转正时做多，从正转负时做空；扭转模式（twist）下，当指标方向从下转上时做多，从上转下时做空。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，同时也允许通过反向信号平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose权限控制）。仓位管理支持两种模式：按存款比例（MM参数为正）或固定手数（MM参数为负）。资金管理通过MMMode枚举选择LOT或其他保证金模式。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，并设置了最大价格偏差（Deviation）以控制滑点风险。
EA-2009.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA generates trading signals using the BlauTStochI momentum oscillator, which applies triple smoothing (with periods XLength1, XLength2, XLength3) to price momentum, filtering short-term noise and capturing medium-term momentum trends. Entry conditions operate in two modes: breakdown mode triggers a buy when the indicator crosses above zero and a sell when it crosses below zero; twist mode triggers a buy when the indicator direction turns upward and a sell when it turns downward. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points, while also permitting position closure via reverse signals controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose permission flags. Position sizing supports two approaches: deposit share allocation (positive MM parameter) or fixed lot size (negative MM parameter). Money management mode is selected via the MMMode enumeration, choosing between LOT and other margin calculation methods. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing redundant trades, and implements a maximum price deviation parameter (Deviation_) to control slippage risk.

risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit not adjusted for volatility, risking insufficient stops or excessive targets during volatile markets

EA-2014.name: Exp_BlauSMStochastic
EA-2014.summary: This EA trades based on the BlauSMStochastic custom indicator, which is a smoothed stochastic momentum indicator by William Blau. It supports three trading modes: zero-line breakdown, histogram twist, and cloud twist of the indicator buffers, opening buy/sell positions and closing opposite ones accordingly.
EA-2014.summary_zh: 该EA基于BlauSMStochastic自定义指标进行交易，这是William Blau的平滑随机动量指标。支持三种交易模式：零线突破、直方图扭转折转和指标云图扭转折转，据此开仓买入/卖出并平掉反向仓位。
EA-2014.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Blau的平滑随机动量指标(BlauSMStochastic)，该指标对传统随机指标进行多重平滑处理以减少噪音。入场条件有三种模式：breakdown模式在直方图穿越零线时开仓，twist模式在直方图方向扭转折转时开仓，cloudtwist模式在上下云线交叉时开仓。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit。仓位管理通过MM参数控制仓位大小，支持LOT和MARGIN两种模式。资金管理采用固定比例或固定手数方式，但缺少动态调整和加仓逻辑。整体策略逻辑清晰，但依赖单一指标且缺乏过滤机制。
EA-2014.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on Blau's Smoothed Stochastic Momentum indicator (BlauSMStochastic), which applies multiple smoothing passes to the traditional stochastic to reduce noise. Entry conditions come in three modes: breakdown mode opens positions when the histogram crosses the zero line, twist mode enters on histogram direction reversal, and cloudtwist mode enters when the upper and lower cloud lines cross. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals, with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels applied. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting both LOT and MARGIN modes for lot calculation. Money management uses a fixed ratio or fixed lot approach but lacks dynamic adjustment or pyramiding logic. The overall strategy logic is clear but relies on a single indicator with no additional filtering mechanism.
pros: 三种交易模式提供灵活性，适应不同市场状态
使用多重平滑的随机动量指标，有效减少虚假信号
具备独立的买入/卖出开平仓开关，可精细控制交易方向
设置了固定止损止盈，有基本的风险控制框架
新K线检测机制避免同一K线重复交易
pros_en: Three trading modes provide flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Multi-smoothed stochastic momentum indicator effectively reduces false signals
Independent buy/sell open/close switches allow fine-grained control over trading direction
Fixed stop loss and take profit provide a basic risk control framework
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading on the same bar
cons: 完全依赖单一指标，缺乏多维度确认和过滤机制
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，可能在多数品种上不合理
没有点差过滤，在点差较大时仍会开仓
缺少移动止损或追踪止盈机制，无法锁定浮动利润
未检测是否已有同向持仓，可能重复开仓
cons_en: Relies entirely on a single indicator without multi-dimensional confirmation or filtering
Default StopLoss of 1000 and TakeProfit of 2000 points are excessively large for most instruments
No spread filter — trades can open even when spread is wide
Lacks trailing stop or trailing take-profit mechanism to lock in floating profits
Does not check for existing same-direction positions, potentially opening duplicate trades
improvements: 增加多指标确认过滤，如加入趋势方向或波动率过滤条件
添加点差过滤和持仓检查，避免高成本重复开仓
引入动态止损止盈或追踪止损机制，提高盈利保护能力
improvements_en: Add multi-indicator confirmation filters such as trend direction or volatility conditions
Implement spread filtering and position checking to avoid high-cost duplicate entries
Introduce dynamic stop loss/take profit or trailing stop mechanisms to better protect profits

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查可能导致重复开仓，增加风险敞口
默认止损止盈点数过大，若未根据品种调整可能造成巨额亏损或错过合理出场
无点差过滤在高点差环境下可能导致不必要的亏损交易
risk_points_en: Lack of position check may cause duplicate entries, increasing risk exposure
Default SL/TP values are very large and may cause significant losses if not adjusted per instrument
No spread filter can lead to unnecessary losing trades in high-spread environments

EA-202.name: 2MA_RSI
EA-202.summary: This EA trades based on a dual EMA crossover filtered by RSI overbought/oversold levels, and employs a Martingale position sizing system that doubles lot size after losses. It opens buy orders when the fast EMA crosses above the slow EMA with RSI below the oversold threshold, and sell orders on the reverse crossover with RSI above the overbought threshold. Positions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and the Martingale lot multiplier resets via global variables across restarts.
EA-202.summary_zh: 该EA基于双EMA交叉并过滤RSI超买超卖水平进行交易，同时采用马丁格尔仓位管理系统在亏损后加倍手数。当快速EMA上穿慢速EMA且RSI低于超卖阈值时买入，反向交叉且RSI高于超买阈值时卖出。每笔交易设有固定止损止盈，马丁格尔手数通过全局变量在重启后保持状态。
EA-202.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双均线交叉与RSI过滤的组合：快速EMA与慢速EMA的金叉死叉作为主信号，RSI超买超卖作为过滤条件，避免在极端区域追单。入场条件为：买入信号需快速EMA上穿慢速EMA且RSI低于超卖线（默认30），卖出信号需快速EMA下穿慢速EMA且RSI高于超买线（默认70）。出场条件依赖固定的止损（500点）和止盈（1500点），止盈是止损的3倍，追求高盈亏比。仓位管理采用马丁格尔系统，通过Martingail类管理手数，亏损后加倍手数（Ud参数控制加倍次数），初始手数由DML参数决定（1000为单位）。资金管理方面，使用全局变量保存马丁格尔状态，确保EA重启后能恢复上次的加仓进度，但没有最大回撤保护或账户余额比例仓位控制。
EA-202.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept combines a dual EMA crossover with RSI filtering: the fast and slow EMA golden/death cross serves as the primary signal, while RSI overbought/oversold levels act as filters to prevent chasing entries in extreme zones. Entry conditions require the fast EMA crossing above the slow EMA with RSI below the oversold level (default 30) for buys, and the reverse crossover with RSI above the overbought level (default 70) for sells. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss (500 points) and take-profit (1500 points), achieving a 3:1 reward-to-risk ratio. Position sizing uses a Martingale system via the Martingail class, doubling lot size after losses with the Ud parameter controlling the number of doubling steps, and DML (default 1000) defining the base lot unit. Money management persists the Martingale state through global variables so the EA can resume its progression after restarts, but there is no maximum drawdown protection or account equity-proportional sizing.

止盈是止损的3倍（1500:500），追求高盈亏比，符合趋势跟踪理念

pros_en: Dual EMA crossover with RSI filter avoids entering at trend exhaustion, providing reasonable entry logic
3:1 reward-to-risk ratio (1500:500) aligns with trend-following principles for high reward trades
Global variables persist Martingale state across EA restarts, improving robustness of position sizing
Custom OnTester metric (profit-loss ratio divided by max consecutive loss) enables better strategy optimization
cons: 马丁格尔仓位管理极其危险，连续亏损后手数指数级增长，可能导致账户爆仓
没有新K线检查，仅用tick_volume>1过滤，在非严格意义上会重复触发信号

cons_en: Martingale position sizing is extremely dangerous — consecutive losses cause exponential lot growth that can blow the account
No new bar check; only tick_volume>1 filtering, which is unreliable for preventing repeated signal triggers
No spread filter, trading session filter, or insufficient margin check, creating risks in live trading
Fixed pip stop-loss and take-profit instead of ATR-adaptive levels perform inconsistently across volatility regimes
Only one position allowed at a time (PositionSelect), limiting strategy flexibility
improvements: 移除马丁格尔仓位管理，改为基于账户风险比例的固定分数仓位管理，每笔交易风险不超过账户2%
添加新K线检测（比较当前bar时间与上次交易时间），避免同一根K线重复开仓
添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差或低流动性时段交易
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，适应不同市场波动率
improvements_en: Remove Martingale sizing and replace with fixed-fractional risk management, risking no more than 2% of account per trade
Add new bar detection (compare current bar time vs last trade time) to prevent multiple entries on the same bar
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
Change stop-loss and take-profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation for better adaptation to varying volatility

risk_points: 马丁格尔系统在连续亏损时手数指数增长，可能迅速耗尽账户资金
没有最大亏损限制或账户净值保护机制
tick_volume过滤不可靠，可能在同一K线多次开仓
无点差检查，高点差时段可能导致滑点过大
risk_points_en: Martingale system causes exponential lot growth during consecutive losses, potentially rapidly depleting account funds
No maximum loss limit or account equity protection mechanism exists
tick_volume filtering is unreliable and may allow multiple entries on the same bar
No spread check — high-spread periods can cause excessive slippage

EA-2026.name: CoensioTrader1V06
EA-2026.summary: This EA trades Bollinger Band mean-reversion signals confirmed by DEMA trend direction across up to 6 currency pairs simultaneously. It enters buy when price pierces below the lower Bollinger Band and reverses upward in an uptrend, and sells when price pierces above the upper band and reverses downward in a downtrend. It includes equity take-profit, trailing stop-loss, optimization data mining, and a remote server verification system.
EA-2026.summary_zh: 该EA基于布林带均值回归信号并结合DEMA趋势方向确认，可同时交易多达6个货币对。在上升趋势中价格刺破布林带下轨后反转向上时买入，在下降趋势中价格刺破布林带上轨后反转向下时卖出。包含权益止盈、移动止损、优化数据挖掘及远程服务器验证功能。
EA-2026.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于布林带的均值回归交易，当价格触及布林带上下轨后回归均值时入场，同时利用DEMA（双指数移动平均线）判断大周期趋势方向作为过滤条件。入场条件为：买入信号需满足前一根K线开盘价低于下轨且收盘价高于下轨（穿回带内）、前一根低点高于再前一根低点（更高低点）、更前一根低点低于再前一根低点（更低低点，即双重底形态），且DEMA呈上升趋势；卖出信号为对称逻辑。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、权益止盈（当权益超过平衡的指定倍数时平掉所有仓位）、移动止损以及信号反向平仓。仓位管理支持三种模式：按风险百分比计算手数、固定手数、按权益与除数比例计算手数。资金管理方面，风险可控但存在不足，如未设置最小止损距离、无点差过滤、且依赖远程服务器验证的代码已过时。
EA-2026.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is Bollinger Band mean reversion, entering when price pierces outside the bands and reverses back, with DEMA trend direction on a higher timeframe serving as a trend filter. Buy entry requires the previous bar to open below the lower band and close above it (piercing back inside), a higher low on the previous bar versus the one before, and a lower low two bars back (double bottom pattern), all confirmed by an ascending DEMA; sell signals follow the symmetrical logic. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss in pips, an equity take-profit that closes all positions when equity exceeds a multiple of balance, a trailing stop-loss step mechanism, and optional signal-based position closing. Position sizing supports three modes: risk-percentage-based lot calculation, fixed lot size, or equity-divided lot sizing. Money management has gaps including no minimum stop-loss distance, no spread filter, no maximum position limit per symbol, and the remote server verification code is obsolete and potentially insecure.

EA-2035.name: Exp_BlauTSStochastic
EA-2035.summary: This EA trades based on the Blau Triple Smoothed Stochastic indicator, supporting three entry modes: zero-line breakout, histogram direction reversal, and signal cloud color change. It uses multi-layer smoothing (up to four averaging passes) to generate trading signals and applies configurable money management with stop loss and take profit.
EA-2035.summary_zh: 该EA基于Blau三重平滑随机指标进行交易，支持三种入场模式：零线突破、柱状图方向反转和信号云颜色变化。它使用多层平滑（最多四次平均）生成交易信号，并应用可配置的资金管理和止损止盈。
EA-2035.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Blau三重平滑随机指标（BlauTSStochastic），该指标通过对价格进行多级平滑处理来消除噪声并提取动量信号。入场条件提供三种模式：breakdown模式为柱状图突破零线时入场，twist模式为柱状图方向改变时入场，cloudtwist模式为信号线上穿或下穿信号云时入场。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，同时支持反向信号平仓（如多头信号出现时平空头仓位）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数或按存款比例计算手数（由MMMode决定）。资金管理方面，MM参数为正值时按存款比例下单，为负值时直接作为手数使用，但缺乏最大仓位限制和回撤控制机制。该策略属于典型的动量跟踪系统，多层平滑旨在减少假信号，但也可能导致信号滞后。
EA-2035.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on the Blau Triple Smoothed Stochastic indicator, which applies multiple layers of smoothing to price data to filter noise and extract momentum signals. Entry conditions are provided in three modes: breakdown mode enters when the histogram crosses the zero line, twist mode enters when the histogram direction reverses, and cloudtwist mode enters when the signal line crosses above or below the signal cloud. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit in points, with additional exits via opposing signals (e.g., closing shorts when a long signal appears). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either fixed lot size or deposit-proportional sizing as determined by the MMMode enumeration. Money management allows MM as a deposit share when positive or as a direct lot size when negative, but lacks maximum position limits or drawdown controls. The multi-layer smoothing (four sequential averaging passes) aims to reduce false signals but inherently introduces signal lag, making it more suitable for higher timeframes where trend persistence is stronger.

EA-2056.name: Exp_BlauErgodic
EA-2056.summary: This EA trades based on the Blau Ergodic oscillator indicator, which is a smoothed momentum-based indicator. It supports three entry modes: zero-line breakout, histogram direction change, and signal cloud color change. Positions are opened and closed systematically based on the selected algorithm mode with configurable lot sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-2056.summary_zh: 该EA基于Blau Ergodic振荡指标进行交易，该指标是一种平滑的动量类指标。它支持三种入场模式：零线突破、柱状图方向变化和信号云颜色变化。根据所选算法模式系统性地开仓和平仓，支持可配置的手数大小和止损/止盈水平。
EA-2056.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Blau Ergodic指标，这是一种经过多重平滑处理的动量振荡器。指标通过四层平滑（XLength1-XLength4）对价格动量进行处理，再生成信号线，形成柱状图和信号云。EA提供三种入场模式：breakdown模式在柱状图穿越零线时入场，twist模式在柱状图方向发生变化时入场，cloudtwist模式在信号云颜色（上下线交叉）发生变化时入场。出场条件包括止损和止盈（以点数设置），以及反向信号触发平仓（需开启相应权限）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持按存款比例或固定手数两种方式，由MMMode参数决定。资金管理方面，EA使用GlobalVariableDel_函数在去初始化时清理全局变量，并利用IsNewBar机制避免同一K线内重复交易。策略整体属于动量跟踪类型，在趋势启动时跟随动量方向入场。
EA-2056.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Blau Ergodic indicator, which is a momentum oscillator processed through multiple layers of smoothing. The indicator applies four smoothing stages (XLength1-XLength4) to price momentum, then generates a signal line to form a histogram and signal cloud. The EA offers three entry modes: breakdown mode enters when the histogram crosses the zero line, twist mode enters when the histogram direction changes, and cloudtwist mode enters when the signal cloud color changes (upper/lower line crossover). Exit conditions include stop-loss and take-profit set in points, as well as reverse signal-triggered position closing (with corresponding permissions enabled). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either deposit share percentage or fixed lot size as determined by the MMMode parameter. For money management, the EA cleans up global variables on deinitialization using GlobalVariableDel_ and employs the IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar. The overall strategy is a momentum-following type, entering in the direction of momentum when a trend is initiating.

EA-209.name: scOnTickMarketWatch
EA-209.summary: This is a script (not an EA) that monitors all symbols in the Market Watch window and fires custom chart events whenever a new tick arrives on any symbol. It works in conjunction with a companion EA (exOnTickMarketWatch) that receives and processes those custom events to print tick information.
EA-209.summary_zh: 这是一个脚本而非EA，它监控市场观察窗口中所有交易品种，当任何品种出现新报价时触发自定义图表事件。它与配套EA（exOnTickMarketWatch）配合使用，后者接收并处理这些自定义事件以打印报价信息。
EA-209.strategy_analysis: 此脚本没有交易策略，它是一个市场监控工具。核心概念是通过轮询方式检测市场观察窗口中所有品种的新报价。具体实现是在while循环中每隔500毫秒检查一次TimeCurrent()是否更新，若更新则遍历所有市场观察品种，比较每个品种的SYMBOL_TIME与当前报价时间，如果品种时间大于等于当前报价时间，则通过EventChartCustom发送自定义事件，事件参数包含品种索引、点差和买入价。没有入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理，因为它不执行任何交易操作。该脚本利用_StopFlag检测用户是否终止运行，使用Sleep(500)控制轮询频率以降低CPU占用。配套EA通过OnChartEvent回调接收事件并打印品种名称、列表索引、买入价和点差信息。
EA-209.strategy_analysis_en: This script has no trading strategy; it is a market monitoring utility. The core concept is to detect new ticks across all symbols in the Market Watch window through a polling mechanism. Specifically, it runs a while loop checking TimeCurrent() every 500 milliseconds, and when a new server time is detected, it iterates through all Market Watch symbols, comparing each symbol's SYMBOL_TIME against the current tick time. If a symbol's time is greater than or equal to the current tick time, it fires a custom chart event via EventChartCustom, passing the symbol index, spread, and bid price as event parameters. There are no entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management because it does not execute any trades. The script uses _StopFlag to detect user termination and Sleep(500) to control the polling frequency and reduce CPU usage. The companion EA receives these events through the OnChartEvent callback and prints the symbol name, list index, bid price, and spread information.

EA-214.name: 20_200_pips_MQL5_v1
EA-214.summary: This EA trades EUR/USD once per day at a specific hour (default 18:00) by comparing the open prices of two H1 bars separated by t1 and t2 offsets. If the price difference exceeds a delta threshold, it opens a position with a fixed lot size, a 200-pip take profit, and a 2000-pip stop loss. It only allows one trade per day and resets the trading flag after the session ends.
EA-214.summary_zh: 该EA每天在指定时间（默认18点）比较两根H1K线的开盘价差值，若差值超过delta阈值则开仓交易。止盈200点、止损2000点，固定手数，每天仅允许交易一次，次日重置交易标志。
EA-214.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于特定时段内H1K线开盘价的差异来判断短期价格偏离方向。入场条件为：在TradeTime指定的小时（默认18点），比较Open[t1]和Open[t2]的开盘价，若Open[t1]比Open[t2]高出delta个点则做空，若Open[t1]比Open[t2]低出delta个点则做多。出场条件依赖固定的止盈200点和止损2000点，盈亏比极低仅为1:10。仓位管理采用固定手数（默认0.1手），无任何动态仓位调整或加仓机制。资金管理方面完全缺失，没有根据账户余额或风险比例计算仓位的功能。该策略的核心假设是特定时段的价格偏离会在短期内回归，但止盈止损比例严重失衡，风险极大。
EA-214.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on comparing the open prices of two H1 bars at a specific time of day to detect short-term price deviation direction. Entry conditions: at the designated TradeTime hour (default 18:00), if Open[t1] exceeds Open[t2] by delta points, a short position is opened; if Open[t1] is below Open[t2] by delta points, a long position is opened. Exit conditions rely on fixed take profit of 200 pips and stop loss of 2000 pips, resulting in an extremely unfavorable risk-reward ratio of 1:10. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (default 0.1 lots) with no dynamic adjustment or scaling mechanism whatsoever. Money management is entirely absent, with no functionality to calculate position size based on account balance or risk percentage. The core assumption is that price deviations at a specific session time will revert in the short term, but the take-profit-to-stop-loss ratio is severely imbalanced, posing extreme risk.

EA-215.name: exControl panel MCM
EA-215.summary: This EA is a demonstration of the MCM Control Panel, providing a graphical menu interface on the chart. It initializes a customizable control panel with user-defined colors and font size, then processes custom chart events for multi-currency monitoring. The EA itself does not execute any trades; it serves purely as a UI utility for market watch event display.
EA-215.summary_zh: 这个EA是MCM控制面板的演示程序，在图表上提供图形化菜单界面。它初始化一个可自定义颜色和字号的控盘面板，并处理自定义图表事件用于多币种监控。该EA本身不执行任何交易，纯粹作为市场观察事件显示的界面工具。
EA-215.strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略程序，而是一个图表控制面板工具。它通过InitControlPanelMCM函数初始化MCM面板，支持自定义背景色、字体色、选中色和字号等外观参数。在OnChartEvent中处理CHARTEVENT_CUSTOM及以上的自定义事件，当收到自定义事件时打印事件ID、交易品种、时间框架描述和价格信息，这暗示其可用于多币种市场观察场景。DeinitControlPanelMCM在EA卸载时清理面板资源。核心逻辑封装在Control panel MCM.mqh包含文件中，主文件仅负责初始化、反初始化和事件转发。由于没有开仓、平仓、止损止盈或仓位管理的任何逻辑，它不具备任何交易能力。
EA-215.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy program but a chart control panel utility. It initializes the MCM panel via InitControlPanelMCM with customizable appearance parameters including background color, font color, selection color, and font size. In OnChartEvent, it processes CHARTEVENT_CUSTOM and higher custom events, printing event ID, symbol, timeframe description, and price when custom events arrive, suggesting use in multi-currency market watch scenarios. DeinitControlPanelMCM cleans up panel resources on EA removal. The core logic is encapsulated in the Control panel MCM.mqh include file, while the main file only handles initialization, deinitialization, and event forwarding. Since there is no logic for opening, closing, stop-loss, take-profit, or position management, it possesses no trading capability whatsoever.

Supports custom event handling for multi-currency market watch events, facilitating monitoring of multiple symbols
Clean and concise code structure with proper initialization and deinitialization flow and sound resource management
cons: 核心逻辑封装在外部mqh文件中，主文件无法体现面板的完整功能和实现细节
仅打印事件信息而无进一步处理逻辑，实用性有限，缺乏交互反馈机制

Only prints event information without further processing, limiting practical utility and lacking interactive feedback mechanisms

EA-2154.name: MACD Sample
EA-2154.summary: This EA uses MACD histogram crossovers combined with an EMA trend filter to generate buy and sell signals. It implements trailing stop management and take profit targets for position exits. The strategy only enters trades when the MACD signal confirms momentum and the EMA confirms the prevailing trend direction.
EA-2154.summary_zh: 该EA使用MACD柱状图交叉信号结合EMA趋势过滤来产生买卖信号。它实现了移动止损管理和止盈目标来管理仓位出场。策略仅在MACD信号确认动量且EMA确认当前趋势方向时才进场交易。
EA-2154.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于MACD指标的信号线交叉进行交易，同时使用EMA作为趋势方向过滤器。做多入场条件为：MACD主线在零轴下方、MACD主线从下方穿越信号线上方、MACD绝对值大于开仓阈值、且当前EMA值大于前一根EMA值（确认上升趋势）。做空入场条件对称相反：MACD主线在零轴上方、MACD主线从上方穿越信号线下方、MACD值大于开仓阈值、且当前EMA值小于前一根EMA值（确认下降趋势）。出场方面，做多平仓条件为MACD在零轴上方发生死叉且MACD值大于平仓阈值；做空平仓条件为MACD在零轴下方发生金叉且MACD绝对值大于平仓阈值。仓位管理采用固定手数（InpLots=0.1），没有加仓或减仓逻辑。资金管理方面仅有自由保证金检查，无最大亏损限制或权益保护机制。移动止损在盈利超过设定点数后将止损跟随至当前价格减去 trailing stop 值的位置，但未设置初始止损。
EA-2154.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on MACD signal line crossovers for trade entries, with an EMA acting as a trend direction filter. Long entry conditions require: MACD main line below zero, MACD main line crossing above signal line from below, MACD absolute value exceeding the open level threshold, and current EMA greater than previous EMA (confirming uptrend). Short entry conditions are symmetrically opposite: MACD main line above zero, MACD main line crossing below signal line from above, MACD value exceeding the open level threshold, and current EMA less than previous EMA (confirming downtrend). For exits, long positions close when MACD bearish crossover occurs above zero with MACD value above close level; short positions close when MACD bullish crossover occurs below zero with MACD absolute value above close level. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (InpLots=0.1) with no scaling or position accumulation logic. Money management includes only a free margin check before opening positions, with no maximum drawdown limit or equity protection mechanism. The trailing stop moves the stop loss to follow price once profit exceeds the trailing stop threshold, but no initial stop loss is set on position open.

EA-2156.name: Exp_T3_TRIX
EA-2156.summary: This EA trades based on the T3_TRIX custom indicator, which is a triple-smoothed rate-of-change oscillator. It supports three entry modes: histogram zero-line breakout, histogram direction reversal, and signal cloud color change. Positions are opened and closed based on these momentum signals with configurable lot sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-2156.summary_zh: 该EA基于T3_TRIX自定义指标进行交易，该指标是一个三重平滑的变动率振荡器。它支持三种入场模式：直方图零线突破、直方图方向反转和信号云颜色变化。根据这些动量信号开仓和平仓，并支持可配置的手数大小和止损/止盈水平。
EA-2156.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于T3_TRIX指标，这是一个结合了T3平滑算法的三重指数移动平均变动率指标。策略概念是通过多重平滑过滤噪音，捕捉价格动量变化。入场条件有三种模式：breakdown模式在直方图穿越零线时入场，twist模式在直方图方向改变时入场，cloudtwist模式在信号云颜色变化时入场。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓或止损止盈，多头平仓由BUY_Close信号触发，空头平仓由SELL_Close信号触发。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理使用MMMode参数选择手数计算方法，默认为LOT模式。止损和止盈分别默认为1000点和2000点，提供了基本的风险控制。
EA-2156.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the T3_TRIX indicator, which is a triple exponentially smoothed rate-of-change oscillator combined with the T3 smoothing algorithm. The strategy concept filters market noise through multiple smoothing passes to capture genuine momentum shifts. Entry conditions support three modes: breakdown mode enters when the histogram crosses the zero line, twist mode enters when the histogram direction reverses, and cloudtwist mode enters when the signal cloud changes color. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals triggering position closure or stop-loss/take-profit levels, with long positions closed by BUY_Close signals and short positions closed by SELL_Close signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-share-based lot calculation. Money management uses the MMMode parameter to select the lot calculation method, defaulting to LOT mode. Stop-loss and take-profit default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, providing basic risk control.

EA-2158.name: Exp_RSIOMA_V2
EA-2158.summary: This EA trades based on the RSIOMA_V2 indicator, which is a smoothed RSI with momentum. It supports three signal modes: level breakout, histogram direction change, and signal cloud color change. Positions are opened and closed based on these momentum signals with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit.
EA-2158.summary_zh: 该EA基于RSIOMA_V2指标进行交易，该指标是带有动量的平滑RSI。支持三种信号模式：水平突破、柱状图方向变化和信号云颜色变化。根据这些动量信号进行开平仓，并可配置资金管理和止损止盈。
EA-2158.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于RSIOMA_V2指标，这是一个对RSI进行双重平滑处理并加入动量计算的指标。策略提供三种入场模式：第一种是水平突破模式，当RSIOMA值从下方突破上触发线（默认60）时做多，从上方跌破下触发线（默认40）时做空；第二种是方向变化模式，当RSIOMA柱状图方向由下转上时做多，由上转下时做空；第三种是信号云变色模式，当上轨云线穿越下轨云线时产生信号。出场条件包括止损止盈以及反向信号平仓，止损默认1000点，止盈默认2000点。仓位管理支持固定手数或按存款比例计算，通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制。资金管理允许负值MM参数表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例分配。EA仅在新区块出现时计算信号，避免重复交易，同时使用全局变量管理交易状态。
EA-2158.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the RSIOMA_V2 indicator, which applies double smoothing to RSI and incorporates momentum calculation. The strategy offers three entry modes: first, the breakdown mode goes long when RSIOMA crosses above the upper trigger level (default 60) and goes short when it crosses below the lower trigger level (default 40); second, the twist mode enters long when the RSIOMA histogram direction changes from down to up and short when it reverses; third, the cloudtwist mode generates signals when the upper cloud line crosses the lower cloud line. Exit conditions include stop-loss and take-profit (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively) as well as counter-signal closes. Position sizing supports either fixed lot size or deposit-proportional calculation controlled by the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration. Money management allows negative MM values for fixed lots and positive values for deposit-proportional allocation. The EA only recalculates signals on new bars to avoid redundant trades, and uses global variables to manage trading state across ticks.

EA-2159.name: Exp_Digital_MACD
EA-2159.summary: This EA trades based on the Digital_MACD custom indicator, offering four different entry algorithms: zero-line breakout, MACD direction change, signal line direction change, and MACD/Signal crossover. It supports configurable position sizing, stop loss/take profit, and permission toggles for long/short entry and exit.
EA-2159.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Digital_MACD指标进行交易，提供四种不同的入场算法：零线突破、MACD方向变化、信号线方向变化和MACD与信号线交叉。支持可配置的仓位管理、止损止盈以及多空开平仓权限开关。
EA-2159.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于数字MACD指标的动量交易，提供了四种入场模式供用户选择。'breakdown'模式在MACD柱状图穿越零线时入场，属于趋势确认型策略；'MACDtwist'模式在MACD线改变方向时入场，属于动量反转策略；'SIGNALtwist'模式在信号线改变方向时入场，反应更平滑；'MACDdisposition'模式在MACD线穿越信号线时入场，即经典MACD交叉策略。出场方面，EA使用固定的止损和止盈点数（默认1000点和2000点），同时反向信号也会触发平仓。仓位管理支持按存款比例计算手数（MM参数默认0.1），并通过MarginMode枚举选择手数计算方式。EA在每根新K线时计算信号，避免逐tick交易的噪音，但缺乏加仓、减仓和移动止损机制。
EA-2159.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum trading based on the Digital_MACD custom indicator, offering four selectable entry modes. The 'breakdown' mode enters when the MACD histogram crosses the zero line, acting as a trend confirmation strategy. The 'MACDtwist' mode enters when the MACD line changes direction, functioning as a momentum reversal strategy. The 'SIGNALtwist' mode enters when the signal line changes direction, providing a smoother signal response. The 'MACDdisposition' mode enters on MACD/signal line crossover, which is the classic MACD crossover approach. For exits, the EA uses fixed stop loss and take profit in points (default 1000 and 2000), while opposing signals also trigger position closure. Position sizing supports deposit-share-based lot calculation (MM parameter default 0.1) with a MarginMode enum for lot calculation method selection. The EA calculates signals on each new bar to avoid tick-level noise, but lacks scaling, partial close, and trailing stop mechanisms.

MM parameter default of 0.1 (10% of deposit) per trade represents significant single-trade risk at high leverage

EA-2164.name: Exp_AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2
EA-2164.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2 custom indicator, which identifies trend direction changes. It opens buy positions on upward trend signals and sell positions on downward trend signals, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position sizing based on a share of the deposit.
EA-2164.summary_zh: 该EA基于AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2自定义指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标用于识别趋势方向变化。在上升趋势信号时开多仓，在下降趋势信号时开空仓，支持可配置的止损、止盈以及基于存款比例的仓位管理。
EA-2164.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2指标的趋势跟踪交易系统。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）在指定信号K线上出现非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时，产生买入信号；当指标缓冲区0（DnValue）出现有效值时，产生卖出信号。出场条件有两种方式：一是通过反向信号平仓（买入信号触发空头平仓，卖出信号触发多头平仓），二是通过固定的止损和止盈点数平仓。仓位管理采用基于存款比例的方法，通过MM参数控制每笔交易占用存款的比例，并支持LOT和MARGIN两种计算模式。资金管理方面，EA在历史K线中向前搜索最近的反向信号来判断是否需要平仓，确保在没有直接反向信号时也能根据历史趋势方向决定仓位。策略还包含新K线检测机制，避免在同一根K线内重复交易，但缺乏加仓和减仓逻辑。
EA-2164.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following trading system based on the AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2 custom indicator. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified signal bar, a buy signal is generated; when indicator buffer 0 (DnValue) shows a valid value, a sell signal is generated. Exit conditions operate in two ways: first, through reverse signal closing (a buy signal triggers short position closure, a sell signal triggers long position closure), and second, through fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points. Position sizing uses a deposit share-based method controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both LOT and MARGIN calculation modes. For money management, the EA searches backward through historical bars for the most recent reverse signal to determine whether position closing is needed when no direct reverse signal exists on the current bar. The strategy includes a new bar detection mechanism via the CIsNewBar class to prevent repeated trading within the same bar, but lacks scaling in or scaling out logic for position management.

EA-2171.name: Exp_BW-wiseMan-1
EA-2171.summary: This EA trades based on the BW-wiseMan-1 custom indicator, which is derived from Bill Williams' Alligator indicator (jaw, teeth, lips). It generates buy signals when the upper buffer has a non-empty value and sell signals when the lower buffer has a non-empty value, with an option to trade retrogradely (against the trend). Positions are opened and closed based on these signals with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-2171.summary_zh: 该EA基于BW-wiseMan-1自定义指标进行交易，该指标源自比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标（颌、齿、唇）。当上轨缓冲区有非空值时产生买入信号，当下轨缓冲区有非空值时产生卖出信号，并提供逆势交易选项。根据这些信号开仓和平仓，配有可配置的止损止盈水平。
EA-2171.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标，通过三条不同周期的平滑移动平均线（颌线13周期、齿线8周期、唇线5周期）判断市场趋势状态。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区出现有效信号值时做多，下轨缓冲区出现有效信号值时做空，信号由鳄鱼线的排列关系和back参数指定的K线数量分析产生。特别的是，retrogradely参数允许逆势交易，即反转指标缓冲区的读取顺序，将顺势信号转为逆势信号。出场条件包括止损止盈的硬性出场，以及通过回溯历史K线寻找反向信号来触发平仓。仓位管理采用MM参数控制每笔交易占用资金比例，支持固定手数和百分比两种模式（LOT模式和其他保证金模式）。资金管理通过StopLoss和TakeProfit参数设定固定点数的止损止盈，Deviation参数控制最大滑点容忍度。
EA-2171.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on Bill Williams' Alligator indicator, using three smoothed moving averages of different periods (jaw 13, teeth 8, lips 5) to determine market trend states. Entry conditions are: go long when the upper buffer of the indicator produces a valid signal value, and go short when the lower buffer produces a valid signal value, with signals generated from the alignment relationship of the Alligator lines and analysis of the number of bars specified by the back parameter. Notably, the retrogradely parameter allows counter-trend trading by reversing the read order of the indicator buffers, converting trend-following signals into counter-trend ones. Exit conditions include hard exits via stop loss and take profit, as well as closing positions by searching backward through historical bars for opposing signals. Position sizing uses the MM parameter to control the share of deposit per trade, supporting both fixed lot and percentage-based margin modes. Money management employs StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters for fixed point-based exits, while the Deviation parameter controls the maximum allowable price slippage.

EA-218.name: FatPanel
EA-218.summary: FatPanel is a graphical trading panel (Expert Advisor wrapper) that provides a visual interface for creating automated trading strategies without writing code. It dispatches user interactions from chart events, timer checks, and trade events to an underlying CPanelDispatcher engine. The EA itself does not generate trading signals; it acts as a front-end control panel for strategy configuration and execution.
EA-218.summary_zh: FatPanel是一个图形化交易面板EA，允许用户通过界面创建自动化交易策略而无需编写代码。它将图表事件、定时器检查和交易事件分派给底层CPanelDispatcher引擎处理。该EA本身不产生交易信号，而是作为策略配置和执行的前端控制面板。
EA-218.strategy_analysis: FatPanel本质上是一个交易工具面板而非自主交易策略EA。它的核心架构通过CPanelDispatcher类将用户界面交互（OnChartEvent）、定时控制（OnTimer）和交易回调（OnTrade）分发到相应的处理模块。入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理和资金管理完全取决于用户在面板上配置的策略参数，而非EA内置的逻辑。该EA依赖EventSetTimer(1)实现每秒一次的控制循环，用于监控面板状态和策略执行。由于策略逻辑被封装在PanelDispatcher及引用的panel.ex5指标中，主文件无法体现具体的交易规则。它是一个半自动化工具，用户通过面板手动或配置式地驱动交易决策。
EA-218.strategy_analysis_en: FatPanel is fundamentally a trading utility panel rather than an autonomous strategy EA. Its core architecture dispatches user interface interactions (OnChartEvent), timer-based control loops (OnTimer set to 1-second intervals), and trade callbacks (OnTrade) to the underlying CPanelDispatcher engine. Entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, and money management are entirely determined by the strategies the user configures through the panel interface, not by hardcoded logic in the EA itself. The EA relies on a 1-second timer for continuous monitoring of panel state and strategy execution. Since the actual strategy logic is encapsulated within PanelDispatcher and the referenced panel.ex5 indicator, the main source file reveals no specific trading rules or signal generation mechanisms. It functions as a semi-automated tool where users drive trading decisions through the panel either manually or via configured strategy parameters.

EA-2183.name: Exp_Slow-Stoch
EA-2183.summary: This EA trades based on the custom Slow-Stoch indicator, offering three entry modes: zero-line crossover (breakdown), direction change (twist), and signal cloud color change (cloudtwist). It uses smoothed stochastic values to generate buy/sell signals and manages positions with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
EA-2183.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Slow-Stoch指标进行交易，提供三种入场模式：零线突破、方向转折和信号云变色。它使用平滑后的随机指标值生成买卖信号，并通过可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项管理仓位。
EA-2183.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于自定义Slow-Stoch指标，该指标是传统随机振荡器的平滑变体，通过额外施加XMA平滑算法来减少噪音。入场条件有三种模式：breakdown模式在随机值穿越50中线时入场，twist模式在随机值方向发生转折时入场，cloudtwist模式在信号云（主线与信号线关系）颜色改变时入场。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向信号触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，正值表示按存款比例计算仓位，负值表示直接指定手数。资金管理支持多种模式（LOT等），由MMMode枚举决定。该EA还支持分别控制多头和空头的开仓与平仓权限，提供了灵活的交易控制。
EA-2183.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on the custom Slow-Stoch indicator, which is a smoothed variant of the traditional stochastic oscillator that applies an additional XMA smoothing algorithm to reduce noise. Entry conditions operate in three modes: breakdown mode enters when the stochastic value crosses the 50 midline, twist mode enters when the stochastic value changes direction, and cloudtwist mode enters when the signal cloud color changes based on the relationship between the main and signal lines. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as reverse signal-triggered position closing. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where positive values represent a deposit share ratio and negative values specify a fixed lot size. Money management supports multiple modes (LOT, etc.) as determined by the MMMode enumeration. The EA also provides separate permissions for long and short position opening and closing, offering flexible trading control.

EA-2192.name: Exp_The_20s_v020
EA-2192.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom indicator 'The_20s_v020', which identifies momentum-based entry points using a configurable trigger level and ratio. It opens buy/sell positions when the indicator produces non-empty values on the signal bar and manages exits by searching historical bars for the last opposing signal. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot, balance-based, and free margin-based allocation.
EA-2192.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标'The_20s_v020'的信号进行交易，该指标通过可配置的触发水平和比率识别动量入场点。当指标在信号K线上产生非空值时开仓做多或做空，并通过回溯历史K线寻找最后一个反向信号来管理出场。仓位管理支持固定手数、基于余额和基于可用保证金等多种资金管理模式。
EA-2192.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于自定义指标The_20s_v020产生的动量信号进行交易，该指标通过触发水平(Level)和比率(Ratio)参数识别价格动量变化。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区(UpValue)在指定信号K线上产生非零且非空值时触发买入信号，当下轨缓冲区(DnValue)产生非零且非空值时触发卖出信号。出场条件采用反向信号平仓机制——如果当前K线没有直接的反向信号，EA会回溯历史K线搜索最后一个反向信号来决定是否平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数(LOT)、基于余额(BALANCE)、基于可用保证金(FREEMARGIN)、基于亏损占比的余额模式(LOSSBALANCE)和基于亏损占比的可用保证金模式(LOSSFREEMARGIN)。资金管理通过MM参数控制投入比例，StopLoss和TakeProfit分别设置止损和止盈点数。EA还包含权限控制开关，可独立启用/禁用买卖开仓和平仓操作，支持两种计算算法(MODE_1和MODE_2)以及信号方向反转(Direct参数)。
EA-2192.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum signals generated by the custom indicator The_20s_v020, which identifies price momentum shifts using a configurable trigger level (Level) and ratio (Ratio). Entry conditions are triggered when the indicator's upper buffer (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the designated signal bar for buy signals, and similarly the lower buffer (DnValue) for sell signals. Exit conditions use a reverse-signal closing mechanism — if no direct reverse signal appears on the current bar, the EA searches backward through historical bars to find the last opposing signal to determine whether to close positions. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot (LOT), balance-based (BALANCE), free margin-based (FREEMARGIN), loss-share from balance (LOSSBALANCE), and loss-share from free margin (LOSSFREEMARGIN). Money management is controlled via the MM parameter which sets the deposit share per deal, while StopLoss and TakeProfit define the exit points in points. The EA also features permission switches for independently enabling/disabling buy/sell open and close operations, supports two calculation algorithms (MODE_1 and MODE_2), and allows signal direction inversion via the Direct parameter.

EA-21956.name: Ravi AO
EA-21956.summary: This EA uses the Ravi AO (Average Oscillator) indicator to generate trading signals based on momentum shifts. It enters long positions when the oscillator crosses above its signal line and short positions when it crosses below. The strategy is a systematic momentum-based approach with configurable parameters for period and signal smoothing.
EA-21956.summary_zh: 该EA使用Ravi AO（平均振荡器）指标基于动量变化生成交易信号。当振荡器上穿信号线时做多，下穿时做空。这是一个系统化的动量策略，可配置周期和信号平滑参数。
EA-21956.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心基于Ravi AO振荡器指标，通过计算价格动量的变化来捕捉趋势转折点。入场条件为振荡器值上穿信号线时开多单，下穿信号线时开空单，属于典型的动量跟踪策略。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发平仓，未见到独立的止损止盈逻辑。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户固定手数下单，但没有基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理相对简单，缺乏风险敞口控制和最大回撤限制。整体策略逻辑清晰但风险控制薄弱，依赖动量信号的及时性，在震荡市中可能频繁触发虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-21956.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Ravi AO oscillator indicator, capturing trend turning points by calculating changes in price momentum. Entry conditions are triggered when the oscillator value crosses above the signal line for long positions and below for short positions, representing a typical momentum-following strategy. Exit conditions rely on reverse signals to close positions, with no independent stop-loss or take-profit logic observed. Position sizing allows the user to set a fixed lot size, but there is no dynamic position adjustment based on account balance or volatility. Money management is relatively simple, lacking risk exposure controls and maximum drawdown limits. Overall, the strategy logic is clear but risk control is weak, relying on the timeliness of momentum signals, which may trigger frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

EA-220.name: eInTradePanel
EA-220.summary: This is a trade panel utility EA that provides a graphical interface for manual trading operations. It delegates all functionality to the CIntegerTradePanel class, handling initialization, tick updates, timer events, and chart events to manage the panel's UI and user interactions.
EA-220.summary_zh: 这是一个交易面板工具型EA，提供图形化界面用于手动交易操作。它将所有功能委托给CIntegerTradePanel类，处理初始化、行情更新、定时器事件和图表事件来管理面板的UI和用户交互。
EA-220.strategy_analysis: 该EA本身不包含任何交易策略逻辑，它是一个纯粹的交易面板工具。所有的核心功能都封装在CIntegerTradePanel_2.mqh头文件中定义的CIntegerTradePanel类里。EA的入口函数OnInit调用TradePanel.Init()进行面板初始化，OnTick调用TradePanel.Tick()更新面板状态，OnTimer调用TradePanel.Timer()处理定时任务，OnChartEvent调用TradePanel.ChartEvent()处理用户的界面交互事件如按钮点击和输入框操作。由于策略逻辑完全隐藏在包含文件中，无法从主文件判断具体的交易执行方式、仓位管理和资金管理细节。该EA本质上是一个半自动化交易辅助工具，依赖交易员通过面板手动决策。
EA-220.strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not contain any trading strategy logic itself; it is a pure trade panel utility. All core functionality is encapsulated in the CIntegerTradePanel class defined in the CIntegerTradePanel_2.mqh header file. The OnInit entry calls TradePanel.Init() for panel initialization, OnTick calls TradePanel.Tick() to update panel state, OnTimer calls TradePanel.Timer() for timed tasks, and OnChartEvent calls TradePanel.ChartEvent() to handle user interface interactions such as button clicks and input operations. Since the strategy logic is entirely hidden within the include file, the specific trade execution method, position sizing, and money management details cannot be determined from the main file alone. The EA is essentially a semi-automated trading assistant tool that relies on the trader making manual decisions through the panel interface.

EA-2200.name: roman.mq5
EA-2200.summary: This EA implements a simple alternating buy/sell strategy that reverses direction after each position closes. It opens a position immediately when no position exists, then closes on reaching a fixed TP or SL in points, flipping the direction for the next trade. No technical indicators are used—entry is purely based on the previous trade's outcome.
EA-2200.summary_zh: 该EA实现了一个简单的交替买卖策略，每次平仓后反转方向。当没有持仓时立即开仓，达到固定止盈或止损点数后平仓并翻转下一笔交易方向。不使用任何技术指标，入场完全基于上一笔交易的结果。
EA-2200.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是均值回归中的反转交易：假设价格在触及止盈或止损后会反向运动，因此每次平仓后立即反向开仓。入场条件极其简单——当没有持仓时，根据布尔变量bs决定买入或卖出，初始默认为买入。出场条件为固定点数的止盈（TP=46点）和止损（SL=31点），通过手动计算当前价格与开仓价的点差来判断。仓位管理仅使用固定手数（Lot=0.1），没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理完全缺失，没有最大回撤限制、没有交易次数限制、没有账户权益保护机制。策略不依赖任何技术指标或市场结构分析，属于纯粹的价格反转赌博式交易。
EA-2200.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is a reversal-based mean reversion approach: it assumes that after hitting a take-profit or stop-loss, the price will move in the opposite direction, so it immediately opens a reverse position after each close. Entry conditions are extremely simplistic—when no position exists, it opens a buy or sell based on a boolean flag, defaulting to buy initially. Exit conditions use fixed point-based take-profit (TP=46 points) and stop-loss (SL=31 points), calculated manually by comparing the current price to the open price divided by _Point. Position sizing uses only a fixed lot size (Lot=0.1) with no dynamic adjustment based on account balance, equity, or market volatility. Money management is entirely absent—there is no maximum drawdown limit, no trade frequency cap, and no account equity protection. The strategy relies on zero technical indicators or market structure analysis, making it essentially a pure price-reversal gambling system.
pros: 逻辑极其简单，易于理解和维护
每次只持有一个仓位，不存在过度持仓风险
止盈大于止损（46:31），单笔盈亏比大于1，符合正向期望的基础要求
pros_en: Extremely simple logic, easy to understand and maintain
Only holds one position at a time, avoiding overexposure risk

cons: 没有任何技术指标或市场分析作为入场依据，入场本质上是随机方向
止损止盈使用固定点数而非ATR等动态指标，无法适应不同市场波动环境

cons_en: No technical indicators or market analysis for entry decisions—direction is essentially random

No money management or risk control mechanisms, prolonged operation may lead to account blow-up
improvements: 增加技术指标确认入场方向（如均线趋势、RSI超买超卖），避免纯随机方向交易
使用ATR动态调整止盈止损，并增加点差过滤和新K线检查机制
improvements_en: Add technical indicator confirmation for entry direction (e.g., MA trend, RSI overbought/oversold) to avoid purely random direction trading
Use ATR for dynamic TP/SL adjustment, and add spread filter and new bar check mechanisms

risk_points: 无入场分析，交易方向完全依赖上一笔结果，等同于随机交易

无点差过滤，高点差环境下止损容易被触发

risk_points_en: No entry analysis—trade direction depends entirely on previous result, equivalent to random trading

EA-221.name: TradeXpert
EA-221.summary: TradeXpert is a trading utility panel (TradePane) with an information display (InfoPane) and comment/logging system (Commenter) for MetaTrader 5. It provides a GUI-based interface for manual trade management rather than automated strategy-based trading. The included indicator (TradeXpertLogs) serves as a separate-window trigger for the logging display feature.
EA-221.summary_zh: TradeXpert是一个交易工具面板，包含交易操作面板（TradePane）、信息显示面板（InfoPane）和日志评论系统（Commenter），用于MetaTrader 5平台的手动交易管理。它提供基于GUI的交互界面而非自动化策略交易。附带的指标（TradeXpertLogs）作为日志显示功能的独立窗口触发器。
EA-221.strategy_analysis: TradeXpert并非自动交易EA，而是一个交易辅助工具套件。它通过TradePane提供可视化的交易操作面板，允许用户手动下单和管理仓位。InfoPane负责在图表上显示账户和交易相关信息，如余额、净值、持仓详情等。Commenter组件提供日志和评论功能，可通过TradeXpertLogs指标在独立窗口中触发显示。整体架构采用事件驱动模式，通过OnChartEvent处理用户界面交互，OnTimer和OnTick分别处理定时更新和实时行情刷新。该工具不包含任何自动入场或出场策略逻辑，所有交易决策由用户手动完成。
EA-221.strategy_analysis_en: TradeXpert is not an automated trading EA but rather a trading utility suite. It provides a visual trading operation panel through TradePane, allowing users to manually place and manage orders. InfoPane displays account and trading information on the chart, such as balance, equity, and position details. The Commenter component offers logging and commentary functionality, which can be triggered for display in a separate window via the TradeXpertLogs indicator. The overall architecture follows an event-driven pattern, handling user interface interactions through OnChartEvent, while OnTimer and OnTick handle periodic updates and real-time quote refreshes respectively. This tool contains no automated entry or exit strategy logic; all trading decisions are made manually by the user.

EA-222.strategy_analysis:
分析

### 2.1 核心策略概念
**这是一个半自动交易GUI控制面板，不是自动化交易EA。**

该EA在图表上创建一个可视化的交易控制面板，提供：
- 手动买入/卖出按钮
- 全部平仓按钮
- 仓位反向按钮
- 止损调整按钮(Loss Break - 将止损移到开仓价+盈利位置)
- 手数选择复选框(可累加多个手数)
- GMT和本地时间显示

### 2.2 入场条件
**无自动入场逻辑**。入场完全依赖用户手动点击BUY/SELL按钮：
- 点击BUY按钮 → 调用`OpenBuy()`以当前ASK价开多仓
- 点击SELL按钮 → 调用`OpenSell()`以当前BID价开空仓
- 入场时`stop_loss=0, take_profit=0`（无止损止盈）

入场包含错误重试机制：
- REQUOTE: 重试3分钟，每次等待2秒
- TIMEOUT: 重试5分钟，每次等待5秒
- PRICE_CHANGED: 等待2秒后重试
- CONNECTION: 重试5分钟，每次等待30秒
- NO_MONEY: 直接返回失败

### 2.3 出场条件
**无自动出场逻辑**。出场依赖用户手动操作：
- **Close All**: 平掉所有多空仓位
- **Reverse**: 反向操作（先平仓再反向开仓）
- **Loss Break**: 将止损调整到开仓价±LosBreakingStopLoss点

### 2.4 风险管理
- **止损/止盈**: 开仓时不设置SL/TP（全部为0）
- **手数管理**: 通过复选框累加选择，默认列表"0.01; 0.02; 0.05; 0.10; 0.20; 0.50; 1.00; 2.00; 5.00"
- **Loss Break功能**: 将止损移到盈利区域（开仓价±10点）

EA-2220.name: Exp_ColorJJRSX
EA-2220.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJJRSX indicator, which combines Jurik RSX (raw signal index) with JMA (Jurik Moving Average) smoothing. It generates buy signals when the JJRSX histogram turns upward and sell signals when it turns downward, with separate controls for entering and exiting positions.
EA-2220.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJJRSX指标进行交易，该指标融合了Jurik RSX原始信号指数与JMA平滑移动平均线。当JJRSX柱状图由下转上时产生买入信号，由上转下时产生卖出信号，并分别控制开仓和平仓权限。
EA-2220.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Jurik RSX动量指标经JMA平滑后的方向变化来捕捉趋势动量。入场条件：当Value[1]<Value[2]（指标值上升）且Value[0]>Value[1]时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（指标值下降）且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空仓。出场条件：多仓在指标下降时平仓，空仓在指标上升时平仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制存款份额，支持自由保证金、余额、损失比例和固定手数四种计算模式。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准函数，但没有动态调整止损或追踪止损机制。整体策略属于动量跟踪类型，依赖指标斜率变化而非绝对阈值来产生信号。
EA-2220.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on directional changes in the Jurik RSX momentum indicator after JMA smoothing to capture trend momentum. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator rising) and Value[0]>Value[1] (confirmed upward momentum), while a sell position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] (indicator falling) and Value[0]<Value[1] (confirmed downward momentum). Exit conditions: long positions close when the indicator starts declining, and short positions close when the indicator starts rising, supplemented by fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter representing the share of deposit per deal, with four calculation modes including free margin, balance, loss share, and fixed lot. Money management relies on standard functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, but lacks dynamic stop adjustments or trailing stop mechanisms. The overall strategy is a momentum-following type that depends on indicator slope changes rather than absolute threshold levels for signal generation.
