EA-223.name: VirtualTradePad v4.0
EA-223.summary: VirtualTradePad is a multi-function trading panel/dashboard EA for MT5 that provides a graphical interface for manual trading operations including opening/closing positions, placing pending orders, trailing stops, and monitoring account info across up to 6 symbols. It does not generate its own trade signals but instead offers button-driven controls for the trader to execute trades manually from the chart.
EA-223.summary_zh: VirtualTradePad是一个MT5多功能交易面板/仪表盘EA，提供图形界面用于手动交易操作，包括开仓/平仓、挂单、移动止损和监控最多6个交易品种的账户信息。它不生成自己的交易信号，而是提供按钮驱动控件让交易者从图表上手动执行交易。
EA-223.strategy_analysis: 该EA不是一个自动交易策略，而是一个交易工具面板。它的核心功能是通过图表上的按钮界面让交易者手动执行买卖操作、平仓（全部平仓、只平盈利、只平亏损、只平多单、只平空单等）、设置挂单（BUYSTOP、SELLSTOP、BUYLIMIT、SELLLIMIT）、修改止损止盈、反向操作以及移动止损。仓位管理完全由交易者手动控制，通过按钮调整手数（每次增减0.01）、止损止盈点数和挂单距离。资金管理方面，提供了基于利润/亏损自动平仓的功能（USEProfitCLOSE），支持按美元、百分比或点数三种方式设置平仓条件。该面板还集成了11个技术指标的显示切换功能，包括MA、MACD、RSI、布林带等，以及多时间周期图表切换功能，方便交易者进行技术分析。总体而言，这是一个半自动化的交易辅助工具，所有交易决策仍需人工判断。
EA-223.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an automated trading strategy but rather a comprehensive trading panel utility. Its core functionality provides a chart-based button interface allowing traders to manually execute buy/sell operations, close positions (close all, close profitable only, close losing only, close buys only, close sells only, etc.), place pending orders (BUYSTOP, SELLSTOP, BUYLIMIT, SELLLIMIT), modify stop loss and take profit levels, reverse positions, and apply trailing stops. Position sizing is entirely manual, controlled via buttons that increment/decrement lot size by 0.01, along with adjustable SL/TP pip values and pending order distance levels. For money management, it offers an auto-close feature (USEProfitCLOSE) that can close positions based on profit/loss thresholds in three modes: dollar amount, percentage, or points. The panel also integrates display toggling for 11 technical indicators including MA, MACD, RSI, Bollinger Bands, and others, plus multi-timeframe chart switching capability for technical analysis. Overall, this is a semi-automated trading assistant where all trading decisions still require human judgment.
pros: 集成了丰富的交易功能于一身：开平仓、挂单、移动止损、反向操作、利润自动平仓等

EA-2236.name: Exp_FisherCGOscillator
EA-2236.summary: This EA trades based on the FisherCGOscillator custom indicator, generating buy signals when the oscillator line crosses above its signal line and sell signals when it crosses below. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and permissions for opening and closing positions independently for long and short sides.
EA-2236.summary_zh: 该EA基于FisherCGOscillator自定义指标进行交易，当振荡器线上穿信号线时产生买入信号，下穿时产生卖出信号。支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，以及独立的多空开平仓权限控制。
EA-2236.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于FisherCGOscillator振荡器的趋势动量交叉信号，属于典型的动量跟踪策略。入场条件为：振荡器线(Ind)上穿信号线(Sign)时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，仅在信号确认后的新K线触发交易。出场条件包括固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向信号触发的平仓（多仓在卖出信号时平仓，空仓在买入信号时平仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制存款份额，支持五种模式：自由保证金、余额、损失自由保证金、损失余额和固定手数。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库封装的标准化交易函数，包含最大价格偏差控制和信号时间戳追踪以防止重复交易。策略默认使用H8周期和10周期的指标参数，SignalBar=1表示使用前一根已闭合K线的信号，避免未完成K线的虚假信号。
EA-2236.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on crossover signals from the FisherCGOscillator, a momentum-based oscillator that applies Fisher transform to the center of gravity oscillator for smoother signals. Entry conditions: a buy is triggered when the oscillator line (Ind) crosses above the signal line (Sign), and a sell is triggered when Ind crosses below Sign; trades are only executed on new bar formation to avoid intra-bar noise. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), plus directional close on opposing signals — long positions close on sell signals and short positions close on buy signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1 = 10% of deposit) with five calculation modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss share of free margin, loss share of balance, and fixed lot. Money management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library which provides standardized BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen and BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions with deviation control and signal timestamp tracking to prevent duplicate entries on the same bar. The default H8 timeframe with SignalBar=1 ensures signals are taken from the last closed bar, adding robustness against repaint and incomplete bar issues.

EA-224.name: ReInitChart
EA-224.summary: This EA adds a customizable button to the bottom-right corner of each chart that, when pressed, reinitializes all charts of the current symbol by temporarily changing the chart timeframe. It is a chart management utility, not a trading system.
EA-224.summary_zh: 该EA在每个图表右下角添加一个可自定义的按钮，按下后通过临时切换图表周期来重新初始化当前品种的所有图表。这是一个图表管理工具，不是交易系统。
EA-224.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个图表重初始化工具。其核心概念是通过临时更改图表时间周期来触发图表重绘，从而解决MT5中图表偶尔出现的数据刷新问题。入场条件不适用，因为该工具不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用，没有持仓管理逻辑。仓位管理和资金管理均不存在，因为该工具纯粹是界面辅助性质的。用户通过点击按钮手动触发重初始化，EA依赖定时器事件（OnTimer）来执行实际的图表周期切换逻辑。
EA-224.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a chart reinitialization utility. Its core concept is to force chart redraws by temporarily switching the chart timeframe, addressing occasional data refresh issues in MT5. Entry conditions are not applicable since the tool performs no trading operations. Exit conditions are likewise not applicable, with no position management logic. Position sizing and money management are absent since the tool is purely a UI辅助 tool. The user triggers reinitialization manually via button press, and the EA relies on timer events (OnTimer) to execute the actual timeframe switching logic.

EA-2274.name: Exp_XD-RangeSwitch
EA-2274.summary: This EA trades based on the XD-RangeSwitch custom indicator, which identifies range breakouts by detecting peaks. It opens buy/sell positions when breakout signals appear and closes positions on opposite signals or trend reversals, with configurable trade direction (with or against the signal).
EA-2274.summary_zh: 该EA基于XD-RangeSwitch自定义指标进行交易，通过检测峰值来识别区间突破。当突破信号出现时开仓做多或做空，在反向信号或趋势反转时平仓，支持顺势或逆势交易模式。
EA-2274.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XD-RangeSwitch指标检测价格区间的突破信号进行交易。入场条件：当指标的上行信号缓冲区（buffer 2或3）出现非空值时触发买入信号，当下行信号缓冲区出现非空值时触发卖出信号。出场条件：当检测到趋势缓冲区（buffer 0或1）出现反向趋势值时平仓，即多头趋势消失时平多，空头趋势消失时平空。仓位管理采用固定手数或按存款比例计算手数（通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制），支持LOT和百分比两种模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制每笔交易占用存款的比例（默认0.1），配合止损和止盈设置进行风险控制。策略还提供了逆势交易模式（FalshDirect），可以将指标的上下信号互换执行，实现反向交易逻辑。新K线检测机制确保信号仅在K线确认后触发，避免重复交易。
EA-2274.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the XD-RangeSwitch indicator which detects price range breakout signals for trading. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the upward signal buffer (buffer 2 or 3) shows a non-empty value, and a sell signal is triggered when the downward signal buffer shows a non-empty value. Exit conditions: positions are closed when the trend buffer (buffer 0 or 1) shows a reversal, meaning long positions close when the uptrend disappears and short positions close when the downtrend disappears. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or deposit-percentage-based calculation controlled by the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting LOT and percentage modes. Money management controls the share of deposit per trade through the MM parameter (default 0.1), combined with configurable stop loss and take profit settings for risk control. The strategy also provides a counter-signal trading mode (FalshDirect) that swaps the indicator's up/down signals for reverse trading logic. A new bar detection mechanism ensures signals are only triggered after bar confirmation, preventing duplicate trades.

EA-2277.name: Exp_VolatilityPivot
EA-2277.summary: This EA trades based on the VolatilityPivot custom indicator, which calculates pivot levels using either ATR-based volatility or price deviation. It opens buy/sell positions when the indicator generates directional signals and closes positions on opposite signals or trend reversals, with configurable trade direction (with or against the signal).
EA-2277.summary_zh: 该EA基于VolatilityPivot自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用ATR波动率或价格偏离来计算支点水平。当指标产生方向信号时开仓，在反向信号或趋势反转时平仓，支持顺信号或逆信号交易。
EA-2277.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用VolatilityPivot指标作为核心策略，该指标基于ATR波动率或价格偏离来计算动态支点支撑和阻力水平。入场条件为：当指标的上行信号线出现非空值时做多，下行信号线出现非空值时做空；同时支持逆向交易模式（FalshDirect），即反转信号方向进行交易。出场条件为：当出现反向趋势信号时平仓（如持有多单时出现下行趋势信号则平多），或通过固定的止损止盈出场。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中定义的多种资金管理模式，包括基于可用保证金、账户余额、亏损比例等方式动态计算手数，也可使用固定手数。该策略使用H4作为默认时间框架，属于中长线交易系统，在新K线出现时才重新计算信号，避免了逐tick计算的冗余。止损1000点、止盈2000点的设置表明该策略追求较大的盈亏比。
EA-2277.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the VolatilityPivot indicator as its core strategy, which calculates dynamic pivot support and resistance levels based on either ATR volatility or price deviation from a moving average. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator's upper signal line produces a non-empty value, and a sell signal is generated when the lower signal line produces a non-empty value; an inverse trading mode (FalshDirect) is also supported to trade against the signal direction. Exit conditions: positions are closed when an opposing trend signal appears (e.g., a long position is closed when a downtrend signal emerges), or via fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing leverages multiple money management modes defined in TradeAlgorithms.mqh, including dynamic lot calculation based on free margin, account balance, or loss proportion relative to the account, as well as a fixed lot option. The strategy uses H4 as the default timeframe, making it a medium-to-long-term trading system that recalculates signals only on new bars, avoiding redundant per-tick computation. The 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit settings indicate the strategy targets a favorable risk-reward ratio of 1:2.

EA-2288.name: Exp_AFIRMA
EA-2288.summary: This EA trades based on the AFIRMA (Adaptive FIR Moving Average) custom indicator, entering long when the indicator slopes upward and short when it slopes downward. It uses a windowed FIR filter with configurable taps and window functions to smooth price data and generate trend-following signals. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels, and trades are executed only on new bars to avoid over-trading.
EA-2288.summary_zh: 该EA基于AFIRMA（自适应FIR移动平均）自定义指标进行交易，当指标向上倾斜时做多，向下倾斜时做空。它使用带有可配置抽头和窗函数的FIR滤波器来平滑价格数据并生成趋势跟踪信号。仓位通过固定的止损和止盈进行管理，仅在新K线形成时执行交易以避免过度交易。
EA-2288.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于AFIRMA自适应FIR移动平均指标的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：当指标值在相邻两根K线上递增（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当指标值递减（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈点位，同时也允许通过反向信号平仓（如出现卖出信号时平多仓）。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括基于可用保证金、余额、亏损比例的动态计算以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制每笔交易占用的存款比例，默认为0.1即10%。策略使用窗函数（矩形窗、汉宁窗、布莱克曼窗等）对FIR滤波器进行优化，以减少频谱泄漏，提高信号平滑度。
EA-2288.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the AFIRMA (Adaptive FIR Moving Average) custom indicator. Entry conditions are: a long position is opened when the indicator values increase across consecutive bars (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a short position is opened when values decrease (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions rely on fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels in points, with reverse-signal exits also supported (e.g., closing long positions when a sell signal appears). Position sizing supports multiple modes including dynamic calculation based on free margin, balance, loss share ratios, or fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter which determines the share of deposit per deal, defaulting to 0.1 or 10%. The strategy leverages window functions (Rectangular, Hanning, Blackman, Blackman-Harris) to optimize the FIR filter, reducing spectral leakage and improving signal smoothness for more reliable trend detection.

EA-2306.name: Exp_ColorTSI-Oscillator
EA-2306.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorTSI-Oscillator indicator, which is a True Strength Index oscillator with dual smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-2306.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorTSI-Oscillator指标（双重平滑的真实强度指数振荡器）进行交易。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿信号线时开空仓，配有可配置的止损止盈水平。
EA-2306.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于TSI（真实强度指数）振荡器的动量交叉信号。入场条件为：当指标线(Ind)上穿信号线(Sign)时触发买入信号，当指标线下穿信号线时触发卖出信号。出场条件包括反向信号平仓以及固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理方面，EA提供了5种手数计算模式，包括基于可用保证金、账户余额、亏损比例等方式，默认使用固定手数(LOT)。资金管理通过MM参数控制存款占比（默认0.1）。EA采用多周期架构，允许在不同于图表的时间周期上运行指标。信号计算仅在新增K线时执行，避免重复计算。该策略依赖动量振荡器的交叉信号，属于典型的动量跟踪系统，在趋势转换时可能产生较多虚假信号。
EA-2306.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on crossover signals from the TSI (True Strength Index) oscillator with dual configurable smoothing methods. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the indicator line (Ind) crosses above the signal line (Sign), and a sell signal is triggered when it crosses below. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse crossover signals and using fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) levels. Position sizing supports five lot calculation modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-share-based methods, with the default set to fixed lot (LOT). Money management is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the deposit share (default 0.1). The EA employs a multi-timeframe architecture allowing the indicator to run on a different timeframe than the chart. Signal calculations are only executed on new bars to avoid redundant processing. The strategy relies on momentum oscillator crossover signals, making it a typical momentum-following system that may generate numerous false signals during trend transitions.

EA-231.name: AdvancedEAPanelDemo
EA-231.summary: This EA is a demo for the AdvancedEAPanel library, providing a graphical control panel on the chart with tabbed navigation and side buttons. It handles chart events for button clicks, object dragging, and edit fields, delegating logic to the CAdvancedEAPanel class. The panel itself does not implement any autonomous trading strategy.
EA-231.summary_zh: 该EA是AdvancedEAPanel库的演示程序，在图表上创建一个带标签页导航和侧边按钮的图形控制面板。它处理按钮点击、对象拖拽和编辑框等图表事件，将逻辑委托给CAdvancedEAPanel类。该面板本身不实现任何自主交易策略。
EA-231.strategy_analysis: 此EA并非自主交易策略，而是一个交互式交易面板工具。它通过CAdvancedEAPanel类创建包含标签页和侧边按钮的GUI界面，允许用户在图表上手动操作交易相关功能。入场和出场条件完全取决于用户与面板的交互，而非程序自动生成的信号。仓位管理和资金管理同样依赖用户手动输入，面板仅提供界面支持。面板支持标签页切换（至少两个标签页tab0和tab1）、侧边按钮操作（含展开/隐藏功能）、对象拖拽处理（如建议入场线的拖拽）以及编辑框输入处理。整体而言，这是一个半自动化交易辅助工具，不具备自动开仓能力。
EA-231.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an autonomous trading strategy but an interactive trading panel utility. It creates a GUI with tabs and side buttons via the CAdvancedEAPanel class, allowing users to manually operate trading-related functions on the chart. Entry and exit conditions depend entirely on user interaction with the panel rather than programmatically generated signals. Position sizing and money management also rely on manual user input, with the panel providing only the interface. The panel supports tab switching (at least two tabs: tab0 and tab1), side button operations (including expand/hide functionality), object drag handling (such as dragging a suggested entry line), and edit field input processing. Overall, this is a semi-automated trading assistance tool without autonomous position-opening capability.

EA-2312.name: Exp_StochasticCGOscillator
EA-2312.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the StochasticCGOscillator custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable permissions for entry and exit. Position sizing and risk management are handled through the TradeAlgorithms library with multiple margin mode options.
EA-2312.summary_zh: 该EA基于StochasticCGOscillator自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并可配置入场和出场的权限。仓位管理和风险管理通过TradeAlgorithms库实现，支持多种保证金模式。
EA-2312.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用StochasticCGOscillator指标作为核心策略引擎，这是一种基于随机指标的改良振荡器，用于捕捉动量变化。入场条件为：当指标线（Ind）从下方穿越信号线（Sign）时产生买入信号，当指标线从上方穿越信号线时产生卖出信号，采用交叉确认机制避免虚假信号。出场条件通过反向交叉信号触发，同时设置了固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），盈亏比为1:2。仓位管理方面，EA支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、自由保证金亏损比例、余额亏损比例和固定手数，默认使用固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制存款份额（默认0.1），但具体计算逻辑依赖外部TradeAlgorithms库。EA仅在新增K线时计算信号（SignalBar=0除外），避免逐tick重复计算，提高了效率。
EA-2312.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the StochasticCGOscillator indicator as its core strategy engine, which is a modified stochastic oscillator designed to capture momentum shifts. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator line crosses above the signal line from below, and a sell signal is generated when the indicator line crosses below the signal line from above, using a crossover confirmation mechanism to avoid false signals. Exit conditions are triggered by reverse crossover signals, with fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) providing a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin share, balance share, free margin loss share, balance loss share, and fixed lot, defaulting to fixed lot mode. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1 deposit share), though the actual calculation logic depends on the external TradeAlgorithms library. The EA only recalculates signals on new bars (unless SignalBar=0), avoiding redundant per-tick calculations for improved efficiency.

EA-2314.name: Exp_HighsLowsSignal
EA-2314.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom HighsLowsSignal indicator, which identifies directional price moves over a configurable number of candles. It opens buy positions on bullish signals and sell positions on bearish signals, with optional position closing on opposite signals. Lot sizing and risk management are handled via the included TradeAlgorithms library.
EA-2314.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义HighsLowsSignal指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标通过识别一定数量K线的方向性价格变化来产生信号。在看涨信号时开多仓，在看跌信号时开空仓，并可选择在出现反向信号时平仓。仓位和资金管理通过内置的TradeAlgorithms库实现。
EA-2314.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA使用HighsLowsSignal指标检测价格连续N根K线朝同一方向运动的趋势信号，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件：当指标的上行缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号Bar上输出非零非EMPTY_VALUE时开多仓，当下行缓冲区（buffer 0）输出有效值时开空仓。出场条件：支持StopLoss和TakeProfit固定点数出场，同时在出现反向信号时平仓（需开启BuyPosClose/SellPosClose权限），还会遍历历史Bar查找最近的反向信号作为平仓依据。仓位管理：通过MM参数控制每次交易占用资金的比例，支持多种保证金模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损比例等），默认使用固定手数(LOT)模式。资金管理：依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数执行交易，包含最大价格偏离(Deviation)参数来控制滑点。策略还使用IsNewBar机制确保每个Bar只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。
EA-2314.strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA uses the HighsLowsSignal indicator to detect directional price movement over a configurable number of consecutive candles, representing a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions: A buy signal is generated when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) outputs a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar; a sell signal is generated when the lower buffer (buffer 0) outputs a valid value. Exit conditions: The EA supports fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit exits in points, and optionally closes positions on opposite signals when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose permissions are enabled. It also scans historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal as an additional closing trigger for position direction determination. Position sizing: The MM parameter controls the share of deposit per trade, supporting multiple margin modes including free margin, balance, loss-proportion-based sizing, and fixed lot mode (default). Money management: Trade execution relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen) which incorporate a maximum price deviation (Deviation) parameter for slippage control. The strategy employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing redundant trade attempts within the same candle.

EA-2334.name: exp_dynamicrs_c
EA-2334.summary: This EA implements a dynamic RSI-based mean reversion strategy that identifies overbought and oversold conditions using an adaptive RSI indicator with dynamic threshold levels. It enters trades when RSI signals extreme deviations from the mean and exits upon reversion to neutral zones or when dynamic stop-loss/take-profit levels are hit.
EA-2334.summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于动态RSI的均值回归策略，通过自适应RSI指标和动态阈值水平来识别超买超卖状态。当RSI信号显示极端偏离均值时入场，在回归中性区域或触发动态止损/止盈时出场。
EA-2334.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用动态RSI（Relative Strength Index）作为核心策略指标，与传统的固定超买超卖阈值不同，它使用动态计算的阈值水平来适应市场波动变化。入场条件为：当RSI跌破动态下阈值时做多，当RSI突破动态上阈值时做空，这体现了均值回归的核心思想——价格极端偏离后将回归均值。出场条件包括RSI回归中性区域时平仓、以及基于ATR或动态计算的止损止盈水平。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，也可能根据账户风险比例动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面，动态止损和止盈的设置有助于控制单笔交易的风险敞口，但具体的资金管理策略细节取决于参数配置。
EA-2334.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dynamic RSI (Relative Strength Index) as its core strategy indicator, distinguishing itself from traditional fixed overbought/oversold thresholds by using dynamically calculated threshold levels that adapt to changing market volatility. Entry conditions are: go long when RSI drops below the dynamic lower threshold, and go short when RSI breaks above the dynamic upper threshold, embodying the core mean reversion philosophy that extreme price deviations will revert to the mean. Exit conditions include closing positions when RSI returns to the neutral zone, as well as hitting dynamically calculated stop-loss and take-profit levels based on ATR or similar volatility measures. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading and may also adjust position size dynamically based on account risk percentage. Money management benefits from dynamic stop-loss and take-profit settings that help control risk exposure per trade, though the specifics depend on the parameter configuration.

EA-2383.name: Exp_CronexMFI
EA-2383.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the CronexMFI custom indicator, which applies double smoothing to the Market Facilitation Index (MFI). It opens buy positions when the main MFI line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.
EA-2383.summary_zh: 该EA基于CronexMFI自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对市场促进指数(MFI)进行了双重平滑处理。当主线向上穿越信号线时开多仓，反之开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
EA-2383.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于CronexMFI指标的双重平滑MFI交叉信号，属于动量类策略。入场条件为：当指标主线(Ind)位于信号线(Sign)之上时，若前一根K线的主线低于或等于信号线（即刚发生向上交叉），则开多仓；反之，当主线在信号线之下且前一根K线发生向下交叉时，开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈（分别默认1000和2000点），以及信号反转时平仓（可独立开关控制）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，支持多种保证金模式包括固定手数(LOT)模式。资金管理支持四种模式：可用保证金比例、余额比例、考虑浮亏的可用保证金比例、考虑浮亏的余额比例以及固定手数。策略还通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复入场。
EA-2383.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on crossover signals from the CronexMFI indicator, which applies double smoothing (configurable smoothing method for fast and slow periods) to the Market Facilitation Index, classifying it as a momentum strategy. Entry conditions: when the main indicator line (Ind) is above the signal line (Sign) and the previous bar showed the main line at or below the signal line (upward crossover), a buy position is opened; conversely, when the main line is below the signal line and a downward crossover occurred, a sell position is opened. Exit conditions include configurable Stop Loss (default 1000 points) and Take Profit (default 2000 points), plus signal-reversal-based closing with independent enable/disable switches for buy and sell position closures. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1), supporting multiple margin modes including fixed lot size (LOT) mode. Money management supports four modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin accounting for floating loss, and percentage of balance accounting for floating loss, plus a fixed lot mode. The strategy also employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation happens only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries.

EA-2384.name: Exp_CronexRSI
EA-2384.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the CronexRSI custom indicator, which applies fast and slow smoothing to RSI values. It opens buy positions when the fast RSI line crosses above the slow signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable position closing on opposite signals. Position sizing is controlled by a money management module with multiple margin modes.
EA-2384.summary_zh: 该EA基于CronexRSI自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对RSI值应用快速和慢速平滑处理。当快速RSI线上穿慢速信号线时开多仓，反向交叉时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。仓位大小通过多种保证金模式的资金管理模块控制。
EA-2384.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于CronexRSI指标的双线交叉，本质上是对RSI进行两次不同周期的平滑处理后再判断动量方向变化。入场条件为：当快速平滑RSI线（Ind）从下方穿越慢速信号线（Sign）时产生买入信号，当快速线从上方穿越慢速信号线时产生卖出信号，交叉确认需要两根K线的对比。出场条件包括：反向交叉信号触发平仓、固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit设置。仓位管理采用多种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数五种模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1。该策略在H4周期上运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根已收盘K线进行信号判断，避免未来数据偷看问题。
EA-2384.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on dual-line crossover of the CronexRSI indicator, which essentially applies two different-period smoothing algorithms to RSI values to detect momentum direction changes. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the fast smoothed RSI line (Ind) crosses above the slow signal line (Sign), and a sell signal on the reverse crossover, requiring two bars for crossover confirmation. Exit conditions include: opposite crossover signals trigger position closing, and fixed StopLoss (1000 points) and TakeProfit (2000 points) settings. Position sizing supports five margin modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 risk ratio. The strategy operates on the H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1 meaning it evaluates the previous closed bar for signals, avoiding look-ahead bias.

EA-2396.name: CronexAC
EA-2396.summary: This EA trades based on the CronexAC (Accelerator Oscillator) indicator, generating buy and sell signals from AO and AC indicator crossovers and color changes. It opens positions when momentum acceleration confirms trend direction and closes them on signal reversal. The strategy is a systematic momentum-based approach relying on Bill Williams' Accelerator/Decelerator oscillator principles.
EA-2396.summary_zh: 该EA基于CronexAC（加速振荡器）指标进行交易，通过AO和AC指标的交叉及颜色变化生成买卖信号。当动量加速确认趋势方向时开仓，在信号反转时平仓。该策略是一个系统化的动量方法，基于比尔·威廉姆斯的加速/减速振荡器原理。
EA-2396.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于比尔·威廉姆斯的加速/减速（AC）振荡器，结合Cronex改进版本的信号平滑处理。入场条件为：做多时AC指标由红转绿（连续两根绿柱）且AO指标为正，做空时AC由绿转红（连续两根红柱）且AO指标为负。出场条件包括：反向信号出现时平仓、止损/止盈触发、或AC指标连续多根反向柱线确认趋势衰竭。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算，默认参数允许用户自定义手数大小。资金管理方面，EA提供止损和止盈参数设置，但默认止损可能较宽，存在一定回撤风险。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于动量确认型交易系统，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
EA-2396.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bill Williams' Accelerator/Decelerator (AC) oscillator, combined with Cronex's improved version for signal smoothing. Entry conditions: go long when AC indicator changes from red to green (two consecutive green bars) and AO is positive; go short when AC changes from green to red (two consecutive red bars) and AO is negative. Exit conditions include: closing on reverse signal appearance, stop-loss/take-profit triggers, or AC showing multiple consecutive opposite-color bars confirming trend exhaustion. Position sizing uses fixed lot size or percentage-based calculation of account balance, with default parameters allowing user-customized lot sizes. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameter settings, but default stop-loss may be wide, presenting some drawdown risk. The overall strategy logic is clear, belonging to the momentum confirmation trading system, suitable for markets with clear trending conditions.

EA-2397.name: exp_cronexao
EA-2397.summary: This EA implements a multi-timeframe Crossover strategy combining signals from higher and lower timeframes to determine trade direction. It uses moving average crossovers and momentum confirmation across different periods to generate entry and exit signals. The system includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-2397.summary_zh: 该EA实现了多周期交叉策略，结合高周期和低周期的信号来确定交易方向。它使用不同周期的均线交叉和动量确认来生成入场和出场信号。系统包含基本的风险管理功能，设有止损和止盈水平。
EA-2397.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于多时间框架的均线交叉系统，通过高周期判断主趋势方向，低周期寻找入场时机。入场条件要求高周期和低周期的均线交叉信号方向一致，并配合动量指标确认趋势强度。出场条件包括止损、止盈触发以及反向交叉信号出现时的主动平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未实现动态仓位调整。资金管理方面设有止损和止盈参数，但缺少最大回撤控制和仓位比例管理。整体策略逻辑较为传统，依赖均线交叉的滞后性特征，在震荡行情中可能产生较多虚假信号。
EA-2397.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a multi-timeframe moving average crossover system, using higher timeframes to determine the main trend direction and lower timeframes to find entry opportunities. Entry conditions require alignment of moving average crossover signals across both higher and lower timeframes, combined with momentum indicator confirmation of trend strength. Exit conditions include stop loss and take profit triggers, as well as active position closing when a reverse crossover signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic position adjustment. Money management includes stop loss and take profit parameters, but lacks maximum drawdown control and proportional position sizing. The overall strategy logic is relatively traditional, relying on the lagging nature of moving average crossovers, which may generate many false signals during ranging markets.
pros: 多周期分析有助于过滤低周期的虚假信号，提高入场质量
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数结构简单，便于优化和调整

EA-2398.name: exp_CronexDeMarker
EA-2398.summary: This EA trades based on the Cronex DeMarker oscillator, a smoothed variant of the standard DeMarker indicator. It opens buy positions when the oscillator crosses upward from oversold levels and sell positions when it crosses downward from overbought levels. The system includes customizable DeMarker periods, smoothing methods, and signal line parameters for trade generation.
EA-2398.summary_zh: 该EA基于Cronex DeMarker震荡指标进行交易，这是标准DeMarker指标的平滑变体。当震荡指标从超卖区域向上交叉时开多仓，从超买区域向下交叉时开空仓。系统包含可自定义的DeMarker周期、平滑方法和信号线参数。
EA-2398.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Cronex DeMarker震荡指标，该指标通过多重平滑处理使标准DeMarker曲线更加平滑，减少虚假信号。入场条件为：当主线从下方穿越信号线且处于超卖区域时做多，当主线从上方穿越信号线且处于超买区域时做空。出场条件依赖反向交叉信号或可配置的止损止盈设置。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺少基于账户余额或风险的动态计算，仅支持手动设定手数。整体策略属于动量反转混合型，利用震荡指标的超买超卖区间捕捉价格转折点。
EA-2398.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Cronex DeMarker oscillator, which applies multiple smoothing passes to the standard DeMarker curve to reduce false signals. Entry conditions are: go long when the main line crosses above the signal line in the oversold zone, and go short when the main line crosses below the signal line in the overbought zone. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or configurable stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management lacks dynamic calculation based on account balance or risk, supporting only manually set lot sizes. The overall strategy is a momentum-reversal hybrid type, capturing price turning points using oscillator overbought and oversold zones.

EA-2407.name: Cronex Chaikin
EA-2407.summary: This EA trades based on the Cronex Chaikin indicator, which is a modified Chaikin Oscillator that smooths the accumulation/distribution flow using moving averages. It generates buy and sell signals from crossover events of the Chaikin oscillator lines, entering positions when momentum shifts in the market. The EA is a systematic momentum-based trading system with configurable lot sizing and stop loss parameters.
EA-2407.summary_zh: 该EA基于Cronex Chaikin指标进行交易，该指标是经过移动平均平滑处理的改良版Chaikin震荡器。通过Chaikin震荡线的交叉事件产生买卖信号，在市场动量发生转变时开仓。该EA是一个系统化的动量交易系统，具有可配置的手数和止损参数。
EA-2407.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Chaikin震荡器，该指标通过计算累积/分布线的移动平均差值来衡量市场资金流向和动量变化。入场条件为Cronex Chaikin指标的主线与信号线发生交叉——主线上穿信号线时做多，下穿信号线时做空。出场条件依赖止损和止盈的设定，以及反向交叉信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，由MoneyFix参数控制每笔交易的手数。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数，但缺乏基于账户余额的动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的动量跟踪系统，但依赖单一指标信号可能导致震荡行情中频繁虚假信号。
EA-2407.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Chaikin Oscillator, which measures market money flow and momentum shifts by calculating the difference between moving averages of the accumulation/distribution line. Entry conditions are triggered when the Cronex Chaikin main line crosses its signal line — a bullish crossover generates a buy signal while a bearish crossover generates a sell signal. Exit conditions rely on configured stop loss and take profit levels, as well as position closure on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach controlled by the MoneyFix parameter for each trade. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameters but lacks dynamic position sizing based on account equity or risk percentage. The overall strategy logic is clear as a typical momentum-following system, but reliance on a single indicator can lead to frequent false signals during ranging markets.

EA-2415.name: JK synchro
EA-2415.summary: JK Synchro is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that generates trade signals by synchronizing multiple oscillator indicators (likely RSI, Stochastic, or similar) to identify aligned momentum shifts across different lookback periods. It enters trades when the synchronized momentum signals confirm a directional move and exits based on opposing signals or fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels.
EA-2415.summary_zh: JK Synchro是一个基于动量的EA，通过同步多个振荡器指标来产生交易信号，识别不同回溯周期下对齐的动量转换。当同步动量信号确认方向性走势时入场，并在出现反向信号或固定止盈止损时出场。
EA-2415.strategy_analysis: JK Synchro策略的核心概念是通过多个动量振荡器的同步信号来确认交易方向，减少单一指标的假信号干扰。入场条件要求多个振荡器在超买或超卖区域同时发出同向信号，形成共振效应后才开仓，例如多个RSI或随机指标同时从超卖区上穿或从超买区下穿。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及反向同步信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未发现动态仓位调整或基于资金比例的计算逻辑。资金管理方面较为薄弱，缺乏最大回撤控制、账户权益保护机制和连续亏损后的仓位缩减逻辑。整体策略依赖指标共振过滤噪音信号，但在趋势反转和震荡市中的适应性可能不足。
EA-2415.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the JK Synchro strategy is to confirm trade direction through synchronized signals from multiple momentum oscillators, reducing false signals from any single indicator. Entry conditions require multiple oscillators to simultaneously emit aligned signals from overbought or oversold zones, creating a resonance effect before opening a position, such as multiple RSI or Stochastic indicators crossing up from oversold or crossing down from overbought simultaneously. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, as well as closing positions when opposing synchronized signals appear. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic position adjustment or equity-proportional calculation logic found. Money management is relatively weak, lacking maximum drawdown controls, account equity protection mechanisms, and position reduction logic after consecutive losses. The overall strategy relies on indicator resonance to filter noise signals, but adaptability in trend reversals and ranging markets may be insufficient.

EA-2419.name: Exp_XPVT
EA-2419.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the XPVT (Volume Price Trend) custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit. Position sizing is managed via a money management module with multiple margin modes.
EA-2419.summary_zh: 该EA基于XPVT（量价趋势）自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损止盈。仓位管理通过资金管理模块实现，支持多种保证金模式。
EA-2419.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XPVT指标的趋势跟踪交叉系统。入场条件为：当指标线Ind上穿信号线Sign时产生买入信号，当Ind下穿Sign时产生卖出信号，具体通过比较相邻两根K线的Ind与Sign值关系来判断交叉。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发时的平仓机制（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于可用保证金减亏损、基于余额减亏损、以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），配合MMMode选择计算方式。策略使用SignalBar参数指定信号确认的K线位置，默认为1即前一根已收盘K线，这有助于避免未来数据偏差。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的单指标交叉趋势跟踪系统。
EA-2419.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following crossover system based on the XPVT (Volume Price Trend) indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator line Ind crosses above the signal line Sign, and a sell signal is generated when Ind crosses below Sign, detected by comparing Ind and Sign values across two consecutive bars. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus a reverse-signal close mechanism where an opposing crossover triggers position closure. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, free margin minus loss, balance minus loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1 risk ratio) combined with MMMode for calculation method selection. The strategy uses SignalBar (default 1) to specify which bar confirms the signal, using the previous closed bar to avoid look-ahead bias. The overall logic is clear and represents a typical single-indicator crossover trend-following system.

It opens and closes positions systematically based on momentum signals from the custom indicator's multiple smoothing layers.
EA-2423.summary_zh: 该EA基于William Blau的BlauHLM（遍历直方图）指标进行交易，支持三种信号模式：零线突破、直方图扭转和云图扭转。它根据自定义指标多层平滑处理后的动量信号系统性地开仓和平仓。
EA-2423.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于William Blau的Ergodic HLM指标，这是一种多层平滑的动量振荡器。策略提供三种入场模式：breakdown模式在直方图穿越零线时开仓——多方直方图从负转正时做多，从正转负时做空；twist模式在直方图方向发生扭转时开仓，即连续三个柱的直方图变化方向反转时触发信号；cloudtwist模式则比较上轨和下轨两条线的交叉来产生信号。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose），同时设置了固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持按固定手数或按账户保证金比例计算仓位。资金管理使用MarginMode枚举选择手数模式，默认0.1的比例。策略使用了多达四层不同长度的平滑处理来过滤噪声，这减少了假信号但也增加了滞后性。
EA-2423.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on William Blau's Ergodic HLM indicator, a multi-layer smoothed momentum oscillator. Three entry modes are provided: breakdown mode triggers when the histogram crosses the zero line — going long when it turns positive and short when it turns negative; twist mode triggers on histogram direction reversal, requiring three consecutive bars to confirm a momentum shift; cloudtwist mode compares the crossover of upper and lower cloud lines to generate signals. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals closing positions (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose), combined with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, which defaults to 0.1, supporting either fixed lot size or margin-proportional calculation via the MarginMode enum. The strategy employs up to four smoothing layers with different period lengths (XLength1-4) to filter noise, which reduces false signals but also increases lag. Money management uses the LOT/FIXED margin mode selection for flexible risk allocation.

EA-2438.name: Exp_JBrainTrend1Stop
EA-2438.summary: This EA trades based on the JBrainTrend1Stop custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend. It uses ATR and Stochastic oscillator inputs combined with JMA smoothing to determine trend direction and stop levels. Position sizing is configurable via money management modes, and trades are managed with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-2438.summary_zh: 该EA基于JBrainTrend1Stop自定义指标进行交易，在指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，在发出下降趋势信号时开空仓。它结合ATR和随机振荡器参数以及JMA平滑来确定趋势方向和止损水平。仓位大小可通过资金管理模式配置，交易使用可配置的止损和止盈进行管理。
EA-2438.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用JBrainTrend1Stop指标作为核心策略引擎，该指标结合ATR（平均真实范围）和随机振荡器（Stochastic）来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当上升趋势缓冲区有值且下降趋势缓冲区前一值为非零时开多仓；当下降趋势缓冲区有值且上升趋势缓冲区前一值为非零时开空仓。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时配合可配置的止损和止盈来控制风险。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于扣除亏损后的可用保证金、基于扣除亏损后的余额、以及固定手数。策略仅在检测到新K线时执行信号判断，避免重复交易。止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，风险回报比为1:2，较为合理。
EA-2438.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the JBrainTrend1Stop indicator as its core strategy engine, which combines ATR (Average True Range) and Stochastic oscillator to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the uptrend buffer has a value and the downtrend buffer's previous value was non-zero; a sell position opens when the downtrend buffer has a value and the uptrend buffer's previous value was non-zero. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing trend signals that close existing positions, supplemented by configurable stop loss and take profit levels for risk control. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. The strategy only evaluates signals on new bar detection, preventing redundant trades within the same bar. The default stop loss is set to 1000 points and take profit to 2000 points, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio which is reasonable.

EA-244.name: grr-al
EA-244.summary: This EA monitors each new bar's opening price and trades on a breakout of DELTA points from that level within the same bar. It enters a buy when price moves above the bar open by DELTA points, or a sell when it moves below by DELTA points, with fixed SL/TP and no position management. The strategy is a simple intrabar breakout system with no trailing stops or multi-position logic.
EA-244.summary_zh: 该EA监控每根新K线的开盘价，当价格在同一K线内突破开盘价上下DELTA点数时入场交易。买入条件为价格高于开盘价DELTA点，卖出条件为价格低于开盘价DELTA点，采用固定止损止盈且无持仓管理。这是一个简单的K线内突破策略，没有移动止损或多仓位逻辑。
EA-244.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于K线内突破的日内交易策略，利用新K线开盘价作为参考基准线，等待价格在K线周期内突破该基准线一定点数后顺势入场。入场条件为：在新K线形成后，若当前买价高于开盘价DELTA点则卖出（反向突破），若当前买价低于开盘价DELTA点则买入——注意这里的逻辑似乎是反向的，卖出在价格上涨时触发而买入在价格下跌时触发，存在逻辑错误嫌疑。出场条件为固定止损100点和止盈700点，风险回报比为1:7。仓位管理方面，当RISK为0时使用固定手数BASELOT=0.1，否则根据账户可用保证金的90%乘以RISK比例计算手数。资金管理存在冗余代码（RISK==0判断重复），且没有检查已有持仓数量，可能造成过度开仓。
EA-244.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is an intrabar breakout trading system that uses the new bar's opening price as a reference level, entering when price breaks away from that level by a defined DELTA within the same bar. Entry conditions: after a new bar forms, if the current bid price exceeds the bar open by DELTA points, a SELL order is placed; if the bid falls below the bar open by DELTA points, a BUY order is placed — notably the logic appears inverted, selling on upward breakouts and buying on downward breakouts, which suggests a possible logic error. Exit conditions use fixed stop loss of 100 points and take profit of 700 points, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:7. Position sizing uses a fixed BASELOT of 0.1 when RISK is 0, otherwise calculates lot size based on 90% of free margin multiplied by the RISK factor, capped at the broker's maximum lot. Money management has redundant code (duplicate RISK==0 check) and lacks any check for existing open positions, which could lead to over-trading on strong trending moves.

EA-248.name: CrossoverMA
EA-248.summary: This EA uses the MetaQuotes standard library CExpert framework to implement a moving average crossover strategy. It generates buy/sell signals based on a single SMA indicator via CSignalMA, uses no trailing stop, and manages risk with fixed lot sizing. The architecture is modular, delegating signal, trailing, and money management to separate plug-in objects.
EA-248.summary_zh: 该EA使用MetaQuotes标准库CExpert框架实现均线交叉策略。它通过CSignalMA基于单一SMA指标生成买卖信号，不使用追踪止损，并采用固定手数进行资金管理。架构模块化，将信号、追踪止损和资金管理分别委托给独立的插件对象。
EA-248.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于移动平均线交叉，当价格从下方穿越SMA向上时产生买入信号，从上方穿越SMA向下时产生卖出信号。入场条件完全依赖CSignalMA模块的内部逻辑，该模块比较价格与SMA的关系来判断趋势方向。出场条件由CExpert框架的默认逻辑处理，由于使用了CTrailingNone（无追踪止损），出场完全依赖框架的反向信号或止损/止盈设置。仓位管理采用CMoneyFixedLot固定手数模式，每笔交易使用0.1手的固定交易量，同时设置了10%的资金百分比参数但固定手数模式下该参数作用有限。资金管理方面缺乏动态调整机制，不会根据账户余额或波动率自适应调整仓位大小。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-248.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on moving average crossover, generating buy signals when price crosses above the SMA and sell signals when it crosses below. Entry conditions rely entirely on the CSignalMA module's internal logic, which compares price position relative to the SMA to determine trend direction. Exit conditions are handled by the CExpert framework's default logic; since CTrailingNone is used (no trailing stop), exits depend entirely on reverse signals or any stop-loss/take-profit set by the framework. Position sizing uses CMoneyFixedLot with a fixed 0.1 lot per trade, and while a 10% percent parameter is set, it has limited effect in fixed lot mode. Money management lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms — there is no adaptive position sizing based on account balance or market volatility. The overall strategy is simple and direct, suitable for strongly trending markets, but prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy conditions.

EA-250.name: ThreeEMA
EA-250.summary: This EA implements a triple Exponential Moving Average (EMA) crossover trend-following strategy using the MQL5 Standard Library framework. It generates trade signals based on the alignment of fast (5), medium (12), and slow (24) period EMAs, with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and uses fixed lot sizing for money management.
EA-250.summary_zh: 该EA基于MQL5标准库框架实现了三重指数移动平均线(EMA)交叉趋势跟踪策略。通过快速(5)、中速(12)和慢速(24)周期EMA的排列方向生成交易信号，采用固定止损止盈和固定手数进行资金管理。
EA-250.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用三条不同周期的EMA来判断趋势方向和入场时机。当快速EMA位于中速EMA之上、中速EMA位于慢速EMA之上时，视为上升趋势并做多；反之则做空。入场条件基于三线排列顺序的变化，即趋势形成或反转时开仓。出场条件采用固定点数的止损(400点)和止盈(900点)，止盈是止损的2.25倍，具有正的盈亏比。仓位管理采用固定手数模式(CMoneyFixedLot)，默认手数为0.1手，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理方面设定了10%的风险百分比参数，但由于使用固定手数，该参数实际作用于保证金计算而非动态仓位调整。策略未使用追踪止损(CTrailingNone)，完全依赖固定止盈止损出场。
EA-250.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is using three EMAs of different periods to determine trend direction and entry timing. When the fast EMA is above the medium EMA and the medium EMA is above the slow EMA, it identifies an uptrend and goes long; the opposite alignment signals a short entry. Entry conditions are based on the alignment order of the three lines, opening positions when a trend forms or reverses. Exit conditions use fixed point-based stop-loss (400 points) and take-profit (900 points), yielding a reward-to-risk ratio of 2.25:1 which is favorable. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default of 0.1 lots, not dynamically adjusting based on account balance. Money management sets a 10% risk percentage parameter, but since fixed lots are used, this parameter affects margin calculation rather than dynamic position sizing. The strategy does not use trailing stops (CTrailingNone), relying entirely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit for exits.

EA-258.name: MA_Crossover_ADX
EA-258.summary: This EA uses the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework to implement a trend-following strategy based on MA crossover confirmed by ADX strength. It enters trades when a moving average crossover occurs and the ADX value exceeds a minimum threshold, with fixed lot sizing and no trailing stop.
EA-258.summary_zh: 该EA基于MQL5标准库Expert框架，实现了以MA交叉信号并经ADX趋势强度确认的趋势跟踪策略。当移动平均线交叉且ADX值超过最低阈值时入场交易，采用固定手数仓位管理，无移动止损。
EA-258.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于移动平均线交叉与ADX趋势强度过滤相结合的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为移动平均线发生交叉信号，且ADX指标值必须高于设定的最低阈值（默认22.0），以此确保只在趋势足够明显时才开仓。出场条件依赖固定的止损（400点）和止盈（900点）设置，止盈目标是止损的2.25倍，体现了较好的盈亏比设计。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（默认0.1手），不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理使用CMoneyFixedLot类，虽然配置了百分比参数（10%），但实际为固定手数模式，缺乏动态风险调控。该策略未使用移动止损（TrailingNone），意味着无法在趋势运行中锁定浮动利润，存在利润回吐风险。
EA-258.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a trend-following system combining moving average crossover signals with ADX trend strength filtration. Entry conditions require a moving average crossover to occur and the ADX indicator value must exceed a configurable minimum threshold (default 22.0), ensuring trades are only opened when the trend is sufficiently strong. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (400 points) and take profit (900 points) levels, with a reward-to-risk ratio of 2.25:1, reflecting a solid profit factor design. Position sizing uses a fixed lot mode (default 0.1 lots) that does not dynamically adjust based on account balance or equity. Money management employs the CMoneyFixedLot class, which despite having a percentage parameter configured (10%), operates in fixed lot mode and lacks dynamic risk scaling. The strategy does not use any trailing stop (TrailingNone), meaning it cannot lock in floating profits during trending moves and risks significant profit givebacks.

EA-261.name: Crossover_2EMA
EA-261.summary: This EA implements a dual EMA crossover trend-following strategy using the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework. It generates buy signals when the fast EMA crosses above the slow EMA and sell signals on the opposite crossover. Position sizing is handled by a fixed lot money management module with no trailing stop applied.
EA-261.summary_zh: 该EA基于MQL5标准库Expert框架实现双EMA交叉趋势跟踪策略。当快速EMA上穿慢速EMA时产生买入信号，反之产生卖出信号。仓位管理采用固定手数资金管理模块，不使用移动止损。
EA-261.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的双指数移动平均线(EMA)交叉策略作为核心交易逻辑，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为快速EMA(默认12周期)上穿慢速EMA(默认24周期)时做多，快速EMA下穿慢速EMA时做空。出场条件依赖于信号反向交叉触发平仓，因为没有配置移动止损模块(TrailingNone)，持仓将一直保持直到反向信号出现。仓位管理采用固定手数方式(CMoneyFixedLot)，默认手数为0.1，资金管理百分比为10%。该策略没有设置止损和止盈，完全依赖信号反转来退出头寸，这在震荡行情中可能导致较大回撤。整体架构基于MQL5标准库的CExpert框架，模块化程度高，信号、移动止损、资金管理各自独立。
EA-261.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic dual Exponential Moving Average (EMA) crossover strategy as its core trading logic, representing a typical trend-following system. Entry conditions are a buy when the fast EMA (default period 12) crosses above the slow EMA (default period 24), and a sell on the opposite crossover. Exit conditions rely on the signal reversing via crossover since no trailing stop module is configured (TrailingNone), meaning positions are held until an opposing signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default lot size of 0.1 and a money management percentage of 10%. The strategy lacks explicit stop-loss and take-profit levels, depending entirely on signal reversal for position closure, which can lead to significant drawdowns during ranging markets. The overall architecture is built on the MQL5 Standard Library CExpert framework, offering high modularity with signal, trailing, and money management as independent components.

EA-262.name: TestMACD
EA-262.summary: This EA uses the standard MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisor framework with a MACD signal module to generate trade entries based on MACD histogram crossover logic. It employs fixed lot sizing with no trailing stop, relying on static stop-loss and take-profit levels for trade management. The EA is a boilerplate implementation built entirely from MQL5 standard library components.
EA-262.summary_zh: 该EA使用MetaTrader 5标准专家框架，配合MACD信号模块，基于MACD柱状图交叉逻辑产生交易入场信号。采用固定手数下单，无移动止损，依赖静态止损止盈管理仓位。整体为基于MQL5标准库组件的模板化实现。
EA-262.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是MACD动量交易，通过快速EMA（12周期）与慢速EMA（24周期）的差值构建MACD线，再以信号线（9周期）作为触发条件，当MACD柱状图出现交叉信号时开仓。入场条件由CSignalMACD类内部逻辑决定，通常为MACD线与信号线的金叉做多、死叉做空。出场条件完全依赖固定止损（90点）和固定止盈（110点），没有使用任何移动止损策略（CTrailingNone），这意味着盈利仓位不会锁定浮盈。仓位管理采用CMoneyFixedLot固定手数模式，每次交易固定0.1手，不考虑账户余额变化动态调整。资金管理方面，虽然设置了10%的百分比参数，但固定手数模式下该参数仅影响风险计算，实际下单量始终为0.1手，缺乏根据波动率或账户风险动态调整仓位的能力。整体策略简单直接，但缺乏对市场环境变化的自适应能力。
EA-262.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is MACD momentum trading, constructing the MACD line from the difference between a fast EMA (period 12) and a slow EMA (period 24), then using a signal line (period 9) as the trigger. Entry conditions are determined by the CSignalMACD class internally, typically going long on a golden cross of the MACD line above the signal line and going short on a death cross. Exit conditions rely entirely on a fixed stop-loss of 90 points and a fixed take-profit of 110 points, with no trailing stop strategy employed (CTrailingNone), meaning profitable positions will not lock in floating gains. Position sizing uses the CMoneyFixedLot fixed lot model, always trading 0.1 lots regardless of account balance changes. Although a 10% percent parameter is set, in fixed lot mode it only affects risk calculation while the actual order size remains constant at 0.1 lots, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust position size based on volatility or account risk. The overall strategy is straightforward but lacks adaptability to changing market conditions.

EA-264.name: Expert_2EMA_ITF
EA-264.summary: This EA uses a dual EMA crossover signal filtered by an ITF (Intraday Time Filter) module, which restricts trading to specific minutes, hours, and days. It combines fast/slow EMA crossover with ATR-based volatility limits and fixed-lot money management, placing pending orders with defined stop-loss, take-profit, and expiration.
EA-264.summary_zh: 该EA使用双EMA交叉信号，并通过ITF（日内时间过滤器）模块进行过滤，限制交易仅在特定的分钟、小时和星期进行。它结合快慢EMA交叉与基于ATR的波动率限制，采用固定手数资金管理，下达带有止损、止盈和过期时间的挂单。
EA-264.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双EMA交叉趋势跟踪，快EMA周期为5，慢EMA周期为30，当快线上穿慢线时做多，下穿时做空。入场条件不仅依赖EMA交叉，还通过ATR指标（周期7）和Limit参数（1.2）过滤低波动率行情，避免在震荡区间入场。出场条件使用固定点数的止损（5.0）和止盈（8.0），并通过订单过期时间（4根K线）自动取消未成交挂单。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（0.1手），不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理使用CMoneyFixedLot类，设置了10%的百分比参数但实际手数为固定值，没有动态仓位缩放机制。ITF时间过滤器允许用户指定好的交易分钟/小时/星期和排除坏的时段，有效避免低流动性或高波动时段的假信号。策略没有追踪止损，使用CTrailingNone表示持仓后不动态调整止损位。
EA-264.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual EMA crossover trend-following approach with a fast EMA period of 5 and a slow EMA period of 30, going long when the fast EMA crosses above the slow EMA and short on the reverse crossover. Entry conditions are further filtered by an ATR indicator (period 7) with a Limit parameter (1.2) to avoid entering during low-volatility consolidation phases. Exit conditions use fixed stop-loss (5.0) and take-profit (8.0) levels, with pending orders automatically cancelled after an expiration of 4 bars if not filled. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (0.1 lots) that does not dynamically scale based on account equity or balance. Money management employs the CMoneyFixedLot class with a 10% percent parameter, but the actual lot size remains fixed without any dynamic position scaling mechanism. The ITF (Intraday Time Filter) module allows users to specify good and bad trading minutes, hours, and days of the week, effectively avoiding false signals during low-liquidity or high-volatility sessions. The strategy uses no trailing stop (CTrailingNone), meaning stop-loss levels are not dynamically adjusted once a position is opened.

EA-267.name: Expert_Alligator
EA-267.summary: This EA implements Bill Williams' Alligator indicator strategy for trend-following trading. It uses the standard MQL5 Expert Advisor framework with CSignalAlligator to generate buy/sell signals based on the alignment and crossover of the Jaw, Teeth, and Lips smoothed moving averages. Position sizing is handled by a fixed lot money management module with no trailing stop applied.
EA-267.summary_zh: 该EA实现了比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标策略进行趋势跟踪交易。它使用标准MQL5专家顾问框架，通过CSignalAlligator根据颚、齿、唇三条平滑移动平均线的排列和交叉来生成买卖信号。仓位管理采用固定手数资金管理模块，未使用追踪止损。
EA-267.strategy_analysis: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标策略，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件依赖三条平滑移动平均线（颚线13周期偏移8、齿线8周期偏移5、唇线5周期偏移3）的排列状态：当唇线在齿线上方且齿线在颚线上方时产生做多信号，反之产生做空信号，CrossMeasure参数(5)用于确认交叉的有效性。出场条件由Expert框架的默认逻辑处理，信号反转时平仓并开反向仓，但未设置明确的止损止盈。仓位管理采用CMoneyFixedLot固定手数模式，固定交易0.1手，Percent参数(10.0)用于风险百分比计算。资金管理方面，固定手数模式不根据账户余额动态调整，缺乏自适应风险控制机制。未使用追踪止损(CTrailingNone)，意味着盈利头寸无法通过移动止损锁定利润。
EA-267.strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements Bill Williams' Alligator indicator strategy, a classic trend-following system. Entry conditions rely on the alignment of three smoothed moving averages (Jaw: period 13 shift 8, Teeth: period 8 shift 5, Lips: period 5 shift 3): a buy signal is generated when Lips are above Teeth and Teeth are above Jaw, and vice versa for sell signals, with the CrossMeasure parameter (5) confirming the validity of crossovers. Exit conditions are handled by the Expert framework's default logic, closing positions and opening reversals when signals invert, but no explicit stop-loss or take-profit levels are set. Position sizing uses the CMoneyFixedLot fixed lot model, trading a constant 0.1 lots, with the Percent parameter (10.0) used for risk percentage calculations. Money management lacks adaptive risk control since the fixed lot model does not dynamically adjust position size based on account balance or volatility. The absence of a trailing stop (CTrailingNone) means profitable positions have no mechanism to lock in gains through a moving stop-loss.

EA-268.name: Expert_Candles
EA-268.summary: This EA uses the CSignalCandles signal module to detect candlestick patterns within a configurable range of bars. It opens buy or sell positions based on pattern recognition, with fixed lot sizing and no trailing stop. The strategy relies on shadow ratio analysis (big vs small shadows) to identify qualifying candlestick formations.
EA-268.summary_zh: 该EA使用CSignalCandles信号模块检测可配置K线范围内的K线形态。基于形态识别开立买入或卖出仓位，采用固定手数且无追踪止损。策略依赖影线比率分析（大影线与小影线）来识别符合条件的K线形态。
EA-268.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于K线形态识别，通过分析指定范围内K线的影线比例来发现交易信号。入场条件由CSignalCandles模块驱动，当检测到大影线超过ShadowBig阈值且小影线低于ShadowSmall阈值的K线形态时触发交易。出场条件依赖固定的止损（StopLoss=2.0）和止盈（TakeProfit=1.0）比例设置，同时订单设有4根K线的过期时间。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（CMoneyFixedLot），默认0.1手，不进行动态调整。资金管理使用MoneyFixedLot模块，Percent参数设为10%但实际采用固定手数，缺乏根据账户余额动态调整仓位的能力。整体策略属于典型的K线形态识别系统，使用MetaQuotes标准库组件构建。
EA-268.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on candlestick pattern recognition, analyzing shadow ratios within a specified range of bars to discover trading signals. Entry conditions are driven by the CSignalCandles module, triggering trades when candlestick patterns with shadows exceeding the ShadowBig threshold and shadows below the ShadowSmall threshold are detected. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss (StopLoss=2.0) and take-profit (TakeProfit=1.0) ratio settings, with orders having a 4-bar expiration time. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot), defaulting to 0.1 lots without dynamic adjustment. Money management employs the MoneyFixedLot module where the Percent parameter is set to 10% but actual sizing uses fixed lots, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust positions based on account balance. The overall strategy is a typical candlestick pattern recognition system built using MetaQuotes standard library components.
pros: 使用MetaQuotes标准库组件，代码结构规范清晰，易于理解和维护
具备完整的参数验证机制（ValidationSettings），防止无效参数导致运行时错误
止损止盈比率可配置，且基于ATR倍数动态调整，适应不同市场波动性
pros_en: Uses MetaQuotes standard library components with clean, well-structured code that is easy to understand and maintain

Configurable stop-loss and take-profit ratios based on ATR multiples, adapting to different market volatilities

No trailing stop mechanism (CTrailingNone), potentially missing opportunities to lock in floating profits
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, which may lead to unfavorable fills during low-liquidity or high-spread periods
Risk-reward ratio of 1:2 (TP:SL) requires a high win rate to maintain positive expectancy
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和风险比例自动计算交易手数
添加追踪止损模块（如CTrailingFixedPips或CTrailingMA），以在趋势延续时保护浮盈
增加点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在高点差和低流动性时段开仓
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that automatically calculates lot size based on account balance and risk percentage
Implement a trailing stop module (e.g., CTrailingFixedPips or CTrailingMA) to protect floating profits during trend continuation
Add spread filter and trading session control to avoid opening positions during high-spread and low-liquidity periods

EA-271.name: RouletteGame
EA-271.summary: This is a graphical roulette game implemented as an MQL5 Expert Advisor, using chart objects to simulate a casino roulette experience. It does not perform any actual trading; instead it provides an interactive gambling game overlay on the MT5 chart. Users can place bets on roulette numbers, colors, and amounts through clickable chart objects.
EA-271.summary_zh: 这是一个以MQL5 EA形式实现的图形化轮盘赌游戏，利用图表对象在MT5图表上模拟赌场轮盘体验。它不执行任何实际交易，而是提供一个交互式赌博游戏界面，用户可以通过点击图表对象在轮盘数字、颜色和下注金额上进行投注。
EA-271.strategy_analysis: 这不是一个交易策略EA，而是一个娱乐性质的轮盘赌游戏工具。核心逻辑封装在CRouletteGame类中，通过CreateGameObjects创建所有图形界面元素，包括0-36的轮盘数字按钮、红黑颜色按钮、下注金额按钮（100到100万及全部押注）以及新游戏、退出游戏、开始游戏等控制按钮。入场条件不适用，因为此EA不开仓交易；取而代之的是用户点击图表对象触发游戏交互。出场条件同样不适用，游戏轮次由Play按钮控制。仓位管理和资金管理均不涉及金融交易，而是游戏内的虚拟筹码管理，提供从100到100万的多种下注选项。OnChartEvent事件处理函数监听所有游戏对象的点击事件，并将点击的对象名称传递给ClickGameObjects方法进行相应处理。
EA-271.strategy_analysis_en: This is not a trading strategy EA but rather an entertainment-oriented roulette game utility. The core logic is encapsulated in the CRouletteGame class, which creates all graphical interface elements via CreateGameObjects, including roulette number buttons (0-36), red/black color buttons, bet amount buttons (100 to 1 million plus all-in), and control buttons for new game, exit game, and play. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not open financial positions; instead, user clicks on chart objects trigger game interactions. Exit conditions are similarly inapplicable, as game rounds are controlled by the Play button. Position sizing and money management do not involve financial trading but rather virtual chip management within the game, offering multiple bet options ranging from 100 to 1 million. The OnChartEvent handler listens for click events on all game objects and passes the clicked object name to the ClickGameObjects method for processing. The game supports chart change persistence through the Load flag, preserving game state when the chart symbol or timeframe changes.

EA-275.name: bobnaley
EA-275.summary: This EA opens long positions when the Moving Average is rising, price is above MA, and Stochastic is rising from below the oversold level. It opens short positions when the MA is falling, price is below MA, and Stochastic is declining from above the overbought level. Position sizing is dynamically calculated based on free margin with a maximum lot cap of 15.
EA-275.summary_zh: 该EA在均线上升、价格高于均线且随机指标从超卖区域上升时开多仓；在均线下降、价格低于均线且随机指标从超买区域下降时开空仓。仓位大小根据可用保证金动态计算，最大手数上限为15手。
EA-275.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用均线与随机指标组合的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件：做多要求MA连续3根K线递增（maVal[0]<maVal[1]<maVal[2]表示索引0为最新值，但代码中maVal[0]<maVal[1]实际上表示MA下降，存在逻辑错误）、Ask价格高于MA最新值、随机指标从下方上升且主值低于超卖线30；做空要求MA连续3根递减、Bid价格低于MA、随机指标下降且主值高于超买线70。出场条件完全依赖固定止盈止损，做多止损为Ask-StopLoss、止盈为Ask+TakeProfit，做空反之。仓位管理使用Money_M()函数，根据账户可用保证金按公式（可用保证金/100000*50）计算手数，并限制在0.1至15手之间，根据手数大小进行不同精度的小数规范化。资金管理要求可用保证金大于5000才允许开仓，且仅允许同时持有一个品种的头寸。值得注意的是代码中存在明显逻辑错误：MA上升条件写成了maVal[0]<maVal[1]（实际是MA下降），与注释描述完全相反。
EA-275.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a combined Moving Average and Stochastic oscillator trend-following strategy. Entry conditions for longs require the MA to be consecutively rising over 3 bars, the Ask price above the current MA value, Stochastic rising and below the oversold level of 30. Entry for shorts requires MA consecutively declining, Bid below MA, and Stochastic declining above the overbought level of 70. However, there is a critical logic bug: the buy condition uses maVal[0]<maVal[1]<maVal[2], which actually checks for MA decreasing (since index 0 is the most recent value from CopyBuffer), contradicting the comment that says 'MA increases'. Exit relies entirely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels with no trailing stop or dynamic exit. Position sizing is calculated via Money_M() using free margin divided by 100000 multiplied by 50, clamped between 0.1 and 15 lots with variable decimal normalization. Money management requires at least 5000 in free margin and restricts to one position per symbol at a time. The StopLoss and TakeProfit input values appear to be in price units (0.0035 and 0.007) rather than points, which may cause issues depending on the symbol's price scale.

parameters.name: Lot
parameters.description: 手数（未使用，实际由Money_M()计算）
parameters.description_en: 手数（未使用，实际由Money_M()计算）

pros: 使用双重指标（MA+随机指标）过滤信号，减少假突破
动态仓位管理根据账户资金调整手数，有一定自适应能力
设有最大手数限制（15手）和最低保证金要求（5000），防止过度杠杆
仅允许单品种单持仓，避免同方向加仓风险
pros_en: Dual indicator filter (MA + Stochastic) reduces false breakout signals
Dynamic position sizing adapts lot size to account equity for some self-adaptation
Maximum lot cap (15) and minimum free margin requirement (5000) prevent excessive leverage
Single position per symbol restriction avoids pyramiding risk on the same direction
cons: MA方向判断存在严重逻辑错误：买入条件中maVal[0]<maVal[1]实际表示MA下降而非上升，与策略意图完全相反
StopLoss和TakeProfit使用价格单位而非点数，在不同报价精度品种上可能失效
输入参数Lot=5完全未使用，Money_M()函数覆盖了手动设置，造成用户误解
缺少新K线检测，每个tick都可能触发信号判断，存在重复开仓隐患
未检查交易执行结果，PositionOpen返回值被忽略
止盈止损值硬编码为绝对价格偏移，未根据ATR或波动率动态调整
cons_en: Critical logic bug in MA direction check: maVal[0]<maVal[1] actually means MA is declining not rising, completely reversing the intended strategy logic
StopLoss and TakeProfit use price units instead of points, which may fail on symbols with different quote precision
The Lot input parameter (5) is completely unused as Money_M() overrides it, misleading the user
No new bar detection means signal logic runs every tick, risking redundant trade attempts
Trade execution result from PositionOpen is not checked, so failed orders go unnoticed
Fixed SL/TP values without ATR or volatility-based dynamic adjustment limit adaptability across instruments
improvements: 修复MA方向判断逻辑错误：买入条件应改为maVal[0]>maVal[1]&&maVal[1]>maVal[2]，卖出条件改为maVal[0]<maVal[1]&&maVal[1]<maVal[2]
将止盈止损改为点数单位并使用NormalizeDouble与品种点值适配，或改用ATR动态计算

Convert SL/TP to point-based units with symbol tick size normalization, or use ATR-based dynamic calculation
Add new bar detection (e.g. compare current vs previous bar time) to avoid redundant per-tick signal evaluation and trade attempts
Check PositionOpen return value and handle trade failures, remove the unused Lot input parameter or integrate it into money management logic

risk_points: MA方向判断逻辑与策略意图完全相反，可能导致逆势开仓，在上涨趋势中做空、下跌趋势中做多
止盈止损使用价格绝对值而非点数，在5位数报价或不同品种上可能产生极小或极大的实际止损范围
每tick执行信号判断而无新K线过滤，在快速行情中可能因PositionSelect判断延迟导致重复开仓

risk_points_en: MA direction logic is reversed from strategy intent, potentially causing counter-trend entries: shorting in uptrends and buying in downtrends
SL/TP using absolute price values instead of points may produce extremely small or large stop ranges on 5-digit quotes or different instruments
Per-tick signal evaluation without new bar filtering could lead to duplicate position attempts during fast market moves due to PositionSelect latency
Unchecked trade execution results mean SL/TP levels rejected by the server would silently fail, leaving positions unprotected

EA-276.name: SyncCharts
EA-276.summary: SyncCharts is a chart synchronization utility EA that keeps all open charts in the terminal aligned with the first (main) chart's view settings. It syncs chart mode, timeframe, scale, shift/border, and scroll position from the main chart to all other charts every second via a timer.
EA-276.summary_zh: SyncCharts是一个图表同步工具EA，它通过每秒定时器将终端中所有打开的图表与第一个（主）图表的视图设置保持一致。它同步主图表的图表模式、时间周期、缩放、偏移和滚动位置到所有其他图表。
EA-276.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略EA，而是一个图表同步工具。它通过定时器（每秒触发一次）检测主图表（ChartFirst返回的图表）的当前视图状态，包括图表模式（蜡烛图/线图等）、时间周期、缩放级别、右侧偏移和首个可见柱的位置。然后将这些属性同步到当前图表，确保多个图表保持一致的视图。同步采用级联式条件判断：先检查模式，再检查周期，再检查偏移，再检查缩放，最后检查滚动位置，只有存在差异时才执行更新。该EA没有任何入场或出场逻辑，不涉及仓位管理和资金管理，仅用于多图表视图协调。它使用CExpert基类进行初始化，但实际上并未利用任何交易功能。
EA-276.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a chart synchronization utility. It uses a 1-second timer to detect the main chart's (returned by ChartFirst) current view state, including chart mode (candles/line etc.), timeframe, scale level, right shift, and first visible bar position. It then synchronizes these properties to the current chart, ensuring multiple charts maintain a consistent view. The synchronization uses cascading conditional checks: first mode, then period, then border shift, then scale, and finally scroll position, only executing updates when differences are detected. The EA has no entry or exit logic, no position sizing or money management, and is purely for multi-chart view coordination. It uses the CExpert base class for initialization but does not actually utilize any trading functionality.
pros: 实现多图表视图同步，提升多时间周期分析效率
级联式条件判断避免不必要的重复更新，逻辑清晰
自动识别主图表和从图表，使用简单无需复杂配置
pros_en: Implements multi-chart view synchronization, improving multi-timeframe analysis efficiency
Cascading conditional checks avoid unnecessary redundant updates, logic is clear
Automatically identifies main and secondary charts, simple to use without complex configuration
cons: 仅同步非主图表，无法双向同步视图变化
1秒定时器间隔可能导致同步延迟，快速滚动时体验不佳
使用了CExpert类但不进行交易，初始化开销不必要，代码架构冗余
cons_en: Only synchronizes non-main charts, cannot bidirectionally sync view changes
1-second timer interval may cause sync lag, poor experience during fast scrolling
Uses CExpert class without trading, unnecessary initialization overhead and redundant architecture
improvements: 移除CExpert依赖，简化初始化流程，减少不必要的资源开销
改用CHARTEVENT_CHART_CHANGE事件代替定时器轮询，实现实时响应式同步
improvements_en: Remove CExpert dependency, simplify initialization flow, and reduce unnecessary resource overhead
Replace timer polling with CHARTEVENT_CHART_CHANGE event for real-time responsive synchronization

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，无资金风险
频繁调用ChartSetSymbolPeriod可能影响图表加载性能
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trading operations, no financial risk
Frequent calls to ChartSetSymbolPeriod may affect chart loading performance

EA-280.name: OnTick(string symbol)
EA-280.summary: This is a multicurrency event handler template that extends the standard OnTick() to receive tick events for multiple symbols simultaneously. It does not implement any trading logic itself, serving as a framework for building multicurrency EAs.
EA-280.summary_zh: 这是一个多货币事件处理器模板，扩展了标准OnTick()以同时接收多个交易品种的tick事件。它本身不实现任何交易逻辑，作为构建多货币EA的框架使用。
EA-280.strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略，而是一个多货币事件处理框架模板。它通过自定义的OnTick(string symbol)事件处理器替代标准的OnTick()函数，使得EA能够同时监听多个交易品种的tick事件。交易品种列表通过SYMBOLS_TRADING宏定义配置，支持手动指定品种列表或使用Market Watch中所有品种。事件类型通过CHART_EVENT_SYMBOL宏定义为CHARTEVENT_TICK，表示监听tick级别的事件。核心逻辑封装在包含文件OnTick(string symbol).mqh中，模板本身仅提供架构骨架，不包含任何入场、出场、仓位管理或资金管理逻辑。用户需要在此基础上自行添加交易策略代码。
EA-280.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a multicurrency event handling framework template. It replaces the standard OnTick() function with a custom OnTick(string symbol) event handler, enabling the EA to listen to tick events from multiple symbols simultaneously. The symbol list is configured via the SYMBOLS_TRADING macro definition, supporting either a manually specified list or all symbols from Market Watch. The event type is defined as CHARTEVENT_TICK via the CHART_EVENT_SYMBOL macro, indicating tick-level event monitoring. The core logic is encapsulated in the include file OnTick(string symbol).mqh, and the template itself only provides an architectural skeleton without any entry, exit, position sizing, or money management logic. Users must add their own trading strategy code on top of this framework.

Supports flexible symbol configuration - both manual specification and automatic Market Watch reading

Core implementation relies on the external include file OnTick(string symbol).mqh, making it impossible to independently evaluate the complete mechanism

EA-281.name: eKeyboardTrader
EA-281.summary: eKeyboardTrader is a semi-automated trading utility that allows traders to execute buy, sell, and close operations via keyboard shortcuts (b, s, c) on the MetaTrader 5 chart. It provides an interactive on-chart interface for modifying lot size, stop loss, take profit, and slippage parameters through keyboard input without using the standard trade dialog.
EA-281.summary_zh: eKeyboardTrader是一个半自动交易工具，允许交易者通过键盘快捷键（b、s、c）在MetaTrader 5图表上执行买入、卖出和平仓操作。它提供了一个交互式图表界面，可通过键盘输入修改手数、止损、止盈和滑点参数，无需使用标准交易对话框。
EA-281.strategy_analysis: 此EA并非基于策略信号的自动交易系统，而是一个键盘驱动的手动交易执行工具。入场条件完全由交易者通过键盘按键决定：按'b'键买入，按's'键卖出，按'c'键平仓。出场条件同样由交易者手动设定止损和止盈点数。仓位管理方面，默认手数为品种最小交易量，可通过按'i'键进入输入模式修改手数、止损、止盈和滑点。资金管理方面，该EA未实现任何自动资金管理逻辑，所有风险控制均依赖交易者手动设置。该工具内置了1秒的交易间隔限制以防止重复触发，但除此之外没有其他风险控制机制。
EA-281.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an automated strategy-based trading system but rather a keyboard-driven manual trade execution utility. Entry conditions are entirely determined by the trader via keyboard shortcuts: 'b' for buy, 's' for sell, and 'c' for close position. Exit conditions are also manually set by the trader through configurable stop loss and take profit values in points. Position sizing defaults to the symbol's minimum volume and can be modified through the input mode accessed by pressing 'i' to change lots, stop loss, take profit, and slippage. Money management is completely absent from the EA's logic — all risk control relies on the trader's manual configuration. The tool implements a 1-second trade interval limit to prevent rapid repeated execution, but offers no other built-in risk safeguards beyond that.

EA-283.name: Expert_ABC_WS_Stoch
EA-283.summary: This EA uses a Stochastic oscillator combined with a moving average filter (CBC_WS_Stoch) to generate trading signals within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework. It employs fixed lot sizing for money management and no trailing stop, relying on the signal thresholds to open and close positions based on overbought/oversold mean reversion logic.
EA-283.summary_zh: 该EA使用随机指标(Stochastic)结合移动平均线过滤器(CBC_WS_Stoch)在MQL5标准库EA框架内生成交易信号。它采用固定手数进行资金管理，不使用追踪止损，依赖信号阈值在超买/超卖均值回归逻辑下开仓和平仓。
EA-283.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于Stochastic随机指标与移动平均线的组合信号过滤器CBC_WS_Stoch。入场条件基于Stochastic指标的超买超卖区域判断，结合MA周期为5的短期移动平均线作为辅助过滤，当综合信号强度超过开仓阈值(默认40)时开仓，低于平仓阈值(默认20)时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数模式(MoneyFixedLot)，默认手数为0.1，不随账户余额动态调整。资金管理方面，设置了10%的百分比参数，但实际使用固定手数，风险控制相对简单。没有设置止损(Signal_StopLevel=0)和止盈(Signal_TakeLevel=0)，完全依赖信号反转来平仓，这意味着如果信号不及时反转，可能面临较大亏损。未使用追踪止损(TrailingNone)，出场仅靠信号触发或挂单过期(4根K线)，整体策略偏向均值回归思路。
EA-283.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the CBC_WS_Stoch signal filter, which combines the Stochastic oscillator with a short-period moving average (MA period=5). Entry conditions rely on the Stochastic indicator's overbought/oversold zones, with the MA serving as an auxiliary filter; a trade is opened when the composite signal strength exceeds the open threshold (default 40) and closed when it falls below the close threshold (default 20). Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (MoneyFixedLot) with a default of 0.1 lots, which does not dynamically adjust based on account balance or equity. Money management sets a 10% percent parameter but effectively uses fixed lots, making risk control relatively simplistic. Notably, there is no stop loss (Signal_StopLevel=0) and no take profit (Signal_TakeLevel=0), meaning the EA relies entirely on signal reversal for exits, which can lead to significant losses if signals fail to reverse in time. No trailing stop is used (TrailingNone), and exits are triggered solely by signal changes or pending order expiration (4 bars), reflecting a mean reversion philosophy overall.
pros: 基于MQL5标准库Expert框架开发，代码结构规范清晰，模块化设计易于扩展
Stochastic与MA组合过滤减少了虚假信号，非标准K周期(47)可避免常见参数拥堵
信号阈值机制(开仓40/平仓20)提供了灵活的信号灵敏度控制，可适应不同市场环境
pros_en: Built on the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework with clean, modular code structure that is easy to extend
Stochastic + MA combination filter reduces false signals; the non-standard K period (47) avoids common parameter congestion
Signal threshold mechanism (open=40/close=20) provides flexible signal sensitivity control adaptable to different market conditions
cons: 没有设置止损和止盈(Signal_StopLevel=0, Signal_TakeLevel=0)，单笔交易风险敞口无限
固定手数资金管理不随账户增长动态调整，无法实现复利效应也不适应不同账户规模

EA-286.name: Expert_ABC_WS_CCI
EA-286.summary: This EA uses a CCI (Commodity Channel Index) indicator smoothed by a Moving Average as its core signal filter within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework. It opens and closes positions based on threshold-based signal logic, employs no trailing stop, and uses fixed lot money management. The strategy relies on CCI momentum shifts confirmed by MA smoothing to generate trade signals.
EA-286.summary_zh: 该EA使用CCI（商品通道指标）配合移动平均线平滑作为核心信号过滤器，基于MQL5标准库专家顾问框架构建。它根据阈值信号逻辑开仓和平仓，不使用追踪止损，采用固定手数资金管理。策略依赖CCI动量变化并经MA平滑确认后产生交易信号。
EA-286.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于CCI动量指标结合MA平滑滤波来捕捉市场动量变化方向。入场条件由CCI周期（默认37）计算动量值，再通过MA周期（默认13）进行平滑处理，当综合信号强度超过开仓阈值（默认40）时触发入场。出场条件为信号强度低于平仓阈值（默认20）时平仓，同时支持止盈止损设置但默认值为0即未启用。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（默认0.1手），不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理使用CMoneyFixedLot类，以固定百分比（默认10%）和固定手数进行配置，没有动态风险调整机制。整体策略属于标准库框架下的动量跟踪型系统，逻辑清晰但缺乏自适应和动态风控能力。
EA-286.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on combining the CCI momentum indicator with MA smoothing to capture directional momentum shifts in the market. Entry conditions are triggered when the CCI (period 37 by default) generates a momentum value that is smoothed by a Moving Average (period 13 by default), and the composite signal strength exceeds the opening threshold (default 40 on a 0-100 scale). Exit conditions occur when the signal strength falls below the closing threshold (default 20), with optional stop loss and take profit levels that default to zero (disabled). Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach (default 0.1 lots) without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management relies on the CMoneyFixedLot class configured with a fixed percentage (default 10%) and fixed lot size, lacking any dynamic risk scaling mechanism. The overall strategy is a momentum-following system within the MQL5 Standard Library framework, with clear logic but limited adaptability and no dynamic risk controls.

EA-287.name: Expert_ABC_WS_MFI
EA-287.summary: This EA uses the MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator smoothed by a Moving Average as a momentum signal filter within the MetaQuotes standard Expert Advisor framework. It opens and closes positions based on threshold-based signal logic from the CBC_WS_MFI filter, with fixed lot sizing and no trailing stop. The strategy relies on the weighted MFI signal crossing configurable open/close thresholds to generate trade decisions.
EA-287.summary_zh: 该EA使用MFI（市场促进指数）指标经移动平均平滑后作为动量信号过滤器，在MetaQuotes标准专家顾问框架内运行。它基于CBC_WS_MFI过滤器的阈值信号逻辑来开仓和平仓，采用固定手数且无追踪止损。策略依赖加权MFI信号穿越可配置的开仓/平仓阈值来生成交易决策。
EA-287.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于MFI（市场促进指数）指标与移动平均线的组合，属于动量类交易策略。入场条件由CBC_WS_MFI过滤器生成信号值，当信号值超过开仓阈值（默认10）时开仓，超过平仓阈值时平仓。MFI指标周期设为37，MA平滑周期设为13，权重为1.0，表明该过滤器是唯一的信号来源且完全控制交易方向。出场条件依赖于信号阈值反向穿越以及固定的止损（50点）和止盈（50点）设置。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（CMoneyFixedLot），默认手数为0.1，资金百分比为10%，不进行动态仓位调整。资金管理较为简单，缺乏根据账户余额或波动性自适应调整仓位的机制。挂单有效期为4根K线，策略不使用追踪止损，意味着盈利后无法锁定浮动利润。
EA-287.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the combination of the MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator with a Moving Average smoother, classifying it as a momentum-type trading strategy. Entry conditions are generated by the CBC_WS_MFI filter, which produces a signal value that triggers a trade when it exceeds the open threshold (default 10) and closes when it exceeds the close threshold. The MFI indicator period is set to 37, the MA smoothing period is 13, and the weight is 1.0, indicating this filter is the sole signal source with full control over trade direction. Exit conditions rely on the signal threshold being crossed in the opposite direction along with fixed stop loss (50 points) and take profit (50 points) levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default lot size of 0.1 and a money percentage of 10%, with no dynamic position adjustment. Money management is simplistic, lacking any mechanism to adapt lot size based on account balance or market volatility. Pending orders expire after 4 bars, and the strategy uses no trailing stop, meaning floating profits cannot be locked in after favorable price movement.
