EA-15228.name: Exp_SilverTrend
EA-15228.summary: This EA trades based on the SilverTrend_Signal custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and optional position closing on reverse signals. The strategy is a signal-based breakout system that enters on new bar formations when the indicator produces non-empty values.
EA-15228.summary_zh: 该EA基于SilverTrend_Signal自定义指标进行交易，在指标产生上穿信号时开多仓，下穿信号时开空仓。支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，以及反向信号平仓功能。策略属于信号驱动型突破系统，在新K线形成且指标产生有效值时入场。
EA-15228.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用SilverTrend_Signal指标检测趋势突破信号进行交易。入场条件：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）在指定SignalBar上产生非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时触发买入信号，当缓冲区0（DnValue）产生有效值时触发卖出信号。出场条件：支持止损和止盈硬出场，同时也支持反向信号平仓——即当买入信号出现时平掉卖仓，卖出信号出现时平掉买仓。仓位管理：提供5种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算模式。该EA还包含额外的反向信号搜索逻辑，当同时启用开仓和平仓时，会向前遍历历史K线寻找更早的反向信号以确认平仓，这增加了策略的保守性但也可能导致延迟平仓。
EA-15228.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses the SilverTrend_Signal indicator to detect trend breakout signals for trading. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified SignalBar; a sell signal triggers when buffer 0 (DnValue) produces a valid value. Exit conditions include hard stop loss and take profit, as well as reverse signal closing — buy signals close sell positions and sell signals close buy positions. Position sizing supports 5 money management modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode for the calculation mode. The EA also includes an additional reverse signal search logic: when both open and close on reverse are enabled, it scans forward through historical bars to find earlier reverse signals for confirmation, which adds conservatism but may delay position closing.

EA-15234.name: Exp_Stalin
EA-15234.summary: This EA trades based on the custom 'Stalin' indicator, which combines fast/slow moving averages with RSI to generate momentum signals. It opens buy positions on upward momentum signals and sell positions on downward momentum signals, with optional position closing on opposite signals. The EA uses the TradeAlgorithms library for position management and supports multiple money management modes.
EA-15234.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Stalin'指标进行交易，该指标结合快慢均线和RSI生成动量信号。在向上动量信号时开多仓，在向下动量信号时开空仓，并可选择在反向信号时平仓。EA使用TradeAlgorithms库进行仓位管理，支持多种资金管理模式。
EA-15234.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于自定义Stalin指标，该指标融合了快速均线(Fast=14)、慢速均线(Slow=21)和RSI(周期17)三种技术分析工具，形成复合动量信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）出现非零非空值时触发买入开仓信号，当指标缓冲区0（DnValue）出现非零非空值时触发卖出开仓信号。出场条件分为两种：一是通过止损/止盈参数设定固定点数退出(StopLoss=1000, TakeProfit=2000)，二是当检测到反向信号时平仓（通过回溯历史柱确认反向信号的存在性）。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险敞口比例，默认0.1。策略还包含Confirm和Flat参数用于信号确认和横盘过滤，但默认值均为0表示未启用。
EA-15234.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the custom Stalin indicator, which integrates three technical analysis tools: a fast moving average (Fast=14), a slow moving average (Slow=21), and RSI (period 17) to form composite momentum signals. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) produces a non-zero non-empty value, a buy signal is triggered; when buffer 0 (DnValue) produces a non-zero non-empty value, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions come in two forms: fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) exits, and opposite signal-based exits where the EA looks back through historical bars to confirm the presence of a contrary signal before closing positions. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default risk exposure of 0.1. The strategy also includes Confirm and Flat parameters for signal confirmation and flat market filtering, though both default to 0 (disabled).

EA-15237.name: Exp_StepMA_NRTR
EA-15237.summary: This EA trades based on the StepMA_NRTR custom indicator, which is a step-moving average NRTR (No Repaint Trailing Reverse) system. It opens buy positions on upward step signals and sell positions on downward step signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. Positions are managed per-bar using new bar detection to avoid redundant signals.
EA-15237.summary_zh: 该EA基于StepMA_NRTR自定义指标进行交易，该指标是一种阶梯移动平均NRTR（无重绘追踪反转）系统。在向上阶梯信号时开多仓，向下阶梯信号时开空仓，支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。通过新K线检测机制逐 bar 管理持仓，避免重复信号。
EA-15237.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于StepMA_NRTR指标的趋势跟踪信号进行交易，该指标结合了阶梯移动平均线和NRTR追踪止损逻辑。入场条件为：当指标的上行通道缓冲区（buffer 2）出现非空值时开多仓，当指标的下行通道缓冲区（buffer 3）出现非空值时开空仓。出场条件包括：反向信号触发时平仓（多仓在下行信号时平仓，空仓在上行信号时平仓），以及止损和止盈的硬性退出。仓位管理通过MarginMode枚举支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比和基于可用保证金百分比等方式。资金管理参数MM控制每笔交易的风险比例，默认为0.1。策略还包含一个额外的确认逻辑：在主信号判断之后，还会检查指标的趋势线缓冲区（buffer 0和1），如果趋势线也发出反向信号，则增强平仓决策。信号仅在每根新K线时评估一次，避免同一根K线内重复开仓。
EA-15237.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy trades based on trend-following signals from the StepMA_NRTR indicator, which combines a step-moving average with NRTR (No Repaint Trailing Reverse) logic. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator's upper channel buffer (buffer 2) shows a non-empty value, and a sell position is opened when the lower channel buffer (buffer 3) shows a non-empty value. Exit conditions include closing on reverse signals (buy close on down signal, sell close on up signal), plus hard stop loss and take profit exits. Position sizing supports multiple modes via the MarginMode enum, including fixed lot size, percentage of balance, and percentage of free margin. The money management parameter MM controls the risk ratio per trade, defaulting to 0.1. An additional confirmation logic checks the trend line buffers (buffers 0 and 1) after the primary signal, reinforcing close decisions if the trend line also signals a reversal. Signals are evaluated only once per new bar via the CIsNewBar class, preventing redundant entries within the same bar.

EA-15239.name: Exp_SuperTrend
EA-15239.summary: This EA trades based on the SuperTrend indicator, which combines CCI and ATR to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the SuperTrend signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable position closing on signal reversals. The EA supports multiple money management modes and includes fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-15239.summary_zh: 该EA基于SuperTrend指标进行交易，该指标结合CCI和ATR来判断趋势方向。当SuperTrend发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。EA支持多种资金管理模式，并包含固定的止损和止盈水平。
EA-15239.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用SuperTrend指标作为核心策略，SuperTrend结合CCI（商品通道指数）和ATR（平均真实范围）来识别趋势方向。入场条件为：当SuperTrend指标的上轨信号线（buffer 2）在指定信号K线上有有效值时，开多仓并平空仓；当下轨信号线（buffer 3）有有效值时，开空仓并平多仓。出场条件包括两种方式：一是通过反向信号触发平仓（如上升趋势信号出现时平空仓），二是通过固定点数的止损和止盈。此外，EA还检查指标的主线（buffer 0和1）来确认平仓信号，增加了额外的出场过滤。仓位管理方面，EA支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于可用保证金减亏损、基于余额减亏损，以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。信号延迟通过SignalBar参数控制，默认为1即使用上一根完成的K线。
EA-15239.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the SuperTrend indicator as its core strategy, which combines CCI (Commodity Channel Index) and ATR (Average True Range) to identify trend direction. Entry conditions are: when the SuperTrend upper signal line (buffer 2) has a valid value on the specified signal bar, it opens a buy position and closes any sell position; when the lower signal line (buffer 3) has a valid value, it opens a sell position and closes any buy position. Exit conditions include two methods: first, reverse signal triggers position closure (e.g., sell positions close when an uptrend signal appears), and second, fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points. Additionally, the EA checks the indicator's main lines (buffers 0 and 1) to confirm close signals, adding an extra exit filter. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, free margin minus loss, balance minus loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades. Signal delay is controlled by the SignalBar parameter, defaulting to 1 which uses the last completed bar.

EA-15240.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom WPRSIsignal indicator, which combines WPR (Williams Percent Range) and RSI into a momentum oscillator. It opens buy positions on upward momentum signals and sell positions on downward momentum signals, with configurable position closing and money management options.
EA-15240.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义WPRSIsignal指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标将WPR（威廉指标）和RSI组合成动量振荡器。它在上涨动量信号时开多仓，在下跌动量信号时开空仓，并提供可配置的平仓和资金管理选项。
EA-15240.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于WPRSIsignal自定义指标，该指标融合了威廉百分比范围（WPR）和相对强弱指数（RSI）的动量信号。入场条件为：当指标的上行缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号柱上产生非零且非空值时，开多仓；当指标的下行缓冲区（buffer 0）产生信号时，开空仓。出场条件包括：当出现反向信号时平仓（例如上行信号触发多仓平仓），以及通过StopLoss和TakeProfit参数设置的固定止损止盈。仓位管理通过MMMode参数支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比和基于可用保证金百分比等方式。资金管理采用MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1手或10%比例。EA还包含一个历史回溯机制，当同时启用开仓和平仓且当前无平仓信号时，会回溯历史柱寻找反向信号以确定是否需要平仓。
EA-15240.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on the WPRSIsignal custom indicator, which combines Williams Percent Range (WPR) and Relative Strength Index (RSI) momentum signals into a unified oscillator. Entry conditions are: a buy position is opened when the indicator's upward buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-empty value on the specified signal bar; a sell position is opened when the downward buffer (buffer 0) produces a signal. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signals (e.g., an upward signal triggers closing of sell positions) and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels set via StopLoss_ and TakeProfit_ parameters. Position sizing supports multiple modes through the MMMode parameter, including fixed lot size, percentage of balance, and percentage of free margin. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk proportion, defaulting to 0.1 lots or 10% ratio. The EA also includes a historical lookback mechanism that scans previous bars for reverse signals when both opening and closing are enabled but no close signal exists on the current bar.

EA-15241.name: Panel-joke
EA-15241.summary: A panel-based semi-automated trading EA that compares the current bar's Open, High, Low, and Close prices against the previous bar to generate a buy/sell momentum signal (0-7 score). It features a GUI panel with manual Buy/Sell/Close buttons and an autopilot mode that automatically opens or reverses positions based on the signal strength.
EA-15241.summary_zh: 一个基于面板的半自动交易EA，通过比较当前K线与前一根K线的开盘价、最高价、最低价和收盘价来生成买卖动量信号（0-7分）。具有GUI面板，支持手动买卖平仓按钮，以及根据信号强度自动开仓或反转仓位的自动驾驶模式。
EA-15241.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于简单的价格动量比较：将当前K线的开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价分别与前一根K线对比，以及计算(H+L)/2、(H+L+C)/3、(H+L+C+C)/4的复合均值进行对比，共7项指标投票决定多空方向。入场条件为：手动模式下点击Buy/Sell按钮开仓，或自动驾驶模式下当买入信号数大于卖出信号数时做多，反之做空。出场条件仅有手动平仓按钮和自动驾驶模式下的仓位反转（先平后开反向仓），没有任何止损或止盈设置。仓位管理采用固定0.01手数，不根据账户余额或风险动态调整。资金管理完全缺失，无止损止盈、无最大持仓限制、无回撤控制，风险暴露极高。
EA-15241.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on simple bar-to-bar price momentum comparison: it compares the current bar's Open, High, Low, and Close against the previous bar, plus three composite averages ((H+L)/2, (H+L+C)/3, (H+L+C+C)/4), for a total of 7 directional votes. Entry conditions are: manual Buy/Sell button clicks on the GUI panel, or in autopilot mode, a BUY when buy votes exceed sell votes and a SELL when sell votes exceed buy votes. Exit conditions are limited to a manual Close button and autopilot position reversals (close then open opposite direction), with absolutely no stop-loss or take-profit levels. Position sizing is fixed at 0.01 lots regardless of account balance, equity, or risk parameters. Money management is entirely absent — there are no stop-losses, take-profits, maximum position limits, or drawdown controls, creating extremely high risk exposure.

EA-15245.name: Exp_NRTR
EA-15245.summary: This Expert Advisor trades based on the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals while optionally closing opposite positions. It uses a configurable money management system with multiple margin modes and includes new bar detection to avoid redundant signal processing on the same bar.
EA-15245.summary_zh: 该EA基于NRTR（Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse）自定义指标进行交易，在向上信号时开多仓，在向下信号时开空仓，同时可选平掉反向持仓。它使用可配置的资金管理系统，支持多种保证金模式，并包含新K线检测以避免在同一根K线上重复处理信号。
EA-15245.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用NRTR指标作为核心趋势跟踪策略，NRTR是一种动态止损反转指标，通过跟踪价格趋势的方向变化来产生交易信号。入场条件为：当NRTR指标的上行信号缓冲区（buffer 2）有有效值时开多仓，当下行信号缓冲区（buffer 3）有有效值时开空仓。出场条件包括两个方面：一是基于反向信号平仓（多单在下行信号时平仓，空单在上行信号时平仓），二是基于固定的止损和止盈参数平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举实现，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损自由保证金、亏损余额和固定手数五种模式计算仓位大小。资金管理依赖于TradeAlgorithms.mqh中封装的交易算法，包括滑点控制和信号时间戳管理。EA还实现了新K线检测机制（CIsNewBar类），确保每个信号只在一个K线周期内处理一次，避免重复开仓。
EA-15245.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the NRTR indicator as its core trend-following strategy, where NRTR is a dynamic trailing stop-reverse indicator that generates trading signals based on directional changes in price trends. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the NRTR indicator's up-signal buffer (buffer 2) has a valid non-empty value, and a sell position is opened when the down-signal buffer (buffer 3) has a valid non-empty value. Exit conditions are twofold: first, reverse-signal-based closing where long positions close on down signals and short positions close on up signals; second, fixed stop-loss and take-profit based closing. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five calculation modes: free margin, balance, loss-free margin, loss-balance, and fixed lot size. Money management relies on trading algorithms encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh, including slippage control and signal timestamp management. The EA also implements a new bar detection mechanism (CIsNewBar class) to ensure each signal is processed only once per bar period, preventing redundant position openings.

EA-15248.name: Exp_NRTR_extr
EA-15248.summary: This EA trades based on the NRTR_extr (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse Extended) custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It implements a trailing reverse logic where trend changes trigger both entry in the new direction and exit from the opposite direction. Position sizing is configurable via multiple money management modes including lot-based and percentage-based allocation.
EA-15248.summary_zh: 该EA基于NRTR_extr自定义指标进行交易，在指标发出上行信号时开多仓，下行信号时开空仓。它实现了追踪反转逻辑，趋势变化时同时触发新方向入场和反方向出场。仓位管理支持多种资金管理模式，包括固定手数和基于余额/净值的百分比分配。
EA-15248.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用NRTR_extr指标作为核心策略引擎，NRTR是一种自适应追踪止损指标，能够在趋势延续时跟随价格移动止损线，在趋势反转时切换方向。入场条件：当指标的第2和第3号缓冲区分别检测到上行信号（UpValue非零且非EMPTY_VALUE）时开多仓，检测到下行信号（DnValue非零且非EMPTY_VALUE）时开空仓。出场条件：反向信号触发时平仓，同时支持通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制是否允许信号平仓。此外，EA还检查第0和第1号缓冲区（止损线）来增强平仓判断，当同方向的开仓和平仓都启用且价格触及止损线时也会触发平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数(LOT)、基于净值(FREEMARGIN)、基于余额(BALANCE)、基于可用保证金减亏损(LOSSFREEMARGIN)和基于余额减亏损(LOSSBALANCE)。EA使用新K线检测机制（IsNewBar）避免同一根K线内重复交易，并通过SignalBar参数允许选择信号来源的K线偏移。
EA-15248.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the NRTR_extr indicator as its core strategy engine. NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) is an adaptive trailing stop indicator that moves the stop line with price during trend continuation and reverses direction on trend changes. Entry conditions: when indicator buffers 2 and 3 detect an upward signal (UpValue non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE), a buy position is opened; when a downward signal (DnValue non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE) is detected, a sell position is opened. Exit conditions: opposite signals trigger position closure, with BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters controlling whether signal-based closing is allowed. Additionally, the EA checks buffers 0 and 1 (trailing stop lines) to enhance exit decisions — when both open and close permissions are enabled for the same direction and price touches the trailing stop line, closure is also triggered. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot (LOT), based on free margin (FREEMARGIN), based on balance (BALANCE), based on free margin minus loss (LOSSFREEMARGIN), and based on balance minus loss (LOSSBALANCE). The EA uses a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to avoid repeated trades within the same bar, and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting the signal source bar offset.

EA-15262.name: Exp_Elliott_Wave_Oscillator
EA-15262.summary: This EA trades based on the Elliott Wave Oscillator (EWO), which is calculated as the difference between two smoothed moving averages of different periods. It opens buy positions when the oscillator turns upward from a declining state and sell positions when it turns downward from a rising state, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.
EA-15262.summary_zh: 该EA基于艾略特波浪振荡器(EWO)进行交易，EWO由两条不同周期的平滑移动平均线之差计算得出。当振荡器从下降转为上升时开多仓，从上升转为下降时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
EA-15262.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于艾略特波浪振荡器，即短周期与长周期平滑均线的差值，本质上是一个动量类指标。入场条件为：当振荡器值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当振荡器值从上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件为：当信号反转时平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose为true时），同时设置了固定的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括按自由保证金、余额、含亏损余额和固定手数等四种方式。资金管理通过MM参数控制仓位比例，默认为0.1，并支持多种保证金计算模式。策略使用了两层平滑算法，第一层为SMA周期5，第二层为JJMA周期35，可通过枚举选择多达10种平滑方法。
EA-15262.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Elliott Wave Oscillator, which measures the difference between a short-period and a long-period smoothed moving average — essentially a momentum-type indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the oscillator turns upward from a declining state (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]); a sell position opens when the oscillator turns downward from a rising state (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions: positions close on signal reversal when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are enabled, plus fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels are applied. Position sizing supports four margin modes — free margin, balance, loss-free margin, and loss-balance — as well as a fixed lot mode. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter (default 0.1) with configurable margin calculation modes. The strategy employs a dual-layer smoothing algorithm with a first-stage SMA of period 5 and a second-stage JJMA of period 35, with up to 10 smoothing methods selectable via enumeration.

EA-15294.name: Exp_XDPO_Histogram
EA-15294.summary: This EA trades based on the XDPO_Histogram custom indicator, which is a detrended price oscillator. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward from a declining state and sell positions when it turns downward from a rising state, implementing a mean-reversion oscillator strategy.
EA-15294.summary_zh: 该EA基于XDPO_Histogram自定义指标进行交易，该指标是去趋势价格振荡器。当直方图从下降状态转向上时开多仓，从上升状态转向下时开空仓，实现均值回归振荡器策略。
EA-15294.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于去趋势价格振荡器(XDPO)，通过双重平滑处理价格数据来识别价格偏离均值的程度。入场条件：当直方图前值小于更前值（下降趋势）且当前值大于前值（开始上升）时做多；当直方图前值大于更前值（上升趋势）且当前值小于前值（开始下降）时做空。出场条件：做多信号出现时平空仓，做空信号出现时平多仓，同时设有止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金、余额、损失保证金、损失余额或固定手数等多种模式。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中封装的函数，提供灵活的资金分配方案。策略依赖两重平滑算法：第一重对价格进行平滑（默认SMA周期12），第二重对振荡器信号进行平滑（默认JJMA周期5），Phase参数控制JJMA/VIDYA/AMA的敏感度。
EA-15294.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Detrended Price Oscillator (XDPO), which applies dual smoothing to price data to identify price deviations from the mean. Entry conditions: a buy is triggered when the previous histogram value is below the prior value (declining) and the current value rises above the previous value (starting to ascend); a sell is triggered when the previous value exceeds the prior value (rising) and the current value drops below the previous value (starting to descend). Exit conditions: long positions are closed when a sell signal appears and short positions are closed when a buy signal appears, complemented by configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting free margin, balance, loss-free-margin, loss-balance, or fixed lot modes. Money management leverages functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, providing flexible capital allocation schemes. The strategy relies on two layers of smoothing algorithms: the first smooths the price (default SMA period 12) and the second smooths the oscillator signal (default JJMA period 5), with Phase parameters controlling the sensitivity of JJMA/VIDYA/AMA algorithms.

EA-15304.name: Exp_ColorXdinMA_StDev
EA-15304.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXdinMA_StDev custom indicator, which combines a dual-length XdinMA moving average with standard deviation filtering. It supports three signal modes (point signals, direct trend detection, or disabled) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with stop loss and take profit.
EA-15304.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXdinMA_StDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了双长度XdinMA移动平均线和标准差过滤。它支持三种信号模式（点信号、直接趋势检测或禁用）用于入场和出场，并使用可配置的资金管理和止损止盈。
EA-15304.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于ColorXdinMA_StDev指标的趋势跟踪系统，该指标融合了双参数XdinMA平滑均线（Length_main和Length_plus）与标准差通道过滤。入场条件分为三种模式：点信号模式（POINT）检测指标缓冲区2-5中的彩色点信号；直接模式（DIRECT）通过均线的拐点判断趋势转向；禁用模式（WITHOUT）则不产生信号。出场条件同样支持三种模式，买入平仓可使用卖出点信号或均线下行判断，卖出平仓同理。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于亏损后可用保证金、基于亏损后余额的比例计算。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，并设置了1000点止损和2000点止盈。标准差倍数dK1和dK2用于过滤低波动性信号，提高入场质量。
EA-15304.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a trend-following system based on the ColorXdinMA_StDev indicator, which integrates dual-parameter XdinMA smoothed moving averages (Length_main and Length_plus) with a standard deviation channel filter. Entry conditions come in three modes: POINT mode detects colored dot signals from indicator buffers 2-5; DIRECT mode identifies trend reversals via moving average inflection points; WITHOUT mode disables signal generation entirely. Exit conditions also support three modes — buy positions can close via sell dot signals or declining MA detection, and vice versa for sell positions. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, and percentage of balance after losses. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio, with a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit. Standard deviation multipliers dK1 and dK2 filter out low-volatility signals to improve entry quality.

EA-15322.name: Exp_Bezier_StDev
EA-15322.summary: This EA trades based on the Bezier_StDev custom indicator, which combines Bezier curve smoothing with standard deviation bands to identify overbought/oversold conditions. It supports three signal modes (point-based, directional, and disabled) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with stop loss and take profit. The strategy opens buy positions on upward turning points and sell positions on downward turning points of the smoothed curve.
EA-15322.summary_zh: 该EA基于Bezier_StDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合贝塞尔曲线平滑和标准差通道来识别超买/超卖条件。它支持三种信号模式（点位、方向、禁用）分别控制入场和出场，并使用可配置的资金管理配合止损止盈。策略在平滑曲线的向上拐点开多仓，在向下拐点开空仓。
EA-15322.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于贝塞尔曲线平滑叠加标准差通道的均值回归思路。入场条件分为三种模式：POINT模式通过读取指标的信号缓冲区（buffer 3为买入信号，buffer 2为卖出信号）判断；DIRECT模式通过比较相邻三根K线的贝塞尔曲线值判断拐点（V形反转）来开仓；WITHOUT模式则禁用信号。出场条件同样支持三种模式：POINT模式根据信号缓冲区、DIRECT模式根据曲线斜率方向变化判断趋势反转平仓。仓位管理采用五种模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额、固定手数），通过MM参数控制风险比例。资金管理方面设有止损和止盈参数，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险回报比为1:2。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根已收盘K线的信号，避免了未收盘K线信号闪烁的问题。
EA-15322.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on mean reversion using Bezier curve smoothing overlaid with standard deviation bands. Entry conditions come in three modes: POINT mode reads the indicator's signal buffers (buffer 3 for buy signals, buffer 2 for sell signals); DIRECT mode detects inflection points by comparing three consecutive Bezier curve values (V-shaped reversal patterns) to open positions; WITHOUT mode disables the signal entirely. Exit conditions also support three modes: POINT mode uses signal buffers, while DIRECT mode detects trend reversal by comparing curve slope direction changes to close positions. Position sizing offers five modes (free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot), controlled by the MM parameter for risk proportion. Money management includes configurable stop loss and take profit, defaulting to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. The strategy operates on the H4 timeframe by default and uses SignalBar=1, meaning signals from the last closed bar, which avoids signal flickering issues from unclosed bars.

EA-15327.name: Exp_BinaryWave_StDev
EA-15327.summary: This EA trades based on the BinaryWave_StDev custom indicator, which combines seven weighted technical indicators (MA, MACD, OsMA, CCI, Momentum, RSI, ADX) into a composite binary wave signal with standard deviation filtering. It supports three signal modes (point signals, direct line direction, or disabled) for both entry and exit, with configurable money management and lot sizing.
EA-15327.summary_zh: 该EA基于BinaryWave_StDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标将七个加权技术指标（MA、MACD、OsMA、CCI、动量、RSI、ADX）组合成复合二元波动信号并进行标准差过滤。它支持三种信号模式（点信号、直接方向线、禁用）用于入场和出场，并配置了资金管理和手数管理。
EA-15327.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是将多个经典技术指标加权组合成一个复合BinaryWave值，然后通过标准差通道进行过滤，产生更可靠的交易信号。入场条件有两种模式：POINT模式检测指标缓冲区中的箭头信号（非EMPTY_VALUE），DIRECT模式检测BinaryWave线的拐点（买入时V形底，卖出时倒V形顶）。出场条件同样支持两种模式：POINT模式检测反向箭头信号，DIRECT模式检测BinaryWave线方向变化（买入仓位于线下降时平仓，卖出仓位于线上升时平仓）。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，配合固定的止损和止盈点数进行风险控制。策略使用可配置的平滑方法对BinaryWave进行二次平滑处理，通过dK1和dK2系数调整标准差通道宽度，减少虚假信号。
EA-15327.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to combine seven classic technical indicators with configurable weights into a composite BinaryWave value, then filter it through standard deviation channels to produce more reliable trading signals. Entry conditions offer two modes: POINT mode detects arrow signals in indicator buffers (non-EMPTY_VALUE values), while DIRECT mode detects inflection points on the BinaryWave line (V-bottom for buy, inverted-V-top for sell). Exit conditions also support two modes: POINT mode detects opposite arrow signals, while DIRECT mode detects BinaryWave line direction changes (close long when line declines, close short when line rises). Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk ratio, combined with fixed stop loss and take profit in points for risk control. The strategy applies a configurable smoothing method for secondary smoothing of the BinaryWave, adjusting standard deviation channel width via dK1 and dK2 coefficients to reduce false signals.

EA-15328.name: Exp_ColorHMA_StDev
EA-15328.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorHMA_StDev indicator, which is a Hull Moving Average enhanced with standard deviation bands. It opens and closes buy/sell positions using three signal modes: point signals from colored dots, direct trend direction from the HMA line, or disabled signals entirely.
EA-15328.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorHMA_StDev指标进行交易，该指标是带有标准差通道的Hull移动平均线。它使用三种信号模式（点信号、直接趋势方向、禁用）来开仓和平仓买卖仓位。
EA-15328.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Hull移动平均线(HMA)结合标准差通道，属于趋势跟踪型策略。入场条件有两种模式：点信号模式通过检查指标缓冲区3/5（买入）或2/4（卖出）是否非空值来确认信号；直接模式通过HMA线的方向变化来判断趋势转折，买入信号为V形反转（先降后升），卖出信号为倒V形反转（先升后降）。出场条件同样支持点信号和直接模式，直接模式下买入平仓条件为HMA线下降，卖出平仓条件为HMA线上升。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种资金管理模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的保证金或固定手数。风险控制依赖固定的止损和止盈参数，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，并设有滑点容差参数Deviation_。
EA-15328.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a Hull Moving Average (HMA) combined with standard deviation channels, classifying it as a trend-following system. Entry conditions support two modes: the POINT mode checks if indicator buffers 3/5 (buy) or 2/4 (sell) contain non-empty values to confirm signal dots; the DIRECT mode detects trend reversals via HMA line direction changes — a V-shaped bottom for buy entries and an inverted V-shaped top for sell entries. Exit conditions also support both modes: in DIRECT mode, a buy position closes when the HMA line declines, and a sell position closes when it rises. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting multiple money management approaches including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin/balance, or fixed lot sizing. Risk control relies on fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points) parameters, with a slippage tolerance parameter (Deviation_). The EA uses a new bar detection mechanism to avoid processing signals on every tick, and employs a Recount flag for error recovery when indicator data is unavailable.

EA-15331.name: Exp_ColorJ2JMAStDev
EA-15331.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom ColorJ2JMAStDev indicator, which combines a J2JMA smoothing filter with standard deviation bands. It supports three signal modes (point, direct, without) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with multiple margin modes to size positions.
EA-15331.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorJ2JMAStDev的信号进行交易，该指标结合了J2JMA平滑滤波器和标准差通道。它支持三种信号模式（点位、直接、无信号）用于入场和出场，并使用可配置的资金管理以多种保证金模式确定仓位大小。
EA-15331.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorJ2JMAStDev指标，该指标是J2JMA双平滑移动平均线与标准差通道的组合。入场条件分为三种模式：点位模式（POINT）检测指标缓冲区中的信号点（非EMPTY_VALUE），直接模式（DIRECT）检测均线的转折（买入时谷底、卖出时峰顶），无信号模式（WITHOUT）则不产生信号。出场条件同样支持三种模式，买入平仓可基于卖出信号点或均线下降，卖出平仓可基于买入信号点或均线上升。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode支持按自由保证金、余额、考虑浮亏的保证金或固定手数四种模式。资金管理由TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数处理，包含止损和止盈设置。EA在新K线形成时或SignalBar为0时计算信号，避免每tick重复计算，提高了效率。
EA-15331.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on the ColorJ2JMAStDev indicator, which combines a J2JMA dual-smoothed moving average with standard deviation bands. Entry conditions come in three modes: POINT mode checks for signal dots in indicator buffers (non-EMPTY_VALUE values), DIRECT mode detects turning points in the J2JMA line (valley for buy, peak for sell), and WITHOUT mode disables signals entirely. Exit conditions also support three modes — buy positions can close on sell signal dots or a declining J2JMA line, while sell positions can close on buy signal dots or a rising J2JMA line. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter as a risk fraction, with MMMode offering four modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin/balance, or fixed lot size. Money management is delegated to TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen) which handle stop-loss and take-profit placement. The EA calculates signals only on new bar formation or when SignalBar is zero, avoiding redundant per-tick calculations for efficiency.

EA-15336.name: Exp_AroonHornSign
EA-15336.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom AroonHornSign indicator, opening buy positions on upward momentum signals and sell positions on downward momentum signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop-loss/take-profit, and separate toggles for opening and closing positions on each signal direction. The strategy also performs a historical bar scan to detect close signals when both open and close permissions are enabled.
EA-15336.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义AroonHornSign指标信号进行交易，在上涨动量信号时开多仓，在下跌动量信号时开空仓。支持多种资金管理模式、止损止盈设置，以及分别控制买卖方向的开关和平仓开关。当同时启用开仓和平仓时，还会扫描历史K线寻找平仓信号。
EA-15336.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于Aroon指标衍生出的AroonHornSign自定义指标，捕捉价格动量方向变化产生交易信号。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区(索引1)在指定信号Bar上出现非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时触发买入信号，下轨缓冲区(索引0)出现类似值时触发卖出信号。出场条件分为两部分：信号本身可直接触发反向平仓（如上涨信号触发卖出平仓），同时当买卖开仓和平仓均启用时，EA会向后扫描历史K线寻找更早的反向信号作为平仓依据。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持按余额百分比、可用保证金百分比、损失后余额/保证金百分比或固定手数五种模式。止损和止盈以点数设置，默认值较大（止损1000点，止盈2000点），表明策略追求较大的趋势行情。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。
EA-15336.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the AroonHornSign custom indicator derived from the Aroon indicator, capturing trading signals from price momentum direction changes. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator's upper buffer (index 1) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified signal bar, and a sell signal triggers similarly on the lower buffer (index 0). Exit conditions operate in two parts: the signal itself can directly trigger reverse-side position closure (e.g., an up signal triggers sell-side closure), and when both open and close permissions are enabled for buy and sell sides, the EA scans historical bars backward to find earlier opposing signals as close confirmation. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting five modes: percentage of balance, percentage of free margin, percentage after loss on balance/margin, or fixed lot size. Stop-loss and take-profit are set in points with large default values (SL=1000, TP=2000), indicating the strategy targets larger trend movements. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing repeated trades on the same bar.

EA-15412.name: Multicurrency trading panel (DC2008)
EA-15412.summary: A multicurrency trading panel for EURUSD, USDJPY, and GBPUSD that provides both manual and automated trading. The auto-trader generates buy/sell signals by comparing the last two bars' Open, High, Low, and Close prices to determine momentum direction. It opens or reverses positions based on which direction has more momentum signals out of 7 checks.
EA-15412.summary_zh: 一个多货币交易面板，支持EURUSD、USDJPY和GBPUSD三个品种的手动和自动交易。自动交易器通过比较最近两根K线的开盘价、最高价、最低价和收盘价来判断动量方向，在7项检查中买入或卖出信号较多时开仓或反转仓位。
EA-15412.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于简单动量比较，通过比较当前K线与前一根K线的Open、High、Low、Close以及它们的组合均值（(H+L)/2、(H+L+C)/3、(H+L+C+C)/4）共7项指标，统计买入和卖出信号数量。入场条件为：当买入信号多于卖出信号时做多，反之作空；若无持仓则新开仓，若有反向持仓则先平仓再反转。出场条件仅通过手动点击CLOSE按钮或CLOSE ALL按钮平仓，自动模式下只在信号反转时才会平仓并反向开仓。仓位管理使用固定手数，可通过面板的加减按钮调整，最小为0.01手，无止损止盈设置。资金管理完全缺失，没有风险控制机制，没有最大持仓限制，没有回撤保护，每品种只允许持有一个仓位。
EA-15412.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on simple momentum comparison, comparing the current bar versus the previous bar across Open, High, Low, Close and their derived averages ((H+L)/2, (H+L+C)/3, (H+L+C+C)/4) for a total of 7 signal checks. Entry conditions: when buy signals exceed sell signals, a long position is opened; conversely for short; if no position exists a new one is opened, if an opposite position exists it is closed and reversed. Exit conditions are only through manual CLOSE/CLOSE ALL buttons; in auto mode positions are only closed when the signal reverses direction. Position sizing uses a fixed lot adjustable via panel +/- buttons with a minimum of 0.01 lots, with no stop-loss or take-profit. Money management is completely absent — there is no risk control mechanism, no maximum position limit, no drawdown protection, and only one position per symbol is allowed.

EA-15491.name: Exp_ColorXTRIX_Histogram
EA-15491.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXTRIX_Histogram custom indicator, which is a triple-smoothed momentum oscillator. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.
EA-15491.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXTRIX_Histogram自定义指标进行交易，该指标是三重平滑动量振荡器。当直方图向上翻转时开多仓，向下翻转时开空仓，并可在信号反转时配置平仓。
EA-15491.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用ColorXTRIX_Histogram指标作为核心策略，该指标基于三重指数平滑算法（XTRIX）计算动量。入场条件为：当直方图值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当直方图值从上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件依赖信号反转平仓以及固定的止损止盈设置，支持独立控制买卖方向的开启和平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金比例，支持多种保证金模式包括固定手数、余额百分比等。该策略使用多周期平滑方法（JJMA、JurX、ParMA等）来减少噪音，但也因此引入了较大的滞后性。策略缺乏对市场波动率、点差和交易时间段的过滤，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
EA-15491.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the ColorXTRIX_Histogram indicator as its core strategy, which calculates momentum based on a triple exponentially smoothed algorithm (XTRIX). Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the histogram value turns from declining to rising (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]); a sell position opens when the histogram value turns from rising to declining (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions rely on signal reversal-based closing and fixed stop-loss/take-profit settings, with independent control for buy and sell direction opening and closing. Position sizing is controlled through the MM parameter with multiple margin modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage. The strategy employs multiple smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) to reduce noise, but this introduces significant lag. The strategy lacks filters for market volatility, spread, and trading sessions, making it prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets.

EA-15513.name: Exp_XDPOCandle
EA-15513.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom XDPOCandle indicator, which uses dual smoothing algorithms to generate colored candle signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum (color value 2) and sell positions when it signals bearish momentum (color value 0), with configurable position closing on signal reversal.
EA-15513.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义XDPOCandle指标的信号进行交易，该指标使用双重平滑算法生成彩色K线信号。当指标发出看涨动量信号（颜色值2）时开多仓，发出看跌动量信号（颜色值0）时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
EA-15513.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于XDPOCandle指标的动量跟踪策略，核心逻辑是利用双重平滑算法（第一层和第二层平滑）对价格数据进行处理，生成彩色K线信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的当前值从非2变为2时开多仓，从非0变为0时开空仓，这种变化检测机制确保只在信号转变时触发交易。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置，以及信号反转时的主动平仓（BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制下单手数比例，MMMode参数决定是固定手数还是基于资金的动态计算。资金管理方面，止损1000点、止盈2000点设置提供了1:2的风险回报比，但0.1的MM值暗示使用10%的可用保证金进行交易。策略采用新K线检测机制（IsNewBar）避免重复信号，同时支持在指定SignalBar上即时执行以实现更快的响应。
EA-15513.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a momentum-following strategy based on the XDPOCandle indicator, which processes price data through dual smoothing algorithms (first and second layer smoothing) to generate colored candle signals. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 4's current value changes from non-2 to 2, and a sell position opens when it changes from non-0 to 0; this change-detection mechanism ensures trades are triggered only on signal transitions. Exit conditions include hard stop-loss and take-profit settings, as well as active position closing on signal reversal (controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters). Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter controlling the lot ratio, with MMMode determining whether to use fixed lots or dynamic calculation based on account margin. In terms of money management, the stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points provide a 1:2 risk-reward ratio, while the MM value of 0.1 suggests using 10% of available margin for trading. The strategy uses a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent duplicate signals, while also supporting instant execution on a specified SignalBar for faster response.

EA-15545.name: Exp_trend_arrows
EA-15545.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom 'trend_arrows' indicator, opening buy positions on upward trend arrows and sell positions on downward trend arrows. It includes configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and options to independently control buy/sell opening and closing. The strategy uses a new bar check to avoid redundant signal processing on the specified timeframe.
EA-15545.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'trend_arrows'指标的交易信号运行，在出现上升趋势箭头时开多仓，下降趋势箭头时开空仓。它包含可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈设置，以及独立控制买卖开平仓的选项。策略使用新K线检查来避免在指定时间周期上重复处理信号。
EA-15545.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于自定义trend_arrows指标的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当指标的第2和第3个缓冲区在指定信号K线上产生非空值时，分别触发买入和卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈设置，以及反向信号平仓——当trend_arrows指标的第0和第1个缓冲区出现反向信号时关闭对应仓位。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种模式，包括固定手数、按余额比例、按可用保证金比例等方式。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。策略还通过额外的缓冲区检查提供反向信号平仓功能，即在已有仓位方向出现相反趋势箭头时主动平仓，增强了风控能力。
EA-15545.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following approach based on the custom trend_arrows indicator. Entry conditions are triggered when indicator buffers 2 and 3 produce non-empty values on the specified signal bar, generating buy and sell signals respectively. Exit conditions include configurable stop loss and take profit levels, plus reverse-signal closing where indicator buffers 0 and 1 can trigger closure of opposing positions. Position sizing supports multiple modes through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, including fixed lot, balance-proportional, and free-margin-proportional sizing. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are processed only once per bar, preventing redundant trades. The strategy also implements an additional reverse-signal closing check using supplementary indicator buffers, actively closing positions when an opposite trend arrow appears, which enhances risk control capability.

EA-15575.name: Exp_Directed_Movement
EA-15575.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover of the Directed Movement indicator's upper and lower lines, which are derived from a doubly-smoothed RSI. It opens buy positions when the upper line crosses above the lower line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing and money management options.
EA-15575.summary_zh: 该EA基于Directed Movement指标的上轨和下轨交叉进行交易，该指标由双重平滑的RSI衍生而来。当上轨上穿下轨时开多仓，反之下穿时开空仓，并提供可配置的平仓和资金管理选项。
EA-15575.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于Directed Movement自定义指标的双线交叉信号，本质上是一个双重平滑RSI动量系统。入场条件为：当上轨从下方穿越下轨时产生买入信号，当下轨从上方穿越上轨时产生卖出信号，信号基于SignalBar根K线前的交叉判断。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发时平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的多种模式，支持按自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的自由保证金或余额比例计算手数，也支持固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），MMMode选择计算模式（默认固定手数LOT）。策略使用了两层平滑处理，第一层默认SMA周期12，第二层默认JJMA周期5，旨在过滤RSI的噪音以产生更稳定的信号。
EA-15575.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on the crossover of the Directed Movement custom indicator's two lines, which is essentially a doubly-smoothed RSI momentum system. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the upper line crosses above the lower line, and a sell signal is generated when the upper line crosses below the lower line, with signals evaluated at the SignalBar-th bar back. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as closing positions on reverse signals via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing uses multiple modes from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, supporting lot calculation based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin or balance percentages, or fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) for risk ratio, and MMMode selects the calculation mode (default fixed lot LOT). The strategy applies two layers of smoothing to RSI, with the first layer defaulting to SMA period 12 and the second to JJMA period 5, aiming to filter RSI noise for more stable signals.

EA-15581.name: Exp_CCI_Woodies
EA-15581.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover of fast and slow CCI (Woodies) indicators. It opens buy positions when the fast CCI crosses above the slow CCI and sell positions when the fast CCI crosses below the slow CCI. Positions are closed on opposite crossover signals, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-15581.summary_zh: 该EA基于Woodies CCI快速线和慢速线的交叉信号进行交易。快速CCI上穿慢速CCI时开多仓，下穿时开空仓。反向交叉信号触发平仓，支持可配置的资金管理和止损止盈设置。
EA-15581.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Woodies CCI指标的双线交叉策略，核心概念是利用快速CCI（默认周期6）和慢速CCI（默认周期14）的相对位置变化捕捉动量转换。入场条件为：快速CCI上穿慢速CCI时开多仓，快速CCI下穿慢速CCI时开空仓，采用前一根K线的交叉确认机制（SignalBar=1），避免未来数据偏差。出场条件为：持有多仓时快速CCI下穿慢速CCI触发平仓，持有空仓时快速CCI上穿慢速CCI触发平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于自由保证金、基于余额、基于扣除亏损后的自由保证金、基于扣除亏损后的余额。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1手，并设有1000点止损和2000点止盈。EA还支持信号反转（Invert参数），允许将做多和做空信号互换，适合逆势交易场景。
EA-15581.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual CCI crossover strategy using the Woodies CCI indicator, where the core concept is capturing momentum shifts through the relative position changes between a fast CCI (default period 6) and a slow CCI (default period 14). Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the fast CCI crosses above the slow CCI, and a sell position opens when the fast CCI crosses below the slow CCI, using a one-bar lag confirmation (SignalBar=1) to avoid look-ahead bias. Exit conditions are: a long position closes when the fast CCI crosses below the slow CCI, and a short position closes when the fast CCI crosses above the slow CCI. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot size, based on free margin, based on balance, based on free margin minus losses, and based on balance minus losses. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 lots, along with a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit. The EA also supports signal inversion via the Invert parameter, which swaps buy and sell signals for counter-trend trading scenarios.

EA-15618.name: Exp_Q2MA
EA-15618.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the Q2MA custom indicator, which uses configurable smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, T3, etc.). It opens buy positions when the upper indicator line crosses above the lower line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with optional position closing on signal reversal. Money management supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot sizing.
EA-15618.summary_zh: 该EA基于Q2MA自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，使用可配置的平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、T3等）。当上线穿越下线时开多仓，反向穿越时开空仓，并可选择在信号反转时平仓。资金管理支持多种保证金模式，包括固定手数。
EA-15618.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双线交叉的趋势跟踪策略，核心依赖Q2MA自定义指标的两条平滑线进行方向判断。入场条件为：上线从下方穿越下线时产生买入信号，上线从上方穿越下线时产生卖出信号，支持信号反转(Invert)功能。出场条件包括止损/止盈预设值以及信号反转时的反向平仓功能。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持五种资金管理模式：自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的自由保证金、扣除亏损后的余额及固定手数。策略在每个新K线形成时检测信号变化，使用SignalBar参数控制信号延迟，避免在未完成K线上产生错误信号。该EA的平滑算法选择灵活，支持JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等高级平滑方法，提升了信号质量。
EA-15618.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual-line crossover trend-following strategy, relying on two smoothed lines from the Q2MA custom indicator to determine market direction. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the upper line crosses above the lower line, and a sell signal is generated on the opposite crossover, with an optional inversion feature. Exit conditions include configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels, plus optional closing of opposite positions upon signal reversal. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter with five money management modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot sizing. The strategy detects signal changes only on new bar formation using the CIsNewBar class, with a SignalBar parameter controlling signal lag to avoid false signals on incomplete bars. The smoothing algorithm is highly configurable, supporting advanced methods like JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, and AMA for improved signal quality.

EA-15619.name: Exp_MaChannel
EA-15619.summary: This EA trades based on the MaChannel custom indicator, which builds a smoothed moving average channel. It opens buy positions when price breaks above the upper channel and sell positions when price breaks below the lower channel, with opposite-direction close signals generated as well.
EA-15619.summary_zh: 该EA基于MaChannel自定义指标进行交易，该指标构建一个平滑移动平均通道。价格突破上轨时开多仓，突破下轨时开空仓，同时产生反向平仓信号。
EA-15619.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于移动平均通道突破，使用可配置的平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等）构建通道上下轨。入场条件为：当上轨信号缓冲区（buffer 2）出现非空值时触发做多开仓和做空平仓信号，当下轨信号缓冲区（buffer 3）出现非空值时触发做空开仓和做多平仓信号。出场条件分为两类：一是反向信号平仓（趋势反转时平掉原有仓位），二是固定止损止盈平仓（StopLoss=1000点，TakeProfit=2000点）。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例、以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，配合MarginMode选择计算方式。该策略还增加了通道线值（buffer 0和1）作为额外的平仓确认条件，即在同时开启同方向开仓和平仓开关时，通道线信号也会触发平仓。
EA-15619.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a moving average channel breakout system, using configurable smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA, etc.) to construct upper and lower channel bands. Entry conditions: when the upper signal buffer (buffer 2) produces a non-empty value, a buy-open and sell-close signal is triggered; when the lower signal buffer (buffer 3) produces a non-empty value, a sell-open and buy-close signal is triggered. Exit conditions are twofold: first, reverse-signal closing (closing existing positions when the opposite signal appears), and second, fixed stop-loss and take-profit closing (StopLoss=1000 points, TakeProfit=2000 points). Position sizing supports five margin modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot mode. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) combined with the MarginMode selection. The strategy also incorporates channel line values (buffers 0 and 1) as additional close confirmation, meaning when both same-direction open and close switches are enabled, channel line signals can also trigger position closing.

EA-15640.name: Exp_ROC2_VG
EA-15640.summary: This EA uses a dual Rate-of-Change (ROC2_VG) custom indicator with two configurable momentum-type calculations (MOM, ROC, ROCP, ROCR, ROCR100) on different periods to generate crossover signals for opening and closing buy/sell positions. It features money management options, stop loss/take profit, signal inversion, and processes signals only on new bars for efficiency.
EA-15640.summary_zh: 该EA使用双速率变化(ROC2_VG)自定义指标，通过两个不同周期的可配置动量类型计算(MOM、ROC、ROCP、ROCR、ROCR100)生成交叉信号来开仓和平仓买卖方向的头寸。具备资金管理选项、止损止盈、信号反转功能，并仅在新K线时处理信号以提高效率。
EA-15640.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于双动量指标交叉的核心概念，使用两个不同周期（默认8和14）的ROC类型指标，当快速动量线向上穿越慢速动量线时产生买入信号，向下穿越时产生卖出信号。入场条件为：快速指标线从下方穿越慢速线（金叉）时买入开仓，从上方穿越（死叉）时卖出开仓，信号仅在指定K线（SignalBar）上检测且需前一K线确认穿越。出场条件包括：反向穿越信号触发平仓、止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等。资金管理依赖于TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供的标准化函数，支持5种保证金计算模式。策略还提供了信号反转功能(Invert)，可将买卖信号互换，适用于逆势交易场景。
EA-15640.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on a dual momentum indicator crossover concept, using two ROC-type indicators with different periods (default 8 and 14) to generate signals when the fast momentum line crosses above or below the slow momentum line. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the fast indicator crosses above the slow indicator (golden cross), and a sell signal when it crosses below (death cross), with crossover confirmation requiring the previous bar to show the opposite relationship. Exit conditions include: reverse crossover signal triggers position closure, stop loss (default 1000 points), and take profit (default 2000 points). Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting multiple modes including fixed lot size, balance percentage, free margin percentage, and others. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library providing standardized functions with 5 margin calculation modes. The strategy also provides a signal inversion feature (Invert) that swaps buy and sell signals, applicable for counter-trend trading scenarios.

EA-15657.name: Exp_TSICloud
EA-15657.summary: This EA trades based on the TSI Cloud indicator, which uses double-smoothed momentum (TSI) with configurable smoothing methods. It opens buy positions when the upper TSI line crosses above the lower line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with optional signal inversion and separate close-on-reversal logic.
EA-15657.summary_zh: 该EA基于TSICloud指标进行交易，该指标使用双重平滑的动量指数(TSI)及可配置的平滑算法。当TSI上线穿越下线时开多仓，反向穿越时开空仓，支持信号反转和独立的反向平仓逻辑。
EA-15657.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于TSI（真实力度指数）云图指标的双线交叉，属于动量类交易系统。入场条件：当上线从下方穿越下线时产生做多信号，当下线从上方穿越上线时产生做空信号，支持信号反转(Invert)功能。出场条件：通过反向信号触发平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose参数控制），同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持多种模式：固定手数(LOT)、基于余额比例、基于可用保证金比例等，由MM和MMMode参数控制。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准化函数，允许0.1的风险比例配置。系统在每个新K线或指定信号柱上检测交叉信号，避免逐tick重复计算，但缺乏加仓和减仓机制。
EA-15657.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover of two TSI (True Strength Index) Cloud indicator lines, classifying it as a momentum-based trading system. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the upper line crosses above the lower line, and a sell signal on the opposite crossover, with an optional signal inversion (Invert) feature that swaps the buffer readings. Exit conditions are triggered by reversal signals controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters, along with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points. Position sizing supports multiple modes including fixed lot size (LOT), balance-based percentage, and free margin-based percentage, governed by the MM and MMMode input parameters. Money management leverages standardized functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The system checks for crossover signals on each new bar or at a specified signal bar index, preventing per-tick redundant calculations, but it lacks scaling in/out or partial position management mechanisms.

EA-15679.name: AutoTrader
EA-15679.summary: This EA is a session-based trading toggle utility that automatically enables or disables the MetaTrader AutoTrading button (Ctrl+E) based on a user-defined time window. Outside the active trading session, it also closes all open positions. It does not generate its own trade signals or open positions based on a strategy.
EA-15679.summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于时段的交易开关工具，根据用户设定的时间窗口自动启用或禁用MetaTrader的自动交易按钮（Ctrl+E）。在活跃交易时段之外，它还会平掉所有持仓。它不会根据策略自行产生交易信号或开仓。
EA-15679.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于时间段来控制交易系统的启用和禁用，而非基于市场技术指标产生交易信号。入场条件方面，当当前时间进入用户设定的起始时间（默认9:30）且自动交易未开启时，EA通过模拟键盘按键Ctrl+E来开启自动交易。出场条件方面，当当前时间超出交易时段时，EA会遍历所有持仓并逐个平仓，同时关闭自动交易功能。仓位管理方面，该EA没有任何仓位管理逻辑，它只是简单地关闭所有持仓而不考虑仓位大小或盈亏状态。资金管理方面，同样没有任何资金管理机制，平仓是无差别执行的所有持仓平仓操作。整体而言，这是一个纯工具型EA，依赖Windows API的keybd_event函数来模拟键盘操作，存在平台依赖性和可靠性风险。
EA-15679.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is to control the enabling and disabling of the trading system based on a time window, rather than generating trade signals from market technical indicators. For entry conditions, when the current time enters the user-defined start time (default 9:30) and AutoTrading is disabled, the EA simulates the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+E via the Windows API to enable AutoTrading. For exit conditions, when the current time falls outside the trading session, the EA iterates through all open positions and closes each one, while also disabling AutoTrading. Regarding position sizing, the EA has no position management logic whatsoever; it simply closes all positions without considering position size or profit/loss status. For money management, there is similarly no money management mechanism—the position closing is indiscriminately executed across all holdings. Overall, this is a purely utility-type EA that relies on the Windows API keybd_event function to simulate keyboard input, introducing platform dependency and reliability concerns.

EA-15708.name: ArbSint
EA-15708.summary: ArbSint is a statistical arbitrage EA that exploits price divergence between correlated or cointegrated instruments. It opens opposing positions when the spread deviates beyond a threshold and closes them when the spread reverts to the mean. The strategy is inherently market-neutral, aiming to profit from relative value convergence rather than directional movement.
EA-15708.summary_zh: ArbSint是一个统计套利EA，利用相关或协整工具之间的价格偏离进行交易。当价差偏离超过阈值时开立对冲仓位，当价差回归均值时平仓。该策略本质上是市场中性的，旨在从相对价值收敛中获利而非方向性走势。
EA-15708.strategy_analysis: ArbSint策略的核心概念是统计套利，基于两个或多个相关金融工具之间的价差偏离和均值回归特性。入场条件是当两个相关品种的价差（或合成价格差）偏离其统计均值达到预设阈值时，同时在两个品种上开立方向相反的仓位，做多被低估的一方、做空被高估的一方。出场条件是当价差回归到均值或达到设定的目标利润时，同时平掉两个品种的仓位，实现套利收益。仓位管理通常采用等值配对方式，确保两边仓位的市场敞口基本对冲。资金管理方面，EA可能根据价差偏离程度和账户风险限额调整仓位大小，但统计套利策略本身的风险相对可控，因为始终持有多空对冲仓位。需注意的关键风险是协整关系可能破裂，导致两个品种的价格持续背离而不回归，造成双重亏损。
EA-15708.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of ArbSint is statistical arbitrage, based on the spread divergence and mean-reversion properties between two or more correlated financial instruments. Entry conditions trigger when the spread (or synthetic price difference) between two correlated symbols deviates beyond a predefined threshold from its statistical mean, simultaneously opening opposing positions—going long on the undervalued instrument and short on the overvalued one. Exit conditions are met when the spread reverts to its mean or reaches a specified target profit, at which point both positions are closed simultaneously to capture the arbitrage profit. Position sizing typically employs equal-value pairing to ensure the market exposure on both legs is essentially hedged. Money management adjusts lot sizes based on the degree of spread deviation and account risk limits, though statistical arbitrage inherently carries relatively controlled risk due to the always-hedged long-short positioning. A key risk to monitor is the potential breakdown of the cointegration relationship, which could cause the two instruments' prices to diverge persistently without reverting, resulting in losses on both legs.

EA-15753.name: Exp_ColorRsiMACD
EA-15753.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorRsiMACD custom indicator, which applies RSI smoothing with configurable averaging methods before computing a MACD-style oscillator. It offers four trading modes: MACD zero-line breakdown, MACD direction twist, signal line twist, and MACD-vs-signal disposition crossover, opening and closing positions accordingly.
EA-15753.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorRsiMACD进行交易，该指标先对RSI进行可配置的平滑处理，再计算类似MACD的振荡器。它提供四种交易模式：MACD零线突破、MACD方向扭转、信号线扭转和MACD与信号线交叉，据此开平仓。
EA-15753.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用经过多种平滑算法（如JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等）处理后的RSI值构建MACD指标，从而生成交易信号。策略提供四种入场模式：breakdown模式基于MACD线穿越零线；MACDtwist模式基于MACD线方向变化（由降转升做多，由升转降做空）；SIGNALtwist模式基于信号线方向变化；MACDdisposition模式基于MACD线与信号线的交叉。出场条件与入场条件相对应，当反向信号触发时平仓，同时设有止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode参数控制，支持固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms库中的函数实现，允许灵活配置买卖开平仓的启用状态。
EA-15753.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy constructs a MACD indicator from RSI values processed through configurable smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA, etc.), generating trading signals from this hybrid oscillator. Four entry modes are available: breakdown mode triggers on MACD crossing the zero line; MACDtwist mode triggers on MACD direction change (declining-to-rising for buys, rising-to-declining for sells); SIGNALtwist mode triggers on signal line direction change; and MACDdisposition mode triggers on MACD/signal line crossover. Exit conditions mirror entries—reverse signals close positions, supplemented by configurable StopLoss and TakeProfit levels. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enum, supporting fixed lots or percentage-of-balance sizing. Money management leverages the TradeAlgorithms library, and each buy/sell open/close action can be independently enabled or disabled.

EA-15764.name: Exp_iRSISign
EA-15764.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom iRSISign indicator, which generates buy and sell signals when RSI crosses user-defined overbought and oversold levels. It opens and closes positions according to these RSI crossover signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
EA-15764.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义iRSISign指标的信号进行交易，当RSI穿越用户设定的超买和超卖水平时生成买卖信号。它根据这些RSI交叉信号开仓和平仓，并配有可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈设置。
EA-15764.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RSI动量指标的自定义变体iRSISign，该指标在RSI突破超买水平（默认70）时产生买入信号，在跌破超卖水平（默认30）时产生卖出信号。入场条件为：当指标的上行信号缓冲区出现有效值（非零且非空值）时开多单，当下行信号缓冲区出现有效值时开空单。出场条件包括：RSI超买信号触发多单平仓，超卖信号触发空单平仓，同时设置了固定点数的止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点）。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的五种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、按余额比例、按可用保证金比例等。策略还包含一个回溯检查机制，当同时允许开仓和平仓且当前无平仓信号时，会向前回溯历史K线寻找是否有尚未触发的反向平仓信号，以避免遗漏平仓机会。
EA-15764.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a custom RSI momentum indicator variant called iRSISign, which generates buy signals when RSI breaks above the overbought level (default 70) and sell signals when it drops below the oversold level (default 30). Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the indicator's upper signal buffer produces a valid value (non-zero and non-empty), and a short position is opened when the lower signal buffer produces a valid value. Exit conditions include: RSI overbought signal triggers long position closure, oversold signal triggers short position closure, with fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points). Position sizing leverages five money management modes from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, including fixed lot, balance-proportional, and free margin-proportional modes. The strategy also incorporates a retrospective check mechanism: when both opening and closing are enabled but no close signal exists on the current bar, it loops back through historical bars to find any untriggered reverse close signal, preventing missed exit opportunities.

EA-15771.name: Exp_iWPRSign
EA-15771.summary: This EA trades based on the iWPRSign custom indicator, which generates buy and sell signals from Williams' Percent Range (WPR) crossing overbought/oversold levels. It opens and closes positions systematically on new bar signals, with configurable money management modes and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-15771.summary_zh: 该EA基于iWPRSign自定义指标进行交易，该指标通过威廉百分比（WPR）穿越超买/超卖水平生成买卖信号。它在新K线信号上系统性地开仓和平仓，支持可配置的资金管理模式和固定止损/止盈。
EA-15771.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于威廉百分比范围（WPR）指标的超买超卖反转信号，当WPR穿越上轨（-30）时产生买入信号，穿越下轨（-70）时产生卖出信号。入场条件为：WPR上穿-30水平时做多，WPR下穿-70水平时做空，仅在指定信号K线上触发。出场条件包括固定止损和止盈，以及反向信号平仓——买入信号同时可平卖仓，卖出信号同时可平买仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、含亏损自由保证金比例、含亏损余额比例及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1手或10%资金。EA还包含历史K线回溯检测逻辑，当同时允许开仓和平仓时，会从信号K线向前搜索最近的反向信号以确认平仓条件。
EA-15771.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Williams' Percent Range (WPR) overbought/oversold reversal signals, generating buy signals when WPR crosses above the -30 upper level and sell signals when WPR crosses below the -70 lower level. Entry conditions are: buy when WPR breaks above -30, sell when WPR breaks below -70, triggered only on the specified signal bar. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, as well as reverse-signal closing where a buy signal can close a sell position and a sell signal can close a buy position. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-inclusive free margin percentage, loss-inclusive balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter, defaulting to 0.1 lots or 10% of capital. The EA also includes a historical bar lookback detection logic that searches forward from the signal bar for the nearest reverse signal to confirm closing conditions when both opening and closing are enabled simultaneously.

EA-15780.name: Exp_Chaikin_Volatility_Stochastic
EA-15780.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the Chaikin Volatility Stochastic custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the oscillator lines cross downward and sell positions when they cross upward, with configurable money management and position closing logic. The strategy operates on a multi-timeframe basis using a selectable higher timeframe for signal generation while executing on the current chart timeframe.
EA-15780.summary_zh: 该EA基于Chaikin波动率随机指标的自定义交叉信号进行交易。当振荡器线条向下交叉时开多仓，向上交叉时开空仓，配有可配置的资金管理和仓位关闭逻辑。策略使用可选的更高时间框架生成信号，同时在当前图表时间框架上执行交易。
EA-15780.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Chaikin波动率随机指标的两条线交叉信号。入场条件为：当Osc1从上方穿越Osc2（向下交叉）时产生买入信号，当Osc1从下方穿越Osc2（向上交叉）时产生卖出信号，信号基于SignalBar指定的K线进行判断。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置（StopLoss_=1000, TakeProfit_=2000点），以及反向交叉信号触发的平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用可配置的资金管理比例（MM=0.1），支持固定手数和保证金比例两种模式。EA使用了多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX等）对指标进行平滑处理，提高了信号的稳定性。策略仅在新的K线形成时重新计算信号，避免了逐tick的频繁交易，但缺乏对市场波动性和点差的过滤机制。
EA-15780.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on crossover signals between two lines of the Chaikin Volatility Stochastic custom indicator. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when Osc1 crosses below Osc2 (downward crossover), and a sell signal is generated when Osc1 crosses above Osc2 (upward crossover), with signals evaluated on the bar specified by SignalBar. Exit conditions include hard stop loss and take profit settings (StopLoss_=1000, TakeProfit_=2000 points), as well as position closing logic triggered by reverse crossover signals. Position sizing uses a configurable money management ratio (MM=0.1), supporting both fixed lot and margin percentage modes. The EA employs multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, etc.) for indicator smoothing, which enhances signal stability. The strategy only recalculates signals on new bar formation, avoiding excessive tick-by-tick trading, but lacks filtering mechanisms for market volatility and spread.

EA-15781.name: Exp_iStochKomposter
EA-15781.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom iStochKomposter indicator, a Stochastic-based oscillator with overbought/oversold levels. It opens buy positions on oversold signals and sell positions on overbought signals, with configurable close-on-opposite-signal logic. Position sizing uses a flexible money management system supporting lot, free margin, balance, and loss-based modes.
EA-15781.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义iStochKomposter指标（一种带超买超卖水平的随机振荡器）的信号进行交易。在超卖信号时开多仓，在超买信号时开空仓，并支持反向信号平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用灵活的资金管理模式，支持固定手数、可用保证金、余额和亏损比例等多种模式。
EA-15781.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于自定义iStochKomposter指标的均值回归交易，该指标本质上是一个改进的随机振荡器，结合了ATR周期参数。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号柱上产生非零且非空值时，产生买入信号；当指标下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）在指定信号柱上产生非零且非空值时，产生卖出信号。出场条件分为两类：一是通过反向信号平仓（买入信号触发卖出平仓，卖出信号触发买入平仓），二是通过固定的止损和止盈水平。仓位管理方面，EA提供了五种资金管理模式：固定手数、基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于亏损后可用保证金、基于亏损后余额。EA还实现了新柱检测机制，避免在同一K线内重复交易，并通过Recount标志确保信号读取失败时能够重新计算。此外，当同时允许开仓和平仓但当前无平仓信号时，EA会向前回溯历史柱寻找最近的反向信号来决定是否平仓。
EA-15781.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy is centered on mean reversion trading using the custom iStochKomposter indicator, which is essentially an enhanced Stochastic oscillator combined with an ATR period parameter. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar; a sell signal is generated when the lower buffer (buffer 0) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the signal bar. Exit conditions are twofold: closing via opposite signals (buy signal triggers sell position close, sell signal triggers buy position close), and through fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. For position sizing, the EA offers five money management modes: fixed lot, based on free margin, based on balance, based on post-loss free margin, and based on post-loss balance. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same candle, and uses a Recount flag to ensure signal recalculation when buffer reads fail. Additionally, when both opening and closing are allowed but no close signal exists, the EA backtracks through historical bars to find the nearest opposite signal to determine whether to close existing positions.

EA-15790.name: Exp_ColorJFatl_Digit
EA-15790.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJFatl_Digit custom indicator, which combines JMA smoothing with FATL digital filtering. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0), with configurable position closing on trend reversal signals. Money management supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.
EA-15790.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJFatl_Digit自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了JMA平滑和FATL数字滤波。当指标发出上升趋势信号（值=2）时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号（值=0）时开空仓，并可在趋势反转时平仓。资金管理支持固定手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比等多种模式。
EA-15790.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于ColorJFatl_Digit指标的趋势跟踪系统，该指标融合了JMA（Jurik移动平均）平滑算法和FATL（快速自适应趋势线）数字滤波技术，用于识别市场趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值为2时产生做多信号，值为0时产生做空信号，同时要求前一根K线的值发生状态切换（从非2到2为做多，从非0到0为做空）以确认趋势启动。出场条件包括：趋势反转时平仓（做多信号出现时平空仓，做空信号出现时平多仓），以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持五种资金管理模式：固定手数、基于余额、基于可用保证金及其亏损调整版本。策略仅在NewBar时检测信号（SignalBar=0除外），避免同根K线内重复交易，使用IsNewBar类来控制交易频率。
EA-15790.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the ColorJFatl_Digit indicator, which integrates JMA (Jurik Moving Average) smoothing algorithm with FATL (Fast Adaptive Trend Line) digital filtering technology to identify market trend direction. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 value equals 2, and a sell signal when the value equals 0, with the additional requirement that the previous bar's value must have transitioned into the signal state (from non-2 to 2 for buy, from non-0 to 0 for sell) to confirm trend initiation. Exit conditions include: closing positions on trend reversal (closing sell positions when buy signal appears, closing buy positions when sell signal appears), as well as fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter with five money management modes: fixed lot, balance-based, free margin-based, and their loss-adjusted variants. The strategy only checks signals on new bars (except when SignalBar=0), avoiding repeated trades within the same bar, using the CIsNewBar class to control trade frequency.

EA-15792.name: Exp_ColorX2MA_Digit
EA-15792.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorX2MA_Digit custom indicator, which uses a dual moving average crossover system with digit rounding. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from neutral (0) to bullish (>0), and sell positions when it transitions from neutral (2) to bearish (<2), with configurable money management and position closing logic.
EA-15792.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorX2MA_Digit自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用双重移动平均线交叉系统并进行数字舍入。当指标从中性状态(0)转为看涨(>0)时开多仓，从中性状态(2)转为看跌(<2)时开空仓，具有可配置的资金管理和仓位关闭逻辑。
EA-15792.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双重平滑移动平均线交叉策略，使用两种不同的平滑方法（MA_Method1和MA_Method2）分别计算快慢均线。入场条件：当指标缓冲区值从0变为大于0时产生买入信号，从2变为小于2时产生卖出信号，本质上是一种趋势跟踪策略，捕捉均线交叉的趋势方向变化。出场条件：买入信号同时触发卖出仓位平仓，卖出信号同时触发买入仓位平仓，形成反向信号平仓机制，同时设有固定的止损和止盈（StopLoss=1000点，TakeProfit=2000点）。仓位管理采用多种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数（默认LOT模式，0.1手）。资金管理通过MarginMode枚举实现多种计算方式，允许灵活的风险控制，但缺乏加仓、减仓或追踪止损等高级功能。
EA-15792.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual smoothed moving average crossover strategy using two different smoothing methods (MA_Method1 and MA_Method2) to calculate fast and slow moving averages respectively. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator buffer value transitions from 0 to greater than 0, and a sell signal when it transitions from 2 to less than 2, which is fundamentally a trend-following approach capturing directional changes at MA crossovers. Exit conditions: a buy signal simultaneously triggers closing of sell positions, and a sell signal triggers closing of buy positions, implementing a reverse-signal exit mechanism alongside fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points). Position sizing supports multiple modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage after-loss margin, percentage after-loss balance, and fixed lot size (default LOT mode at 0.1 lots). Money management is implemented through the MarginMode enumeration offering flexible risk control, but lacks advanced features such as position scaling, partial closes, or trailing stops.

EA-15801.name: Exp_iDeMarkerSign
EA-15801.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom iDeMarkerSign indicator, which identifies overbought and oversold conditions using DeMarker oscillator levels. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward crossover above the lower level and sell positions when it signals a downward crossover below the upper level, with configurable close-on-opposite-signal logic. Position sizing is managed via a money management module supporting multiple margin modes.
EA-15801.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义iDeMarkerSign指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标通过DeMarker震荡器的超买超卖水平来识别交易机会。当指标在低位发出向上信号时开多仓，在高位发出向下信号时开空仓，并支持反向信号平仓逻辑。仓位管理通过支持多种保证金模式的资金管理模块实现。
EA-15801.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用DeMarker指标的极值区域反转信号进行交易。入场条件为：当iDeMarkerSign指标在超卖区域（DnLevel=0.3以下）产生上穿信号时开多仓，当在超买区域（UpLevel=0.7以上）产生下穿信号时开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号出现时的平仓机制——代码中有一段逻辑会在当前无反向信号时回溯历史K线寻找更早的平仓信号。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于自由保证金、基于余额、基于净自由保证金和基于净余额的比例计算。资金管理通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现，包含滑点容忍度设置。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根已收盘K线的信号来确认交易，这是一种避免未来数据的合理做法。
EA-15801.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA trades on DeMarker indicator reversal signals from extreme zones. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when iDeMarkerSign generates an upward signal in the oversold zone (below DnLevel=0.3), and a sell position is opened when a downward signal appears in the overbought zone (above UpLevel=0.7). Exit conditions include fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points, plus an opposite-signal close mechanism — the code includes logic that retrospectively scans historical bars to find earlier closing signals when no current reverse signal exists. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, free margin-based, balance-based, net free margin-based, and net balance-based proportional calculation. Money management is implemented via the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, including a deviation/slippage tolerance setting. The strategy defaults to the H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1, meaning it confirms trades on the previous closed bar, which is a sound practice to avoid repainting issues.

EA-15817.name: Exp_FRASMAv2
EA-15817.summary: This EA trades based on the FRASMAv2 (Fractal Adaptive Simple Moving Average v2) custom indicator signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a neutral state to a bullish signal and sell positions when it transitions to a bearish signal, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-15817.summary_zh: 该EA基于FRASMAv2（分形自适应简单移动均线v2）自定义指标信号进行交易。当指标从中性状态转为看涨信号时开多仓，转为看跌信号时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-15817.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用FRASMAv2分形自适应移动均线指标作为核心策略信号源。入场条件：当指标缓冲区值从0（中性）变为大于0时产生买入信号，从2（中性/看跌）变为小于2时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理通过MM参数和MarginMode枚举支持多种模式，包括基于可用保证金、余额、损失后保证金或固定手数。资金管理提供了FREEMARGIN、BALANCE、LOSSFREEMARGIN、LOSSBALANCE和LOT五种模式选择。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar参数控制信号触发时机，并包含新K线检测机制避免重复信号。
EA-15817.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the FRASMAv2 (Fractal Adaptive Simple Moving Average v2) custom indicator as its core signal source. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator buffer value transitions from 0 (neutral) to greater than 0, and a sell signal is generated when it transitions from 2 (neutral/bearish) to less than 2. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus reverse signal-based position closing via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose flags. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MarginMode enumeration, supporting five modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin-based, loss-adjusted balance-based, and fixed lot size. Money management offers FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE, and LOT options for flexible risk allocation. The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe and uses a SignalBar parameter to control signal timing, with a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate signals.

EA-15841.name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA
EA-15841.summary: This EA trades based on the Volume Weighted Moving Average indicator, generating buy signals when the VWMA turns upward and sell signals when it turns downward. It compares three consecutive VWMA values to detect trend direction changes and uses configurable money management modes for position sizing. Entries and exits are controlled separately with boolean toggles, and StopLoss/TakeProfit levels are applied to all positions.
EA-15841.summary_zh: 该EA基于成交量加权移动平均线(VWMA)指标进行交易，当VWMA拐头向上时产生买入信号，拐头向下时产生卖出信号。通过比较三个连续的VWMA值来检测趋势方向变化，并使用可配置的资金管理模式进行仓位管理。入场和出场分别通过布尔开关独立控制，所有仓位均设置止损和止盈。
EA-15841.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于成交量加权移动平均线(VWMA)的趋势跟踪，利用成交量对价格的加权来确认趋势的真实性。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（VWMA从下降转为上升）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值继续上升）时开多单；当Value[1]>Value[2]（VWMA从上升转为下降）且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空单。出场条件为：趋势反转时分别平仓——VWMA下降时平多单，VWMA上升时平空单，同时设置固定点数的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的保证金/余额比例，以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），配合MMMode选择具体的计算方式。策略使用了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线内重复开仓，同时也支持在SignalBar为0时每个tick都进行信号计算。
EA-15841.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is trend following based on the Volume Weighted Moving Average (VWMA), which uses volume weighting to confirm the authenticity of price trends. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Value[1]<Value[2] (VWMA turns from declining to rising) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current value continues rising); a sell signal is generated when Value[1]>Value[2] (VWMA turns from rising to declining) and Value[0]<Value[1]. Exit conditions: positions are closed on trend reversal — long positions close when VWMA declines, short positions close when VWMA rises, with fixed StopLoss (1000 points) and TakeProfit (2000 points) applied. Position sizing supports multiple modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of margin/balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1 risk ratio) combined with the MMMode selector for the specific calculation method. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated entries within the same bar, while also supporting per-tick signal calculation when SignalBar is set to 0.

pros: 使用成交量加权移动平均线，相比简单移动平均更能反映真实的市场趋势强度
入场和出场逻辑完全独立可控，灵活性高，可以只开仓不平仓或只平仓不开仓
具备新K线检测机制，防止同一根K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
