EA-16371.name: Exp_JSatl_Digit_System
EA-16371.summary: This EA implements a trend-following trading system based on the JSatl (Jurik Satl) digital filter indicator, which combines Jurik-style smoothing with adaptive trend-line analysis to identify and follow market trends. It generates buy and sell signals when the JSatl indicator changes direction or crosses threshold levels, opening positions in the direction of the detected trend. The system includes configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters along with position sizing controls.
EA-16371.summary_zh: 该EA基于JSatl（Jurik Satl）数字滤波指标实现趋势跟踪交易系统，结合Jurik风格平滑与自适应趋势线分析来识别和跟随市场趋势。当JSatl指标改变方向或穿越阈值水平时，产生买入和卖出信号，沿检测到的趋势方向开仓。系统包含可配置的止损止盈参数及仓位管理控制。
EA-16371.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于JSatl数字滤波指标，该指标融合了Jurik平滑算法与自适应趋势线技术，旨在过滤市场噪音并捕捉主趋势方向。入场条件依赖JSatl指标的方向变化——当指标由下降转为上升时产生买入信号，由上升转为下降时产生卖出信号，本质上是一种趋势反转跟踪策略。出场条件通过固定止损和止盈参数实现，当价格触及预设水平时自动平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，允许用户通过参数设置每笔交易的手数大小。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和保证金比例检查，但缺乏动态仓位调整机制如ATR-based仓位计算。整体策略逻辑清晰，但过于依赖单一指标的信号质量，在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号。
EA-16371.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the JSatl digital filter indicator, which integrates Jurik smoothing algorithms with adaptive trend-line technology to filter market noise and capture the main trend direction. Entry conditions rely on the JSatl indicator's directional changes—a buy signal is generated when the indicator turns from declining to rising, and a sell signal when it turns from rising to declining, essentially a trend-reversal tracking approach. Exit conditions are implemented through fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters, automatically closing positions when price reaches preset levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot mode, allowing users to set the lot size for each trade via input parameters. Money management provides maximum position limits and margin ratio checks, but lacks dynamic position sizing mechanisms such as ATR-based lot calculation. The overall strategy logic is clear, but it is overly dependent on the signal quality of a single indicator, which may frequently generate false signals in ranging markets.

EA-16396.name: TralingLine
EA-16396.summary: TralingLine is a trailing stop utility EA that dynamically adjusts stop-loss levels by following a trend line drawn on the chart. It does not open its own positions but instead manages existing positions by moving their stop-loss to track a user-defined or algorithmically placed trend line, locking in profits as the market moves favorably.
EA-16396.summary_zh: TralingLine是一个追踪止损工具型EA，通过跟踪图表上绘制的趋势线来动态调整持仓的止损价位。它不自主开仓，而是管理已有持仓，随着市场有利移动将止损沿趋势线推移以锁定利润。
EA-16396.strategy_analysis: TralingLine的核心策略概念是基于趋势线的动态追踪止损管理，而非自主交易策略。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不自行开仓，而是依赖于用户手动或其它EA建立的持仓。出场条件由趋势线位置决定——当价格回撤突破趋势线时，止损被触发从而平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅管理已有订单的止损价位。资金管理方面，该工具通过趋势线追踪来保护已有利润，本质上是一种动态风险控制机制，随着趋势发展逐步锁定浮盈。其优势在于将技术分析中的趋势线直观地与止损管理结合，使交易者可以按照自己对趋势的判断来设定止损跟踪逻辑。
EA-16396.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of TralingLine is dynamic trailing stop management based on a trend line, rather than an autonomous trading strategy. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not open positions on its own; it relies on existing positions created manually or by other EAs. Exit conditions are determined by the trend line position — when price retraces beyond the trend line, the stop-loss is triggered to close the position. For position sizing, this EA does not calculate lot sizes as it only manages stop-loss levels of existing orders. Regarding money management, the tool protects unrealized profits by trailing along the trend line, essentially acting as a dynamic risk control mechanism that progressively locks in gains as the trend develops. Its strength lies in bridging technical analysis trend lines with stop-loss management, allowing traders to align stop tracking with their own trend interpretation.

EA-16408.name: Exp_ColorJSatl_Digit
EA-16408.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJSatl_Digit indicator, which is a digital signal processing-based trend-following indicator that changes color to indicate trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns bullish (color change to upward) and sell positions when it turns bearish, with configurable position management and exit logic.
EA-16408.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJSatl_Digit指标进行交易，该指标采用数字信号处理技术判断趋势方向并通过颜色变化发出信号。当指标转为看涨颜色时开多仓，转为看跌颜色时开空仓，具有可配置的仓位管理和出场逻辑。
EA-16408.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，依赖于ColorJSatl_Digit指标的数字信号处理算法来识别趋势方向变化。入场条件为指标颜色发生转变——从下跌趋势颜色转为上涨趋势颜色时做多，反之做空，本质上是一个趋势反转追踪系统。出场条件通常包括指标颜色再次反转时平仓，以及可能设定的止损和止盈水平。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，可能包含仓位加码或缩仓机制以适应不同账户规模。资金管理方面，EA提供了一些参数用于控制风险敞口，但具体的止损机制需要根据参数配置来评估。整体而言，该策略在趋势明确的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16408.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, relying on the ColorJSatl_Digit indicator's digital signal processing algorithm to identify trend direction changes. Entry conditions are triggered when the indicator color shifts — going long when the color changes from bearish to bullish, and short when the reverse occurs, essentially making it a trend reversal tracking system. Exit conditions typically include closing positions when the indicator color reverses again, along with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, potentially including mechanisms to scale positions up or down based on account size. Money management parameters are provided to control risk exposure, though the actual stop-loss mechanism effectiveness depends on parameter configuration. Overall, the strategy performs well in clearly trending markets but may generate frequent false signals in choppy, range-bound conditions leading to consecutive losses.

EA-16409.name: Exp_Waddah_Attar_Trend
EA-16409.summary: This EA implements the Waddah Attar Trend indicator-based trading strategy, which combines MACD and Bollinger Bands to identify trend direction and strength. It enters long positions when the indicator shows a bullish trend with sufficient momentum and short positions for bearish trends, exiting when the trend weakens or reverses. The EA applies a systematic trend-following approach with configurable parameters for sensitivity and risk management.
EA-16409.summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于Waddah Attar Trend指标的交易策略，结合MACD和布林带来识别趋势方向和强度。当指标显示看涨趋势且动量充足时做多，看跌趋势时做空，在趋势减弱或反转时平仓。EA采用系统化的趋势跟踪方法，具有可配置的灵敏度和风险管理参数。
EA-16409.strategy_analysis: Waddah Attar Trend策略的核心概念是将MACD的动量信号与布林带的波动性结合，构建一个综合趋势判断指标。入场条件方面，当指标柱状图为正且超过阈值时开多单，为负且超过阈值时开空单，这确保了只在趋势明确时才进场。出场条件包括趋势减弱（柱状图缩小到阈值以下）或出现反向信号时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户可通过参数设置交易量。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈设置，但整体依赖趋势持续性来获取利润，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。该策略在强趋势市场中表现良好，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16409.strategy_analysis_en: The Waddah Attar Trend strategy's core concept combines MACD momentum signals with Bollinger Bands volatility to create a comprehensive trend assessment indicator. For entry conditions, a long position is opened when the histogram is positive and exceeds a configurable threshold, and a short position when negative and exceeding the threshold, ensuring trades only occur when trends are well-established. Exit conditions include closing positions when the trend weakens (histogram shrinks below threshold) or when a reversal signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user can set the trading volume through input parameters. Money management provides stop loss and take profit settings, but overall relies on trend persistence for profit generation, lacking a dynamic position adjustment mechanism. The strategy performs well in strong trending markets but may produce frequent false signals leading to consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets.

EA-16418.name: Exp_i4_DRF_v2
EA-16418.summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the i4 (Institutional Index) and DRF (Dynamic Range Filter) indicators, opening positions in the direction of the prevailing trend when the dynamic range confirms momentum. It uses version 2 of the system with improved entry filtering and trade management logic.
EA-16418.summary_zh: 该EA基于i4（机构指数）和DRF（动态范围过滤器）指标实现趋势跟踪策略，在动态范围确认动量时沿主导趋势方向开仓。这是该系统的第二版，改进了入场过滤和交易管理逻辑。
EA-16418.strategy_analysis: 策略核心结合i4指标判断市场机构资金流向和DRF动态范围过滤器确认趋势方向，两者共振时产生交易信号。入场条件为i4指标显示多空方向且DRF过滤器突破动态范围边界，确认趋势启动后顺势开仓。出场条件包括反向信号出现、固定止损止盈触发或动态跟踪止损平仓。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于账户风险的动态手数计算两种模式。资金管理方面设有最大持仓限制和单笔风险百分比控制，以防止过度集中风险。策略适合中长周期运行，避免短线噪音干扰。
EA-16418.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core combines the i4 indicator to gauge institutional money flow direction and the DRF dynamic range filter to confirm trend directionality, generating trade signals when both align. Entry conditions require the i4 indicator showing a bullish or bearish bias while the DRF filter breaks beyond its dynamic range boundary, confirming trend initiation before entering in the trend direction. Exit conditions include opposing signal appearance, fixed stop-loss and take-profit triggers, or dynamic trailing stop closure. Position sizing supports both fixed lot mode and risk-based dynamic lot calculation proportional to account equity. Money management features maximum position limits and per-trade risk percentage controls to prevent over-concentration of exposure. The strategy is suited for medium-to-long timeframe operation, avoiding short-term market noise interference.

EA-16427.name: Exp_JSatlCandle
EA-16427.summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the JSatl (JSA Trend Line) indicator combined with candlestick pattern analysis. It generates buy signals when the JSatl indicator confirms an uptrend and candlestick patterns support continued upward momentum, and sell signals under the opposite conditions. The EA automates trade entry, exit, and position management based on these combined technical signals.
EA-16427.summary_zh: 该EA是基于JSatl（JSA趋势线）指标与K线形态分析相结合的趋势跟踪智能交易系统。当JSatl指标确认上升趋势且K线形态支撑继续上涨时产生买入信号，反之则产生卖出信号。该EA基于这些组合技术信号自动执行入场、出场和仓位管理。
EA-16427.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用JSatl趋势线指标判断主趋势方向，结合K线形态确认入场时机，实现趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：JSatl指标显示趋势方向转变（如从下降转上升时做多），同时配合K线形态（如看涨吞没、锤子线等反转形态）进行二次确认。出场条件包括：JSatl指标发出反向信号、达到预设的止盈止损目标、或K线形态出现反转信号时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，可能根据账户资金比例进行仓位调整。资金管理方面，通过止损设置控制单笔风险，但具体是否包含动态止损或追踪止损需参考参数配置。整体策略属于典型的技术指标组合型趋势跟踪系统，依赖指标信号的及时性和准确性。
EA-16427.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is to use the JSatl trend line indicator to determine the main trend direction, combined with candlestick pattern confirmation for entry timing, implementing trend-following trading. Entry conditions are: the JSatl indicator shows a trend direction change (e.g., going long when shifting from downtrend to uptrend), confirmed by a secondary candlestick pattern signal (such as bullish engulfing, hammer, or other reversal patterns). Exit conditions include: the JSatl indicator issuing a reverse signal, reaching preset take-profit or stop-loss targets, or candlestick patterns showing reversal signals triggering position closure. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading and may adjust position size based on account equity percentage. Money management controls per-trade risk through stop-loss settings, though whether dynamic or trailing stops are included depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy is a typical technical indicator combination trend-following system, relying on the timeliness and accuracy of indicator signals for profitability.

EA-16428.name: Exp_Bear_Bulls_Power
EA-16428.summary: This EA trades based on the Bears Power and Bulls Power indicators developed by Alexander Elder. It enters long positions when Bulls Power is positive and rising, and short positions when Bears Power is negative and falling, using EMA as the trend filter.
EA-16428.summary_zh: 该EA基于Alexander Elder开发的空头力量和多头力量指标进行交易。当多头力量为正且上升时做多，当空头力量为负且下降时做空，使用EMA作为趋势过滤器。
EA-16428.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Elder射线理论，通过衡量多空力量来判断市场主导方向。入场条件：多头力量指标为正值且上升时开多单，空头力量指标为负值且下降时开空单，同时EMA用于确认趋势方向。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及指标反转信号平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面提供了风险百分比参数来控制每笔交易的风险敞口。整体策略属于动量跟随类型，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
EA-16428.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Elder Ray theory, measuring bullish and bearish forces to determine market dominance. Entry conditions: long positions are opened when Bulls Power is positive and rising, while short positions are opened when Bears Power is negative and falling, with EMA serving as the trend confirmation filter. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as indicator reversal signals for position closing. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management provides risk percentage parameters to control the risk exposure per trade. The overall strategy is a momentum-following type, suitable for markets with clear trending conditions.

EA-16438.name: Exp_i4_DRF_v3
EA-16438.summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the i4 (Intraday Intuition Index) and DRF (Dynamic Range Filter) indicators, entering trades when both indicators align in the same direction. It uses dynamic range filtering to identify trend conditions and the i4 indicator for momentum confirmation, with version 3 incorporating additional filtering and risk management refinements. The system operates systematically with predefined entry/exit rules and adjustable position sizing.
EA-16438.summary_zh: 该EA基于i4指标（盘中直觉指数）和DRF指标（动态范围过滤器）实现趋势跟踪策略，当两个指标方向一致时入场交易。它使用动态范围过滤来识别趋势条件，并用i4指标进行动量确认，第3版本增加了额外的过滤和风险管理优化。系统以系统化方式运行，具有预定义的入场/出场规则和可调节的仓位管理。
EA-16438.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双指标确认的趋势跟踪策略，核心逻辑是i4指标与DRF动态范围过滤器的联合信号判定。入场条件要求两个指标同时发出同方向信号，i4指标负责动量方向的判断，DRF指标负责过滤震荡行情并确认趋势的有效性。出场条件包括指标反向信号触发平仓以及预设的止损止盈水平，确保每笔交易都有明确的风险边界。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式，通过参数可调节每笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理方面，EA提供了最大持仓限制和最大回撤控制参数，避免在不利行情中过度暴露风险。整体策略设计强调信号确认的严格性，减少假突破带来的亏损交易。
EA-16438.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual-indicator confirmation trend-following strategy, with the core logic relying on joint signal determination from the i4 indicator and the DRF Dynamic Range Filter. Entry conditions require both indicators to simultaneously emit signals in the same direction, where the i4 indicator handles momentum direction judgment and the DRF filter eliminates choppy market conditions while confirming trend validity. Exit conditions include indicator reversal signals triggering position closure and preset stop-loss/take-profit levels, ensuring every trade has a defined risk boundary. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or account-balance-proportional calculations, with parameters allowing adjustment of risk exposure per trade. For money management, the EA provides maximum position limits and maximum drawdown control parameters to avoid excessive risk exposure during adverse market conditions. The overall strategy design emphasizes strictness of signal confirmation to reduce losing trades caused by false breakouts.

Lack of trading session filters may produce trades with excessive slippage during low-liquidity periods
No ATR-based dynamic stop-loss detected; fixed stops may be too tight during high-volatility conditions

EA-16478.name: Exp_ColorXvaMA_Digit_StDev
EA-16478.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXvaMA_Digit indicator with StDev (Standard Deviation) filtering. It enters positions when the colored moving average changes direction, confirmed by standard deviation volatility conditions. The strategy combines a digitally-smoothed variable-period moving average with volatility filtering for trend reversal entries.
EA-16478.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXvaMA_Digit指标配合标准差(StDev)过滤进行交易。当彩色变周期均线改变方向且标准差波动率条件满足时开仓。策略结合数字平滑变周期移动平均线和波动率过滤来捕捉趋势反转入场点。
EA-16478.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于ColorXvaMA_Digit指标的变色均线信号，该指标是一种数字平滑的变周期移动平均线，当均线颜色从一种变为另一种时代表趋势方向发生改变。入场条件为均线颜色切换且标准差(StDev)达到一定阈值，标准差过滤用于确认波动率足够支持趋势反转的有效性。出场条件主要依赖反向均线颜色信号或止损止盈设置。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过MM参数控制下单量。资金管理方面提供了风险百分比模式可选，但没有动态仓位调整机制。整体策略属于均值回归类型，在趋势反转点入场，依赖波动率确认信号有效性。
EA-16478.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the ColorXvaMA_Digit indicator's color-changing moving average signal, which is a digitally-smoothed variable-period moving average that changes color to indicate trend direction shifts. Entry conditions require the moving average color to switch and the standard deviation (StDev) to reach a specified threshold, where the StDev filter confirms sufficient volatility to support a valid trend reversal. Exit conditions primarily rely on the opposite moving average color signal or user-configured stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach controlled by the MM parameter, with an optional risk-percentage mode available. Money management offers a percentage risk mode but lacks dynamic position adjustment based on account equity changes. The overall strategy is mean-reversion in nature, entering at trend reversal points and relying on volatility confirmation for signal validity.

EA-16487.name: Exp_Delta_RSI
EA-16487.summary: This EA trades based on the Delta RSI indicator, which measures the difference between two RSI periods to detect momentum shifts. It enters long positions when the delta between fast and slow RSI crosses above a threshold and short positions when it crosses below. The strategy aims to capture momentum reversals before they become apparent on a single RSI reading.
EA-16487.summary_zh: 该EA基于Delta RSI指标进行交易，通过计算两个不同周期RSI的差值来捕捉动量变化。当快速RSI与慢速RSI的差值上穿阈值时做多，下穿时做空。策略旨在单一RSI无法显示的动量反转发生时尽早捕捉交易机会。
EA-16487.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用Delta RSI（两个不同周期RSI的差值）来识别动量转折点。入场条件为：当快速RSI减去慢速RSI的差值从负转正并突破设定阈值时开多单，反之当差值从正转负并跌破负阈值时开空单。出场条件通常包括反向信号出现时平仓或达到止损/止盈目标。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式，允许用户通过参数调整每笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理上，EA提供了止损和止盈参数，但具体是否强制设置取决于参数配置。该策略的优势在于能更敏感地捕捉动量变化，比单一RSI指标反应更快，但在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号导致频繁亏损。
EA-16487.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept uses Delta RSI (the difference between two RSI periods) to identify momentum turning points. Entry conditions are: a long position is opened when the fast RSI minus slow RSI delta crosses above a positive threshold, and a short position is opened when the delta crosses below a negative threshold. Exit conditions typically include closing on opposite signal generation or hitting stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a money-management-based calculation, with user-configurable risk exposure per trade. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters, though enforcement depends on the user's configuration. The strategy's advantage is faster sensitivity to momentum shifts compared to a single RSI, but it is prone to false signals in choppy markets leading to frequent losses.

EA-16501.name: Exp_Delta_MFI
EA-16501.summary: This EA trades based on the Delta MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator, which combines volume analysis with price range movements to identify momentum shifts. It enters positions when the delta between current and previous MFI values signals strengthening or weakening market facilitation, typically used to catch trending moves driven by volume participation.
EA-16501.summary_zh: 该EA基于Delta MFI（市场促进指数）指标进行交易，通过结合成交量分析与价格范围变动来识别动量转换。当当前MFI值与前期MFI值的差值发出市场促进加强或减弱的信号时开仓，通常用于捕捉由成交量参与推动的趋势行情。
EA-16501.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是Delta MFI指标，即市场促进指数的变化量，用于衡量市场参与度和动量的变化。入场条件基于MFI差值的正负变化：当Delta MFI为正且成交量增加时，视为多头信号入场做多；当Delta MFI为负且成交量增加时，视为空头信号入场做空。出场条件可能基于反向的Delta MFI信号或固定的止损止盈水平。仓位管理方面，EA可能使用固定手数或基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，EA使用止损来控制单笔风险，但具体的风险控制机制取决于参数设置。整体策略属于动量类策略，依赖成交量确认价格运动的有效性，适合趋势明显且成交量活跃的市场环境。
EA-16501.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA revolves around the Delta MFI indicator, which measures changes in the Market Facilitation Index to gauge shifts in market participation and momentum. Entry conditions are based on the sign and magnitude of the MFI delta: a positive Delta MFI accompanied by increasing volume serves as a bullish signal for long entries, while a negative Delta MFI with rising volume signals bearish conditions for short entries. Exit conditions likely rely on opposing Delta MFI signals or predefined stop-loss and take-profit levels to manage trade closure. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or dynamic calculations based on account equity and risk parameters. Money management incorporates stop-loss orders to limit per-trade risk exposure, though the effectiveness depends heavily on parameter configuration. The overall approach is a momentum-based strategy that relies on volume confirmation to validate price movements, making it most suitable for trending markets with active volume participation.

EA-16512.name: Exp_Delta_WPR
EA-16512.summary: This EA trades based on the delta (change) of the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator, entering positions when the momentum shift of WPR exceeds a threshold. It uses fixed lot sizing with stop loss and take profit for trade management.
EA-16512.summary_zh: 该EA基于威廉百分比指标(WPR)的变化量(Delta)进行交易，当WPR的动量偏移超过阈值时开仓。使用固定手数配合止损和止盈进行仓位管理。
EA-16512.strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是利用WPR指标的变化率(Delta)来捕捉市场动量的突变，而非传统地使用WPR的超买超卖区域。入场条件为WPR的Delta值超过预设阈值时，表明动量方向发生了显著偏移，此时顺势开仓做多或做空。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，没有追踪止损或动态退出机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，不根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面较为简单，仅依赖止损来控制单笔风险，缺乏整体账户风险控制机制如最大回撤限制或连亏保护。
EA-16512.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to capture sudden shifts in market momentum by measuring the rate of change (Delta) of the WPR indicator, rather than using traditional overbought/oversold zones. Entry conditions trigger when the WPR Delta exceeds a predefined threshold, signaling a significant momentum shift, at which point the EA opens a position in the direction of the shift. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is relatively simplistic, relying solely on stop loss for per-trade risk control, lacking overall account-level safeguards such as maximum drawdown limits or consecutive loss protection.

EA-16526.name: Exp_RSI_Slowdown
EA-16526.summary: This EA trades based on RSI slowdown signals, detecting when the RSI indicator's momentum decelerates in overbought or oversold zones as a precursor to trend reversal. It enters trades when RSI shows signs of slowing down near extreme levels, aiming to capture reversal moves. The strategy is a momentum-based mean reversion approach using RSI divergence in momentum rather than price.
EA-16526.summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI减速信号进行交易，检测RSI指标在超买或超卖区域动量减速的情况，作为趋势反转的前兆。当RSI在极端水平附近显示减速迹象时入场，旨在捕捉反转行情。该策略是基于动量的均值回归方法，利用的是RSI动量背离而非价格背离。
EA-16526.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用RSI指标在超买或超卖区域的动量减速现象来捕捉潜在的趋势反转信号。入场条件为：当RSI进入超买区域（通常>70）且其变化速率开始放缓时开空单；当RSI进入超卖区域（通常<30）且其变化速率开始放缓时开多单。出场条件通常包括固定的止盈止损，或者当RSI回到中性区域时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户自定义手数，可能支持固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，需要关注是否有最大持仓限制和连续亏损后的保护机制。整体来看，该策略试图在动量衰竭时入场，属于逆势交易类型，需要对市场趋势有较好的判断以避免在强势趋势中逆势入场。
EA-16526.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is to use the deceleration of RSI momentum in overbought or oversold zones to capture potential trend reversal signals. Entry conditions: when RSI enters the overbought zone (typically >70) and its rate of change begins to slow down, a sell order is placed; when RSI enters the oversold zone (typically <30) and its rate of change begins to slow down, a buy order is placed. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or closing positions when RSI returns to neutral territory. Position sizing allows the user to customize lot size, potentially supporting fixed lots or equity-based dynamic lot calculation. Money management aspects need to be evaluated for maximum position limits and protection mechanisms after consecutive losses. Overall, the strategy attempts to enter when momentum is exhausting, which is a counter-trend trading approach requiring good trend judgment to avoid trading against strong trends.

EA-16560.name: Exp_WPR_Slowdown
EA-16560.summary: This EA trades based on the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator slowdown pattern, entering positions when the WPR momentum decelerates after reaching extreme overbought or oversold zones. It identifies momentum exhaustion as a reversal signal and executes trades accordingly. The strategy aims to capture turning points where price momentum fades near extremes.
EA-16560.summary_zh: 该EA基于威廉指标(WPR)减速模式进行交易，当WPR动量在达到极端超买或超卖区域后减速时入场。它将动量耗尽视为反转信号并据此执行交易。该策略旨在捕捉价格动量在极端值附近衰减的转折点。
EA-16560.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用威廉指标(WPR)的减速现象来判断市场反转时机。WPR指标衡量价格在近期区间中的相对位置，当达到极端超买(接近0)或超卖(接近-100)区域时，表明市场可能过度延伸。入场条件为WPR从极端区域开始减速回落，即动量衰减而非立即反转，这种减速模式被视为趋势即将结束的早期信号。出场条件通常包括WPR回归中性区域或达到预设的止盈止损水平。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户固定手数或基于账户余额动态计算仓位。资金管理依赖于止损设置和仓位控制，但缺少对多重持仓的严格检查可能导致过度敞口风险。
EA-16560.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is to use the deceleration phenomenon of the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator to identify market reversal opportunities. The WPR indicator measures the price's relative position within a recent range, and when it reaches extreme overbought (near 0) or oversold (near -100) zones, it signals that the market may be overextended. Entry conditions are triggered when WPR begins to decelerate from extreme zones, meaning momentum is fading rather than immediately reversing, and this deceleration pattern is interpreted as an early signal that the trend is about to end. Exit conditions typically include WPR returning to neutral territory or reaching preset take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing allows the user to set fixed lots or dynamically calculate position size based on account balance. Money management relies on stop-loss settings and position control, but the lack of rigorous multiple position checks may lead to overexposure risk.

EA-16561.name: Exp_MFI_Slowdown
EA-16561.summary: This EA trades based on the Money Flow Index (MFI) slowdown pattern, detecting when the MFI indicator momentum decelerates after reaching extreme overbought or oversold zones. It opens trades anticipating a reversal when MFI momentum fades, signaling potential price exhaustion and trend change.
EA-16561.summary_zh: 该EA基于资金流量指标(MFI)减速模式进行交易，当MFI指标在达到极端超买或超卖区域后动量减速时检测信号。它在MFI动量衰减时开仓，预示价格可能耗尽动能并发生趋势反转。
EA-16561.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于资金流量指标(MFI)的动量减速检测，当MFI进入超买或超卖区域后其变化速率放缓时，视为趋势即将反转的信号。入场条件为MFI从极端区域回落且当前MFI值相较于前一周期变化幅度减小，表明多空力量正在衰减。多头入场需MFI从超卖区向上减速回升，空头入场需MFI从超买区向下减速回落。出场条件通常包含固定止损和止盈设置，或当MFI反向穿越中性区域时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算方式，缺乏自适应仓位调整机制。资金管理方面仅依赖止损单进行风险控制，没有动态调整止损或追踪止损功能，整体风险控制较为基础。
EA-16561.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on detecting momentum slowdown in the Money Flow Index (MFI), treating the deceleration of MFI after reaching extreme overbought or oversold zones as a signal for impending trend reversal. Entry conditions require MFI to recede from extreme zones with a decreasing rate of change between current and previous MFI values, signaling fading bullish or bearish momentum. Long entries trigger when MFI decelerates upward from oversold territory, while short entries trigger when MFI decelerates downward from overbought territory. Exit conditions typically include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, or closing positions when MFI crosses back through neutral zones. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes or account-balance percentage calculations without adaptive scaling mechanisms. Money management relies solely on stop-loss orders for risk control, lacking dynamic stop adjustments or trailing stop functionality, making the overall risk management relatively basic.

结合超买超卖区域过滤，减少了虚假信号的发生概率

EA-16615.name: Exp_Trigger_Line
EA-16615.summary: This EA trades based on the Trigger Line indicator, which is a variation of the Linear Regression Channel or moving average crossover system. It opens buy positions when the fast trigger line crosses above the slow trigger line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, implementing a systematic trend-following strategy with configurable lot sizing and stop levels.
EA-16615.summary_zh: 该EA基于触发线(Trigger Line)指标进行交易，这是一种线性回归通道或均线交叉系统的变体。当快速触发线上穿慢速触发线时开多仓，反之开空仓，实现了可配置手数和止损水平的系统化趋势跟踪策略。
EA-16615.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双触发线交叉策略作为核心入场逻辑，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统。快速触发线与慢速触发线的金叉作为做多信号，死叉作为做空信号，本质上捕捉的是趋势的启动和转向。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号或预设的止损止盈水平，部分版本可能包含追踪止损机制以保护浮动利润。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，未发现基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺乏复合头寸控制，未观察到马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，但在震荡行情中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16615.strategy_analysis_en: The EA employs a dual trigger line crossover strategy as its core entry logic, representing a classic trend-following system. The golden cross of the fast trigger line above the slow trigger line serves as the buy signal, while the death cross provides the sell signal, essentially capturing trend initiation and reversal. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or preset stop-loss and take-profit levels, with some versions potentially including a trailing stop mechanism to protect floating profits. Position sizing follows a fixed lot model, with no dynamic position adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage observed. Money management lacks compound position control, and no martingale or grid pyramiding logic is present. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, but may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

EA-16649.name: Exp_XMACandles
EA-16649.summary: This EA trades based on the XMACandles indicator, which generates colored candlesticks derived from multiple moving average calculations. It opens buy positions when the indicator candles turn bullish (blue/green) and sell positions when they turn bearish (red), following the trend direction signaled by the XMA crossover logic.
EA-16649.summary_zh: 该EA基于XMACandles指标进行交易，该指标通过多重移动平均线计算生成彩色K线。当指标K线转为看涨颜色时开多仓，转为看跌颜色时开空仓，跟随XMA交叉逻辑指示的趋势方向进行交易。
EA-16649.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于XMACandles指标，该指标通过多重移动平均线的交叉和方向变化来生成彩色K线，反映市场趋势的强度和方向。入场条件为：当XMACandles指标从看跌颜色转为看涨颜色时开多单，从看涨颜色转为看跌颜色时开空单，本质上是趋势跟踪型的移动平均交叉策略。出场条件依赖于指标颜色的反转信号，当趋势方向改变时平仓当前头寸并可能反向开仓。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，参数中包含手数设置。资金管理方面，该EA可能包含止损和止盈设置，但具体取决于参数配置，默认可能仅依赖指标信号反转来控制风险。
EA-16649.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the XMACandles indicator, which generates colored candlesticks through multiple moving average crossovers and directional changes to reflect market trend strength and direction. Entry conditions: open a buy position when the XMACandles indicator changes from bearish color to bullish color, and open a sell position when it changes from bullish to bearish color, essentially a trend-following moving average crossover strategy. Exit conditions rely on the indicator color reversal signal, closing the current position when the trend direction changes and potentially opening a reverse position. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or percentage-based calculation tied to account balance, with lot size parameters available in the configuration. Money management aspects may include stop loss and take profit settings, but this depends on parameter configuration; by default the EA may rely primarily on indicator signal reversals for risk control rather than explicit SL/TP levels.
pros: 基于多重移动平均的趋势跟踪策略，逻辑清晰易懂

EA-16665.name: exp_x2ma_jfatl
EA-16665.summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system combined with the JFATL (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) indicator to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long positions when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA and JFATL confirms the trend direction, and enters short positions on the reverse condition. The system applies a systematic approach with configurable parameters for MA periods, JFATL settings, and risk management.
EA-16665.summary_zh: 该EA使用双均线交叉系统结合JFATL（Jurik快速自适应趋势线）指标来生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当快速均线上穿慢速均线且JFATL确认趋势方向时做多，反之做空。系统采用系统化方法，提供可配置的均线周期、JFATL参数和风险管理设置。
EA-16665.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是双均线交叉结合JFATL趋势线确认的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为快速均线与慢速均线发生金叉或死叉，同时JFATL指标方向与交叉方向一致作为过滤确认，从而减少虚假信号。出场条件通常包括反向交叉信号触发平仓，或达到止损/止盈目标。仓位管理方面，EA提供手数配置参数，支持固定手数交易。资金管理方面，通过止损设置控制单笔风险，但具体的止损机制依赖于参数配置的合理性。整体策略逻辑清晰，双确认机制有效降低了震荡行情中的假突破风险，但在震荡市中仍可能产生连续亏损信号。
EA-16665.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system combining dual moving average crossover with JFATL trend line confirmation. Entry conditions require a golden cross or death cross between fast and slow moving averages, with JFATL direction matching the crossover direction as a filter to reduce false signals. Exit conditions typically include closing positions on reverse crossover signals or hitting stop-loss/take-profit targets. Position sizing relies on configurable lot size parameters, supporting fixed lot trading. Money management controls per-trade risk through stop-loss settings, though the effectiveness depends on reasonable parameter configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear, and the dual-confirmation mechanism effectively reduces the risk of false breakouts in choppy markets, but consecutive losing signals can still occur during ranging conditions.

EA-16672.name: Multi_Lot_Scalper
EA-16672.summary: A scalping EA that employs a martingale-style multi-lot progression strategy, doubling or increasing lot sizes after losing trades to recover losses. It enters positions based on simple technical signals and relies on the increasing position sizes to eventually close in profit when the market reverses. The EA is designed for short-term trades with small take-profit targets but carries significant risk due to its martingale position sizing.
EA-16672.summary_zh: 一个采用马丁格尔式多手数递进策略的剥头皮EA，在亏损交易后加倍或增大手数以回收损失。它基于简单的技术信号入场，并依靠递增的仓位在市场反转时最终获利平仓。该EA设计用于小获利目标的短期交易，但由于其马丁格尔仓位管理方式而承担着显著的风险。
EA-16672.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于马丁格尔原理：每次亏损后增大手数，期望一次赢利覆盖之前所有亏损。入场条件可能依赖简单指标信号如移动平均线交叉或RSI超买超卖来判断短期价格反转点。出场条件通常为固定的止盈点数目标，止损可能缺失或设置较宽以避免过早被止损出局。仓位管理是核心特征：初始手数较小，每次亏损后按倍数或固定比例增加手数，形成1-2-4-8的经典马丁格尔序列。资金管理方面缺乏有效的最大持仓限制或最大回撤保护，在连续亏损行情中账户面临爆仓风险。整体策略在震荡行情中可能表现良好，但在单边趋势中会造成灾难性损失。
EA-16672.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the martingale principle: increasing lot size after each loss, expecting a single win to recover all previous losses. Entry conditions likely rely on simple technical indicators such as moving average crossovers or RSI overbought/oversold levels to identify short-term price reversal points. Exit conditions typically use a fixed take-profit in pips target, while stop-loss may be absent or set very wide to avoid premature stop-outs. Position sizing is the core feature: starting with a small initial lot, each loss triggers a multiplication or fixed-ratio increase in lot size, forming the classic 1-2-4-8 martingale sequence. Money management lacks effective maximum position limits or maximum drawdown protection, exposing the account to margin call risk during consecutive losing streaks. The overall strategy may perform well in ranging markets but can cause catastrophic losses during strong trending conditions.
pros: 在震荡行情中可以稳定获利，小TP目标容易达成
马丁格尔策略理论上可以回收之前所有亏损
参数简单易懂，用户可以快速配置和调整
pros_en: Can generate steady profits in ranging markets where small TP targets are easily hit
Martingale progression theoretically recovers all previous losses with a single winning trade
Simple and intuitive parameters allow users to quickly configure and adjust settings
cons: 马丁格尔策略在单边行情中可能导致爆仓
缺少止损设置使风险无限放大
手数指数增长会很快触及经纪商最大手数限制或账户保证金不足
连续亏损时心理和资金压力极大
cons_en: Martingale strategy can lead to account blow-up during strong trending markets
Absence of stop-loss exposes the account to unlimited downside risk
Exponential lot growth quickly hits broker maximum lot limits or insufficient margin
Extreme psychological and financial pressure during consecutive losing streaks
improvements: 增加严格的最大回撤保护机制，当回撤超过阈值时停止交易
添加有效的止损逻辑替代纯马丁格尔依赖
加入趋势过滤器，在单边行情中暂停马丁格尔加仓
improvements_en: Add strict maximum drawdown protection that halts trading when drawdown exceeds a threshold
Implement effective stop-loss logic instead of relying purely on martingale recovery
Incorporate a trend filter to pause martingale position increases during strong trending markets

缺少有效止损，单笔交易亏损可能超过账户承受能力
无最大持仓数量限制，手数可指数级增长

EA-16673.name: exp_x2ma_jjrsx
EA-16673.summary: This EA generates trading signals based on the crossover of two moving averages (x2MA) combined with the Jurik RSX (JJRSX) momentum indicator as a filter. It enters long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and JJRSX confirms bullish momentum, and enters short on the reverse conditions. The strategy is a systematic trend-following system with momentum confirmation.
EA-16673.summary_zh: 该EA基于两条移动平均线的交叉信号（x2MA）结合Jurik RSX（JJRSX）动量指标作为过滤条件来生成交易信号。当快线上穿慢线且JJRSX确认看涨动量时做多，反之为做空。这是一个带有动量确认的系统性趋势跟踪策略。
EA-16673.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是双移动平均线交叉系统配合Jurik RSX动量指标过滤。入场条件为：做多时快线MA上穿慢线MA，同时JJRSX指标处于上升状态或高于某个阈值；做空则反之。双MA交叉是经典的趋势跟踪方法，而JJRSX作为平滑的动量指标，相比普通RSI减少了噪音信号，能有效过滤假突破和震荡行情中的虚假交叉。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号或JJRSX动量反转。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数，但具体的风控机制取决于参数配置。整体而言，该策略在趋势明确的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16673.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a dual moving average crossover system filtered by the Jurik RSX momentum indicator. Entry conditions are: go long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA while JJRSX confirms bullish momentum (rising or above a threshold), and go short on the reverse. The dual MA crossover is a classic trend-following approach, while JJRSX serves as a smoothed momentum indicator that reduces signal noise compared to standard RSI, effectively filtering out false breakouts and whipsaws in ranging markets. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or JJRSX momentum reversal. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, and some versions may include dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameters, though the specific risk controls depend on parameter configuration. Overall, this strategy performs well in clearly trending markets but may generate frequent false signals leading to consecutive losses in choppy, range-bound conditions.
pros: 双指标过滤减少了单一MA交叉系统的假信号，Jurik RSX的平滑特性显著降低信号噪音
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数可调性强，适合不同市场环境下的优化
趋势跟踪策略在明确趋势行情中表现稳健，盈亏比潜力较大
pros_en: Dual indicator filtering reduces false signals compared to a single MA crossover system; JJRSX's smoothing characteristic significantly reduces signal noise
Clear and understandable strategy logic with highly adjustable parameters, suitable for optimization across different market conditions
Trend-following strategy performs robustly in clear trending markets with good risk-reward ratio potential
cons: 双MA交叉系统天然存在滞后性，入场时趋势可能已经走了一段，导致利润缩水
震荡行情中MA交叉频繁发生，即使有JJRSX过滤仍可能产生连续亏损
默认止损和止盈为0，若用户不手动设置则缺乏基本风险保护，存在较大资金风险
cons_en: The dual MA crossover system inherently suffers from lag; by the time entry signals fire, the trend may already be well underway, reducing potential profit
In ranging markets, MA crossovers occur frequently, and even with JJRSX filtering, consecutive losses are still possible
Default stop loss and take profit are set to 0, meaning without manual configuration the EA lacks basic risk protection, posing significant capital risk
improvements: 增加新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓；添加点差过滤，防止高滑点环境下入场
引入移动止损或追踪止损机制，在趋势行情中锁定利润；增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈，自适应市场波动性
添加交易时段过滤，避免在低流动性时段交易；增加最大持仓数量和最大回撤限制的资金管理模块
improvements_en: Add new bar checking to prevent repeated entries within the same candle; add spread filtering to avoid entries in high-spread environments
Introduce trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits during trending moves; add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for adaptive volatility management
Add trading session filtering to avoid trading during low-liquidity periods; implement maximum position count and maximum drawdown limits as money management modules

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，未设置时仓位完全裸露于市场风险中，可能导致单笔巨额亏损
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线内多次开仓导致过度交易
MA交叉策略在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续小亏累积
risk_points_en: Default SL/TP of 0 leaves positions fully exposed to market risk without configuration, potentially leading to massive single-trade losses
Lack of new bar check may cause multiple entries within the same candle, leading to overtrading
MA crossover strategy may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, causing accumulated losses from consecutive small losses

EA-16681.name: exp_x2ma_digit_dm_361
EA-16681.summary: This EA uses a dual moving average (x2MA) crossover system with digital signal processing and a decision matrix (DM) to generate trend-following trade entries. It combines two smoothed moving averages to detect trend direction changes and applies a 3/6/1 decision logic to filter signals and manage positions.
EA-16681.summary_zh: 该EA使用双重移动平均线(x2MA)交叉系统，结合数字信号处理和决策矩阵(DM)来生成趋势跟踪交易信号。它通过两条平滑移动平均线检测趋势方向变化，并应用3/6/1决策逻辑来过滤信号和管理持仓。
EA-16681.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双移动平均线交叉系统，通过数字信号处理方法对均线进行平滑处理以减少噪音信号。入场条件是当快线上穿慢线时做多，快线下穿慢线时做空，同时决策矩阵(361)会对信号进行多维度过滤确认。出场条件包括反向交叉信号平仓以及内置的止损和止盈机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态计算方式。资金管理方面提供了风险百分比参数控制每笔交易的最大风险敞口。决策矩阵的361逻辑可能代表3个确认条件、6个过滤维度和1个最终执行决策的层级化信号验证体系。
EA-16681.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is built on a dual moving average crossover system enhanced with digital signal processing techniques to smooth the averages and reduce false signals. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, and a short position on the reverse cross, with the decision matrix (361) providing multi-dimensional signal filtration and confirmation. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse crossover signals as well as built-in stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms. Position sizing supports both fixed lot sizes and dynamic calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management incorporates a risk percentage parameter to control the maximum exposure per trade. The 361 decision matrix logic likely represents a hierarchical signal verification system with 3 confirmation conditions, 6 filtering dimensions, and 1 final execution decision, providing a structured approach to trade signal validation.

EA-16682.name: CyberiaTrader
EA-16682.summary: CyberiaTrader is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that identifies rapid price movements and enters trades in the direction of momentum spikes. It uses a proprietary calculation method to detect abnormal price action velocity and executes market orders with fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. The EA is designed for high-frequency trading on M1-M15 timeframes with aggressive entry timing.
EA-16682.summary_zh: CyberiaTrader是一个基于动量的智能交易系统，通过检测价格异常波动速度来捕捉快速行情。它使用专有的计算方法识别动量脉冲方向，并在检测到信号时立即执行市价单，配合固定止盈止损。该EA专为M1-M15时间框架的高频交易设计，入场时机非常激进。
EA-16682.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：CyberiaTrader的核心思想是检测价格运动的加速度和动量异常，当价格在短时间内出现异常快速的移动时，认为趋势将延续并顺势入场。入场条件：通过计算当前价格与历史价格之间的速度差异，当速度超过动态阈值时产生交易信号，做多信号出现在价格向上加速时，做空信号出现在价格向下加速时。出场条件：使用固定点数的止盈和止损，也可以通过反向动量信号平仓。仓位管理：采用固定手数交易，部分版本支持基于账户余额的比例仓位调整。资金管理：虽然设有止损，但动量交易在市场转折时容易出现滑点，且固定止损在波动剧烈时可能不够灵活，缺乏追踪止损机制也是一大缺陷。
EA-16682.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of CyberiaTrader is detecting price acceleration and momentum anomalies, entering trades when price moves abnormally fast in a direction, assuming the momentum will continue. Entry conditions are generated when price velocity exceeds a dynamic threshold calculated from historical price data; buy signals occur on upward acceleration and sell signals on downward acceleration. Exit conditions use fixed pip take-profit and stop-loss levels, with additional option to close on reverse momentum signals. Position sizing uses fixed lots by default, with some versions supporting balance-proportional lot calculation. Money management relies on fixed stop-losses which may not adapt well to changing volatility, and the absence of a trailing stop means profits can evaporate during momentum reversals; slippage during high-volatility entries is also a significant concern.
pros: 动量检测算法独特，能捕捉突发行情的起始阶段

参数相对简洁，用户调整难度低
pros_en: Unique momentum detection algorithm that captures the onset of sudden market moves
Fast entry execution with high sensitivity to short-term momentum explosions

缺乏有效的追踪止损机制，盈利单容易被回撤吞没

risk_points_en: High-frequency momentum trading on M1/M15 suffers severe slippage when spreads widen

No maximum consecutive loss limit or daily drawdown cap for account protection

EA-16686.name: DayTrading
EA-16686.summary: DayTrading is an Expert Advisor designed for intraday scalping on lower timeframes. It enters trades based on momentum and short-term trend signals, targeting small price movements with tight take-profit levels. The EA aims to capture multiple small gains throughout the trading session while using stop-loss protection on each trade.
EA-16686.summary_zh: DayTrading是一个专为日内短线剥头皮设计的EA，在较低时间周期上运行。它根据动量和短期趋势信号入场，以较窄的止盈目标捕捉小幅价格波动。该EA试图在交易时段内通过多次小幅盈利累积收益，同时每笔交易都设有止损保护。
EA-16686.strategy_analysis: DayTrading EA采用日内剥头皮策略，专注于在低时间周期（如M5、M15）上捕捉短期价格波动。入场条件通常基于短期动量指标（如RSI、随机振荡器或MACD）的信号确认，结合价格行为判断短期趋势方向。出场条件包括固定点数的止盈和止损，止盈目标较小以适应剥头皮风格，止损设置相对紧凑以控制单笔亏损。仓位管理方面，EA可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的动态手数计算方式。资金管理上，EA依赖每笔交易的止损来控制风险，但作为剥头皮策略，需要关注点差对盈利的影响，特别是在高波动时段点差扩大可能侵蚀利润。整体策略逻辑较为简单直接，适合流动性好的主流货币对。
EA-16686.strategy_analysis_en: The DayTrading EA employs an intraday scalping strategy focused on capturing short-term price movements on lower timeframes such as M5 or M15. Entry conditions are typically based on short-term momentum indicators like RSI, Stochastic oscillator, or MACD signals combined with price action to determine the immediate trend direction. Exit conditions include fixed-pip take-profit and stop-loss levels, with small take-profit targets suited to the scalping style and relatively tight stop-losses to limit individual trade losses. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or dynamic calculation based on account balance, though the exact method depends on the input parameters. Money management relies on per-trade stop-losses for risk control, but as a scalping strategy, spread costs are a critical factor since wide spreads during volatile periods can easily erode the thin profit margins. The overall strategy logic is straightforward and best suited for highly liquid major currency pairs.

缺乏交易时段和点差过滤可能在高成本时段产生亏损交易
频繁交易累积的手续费成本不可忽视
risk_points_en: Scalping strategy is extremely sensitive to spreads; risk increases significantly when spreads widen
Risk-reward ratio with TP smaller than SL requires high win rate to be profitable
Lack of session and spread filters may produce losing trades during high-cost periods
Cumulative commission costs from frequent trading cannot be ignored

EA-16690.name: 20 200 expert v 4.2 AntS
EA-16690.summary: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy using a 20-period and 200-period moving average, with AntS (Anti-Stop or Anti-S) enhancements in version 4.2. It enters long positions when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and short positions on the reverse crossover, incorporating additional filters and stop management logic.
EA-16690.summary_zh: 该EA使用20周期和200周期双均线交叉策略，在4.2版本中加入了AntS增强功能。当快均线上穿慢均线时做多，反之做空，并包含额外的过滤条件和止损管理逻辑。
EA-16690.strategy_analysis: 该EA基于经典的20/200双均线交叉策略，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为20周期均线与200周期均线的交叉——金叉做多，死叉做空。版本4.2中的AntS增强可能包含反向止损逻辑或防假突破过滤器，以提高信号质量。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的动态计算方式。出场条件可能包括均线反向交叉、固定止盈止损或移动止损。资金管理方面，由于使用200周期均线，属于长周期趋势跟踪，单笔回撤可能较大但胜率相对稳定。该策略在趋势明显的市场中表现良好，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16690.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is based on the classic 20/200 dual moving average crossover strategy, a quintessential trend-following system. Entry conditions are triggered when the 20-period MA crosses above the 200-period MA for long positions and vice versa for short positions. The AntS enhancement in version 4.2 likely incorporates anti-whipsaw filters or reverse-stop logic to improve signal quality and reduce false entries. Position sizing may use fixed lots or dynamic calculation based on account balance. Exit conditions likely include MA reverse crossover, fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels, or trailing stop mechanisms. Money management is characterized by long-period trend following with the 200 MA, meaning individual drawdowns can be significant but the win rate tends to be relatively stable over trending periods. The strategy performs well in strongly trending markets but can suffer from frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging or choppy conditions.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，基于经典双均线交叉，易于理解和验证
20/200均线组合覆盖短长期趋势，在强趋势市场中表现优异
AntS增强功能可能减少了假突破带来的无效交易信号
长周期200均线提供了可靠的趋势方向判断基准
系统化执行避免了情绪化交易，纪律性强
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic based on the classic dual MA crossover, easy to understand and verify
The 20/200 MA combination covers both short and long-term trends, performing excellently in strong trending markets
AntS enhancement likely reduces false breakout signals and unnecessary trades
The 200-period MA provides a reliable benchmark for trend direction determination
Systematic execution eliminates emotional trading and enforces discipline
cons: 均线交叉策略存在明显滞后性，入场和出场都延迟于实际趋势转折点
在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假交叉信号，导致连续亏损
20/200组合的信号频率极低，可能长时间无交易，资金利用率不高
如果未设置止损或止损过大，单笔亏损可能非常严重
缺乏市场波动率或成交量过滤条件，在高波动低趋势环境中容易受损
cons_en: MA crossover strategies have significant lag, with entries and exits delayed from actual trend reversal points
Prone to frequent false crossover signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
The 20/200 combination generates very few signals, potentially resulting in long periods with no trades and low capital utilization
If stop-loss is not set or is too wide, individual trade losses can be very severe
Lacks volatility or volume filters, making it vulnerable in high-volatility low-trend environments
improvements: 增加ATR或波动率过滤器，在低趋势强度环境下减少交易频率
加入多时间框架确认，例如H4趋势方向与D1一致时才入场
引入动态止损止盈，基于ATR倍数设置而非固定点数
improvements_en: Add ATR or volatility filters to reduce trade frequency in low-trend-strength environments
Incorporate multi-timeframe confirmation, such as entering only when H4 and D1 trend directions align
Implement dynamic stop-loss and take-profit based on ATR multiples rather than fixed pip values

risk_points: 双均线交叉存在显著滞后，可能导致大幅回撤后才出场
如果默认止损为0，则存在无止损交易的风险
震荡市中连续虚假信号可能造成累积亏损
risk_points_en: Dual MA crossover has significant lag, potentially causing large drawdowns before exit signals trigger
If default stop-loss is 0, there is risk of trading without protective stops
Consecutive false signals in ranging markets can cause cumulative losses

EA-16709.name: e-Regr
EA-16709.summary: e-Regr is an Expert Advisor that trades based on linear regression channel analysis, entering positions when price deviates from the regression line and reverts back toward it. It uses the regression channel to identify overextended price moves and capitalizes on the statistical tendency of prices to return to their mean. The EA systematically opens buy or sell trades when price touches or crosses the regression channel boundaries.
EA-16709.summary_zh: e-Regr是一个基于线性回归通道分析的智能交易系统，当价格偏离回归线后向均值回归时进场交易。它利用回归通道识别过度延伸的价格走势，并利用价格回归均值的统计趋势获利。当价格触及或穿越回归通道边界时，该EA系统性地开仓买入或卖出。
EA-16709.strategy_analysis: e-Regr策略的核心概念是线性回归通道的均值回归原理，即价格在统计学上倾向于回归到线性回归均值线附近。入场条件为：当价格触及或突破回归通道的上轨时做空，触及或突破下轨时做多，预期价格将回归至通道中线。出场条件包括价格回到回归中线时平仓，或触及止损/止盈水平。仓位管理方面，EA允许通过参数调整手数大小，但具体是否采用固定手数或动态仓位需根据参数设定。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损设置功能，但需注意均值回归策略在强趋势行情中可能面临连续亏损的风险。整体策略逻辑依赖于回归通道周期参数的正确设置，不同市场条件下需要调整参数以适应波动率变化。
EA-16709.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the e-Regr strategy is the mean reversion principle based on linear regression channels, relying on the statistical tendency of prices to revert toward the linear regression mean line. Entry conditions are: when price touches or breaks above the upper regression channel band, a sell position is opened; when price touches or breaks below the lower band, a buy position is opened, with the expectation that price will revert to the channel midline. Exit conditions include closing positions when price returns to the regression midline, or when stop-loss/take-profit levels are hit. Position sizing is configurable through lot size parameters, though the EA appears to use fixed lot sizing rather than dynamic allocation based on account equity. Money management incorporates stop-loss settings, but traders should be aware that mean reversion strategies face the risk of consecutive losses during strong trending markets. The overall strategy logic depends heavily on correct regression channel period settings, and parameters need adjustment to adapt to changing market volatility conditions.

pros: 基于线性回归的均值回归策略具有统计学理论基础，逻辑严谨
回归通道能动态适应价格趋势变化，比静态支撑阻力位更灵活
设有止损止盈参数，提供了基本的风险控制机制
pros_en: Mean reversion strategy based on linear regression has a solid statistical foundation with rigorous logic
Regression channels dynamically adapt to price trend changes, offering more flexibility than static support/resistance levels
Stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide a basic risk control mechanism
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中可能遭受重大亏损，价格可能长期不回归
固定手数的仓位管理方式未考虑账户资金变化，存在过度杠杆风险

Fixed lot sizing does not account for account equity changes, posing over-leveraging risk

improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that adjusts lot size based on account equity and ATR volatility
Implement a trend filter mechanism to pause mean reversion trading during strong trending markets and avoid counter-trend losses

缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓

risk_points_en: Mean reversion strategy faces sustained counter-trend loss risk in one-directional trending markets

EA-16726.name: The MasterMind 2
EA-16726.summary: The MasterMind 2 is a Martingale-based EA that opens trades based on a primary signal (typically a momentum or trend indicator) and doubles the lot size after each consecutive loss, aiming to recover all previous losses with a single winning trade. It operates without a hard stop-loss, relying instead on the Martingale progression and an optional take-profit target to close positions. The strategy inherently carries exponential risk as losing streaks rapidly escalate position sizes.
EA-16726.summary_zh: The MasterMind 2是一个基于马丁格尔策略的EA，在初始信号触发后开仓，每次亏损后将手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利覆盖之前所有亏损。该EA不设硬性止损，依赖马丁格尔倍投和止盈目标来平仓，连续亏损会导致仓位呈指数级增长，风险极高。
EA-16726.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是马丁格尔倍投法：首次开仓使用基础手数，当交易亏损时，下一次开仓手数翻倍，期望一次盈利即可回本并获利。入场条件通常基于简单的技术指标信号（如移动平均线交叉或RSI超买超卖），出场条件为止盈达到设定目标或账户权益触发保护机制。仓位管理采用固定倍数递增（通常为2倍），没有设定止损价格，仅依赖马丁格尔逻辑覆盖亏损。资金管理方面缺乏最大持仓限制和回撤保护，连续亏损可能导致手数迅速膨胀至爆仓。整体策略概念简单但在长期亏损序列下面临毁灭性风险。
EA-16726.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is the Martingale doubling method: it opens the first position with a base lot size and doubles the lot on each subsequent entry after a loss, expecting a single win to recover all prior losses plus profit. Entry conditions are typically based on simple technical indicator signals such as moving average crossovers or RSI overbought/oversold levels, while exit conditions rely on reaching a preset take-profit target or an account equity protection trigger. Position sizing follows a fixed multiplier progression (usually 2x) with no hard stop-loss price set on any individual trade. Money management lacks maximum position limits and drawdown protection, meaning a prolonged losing streak can cause lot sizes to escalate exponentially toward account blowout. The overall strategy concept is straightforward but faces catastrophic risk under sustained losing sequences.
pros: 策略逻辑简单易懂，参数少，便于理解和调试
在短周期震荡行情中可能通过倍投快速回本并获利
设有最大订单数限制，一定程度上控制了极端风险
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and easy to understand with few parameters, facilitating debugging and configuration
In short-term ranging markets, the doubling approach may recover losses and generate profit quickly
Maximum order count limit provides some degree of protection against extreme escalation
cons: 马丁格尔倍投在连续亏损时手数指数增长，极易导致爆仓
没有设定止损价格，单笔交易亏损无上限
缺乏回撤保护和动态手数调整机制，资金管理薄弱
在趋势行情中逆势倍投会加速亏损
cons_en: Martingale lot doubling causes exponential position growth during consecutive losses, easily leading to account blowout
No stop-loss price is set, meaning individual trade losses have no ceiling
Lacks drawdown protection and dynamic lot adjustment, resulting in weak money management
Counter-trend doubling during trending markets accelerates losses
improvements: 增加硬性止损和最大回撤保护，防止单笔或累计亏损失控
改用固定比例仓位管理（如风险百分比）替代马丁格尔倍投，降低爆仓概率
improvements_en: Add hard stop-loss and maximum drawdown protection to prevent uncontrolled single-trade or cumulative losses
Replace Martingale doubling with fixed-fractional position sizing (e.g., risk percentage) to reduce blowout probability

risk_points: 马丁格尔倍投在连续亏损时手数指数增长，可能导致账户爆仓
没有硬性止损，单笔交易亏损无限制
缺乏回撤保护和强制平仓机制
risk_points_en: Martingale lot doubling causes exponential position growth during losing streaks, potentially leading to account blowout
No hard stop-loss means individual trade losses are unlimited
Lacks drawdown protection and forced liquidation mechanisms

EA-16727.name: Artificial Intelligence
EA-16727.summary: This EA uses a neural network-inspired approach to predict price movement directions, employing a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) architecture trained on historical price data. It generates buy/sell signals based on the network's output after processing normalized input features derived from price and indicator values. The system autonomously opens and manages positions according to its trained model predictions.
EA-16727.summary_zh: 该EA使用受神经网络启发的方法来预测价格走势方向，采用在历史价格数据上训练的多层感知器(MLP)架构。它通过网络处理来自价格和指标值的归一化输入特征后生成买入/卖出信号，并根据训练好的模型预测自主开仓和管理仓位。
EA-16727.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于人工神经网络的多层感知器模型，通过输入层接收归一化的价格特征和指标数据，经过隐藏层的非线性变换后在输出层产生交易方向预测。入场条件为神经网络输出值超过预设阈值时触发买入或卖出信号，通常结合多个技术指标如移动平均线、RSI、MACD等作为输入特征。出场条件依赖止盈止损设置或反向信号生成，部分版本还包含追踪止损功能。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数计算方式，但通常缺乏高级资金管理策略如凯利公式或动态风险调整。资金管理方面，该EA的风险控制主要依赖静态止损和手数设定，缺乏自适应的仓位调整机制来应对市场波动率变化，整体风险敞口取决于网络预测的准确率和止损距离的设置。
EA-16727.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) artificial neural network model that receives normalized price features and indicator data through the input layer, undergoes nonlinear transformations in hidden layers, and produces trading direction predictions at the output layer. Entry conditions trigger buy or sell signals when the neural network output exceeds predefined threshold values, typically combining multiple technical indicators such as moving averages, RSI, and MACD as input features. Exit conditions rely on take-profit and stop-loss settings or the generation of opposite signals, with some versions also incorporating trailing stop functionality. Position sizing employs fixed lot sizes or account balance-proportional lot calculations, but generally lacks advanced money management strategies such as the Kelly criterion or dynamic risk adjustment. In terms of money management, the EA's risk control primarily depends on static stop-loss and lot size settings, lacking an adaptive position adjustment mechanism to respond to changes in market volatility, with overall risk exposure depending on the network's prediction accuracy and stop-loss distance configuration.

EA-16728.name: Opening and Closing on Time
EA-16728.summary: This EA automatically opens and closes positions at user-specified times of day, allowing traders to exploit time-based market patterns such as session opens or scheduled volatility windows. It places market orders at designated times and closes all positions at a specified closing time, functioning as a simple time-based trading system. The EA relies purely on time triggers rather than technical indicators for entry and exit decisions.
EA-16728.summary_zh: 该EA在用户指定的时间自动开仓和平仓，允许交易者利用基于时间的市场规律，如时段开盘或定时波动窗口。它在指定时间下市价单，并在指定的平仓时间关闭所有持仓，作为一个简单的基于时间的交易系统。该EA完全依赖时间触发而非技术指标来进行入场和出场决策。
EA-16728.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于时段交易理念，即在特定时间段内市场具有统计上可预测的行为模式，如伦敦或纽约开盘时段的波动性增加。入场条件完全由用户设定的开仓时间触发，EA在指定时间到达时自动执行市价买入或卖出订单，不依赖任何技术指标判断。出场条件同样由时间驱动，当到达用户设定的平仓时间时，EA会关闭所有当前持仓。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数参数，没有动态仓位调整机制，用户需要手动设置交易量大小。资金管理较为薄弱，没有止损和止盈的动态计算，仅依赖时间平仓作为唯一的风险控制手段，缺乏对市场波动性和账户权益的考量。
EA-16728.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on session trading philosophy, where specific time windows exhibit statistically predictable market behavior patterns, such as increased volatility during London or New York session opens. Entry conditions are triggered purely by user-configured opening times, with the EA automatically executing market buy or sell orders when the designated time is reached, without relying on any technical indicator analysis. Exit conditions are similarly time-driven, where the EA closes all open positions when the user-specified closing time arrives. Position sizing uses a fixed lot parameter without any dynamic adjustment mechanism, requiring the user to manually set the trade volume. Money management is relatively weak, as there is no dynamic stop-loss or take-profit calculation, relying solely on time-based closing as the only risk control measure, lacking consideration for market volatility and account equity.

pros_en: Simple and intuitive strategy logic that is easy to understand and configure, suitable for beginners

EA-16732.name: exp_3sto
EA-16732.summary: An Expert Advisor that uses three Stochastic oscillators across different timeframes to generate trading signals. It aligns signals from higher timeframes for trend direction and lower timeframes for entry timing, executing trades when all three Stochastic conditions are met simultaneously.
EA-16732.summary_zh: 该EA使用三个不同周期的随机指标(Stochastic)产生交易信号,通过高周期判断趋势方向、低周期确定入场时机,当三个随机指标条件同时满足时执行交易。
EA-16732.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于三重随机指标共振,通过在三个不同时间周期上部署Stochastic振荡器来确认趋势方向和入场时机。入场条件通常要求高周期Stochastic显示上升趋势(如K线在D线上方且处于超卖区向上交叉),中周期Stochastic确认动量方向,低周期Stochastic提供精确入场信号。出场条件可能包括Stochastic反向交叉、达到预设止盈止损、或高周期趋势反转信号。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位,但具体取决于参数设置。资金管理方面,三重过滤机制本身提供了一定的信号质量保障,但若无动态仓位调整和风险控制机制,在极端行情下仍可能面临较大回撤风险。
EA-16732.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on triple Stochastic convergence across three different timeframes, deploying Stochastic oscillators on higher, medium, and lower timeframes to confirm trend direction and entry timing. Entry conditions typically require the higher-timeframe Stochastic to show an uptrend (e.g., K line crossing above D line from oversold territory), the medium-timeframe Stochastic to confirm momentum direction, and the lower-timeframe Stochastic to provide a precise entry trigger. Exit conditions may include Stochastic reverse crossovers, reaching preset take-profit or stop-loss levels, or higher-timeframe trend reversal signals. Position sizing likely uses fixed lots or account-balance-proportional sizing depending on parameter configuration. Money management relies on the triple-filter mechanism for signal quality assurance, but without dynamic position adjustment and comprehensive risk controls, significant drawdowns may occur during extreme market conditions.

EA-16733.name: exp_3rvi
EA-16733.summary: This EA trades based on the 3-period Relative Vigor Index (RVI) indicator, generating buy and sell signals when the RVI main line crosses its signal line. It opens positions in the direction of the crossover and manages trades with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-16733.summary_zh: 该EA基于3周期相对活力指数(RVI)指标进行交易，当RVI主线与其信号线交叉时产生买卖信号。它在交叉方向开仓，并使用可配置的止损和止盈水平管理交易。
EA-16733.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于相对活力指数(RVI)指标的交叉信号。RVI指标衡量价格收于高点附近的力度，主线与信号线的交叉被视为动量转变的标志。入场条件为RVI主线从下方穿越信号线时做多，从上方穿越信号线时做空。出场条件依赖预设的固定止损和止盈水平，没有追踪止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动性进行动态调整。资金管理方面仅依赖止损来控制单笔风险，缺乏整体仓位控制和回撤保护机制。策略逻辑相对简单，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
EA-16733.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on crossover signals from the Relative Vigor Index (RVI) indicator. The RVI measures the vigor of price closing near its highs, and crossovers between the main line and signal line are interpreted as momentum shifts. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the RVI main line crosses above its signal line, and a sell when it crosses below. Exit conditions rely on preset fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management depends solely on stop loss to control per-trade risk, lacking overall position control and drawdown protection. The strategy logic is relatively simple and works best in trending markets, but is prone to frequent false signals in choppy or ranging conditions.

EA-16741.name: RobotPowerM5 meta4V12
EA-16741.summary: RobotPowerM5 is an M5 timeframe momentum-based Expert Advisor that generates trade signals from a combination of oscillators and trend filters. It enters positions when momentum indicators confirm directional strength and exits via fixed take-profit or stop-loss levels. The EA includes lot sizing and basic risk controls but appears to lack advanced money management features.
EA-16741.summary_zh: RobotPowerM5是一个基于M5时间框架动量策略的EA，通过振荡器和趋势过滤器的组合产生交易信号。当动量指标确认方向性强度时入场，通过固定止盈或止损出场。该EA包含手数设置和基本风险控制，但似乎缺乏高级资金管理功能。
EA-16741.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用动量策略，在M5短周期时间框架上运行，适合捕捉短期价格波动。入场条件依赖于多个动量类指标（如RSI、MACD、随机指标等）的共振确认，当指标集体指向同一方向时触发交易信号。出场条件使用固定的止盈和止损水平，没有追踪止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理基于固定手数或简单的资金比例计算，没有采用马丁格尔或网格策略。资金管理方面相对简单，没有复杂的动态仓位调整或基于波动率的手数计算。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为基础，缺乏对市场状态变化的自适应能力。
EA-16741.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a momentum-based strategy operating on the M5 short-term timeframe, suitable for capturing short-term price movements. Entry conditions rely on confluence confirmation from multiple momentum-type indicators (such as RSI, MACD, Stochastic, etc.), triggering trade signals when indicators collectively point in the same direction. Exit conditions use fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing is based on fixed lots or a simple account percentage calculation, without employing martingale or grid strategies. Money management is relatively simple, lacking complex dynamic position adjustment or volatility-based lot calculation. The overall strategy logic is clear but basic, lacking adaptive capability to changing market conditions.

EA-16759.name: Exp_GStopLoss
EA-16759.summary: Exp_GStopLoss is a utility Expert Advisor that manages stop loss levels for open positions, likely implementing a global or trailing stop loss mechanism. It does not open trades on its own but instead modifies existing positions' stop loss to protect profits or limit losses. The EA monitors all open positions and adjusts their SL according to configurable rules.
EA-16759.summary_zh: Exp_GStopLoss是一个工具类EA，用于管理持仓的止损水平，可能实现全局止损或追踪止损功能。它不自行开仓，而是根据可配置规则修改已有持仓的止损以保护利润或限制亏损。该EA监控所有持仓并按规则调整止损。
EA-16759.strategy_analysis: 该EA属于止损管理工具，不具备自主开仓的策略逻辑。其核心功能是监控账户中所有持仓的止损水平，并根据价格走势动态调整止损位。入场条件不适用，因为它不自行开仓；出场条件通过调整止损间接实现，当价格回撤触及调整后的止损时平仓。仓位管理不涉及，资金管理方面可能包含按点数或百分比设置止损的参数。该工具通常支持对所有品种或指定品种的持仓进行止损调整，并可能包含追踪止损功能，即随着盈利增加将止损逐步向有利方向移动。
EA-16759.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a stop loss management tool and does not have its own trade entry strategy logic. Its core function is to monitor stop loss levels for all open positions in the account and dynamically adjust them based on price movement. Entry conditions are not applicable since it does not open trades on its own; exit conditions are indirectly achieved by adjusting stop loss, closing positions when price retraces to the adjusted stop level. Position sizing is not involved, and money management may include parameters for setting stop loss by pips or percentage. The tool typically supports stop loss adjustment for positions across all symbols or specified symbols, and may include trailing stop functionality that gradually moves the stop loss in the favorable direction as profit increases.

EA-16760.name: Exp_GTakeProfit
EA-16760.summary: This EA implements a grid trading strategy with a global take-profit mechanism. It places pending orders at fixed price intervals and closes all positions once a combined profit target is reached. The strategy relies on price oscillation within a range to capture incremental profits across multiple orders.
EA-16760.summary_zh: 该EA实现了带全局止盈机制的网格交易策略。它在固定价格间隔处放置挂单，并在所有持仓的总盈利达到目标时一次性平仓。该策略依赖价格在一定区间内震荡，通过多个订单逐步累积利润。
EA-16760.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于网格交易，通过在设定价格范围内按固定间距布设买单和卖单来捕获市场波动。入场条件是当价格到达网格的某个价位时，对应的挂单被触发成交，形成持仓。出场条件采用全局止盈机制，即所有持仓的总浮动盈利达到预设目标时，全部平仓；同时也设有全局止损来控制最大亏损。仓位管理方面，每个网格订单使用固定的手数，没有根据账户余额动态调整仓位的功能。资金管理依赖止盈止损比例来控制风险，但由于网格策略在单边行情中会不断加仓，存在较大风险。整体而言，该策略适合震荡行情，在趋势行情中可能遭受严重亏损。
EA-16760.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on grid trading, capturing market fluctuations by placing buy and sell pending orders at fixed intervals within a set price range. Entry conditions are met when price reaches a grid level and the corresponding pending order is triggered. Exit conditions use a global take-profit mechanism where all positions are closed when the combined floating profit reaches a preset target, along with a global stop-loss to cap maximum loss. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size per grid order without dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management relies on the take-profit and stop-loss ratio, but the grid strategy continuously adds positions in trending markets, creating significant risk. The strategy is suitable for ranging markets but may suffer severe losses in strong trending conditions.

cons: 单边趋势行情中网格会持续加仓，可能导致严重浮亏甚至爆仓
固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，大资金使用效率低
没有考虑点差和手续费对高频网格交易的侵蚀影响
cons_en: Grid continuously adds positions in trending markets, potentially causing severe floating losses or margin calls
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, reducing capital efficiency for larger accounts
Does not account for spread and commission erosion effects on high-frequency grid trading
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和风险比例自动调整手数
加入趋势过滤器，在强趋势行情中暂停网格或调整方向
增加点差和手续费的考量，优化网格间距的最小盈利阈值

Incorporate a trend filter to pause grid trading or adjust direction during strong trending markets

EA-16762.name: MTC Combo v2
EA-16762.summary: MTC Combo v2 is a multi-strategy Expert Advisor that combines multiple trading techniques (trend following, momentum, and mean reversion signals) across different timeframes to generate composite entry signals. The EA uses a combo approach where multiple independent signal components must align before opening a position, aiming to filter out false signals and improve trade quality.
EA-16762.summary_zh: MTC Combo v2是一个多策略组合EA，它在不同时间周期上结合趋势跟踪、动量和均值回归等多种交易技术来生成复合入场信号。该EA采用组合方法，要求多个独立信号组件对齐后才开仓，旨在过滤虚假信号并提高交易质量。
EA-16762.strategy_analysis: MTC Combo v2的核心策略概念是多重确认组合交易，通过融合不同类别的技术信号来提高入场可靠性。入场条件要求多个独立信号模块同时发出同方向信号，形成共振效应后才触发交易，这大幅降低了单一指标误判的概率。出场条件结合了固定止盈止损和动态跟踪止损，在保护利润的同时给予趋势足够的运行空间。仓位管理采用基于账户余额的比例仓位计算方式，可根据风险承受能力调整单笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理方面包含了最大持仓限制和连续亏损后的保护机制，但具体的马丁格尔或网格特征需要根据参数配置来判断。整体策略设计偏向保守稳健，多重过滤机制有效减少了虚假信号，但也可能在高波动行情中错过部分机会。
EA-16762.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of MTC Combo v2 is multi-confirmation combo trading, which improves entry reliability by fusing signals from different technical categories. Entry conditions require multiple independent signal modules to emit same-direction signals simultaneously, creating a resonance effect before triggering a trade, which significantly reduces the probability of single-indicator misjudgment. Exit conditions combine fixed take-profit and stop-loss with dynamic trailing stops, protecting profits while giving trends enough room to develop. Position sizing uses an account-balance-proportional calculation method, allowing adjustment of per-trade risk exposure based on risk tolerance. Money management includes maximum position limits and protection mechanisms after consecutive losses, though the presence of Martingale or grid characteristics depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy design leans conservative and steady, with multiple filtering mechanisms effectively reducing false signals, but this may also cause missed opportunities during high-volatility market conditions.

EA-16764.name: PivotHeiken 3
EA-16764.summary: This EA combines Pivot Point levels with Heiken Ashi candlestick analysis to generate trade signals. It identifies entry opportunities when Heiken Ashi candles confirm direction near pivot support/resistance levels, and manages trades with take profit and stop loss based on pivot structure. The strategy aims to capture reversals or breakouts at key pivot levels confirmed by Heiken Ashi trend direction.
EA-16764.summary_zh: 该EA结合支点（Pivot Point）水平与平均K线（Heiken Ashi）分析来生成交易信号。当Heiken Ashi蜡烛在支点支撑/阻力位附近确认方向时，识别入场机会，并基于支点结构设定止盈止损来管理交易。该策略旨在捕捉由Heiken Ashi趋势方向确认的支点关键位反转或突破。
EA-16764.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于传统支点计算（每日开盘、最高、最低、收盘价）得出支撑S1/S2/S3和阻力R1/R2/R3水平，结合Heiken Ashi平滑蜡烛图判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当价格接近支点支撑位且Heiken Ashi蜡烛由红转绿时做多，当价格接近支点阻力位且Heiken Ashi蜡烛由绿转红时做空。出场条件包括基于支点距离的固定止盈止损，以及Heiken Ashi颜色反转时的信号出场。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面，止损通常设置在相邻支点水平之外，以确保风险可控。整体策略逻辑清晰，但依赖支点位的准确性及Heiken Ashi在震荡市中的假信号过滤能力。
EA-16764.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on traditional pivot point calculations using daily open, high, low, and close prices to derive support S1/S2/S3 and resistance R1/R2/R3 levels, combined with Heiken Ashi smoothed candles for trend direction confirmation. Entry conditions: go long when price approaches pivot support and Heiken Ashi candles turn from red to green; go short when price approaches pivot resistance and Heiken Ashi candles turn from green to red. Exit conditions include fixed take profit and stop loss based on pivot level distances, plus signal exits when Heiken Ashi color reverses. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or percentage-based calculation tied to account balance. Money management sets stop losses beyond adjacent pivot levels to ensure risk is controlled. The overall strategy logic is clear but depends on pivot level accuracy and Heiken Ashi's ability to filter false signals in choppy markets.

EA-16782.name: Exp_GStop
EA-16782.summary: Exp_GStop is a utility Expert Advisor that manages trailing stops and guaranteed stop-loss levels for open positions. It does not open trades on its own but instead monitors existing positions and dynamically adjusts stop-loss orders to protect profits. The EA provides automated risk management by trailing stops based on configurable parameters.
EA-16782.summary_zh: Exp_GStop是一个工具类EA，主要用于管理持仓的移动止损和保本止损功能。它不会自行开仓，而是监控已有持仓并动态调整止损价位以保护利润。该EA通过可配置参数提供自动化的风险管理功能。
EA-16782.strategy_analysis: Exp_GStop的核心策略概念是追踪止损和保本止损管理，而非自主交易。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行开仓操作，仅对已有持仓进行管理。出场条件基于移动止损逻辑：当价格朝有利方向移动达到设定点数后，止损会被移动到保本或锁定利润的位置。仓位管理不涉及，因为EA不负责开仓或调整仓位大小。资金管理体现在通过动态止损保护已实现浮盈，防止盈利回撤为亏损。该EA通常提供多种追踪止损模式（如按点数追踪、按百分比追踪、按指标追踪等），并允许用户配置激活距离和追踪距离等关键参数。
EA-16782.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of Exp_GStop is trailing stop and guaranteed stop-loss management rather than autonomous trading. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not execute opening trades; it only manages existing positions. Exit conditions are based on trailing stop logic: when the price moves favorably by a configured number of points, the stop-loss is moved to breakeven or a profit-locking level. Position sizing is not involved as the EA does not handle opening or adjusting lot sizes. Money management is reflected through dynamic stop-loss adjustments that protect floating profits from reversing into losses. The EA typically offers multiple trailing stop modes (such as fixed-point trailing, percentage-based trailing, or indicator-based trailing) and allows users to configure key parameters like activation distance and trailing step distance.

EA-16783.name: 2MA Bunny Cross Expert
EA-16783.summary: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy known as the 'Bunny Cross,' generating buy signals when a fast MA crosses above a slow MA and sell signals on the reverse crossover. It systematically opens and closes positions based on these crossover events, making it a classic trend-following system. The EA is designed for automated execution without manual intervention.
EA-16783.summary_zh: 该EA实现了被称为'Bunny Cross'的双均线交叉策略，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时产生买入信号，反之下穿时产生卖出信号。它根据这些交叉事件系统性地开仓和平仓，是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统。该EA专为全自动执行而设计，无需人工干预。
EA-16783.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双移动平均线交叉作为核心策略概念，属于典型的趋势跟踪型交易系统。入场条件为：当快速均线从下方穿越慢速均线向上时开多单，当快速均线从上方穿越慢速均线向下时开空单。出场条件通常为反向交叉信号出现时平仓，可能也包含止损和止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，该策略缺乏自适应的仓位调整机制，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。整体而言，策略逻辑简单明了，但在不同市场环境下的适应性有限。
EA-16783.strategy_analysis_en: The EA employs a dual moving average crossover as its core strategy concept, representing a classic trend-following trading system. Entry conditions are straightforward: a buy position is opened when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, and a sell position is opened when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. Exit conditions typically involve closing the position upon a reverse crossover signal, and may include stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing generally uses either a fixed lot size or an account-equity-based lot calculation method. Money management is relatively basic, lacking adaptive position adjustment mechanisms that could respond to changing market volatility. The strategy tends to generate frequent false signals during ranging or choppy markets, leading to consecutive losses when no clear trend exists.

EA-16786.name: exp_centerofgravitycandle
EA-16786.summary: This EA trades based on the Center of Gravity indicator applied to candle data, entering positions when price deviates from the calculated center of gravity and expecting a reversion to the mean. It generates buy signals when the COG value is at the lower band and sell signals when at the upper band, typically using crossover or extreme-level detection for entries. The strategy systematically opens and closes positions based on these oscillator-style signals without discretionary input.
EA-16786.summary_zh: 该EA基于应用于K线数据的重心(Center of Gravity)指标进行交易,当价格偏离计算的重心时入场,预期价格将回归均值。在COG值处于下轨时产生买入信号,处于上轨时产生卖出信号,通过交叉或极值检测来确定入场时机。该策略系统性地根据振荡器类信号开仓和平仓,无需人工干预。
EA-16786.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Center of Gravity(重心)指标,这是一个由John Ehlers开发的振荡器类指标,通过多项式回归计算价格的重心位置来判断市场的超买超卖状态。入场条件为:当COG指标从下轨区域向上穿越时开多单,表示价格从超卖区域开始回归;当COG指标从上轨区域向下穿越时开空单,表示价格从超买区域开始回归。出场条件通常依赖COG指标回到中轴或穿越中轴时平仓,也可能设置止损和止盈水平。仓位管理方面,EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式,具体取决于参数设置。资金管理方面,该EA可能缺乏动态调整仓位大小的机制,风险控制主要依赖止损设置。整体策略属于典型的均值回归类型,在震荡行情中表现较好,但在强趋势行情中可能连续亏损。
EA-16786.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Center of Gravity (COG) indicator, an oscillator developed by John Ehlers that uses polynomial regression to calculate the center of gravity of price, determining overbought and oversold market conditions. Entry conditions: buy when the COG indicator crosses upward from the lower band area, indicating price is reverting from oversold territory; sell when the COG indicator crosses downward from the upper band area, indicating price is reverting from overbought territory. Exit conditions typically rely on the COG returning to or crossing the zero line, though stop-loss and take-profit levels may also be configured. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or an equity-proportional calculation depending on parameter settings. Money management may lack a dynamic position-sizing mechanism, with risk control primarily dependent on stop-loss settings. The overall strategy is a classic mean reversion type that performs well in ranging markets but may suffer consecutive losses in strong trending conditions.
