EA-18800.name: Martin
EA-18800.summary: This EA implements a classic Martingale strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade while resetting to the initial lot after a win. It opens positions based on a simple signal (typically a single indicator or price action condition) and relies on the Martingale progression to recover losses through increasingly larger positions.
EA-18800.summary_zh: 该EA实现了经典的马丁格尔策略，在每次亏损交易后将手数翻倍，而在盈利后重置为初始手数。它基于简单信号（通常是单一指标或价格行为条件）开仓，并通过不断加大的仓位来弥补损失。
EA-18800.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于经典马丁格尔理论：亏损后加倍下注，一次赢利即可覆盖之前所有亏损。入场条件通常依赖单一技术指标信号（如移动平均线交叉或RSI超买超卖）判断方向开仓。出场条件为达到止盈目标时平仓获利，若亏损则在下一笔交易中加倍手数。仓位管理采用等比递增方式，每次亏损后手数乘以倍数系数（通常为2），盈利后回归初始手数。资金管理方面缺乏硬性止损，账户风险随连续亏损呈指数级增长，在极端行情下可能导致爆仓。该策略在震荡市中短期可能有效，但面对单边趋势行情时存在巨大风险。
EA-18800.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the classic Martingale theory: doubling the bet after each loss so that a single win can recover all previous losses. Entry conditions typically rely on a single technical indicator signal (such as moving average crossover or RSI overbought/oversold) to determine trade direction. Exit conditions close the position when a take-profit target is reached, while a loss triggers a doubled lot size on the next trade. Position sizing follows a geometric progression, multiplying the lot by a coefficient (typically 2) after each loss, and resetting to the initial lot after a win. Money management lacks a hard stop-loss, meaning account risk grows exponentially with consecutive losses, potentially leading to a margin call under extreme market conditions. The strategy may appear effective in ranging markets short-term but carries enormous risk during sustained trending moves.
pros: 逻辑简单易懂，新手也能快速理解运行机制
在震荡行情中短期表现可能较好，能持续获利
盈利后自动重置手数，锁定利润避免过度加仓
pros_en: Simple and easy-to-understand logic, accessible even for beginners
May perform well short-term in ranging/sideways markets, generating consistent small profits
Automatically resets lot size after a win, locking in profits and avoiding over-leveraging

缺乏有效止损机制，单边行情中亏损无上限
不适应趋势行情，逆势加仓会放大损失

Poorly suited for trending markets, adding to losing positions amplifies losses
Does not account for the erosion effect of spreads and commissions on the Martingale sequence

未对最大仓位设置硬性限制，风险敞口不可控

EA-18817.name: Exp_ForceTrend
EA-18817.summary: This EA trades based on the Force Trend indicator, which combines price force and trend direction to generate buy and sell signals. It opens positions when momentum confirms a trend shift and manages trades with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The strategy is a systematic momentum-following approach that aims to capture trending moves.
EA-18817.summary_zh: 该EA基于Force Trend指标进行交易，结合价格动力和趋势方向产生买卖信号。当动量确认趋势转向时开仓，并通过可配置的止损和止盈水平管理交易。策略是一种系统化的动量跟踪方法，旨在捕捉趋势行情。
EA-18817.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于Force Trend指标的动量跟踪系统。入场条件为Force Trend指标发出趋势方向确认信号时开仓做多或做空，通常依赖指标线的方向变化或穿越零轴来判断。出场条件包括触及止损或止盈水平，以及指标发出反向信号时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面，止损和止盈参数可配置但缺乏追踪止损或部分平仓等高级功能。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为基础，缺乏对市场波动性和流动性的适应性调整。
EA-18817.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a momentum-following system based on the Force Trend indicator. Entry conditions trigger when the Force Trend indicator confirms a trend direction shift, typically using indicator line direction changes or zero-line crossovers as signals. Exit conditions include hitting stop loss or take profit levels, and closing positions when the indicator issues a reverse signal. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management relies on configurable stop loss and take profit parameters but lacks advanced features like trailing stops or partial position closing. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively basic, lacking adaptive adjustments for market volatility and liquidity conditions. The EA does not incorporate spread filtering or session awareness, which could lead to unfavorable entries during high-spread or low-liquidity periods.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调整参数
基于动量指标的趋势跟踪，在强趋势市场中表现较好
提供可配置的止损止盈，有基本的风险控制
代码结构简洁，便于二次开发和优化
使用魔术号区分订单，支持多EA并行运行
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and adjust parameters
Momentum-based trend following performs well in strong trending markets
Configurable stop loss and take profit provide basic risk control
Clean code structure facilitates further development and optimization
Magic number for order identification supports running multiple EAs simultaneously
cons: 固定手数不根据账户资金和波动性动态调整，资金管理不够灵活
缺乏追踪止损功能，趋势行情中可能无法锁定足够利润

Implement multi-timeframe confirmation and spread filtering to enhance entry quality and reduce false signals

EA-18824.name: Trade in Channel
EA-18824.summary: This EA trades within a price channel, identifying channel boundaries and executing trades on breakout or reversal signals. It automatically detects channel highs and lows, then enters positions when price action confirms a breakout or bounce from channel edges. The system includes built-in stop loss and take profit management based on channel dimensions.
EA-18824.summary_zh: 该EA在价格通道内进行交易，自动识别通道上下边界，并在价格突破或反弹时执行交易。系统根据通道宽度自动计算止损和止盈水平，实现通道突破与通道内反转相结合的交易策略。
EA-18824.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于价格通道的突破与回归交易。EA通过识别一定周期内的最高价和最低价来构建价格通道，当价格突破通道上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空，属于通道突破策略。同时，当价格触及通道边界后反弹时，也可能触发通道内反转交易。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、通道反向边界平仓以及时间过滤平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，止损距离根据通道宽度动态调整，确保风险与市场波动性相匹配。整体策略逻辑清晰，但通道识别在趋势转折时可能出现滞后。
EA-18824.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on price channel breakout and mean reversion trading. The EA constructs a price channel by identifying the highest high and lowest low over a specified lookback period, then enters long positions when price breaks above the upper channel boundary and short positions when price breaks below the lower boundary. Exit conditions include fixed take profit and stop loss levels calculated from channel width, reverse channel boundary exits, and optional time-based filters. Position sizing can use either fixed lots or dynamically calculated lots based on account balance and risk percentage. Money management adjusts stop loss distance according to channel width, ensuring risk is proportional to market volatility. The overall strategy logic is clear and systematic, but channel identification may lag during trend transitions, leading to false breakouts.

EA-18827.name: OzFx
EA-18827.summary: OzFx is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossovers combined with oscillator filters to identify and ride market trends. It enters long positions when fast MA crosses above slow MA with confirming oscillator signals, and short positions on the reverse. The EA includes trailing stop functionality and risk management parameters to protect profits during trending moves.
EA-18827.summary_zh: OzFx是一个趋势跟踪型EA，利用移动平均线交叉结合振荡器过滤来识别并跟随市场趋势。当快速MA上穿慢速MA且振荡器信号确认时做多，反之时做空。该EA包含移动止损功能和风险管理参数，以在趋势运行中保护利润。
EA-18827.strategy_analysis: OzFx策略的核心概念是基于移动平均线的金叉和死叉来判断趋势方向，并结合振荡器（如RSI或MACD）作为入场过滤条件，避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓。入场条件为快速均线穿越慢速均线，同时振荡器处于超买或超卖区域之外确认趋势强度。出场条件包括固定的止盈止损设置以及移动止损跟踪机制，当价格向有利方向移动时逐步锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，允许用户自定义每笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理方面，该EA提供最大持仓限制和单日最大亏损控制参数，但缺少马丁格尔或网格等激进策略，整体偏向稳健的趋势跟踪风格。
EA-18827.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the OzFx strategy is based on moving average crossovers (golden cross and death cross) to determine trend direction, combined with oscillator filters (such as RSI or MACD) as entry confirmation to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets. Entry conditions require the fast moving average to cross the slow moving average while the oscillator confirms trend strength by staying outside overbought or oversold zones. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss settings along with a trailing stop mechanism that gradually locks in profits as price moves favorably. Position sizing supports both fixed lot size and percentage-based calculation derived from account balance, allowing users to customize risk exposure per trade. Money management features include maximum position limits and daily maximum loss control parameters, but the EA lacks aggressive strategies like martingale or grid, leaning towards a conservative trend-following style overall.

具备移动止损功能，能在趋势行情中有效锁定浮动利润

在震荡行情中仍可能产生连续亏损信号，振荡器过滤不能完全避免

EA-18841.name: Nevalyashka
EA-18841.summary: Nevalyashka is a Mean Reversion EA that trades price deviations from a moving average centerline. It opens positions when price moves excessively away from the mean and closes when price reverts back. The strategy relies on statistical return-to-mean behavior with fixed lot sizing and stop loss protection.
EA-18841.summary_zh: Nevalyashka是一个均值回归EA，基于价格偏离均线中心线的程度进行交易。当价格过度偏离均值时开仓，价格回归时平仓。该策略依赖统计回归均值行为，采用固定手数和止损保护。
EA-18841.strategy_analysis: Nevalyashka策略的核心概念是均值回归，即价格偏离移动平均线达到一定程度后倾向于回归。入场条件为价格偏离均线超过设定的阈值倍数时开仓，做多当价格向下偏离，做空当价格向上偏离。出场条件包括价格回归到均线附近时获利平仓，以及触及止损时亏损平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理方面设有止损和止盈，但缺乏复合仓位管理或加仓机制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但在趋势行情中可能面临连续亏损的风险。
EA-18841.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Nevalyashka strategy is mean reversion, expecting price to return to its moving average after significant deviations. Entry conditions trigger when price deviates beyond a configured threshold multiplier from the moving average line — longs when price is below the mean, shorts when above. Exit conditions include profit-taking when price reverts to the moving average vicinity, and stop-loss execution when the deviation continues against the position. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management incorporates stop loss and take profit levels, but lacks compounding position management or scaling-in mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, but it faces the risk of consecutive losses during strong trending markets where mean reversion fails.

EA-18857.name: Last ZZ50
EA-18857.summary: This EA trades based on ZigZag indicator signals, identifying swing highs and lows to determine trend direction and enter positions at reversal points. The 'ZZ50' likely refers to a ZigZag with a 50-pip or 50-point depth parameter for filtering minor price movements. It opens buy positions at ZigZag lows and sell positions at ZigZag highs, aiming to catch trend reversals and ride the new trend.
EA-18857.summary_zh: 该EA基于ZigZag指标信号进行交易，通过识别摆动高低点来判断趋势方向并在反转点入场。'ZZ50'可能指深度参数为50点或50个点的ZigZag指标，用于过滤小幅价格波动。它在ZigZag低点开多单，在ZigZag高点开空单，旨在捕捉趋势反转并跟随新趋势运行。
EA-18857.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ZigZag指标的摆动点识别，当ZigZag确认新的低点形成时开多单，当确认新的高点形成时开空单。入场条件依赖ZigZag指标完成一个摆动点的确认，这需要价格回撤超过设定的深度阈值（50点/点）。出场条件可能包括固定止盈止损或等待下一个ZigZag摆动点形成后平仓。仓位管理方面，从文件名无法确定是否包含动态手数计算，可能使用固定手数。资金管理方面，缺乏明确的资金管理机制是该类EA的常见问题，仅依赖ZigZag信号本身而不考虑账户风险敞口。
EA-18857.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on ZigZag indicator swing point identification, opening long positions when a new ZigZag low is confirmed and short positions when a new ZigZag high is confirmed. Entry conditions rely on the ZigZag indicator completing a swing point confirmation, which requires price to retrace beyond the configured depth threshold (50 points/pips). Exit conditions may include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or waiting for the next ZigZag swing point to form before closing. Position sizing is unclear from the filename alone but likely uses fixed lot sizes without dynamic calculation based on account equity. Money management is a common weakness in ZigZag-based EAs as they typically rely solely on the indicator signal without considering overall account risk exposure or drawdown limits.

EA-18862.name: AutoSLTP
EA-18862.summary: AutoSLTP is a utility EA that automatically sets Stop Loss (SL) and Take Profit (TP) levels on open positions that lack them. It monitors existing trades and applies predefined SL/TP values based on user configuration, acting as a risk management assistant rather than a strategy-based trading system.
EA-18862.summary_zh: AutoSLTP是一个工具型EA，自动为缺少止损和止盈的持仓设置止损（SL）和止盈（TP）水平。它监控现有交易并根据用户配置的预设值应用SL/TP，作为风险管理辅助工具而非策略型交易系统。
EA-18862.strategy_analysis: AutoSLTP本身不执行任何交易策略，它不会基于技术指标或市场信号开仓。其核心功能是持续扫描用户账户中所有开放持仓，检测哪些仓位缺少止损或止盈设置。当发现没有SL/TP的仓位时，它会根据用户预设的参数值自动为这些仓位添加止损和止盈订单。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅对已有仓位进行止损止盈的补充设置。资金管理方面，它通过强制设置止损来帮助用户控制单笔交易的最大亏损，这是一种被动的风险管理手段。出场条件完全依赖于用户设定的SL/TP值，当市场价格触及止损或止盈水平时由平台自动平仓。
EA-18862.strategy_analysis_en: AutoSLTP does not execute any trading strategy on its own; it does not open positions based on technical indicators or market signals. Its core functionality is to continuously scan all open positions in the user's account, detecting which positions lack a stop loss or take profit. When it finds positions without SL/TP, it automatically applies stop loss and take profit orders based on the user's predefined parameter values. In terms of position sizing, this EA does not involve lot size calculation since it only modifies existing positions rather than opening new ones. Regarding money management, it helps users control maximum loss per trade by enforcing stop loss placement, which serves as a passive risk management tool. Exit conditions depend entirely on the user-configured SL/TP values, with the platform automatically closing positions when market price reaches the stop loss or take profit level.

EA-18886.name: New Random
EA-18886.summary: This EA generates random trade entries with configurable direction probability, lot size, and stop loss/take profit levels. It is essentially a random-number-based trading system that opens positions without any technical analysis or market logic. The EA serves as an experimental or benchmark tool to compare against strategy-based systems.
EA-18886.summary_zh: 该EA基于随机数生成器产生交易信号，以可配置的概率决定做多或做空，并设置止损和止盈水平。它本质上是一个没有任何技术分析或市场逻辑的随机交易系统，主要用于实验或作为基准对比策略化交易系统的效果。
EA-18886.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念完全基于随机数生成，没有任何技术指标或市场分析方法作为入场依据。入场条件是通过随机数与预设的做多概率阈值比较来决定交易方向，当随机数低于阈值则做多，否则做空。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈水平，没有移动止损或其他动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过参数直接设定交易手数，没有根据账户余额或风险比例进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险控制机制，没有最大持仓限制、没有回撤保护、没有资金比例计算，仅靠固定止损作为唯一的风险屏障。整体策略更接近赌博而非投资，不适合实盘交易使用。
EA-18886.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is entirely based on random number generation, with no technical indicators or market analysis methods used as entry basis. Entry conditions are determined by comparing a random number against a preset long-bias probability threshold; if the random number is below the threshold, it goes long, otherwise it goes short. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with no trailing stop or other dynamic exit mechanisms. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user directly sets the trade volume through a parameter, without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk ratio. Money management lacks risk control mechanisms such as maximum position limits, drawdown protection, or equity-proportional sizing, relying solely on the fixed stop loss as the only risk barrier. The overall strategy is closer to gambling than investing and is unsuitable for live trading.

EA-18893.name: up3x1 Investor
EA-18893.summary: The up3x1 Investor EA is a trend-following expert advisor that likely uses moving average-based or momentum-based signals to identify and ride market trends. It opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend and manages them with trailing stops or trend-reversal exit logic. The EA is designed for medium-to-long-term swing trading on major currency pairs.
EA-18893.summary_zh: up3x1 Investor是一个趋势跟踪型EA，基于均线或动量信号识别并跟随市场趋势开仓。它在趋势方向上建仓，并通过移动止损或趋势反转逻辑管理仓位。该EA适用于主要货币对的中长期波段交易。
EA-18893.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用趋势跟踪策略，通过技术指标判断市场主要方向并在趋势确认后入场。入场条件通常基于移动均线交叉、价格突破或动量指标确认趋势方向。出场条件包括趋势反转信号触发平仓、移动止损保护利润以及固定止损控制单笔亏损。仓位管理方面，EA可能根据账户余额或风险比例动态调整手数，也可能使用固定手数。资金管理上，EA通过止损和移动止损限制每笔交易的风险敞口，但具体的风险控制强度取决于参数设置。总体而言，该策略在趋势明确的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损。
EA-18893.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy that identifies the prevailing market direction using technical indicators and enters after trend confirmation. Entry conditions are typically based on moving average crossovers, price breakouts, or momentum indicator signals confirming the trend direction. Exit conditions include trend reversal signals triggering position closure, trailing stops to protect profits, and fixed stop-losses to limit individual trade losses. For position sizing, the EA may dynamically adjust lot sizes based on account balance or risk percentage, or it may use fixed lots. Money management relies on stop-loss and trailing stop mechanisms to limit risk exposure per trade, though the actual risk control strength depends on parameter settings. Overall, the strategy performs well in clearly trending markets but may generate frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy conditions.

EA-18904.name: Opposite Trade
EA-18904.summary: This EA opens opposite (hedging) positions against existing trades when a specified drawdown threshold is reached. It acts as a loss recovery mechanism by opening reverse trades with adjustable lot multipliers to hedge against adverse price movement.
EA-18904.summary_zh: 该EA在现有持仓达到指定浮亏阈值时，自动开立反向对冲仓位。通过可调的手数倍数开立反向交易来对冲不利价格波动，作为一种亏损恢复机制。
EA-18904.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于对冲恢复：当现有持仓浮亏达到设定的阈值时，EA自动开立反向仓位进行对冲。入场条件是当前持仓的浮亏超过InpLossForOpposite参数指定的点数或金额阈值。出场条件依赖于对冲仓位的盈利覆盖原仓位亏损，或由用户手动关闭。仓位管理采用可调的倍数系数（LotMultiplier），对冲仓位的手数可以大于原仓位以加速回本。资金管理方面，EA允许设置最大对冲次数限制以防止无限开仓。但该策略本质上是一种有限马丁格尔变体，在极端单边行情中仍面临风险。整体而言，这是一种被动防守型策略，而非主动进攻型交易系统。
EA-18904.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on hedge recovery: when an existing position's floating loss exceeds a configured threshold, the EA automatically opens an opposite position to hedge. Entry condition is triggered when current position drawdown surpasses the InpLossForOpposite parameter threshold in points or monetary value. Exit conditions depend on the hedge position's profit covering the original position's loss, or manual closure by the user. Position sizing uses an adjustable multiplier coefficient (LotMultiplier) where the hedge position's lot size can exceed the original to accelerate breakeven recovery. Money management includes a maximum hedge count limit to prevent unlimited position opening. However, the strategy is essentially a limited martingale variant and still faces risk in extreme trending markets. Overall, this is a defensive recovery strategy rather than a proactive trading system.

EA-18942.name: Exp_Stopreversal
EA-18942.summary: This EA implements a stop-reversal strategy that reverses position direction when price hits a stop level, effectively turning every stop-loss into a new entry signal in the opposite direction. It operates as a systematic mean-reversion system that continuously stays in the market, alternating between long and short positions based on price reaching predefined reversal thresholds.
EA-18942.summary_zh: 该EA实现了止损反转策略，当价格触及止损水平时反转持仓方向，将每次止损转化为反向新入场信号。它作为一种系统性均值回归策略，始终持仓，基于价格达到预定义反转阈值在多头和空头之间交替。
EA-18942.strategy_analysis: 止损反转策略的核心概念是当当前持仓被止损出场时，立即在相反方向开立新仓位，本质上将止损转化为反转信号。入场条件为：当多头仓位被止损平仓后立即开空，当空头仓位被止损平仓后立即开多，始终在市场中保持持仓。出场条件仅依赖止损触发，没有独立的止盈逻辑，盈利完全依赖价格在下次反转前朝有利方向移动足够距离。仓位管理通常使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算，缺乏根据市场波动率动态调整仓位的机制。资金管理方面存在明显不足，因为策略持续持仓且每次反转都产生新交易，在单边趋势行情中会连续止损并反复反转，导致累积亏损风险极大。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在趋势行情中会产生连续亏损，属于典型的均值回归策略特征。
EA-18942.strategy_analysis_en: The stop-reversal strategy's core concept is that when the current position is stopped out, a new position is immediately opened in the opposite direction, effectively converting each stop-loss into a reversal entry signal. Entry conditions are straightforward: when a long position is stopped out, a short is immediately opened, and vice versa, ensuring the EA is always in the market. Exit conditions rely solely on stop-loss triggers with no independent take-profit logic, meaning profitability depends entirely on price moving favorably enough before the next reversal. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or balance-proportional sizing without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility or ATR. Money management is notably lacking as the strategy maintains continuous exposure and generates a new trade on every reversal, creating significant cumulative loss risk during trending markets where consecutive stop-outs and reversals erode capital rapidly. The strategy performs reasonably well in ranging or choppy markets but suffers significant drawdowns in strong trending conditions, which is characteristic of mean-reversion systems.

EA-19046.name: Burg Extrapolator
EA-19046.summary: This EA uses the Burg method (Maximum Entropy Method) for spectral analysis and extrapolation of price series. It decomposes the price signal into its frequency components using autoregressive modeling, then forecasts future price movement by extrapolating those components forward. Trading signals are generated based on the extrapolated price direction.
EA-19046.summary_zh: 该EA使用Burg方法（最大熵法）对价格序列进行频谱分析和外推预测。通过自回归建模将价格信号分解为频率成分，然后外推这些成分来预测未来价格走势，并根据外推方向生成交易信号。
EA-19046.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Burg谱分析方法，这是一种最大熵谱估计技术，通过对价格序列进行自回归(AR)建模来提取信号的频率成分。EA将历史价格数据分解为多个正弦波分量，每个分量具有特定的振幅、频率和相位，然后将这些分量向前外推以预测未来价格走势。入场条件基于外推预测的方向：当预测价格上升时开多仓，当预测价格下降时开空仓。出场条件通常依赖反向预测信号或固定止损止盈。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数或基于资金的简单仓位计算。资金管理相对简单，缺乏动态风险调整机制。这种方法本质上是假设价格序列具有周期性特征可以外推，属于统计学上的均值回归思路，但在强趋势市场中可能失效。
EA-19046.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on the Burg spectral analysis method, a maximum entropy spectral estimation technique that performs autoregressive (AR) modeling on price series to extract frequency components. The EA decomposes historical price data into multiple sinusoidal components, each with specific amplitude, frequency, and phase, then extrapolates these components forward to forecast future price movement. Entry conditions are based on the extrapolated prediction direction: long positions when the forecast predicts rising prices, short positions when the forecast predicts falling prices. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse prediction signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses fixed lots or simple equity-based calculation. Money management is relatively basic, lacking dynamic risk adjustment mechanisms. This approach inherently assumes price series possess periodic characteristics that can be extrapolated, following a mean reversion philosophy, but may fail in strong trending markets.

数学模型透明，预测过程可解释性强，不同于黑盒机器学习方法
pros_en: Employs advanced spectral analysis with solid theoretical foundation; the Burg method has mature applications in signal processing
Capable of capturing implicit periodic characteristics in price series, providing good prediction in ranging markets
Transparent mathematical model with interpretable prediction process, unlike black-box machine learning approaches
cons: 频谱外推假设价格具有周期性，在强趋势市场或突发事件中预测会严重偏离

Lacks robust risk management mechanisms; stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, posing significant loss risk

improvements: 增加自适应模型阶数选择机制，如基于AIC/BIC准则自动确定最优阶数
添加趋势过滤器，在强趋势市场中暂停交易或切换策略，避免外推失效
improvements_en: Add adaptive model order selection mechanism, such as AIC/BIC criterion-based automatic optimal order determination
Add trend filter to suspend trading or switch strategy in strong trending markets, avoiding extrapolation failure

频谱外推方法在非平稳市场中预测不可靠，可能导致连续错误信号
risk_points_en: Stop-loss defaults to 0, meaning no hard risk control; single trade loss can expand indefinitely
Spectral extrapolation is unreliable in non-stationary markets, potentially generating consecutive wrong signals

EA-19048.name: Carbophos
EA-19048.summary: Carbophos is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses a combination of moving average crossovers and momentum indicators to identify and ride market trends. It enters trades when fast and slow moving averages cross in the direction of the prevailing trend confirmed by ADX strength. The EA includes built-in position management with trailing stops and fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels.
EA-19048.summary_zh: Carbophos是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，结合均线交叉和动量指标来识别并跟随市场趋势。当快慢均线在ADX确认的趋势方向上交叉时开仓。EA内置仓位管理功能，包含移动止损和固定的止盈止损水平。
EA-19048.strategy_analysis: Carbophos策略的核心概念是基于双重均线交叉的趋势跟踪系统，辅以ADX指标过滤弱势行情避免假突破。入场条件为快速均线与慢速均线发生金叉或死叉，且ADX值高于阈值确认趋势强度足够。出场条件包括触及固定止盈止损、均线反向交叉信号、以及移动止损被触发。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，没有使用马丁格尔或网格加仓策略。资金管理方面设有最大持仓限制和单日最大亏损控制，但在仓位缩放方面相对简单，缺乏根据波动率动态调整的机制。
EA-19048.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Carbophos strategy is a dual moving average crossover trend-following system supplemented by ADX indicator filtering to avoid false breakouts in weak markets. Entry conditions require a golden cross or death cross between fast and slow moving averages with ADX value above a threshold confirming sufficient trend strength. Exit conditions include hitting fixed take-profit or stop-loss levels, a reverse moving average crossover signal, or trailing stop activation. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation tied to account balance, without employing martingale or grid scaling strategies. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and daily maximum loss controls, but the position scaling mechanism is relatively simple and lacks dynamic volatility-based adjustment.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，均线交叉搭配ADX过滤有效减少假信号
设有固定止损和移动止损，风险控制机制相对完善
不使用马丁格尔或网格策略，避免了爆仓的极端风险
趋势跟踪策略在强势行情中表现良好，能够捕获中长期趋势
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic with MA crossover plus ADX filtering effectively reduces false signals
Fixed stop-loss and trailing stop provide relatively sound risk control mechanisms
No martingale or grid strategies used, avoiding the extreme risk of account blowout
Trend-following approach performs well in strong trending markets, capturing medium-to-long-term trends
cons: 均线交叉系统存在明显滞后性，入场和出场时机偏晚导致利润回吐
震荡行情中频繁产生虚假交叉信号，可能导致连续亏损
仓位管理缺乏根据市场波动率动态调整的机制，固定手数在高波动时风险偏大
未包含点差过滤机制，在高压差品种上交易成本可能侵蚀利润
cons_en: MA crossover system has noticeable lag, causing late entries and exits that lead to profit givebacks
Frequent false crossover signals in ranging markets can lead to consecutive losses
Position sizing lacks dynamic volatility-based adjustment; fixed lots carry higher risk during high volatility
No spread filter included, so trading costs on high-spread instruments may erode profitability
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如在H4趋势方向上只做H1同向交叉信号，减少假信号
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整止损距离和仓位大小
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., only taking H1 crossover signals aligned with H4 trend direction to reduce false signals
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit that automatically adjusts distance and position size based on market volatility

risk_points: 均线滞后性导致止损被触发前已有较大浮亏
缺乏点差过滤在高压差环境下可能频繁止损
固定止损在低波动行情中可能过大而在高波动行情中过小
risk_points_en: MA lag may result in significant floating loss before stop-loss is triggered
Lack of spread filter may cause frequent stop-outs in high-spread environments
Fixed stop-loss may be too wide in low volatility and too tight in high volatility conditions

EA-19067.name: EA Trix
EA-19067.summary: EA Trix is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that uses the Triple Exponential Moving Average (Trix) indicator to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when the Trix indicator crosses above its signal line and enters short positions when it crosses below. The EA is designed to capture momentum shifts while filtering out market noise through the triple smoothing of the TRIX oscillator.
EA-19067.summary_zh: EA Trix是一个基于动量的智能交易系统，使用三重指数移动平均线（Trix）指标来生成交易信号。当Trix指标向上穿越其信号线时做多，向下穿越时做空。该EA通过TRIX振荡器的三重平滑来过滤市场噪音，捕捉动量转换。
EA-19067.strategy_analysis: EA Trix的策略核心是利用三重指数移动平均线（TRIX）指标来识别市场动量的方向变化。入场条件：当TRIX指标线从下方穿越其信号线时开多单，表示动量转为上升；当TRIX线从上方穿越信号线时开空单，表示动量转为下降。出场条件主要依赖反向交叉信号平仓，也可能设置止损和止盈来控制单笔交易的风险。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户自定义交易手数，但缺少基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，EA提供止损止盈参数供用户设置，但未集成复合头寸管理或追踪止损功能。整体而言，该策略属于典型的动量跟踪系统，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-19067.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of EA Trix revolves around the Triple Exponential Moving Average (TRIX) oscillator to identify shifts in market momentum direction. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the TRIX line crosses above its signal line, indicating upward momentum; a short position is opened when the TRIX line crosses below its signal line, indicating downward momentum. Exit conditions primarily rely on the opposite crossover signal for closing positions, with optional stop loss and take profit levels to manage individual trade risk. Position sizing allows the user to define a fixed lot size, but lacks dynamic position sizing based on account equity or market volatility. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameters, but does not incorporate compound position management, trailing stops, or equity-based risk scaling. Overall, this is a classic momentum-following system best suited for trending markets, though it may generate frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy or range-bound conditions.

EA-19070.name: Pending orders by time
EA-19070.summary: This EA places pending buy and sell orders at user-specified times during the trading day. It allows traders to schedule order placements at precise moments, such as around market openings or news events, with configurable expiry, stop loss, and take profit levels for each order type.
EA-19070.summary_zh: 该EA允许交易者在指定时间自动挂出买入和卖出待处理订单。用户可以设定精确的下单时间、止损、止盈和订单过期时间，适用于在市场开盘或重要新闻发布前后定时部署订单。
EA-19070.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于时间的定时挂单策略，其概念是交易者预判特定时段可能出现的价格突破或波动，在指定时间自动部署买入和卖出挂单。入场条件完全依赖用户设定的时间参数，当系统时间到达指定时刻时，EA会在当前价格上下方分别放置买入止损和卖出止损挂单。出场条件通过每个订单类型独立配置的止损和止盈参数实现，也可以设置订单过期时间自动取消未成交订单。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，由用户手动设定买入和卖出的手数大小。资金管理方面，EA没有内置的资金管理逻辑，完全依赖用户自行决定仓位规模，缺乏基于账户余额或风险比例的动态仓位调整功能。整体而言，这是一个半自动化工具，策略判断完全依赖交易者自身对市场时段的预判。
EA-19070.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a time-based scheduled pending order placement system, where the trader predicts potential price breakouts or volatility at specific trading sessions and automates order deployment. Entry conditions rely entirely on user-defined time parameters — when the system clock reaches the specified hour and minute, the EA places buy stop and sell stop pending orders above and below the current price respectively. Exit conditions are implemented through independently configurable stop loss and take profit levels for each order type, along with an optional order expiration time that automatically cancels unfilled orders. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach, with the user manually setting lot sizes for buy and sell orders separately. Money management is absent from the EA's internal logic, meaning position sizing is entirely at the trader's discretion without any dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage. Overall, this is a semi-automated utility where strategic judgment depends completely on the trader's own assessment of market session behavior.

EA-19089.name: OpenTime
EA-19089.summary: OpenTime is an Expert Advisor that trades at specific session open times, entering positions when a new trading session begins. It captures the momentum and volatility that typically occurs at market open by placing trades in the direction of the prevailing trend or based on predefined directional bias at session start. The EA uses time-based entry logic combined with session-specific price action to execute trades.
EA-19089.summary_zh: OpenTime是一个在特定交易时段开盘时进行交易的Expert Advisor,在新的交易时段开始时进场持仓。它通过在市场开盘时沿当前趋势方向或预设方向下单来捕捉通常在开盘时出现的动量和波动性。该EA使用基于时间的入场逻辑结合时段特定的价格行为来执行交易。
EA-19089.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于交易时段开盘时刻的波动性捕捉,认为市场在主要时段(如伦敦、纽约)开盘时往往会出现方向性突破和较大波动。入场条件为当服务器时间到达预设的交易时段开盘时间时,EA会根据当前价格与前一周期收盘价的关系或趋势指标判断方向并开仓。出场条件通常包括止盈和止损的设置,也可能在时段结束时平仓以避免隔夜风险。仓位管理方面,EA允许用户固定手数或根据账户余额动态计算仓位大小。资金管理依赖于止损距离与账户风险的比值,但具体实现细节因源码为二进制无法完全确认。
EA-19089.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on capturing volatility at trading session open times, under the assumption that major sessions (London, New York) often produce directional breakouts and significant moves at their open. Entry conditions trigger when server time reaches a predefined session open time, where the EA determines trade direction based on the relationship between current price and previous period close or trend indicators. Exit conditions typically include take profit and stop loss levels, and may also close positions at session end to avoid overnight risk. Position sizing allows the user to set fixed lots or dynamically calculate size based on account balance. Money management relies on the ratio of stop loss distance to account risk, though specific implementation details cannot be fully confirmed as the source code is binary and unreadable.

EA-19095.name: Anubis
EA-19095.summary: Anubis is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossovers combined with momentum filters to identify and ride market trends. It enters trades when fast and slow moving averages cross in the direction of the prevailing trend confirmed by a momentum oscillator. The EA includes built-in stop loss and take profit management with optional trailing stop functionality.
EA-19095.summary_zh: Anubis是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，利用均线交叉结合动量过滤器来识别并跟随市场趋势。当快速均线和慢速均线在动量震荡指标确认的趋势方向上交叉时入场交易。该EA内置止损止盈管理，并带有可选的移动止损功能。
EA-19095.strategy_analysis: Anubis EA的核心策略基于双均线交叉系统，通过快速均线与慢速均线的金叉和死叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件要求均线交叉信号必须得到动量指标（如RSI或MACD）的确认，避免在震荡行情中产生虚假信号。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及可选的移动止损，后者在趋势延续时锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额百分比的风险计算方式，确保单笔交易风险可控。资金管理方面，EA提供了最大持仓限制和最大回撤保护参数，防止过度交易和账户资金大幅缩水。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在强震荡市中均线交叉容易频繁发出错误信号，需要配合过滤条件使用。
EA-19095.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of the Anubis EA is based on a dual moving average crossover system, using golden cross and death cross of fast and slow moving averages to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require that the MA crossover signal be confirmed by a momentum indicator such as RSI or MACD, avoiding false signals in ranging markets. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels along with an optional trailing stop that locks in profits as the trend extends. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or risk-based calculation using a percentage of account balance, ensuring controlled risk per trade. Money management features include maximum position limits and maximum drawdown protection parameters to prevent overtrading and significant account equity depletion. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-structured, though MA crossovers can generate frequent false signals in strongly ranging markets, necessitating complementary filter conditions.

EA-19102.name: MT45
EA-19102.summary: MT45 is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossover signals filtered by ADX strength to enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It includes optional trailing stop functionality and ATR-based stop loss management for dynamic risk control. The EA operates systematically on multiple timeframes with configurable parameters for MA periods, ADX thresholds, and position sizing.
EA-19102.summary_zh: MT45是一个趋势跟踪智能交易系统，使用移动平均线交叉信号配合ADX强度过滤来顺趋势方向入场交易。它包含可选的追踪止损功能和基于ATR的动态止损管理，用于动态风险控制。该EA可在多个周期上系统化运行，提供MA周期、ADX阈值和仓位管理的可配置参数。
EA-19102.strategy_analysis: MT45的核心策略是基于移动平均线交叉的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件：当快速MA上穿慢速MA且ADX值超过设定阈值时开多单，反之当快速MA下穿慢速MA且ADX确认趋势强度时开空单。出场条件：采用ATR倍数作为止损距离，同时提供追踪止损功能以锁定利润。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和单笔最大亏损控制参数。该策略的优势在于ADX过滤可以有效避免震荡行情中的虚假信号，但趋势行情结束后可能产生较大回撤。
EA-19102.strategy_analysis_en: MT45's core strategy is a trend following system based on moving average crossovers. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and the ADX value exceeds the configured threshold, while a short position is opened when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA with ADX confirming trend strength. Exit conditions: an ATR multiple is used as the stop loss distance, and an optional trailing stop function locks in profits as the trend progresses. Position sizing supports both fixed lot sizes and percentage-based calculations relative to account equity. Money management includes parameters for maximum open positions and per-trade maximum loss limits. The strategy benefits from ADX filtering which effectively avoids false signals during ranging markets, but may experience significant drawdowns when trending phases end abruptly.

EA-19110.name: Multi Time Frame Trader
EA-19110.summary: This EA analyzes multiple timeframes simultaneously to generate trading signals, entering positions only when higher and lower timeframe signals align. It uses a multi-timeframe confluence approach to filter out noise and improve trade quality by requiring agreement across different time horizons. The EA manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels while monitoring multiple timeframe conditions for exit signals.
EA-19110.summary_zh: 该EA同时分析多个时间周期以生成交易信号，仅在高低周期信号一致时才开仓。它采用多周期共振方法来过滤噪音并提高交易质量，要求不同时间维度的信号达成一致。EA通过可配置的止损和止盈水平管理仓位，同时监控多周期条件作为出场信号。
EA-19110.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是多周期共振交易，通过同时监控多个时间框架（如M15、H1、H4）的技术指标信号来确认交易方向。入场条件要求较短周期和较长周期的信号必须一致，例如短周期出现买入信号的同时长周期趋势也必须向上，这种多重确认机制有效过滤了虚假信号。出场条件包括止损止盈触发、反向信号出现或多个时间框架信号反转。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态仓位计算方式，允许用户选择适合自己的仓位管理模式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和每日最大亏损限制等保护机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，通过多周期分析降低了单一时间框架的误判风险，但也可能因过度过滤而错过部分交易机会。
EA-19110.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is multi-timeframe confluence trading, which monitors technical indicator signals across multiple timeframes (such as M15, H1, H4) simultaneously to confirm trade direction. Entry conditions require alignment between shorter and longer timeframe signals — for example, a buy signal on the shorter timeframe must coincide with an upward trend on the longer timeframe, effectively filtering out false signals through multiple confirmation layers. Exit conditions include stop loss and take profit triggers, opposing signal generation, or reversal of signals across multiple timeframes. Position sizing supports both fixed lot and dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage, giving users flexibility to choose their preferred money management approach. Risk management includes maximum position limits and daily maximum loss protection mechanisms to safeguard capital. The overall strategy is logically sound, reducing single-timeframe misjudgment risk through multi-timeframe analysis, though the strict filtering may cause missed trading opportunities during fast-moving markets.

EA-19119.name: Multi Stochastic
EA-19119.summary: This EA uses multiple Stochastic oscillators across different timeframes to generate trading signals. It enters trades when multiple Stochastic indicators align in the same direction across timeframes, confirming overbought or oversold conditions. The strategy aims to filter out false signals by requiring confluence from several timeframe perspectives.
EA-19119.summary_zh: 该EA使用多个不同时间周期的随机指标(Stochastic)来生成交易信号。当多个时间周期的随机指标在同一方向上对齐时，确认超买或超卖条件后入场交易。该策略旨在通过要求多个时间周期视角的共振来过滤虚假信号。
EA-19119.strategy_analysis: Multi Stochastic EA的核心策略概念是基于多时间周期随机指标的共振确认。入场条件要求多个时间周期的Stochastic指标同时处于超买区（高于某一阈值）时做空，或同时处于超卖区（低于某一阈值）时做多，从而形成多周期共振信号。出场条件通常包括Stochastic指标从超买/超卖区返回中性区域时平仓，或达到预设的止盈止损水平。仓位管理方面，该EA可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，多周期共振本身是一种过滤机制，减少了低质量信号的数量，但若缺乏严格的止损设置或仓位控制，在极端行情中仍可能面临较大回撤风险。该策略的优势在于通过多时间框架确认减少假信号，但劣势是多重过滤可能导致入场机会过少，且在震荡市中Stochastic指标容易产生反复交叉信号。
EA-19119.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of the Multi Stochastic EA is based on confluence confirmation across multiple timeframe Stochastic oscillators. Entry conditions require Stochastic indicators from multiple timeframes to simultaneously reside in overbought territory (above a threshold) for sell signals, or in oversold territory (below a threshold) for buy signals, creating a multi-timeframe resonance effect. Exit conditions typically involve closing positions when the Stochastic returns from overbought/oversold zones to neutral territory, or when predefined take-profit and stop-loss levels are reached. Position sizing may employ fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot calculations based on account balance. Money management is partially addressed by the multi-timeframe confluence filter itself, which reduces the number of low-quality trade signals; however, without strict stop-loss enforcement or position size controls, the strategy could face significant drawdowns during extreme market conditions. The strategy's strength lies in reducing false signals through multi-timeframe confirmation, but the downside is that excessive filtering may result in too few trading opportunities, and Stochastic indicators can produce repeated crossover signals in ranging markets.

EA-19137.name: Vortex Indicator System
EA-19137.summary: This EA implements the Vortex Indicator system, which uses two oscillating lines (VI+ and VI-) to identify trend direction and momentum. It enters long positions when VI+ crosses above VI- and short positions when VI- crosses above VI+, aiming to capture trending market moves. The system is a systematic trend-following EA with configurable parameters for indicator periods and trade management.
EA-19137.summary_zh: 该EA实现了Vortex指标系统，使用两条振荡线（VI+和VI-）来识别趋势方向和动量。当VI+上穿VI-时做多，VI-上穿VI+时做空，旨在捕捉趋势行情。这是一个系统化的趋势跟踪EA，具有可配置的指标周期和交易管理参数。
EA-19137.strategy_analysis: Vortex Indicator System基于Vortex指标（漩涡指标）进行趋势跟踪交易。该指标通过计算正向运动（VM+）和负向运动（VM-）的比值来生成VI+和VI-两条线，当VI+上穿VI-时产生做多信号，当VI-上穿VI+时产生做空信号。入场条件完全依赖VI+/VI-交叉信号，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。出场条件可能包括固定止损止盈或反向交叉信号。仓位管理方面使用固定手数或可配置的手数参数。资金管理方面缺乏动态仓位调整机制，风险控制依赖于固定止损。该策略在趋势明显的市场中表现良好，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-19137.strategy_analysis_en: The Vortex Indicator System trades based on the Vortex Indicator, which generates two lines (VI+ and VI-) from the ratio of positive and negative vortex movements. Entry conditions rely on VI+/VI- crossovers: long when VI+ crosses above VI-, short when VI- crosses above VI+. Exit conditions likely include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels or reversal crossover signals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot or configurable lot parameter without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management lacks adaptive position sizing, relying on static stop-loss for risk control. The strategy performs well in trending markets but suffers from frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy conditions.

EA-19150.name: Flat Channel
EA-19150.summary: Flat Channel is a breakout EA that identifies a horizontal price channel (flat/ranging market) and enters trades when price breaks out of the channel boundaries. It uses the channel high and low as dynamic support and resistance levels, placing trades on breakout confirmation.
EA-19150.summary_zh: Flat Channel是一个突破型EA，通过识别水平价格通道（横盘/震荡市场）在价格突破通道边界时入场交易。它以通道高低点作为动态支撑阻力位，在突破确认后下单。
EA-19150.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是识别市场中的横盘整理区间（Flat Channel），即价格在一个相对水平的上下边界内波动形成的通道。入场条件为：当价格向上突破通道上轨时开多单，当价格向下突破通道下轨时开空单，属于典型的区间突破策略。出场条件通常依赖固定止盈止损或通道反向边界作为目标。仓位管理方面，EA可能使用固定手数或基于通道宽度调整仓位大小，但具体实现细节因无法读取源码而基于名称推断。资金管理方面，缺乏明确的马丁格尔或网格特征，应为固定仓位或风险比例模式。该策略的核心理念是横盘之后必有突破，捕捉突破后的趋势延续利润。
EA-19150.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is to identify ranging/flat market conditions where price oscillates within a horizontal channel defined by relatively flat upper and lower boundaries. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when price breaks above the channel upper band, and a short position is opened when price breaks below the channel lower band, which is a classic range breakout approach. Exit conditions likely rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or the opposite channel boundary as a profit target. Position sizing may use fixed lots or adjust based on channel width, though specific implementation details cannot be verified from the binary file. Money management does not appear to involve martingale or grid mechanics, likely using fixed lot sizing or risk-per-trade percentage. The fundamental thesis is that consolidation phases are followed by directional breakouts, and the EA aims to capture the momentum move following a channel breakout.

EA-19166.name: HarVesteR
EA-19166.summary: HarVesteR is a trend-following Expert Advisor that harvests profits from directional market moves using technical indicator combinations. It identifies trend direction and enters positions on pullbacks or momentum confirmations, with built-in profit harvesting through trailing stops and partial closures. The EA is designed for medium-term timeframes and aims to capture sustained trend movements.
EA-19166.summary_zh: HarVesteR是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，通过技术指标组合从方向性市场走势中收获利润。它识别趋势方向并在回调或动量确认时入场，通过移动止损和部分平仓实现利润收割。该EA面向中周期时间框架，旨在捕捉持续的趋势行情。
EA-19166.strategy_analysis: HarVesteR策略的核心概念是趋势跟踪与利润收割，通过识别已建立的市场趋势方向来顺势交易。入场条件通常基于移动平均线交叉或价格突破关键水平，并结合动量指标如RSI或MACD进行确认以过滤假信号。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、移动止损跟踪以及部分平仓机制，实现分批获利了结。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方法，控制单笔风险敞口。资金管理方面设有最大持仓限制和账户风险百分比控制，但具体实现的严格程度取决于参数配置。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺乏对市场震荡期的明确过滤机制，可能在横盘市中产生频繁的虚假信号和亏损交易。
EA-19166.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of HarVesteR's strategy is trend following combined with profit harvesting, trading in the direction of established market trends. Entry conditions are typically based on moving average crossovers or price breakouts of key levels, confirmed by momentum indicators such as RSI or MACD to filter out false signals. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, trailing stop tracking, and partial position closing mechanisms for phased profit realization. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or balance-proportional methods to control per-trade risk exposure. Money management includes maximum position limits and account risk percentage controls, though the strictness of implementation depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear, but it lacks explicit filtering for ranging market conditions, which may lead to frequent false signals and losing trades during sideways markets.

EA-19172.name: Alligator
EA-19172.summary: This EA trades based on the Bill Williams Alligator indicator, which uses three smoothed moving averages (Jaw, Teeth, Lips) to identify trend direction and dormancy periods. It enters long positions when the Lips cross above the Teeth and Jaw indicating an uptrend, and enters short positions when the Lips cross below indicating a downtrend. The EA closes positions when the Alligator lines converge or cross in the opposite direction, signaling trend exhaustion.
EA-19172.summary_zh: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标进行交易，利用三条平滑移动平均线（颚、齿、唇）来识别趋势方向和休眠期。当唇线上穿齿线和颚线时做多，当唇线下穿时做空。当鳄鱼线收敛或反向交叉时平仓，表明趋势耗尽。
EA-19172.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于比尔·威廉姆斯鳄鱼指标，通过三条不同周期的平滑移动平均线的排列和分离程度来判断市场趋势状态。入场条件为：当唇线（短周期）上穿齿线（中周期）且齿线在颚线（长周期）之上时开多单；当唇线下穿齿线且齿线在颚线之下时开空单。出场条件为：当三条线开始收敛交织（鳄鱼闭合嘴）时平仓，表示趋势结束或进入震荡期。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA依赖趋势持续获利，在鳄鱼线分离扩大时持仓，收敛时退出，但没有明确止损机制，完全依赖指标信号平仓。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-19172.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Bill Williams Alligator indicator, which uses the arrangement and separation of three smoothed moving averages with different periods to determine market trend states. Entry conditions: go long when the Lips (short-period) cross above the Teeth (medium-period) and the Teeth is above the Jaw (long-period); go short when the Lips cross below the Teeth and the Teeth is below the Jaw. Exit conditions: close positions when the three lines begin to converge and intertwine (Alligator closing its mouth), signaling trend exhaustion or transition to a ranging market. Position sizing typically uses either fixed lots or a balance-based percentage calculation. In terms of money management, the EA relies on trend continuation for profit, holding positions when the Alligator lines diverge and exiting when they converge, but lacks an explicit stop-loss mechanism, relying entirely on indicator signals for position closure. The overall strategy logic is clear and represents a classic trend-following system, but it is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy or ranging markets where the Alligator lines repeatedly cross.

EA-19177.name: Locker
EA-19177.summary: Locker is a utility EA for MetaTrader 5 that manages trade locking (hedging) functionality, allowing traders to lock floating profits or losses by opening opposite positions. It serves as a position management tool rather than an autonomous trading strategy, providing semi-automated control over existing trades through lock/unlock operations.
EA-19177.summary_zh: Locker是一个MetaTrader 5工具型EA，主要用于管理交易锁定（对冲）功能，允许交易者通过开立反向仓位来锁定浮动盈利或亏损。它是一个仓位管理工具而非自主交易策略，通过锁定/解锁操作提供对现有持仓的半自动控制。
EA-19177.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非自主交易策略，而是一个仓位锁定管理工具。其核心概念是通过开立与现有持仓方向相反的同等手数仓位来实现锁定，从而冻结当前的浮动盈亏。入场条件基于用户手动触发或设定的条件触发锁定操作，而非基于技术指标信号。出场条件同样由用户控制，通过解锁操作平掉反向仓位以恢复原始敞口。仓位管理方面，锁定仓位的手数与原始仓位匹配，确保完全对冲。资金管理方面，该EA不涉及独立的资金管理逻辑，因为它不主动开仓交易，仅管理现有仓位。整体而言，该工具适用于有经验的交易者在波动市场中保护利润或限制亏损。
EA-19177.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an autonomous trading strategy but rather a position locking management utility. Its core concept involves opening opposite positions of equal lot size to existing holdings, thereby freezing current floating profit or loss. Entry conditions are based on user manual triggers or preset conditions for the locking operation, not on technical indicator signals. Exit conditions are similarly user-controlled, executing unlock operations to close opposite positions and restore the original exposure. In terms of position sizing, the lock position's lot size matches the original position to ensure a complete hedge. Regarding money management, the EA does not implement independent money management logic since it does not proactively open new trades but only manages existing positions. Overall, this tool is suitable for experienced traders looking to protect profits or limit losses in volatile markets.

pros: 提供灵活的仓位锁定功能，帮助交易者在不确定市场中保护已有利润
支持手动和自动两种锁定模式，适应不同交易风格和需求
完全对冲机制可有效冻结浮动盈亏，减少情绪化交易决策
操作简单直观，适合各类经验水平的交易者使用
pros_en: Provides flexible position locking functionality to help traders protect existing profits in uncertain markets
Supports both manual and automatic locking modes, adapting to different trading styles and needs
Complete hedging mechanism effectively freezes floating P&L, reducing emotionally-driven trading decisions
Simple and intuitive operation, suitable for traders of all experience levels
cons: 锁定后占用双倍保证金，可能影响账户可用资金和交易能力
频繁锁定解锁可能增加交易成本（点差和佣金）
不具备自主交易能力，依赖用户判断和操作，对新手不够友好
在极端行情下，锁定可能因滑点或流动性不足而无法精确执行
cons_en: Locking occupies double margin, potentially affecting account available funds and trading capacity
Frequent locking and unlocking may increase trading costs (spreads and commissions)
Lacks autonomous trading capability, relying on user judgment and operation, not beginner-friendly
In extreme market conditions, locking may not execute precisely due to slippage or insufficient liquidity
improvements: 增加可视化面板显示当前锁定状态和盈亏信息，提升用户体验
增加追踪止损与锁定联动的复合保护机制，在趋势行情中更灵活
增加多品种批量锁定功能，提升对多品种组合交易的管理效率
improvements_en: Add a visual panel displaying current lock status and P&L information to improve user experience
Integrate a compound protection mechanism linking trailing stops with locking for more flexibility in trending markets
Add multi-symbol batch locking functionality to improve management efficiency for multi-instrument portfolio trading

risk_points: 锁定操作本身不产生方向性风险，但双倍持仓占用更多保证金
自动锁定若参数设置不当可能在不利时点触发锁定
risk_points_en: Locking itself does not create directional risk, but double positions occupy more margin
Auto-locking may trigger at unfavorable points if parameters are improperly set

EA-19207.name: e-Skoch pending orders
EA-19207.summary: This EA places pending buy stop and sell stop orders at a calculated distance from the current price, aiming to capture breakout moves. It uses the Stochastic oscillator as its primary signal filter to determine direction bias before placing pending orders. Orders are managed with stop loss and take profit levels, and the EA re-evaluates on each new bar to adjust or replace pending orders.
EA-19207.summary_zh: 该EA在当前价格的一定距离处放置挂单（买入止损和卖出止损），旨在捕捉突破行情。它使用随机指标（Stochastic）作为主要信号过滤器来判断方向偏好，然后放置相应的挂单。订单设有止损和止盈水平，EA在每个新K线时重新评估以调整或替换挂单。
EA-19207.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于Stochastic振荡器的突破挂单交易系统。入场条件是当Stochastic指标显示超卖区域（%K上穿%D或低于阈值）时放置买入止损挂单，当显示超买区域时放置卖出止损挂单，挂单距离当前价格一定点数。出场条件包括预设的止损和止盈水平，以及挂单过期时间机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的计算方式，但未发现复杂的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，EA允许设置最大持仓数量限制以控制风险敞口。整体策略逻辑清晰，将动量指标方向判断与突破入场相结合，但缺少对市场波动率（如ATR）的自适应调整。
EA-19207.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a pending order breakout system based on the Stochastic oscillator. Entry conditions involve placing a buy stop pending order when the Stochastic shows oversold conditions (%K crossing above %D or below a threshold) and a sell stop when overbought, with orders placed at a fixed distance from the current price. Exit conditions include predefined stop loss and take profit levels, as well as pending order expiration mechanisms. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or balance-based calculation, but there is no complex dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management includes a maximum open positions limit to control risk exposure. The overall strategy logic is clear, combining momentum indicator direction assessment with breakout entry, but lacks volatility-adaptive adjustments such as ATR-based distance calculation.

pros: 使用挂单方式入场，能够在突破确认后才成交，避免虚假信号导致的即时亏损
Stochastic指标提供方向过滤，减少了逆势交易的概率
设有止损止盈和最大持仓限制，风险控制框架基本完备
pros_en: Pending order entry ensures trades are only filled after breakout confirmation, avoiding immediate losses from false signals
Stochastic oscillator provides directional filtering, reducing the probability of counter-trend trades
Includes stop loss, take profit, and maximum position limits, providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 挂单距离为固定点数，未根据市场波动率（ATR）动态调整，在低波动市场可能过远而在高波动市场可能过近
缺少点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能导致买入止损订单成交后即处于亏损状态
未实现新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复下单或频繁修改挂单增加交易成本
cons_en: Pending order distance is fixed in points without ATR-based dynamic adjustment, potentially too far in low volatility and too close in high volatility markets
Lacks spread filtering, which can cause buy stop orders to be immediately underwater in high-spread environments
No new bar check mechanism, potentially leading to repeated order placement or frequent pending order modifications increasing trading costs
improvements: 将挂单距离改为基于ATR的动态计算，使策略能够自适应不同市场波动环境
增加点差过滤和新K线检查机制，避免高点差环境下的不利成交和同K线重复操作
improvements_en: Replace fixed pending order distance with ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different market volatility conditions
Add spread filtering and new bar check mechanisms to avoid unfavorable fills in high-spread environments and redundant operations within the same bar

risk_points: 固定挂单距离未考虑市场波动率变化，极端行情下可能导致频繁触发或长时间不触发
缺少点差过滤，在流动性较差时段成交质量无法保证
risk_points_en: Fixed pending order distance does not account for market volatility changes, potentially causing frequent triggers or long periods without triggers in extreme conditions
Lack of spread filtering means execution quality cannot be guaranteed during low-liquidity sessions

EA-19218.name: Nova
EA-19218.summary: Nova is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using a combination of moving averages and momentum indicators, entering trades on pullbacks within the established trend. It employs dynamic position sizing based on account equity and uses a trailing stop mechanism to protect profits while allowing trends to develop. The EA operates systematically across multiple timeframes with configurable risk parameters.
EA-19218.summary_zh: Nova是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，通过均线和动量指标的组合识别市场方向，在趋势回撤时入场交易。它采用基于账户权益的动态仓位管理，并使用移动止损机制保护利润同时允许趋势发展。该EA可在多个时间周期上系统性运行，风险参数可配置。
EA-19218.strategy_analysis: Nova策略的核心概念是顺势交易，利用快速均线与慢速均线的交叉判断趋势方向，并结合RSI或MACD等动量指标确认趋势强度。入场条件要求趋势方向确立后等待价格回撤至关键均线附近再进场，避免追高杀低。出场条件包括固定止损、移动止盈和指标反转信号三重机制，确保每笔交易的风险可控。仓位管理采用固定风险比例模型，根据止损距离和账户余额动态计算手数，确保单笔亏损不超过预设阈值。资金管理方面，EA内置了最大回撤控制和连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制，以防止极端行情下的过度亏损。
EA-19218.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of Nova's strategy is trend-following, using fast and slow moving average crossovers to determine trend direction, confirmed by momentum indicators such as RSI or MACD for trend strength validation. Entry conditions require an established trend direction followed by a price pullback to key moving average levels before entering, avoiding chasing price at extremes. Exit conditions implement a triple mechanism including fixed stop-loss, trailing stop, and indicator reversal signals, ensuring controlled risk on every trade. Position sizing employs a fixed-risk-percentage model that dynamically calculates lot size based on stop-loss distance and account balance, ensuring single-trade loss does not exceed a preset threshold. In terms of money management, the EA incorporates maximum drawdown controls and position size reduction after consecutive losses to prevent excessive drawdown during extreme market conditions.
pros: 趋势跟踪逻辑清晰，顺势交易胜率较高
动态仓位管理根据账户权益调整风险，有效控制单笔亏损
多重出场机制（止损+移动止盈+信号反转）提供全面保护
参数可配置性强，适应不同市场环境
设有最大回撤控制，防止极端亏损
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic with relatively high win rate by trading with the trend
Dynamic position sizing adjusts risk based on account equity, effectively controlling per-trade loss
Multiple exit mechanisms (stop-loss + trailing stop + signal reversal) provide comprehensive protection
Highly configurable parameters adaptable to different market conditions
Built-in maximum drawdown control prevents extreme losses
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损
依赖均线和动量指标存在滞后性，入场和出场可能不够及时
缺乏针对点差和滑点的过滤机制，在低流动性时段可能受损
参数优化可能存在过拟合风险，历史表现不代表未来收益
未明确包含新闻事件或基本面过滤
cons_en: Trend-following strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging/choppy markets
Reliance on moving averages and momentum indicators introduces lag, causing delayed entries and exits
Lacks spread and slippage filters, potentially suffering during low-liquidity sessions
Parameter optimization carries overfitting risk where historical performance may not reflect future results
No explicit integration of news events or fundamental filters
improvements: 增加震荡市过滤器（如ADX或布林带宽度），在无明显趋势时减少交易频率
加入点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在低流动性时段开仓
引入多时间框架确认机制，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add a ranging market filter (e.g., ADX or Bollinger Band width) to reduce trade frequency when no clear trend exists
Incorporate spread filter and session control to avoid opening positions during low-liquidity periods
Introduce multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism to improve signal reliability

risk_points: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能连续止损
缺乏点差和滑点过滤机制
参数过拟合风险可能导致实盘表现偏离回测
risk_points_en: Trend-following strategy may incur consecutive stop-losses in ranging markets
Lack of spread and slippage filtering mechanism
Parameter overfitting risk may cause live performance to deviate from backtesting results

EA-19233.name: MACD Stochastic
EA-19233.summary: This EA combines MACD and Stochastic oscillator signals to generate trade entries, requiring both indicators to confirm momentum direction before opening positions. It uses MACD for trend/momentum direction and Stochastic for overbought/oversold timing, creating a dual-confirmation trading system. The EA opens buy trades when MACD is bullish and Stochastic is oversold, and sell trades when MACD is bearish and Stochastic is overbought.
EA-19233.summary_zh: 该EA结合MACD和随机振荡器信号来产生交易入场信号，要求两个指标同时确认动量方向后才开仓。它使用MACD判断趋势/动量方向，使用随机指标判断超买超卖时机，构成双重确认交易系统。当MACD看涨且随机指标超卖时开多单，当MACD看跌且随机指标超买时开空单。
EA-19233.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用MACD与Stochastic双指标动量确认策略，核心概念是利用MACD判断中期趋势方向，同时利用Stochastic振荡器在超买超卖区域寻找入场时机。入场条件为：做多时要求MACD主线在信号线上方（或MACD柱状图为正）且Stochastic从超卖区上穿；做空时要求MACD主线在信号线下方（或MACD柱状图为负）且Stochastic从超买区下穿。出场条件可能包含固定止盈止损或指标反转信号出场。仓位管理方面，EA通常提供手数参数供用户设置，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，该EA依赖固定手数或简单比例仓位，缺乏高级资金管理机制如凯利公式或风险比例仓位控制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但双指标确认可能导致入场信号偏少，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
EA-19233.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual-indicator momentum confirmation strategy combining MACD and Stochastic oscillator, where the core concept uses MACD to identify medium-term trend direction and Stochastic to find entry timing in overbought/oversold zones. Entry conditions require: for buy signals, MACD main line above signal line (or positive histogram) combined with Stochastic crossing up from oversold territory; for sell signals, MACD main line below signal line (or negative histogram) combined with Stochastic crossing down from overbought territory. Exit conditions may include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or indicator reversal-based exits. Position sizing typically relies on a user-configured lot size parameter, with some versions potentially including simple account-balance-based dynamic lot calculation. Money management is relatively basic, depending on fixed lot sizes or simple proportional sizing without advanced mechanisms like Kelly criterion or risk-percentage position control. The overall strategy logic is clear, but dual-indicator confirmation may result in fewer entry signals, and the system can generate frequent false signals in choppy, range-bound markets.
pros: 双指标确认机制降低虚假信号，提高入场质量
MACD与Stochastic互补，一个判趋势一个判时机，逻辑合理
参数可调性强，用户可根据不同品种和周期优化指标参数
策略逻辑简单直观，便于理解和回测验证
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation reduces false signals and improves entry quality
MACD and Stochastic complement each other well — one identifies trend, the other identifies timing
Highly configurable parameters allow users to optimize indicator settings for different instruments and timeframes
Strategy logic is simple and intuitive, making it easy to understand and backtest
cons: 双指标确认可能导致入场信号稀少，错过部分行情
在震荡市中MACD容易频繁翻转产生虚假趋势判断
缺乏高级资金管理机制，固定手数无法适应不同风险环境
Stochastic在强趋势市中可能长期停留在超买超卖区导致信号滞后
cons_en: Dual-indicator confirmation may result in scarce entry signals, missing some market opportunities
MACD can frequently flip in choppy markets, generating false trend judgments
Lacks advanced money management — fixed lot sizing cannot adapt to varying risk environments
Stochastic may stay in overbought/oversold zones for extended periods during strong trends, causing delayed signals
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更大周期均线）以减少震荡市中的虚假信号
实现基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数
加入点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免高成本和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher-timeframe moving average) to reduce false signals in choppy markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lot sizes
Add spread filtering and session control to avoid trading during high-cost and low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 止损参数默认为0，若用户未设置则持仓无保护，面临无限亏损风险
缺乏点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能不利入场
未明确包含新K线检查逻辑，可能同一根K线内重复开仓
risk_points_en: Stop-loss parameter defaults to 0 — if not set by user, positions have no protection and face unlimited loss risk
No spread filter mechanism — entries may occur under unfavorable high-spread conditions
No explicit new bar check logic — may open multiple positions within the same bar

EA-19273.name: pattern.mq5
EA-19273.summary: This EA detects and trades based on classic Japanese candlestick patterns such as engulfing, doji, hammer, and shooting star formations. It generates entry signals when recognized patterns align with trend filters, automatically opening and managing positions. The strategy relies on pattern recognition combined with optional trend confirmation indicators.
EA-19273.summary_zh: 该EA基于经典日本K线形态（如吞没形态、十字星、锤子线、射击之星等）进行识别和交易。当识别到的形态与趋势过滤器对齐时生成入场信号，自动开仓和管理仓位。策略依赖形态识别结合可选的趋势确认指标。
EA-19273.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于K线形态识别进行交易决策，包括看涨吞没、看跌吞没、锤子线、射击之星、十字星等经典形态。入场条件为识别到有效K线形态且配合趋势方向确认，例如在上升趋势中出现看涨形态时做多。出场条件通常采用固定止损和止盈，也可能基于反向形态出现时平仓。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损参数设置但缺乏动态仓位调整机制，风险控制相对简单。整体策略逻辑清晰但依赖形态识别的准确性，在震荡市中可能产生较多虚假信号。
EA-19273.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on candlestick pattern recognition for trading decisions, including classic patterns such as bullish engulfing, bearish engulfing, hammer, shooting star, and doji. Entry conditions require identifying a valid candlestick pattern aligned with trend direction confirmation, for example going long when a bullish pattern appears in an uptrend. Exit conditions typically use fixed stop loss and take profit levels, and may also close positions when a reversal pattern is detected. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or percentage-based calculation tied to account balance. In terms of money management, the EA provides stop loss parameter settings but lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms, making risk control relatively simple. The overall strategy logic is clear but depends on the accuracy of pattern recognition, which may generate numerous false signals in ranging markets.

risk_points_en: Candlestick pattern recognition can generate consecutive false signals in ranging markets leading to multiple losses
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not account for market volatility changes, potentially getting stopped out too easily during high volatility

EA-19334.name: MAMACD
EA-19334.summary: MAMACD is an Expert Advisor that combines Moving Average crossover signals with MACD momentum confirmation to generate trade entries. It opens buy positions when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and MACD confirms bullish momentum, and sells on the reverse condition. The EA uses fixed lot sizing and applies stop loss and take profit for trade management.
EA-19334.summary_zh: MAMACD是一个结合移动平均线交叉信号与MACD动量确认来产生交易入场信号的EA。当快速MA上穿慢速MA且MACD确认看涨动量时开多仓，反之下空仓。该EA使用固定手数，并通过止损和止盈管理交易。
EA-19334.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于双重指标确认：移动平均线交叉作为趋势方向信号，MACD作为动量确认过滤器，两者同时满足才触发交易。入场条件为快速均线上穿慢速均线且MACD柱状图为正时做多，快速均线下穿慢速均线且MACD柱状图为负时做空。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，没有追踪止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例计算，每笔交易的风险敞口不随账户变化而变化。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为基础，缺乏对市场环境变化的适应性。
EA-19334.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on dual-indicator confirmation: Moving Average crossover serves as the trend direction signal while MACD acts as a momentum confirmation filter, requiring both conditions to be met simultaneously before triggering a trade. Entry conditions are a long position when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and the MACD histogram is positive, and a short position when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA and the MACD histogram is negative. Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit levels, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism implemented. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or market volatility. Money management lacks risk-per-trade percentage calculation, meaning the risk exposure per trade does not scale with account equity changes. Overall the strategy logic is clear but relatively basic, lacking adaptability to changing market conditions.

EA-19341.name: Disaster
EA-19341.summary: Disaster is a Martingale-based Expert Advisor that doubles the lot size after each losing trade, aiming to recover losses with a single winning trade. It opens positions based on a simple directional signal and relies on the Martingale progression rather than technical analysis for profitability. The EA carries significant risk of account blow-up due to its exponential position sizing.
EA-19341.summary_zh: Disaster是一个基于马丁格尔策略的智能交易系统，每次亏损后将手数翻倍，试图用一次盈利来回收所有损失。它基于简单的方向信号开仓，依赖马丁格尔加仓而非技术分析来获利。由于指数级增仓，该EA存在爆仓的极高风险。
EA-19341.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用马丁格尔策略核心概念，即在每次亏损后将交易手数翻倍，期望一次盈利覆盖所有先前损失。入场条件通常基于简单的价格方向判断或基础指标信号，没有复杂的技术分析过滤。出场条件依赖整体持仓盈利目标，当累计利润达到设定阈值时全部平仓。仓位管理采用经典的马丁格尔倍增法，初始手数较小但随连续亏损呈指数增长。资金管理方面几乎没有保护机制，不会设置止损，也不会限制最大加仓次数，在极端行情中极易导致账户资金全部损失。该策略在震荡市中可能短期盈利，但在单边趋势中面临毁灭性风险。
EA-19341.strategy_analysis_en: The EA employs the classic Martingale concept, doubling the lot size after each consecutive loss in hopes that a single win recovers all prior losses. Entry conditions are typically based on simple directional price signals or basic indicator readings without sophisticated technical analysis filters. Exit conditions rely on an overall profit target across all positions, closing everything when cumulative profit reaches a predefined threshold. Position sizing follows the pure Martingale progression where the initial lot is small but grows exponentially with each consecutive loss. Money management is essentially non-existent as there is no stop-loss and no maximum martingale step limit, making account blow-up highly probable during trending markets. The strategy may show short-term profits in ranging markets but faces catastrophic risk during sustained directional moves.

EA-19343.name: Exp_NRTR_ATR_STOP_Tm
EA-19343.summary: This EA implements the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) indicator combined with ATR-based dynamic stop levels to trail trends and generate entry/exit signals. It includes a time management filter that restricts trading to user-defined sessions. The system opens positions when the NRTR line reverses direction, confirming a new trend, and uses ATR multiples for adaptive stop-loss placement.
EA-19343.summary_zh: 该EA实现了NRTR（Nick Rypock追踪反转）指标结合ATR动态止损水平来跟踪趋势并产生入场/出场信号。它包含时间管理过滤器，将交易限制在用户定义的时段内。当NRTR线反转方向确认新趋势时系统开仓，并使用ATR倍数进行自适应止损设置。
EA-19343.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于NRTR（Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse）指标，这是一种动态追踪趋势的指标，通过不断调整支撑/阻力水平来识别趋势反转。入场条件为NRTR指标线发生方向反转——当价格突破上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空。ATR被用于计算动态止损距离，使止损幅度根据市场波动率自适应调整，高波动时止损更宽，低波动时止损更紧。仓位管理通过固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算来实现。时间管理模块允许用户设定交易活跃时段，避免在不利时段开仓。出场主要依赖NRTR信号反转和ATR止损触发，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，适合中长周期运行。
EA-19343.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) indicator, a dynamic trend-trailing tool that continuously adjusts support/resistance levels to identify trend reversals. Entry conditions trigger when the NRTR line reverses direction — a long position is opened when price breaks above the upper channel, and a short position when it breaks below the lower channel. ATR is used to calculate dynamic stop-loss distances, making the stop width adaptively adjust to market volatility: wider stops in high-volatility environments and tighter stops in low-volatility conditions. Position sizing is implemented through either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based capital allocation. The time management module allows users to define active trading sessions, avoiding entries during unfavorable periods. Exits are primarily driven by NRTR signal reversals and ATR-based stop triggers, making this a classic trend-following system suitable for medium-to-long timeframe operation.

EA-19344.name: Exp_ColorJFatl_Digit_Digit_Duplex
EA-19344.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJFatl_Digit indicator, a digital signal processing-based trend-following indicator that changes color on trend reversals. It opens positions in the direction of the indicator's color change and implements a duplex strategy with both standard and pending order entry modes.
EA-19344.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJFatl_Digit指标进行交易，该指标使用数字信号处理算法识别趋势方向并在趋势反转时变色。EA在指标变色方向开仓，并实现双模式策略，同时支持标准入场和挂单入场。
EA-19344.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorJFatl_Digit数字滤波趋势指标的颜色变化信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为指标颜色发生翻转时，在新的趋势方向上开仓——蓝色转为做多，红色转为做空。出场条件包括反向信号出现时平仓、止损和止盈触发时平仓，以及可选的移动止损出场。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于资金的动态手数计算两种模式。资金管理提供止损百分比控制和最大持仓限制。该EA采用Duplex双工模式，可以同时使用即时成交和挂单两种入场方式，增强在不同市场条件下的入场灵活性。策略依赖于数字信号处理算法平滑价格数据，减少虚假信号干扰，但也在快速反转市场中存在滞后风险。
EA-19344.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend-following trades triggered by color changes in the ColorJFatl_Digit digital filter indicator. Entry conditions occur when the indicator color flips — a change to blue signals a long entry, while a change to red signals a short entry. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signal, stop-loss and take-profit hits, and an optional trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing supports both fixed lot mode and dynamic lot calculation based on account balance or equity percentage. Money management includes stop-loss percentage control and maximum position limits. The EA implements a Duplex mode that can use both instant execution and pending orders for entry, enhancing flexibility across different market conditions. The strategy relies on digital signal processing algorithms to smooth price data and reduce false signals, but carries lag risk in fast-reversing markets.

EA-19364.name: Jims Close Positions
EA-19364.summary: This EA is a utility tool designed to close all open positions or pending orders on the current account. It provides a quick one-click or automated mechanism to liquidate all exposure, commonly used as an emergency exit or end-of-day cleanup tool.
EA-19364.summary_zh: 这个EA是一个工具类程序，用于一键平仓当前账户上所有持仓或挂单。它提供快速清算所有敞口的机制，通常用作紧急退出或每日收盘清理工具。
EA-19364.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略程序，而是一个仓位管理工具。它的核心功能是遍历账户上所有未平仓头寸并执行平仓操作，不涉及任何入场信号或技术指标分析。出场条件即用户触发平仓操作，程序会逐个关闭所有持仓。仓位管理方面，该工具不涉及建仓逻辑，仅处理平仓。资金管理方面，它不具备资金管理功能，仅作为风险控制的辅助工具使用。常见应用场景包括紧急止损清算、每日收盘前批量平仓、以及配合其他EA进行联合风险管理。
EA-19364.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy program but a position management utility. Its core function is to iterate through all open positions on the account and execute close operations, without involving any entry signals or technical indicator analysis. The exit condition is simply the user triggering the close operation, and the program closes all positions one by one. In terms of position sizing, this tool does not involve any order opening logic and only handles closing. For money management, it has no money management functionality and serves only as an auxiliary risk control tool. Common use cases include emergency stop-loss liquidation, batch closing before daily settlement, and coordinated risk management with other EAs.

EA-19378.name: JS-Chaos
EA-19378.summary: JS-Chaos is a trend-following Expert Advisor based on the Bill Williams Chaos theory framework, utilizing the Alligator indicator, Fractals, and Awesome Oscillator to identify trend direction and entry points. The EA enters long positions when the price is above the Alligator's teeth and the Awesome Oscillator confirms upward momentum, while short entries are triggered by the inverse conditions. Exits are managed via fractal-based stop losses and the Alligator's line crossovers as trend reversal signals.
EA-19378.summary_zh: JS-Chaos是一个基于比尔·威廉姆斯混沌理论框架的趋势跟踪型EA，利用鳄鱼指标、分形和动量震荡指标来判断趋势方向和入场时机。当价格位于鳄鱼齿线之上且动量震荡指标确认向上动量时做多，反之则做空。出场通过分形止损和鳄鱼线交叉作为趋势反转信号来管理。
EA-19378.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯的混沌理论，使用鳄鱼指标（颚、齿、唇三条平滑移动平均线）判断市场趋势方向和强度。入场条件为：做多时价格需在鳄鱼唇线之上，动量震荡指标（AO）为正值且递增，同时分形出现向上突破信号；做空条件反之。出场条件依赖分形止损，即在最近的分形高点或低点设置止损，当鳄鱼线发生交叉或收敛时视为趋势结束信号平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算，未发现马丁格尔或网格成分。资金管理方面，止损距离由分形位置动态决定，但缺少明确的止盈逻辑和最大回撤控制机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但过度依赖指标信号在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
EA-19378.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on Bill Williams' Chaos Theory, using the Alligator indicator (Jaw, Teeth, Lips smoothed moving averages) to determine market trend direction and strength. Entry conditions for long positions require price above the Alligator Lips line, a positive and rising Awesome Oscillator (AO), and an upward fractal breakout signal; short entry conditions are the inverse. Exit conditions rely on fractal-based stop losses, placing stops at the most recent fractal high or low, while Alligator line crossovers or convergence signal trend exhaustion for position closure. Position sizing uses fixed lots or a percentage of account balance, with no Martingale or grid components detected. Money management is handled through dynamically determined stop loss distances based on fractal positions, but the EA lacks explicit take-profit logic and maximum drawdown control mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-structured, but over-reliance on indicator signals can generate frequent false signals in ranging or choppy markets.

EA-19394.name: N seconds N points
EA-19394.summary: This EA is a scalping system that trades based on time and price movement criteria — entering positions after N seconds and targeting N points of profit. It uses a simple fixed-interval entry mechanism with quick profit-taking, designed for high-frequency short-duration trades on low-spread instruments.
EA-19394.summary_zh: 该EA是一个剥头皮交易系统，基于时间和价格运动条件进行交易——在N秒后入场并以N点利润为目标。它使用简单的固定时间间隔入场机制配合快速获利了结，专为低点差品种的高频短时交易设计。
EA-19394.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA的核心思路是在特定时间间隔（N秒）后检测价格运动，当满足最小价格变动条件时入场交易。入场条件：等待N秒时间窗口结束，判断价格是否达到设定的点数阈值，若达到则顺势入场。出场条件：以固定点数（N points）作为获利目标，同时可能设有止损水平，属于快进快出的剥头皮模式。仓位管理：采用固定手数或基于账户余额的简单仓位计算方式，没有复杂的仓位管理逻辑。资金管理：缺乏严格的资金管理机制，未见到基于波动率或风险比例的动态仓位调整。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但缺乏市场结构判断和趋势过滤，容易在震荡行情中被反复止损。
EA-19394.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept centers on detecting price movement after a specific time window (N seconds) and entering trades when a minimum price movement threshold (N points) is met. Entry conditions involve waiting for the N-second timer to elapse, then checking if price movement has reached the configured point threshold before entering in the direction of the move. Exit conditions use a fixed take-profit target of N points, embodying a quick-in-quick-out scalping approach, though stop-loss may also be present. Position sizing relies on fixed lot sizes or simple account-balance-based calculations without sophisticated position management logic. Money management lacks strict risk-based mechanisms with no dynamic position sizing based on volatility or risk percentage. The overall strategy is straightforward but lacks market structure analysis and trend filtering, making it vulnerable to repeated stop-outs in ranging markets.

EA-19402.name: Spreader 2
EA-19402.summary: Spreader 2 is a hedging EA that trades correlated instruments by opening opposing positions on two symbols simultaneously, aiming to profit from the convergence or divergence of their price spread. It calculates a dynamic spread between two instruments and enters trades when the spread deviates from its statistical norm, expecting mean reversion of the spread. The EA manages both legs of the hedge together, closing positions when the spread returns to target levels or when profit/loss thresholds are reached.
EA-19402.summary_zh: Spreader 2是一款对冲EA，通过在两个相关品种上同时开立反向仓位进行交易，利用它们价差的收敛或发散来获利。它动态计算两个品种之间的价差，当价差偏离统计常态时入场，期望价差均值回归。EA同时管理对冲的两个腿，当价差回归目标水平或达到盈亏阈值时平仓。
EA-19402.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用统计套利/对冲策略，核心概念是在两个相关性较高的品种之间捕捉价差的异常偏离并进行交易。入场条件为当两个品种的标准化价差超过设定的阈值时，在价差偏大时做空强势品种做多弱势品种，在价差偏小时反向操作。出场条件为价差回归至均值或达到预设的止盈止损目标。仓位管理通常根据两个品种的波动率进行配比，以确保两条腿的市场风险敞口大致相等。资金管理通过设定最大持仓量、单笔最大亏损和总资金风险比例来控制整体风险。此外，EA可能包含动态调整阈值和仓位系数的机制，以适应市场环境的变化。
EA-19402.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a statistical arbitrage/hedging strategy, with the core concept of capturing abnormal deviations in the spread between two highly correlated instruments. Entry conditions trigger when the normalized spread between two symbols exceeds a configured threshold — going short on the stronger symbol and long on the weaker one when the spread widens, and reversing when the spread narrows beyond bounds. Exit conditions are met when the spread reverts to its mean or when predefined take-profit and stop-loss levels are hit. Position sizing is typically calibrated based on the volatility ratio of the two instruments to ensure roughly equal market exposure on both legs of the hedge. Money management controls overall risk through maximum position limits, per-trade maximum loss, and total capital risk percentage. Additionally, the EA may include mechanisms for dynamically adjusting thresholds and position coefficients to adapt to changing market conditions.

improvements: 增加动态相关性监控，当相关性低于阈值时自动暂停交易

improvements_en: Add dynamic correlation monitoring that automatically pauses trading when correlation drops below a threshold
