EA-19637.name: Martin for small deposits
EA-19637.summary: A Martingale-style EA that opens positions in one direction and progressively increases lot size by a multiplicative factor when price moves against the position. It uses a simple price comparison over 15 bars to determine initial direction, then adds positions at fixed step distances. All positions are closed when total floating profit exceeds a threshold, or immediately if both buy and sell positions somehow coexist.
EA-19637.summary_zh: 这是一个马丁格尔策略EA，在价格逆向波动时通过乘数因子递增加仓。初始方向由15根K线的收盘价比较决定，随后按固定间距加仓。当浮盈超过阈值时全部平仓，若同时存在多空仓位则立即全部平仓。
EA-19637.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的马丁格尔策略概念，核心逻辑是在价格逆向运行时逐步加仓以摊薄均价。入场条件分为两种：首次入场通过比较最近15根K线的收盘价趋势来决定方向（收低则做多，收高则做空）；加仓条件是当价格逆现有持仓方向移动超过设定步距时，以乘数因子递增手数开仓。出场条件是当所有持仓的总浮盈（含佣金和掉期）超过最小盈利阈值时全部平仓，没有任何止损机制。仓位管理采用指数递增方式，第N次加仓手数为初始手数乘以增长因子的N次方，但受最大手数限制。资金管理方面存在严重缺陷：没有止损，完全依赖价格回调来解套，在趋势行情中可能因持续加仓而爆仓。此外，跳过K线数的机制限制了加仓频率，但并不能有效控制风险。
EA-19637.strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a classic Martingale strategy where the core concept is to progressively increase position size when price moves against existing positions to average down the entry price. Entry conditions come in two types: the initial entry direction is determined by comparing the close price of the most recent bar against the close 15 bars ago (lower close triggers buy, higher triggers sell); subsequent entries occur when price moves against existing positions by more than the configured step distance, with lot size multiplied by the increase factor raised to the power of the position count. Exit conditions are solely based on total floating profit across all positions exceeding the minimum profit threshold, with absolutely no stop loss mechanism. Position sizing follows exponential growth where the N-th additional position uses the base lot multiplied by the increase factor to the N-th power, capped by a maximum lot limit. Money management is severely deficient: there is no stop loss, the strategy relies entirely on price reversion to exit profitably, and sustained trending markets can lead to margin call due to continuously increasing exposure. The bar-skipping mechanism limits adding frequency but does not effectively control downside risk.

EA-19643.name: Arrows and Curves EA
EA-19643.summary: This EA uses a custom indicator called 'arrows_curves' based on a reversal period (SSP) with channel and shift parameters to generate buy/sell signals. It operates on new bar formation, opening positions when no existing positions are present, and closing opposing positions or applying trailing stops when already in a position. The strategy is a reversal-based system with configurable stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop management.
EA-19643.summary_zh: 该EA使用名为'arrows_curves'的自定义指标，基于反转周期(SSP)及通道和偏移参数生成买卖信号。它在新K线形成时运行，无持仓时开仓，有持仓时平掉反向仓位或应用追踪止损。该策略是一个基于反转的交易系统，具有可配置的止损、止盈和追踪止损管理。
EA-19643.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于反转信号的均值回归交易，使用自定义指标'arrows_curves'检测价格反转点。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区0在索引1处非零时开多单，缓冲区1在索引1处非零时开空单。出场条件包括：固定止损和止盈、追踪止损机制、以及当出现反向信号时平掉当前持仓。仓位管理方面，支持固定手数或基于风险百分比的动态手数计算（使用CMoneyFixedMargin类）。资金管理使用风险百分比从可用保证金中计算仓位大小，并在开仓前通过CheckVolume验证手数有效性。该EA仅在新K线出生时执行交易逻辑，避免逐tick交易的过度交易问题。
EA-19643.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a mean reversion trading system based on reversal signals, using the custom indicator 'arrows_curves' to detect price reversal points. Entry conditions: open a buy when indicator buffer 0 at index 1 is non-zero, open a sell when indicator buffer 1 at index 1 is non-zero. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit, a trailing stop mechanism, and closing opposing positions when a reverse signal appears. Position sizing supports either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on a risk percentage using the CMoneyFixedMargin class. Money management uses a risk percentage to calculate position size from free margin, and validates lot size via CheckVolume before order submission. The EA only executes trading logic on new bar formation, avoiding over-trading issues from tick-by-tick execution.

EA-19646.name: ExpertZZLWA
EA-19646.summary: ExpertZZLWA is a trend-following Expert Advisor that utilizes the ZZLWA (ZigZag Linear Weighted Average) indicator to identify market reversals and trend direction. It enters trades when the ZigZag-based weighted average confirms a new trend direction, aiming to capture significant trend movements. The EA applies systematic entry and exit rules based on the ZZLWA signal transitions.
EA-19646.summary_zh: ExpertZZLWA是一个基于ZZLWA（ZigZag线性加权平均）指标的趋势跟踪型EA，通过识别市场反转和趋势方向进行交易。当ZigZag加权平均确认新趋势方向时开仓，旨在捕捉显著的趋势行情。该EA基于ZZLWA信号转换应用系统化的入场和出场规则。
EA-19646.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是利用ZigZag线性加权平均指标来识别趋势的转折点，当指标方向从下行转为上行时做多，从上行转为下行时做空。入场条件依赖于ZZLWA指标的方向翻转信号，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略，追求捕捉中长线趋势利润。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损或指标反向信号平仓，确保每笔交易都有明确的风险控制。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户自定义手数或采用基于资金比例的动态仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，建议配合合理的风险比例设置，避免单笔交易过度暴露风险，但需注意趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能频繁止损。
EA-19646.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA relies on the ZigZag Linear Weighted Average (ZZLWA) indicator to identify trend reversal points, going long when the indicator direction shifts from downward to upward and going short when it shifts from upward to downward. Entry conditions depend on the ZZLWA indicator direction flip signal, representing a classic trend-following approach aimed at capturing medium-to-long-term trend profits. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or closing positions on opposite indicator signals, ensuring each trade has defined risk controls. Position sizing allows the user to customize lot sizes or employ dynamic position calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management should incorporate reasonable risk ratio settings to avoid excessive exposure on any single trade, though trend-following strategies may suffer frequent stop-outs during ranging markets.

EA-19647.name: Exp_XDidi_Index_Cloud_Duplex
EA-19647.summary: This EA implements a duplex trading system based on the XDidi Index Cloud indicator, which is derived from the Didi Index (a Brazilian trend-following indicator). It opens buy and sell positions based on crossover signals of the indicator's three moving average components and uses a cloud visualization for trend confirmation.
EA-19647.summary_zh: 该EA基于XDidi Index Cloud指标实现双工交易系统，该指标源自巴西的Didi指标（一种趋势跟踪指标）。通过指标三条移动平均线组分的交叉信号开仓做多或做空，并利用云图可视化来确认趋势方向。
EA-19647.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Didi指数，这是一种巴西市场流行的趋势跟踪指标，由三条不同周期的移动平均线构成，通过它们的交叉关系判断趋势方向。入场条件：当短期均线上穿中期和长期均线时开多仓，当短期均线下穿中期和长期均线时开空仓，Cloud区域的颜色变化也作为辅助确认信号。出场条件：依赖反向交叉信号平仓，或通过固定的止损止盈参数出场。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，通过MoneyManagement选项可切换为基于账户余额的动态手数计算。资金管理方面提供了止损百分比控制，但整体风控机制较为基础，缺乏波动率自适应的仓位调整。该EA同时支持两个方向的交易（Duplex模式），可以在多空之间灵活切换。
EA-19647.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Didi Index, a popular Brazilian trend-following indicator composed of three moving averages with different periods, using their crossover relationships to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the short-term MA crosses above the medium and long-term MAs, and a short position is opened when the short-term MA crosses below the medium and long-term MAs, with the Cloud color change serving as an auxiliary confirmation signal. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals for position closure, or through fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach by default, with a MoneyManagement option to switch to a dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management provides stop-loss percentage control, but overall risk management is relatively basic, lacking volatility-adaptive position sizing. The EA supports duplex (bi-directional) trading mode, allowing flexible switching between long and short positions based on the indicator signals.

EA-19653.name: Exp_ColorJFatl_Digit_Tm_Plus
EA-19653.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJFatl_Digit indicator, which is a digital signal processing adaptive trend line filter. It enters long when the colored JFatl line changes to bullish color and short when it changes to bearish color, with time window filtering to restrict trading to specific sessions and enhanced Plus features for position management.
EA-19653.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJFatl_Digit数字信号自适应趋势线滤波指标进行交易。当JFatl线颜色转为看涨时做多，转为看跌时做空，同时通过时间过滤器限制在特定交易时段内交易，Plus版本增强了仓位管理功能。
EA-19653.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于JFatl数字自适应趋势线滤波器，该滤波器结合了Jurik平滑算法和自适应趋势跟踪技术来过滤市场噪音并识别趋势方向。入场条件为当ColorJFatl_Digit指标的颜色发生改变时开仓——颜色从红色变为绿色时开多单，从绿色变为红色时开空单。出场条件包括反向信号出现时平仓、止损止盈触发平仓以及尾部跟踪止损平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，Plus版本可能包含移动止损和盈亏平衡功能来保护利润。时间过滤器限制EA仅在用户指定的交易时段内进行交易，避免在低流动性或高波动性时段开仓。
EA-19653.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the JFatl digital adaptive trend line filter, which combines Jurik smoothing algorithms with adaptive trend-following technology to filter market noise and identify trend direction. Entry conditions trigger when the ColorJFatl_Digit indicator changes color — opening a long position when color shifts from red to green, and a short position when it shifts from green to red. Exit conditions include closing on reverse signal, stop loss/take profit hit, and trailing stop activation. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management in the Plus version likely includes trailing stop and breakeven features to protect profits. The time filter restricts trading to user-specified sessions, avoiding low-liquidity or high-volatility periods for entry.

EA-19655.name: GalacticExplosion
EA-19655.summary: GalacticExplosion is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that identifies explosive price movements resembling a galactic explosion pattern, entering trades when price bursts through key support or resistance levels with strong momentum. The EA uses volatility-based entry signals to capture rapid directional moves and employs trailing stops to lock in profits during trending conditions. It is designed for medium-to-high volatility market environments where breakouts tend to sustain momentum.
EA-19655.summary_zh: GalacticExplosion是一个基于突破策略的智能交易系统，识别类似星系爆炸形态的剧烈价格运动，在价格突破关键支撑或阻力位并伴随强劲动量时入场交易。该EA使用基于波动率的入场信号捕捉快速方向性行情，并通过追踪止损在趋势行情中锁定利润。它适用于中高波动率的市场环境，此类环境中突破往往能持续保持动量。
EA-19655.strategy_analysis: GalacticExplosion的核心策略概念是捕捉价格突破关键水平后的爆炸性行情，类似于星系爆炸的扩散效应。入场条件通常基于价格突破前N根K线的最高价或最低价，并配合波动率指标（如ATR）确认突破的有效性，避免虚假突破。出场条件包括固定止盈目标、追踪止损以及突破失败后的反向信号止损，确保在趋势延续时最大化利润而在突破失败时及时离场。仓位管理采用基于账户余额百分比和ATR的动态手数计算方法，根据市场波动率自动调整仓位大小，高波动时减小仓位以控制风险。资金管理方面设置了最大同时持仓数限制和单日最大亏损限额，防止连续亏损导致账户严重回撤。整体策略适合在有明显支撑阻力位且波动率适中的品种上运行，但在震荡市中可能频繁触发虚假突破导致连续止损。
EA-19655.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of GalacticExplosion is to capture explosive price movements after breaking through key levels, analogous to the expanding effect of a galactic explosion. Entry conditions are typically based on price breaking above the highest high or below the lowest low of the previous N bars, confirmed by volatility indicators such as ATR to validate the breakout and filter out false breakouts. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit targets, trailing stops, and stop-loss on breakout failure signals, ensuring profit maximization during trend continuation and timely exit when breakouts fail. Position sizing employs a dynamic lot calculation based on account balance percentage and ATR, automatically adjusting position size according to market volatility — reducing size during high volatility periods to control risk. Money management incorporates limits on maximum simultaneous positions and maximum daily loss, preventing consecutive losses from causing severe account drawdowns. The overall strategy is suitable for instruments with clear support/resistance levels and moderate volatility, but may frequently trigger false breakouts in ranging markets leading to consecutive stop-losses.

EA-19666.name: Exp_ColorJJRSX_Tm_Plus
EA-19666.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJJRSX indicator, a colored version of the JJRSX (Jurik RSX) momentum oscillator. It enters long positions when the indicator turns bullish (color change to upward) and short positions when it turns bearish, with time filtering and plus features for enhanced trade management.
EA-19666.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJJRSX指标进行交易，JJRSX是Jurik RSX动量振荡器的彩色版本。当指标转为看涨颜色时做多，转为看跌颜色时做空，并具有时间过滤和增强交易管理功能。
EA-19666.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用ColorJJRSX动量振荡器的颜色变化作为交易信号。入场条件为：当JJRSX指标颜色从下跌转为上涨时开多仓，从上涨转为下跌时开空仓，属于典型的动量反转交易策略。出场条件依赖于指标颜色的再次反转或固定止损止盈设置。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数，但具体的风险控制力度取决于参数配置。该EA还加入了时间过滤功能，允许用户限制交易时段，避免在不利时段开仓。Plus版本可能增加了移动止损、追踪止损等增强功能，提升了交易管理的灵活性。
EA-19666.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses color changes of the ColorJJRSX momentum oscillator as trading signals. Entry conditions: open long when the JJRSX indicator color changes from bearish to bullish, and open short when it changes from bullish to bearish, representing a typical momentum reversal trading approach. Exit conditions rely on the indicator color reversing again or on fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-based calculation tied to account equity. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters, though the actual risk control effectiveness depends on parameter configuration. The EA also includes a time filter feature, allowing users to restrict trading to specific sessions and avoid opening positions during unfavorable periods. The Plus version likely adds enhanced features such as trailing stops, improving trade management flexibility.

EA-19726.name: Reduce_risks
EA-19726.summary: This EA is designed to reduce trading risk by implementing hedging strategies that open opposing positions when existing trades move against the trader. It monitors open positions and automatically places counter-direction trades to limit drawdown exposure.
EA-19726.summary_zh: 该EA旨在通过实施对冲策略来降低交易风险，当现有持仓朝不利方向运动时，自动开立反向仓位。它监控持仓情况并自动放置反向交易以限制回撤敞口。
EA-19726.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是风险对冲，当检测到已有持仓出现亏损时，通过开立反向仓位来减少整体风险敞口。入场条件基于对现有持仓浮亏的监控，当亏损达到预设阈值时触发对冲操作。出场条件可能包括主仓位回归盈利或对冲仓位达到目标利润后平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于原始仓位比例的方式确定对冲仓位大小。资金管理方面，EA名称'降低风险'表明其设计初衷是保护资金而非追求高收益，但多次对冲可能导致持仓复杂化。整体策略属于防御性交易方法，适合在剧烈波动市场中保护已有仓位。
EA-19726.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is risk hedging, opening opposing positions when existing holdings show losses to reduce overall risk exposure. Entry conditions are based on monitoring floating losses of existing positions, triggering hedging operations when losses reach a preset threshold. Exit conditions may include closing the hedge when the primary position returns to profit or when the hedge position reaches its target profit. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a ratio-based approach relative to the original position to determine hedge size. Money management is defensive by design as indicated by the name 'Reduce risks', aiming to protect capital rather than pursue high returns, though multiple hedges can complicate position management. Overall, this is a defensive trading approach suitable for protecting existing positions in volatile markets.

pros: 有效限制单边持仓的下行风险，在剧烈波动市场中提供保护
对冲策略逻辑清晰，无需复杂技术指标判断即可执行
半自动化设计允许交易者保留主仓位判断权，灵活性较高
pros_en: Effectively limits downside risk of directional positions, providing protection in volatile markets
Hedging strategy logic is clear and executable without complex technical indicator analysis
Semi-automated design allows traders to retain discretion over primary positions, offering flexibility
cons: 对冲仓位本身也可能亏损，若市场持续单边运行可能导致双向持仓同时浮亏
多次对冲可能使持仓结构过于复杂，增加管理难度和点差成本
缺乏明确的止损机制可能导致对冲失败时风险失控
cons_en: Hedge positions themselves can incur losses; sustained one-sided market moves may cause both original and hedge positions to lose simultaneously
Multiple hedges can overcomplicate position structure, increasing management difficulty and spread costs
Lack of explicit stop-loss mechanisms may lead to uncontrolled risk if hedging fails
improvements: 增加对冲仓位的止损设置，防止单边行情下对冲失效造成双重亏损
加入点差过滤和市场波动率检测，避免在高点差或极端波动时频繁开仓对冲
improvements_en: Add stop-loss settings for hedge positions to prevent double losses when hedging fails in trending markets
Incorporate spread filtering and volatility detection to avoid frequent hedging during high spread or extreme volatility conditions

risk_points: 对冲仓位缺乏止损可能导致双向持仓同时亏损扩大
频繁对冲增加交易成本（点差和佣金），可能侵蚀账户资金
risk_points_en: Lack of stop-loss on hedge positions may cause both sides of the position to accumulate losses simultaneously
Frequent hedging increases trading costs (spreads and commissions), which may erode account equity

EA-19759.name: ZigZagEvgeTrofi ver. 1
EA-19759.summary: This EA uses the ZigZag indicator to identify trend reversals and opens trades in the direction of the newly identified trend. It enters positions when the ZigZag confirms a new swing high or low, aiming to capture trending moves from reversal points. The strategy is a systematic trend-following approach based on ZigZag pattern recognition.
EA-19759.summary_zh: 该EA使用ZigZag指标识别趋势反转点，并在新确认的趋势方向上开仓交易。当ZigZag确认新的摆动高点和低点时入场，旨在从反转点捕捉趋势行情。这是一种基于ZigZag形态识别的系统性趋势跟踪策略。
EA-19759.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用ZigZag指标检测价格波动的极值点（波峰和波谷），以此判断趋势方向的变化。当ZigZag指标确认一个新的低点形成时，EA判断上升趋势开始并做多；当确认一个新的高点形成时，EA判断下降趋势开始并做空。入场条件依赖于ZigZag参数（如深度、偏差、回撤）的调校，这些参数决定了 swing point 的灵敏度。出场条件通常基于固定的止盈止损或反向ZigZag信号触发平仓。仓位管理方面，EA提供手数参数供用户配置，但未见明显的动态仓位调整或基于账户权益的资金管理逻辑。风险控制依赖止损设置，但ZigZag指标的重绘特性可能导致信号回溯，增加虚假信号的风险。
EA-19759.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses the ZigZag indicator to detect extremum points (peaks and troughs) of price swings, thereby identifying changes in trend direction. When the ZigZag confirms a new trough, the EA determines an uptrend has started and opens a long position; when a new peak is confirmed, it identifies a downtrend and opens a short position. Entry conditions depend heavily on the ZigZag parameters (such as Depth, Deviation, and Backstep), which control the sensitivity of swing point detection. Exit conditions are typically based on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or closing positions on opposing ZigZag signals. Position sizing is configured via a lot size parameter, but there is no apparent dynamic position sizing or equity-based money management logic. Risk control relies on stop-loss settings, though the repainting nature of the ZigZag indicator may cause signals to be revised retrospectively, increasing the risk of false signals.

parameters.description_en: ZigZag指标深度参数，控制swing point检测的灵敏度

parameters.description_en: ZigZag回撤参数，限制最近swing point之间的最小K线数

pros: ZigZag指标直观地识别趋势反转点，逻辑清晰易于理解
趋势跟踪策略在强趋势行情中能够捕获较大的利润波段
参数可调允许用户根据不同品种和周期优化swing point灵敏度
pros_en: The ZigZag indicator intuitively identifies trend reversal points with clear and easy-to-understand logic
The trend-following strategy can capture large profit swings during strong trending markets
Adjustable parameters allow users to optimize swing point sensitivity for different instruments and timeframes
cons: ZigZag指标具有重绘特性，历史信号可能被修改，导致回测结果不可靠
缺乏动态仓位管理和资金管理机制，固定手数在不同市场条件下风险敞口不一致
在震荡市中频繁产生虚假反转信号，容易造成连续亏损
未包含新K线检查机制，可能在同一信号上重复开仓
cons_en: The ZigZag indicator has a repainting nature where historical signals can be modified, making backtesting results unreliable
Lacks dynamic position sizing and money management mechanisms, resulting in inconsistent risk exposure across varying market conditions
Generates frequent false reversal signals in ranging markets, easily leading to consecutive losses
Does not include a new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same signal
improvements: 增加新K线检查逻辑，避免同一信号重复入场；结合其他指标（如ATR或均线）过滤虚假ZigZag信号
引入基于账户权益的动态仓位管理，并根据ATR设置自适应止损止盈，以适应不同市场波动性
improvements_en: Add a new bar check to prevent duplicate entries on the same signal; combine with additional indicators (e.g., ATR or moving averages) to filter false ZigZag signals
Introduce equity-based dynamic position sizing and ATR-adaptive stop-loss/take-profit to accommodate varying market volatility

risk_points: ZigZag指标重绘特性导致信号可能被事后修改，实盘表现可能与回测不一致
缺乏新K线检查可能导致重复开仓，增加不必要风险敞口
震荡行情中虚假信号频繁，缺少趋势过滤机制
risk_points_en: ZigZag repainting means signals can be revised after the fact, causing live performance to diverge from backtests
Lack of new bar checking may cause duplicate position openings, increasing unnecessary risk exposure
Frequent false signals in ranging markets without a trend filter mechanism

EA-19776.name: LacusTstopandBE
EA-19776.summary: This EA is a trailing stop and break-even utility that manages existing open positions by moving stop losses to breakeven or trailing them as price moves in favor. It does not open trades on its own but instead applies dynamic trailing stop and break-even logic to manually or otherwise opened positions.
EA-19776.summary_zh: 该EA是一个追踪止损和保本工具，通过在价格有利方向移动时将止损移至保本位或动态追踪止损来管理已有的持仓。它不会自行开仓，而是对手动或其他方式开立的仓位应用动态追踪止损和保本逻辑。
EA-19776.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是作为仓位管理辅助工具，不自行产生交易信号或开仓。入场条件不适用，因为它不执行开仓操作，仅在已有持仓的基础上运作。出场条件通过追踪止损和保本机制实现：当价格朝有利方向移动达到设定点数时，将止损移至保本位；当利润继续增长时，止损会以设定的步长持续追踪价格。仓位管理方面，EA不对仓位大小进行控制，仅管理已有仓位的止损水平。资金管理方面，EA不涉及资金管理逻辑，仅提供风险保护功能，通过追踪止损锁定利润并限制回撤。
EA-19776.strategy_analysis_en: This EA functions as a position management utility and does not generate its own trade signals or open positions. Entry conditions are not applicable since it does not execute opening trades; it operates solely on existing positions. Exit conditions are implemented through trailing stop and break-even mechanisms: when price moves favorably by a configured number of points, the stop loss is moved to breakeven; as profit continues to grow, the stop loss trails price at a configured step distance. Position sizing is not managed by this EA, as it only adjusts stop loss levels on already-opened positions. Money management is not within the scope of this EA, which focuses purely on risk protection by locking in profits and limiting drawdown through trailing stops.

保本功能有效锁定利润，防止盈利仓位转为亏损

pros_en: Automated stop loss management reduces manual oversight burden
Break-even feature effectively locks in profits and prevents winning trades from turning into losers
Flexible trailing stop logic with configurable step and distance parameters
cons: 不进行开仓操作，需配合其他信号源使用

Add position filtering to support selective management by symbol, direction, or profit amount

risk_points_en: As a pure utility EA it does not generate trading risk, but incorrect parameter settings may result in stops being too tight or too loose

EA-19781.name: VR ZVER v.2
EA-19781.summary: VR ZVER v.2 is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using a combination of moving averages and momentum indicators, entering trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. The EA employs a multi-confirmation entry system with trend filters and momentum validation to reduce false signals. It includes trailing stop functionality and risk management features to protect profits and limit losses.
EA-19781.summary_zh: VR ZVER v.2是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，通过移动平均线和动量指标的组合来判断市场方向，沿趋势方向入场交易。该EA采用多确认入场系统，结合趋势过滤和动量验证来减少虚假信号，并包含移动止损和风险管理功能来保护利润和限制亏损。
EA-19781.strategy_analysis: VR ZVER v.2的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过多重技术指标确认趋势方向后再入场。入场条件依赖移动平均线的排列方向和动量指标的共振信号，当短期均线上穿长期均线且动量指标确认多头力量时做多，反之做空。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、移动止损跟踪以及趋势反转信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用基于账户余额百分比的动态手数计算方式，根据市场波动率调整仓位大小。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和回撤保护机制，当账户亏损达到设定阈值时停止交易。该策略的优点是顺势交易胜率较高，但在震荡行情中容易产生连续亏损。
EA-19781.strategy_analysis_en: VR ZVER v.2's core strategy is trend following, requiring multiple technical indicator confirmations before entering in the trend direction. Entry conditions rely on moving average alignment and momentum indicator confluence signals, going long when the short-term MA crosses above the long-term MA with momentum confirming bullish strength, and vice versa for shorts. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, trailing stop tracking, and trend reversal signal-triggered position closing. Position sizing uses a dynamic lot calculation based on account balance percentage, adjusting position size according to market volatility. Money management implements maximum position limits and drawdown protection mechanisms, halting trading when account losses reach a predefined threshold. The strategy's strength lies in higher win rates during trending markets, but it is prone to consecutive losses during ranging or choppy conditions.

pros_en: Multi-indicator confirmation entry reduces false signals and improves win rate
Dynamic position sizing and drawdown protection effectively controls risk
Trailing stop feature locks in floating profits and prevents profit giveback
Trend-following logic is clear and aligns with market trend movement principles
Highly configurable parameters allow users to optimize settings for different market conditions

cons_en: Trend-following strategy performs poorly in ranging markets, prone to consecutive stop-losses

Fixed pip stop-loss doesn't account for volatility differences across currency pairs

回撤保护阈值若设置不当，可能在正常回调时过早停止交易
risk_points_en: Lacks automatic market regime detection, may sustain continuous losses in ranging markets
Fixed stop-loss not adapted to different instrument volatility, may trigger frequently on high-volatility pairs
Drawdown protection threshold if improperly set may halt trading prematurely during normal pullbacks

EA-19818.name: Price Extreme Strategy
EA-19818.summary: Price Extreme Strategy is an Expert Advisor that identifies extreme price levels (highest highs and lowest lows) over a defined period and enters breakout trades when price breaches these extremes. It aims to capture strong directional moves following the breakout of established price boundaries. The EA systematically places buy orders on upside breakouts and sell orders on downside breakouts with predefined risk management parameters.
EA-19818.summary_zh: 价格极值策略EA通过识别设定周期内的极端价格水平（最高点和最低点），在价格突破这些极值时入场交易。该策略旨在捕捉价格突破既有边界后的强势方向性走势。EA在向上突破时系统性地下买入单，在向下突破时下卖出单，并配置了预定义的风险管理参数。
EA-19818.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是基于价格极值突破，即在一定周期内识别价格的最高点和最低点作为关键支撑阻力位。入场条件为：当价格突破N周期内的最高价时开多单，当价格跌破N周期内的最低价时开空单，属于典型的突破策略。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损，以及在极值重新计算时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位。资金管理方面，通过止损控制单笔风险，但需关注连续假突破带来的回撤风险。该策略在趋势明显的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中容易因频繁假突破而亏损。
EA-19818.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is based on price extreme breakouts, identifying the highest and lowest prices over a defined period as key support and resistance levels. Entry conditions: a buy order is placed when price breaks above the N-period high, and a sell order is placed when price breaks below the N-period low, representing a classic breakout approach. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with position closure when price extremes are recalculated. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-balance-proportional sizing. Money management relies on stop-losses to control per-trade risk, but the strategy is vulnerable to drawdowns from consecutive false breakouts. The strategy performs well in trending markets but suffers in ranging markets due to frequent false breakout whipsaws.

自带止损止盈设置，风险可控，单笔亏损有上限

参数化设计便于优化和适应不同品种周期

Built-in stop-loss and take-profit settings provide controlled risk with capped per-trade loss

Parameterized design allows optimization and adaptation to different instruments and timeframes

EA-19829.name: Fractals at Close prices EA
EA-19829.summary: This EA trades based on Bill Williams' Fractal indicator applied to Close prices, entering long positions when price breaks above an up-fractal and short positions when price breaks below a down-fractal. It is a classic breakout system that uses fractal levels as dynamic support and resistance zones to generate trade signals. The EA automatically opens and manages positions when the close price confirms a fractal breakout.
EA-19829.summary_zh: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯的分形指标应用于收盘价，当价格突破上分形时做多，突破下分形时做空。这是一个经典的突破系统，利用分形水平作为动态支撑和阻力区域来生成交易信号。EA在收盘价确认分形突破后自动开仓和管理仓位。
EA-19829.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯分形指标的突破交易。入场条件为：当收盘价向上突破最近的上分形时开多单，当收盘价向下突破最近的下分形时开空单。分形由至少5根K线组成，中间K线的最高价或最低价为极值，形成动态的支撑阻力位。出场条件通常依赖反向分形突破信号或固定的止损止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA可能使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，该策略依赖分形结构的有效性，但分形突破在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的假突破信号，导致连续亏损。整体而言，这是一个结构化的突破跟踪系统，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
EA-19829.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on breakout trading using Bill Williams' Fractal indicator. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the close price breaks above the most recent up-fractal, and a short position is opened when the close price breaks below the most recent down-fractal. A fractal consists of at least 5 bars where the middle bar's high or low is the extreme, forming dynamic support and resistance levels. Exit conditions typically rely on an opposing fractal breakout signal or fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-balance-based calculation. Money management depends on the validity of the fractal structure, but fractal breakouts are prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses. Overall, this is a structured breakout-following system best suited for trending market conditions.

EA-19906.name: Diff_TF_MA_EA
EA-19906.summary: This EA trades based on the difference between moving averages from two different timeframes. It compares the MA values from a higher and a lower timeframe to generate buy and sell signals when the differential crosses threshold levels. The strategy aims to capture trend alignment across multiple timeframes for higher-probability entries.
EA-19906.summary_zh: 该EA基于两个不同周期移动平均线的差值进行交易。它比较高周期和低周期的MA值，当差值穿越阈值水平时产生买入和卖出信号。该策略旨在通过多周期趋势对齐来提高入场概率。
EA-19906.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用两个不同时间框架的移动平均线差值来判断市场趋势方向。入场条件为：当快周期MA与慢周期MA的差值超过设定的阈值时，产生买入或卖出信号，差值为正且增大时做多，差值为负且减小时做空。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发或止损止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户固定手数交易，但没有看到动态仓位调整或基于资金比例的仓位管理机制。资金管理较为基础，主要依赖止损止盈参数控制单笔风险。整体策略逻辑简单明了，多周期对齐思路有助于过滤假信号，但缺乏对市场波动性和交易成本（点差）的考虑。
EA-19906.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA utilizes the difference between moving averages from two different timeframes to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions are triggered when the differential between the fast-timeframe MA and slow-timeframe MA exceeds a user-defined threshold: a positive and increasing differential generates buy signals while a negative and decreasing differential generates sell signals. Exit conditions rely on reverse signal triggers or stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing allows the user to specify a fixed lot size, but there is no dynamic position sizing or equity-proportional lot calculation mechanism. Money management is relatively basic, primarily relying on stop-loss and take-profit parameters to control per-trade risk. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, and the multi-timeframe alignment approach helps filter false signals, but it lacks consideration for market volatility and trading costs such as spread.

EA-19913.name: Percentage_Crossover_Channel_EA
EA-19913.summary: This EA trades based on a percentage-based channel that dynamically adjusts to price movements. It enters buy positions when price crosses below the lower channel boundary and sell positions when price crosses above the upper channel boundary, aiming to capture mean reversion moves within the channel range.
EA-19913.summary_zh: 该EA基于百分比通道进行交易，通道根据价格动态调整。当价格穿越通道下边界时做多，穿越上边界时做空，旨在捕捉通道范围内的均值回归行情。
EA-19913.strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是基于百分比计算的动态通道，通道上下轨根据价格的一定百分比偏移量构建，形成类似布林带的包络线。入场条件为：当价格从上方穿越下通道时开多单，预期价格回归通道中心；当价格从下方穿越上通道时开空单，预期价格回落。出场条件依赖通道交叉信号的反转，即持仓至价格穿越对侧通道边界时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数参数，未发现基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理上缺乏明确的最大持仓限制和最大回撤控制，整体依赖通道回归假设但未设置硬性止损保护。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在强趋势行情中可能因价格持续偏离通道而产生连续亏损。
EA-19913.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is a dynamically calculated percentage-based channel, where the upper and lower boundaries are constructed as a percentage offset from price, forming an envelope similar to Bollinger Bands. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when price crosses below the lower channel boundary, expecting mean reversion toward the channel center; open a sell position when price crosses above the upper channel boundary, expecting price to fall back. Exit conditions rely on the reversal of the crossover signal — positions are held until price crosses the opposite channel boundary. Position sizing uses a fixed lot parameter with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management lacks explicit maximum position limits and drawdown controls, relying on channel mean reversion assumptions without hard stop-loss protection. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but may suffer consecutive losses in strong trending conditions where price persistently deviates from the channel.

EA-19914.name: NTK 07
EA-19914.summary: NTK 07 is a trend-following Expert Advisor for MetaTrader 5 that identifies directional momentum and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses a combination of moving average-based trend detection and momentum confirmation signals to open positions, with built-in stop-loss and take-profit management. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention once configured.
EA-19914.summary_zh: NTK 07是一个基于趋势跟踪策略的MetaTrader 5智能交易系统，通过识别方向性动量并沿当前趋势方向入场交易。它结合均线趋势检测和动量确认信号来开仓，并内置止损止盈管理功能。配置完成后该EA可全自动运行，无需人工干预。
EA-19914.strategy_analysis: NTK 07采用趋势跟踪策略作为核心概念，通过移动平均线判断市场的主趋势方向。入场条件依赖于价格与均线的关系以及动量指标的确认，当两者一致时发出交易信号。出场条件包括预设的止损和止盈水平，同时可能包含追踪止损功能来锁定利润。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理上，止损设置提供了每笔交易的最大风险控制，但需要用户合理配置参数以确保风险在可接受范围内。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
EA-19914.strategy_analysis_en: NTK 07 employs a trend-following strategy as its core concept, using moving averages to determine the prevailing market trend direction. Entry conditions rely on the relationship between price and moving averages combined with momentum indicator confirmation, generating trade signals when both align. Exit conditions include preset stop-loss and take-profit levels, and the EA may incorporate a trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits as the trend progresses. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, with some versions potentially including dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management is handled through stop-loss settings that provide maximum risk control per trade, though users must configure parameters appropriately to keep risk within acceptable limits. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-suited for markets with pronounced trending behavior.

EA-19916.name: TimeEA
EA-19916.summary: TimeEA is a time-based Expert Advisor that executes trades during specific time sessions. It uses time window filters to determine entry points, opening positions at designated trading hours. The EA relies on time-of-day patterns rather than technical indicators for its trading signals.
EA-19916.summary_zh: TimeEA是一个基于时间的智能交易系统，在特定时段执行交易。它使用时间窗口过滤器来确定入场点，在指定的交易时段开仓。该EA依赖日内时间模式而非技术指标来产生交易信号。
EA-19916.strategy_analysis: TimeEA的核心策略概念是基于时段交易，即在特定的时间窗口内开仓交易，利用市场在不同时段的波动特征获取利润。入场条件主要依赖于当前服务器时间是否落在用户设定的时间范围内，当时间匹配时触发交易信号。出场条件通常包括止盈和止损设置，也可能在特定时间窗口结束时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理依赖于止损和止盈的设置，但缺乏动态调整止损的机制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但过度依赖时间因素而忽略价格行为和技术分析，存在一定的局限性。
EA-19916.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of TimeEA is session-based trading, executing positions within specific time windows to exploit market volatility patterns characteristic of different trading sessions. Entry conditions primarily depend on whether the current server time falls within user-defined time ranges, triggering trade signals when the time matches. Exit conditions typically include take-profit and stop-loss settings, and may also close positions when the time window ends. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or balance-proportional lot calculation methods. Money management relies on stop-loss and take-profit settings but lacks dynamic trailing stop mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, but it is overly reliant on time factors while ignoring price action and technical analysis, presenting certain limitations.

EA-19930.name: TrailingTakeProfit
EA-19930.summary: This EA is a trailing take-profit utility that dynamically adjusts the take-profit level of existing open positions as price moves in the favorable direction. It does not open trades on its own but manages profit targets to lock in gains while allowing positions to capture more profit. Users configure the trailing distance and step parameters to control how aggressively the take-profit follows price movement.
EA-19930.summary_zh: 这个EA是一个追踪止盈工具，当价格朝有利方向移动时，动态调整现有持仓的止盈水平。它不会自行开仓，而是通过管理盈利目标来锁定收益，同时允许仓位捕获更多利润。用户可以配置追踪距离和步长参数来控制止盈跟随价格运动的激进程度。
EA-19930.strategy_analysis: 该EA属于仓位管理工具而非自主交易策略。其核心概念是在持仓浮盈增加时，逐步将止盈价位向有利方向移动，从而在保留盈利空间的同时锁定已有利润。入场条件方面，该EA不主动入场，而是依赖于已有持仓的存在。出场条件由被调整的止盈水平触发，当价格回撤至当前止盈位时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅管理已有订单的止盈参数。资金管理方面，该EA通过追踪止盈间接保护资金，但本身不执行风险控制逻辑如止损设置或仓位比例计算。用户需自行确保已有仓位设置了合理的止损。
EA-19930.strategy_analysis_en: This EA functions as a position management tool rather than an autonomous trading strategy. Its core concept is to progressively move the take-profit level in the favorable direction as unrealized profit increases, thereby locking in gains while preserving room for further profit. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not initiate trades; it depends entirely on pre-existing open positions to manage. Exit conditions are triggered when price retraces to the current trailing take-profit level, at which point the position is closed by the broker. For position sizing, the EA does not calculate or modify lot sizes, only adjusting the take-profit parameter of existing orders. In terms of money management, the EA indirectly protects capital by trailing take-profit, but it does not implement risk control logic such as stop-loss placement or position sizing ratios. Users must ensure that existing positions have reasonable stop-losses configured independently.

pros_en: Automates take-profit management, reducing the need for manual intervention by the trader

Can be combined with any independent trade-opening strategy to enhance profit protection of the overall trading system

In highly volatile markets, the take-profit may be frequently triggered right before price continues in the original direction, resulting in opportunity cost losses
improvements: 增加止损追踪功能，实现止盈与止损的协同管理
添加盈利回撤百分比模式作为追踪止盈的替代策略，提高灵活性

Implement a profit-drawdown percentage mode as an alternative trailing strategy to increase flexibility

EA-19931.name: RndTrade
EA-19931.summary: RndTrade is an Expert Advisor that executes trades based on random entry signals, essentially a randomized trading system. It opens buy or sell positions with no directional bias, relying on probability and risk management rather than technical or fundamental analysis. The EA serves as an experimental or benchmark tool to test whether risk management alone can produce profitable results without any predictive edge.
EA-19931.summary_zh: RndTrade是一个基于随机入场信号执行交易的EA，本质上是一个随机化交易系统。它以无方向偏好开立多头或空头头寸，依赖概率和风险管理而非技术或基本面分析。该EA作为实验或基准工具，测试仅靠风险管理是否能在没有任何预测优势的情况下产生盈利结果。
EA-19931.strategy_analysis: RndTrade的策略概念完全基于随机性，入场条件由随机数生成器决定，随机选择买入或卖出方向，没有任何技术指标或价格行为分析作为依据。出场条件依赖于预设的止损和止盈水平，或者可能使用追踪止损来管理已开仓位。仓位管理方面，EA可能提供固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理是该EA唯一的核心优势，因为随机入场本身没有统计优势，盈利完全取决于良好的风险回报比和仓位控制。整体而言，这是一个概念验证型EA，用于验证'随机入场+严格风险管理'是否能长期存活，实际交易中缺乏任何可重复的统计优势。
EA-19931.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of RndTrade is entirely based on randomness, with entry conditions determined by a random number generator that randomly selects buy or sell direction without any technical indicator or price action analysis. Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit levels, or possibly a trailing stop mechanism to manage open positions. For position sizing, the EA likely offers fixed lot size or balance-proportional lot calculation. Money management is the only core strength of this EA, since random entry itself carries no statistical edge, and profitability depends entirely on favorable risk-reward ratios and position control. Overall, this is a proof-of-concept EA designed to test whether 'random entry + strict risk management' can survive long-term, but it lacks any repeatable statistical advantage in actual trading.

improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器，在趋势行情中增加方向性偏向而非完全随机

EA-19936.name: Ambush
EA-19936.summary: Ambush is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that identifies consolidation ranges and enters trades when price breaks out of those ranges. It uses pending orders to capture momentum from range expansion after periods of price compression. The EA places buy-stop and sell-stop orders at the boundaries of identified ranges and manages them with stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-19936.summary_zh: Ambush是一个基于突破策略的智能交易系统，它识别价格整理区间并在价格突破区间边界时入场交易。EA在识别出的区间边界放置突破挂单（Buy Stop和Sell Stop），以捕捉价格压缩后区间扩张带来的动量行情，并通过止损和止盈水平管理仓位。
EA-19936.strategy_analysis: Ambush策略的核心概念是识别市场的整理区间（盘整阶段），然后在区间上下边界设置突破挂单。入场条件为：当价格在一段时间内形成窄幅波动区间后，EA在区间高点上方设置Buy Stop订单，在区间低点下方设置Sell Stop订单，等待突破发生时自动成交。出场条件包括预设的止盈和止损水平，以及当区间失效或超时未突破时删除挂单。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态手数计算。资金管理依赖于止损设置来控制单笔风险，但具体的风险控制程度取决于参数配置。该策略的优势在于捕捉趋势启动的初期阶段，但风险在于假突破可能导致频繁止损。
EA-19936.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Ambush strategy is to identify market consolidation ranges (sideways phases) and then place breakout pending orders at the upper and lower boundaries of those ranges. Entry conditions: after price forms a narrow trading range over a defined period, the EA places a Buy Stop order above the range high and a Sell Stop order below the range low, waiting for a breakout to trigger the order automatically. Exit conditions include preset take-profit and stop-loss levels, as well as deletion of pending orders when the range becomes invalid or the breakout fails to occur within a timeout period. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, and some versions may include dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management relies on stop-loss settings to control per-trade risk, though the degree of risk control depends on parameter configuration. The strategy's strength lies in capturing the early stage of trend initiation, but the risk is that false breakouts can lead to frequent stop-loss triggers.

EA-19940.name: SAR RSI MTS
EA-19940.summary: This EA combines Parabolic SAR direction changes with RSI momentum confirmation to generate trend-following trade signals on new bar formation. It opens buy positions when SAR flips below price and RSI is rising above 50, and sell positions when SAR flips above price and RSI is falling below 50. Position sizing uses fixed margin risk percentage with trailing stop management for open trades.
EA-19940.summary_zh: 该EA结合抛物线SAR方向变化与RSI动量确认，在新K线形成时生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当SAR翻转到价格下方且RSI上穿50时开多仓，当SAR翻转到价格上方且RSI下穿50时开空仓。仓位管理使用固定保证金风险百分比，并对持仓进行移动止损管理。
EA-19940.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA是一个典型的趋势跟踪系统，利用Parabolic SAR判断趋势方向翻转，同时用RSI作为动量过滤器确认趋势强度。入场条件：做多需满足四个条件——前一根SAR值低于收盘价（SAR在价格下方）、SAR值从前一根到当前根递增（确认SAR翻转向上追踪趋势）、当前RSI大于50（多头动量确认）、当前RSI大于前一根RSI（动量增强确认）；做空条件对称相反。出场条件：采用固定止损和止盈（10点止损/40点止盈），以及移动止损（15点跟踪止损+5点步进），当价格朝有利方向移动超过跟踪止损加步进距离时调整止损。仓位管理：使用CMoneyFixedMargin类根据风险百分比（默认1%）和可用保证金计算开仓手数，同时通过CTrade.CheckVolume进行预检以避免资金不足错误。资金管理：最多允许同时持有6个同策略仓位，止损止盈均以点数输入并自动适配3/5位报价。移动止损对多空仓位分别处理，确保止损只朝有利方向移动。
EA-19940.strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA is a classic trend-following system that uses Parabolic SAR to detect trend direction reversals and RSI as a momentum filter to confirm trend strength. Entry conditions: Long entry requires four conditions — previous SAR below close price (SAR beneath price), SAR increasing from previous to current bar (confirming SAR flip tracking the trend), current RSI above 50 (bullish momentum confirmation), and current RSI higher than previous RSI (momentum acceleration confirmation); short entry conditions are symmetrically opposite. Exit conditions: Fixed stop loss and take profit (10 pips SL / 40 pips TP), plus a trailing stop (15 pips trailing stop + 5 pips step) that adjusts the stop loss when price moves favorably beyond the trailing distance plus step increment. Position sizing: Uses CMoneyFixedMargin class to calculate lot size based on risk percentage (default 1%) and available free margin, with a pre-check via CTrade.CheckVolume to avoid insufficient margin errors. Money management: Allows up to 6 simultaneous positions for the same strategy, with SL/TP input in pips auto-adjusted for 3/5 digit brokers. The trailing stop handles long and short positions separately, ensuring stops only move in the favorable direction.

EA-19945.name: EMA Cross Contest Hedged
EA-19945.summary: This EA trades EMA crossover signals with an optional MACD filter, placing a main market order plus 4 hedge pending orders at fixed intervals. It uses trailing stops for open positions and optionally closes opposite positions on signal reversal. The hedging mechanism creates a ladder of stop orders in the direction of the trend to scale into positions.
EA-19945.summary_zh: 该EA基于EMA交叉信号进行交易，可选MACD过滤，入场时同时下1个市价单和4个间隔排列的对冲挂单。对已持仓位使用移动止损跟踪利润，并在信号反转时可选平掉反向仓位。对冲机制通过在趋势方向上布置阶梯式止损挂单来逐步建仓。
EA-19945.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于短期EMA与长期EMA的交叉判断趋势方向，当短EMA上穿长EMA时视为上升趋势，下穿时视为下降趋势。入场条件为EMA交叉且可选MACD过滤（做多需MACD主线>=0，做空需MACD主线<=0），入场时除市价单外还会在距离当前价格1-4倍HedgeLevel处放置4个同方向止损挂单，形成阶梯式加仓。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及移动止损跟踪，移动止损仅在利润超过TrailingStop+TrailingStep时才启动调整。仓位管理采用固定手数，未根据账户资金动态调整。资金管理方面没有最大持仓限制，4个挂单加上市价单意味着单次信号可能同时持有5个仓位，风险敞口较大。
EA-19945.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover of a short-period EMA and a long-period EMA to determine trend direction, with an uptrend signaled when the short EMA crosses above the long EMA and a downtrend when it crosses below. Entry conditions require an EMA crossover plus an optional MACD filter (long requires MACD main line >= 0, short requires MACD main line <= 0), and upon entry the EA places a market order along with 4 stop orders spaced at 1x to 4x the HedgeLevel distance, creating a ladder of scaling-in positions. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as a trailing stop that only activates when unrealized profit exceeds TrailingStop plus TrailingStep. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management lacks a maximum position limit, and the combination of a market order plus 4 pending stop orders means a single signal can result in up to 5 simultaneous positions, creating significant risk exposure.

EA-19951.name: Trend Me Leave Me
EA-19951.summary: This EA identifies trend direction using moving averages and generates entry signals when the trend is confirmed, then manages trades with a trailing stop mechanism. It opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend and exits when the trend reverses or the trailing stop is hit. The EA is designed to capture medium-to-long-term trend movements while protecting profits with dynamic stop management.
EA-19951.summary_zh: 该EA通过移动平均线识别趋势方向，在趋势确认后生成入场信号，并使用追踪止损机制管理交易。它沿当前趋势方向开仓，在趋势反转或追踪止损触发时出场。该EA旨在捕捉中长线趋势行情，同时通过动态止损保护利润。
EA-19951.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于移动平均线的趋势跟踪系统，利用快速均线与慢速均线的交叉或价格与均线的关系判断趋势方向。入场条件为趋势确认后，价格沿趋势方向突破或回踩确认时开仓，做多为均线多头排列且价格站上均线，做空为空头排列且价格跌破均线。出场条件包括趋势反转信号（均线交叉反向）或追踪止损被触发，追踪止损会随着盈利增加而不断上移止损位以锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式，没有复杂的加仓逻辑。资金管理方面依赖追踪止损来控制单笔风险，但未发现明确的最大回撤限制或账户级别的风险控制机制。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为基础，缺乏对震荡市的过滤机制和多重时间框架确认。
EA-19951.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a trend following system based on moving averages, using the crossover of fast and slow MAs or the relationship between price and MAs to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require trend confirmation, with long entries when MAs are in bullish alignment and price is above the MA, and short entries when bearish alignment with price below the MA. Exit conditions include trend reversal signals (MA crossover in opposite direction) or trailing stop activation, where the trailing stop continuously moves upward as profit increases to lock in gains. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation of account balance, without complex pyramiding logic. Money management relies on the trailing stop for single-trade risk control, but there is no explicit maximum drawdown limit or account-level risk management mechanism. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively basic, lacking consolidation market filtering and multi-timeframe confirmation.
pros: 趋势跟踪逻辑清晰简单，易于理解和调整参数
使用追踪止损机制保护已获利润，降低回吐风险
策略概念成熟，趋势跟踪在趋势市中表现稳定

cons_en: Pure trend strategy prone to frequent stop losses in ranging markets, producing consecutive losses

No trading session filter, may generate poor signals during low liquidity periods

improvements: 增加震荡市过滤器（如ADX或ATR阈值），在低趋势强度时减少交易频率
加入多时间框架确认逻辑，提高入场信号可靠性

Incorporate multi-timeframe confirmation logic to improve entry signal reliability

EA-19963.name: TrailingStopAndTake
EA-19963.summary: This EA is a trailing stop and take profit management utility that does not open its own positions. It monitors existing open positions and dynamically adjusts their stop loss levels to trail price movement, while also managing take profit targets based on user-configurable parameters.
EA-19963.summary_zh: 该EA是一个移动止损和止盈管理工具，不会自行开仓。它监控已有的持仓，根据价格变动动态调整止损水平以跟踪利润，同时根据用户配置的参数管理止盈目标。
EA-19963.strategy_analysis: 该EA不是一个自主交易策略，而是一个持仓管理工具。它不产生任何入场信号或自行开仓，仅对已存在的持仓进行管理。其核心功能是移动止损（Trailing Stop），即随着价格朝有利方向移动，逐步将止损价位向盈利方向推移以锁定利润。同时具备止盈管理功能，可以设置固定或动态的止盈目标。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅对现有持仓的止损和止盈进行修改。资金管理方面，通过移动止损来保护已有利润，间接起到资金保护作用。该工具适用于所有已有持仓的策略，作为辅助工具提升风控能力。
EA-19963.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an autonomous trading strategy but rather a position management utility. It does not generate any entry signals or open positions on its own; it only manages existing open positions. Its core functionality is trailing stop, which means as price moves favorably, it gradually shifts the stop loss level in the profitable direction to lock in gains. It also features take profit management, allowing users to set fixed or dynamic take profit targets. In terms of position sizing, the EA does not handle lot size calculation since it never opens trades. For money management, it indirectly protects capital by using trailing stops to secure unrealized profits. This tool is applicable to any strategy with existing positions, serving as an auxiliary tool to enhance risk control capabilities.

EA-19971.name: Channels(barabashkakvn's edition)
EA-19971.summary: This EA trades channel breakouts using a fast EMA(2) crossing Envelopes bands based on a slow EMA(220) on the H1 timeframe. It opens BUY when the fast EMA(Close) crosses above an Envelope lower or upper band, and SELL when the fast EMA(Open) crosses below an Envelope upper or lower band. Positions are managed with configurable trailing stops and optional time-based session filtering.
EA-19971.summary_zh: 该EA基于H1周期上快速EMA(2)穿越基于慢速EMA(220)的包络线(Envelopes)通道进行突破交易。当快速EMA(收盘价)上穿包络线下轨或上轨时开多仓，当快速EMA(开盘价)下穿包络线上轨或下轨时开空仓。持仓通过可配置的移动止损和可选的时段过滤进行管理。
EA-19971.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于包络线通道突破，使用三条不同偏差(0.3%、0.7%、1.0%)的Envelopes指标构建多层通道，配合EMA(2)作为快速信号线和EMA(220)作为中线基准。入场条件方面，做多信号包括EMA(2,Close)上穿任一Envelopes下轨、上穿任一Envelopes上轨、或上穿EMA(220)；做空信号为EMA(2,Open)下穿任一Envelopes上轨、下穿任一下轨、或下穿EMA(220)，均采用穿越确认。出场条件仅依赖移动止损机制，当浮盈超过移动止损距离加步长时，将止损调整至当前价格减去移动止损距离(多仓)或加上移动止损距离(空仓)，无固定止盈止损的强制出场(输入默认为0)。仓位管理采用固定手数(InpLots)，无加仓减仓逻辑，同时只持有一个方向的头寸(total==0时才开仓)。资金管理方面没有动态仓位计算或风险百分比控制，仅做最小/最大手数和手数步长的合规性检查。
EA-19971.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Envelopes channel breakouts, using three Envelopes indicators with different deviations (0.3%, 0.7%, 1.0%) to construct multi-layer channels, combined with EMA(2) as the fast signal line and EMA(220) as the midline baseline. Entry conditions for BUY signals include EMA(2,Close) crossing above any Envelopes lower band, any upper band, or the EMA(220) itself; SELL signals are triggered when EMA(2,Open) crosses below any Envelopes upper band, any lower band, or the EMA(220), all using crossover confirmation. Exit conditions rely solely on trailing stop mechanisms — when floating profit exceeds the trailing stop distance plus step, the stop loss is adjusted to current price minus trailing stop (for buys) or plus trailing stop (for sells), with no mandatory fixed take-profit or stop-loss exits (input defaults are 0). Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (InpLots) with no pyramiding or position reduction logic, and only one position direction is held at a time (new entries only when total==0). Money management lacks dynamic lot calculation or risk-percentage controls, only performing compliance checks for minimum/maximum lots and lot step granularity.

EA-19977.name: MACDSimpleReshetov
EA-19977.summary: This EA implements a simple MACD-based trading strategy credited to Reshetov. It generates buy signals when the MACD histogram crosses above zero and sell signals when it crosses below zero, opening positions in the direction of the momentum shift. The strategy is a classic momentum-following approach using the MACD indicator as its sole signal source.
EA-19977.summary_zh: 该EA实现了由Reshetov提出的基于MACD的简单交易策略。当MACD柱状图上穿零轴时产生买入信号，下穿零轴时产生卖出信号，沿动量转变方向开仓。这是一个经典的动量跟踪策略，仅以MACD指标作为信号来源。
EA-19977.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于MACD指标的动量转变，利用MACD柱状图（histogram）与零轴的交叉作为交易信号。入场条件为：当MACD柱状图从负转正（上穿零轴）时开多单，从正转负（下穿零轴）时开空单。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发平仓，即在持有多单时MACD柱状图下穿零轴则平多开空，反之亦然。仓位管理方面，该策略采用固定手数交易，未根据账户资金或波动率动态调整仓位大小。资金管理较为简单，缺乏止损和止盈的显式设置，完全依赖反向信号来关闭仓位。整体而言，这是一个典型的单指标动量策略，逻辑简洁但风险控制薄弱。
EA-19977.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum shifts detected by the MACD indicator, using the crossover of the MACD histogram with the zero line as trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the MACD histogram crosses above zero, and a sell position is opened when it crosses below zero. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals — a long position is closed (and a short opened) when the histogram crosses below zero, and vice versa. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size without dynamic adjustment based on account equity, volatility, or risk percentage. Money management is rudimentary, lacking explicit stop-loss and take-profit levels, depending entirely on signal reversal for position closure. Overall, this is a typical single-indicator momentum strategy with simple logic but weak risk controls.

代码结构简单，便于修改和扩展添加额外过滤条件
零轴交叉信号客观明确，无主观判断空间

EA-19981.name: Pipsover 2
EA-19981.summary: Pipsover 2 is a scalping EA that aims to capture small pip movements by entering trades on short-term momentum signals and exiting with fixed pip targets. It operates primarily on lower timeframes with tight take-profit and stop-loss levels. The EA uses a simple price-action or indicator-based trigger to identify quick pip opportunities.
EA-19981.summary_zh: Pipsover 2是一款剥头皮EA，通过短期动量信号入场并使用固定点数目标出场，旨在捕捉小幅点数波动。它主要在低时间周期上运行，采用较窄的止盈和止损水平。该EA使用简单的价格行为或指标触发来识别快速点数机会。
EA-19981.strategy_analysis: Pipsover 2的策略概念基于剥头皮交易，通过捕捉小幅价格波动获取利润。入场条件通常依赖于短期价格动量突破或简单指标交叉信号，例如价格突破近期高低点或移动平均线交叉。出场条件采用固定点数的止盈和止损设置，止盈目标较小而止损相对较紧，追求高胜率交易。仓位管理通常使用固定手数或基于账户余额的简单比例计算，缺乏动态调整机制。资金管理方面，EA可能提供风险百分比参数但整体较为基础，未考虑波动率自适应或动态仓位调整。该策略在低点差、高流动性的交易时段表现较好，但在剧烈波动或点差扩大时风险显著增加。
EA-19981.strategy_analysis_en: Pipsover 2's strategy concept is based on scalping, capturing small price movements for profit. Entry conditions typically rely on short-term momentum breakouts or simple indicator crossover signals, such as price breaking recent highs/lows or moving average crossovers. Exit conditions use fixed pip-based take-profit and stop-loss settings, with small TP targets and tight stops, aiming for high win-rate trades. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or a simple percentage-of-balance calculation, lacking dynamic adjustment mechanisms. In terms of money management, the EA may offer risk percentage parameters but overall is fairly basic, without volatility-adaptive or dynamic position sizing. The strategy performs better during low-spread, high-liquidity trading sessions, but risk increases significantly during volatile markets or when spreads widen.
pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，易于理解和调试
固定点数止盈止损使风险可控且可预测
适合低点差账户和高流动性时段交易

EA-20000.name: N Candles v6
EA-20000.summary: This EA identifies and trades based on N consecutive bullish or bearish candles (candlestick streaks) as a momentum exhaustion or continuation signal. It enters positions when a configurable number of consecutive same-direction candles are detected, aiming to capitalize on short-term overextension or trend persistence. The strategy includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-20000.summary_zh: 该EA基于N根连续看涨或看跌K线（K线连击）作为动量耗尽或延续信号进行交易。当检测到可配置数量的同方向连续K线时入场，旨在利用短期过度延伸或趋势持续性获利。策略包含基本的止损和止盈风险管理。
EA-20000.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于K线连击形态识别，即当出现N根连续的同色K线（全部看涨或全部看跌）时视为交易信号。入场条件为：当检测到指定数量的连续看涨K线时做空（假设动量耗尽），或检测到指定数量的连续看跌K线时做多（假设超卖反弹），也可选择顺势入场。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈设置，可能还包含K线形态反转的动态出场逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，止损和止盈的比例关系决定了单笔风险回报比，但该策略缺乏对整体账户风险的动态控制。该EA的核心假设是连续K线代表市场极端状态，随时可能回归或突破，但这种假设在不同市场条件下表现差异极大。
EA-20000.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on consecutive candle streak identification, treating N same-direction candles in a row as a trading signal. Entry conditions: the EA enters a short position when N consecutive bullish candles are detected (assuming momentum exhaustion) or a long position when N consecutive bearish candles are detected (assuming oversold bounce), with an option for trend-following entries instead. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels, potentially supplemented by candlestick pattern reversal exit logic. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or an equity percentage-based calculation. Money management is governed by the stop loss to take profit ratio which determines the risk-reward profile per trade, but the strategy lacks dynamic account-level risk control. The core assumption is that consecutive candles represent market extremes prone to reversal or breakout, but this assumption performs very differently across varying market conditions.

EA-20002.name: GetM1Data v2
EA-20002.summary: This EA is a data extraction utility that collects and exports M1 (1-minute) bar data from MetaTrader 5. It does not open any trades but instead gathers historical or live minute-level OHLCV data for external analysis or backtesting purposes.
EA-20002.summary_zh: 该EA是一款数据提取工具，用于从MetaTrader 5中收集和导出M1（1分钟）K线数据。它不执行任何交易操作，而是采集历史或实时的分钟级OHLCV数据，供外部分析或回测使用。
EA-20002.strategy_analysis: 该EA本质上是一个数据采集工具而非交易策略。它通过遍历M1时间周期的K线数据，提取开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价和成交量等信息。入场和出场条件在此不适用，因为该EA不进行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理同样不适用。其主要功能是将采集到的M1数据以某种格式（如CSV或自定义格式）输出，便于交易者在其他平台或工具中进行量化分析。该工具对于需要高质量逐笔数据进行策略开发的交易者非常有价值。
EA-20002.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is fundamentally a data collection tool rather than a trading strategy. It iterates through M1 timeframe bar data to extract open, high, low, close, and volume information. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute any trades. Position sizing and money management are also not applicable. Its primary function is to output the collected M1 data in a structured format (such as CSV) for traders to perform quantitative analysis on external platforms. This tool is valuable for strategy developers who require high-quality minute-level data for backtesting and research. The utility nature means it focuses on data accuracy and export reliability rather than market timing.

EA-20010.name: MACD EA
EA-20010.summary: This EA trades based on MACD crossover signals, entering long positions when MACD crosses above its signal line and entering short positions when MACD crosses below. It uses configurable lot sizing and stop loss/take profit levels for risk management. The strategy is a classic momentum-following approach relying on MACD histogram and signal line interactions.
EA-20010.summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD交叉信号进行交易，当MACD向上穿越信号线时做多，向下穿越信号线时做空。它使用可配置的手数和止损/止盈水平进行风险管理。该策略是经典的动量跟踪方法，依赖MACD柱状图和信号线的交互。
EA-20010.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的MACD动量交叉策略，核心概念是利用MACD指标的金叉和死叉来判断市场趋势方向。入场条件为MACD主线与信号线发生交叉——金叉做多，死叉做空。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈参数，也可能在反向交叉信号出现时平仓。仓位管理使用固定手数方式，用户通过InpLotSize参数设定每笔交易的手数。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损参数来控制单笔亏损上限，但未见基于账户余额的动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-20010.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic MACD momentum crossover strategy, with the core concept of using MACD golden cross and death cross signals to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions are based on MACD main line crossing the signal line — golden cross for long entries, death cross for short entries. Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit parameters, and may also close positions when an opposing crossover signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user sets the lot size through the InpLotSize parameter. Money management includes a stop loss parameter to cap per-trade losses, but lacks dynamic position sizing based on account equity or balance. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, but is prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

MACD滞后性导致入场不及时，止损可能频繁触发
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar leading to overexposure
Fixed lot size cannot adapt to different account sizes, risk may be too high for small accounts
MACD lag causes delayed entries, stop losses may be frequently triggered

EA-20074.name: Patterns_EA
EA-20074.summary: Patterns_EA is an Expert Advisor that detects classic Japanese candlestick patterns (such as Engulfing, Hammer, Doji, etc.) and automatically enters trades based on those pattern signals. It applies technical confirmation filters to reduce false signals and manages open positions with stop-loss and take-profit levels. The EA operates systematically, scanning for pattern formations on each new bar and executing trades without manual intervention.
EA-20074.summary_zh: Patterns_EA是一个基于经典日本K线形态（如吞没形态、锤子线、十字星等）自动识别并开仓交易的Expert Advisor。它通过技术确认过滤器减少假信号，并使用止损和止盈管理持仓。该EA系统化运行，在每个新K线形成时扫描形态并自动执行交易。
EA-20074.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是识别经典的日本K线形态，如看涨/看跌吞没形态、锤子线、倒锤子线、晨星/暮星等反转信号。入场条件为：当EA检测到有效的K线形态完成后，结合可选的趋势过滤器（如移动平均线方向）确认，在形态确认后的下一根K线开盘时入场。出场条件包括固定止损止盈、形态失效止损以及可选的移动止损。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算手数方式。资金管理方面，EA提供风险百分比参数控制每笔交易的最大亏损比例，并设有最大持仓数量限制以防止过度暴露。该策略的优势在于K线形态是经过长期验证的价格行为信号，具有直观的市场心理含义，但劣势是K线形态在震荡市中容易产生大量假信号，需要趋势过滤器的配合使用。
EA-20074.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is to identify classic Japanese candlestick patterns such as bullish/bearish engulfing, hammer, inverted hammer, morning/evening star and other reversal signals. Entry conditions: when the EA detects a valid completed candlestick pattern, it optionally confirms with a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) before entering on the next bar's open. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit, pattern-invalidation stops, and an optional trailing stop. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage-based lot calculation derived from account balance. Money management incorporates a risk percentage parameter to control the maximum loss per trade, along with a maximum open positions limit to prevent overexposure. The strategy's strength lies in candlestick patterns being time-tested price action signals with intuitive market psychology meaning, but its weakness is that candlestick patterns generate many false signals in ranging markets, requiring trend filter cooperation for reliable performance.
pros: 基于经典K线形态，策略逻辑透明且经过长期市场验证
提供趋势过滤器有效减少震荡行情中的假信号
具备完整的风险管理机制，包括止损止盈和最大持仓限制
参数设计灵活，支持固定手数和风险百分比两种仓位模式
支持多种K线形态识别，策略覆盖面广
pros_en: Based on classic candlestick patterns with transparent strategy logic verified over decades of market data
Trend filter effectively reduces false signals in ranging/sideways markets
Complete risk management mechanism including stop-loss, take-profit, and maximum position limits
Flexible parameter design supporting both fixed lot and risk-percentage position sizing modes
Supports multiple candlestick pattern recognition providing broad strategy coverage
cons: K线形态在震荡市中仍可能产生较多假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏市场波动率(如ATR)自适应机制，止损止盈为固定点数不够灵活
未包含点差过滤，在小周期或高点差品种上可能不利
形态识别依赖单根或少量K线，缺少多周期确认提高可靠性
未实现交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利成交
cons_en: Candlestick patterns can still generate excessive false signals in choppy/ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks ATR-based adaptive mechanism; fixed pip stop-loss and take-profit are inflexible across different volatility regimes
No spread filter included, potentially disadvantageous on lower timeframes or high-spread instruments
Pattern recognition relies on single or few candles, missing multi-timeframe confirmation for improved reliability
No trading session filter implemented, potentially causing unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整出场水平
添加多时间框架确认机制，在更高周期趋势方向一致时才开仓
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免高成本和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that automatically adjusts exit levels based on market volatility
Add multi-timeframe confirmation requiring higher-timeframe trend alignment before entering positions
Implement spread filter and trading session filter to avoid high-cost and low-liquidity period trading

risk_points: 固定止损止盈在极端波动行情中可能不足，存在单笔亏损超出预期的风险
K线形态信号在无趋势行情中频繁触发可能导致连续小额亏损累积
缺乏点差过滤器在高点差环境下可能导致实盘滑点成本显著增加
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss and take-profit may be insufficient during extreme volatility, risking larger-than-expected single-trade losses
Candlestick pattern signals fire frequently in trendless markets, potentially accumulating consecutive small losses
Lack of spread filter can cause significant real-world slippage cost increase in high-spread environments

EA-20087.name: OpenTime
EA-20087.summary: OpenTime is a session-based EA that executes trades at specific market open times, capitalizing on the volatility and momentum that typically occur at the start of major trading sessions. It places pending orders or market orders at predetermined times aligned with session openings such as London or New York. The EA relies on time-based entry logic rather than traditional technical indicators.
EA-20087.summary_zh: OpenTime是一个基于时段的EA，在特定市场开盘时间执行交易，利用主要交易时段开盘时通常出现的波动性和动量。它在与伦敦或纽约等时段开盘对齐的预定时间放置挂单或市价单。该EA依赖基于时间的入场逻辑，而非传统技术指标。
EA-20087.strategy_analysis: OpenTime的策略核心是利用市场开盘时段的高波动性进行交易。入场条件基于固定时间触发，当到达预设的开盘时间点时，EA会自动下单。出场条件通常依赖止损和止盈的设定，部分版本可能包含时间到期平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA通过止损控制单笔风险，但策略高度依赖时段选择的准确性。该策略假设开盘瞬间的方向性波动具有统计优势，但未使用技术指标进行方向确认，存在盲目入场的风险。
EA-20087.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of OpenTime leverages high volatility during market session opening times. Entry conditions are triggered by fixed time schedules, where the EA automatically places orders when the preset session open time is reached. Exit conditions typically rely on stop loss and take profit settings, with some versions including time-based forced closure logic. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or account-balance-proportional calculation methods. Money management is handled through stop loss to control per-trade risk, but the strategy heavily depends on the accuracy of session timing selection. The strategy assumes that directional volatility at session opens provides a statistical edge, but the absence of technical indicator confirmation for trade direction introduces the risk of blind entries.

策略逻辑简单清晰，执行规则明确，便于回测和优化
避免了长时间持仓的风险，交易时间窗口有限，资金利用效率较高
时间驱动策略不受指标滞后影响，入场时机精确
pros_en: Capitalizes on high volatility and liquidity advantages at market session opens, which statistically have directional probability edges
Simple and clear strategy logic with explicit execution rules, easy to backtest and optimize
Avoids prolonged position holding risk with limited trading windows, resulting in efficient capital utilization
Time-driven strategy is not affected by indicator lag, providing precise entry timing
cons: 缺乏技术指标确认交易方向，开盘瞬间方向不确定可能导致频繁止损
固定时间入场无法适应不同市场环境，震荡市中开盘突破策略容易失败
挂单可能在剧烈波动时滑点严重，实际成交价与预期偏差大
未包含扩展的加仓或调整逻辑，单次交易失败对整体收益影响较大

Fixed-time entries cannot adapt to different market conditions, open-breakout strategies tend to fail in ranging markets

improvements: 增加技术指标确认（如EMA趋势方向、RSI超买超卖）作为开盘交易的过滤条件，提高入场胜率
加入波动率自适应机制，根据ATR动态调整止损止盈和挂单距离，适应不同市场环境
improvements_en: Add technical indicator confirmation (such as EMA trend direction, RSI overbought/oversold) as filters for session-open trades to improve win rate
Implement volatility-adaptive mechanisms using ATR to dynamically adjust stop loss, take profit, and pending order distances for different market conditions

risk_points: 无技术指标方向确认，开盘方向不确定时可能连续亏损
开盘时段滑点风险较高，尤其在大新闻发布期间实际成交可能严重偏离预期
risk_points_en: No technical indicator direction confirmation, consecutive losses possible when opening direction is uncertain
High slippage risk during session opens, especially during major news releases where actual fills may significantly deviate from expectations

EA-20089.name: SerialMA_EA
EA-20089.summary: SerialMA_EA is a trend-following expert advisor that uses a series of moving averages with different periods to determine trend direction and generate trade signals. It enters long positions when faster MAs cross above slower MAs and enters short positions on the opposite crossover, aiming to capture sustained directional moves. The EA employs serial (multiple) MA alignment as its core logic, filtering entries based on the alignment of several moving average periods.
EA-20089.summary_zh: SerialMA_EA是一个趋势跟踪型EA，使用一系列不同周期的移动平均线来判断趋势方向并生成交易信号。当快速均线向上穿越慢速均线时做多，反向下穿时做空，旨在捕捉持续的方向性行情。该EA的核心逻辑是序列均线排列，通过多条均线的同向排列来过滤入场信号。
EA-20089.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于多条移动平均线的序列排列来判断趋势方向，当短期、中期、长期均线按特定顺序排列时确认趋势成立并入场。入场条件为：做多时要求短期均线在中期均线之上、中期均线在长期均线之上（多头排列），做空则相反（空头排列），部分版本可能加入均线交叉作为触发条件。出场条件通常包括均线排列反转、固定止损止盈、或趋势减弱信号。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，部分参数允许调整仓位大小。资金管理方面，该EA依赖均线排列的可靠性来控制风险，但若缺少明确的止损机制则风险较大。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势行情但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-20089.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the serial alignment of multiple moving averages to determine trend direction, confirming a trend when short-term, medium-term, and long-term MAs align in a specific order. Entry conditions require a bullish alignment (short-term MA above medium-term MA above long-term MA) for long positions and the reverse bearish alignment for short positions; some versions may also use MA crossover as a trigger signal. Exit conditions typically include reversal of the MA alignment pattern, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, or trend weakening signals. Position sizing generally uses fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculations relative to account balance, with some parameters allowing adjustment of trade size. Money management relies on the reliability of MA alignment to control risk, though the absence of explicit stop-loss mechanisms can expose the account to significant drawdown. The overall strategy logic is clear and suitable for trending markets, but it tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging or choppy conditions leading to consecutive losses.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，多条均线排列有效过滤假突破信号
趋势行情中表现良好，能够捕捉中长线趋势的大部分利润
参数可调整性强，用户可根据不同品种和时间周期优化均线参数
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic with multiple MA alignment effectively filtering false breakout signals
Performs well in trending markets, capable of capturing most of the profit from medium to long-term trends
Highly adjustable parameters allow users to optimize MA periods for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号，导致连续亏损和资金回撤
均线系统固有滞后性，入场和出场信号均滞后于价格实际转折点
若未设置止损或止损过宽，单笔亏损可能较大，资金管理风险偏高
cons_en: Frequent false signals in ranging markets lead to consecutive losses and account drawdown
Inherent lag of moving average systems means entry and exit signals are delayed from actual price turning points
Without proper stop-loss or with excessively wide stops, single trade losses can be significant with elevated money management risk
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤器（如ADX或ATR）以在震荡行情中减少虚假信号
加入动态止损机制（如移动止损或基于ATR的止损）以更好地保护利润和控制风险
improvements_en: Add a trend strength filter (such as ADX or ATR) to reduce false signals during ranging market conditions
Implement dynamic stop-loss mechanisms (such as trailing stops or ATR-based stops) to better protect profits and control risk

risk_points: 均线滞后性导致入场延迟，可能在趋势末期才入场从而面临反转风险
若止损参数默认为0则无止损保护，极端行情下可能遭受重大亏损
risk_points_en: MA lag causes delayed entries, potentially entering near trend exhaustion and facing reversal risk
Default stop-loss parameter of 0 means no stop-loss protection, risking significant losses during extreme market moves

EA-20127.name: Fractured Fractals
EA-20127.summary: This EA trades fractal breakout patterns, entering positions when price breaks above or below Bill Williams' fractal levels. It uses fractal highs and lows as dynamic support/resistance zones and executes trades on confirmed breakouts with built-in stop loss and take profit management.
EA-20127.summary_zh: 该EA基于分形突破模式交易，当价格突破比尔·威廉姆斯分形的高点或低点时入场。它使用分形高低点作为动态支撑阻力区域，在确认突破后执行交易，并内置止损和止盈管理。
EA-20127.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于比尔·威廉姆斯分形指标，识别局部高点或低点作为关键支撑阻力位。入场条件为价格向上突破前一分形高点时做多，向下突破前一分形低点时做空，属于经典突破策略。出场条件依赖预设的止损止盈比例，止损设在分形另一侧，止盈根据风险回报比设定。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，策略依赖分形结构的有效性，但缺乏对虚假突破的过滤机制，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-20127.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bill Williams' Fractal indicator, identifying local highs and lows as key support and resistance levels. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above a previous fractal high and a sell when price breaks below a previous fractal low, constituting a classic breakout approach. Exit conditions rely on predefined stop loss and take profit ratios, with stops placed on the opposite side of the fractal and take profit set according to a risk-reward ratio. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or account-balance-based proportional calculation. Money management depends on the validity of fractal structures, but the strategy lacks a false breakout filter mechanism, making it prone to frequent whipsaw signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets.

pros_en: Fractal breakout logic is clear and based on classic technical analysis theory, easy to understand and verify

加入成交量确认或K线形态确认机制，提高突破信号的有效性和胜率
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or moving average direction) to trade fractal breakouts only in confirmed trends, reducing false signals in ranging markets
Incorporate volume confirmation or candlestick pattern confirmation to improve signal validity and win rate

Fractal signal lag may result in suboptimal entry prices

EA-20132.name: BHS system
EA-20132.summary: The BHS system EA is a trend-following expert advisor that identifies market direction using a combination of moving averages and momentum indicators, entering trades when trend conditions align. It manages positions with defined stop loss and take profit levels while applying trailing stop functionality to protect profits as the trend progresses. The system operates systematically on higher timeframes to capture sustained directional moves.
EA-20132.summary_zh: BHS系统EA是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，通过移动平均线和动量指标的组合来判断市场方向，在趋势条件一致时入场交易。它使用预定义的止损和止盈水平管理仓位，并应用移动止损功能在趋势延续时保护利润。该系统在较高时间周期上系统化运行以捕捉持续的方向性走势。
EA-20132.strategy_analysis: BHS系统采用多重移动平均线交叉和动量确认的趋势跟踪策略，当短期均线上穿长期均线且动量指标支持方向时开仓做多，反之开仓做空。入场条件要求趋势方向与动量方向一致，避免在震荡行情中频繁交易。出场条件包括固定的止损止盈以及移动止损机制，当价格向有利方向移动时自动调整止损位锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算，确保每笔交易的风险可控。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和回撤保护，防止单一趋势判断失误造成过大损失。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在趋势反转点可能存在较大回撤风险。
EA-20132.strategy_analysis_en: The BHS system employs a multi-moving average crossover strategy with momentum confirmation, entering long positions when the short-term MA crosses above the long-term MA and momentum indicators support the directional bias, and vice versa for short positions. Entry conditions require alignment between the trend direction and momentum readings to avoid excessive trading in ranging markets. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels along with a trailing stop mechanism that automatically adjusts the stop level as price moves favorably to lock in profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-based calculation tied to account balance, ensuring controlled risk per trade. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and drawdown protection to prevent oversized losses from a single erroneous trend assessment. The overall strategy logic is clear, but significant drawdowns can occur at trend reversal points where the system remains committed to the fading trend.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰，趋势跟踪理念成熟，适合趋势明显的市场环境
使用多重确认机制减少虚假信号，均线交叉加动量过滤提高入场质量
移动止损机制有效保护浮动利润，降低盈利回吐风险
参数可调性强，交易者可根据不同品种和时间周期灵活优化
设有最大持仓限制，防止过度开仓导致风险失控
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on well-established trend following principles, suitable for markets with strong directional movement
Multi-confirmation mechanism reduces false signals by combining MA crossover with momentum filtering for higher quality entries
Trailing stop mechanism effectively protects floating profits and reduces the risk of giving back gains
Highly configurable parameters allow traders to flexibly optimize for different instruments and timeframes
Maximum position limits prevent overtrading and keep risk under control
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生连续亏损，缺乏区间识别和自适应机制
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动期可能止损过窄，低波动期止盈过远

EA-20148.name: Ichimoku
EA-20148.summary: This EA trades based on the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator system, using the interaction of the Tenkan-sen, Kijun-sen, Senkou Span A, and Senkou Span B to identify trend direction and generate entry signals. It enters long positions when price is above the cloud and the Tenkan-sen crosses above the Kijun-sen, and enters short positions under the opposite conditions. The EA manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels derived from the Ichimoku components.
EA-20148.summary_zh: 该EA基于一目均衡表（Ichimoku Kinko Hyo）指标系统进行交易，利用转换线、基准线、先行带A和先行带B的相互关系来判断趋势方向并生成入场信号。当价格位于云层上方且转换线上穿基准线时做多，在相反条件下做空。EA通过基于一目均衡表组件的可配置止损和止盈水平来管理仓位。
EA-20148.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于一目均衡表（Ichimoku Kinko Hyo）这一经典的日本技术分析系统。入场条件为：做多时要求价格位于云层（Kumo）上方，且Tenkan-sen（转换线）向上穿越Kijun-sen（基准线），形成看涨交叉；做空时要求价格位于云层下方，且Tenkan-sen向下穿越Kijun-sen，形成看跌交叉。云层的颜色和厚度也被用作趋势强度和支撑阻力的判断依据。出场条件包括止损和止盈的设定，通常止损设于云层的另一侧，止盈则基于风险回报比或Chikou Span（迟行线）的确认。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比进行计算，允许用户自定义交易量。资金管理方面，EA提供可配置的止损距离和最大持仓限制，但缺乏动态仓位调整机制如ATR-based止损。
EA-20148.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo system, a classic Japanese technical analysis framework. Entry conditions require price to be above the Kumo (cloud) with the Tenkan-sen crossing above the Kijun-sen for long positions, and price below the cloud with the Tenkan-sen crossing below the Kijun-sen for short positions. The cloud's color and thickness serve as additional confirmations for trend strength and support/resistance levels. Exit conditions include stop loss placement typically on the opposite side of the cloud and take profit based on risk-reward ratios or Chikou Span confirmation. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach or percentage-of-balance method with user-configurable trade volume. Money management provides configurable stop loss distances and maximum position limits, but lacks dynamic position sizing mechanisms such as ATR-based stops or volatility-adjusted lot calculations.
