improvements: 增加自适应时间周期选择机制，根据市场波动自动调整确认周期
引入动态止损止盈机制，基于ATR或市场波动性自动调整出场参数
improvements_en: Add an adaptive timeframe selection mechanism that automatically adjusts confirmation periods based on market volatility
Introduce dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms that automatically adjust exit parameters based on ATR or market volatility

自定义指标Ang_Zad_C的稳定性未经充分验证，可能在极端行情下失效

risk_points_en: Multi-timeframe confirmation delay may cause entries at trend exhaustion, increasing reversal risk

EA-21440.name: Return Strategy
EA-21440.summary: This EA implements a mean reversion strategy that enters trades when price deviates significantly from a central moving average or equilibrium level, expecting a return to the mean. It identifies overextended market conditions and places counter-trend trades with defined take-profit targets at or near the mean. The strategy includes basic risk management with stop-loss and lot sizing controls.
EA-21440.summary_zh: 该EA实现均值回归策略，当价格显著偏离中心移动平均线或均衡水平时入场交易，预期价格将回归均值。它识别过度延伸的市场条件，并在均值附近设置反趋势交易和明确的获利目标。策略包含基本的止损和手数控制风险管理。
EA-21440.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于均值回归原理，假设价格偏离均值后会回归。入场条件通常是价格触及布林带外轨或偏离移动平均线超过设定的阈值倍数后开反向仓。出场条件包括价格回归到均值线时止盈，以及止损设在偏离更远处作为保护。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面设有最大持仓限制和单笔风险控制。整体策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在趋势行情中可能连续亏损。
EA-21440.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the mean reversion principle, assuming that price will return to the mean after deviating from it. Entry conditions typically involve price reaching Bollinger Band outer bands or deviating beyond a set threshold multiple from the moving average, then opening a counter-trend position. Exit conditions include take-profit when price returns to the mean line, and stop-loss placed further out as protection. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or equity-proportional lot calculation. Money management includes maximum position limits and per-trade risk controls. The overall strategy performs well in ranging markets but may incur consecutive losses during trending conditions.

EA-21452.name: ZigZag EA
EA-21452.summary: This EA uses the ZigZag indicator to identify trend reversal points and opens trades in the direction of the newly formed trend. It enters positions when a new ZigZag leg is confirmed and exits based on opposite signals or fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels. The strategy aims to capture medium-to-long-term trend swings by following the ZigZag pivot points.
EA-21452.summary_zh: 该EA利用ZigZag指标识别趋势反转点，并在新趋势方向上开仓交易。当新的ZigZag波段确认后入场，根据反向信号或固定止盈止损出场。策略旨在通过跟随ZigZag拐点来捕捉中长线趋势波段。
EA-21452.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于ZigZag指标识别市场的高点和低点拐点，在趋势方向确认后入场交易。入场条件为当ZigZag指标确认新的波峰或波谷形成时，在趋势延续方向开仓——波谷形成后做多，波峰形成后做空。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损，以及当ZigZag指标形成反向拐点时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA可能支持固定手数或基于资金比例的动态仓位计算。资金管理依赖于止损距离和账户余额来确定每笔交易的风险敞口。策略假设ZigZag拐点标记了趋势的真实反转，但需注意ZigZag指标具有重绘特性，已确认的拐点可能随价格变化而移动，这给实盘交易带来不确定性。
EA-21452.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the ZigZag indicator to identify market swing highs and lows, entering trades after trend direction confirmation. Entry conditions trigger when the ZigZag indicator confirms a new peak or trough formation — going long after a trough and short after a peak. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, as well as closing positions when the ZigZag forms an opposite pivot point. Position sizing may support fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management relies on stop-loss distance and account balance to determine risk exposure per trade. The strategy assumes ZigZag pivot points mark genuine trend reversals, but it is important to note that the ZigZag indicator has repainting characteristics, meaning confirmed pivots may shift as price evolves, introducing uncertainty in live trading.

EA-21457.name: Breakdown
EA-21457.summary: This EA implements a breakdown/breakout strategy that enters trades when price breaks through predefined support or resistance levels. It identifies key price levels and opens positions in the direction of the breakout, aiming to capture momentum-driven moves after price escapes a consolidation range.
EA-21457.summary_zh: 该EA实现了突破策略，当价格突破预设的支撑或阻力位时入场交易。它识别关键价格水平并在突破方向开仓，旨在捕捉价格脱离盘整区间后的动量行情。
EA-21457.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是突破交易，通过识别关键支撑和阻力水平，在价格突破这些水平时顺势入场。入场条件为价格收盘突破前期高点或低点，确认突破有效性后开仓做多或做空。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及可选的追踪止损，锁定利润同时控制风险。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态计算方式，允许用户调整风险敞口。资金管理方面提供风险比例设置，但缺乏对最大持仓和连续亏损的系统性控制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但突破确认机制较为简单，可能出现假突破导致的频繁止损。
EA-21457.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is breakout trading, entering positions when price breaks through identified support and resistance levels. Entry conditions trigger when price closes above a prior swing high for longs or below a swing low for shorts, confirming the breakout before opening a position. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with an optional trailing stop to lock in profits while controlling downside risk. Position sizing supports both fixed lot sizes and dynamic calculation based on account equity, allowing users to adjust their risk exposure. Money management provides risk percentage settings but lacks systematic controls for maximum concurrent positions and consecutive loss limits. The overall strategy logic is clear, but the breakout confirmation mechanism is relatively simple, which may lead to frequent stop-outs from false breakouts.

EA-21495.name: 3SMA
EA-21495.summary: This EA uses three Simple Moving Averages (SMA) of different periods to determine trend direction and generate trading signals. It typically enters long when the fast SMA is above the medium SMA which is above the slow SMA, and short when the reverse alignment occurs. Exits are triggered when the SMA alignment breaks or crosses in the opposite direction.
EA-21495.summary_zh: 该EA使用三条不同周期的简单移动平均线(SMA)来判断趋势方向并生成交易信号。通常在快线在中线之上、中线在慢线之上时做多，反之做空。当SMA排列被打乱或反向交叉时触发出场。
EA-21495.strategy_analysis: 3SMA策略的核心概念是通过三条不同周期的简单移动平均线（短期、中期、长期）的排列顺序来判断市场趋势的方向和强度。入场条件为：当三条SMA呈现多头排列（短>中>长）时开多单，呈现空头排列（短<中<长）时开空单。出场条件通常为SMA排列被打乱，即短期均线上穿或下穿中期均线时平仓。仓位管理一般采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算手数。资金管理方面，该EA可能包含止损和止盈设置，但具体的止损止盈逻辑依赖于参数配置。该策略的优点是逻辑简单清晰，能有效捕捉中长期趋势，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和反复亏损。
EA-21495.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the 3SMA strategy is to determine market trend direction and strength through the alignment order of three Simple Moving Averages with different periods (short-term, medium-term, long-term). Entry conditions are: open long when the three SMAs show bullish alignment (short > medium > long), and open short when they show bearish alignment (short < medium < long). Exit conditions are typically triggered when the SMA alignment is broken, i.e., when the short-term MA crosses the medium-term MA in the opposite direction. Position sizing generally uses fixed lots or calculates lot size based on a percentage of account balance. Money management may include stop-loss and take-profit settings, but the specific SL/TP logic depends on parameter configuration. The strategy's strength is its simple and clear logic that can effectively capture medium to long-term trends, but it is prone to frequent false signals and repeated losses in ranging markets.

EA-21499.name: One MA EA
EA-21499.summary: This EA trades based on a single Moving Average indicator, opening buy positions when price crosses above the MA and sell positions when price crosses below. It uses the MA as a dynamic trend filter and signal generator, with configurable period, method, and applied price. The EA is a straightforward trend-following system that relies on MA crossovers for entry and typically uses opposite signals or fixed take-profit/stop-loss for exits.
EA-21499.summary_zh: 该EA基于单一移动平均线指标进行交易，当价格上穿MA时开多单，下穿时开空单。它将MA作为动态趋势过滤器和信号生成器，可配置周期、方法和应用价格。这是一个简单直接的趋势跟踪系统，依赖MA交叉作为入场信号，通常使用反向信号或固定止盈止损出场。
EA-21499.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用单一移动平均线作为趋势判断的核心指标，策略概念非常简洁——价格位于MA之上视为上升趋势做多，价格位于MA之下视为下降趋势做空。入场条件通常为价格与MA的交叉：收盘价上穿MA时开多仓，收盘价下穿MA时开空仓。出场条件可能包括反向交叉信号平仓、固定止盈止损，或者两者结合使用。仓位管理方面，该EA通常使用固定手数交易，缺乏基于波动率或账户风险的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为基础，可能仅依赖止损来控制单笔亏损，没有额外的资金管理规则如最大回撤限制或连续亏损后的仓位缩减。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为单一，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-21499.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses a single Moving Average as the core indicator for trend determination, with a straightforward strategy concept—price above the MA is considered an uptrend for buying, and price below the MA is considered a downtrend for selling. Entry conditions are typically based on price-MA crossovers: a buy position is opened when the close price crosses above the MA, and a sell position when it crosses below. Exit conditions may include closing on opposite crossover signals, fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or a combination of both. Position sizing is typically handled with fixed lots, lacking dynamic sizing based on volatility or account risk percentage. Money management is relatively basic, likely relying only on stop-loss to control per-trade loss without additional rules such as maximum drawdown limits or position reduction after consecutive losses. The overall strategy logic is clear but simplistic, making it prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during choppy or ranging market conditions.

EA-21511.name: CCI and Martin
EA-21511.summary: This EA uses the CCI (Commodity Channel Index) indicator to generate trade signals and applies a Martingale position sizing strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade. It opens buy positions when CCI is oversold and sell positions when CCI is overbought, relying on eventual mean reversion to recover losses. The Martingale approach makes it inherently high-risk, as a prolonged losing streak can rapidly deplete the account.
EA-21511.summary_zh: 该EA使用CCI（商品通道指标）生成交易信号，并采用马丁格尔仓位管理策略，在每次亏损后加倍仓位。它在CCI超卖时开多单，在CCI超买时开空单，依赖价格的均值回归来挽回损失。马丁格尔策略使其风险极高，连续亏损可能迅速耗尽账户资金。
EA-21511.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于CCI指标的均值回归信号与马丁格尔资金管理的结合。入场条件为CCI指标进入超卖区域（通常低于-100）时开多单，CCI进入超买区域（通常高于+100）时开空单。出场条件依赖于止盈目标，当持仓盈利达到预设目标时平仓。仓位管理采用经典马丁格尔策略，每次交易亏损后将下一单的手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利覆盖之前所有亏损。资金管理方面，初始手数较小，但随亏损次数增加手数呈指数增长，没有设定最大加倍次数限制。该策略在震荡行情中可能有效，但在单边趋势行情中连续亏损将导致仓位急剧放大，面临爆仓风险。
EA-21511.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept combines CCI-based mean reversion signals with a Martingale money management system. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the CCI indicator enters oversold territory (typically below -100) and a sell when CCI enters overbought territory (typically above +100). Exit conditions rely on a take-profit target, closing positions when a preset profit level is reached. Position sizing follows the classic Martingale approach, doubling the lot size after each consecutive loss in an attempt to recover all previous losses with a single win. Money management starts with a small initial lot size, but positions grow exponentially with each loss, and there is typically no hard cap on the number of doublings. This strategy may work in ranging markets but faces catastrophic drawdown risk in trending markets where consecutive losses cause position sizes to escalate uncontrollably.

pros_en: CCI is a well-established overbought/oversold indicator with clear and interpretable signal logic

EA-21515.name: Crossing Moving Average
EA-21515.summary: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy, generating buy signals when a fast moving average crosses above a slow moving average and sell signals when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. It is a classic trend-following system that aims to capture directional moves by entering trades on confirmed crossover events. The EA typically includes configurable MA periods and lot sizing parameters.
EA-21515.summary_zh: 该EA实现了双均线交叉策略，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时产生买入信号，快速均线下穿慢速均线时产生卖出信号。这是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统，旨在通过在确认的交叉事件上进场来捕捉方向性行情。EA通常包含可配置的均线周期和手数参数。
EA-21515.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于双移动平均线交叉的核心概念，利用短期均线和长期均线的交叉来判断趋势方向的变化。入场条件为快速均线从下方穿越慢速均线时做多，快速均线从上方穿越慢速均线时做空，这本质上是捕捉趋势启动的信号。出场条件通常是在反向交叉信号出现时平仓并反向开仓，意味着该策略始终在场，没有空仓等待期。仓位管理方面，该EA通常使用固定手数交易，没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态仓位调整。资金管理较为简单，缺乏止盈止损的精细化设置，完全依赖反向信号来退出头寸。整体而言，这是一个基础的趋势跟踪策略，逻辑清晰但缺乏风险管理的深度设计。
EA-21515.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on the core concept of dual moving average crossover, using the crossing of short-term and long-term moving averages to identify changes in trend direction. Entry conditions are: go long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA from below, and go short when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA from above, which essentially captures the initiation of new trends. Exit conditions typically involve closing the current position and opening a reverse position when an opposite crossover signal appears, meaning the strategy is always in the market with no flat periods. Position sizing usually employs fixed lot sizes without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is relatively simplistic, lacking refined take-profit and stop-loss settings, relying entirely on reverse signals to exit positions. Overall, this is a basic trend-following strategy with clear logic but lacking depth in risk management design.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
趋势行情中能够有效捕捉大波段利润
参数少，过拟合风险相对较低
始终在场，不会错过重大趋势行情
双均线交叉是经过长期验证的经典策略框架
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and verify

Always in the market, never misses major trend moves

cons_en: Frequent false signals in ranging/sideways markets leading to consecutive losses

Lack of stop-loss mechanism may result in excessive single-trade losses
Fixed lot sizing does not consider account risk proportion management

improvements: 添加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中减少交易频率
引入动态止损和移动止损机制，保护已有利润
实现基于ATR的动态仓位管理，根据市场波动调整风险敞口
增加新K线检查机制，避免在同一根K线上重复开仓
考虑加入多时间框架确认，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to reduce trading frequency in ranging markets
Implement dynamic and trailing stop-loss mechanisms to protect profits

均线滞后性导致在趋势反转时回吐大量利润

Lack of stop-loss protection may lead to significant single-trade losses

EA-21523.name: Separate trade
EA-21523.summary: This EA implements a scalping strategy that opens separate buy and sell trades based on fast price movement signals, likely using short-term momentum or price deviation from a mean. It targets small profits per trade with tight take-profit levels, typical of a scalping approach on lower timeframes.
EA-21523.summary_zh: 该EA实现了一种剥头皮策略，基于短期价格运动信号分别开立买单和卖单。每次交易目标利润较小，采用紧止盈设置，是典型的低时间框架剥头皮交易方式。
EA-21523.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于短期价格偏离或动量信号进行剥头皮交易。入场条件可能依赖于价格相对于某个基准（如移动平均线）的偏离程度，当偏离超过阈值时入场，预期价格回归或继续沿动量方向运动。出场条件设置了固定的止盈和止损水平，止盈较小以快速锁定利润。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金的简单计算方式，没有复杂的动态仓位调整。资金管理方面缺乏对账户整体风险的统筹考虑，没有最大回撤限制或账户权益保护机制。策略的核心风险在于剥头皮交易对点差和滑点极其敏感，在没有点差过滤的情况下可能导致频繁的虚假信号触发。
EA-21523.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on scalping using short-term price deviation or momentum signals. Entry conditions likely rely on the degree of price deviation from a baseline (such as a moving average), entering when deviation exceeds a threshold in expectation of either mean reversion or momentum continuation. Exit conditions use fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with small take-profit to quickly lock in gains. Position sizing employs fixed lots or a simple account-balance-based calculation without sophisticated dynamic adjustment. Money management lacks holistic account risk consideration, with no maximum drawdown limit or equity protection mechanism. The core risk lies in scalping's extreme sensitivity to spread and slippage, which without a spread filter can lead to frequent false signal triggers and net losses even on nominally winning trades.

EA-21539.name: Exp_XPeriodCandleSystem_Tm_Plus
EA-21539.summary: This EA trades based on the XPeriodCandleSystem, which generates candlestick signals across multiple periods using custom candle period aggregation. It incorporates a time filter (Tm) to restrict trading to specific sessions and a Plus module for additional signal confirmation or filtering, entering positions when the composite candle pattern aligns with the trading direction.
EA-21539.summary_zh: 该EA基于XPeriodCandleSystem多周期K线形态系统进行交易，通过自定义K线周期聚合生成信号，并结合时间过滤器(Tm)限制交易时段，Plus模块提供额外的信号确认或过滤，当复合K线形态与交易方向一致时开仓。
EA-21539.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于XPeriodCandleSystem，该系统将价格数据聚合为自定义周期的K线，然后识别看涨或看跌的K线形态模式作为交易信号。入场条件为当自定义周期K线形成明确的看涨形态时做多，看跌形态时做空，同时Plus模块可能提供额外的确认条件（如趋势方向一致性、波动率过滤等）。出场条件依赖止损和止盈参数设置，可能还包括反向K线形态信号作为平仓依据。仓位管理通过手数参数控制每笔交易的大小，可能支持固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，EA提供了时间过滤器限制交易在特定时段进行，有助于避开低流动性或高波动时段，减少滑点和假信号风险。整体策略是典型的多周期K线形态识别交易系统，依赖形态的可靠性进行方向性交易。
EA-21539.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the XPeriodCandleSystem, which aggregates price data into custom-period candles and then identifies bullish or bearish candlestick patterns as trading signals. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the custom-period candle forms a clear bullish pattern and a short position on bearish patterns, with the Plus module potentially providing additional confirmation such as trend direction consistency or volatility filtering. Exit conditions rely on stop loss and take profit parameter settings, and may also include reverse candle pattern signals as a closing basis. Position sizing is controlled through lot size parameters, potentially supporting fixed lots or equity-based dynamic lot calculation. Money management incorporates a time filter that restricts trading to specific sessions, helping avoid low liquidity or high volatility periods that increase slippage and false signal risks. The overall strategy is a typical multi-period candlestick pattern recognition trading system that relies on pattern reliability for directional trades.

EA-21540.name: Exp_AbsolutelyNoLagLwma_Range_Channel_Tm_Plus
EA-21540.summary: This EA trades breakouts from a range channel built on an AbsolutelyNoLagLWMA (zero-lag linear weighted moving average) with upper and lower band offsets. It includes time filtering to restrict trading to specific sessions and a 'Plus' module for additional trade management features such as trailing stops or breakeven logic.
EA-21540.summary_zh: 该EA基于AbsolutelyNoLagLWMA（零滞后线性加权均线）构建的区间通道进行突破交易，上下轨通过偏移量计算。内置时间过滤器限制交易时段，Plus模块提供额外的交易管理功能如移动止损或保本逻辑。
EA-21540.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是利用AbsolutelyNoLagLWMA消除传统均线的滞后性，以该均线为中轨加上固定偏移构建上下轨形成区间通道。当价格突破上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空，属于典型的通道突破策略。入场条件为价格收盘突破通道边界，出场条件包括反向突破通道、固定止盈止损以及Plus模块的移动止损和保本机制。仓位管理支持手数设置，可能包含基于资金的动态仓位计算。时间过滤器允许用户限定交易时段，避免低流动性时段的假突破。整体策略逻辑清晰，但区间宽度的固定偏移可能在波动率变化时产生不适配问题。
EA-21540.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses AbsolutelyNoLagLWMA to eliminate the lag inherent in traditional moving averages, then constructs upper and lower channel bands by adding fixed offsets to this zero-lag midline. A buy signal is generated when price breaks above the upper band, and a sell signal when price breaks below the lower band, forming a classic channel breakout system. Entry conditions require a candlestick close beyond the channel boundary, while exit conditions include opposite band breakout, fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, and the Plus module's trailing stop and breakeven mechanisms. Position sizing supports manual lot configuration and potentially account-balance-based dynamic lot calculation. The time filter allows users to restrict trading to specific sessions, avoiding false breakouts during low-liquidity periods. The overall logic is clear, but the fixed offset for channel width may become maladaptive when market volatility changes significantly.
pros: 零滞后LWMA减少了信号延迟，入场更及时

EA-21541.name: Exp_CandleStop_System_Tm_Plus
EA-21541.summary: This EA implements a candlestick-based stop/reversal trading system with time filtering (Tm) and additional enhancements (Plus). It identifies specific candlestick patterns to determine entry signals, uses candle-based stop levels for risk management, and applies time session filters to restrict trading to specific periods. The system likely trades reversals or continuations based on candle formation analysis with dynamic stop placement derived from candle extremes.
EA-21541.summary_zh: 该EA实现了一个基于K线形态的止损/反转交易系统，带有时间过滤(Tm)和增强功能(Plus)。它通过识别特定K线形态来确定入场信号，使用基于K线的止损位进行风险管理，并应用时段过滤器限制在特定时间段内交易。系统基于K线形态分析进行反转或顺势交易，止损位动态取自K线极值。
EA-21541.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是基于K线形态识别来捕捉市场反转或趋势延续机会。入场条件依赖于特定K线组合的识别，例如看涨/看跌吞没形态、锤子线或十字星等经典形态，当形态确认后触发交易信号。出场条件采用基于K线极值的动态止损，即止损位设在信号K线的高低点之外，同时可能包含固定止盈目标或跟踪止损机制。仓位管理方面，EA提供手数参数供用户配置，可能支持固定手数或基于风险的动态仓位计算。资金管理通过时间过滤器实现，限制在流动性较好的时段交易以降低滑点和虚假信号风险。Plus增强版可能在基础版本上增加了多时间框架确认、信号过滤指标或更复杂的风控逻辑。
EA-21541.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is based on candlestick pattern recognition to capture market reversal or trend continuation opportunities. Entry conditions rely on identifying specific candlestick formations such as bullish/bearish engulfing patterns, hammer candles, or doji stars, with trade signals triggered upon pattern confirmation. Exit conditions employ dynamic stops derived from candle extremes, placing stop-loss levels beyond the high or low of the signal candle, and may include fixed take-profit targets or trailing stop mechanisms. Position sizing provides configurable lot parameters, potentially supporting fixed lots or risk-based dynamic position calculation. Money management is enhanced through a time filter that restricts trading to sessions with better liquidity, reducing slippage and false signal risk. The Plus enhancement version likely adds multi-timeframe confirmation, signal filtering indicators, or more sophisticated risk control logic on top of the base system.

EA-21557.name: Exp_Rj_SlidingRangeRj_Digit_System_Tm_Plus
EA-21557.summary: This EA trades breakout signals generated by the Sliding Range Rj Digit System indicator, entering positions when price breaks out of a dynamically sliding range. It incorporates a time filter (Tm) to restrict trading to specific sessions and a Plus module for enhanced entry/exit management, combining range-breakout logic with session-based trade filtering.
EA-21557.summary_zh: 该EA基于Sliding Range Rj Digit System指标产生的突破信号进行交易，当价格突破动态滑动区间时入场。它集成了时间过滤器(Tm)限制交易时段，并带有Plus增强模块优化入场和出场管理，将区间突破逻辑与时段过滤相结合。
EA-21557.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于滑动区间突破，通过Sliding Range Rj Digit System指标动态计算价格波动的上下轨区间。当价格突破该区间的上轨时开多单，突破下轨时开空单，属于典型的区间突破策略。入场条件依赖指标信号触发，同时结合Tm时间过滤模块，仅在用户指定的交易时段内允许开仓，避免非活跃时段的虚假突破。出场条件包括固定的止盈止损设置，以及Plus模块提供的移动止损或追踪出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式，默认参数允许用户灵活调整。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数设置，但缺乏动态仓位调整或基于ATR的自适应止损机制，整体风控依赖于用户正确设置参数。
EA-21557.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a sliding range breakout, using the Sliding Range Rj Digit System indicator to dynamically calculate upper and lower bands of price fluctuation. When price breaks above the upper band, a buy order is placed; when it breaks below the lower band, a sell order is opened, following a classic range breakout approach. Entry conditions rely on the indicator signal trigger, combined with the Tm time filter module that only allows trading during user-specified sessions, avoiding false breakouts during inactive market periods. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss settings, along with trailing stop or enhanced exit mechanisms provided by the Plus module. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or balance-based lot calculation, with default parameters allowing flexible user adjustment. Money management relies on user-configured stop-loss and take-profit parameters, but lacks dynamic position sizing or ATR-based adaptive stop mechanisms, leaving overall risk control dependent on proper parameter configuration by the user.
pros: 集成时间过滤器避免非活跃时段虚假突破，减少无效交易
滑动区间动态调整适应市场波动变化，比固定区间更灵活

EA-21558.name: Exp_DEMA_Range_Channel_Tm_Plus
EA-21558.summary: This EA trades breakout entries based on the Double EMA (DEMA) Range Channel indicator, opening positions when price breaks above or below the channel boundaries. It includes a time-based trade management filter (Tm) that restricts trading to specific hours, plus additional risk controls such as trailing stops and breakeven functionality.
EA-21558.summary_zh: 该EA基于双重EMA(DEMA)范围通道指标进行突破交易，当价格突破通道上下边界时开仓。内置基于时间的交易管理过滤器(Tm)，限制仅在特定时段交易，并附带移动止损和保本等附加风控功能。
EA-21558.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于DEMA范围通道的突破交易系统。DEMA相比普通EMA响应更快，通道上下轨构成动态支撑阻力区域。入场条件：价格向上突破通道上轨时做多，向下突破下轨时做空，属于典型的区间突破策略。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、移动止损跟踪和保本止损功能，同时支持基于时间的自动平仓(Tm功能)，可限制交易时段或在指定时间强制平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态仓位计算方式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和每日亏损限额等保护机制，但作为突破策略在震荡市中可能频繁出现虚假突破导致连续止损。
EA-21558.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a breakout trading system based on the DEMA Range Channel. DEMA responds faster than standard EMA, and the channel boundaries form dynamic support and resistance zones. Entry conditions: go long when price breaks above the upper channel, go short when price breaks below the lower channel, representing a classic range breakout approach. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss, trailing stop tracking, and breakeven functionality, along with time-based forced closing (Tm feature) that can restrict trading hours or close positions at specified times. Position sizing supports both fixed lots and dynamic calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management provides maximum position limits and daily loss caps as protective mechanisms, though as a breakout strategy it may suffer frequent false breakouts in ranging markets leading to consecutive stop-losses.

EA-21563.name: Market Capture
EA-21563.summary: Market Capture is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that identifies periods of market consolidation and enters trades when price breaks out of the captured range. It aims to capture significant directional moves following periods of low volatility and range-bound price action, using defined entry and exit rules based on range expansion.
EA-21563.summary_zh: Market Capture是一个基于突破的EA，它识别市场盘整期，并在价格突破所捕获的区间时入场交易。该EA旨在捕捉低波动率和横盘整理后出现的显著方向性行情，使用基于区间扩展的明确入场和出场规则。
EA-21563.strategy_analysis: Market Capture策略的核心概念是捕获市场在盘整期间形成的价格区间，并在突破发生时入场。入场条件基于价格突破先前定义的区间高低点，当价格向上突破区间上轨时做多，向下突破区间下轨时做空。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损或跟踪止损来锁定利润。仓位管理方面，该EA支持手数设置，可能根据账户余额或风险比例进行仓位调整。资金管理方面，通过止损来控制单笔交易风险，但需要关注是否对多重突破进行了过滤以避免假突破。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于经典的区间突破交易方法，但在震荡市中可能面临频繁止损的风险。
EA-21563.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Market Capture strategy is to identify price ranges formed during market consolidation periods and enter trades upon breakout. Entry conditions are based on price breaking above the defined range high for long positions or below the range low for short positions. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or trailing stops to lock in profits as the move develops. Position sizing supports configurable lot sizes and may adjust based on account balance or risk percentage parameters. Money management is handled through stop-loss controls to limit per-trade risk, though the effectiveness of false breakout filtering varies. The overall strategy logic is clear and follows a classic range breakout trading methodology, but it may face frequent stop-outs in choppy, non-trending markets where breakouts fail to sustain directional momentum.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰，区间突破是经过长期验证的经典交易方法
使用固定止损和止盈，风险可控且易于回测验证
跟踪止損功能可以在趋势行情中有效锁定利润

pros_en: Clear and well-defined strategy logic based on the proven range breakout methodology
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit provide defined risk management and easy backtesting
Trailing stop feature effectively locks in profits during trending market conditions
Parameterized design allows traders to optimize settings for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 在震荡市中容易遭遇假突破导致频繁止损，胜率可能较低
区间识别方法可能过于简单，未考虑波动率变化和市场结构
缺乏多重时间框架确认和成交量验证，突破信号可靠性有限
仓位管理可能不够灵活，未支持基于ATR的动态止损止盈
cons_en: Vulnerable to false breakouts in choppy markets leading to frequent stop-outs and low win rate
Range identification method may be overly simplistic without accounting for volatility changes or market structure
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and volume validation, limiting breakout signal reliability
Position sizing may lack flexibility without ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit support
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈和仓位计算，适应不同市场波动率
加入多时间框架确认和成交量过滤，提高突破信号的可靠性
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss, take-profit, and position sizing to adapt to varying market volatility
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation and volume filtering to improve breakout signal reliability

risk_points: 假突破风险：在低波动或震荡市场中可能频繁触发止损

risk_points_en: False breakout risk: frequent stop-loss triggers likely in low-volatility or choppy markets
Fixed stop-loss may not suit all instruments—too wide for low-volatility and too narrow for high-volatility pairs

EA-21595.name: GBP9AM
EA-21595.summary: This EA trades the GBPUSD pair specifically during the 9 AM London session open, exploiting the volatility and directional momentum that often occurs at the start of the London trading session. It enters trades based on price action and momentum signals at the session open time and manages positions with defined stop loss and take profit levels. The strategy is time-restricted and highly specialized for a single currency pair at a specific daily session.
EA-21595.summary_zh: 该EA专门在伦敦时段开盘的上午9点交易GBPUSD货币对，利用伦敦交易时段开始时经常出现的波动性和方向性动量。它根据时段开盘时的价格行为和动量信号入场，并使用设定的止损和止盈管理仓位。该策略是时间受限的，专门针对单一货币对在特定日常时段进行交易。
EA-21595.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于伦敦时段上午9点开盘时的市场波动特征进行交易，利用机构资金流入带来的方向性突破。入场条件通常是在9点时段开始时检测价格突破某个区间或动量指标发出信号，确认方向后入场。出场条件包括固定的止盈和止损水平，部分版本可能包含移动止损或时间止损（如果在时段结束前未达到目标则平仓）。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算，风险参数可调。资金管理方面，该策略依赖时段波动的统计优势，但集中在单一时段和单一货币对上，分散化不足。整体而言，这是一种典型的时段突破策略，逻辑清晰但需要对伦敦开盘的波动特征有深刻理解。
EA-21595.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is trading the London session open at 9 AM, capitalizing on the institutional money flow and volatility spike that frequently occurs as European markets come online. Entry conditions typically involve detecting a price breakout from a pre-session range or momentum confirmation at the 9 AM bar, entering in the direction of the breakout momentum. Exit conditions include fixed take profit and stop loss levels, with some implementations featuring trailing stops or time-based exits that close positions before the session ends if targets are not reached. Position sizing generally uses fixed lot sizes or percentage-based sizing relative to account balance, with configurable risk parameters. Money management relies on the statistical edge of session-opening volatility patterns, but the concentration on a single time window and single currency pair lacks diversification. Overall, this is a classic session breakout strategy with clear logic but requires deep understanding of London open volatility characteristics.

EA-21610.name: Exp_Open_Oscillator_Cloud_MMRec
EA-21610.summary: This EA trades based on oscillator cloud signals, opening positions when the oscillator crosses cloud boundaries indicating overbought or oversold conditions. It uses money management recommendations (MMRec) to dynamically adjust position sizing. The strategy targets reversal points within oscillator extreme zones.
EA-21610.summary_zh: 该EA基于振荡器云图信号进行交易，当振荡器穿越云图边界指示超买或超卖状态时开仓。它使用资金管理建议(MMRec)动态调整仓位大小，策略目标锁定振荡器极端区域内的反转点。
EA-21610.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是均值回归，利用振荡器云图来判断市场的超买超卖状态。入场条件为振荡器突破云图上轨时做空，突破云图下轨时做多，暗示价格将回归均值。出场条件包括触及止盈目标、止损触发或振荡器回归云图中心区域。仓位管理通过MMRec模块根据账户余额和风险参数动态计算最优手数。资金管理方面，EA会根据历史波动率和账户净值比例调整每笔交易的风险敞口。整体策略依赖于振荡器极端读数的回归特性，适合震荡行情但可能在趋势行情中遭受连续亏损。
EA-21610.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is mean reversion, utilizing an oscillator cloud to identify overbought and oversold market conditions. Entry conditions trigger a sell when the oscillator breaks above the cloud upper band and a buy when it breaks below the lower band, implying price will revert to the mean. Exit conditions include hitting take-profit targets, stop-loss triggers, or the oscillator returning to the cloud center zone. Position sizing is dynamically calculated through the MMRec module based on account balance and risk parameters. Money management adjusts risk exposure per trade according to historical volatility and account equity ratio. The overall strategy depends on the mean-reverting property of extreme oscillator readings, performing well in ranging markets but potentially suffering consecutive losses in trending conditions.

EA-21612.name: Exp_wajdyss_Ichimoku_Candle_MMRec
EA-21612.summary: This EA trades based on Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator signals combined with candlestick pattern recognition. It uses money management recommendations (MMRec) to dynamically adjust position sizes. Entries are triggered when price action and Ichimoku cloud alignment confirm a trend direction.
EA-21612.summary_zh: 该EA基于一目均衡表(Ichimoku)指标信号与K线形态识别相结合进行交易。它使用资金管理建议(MMRec)来动态调整仓位大小。当价格行为和一目均衡表云图对齐确认趋势方向时触发入场。
EA-21612.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于一目均衡表(Ichimoku Kinko Hyo)指标，结合K线形态进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件包括：价格突破云图（Kumo）、转换线（Tenkan-sen）与基准线（Kijun-sen）的金叉/死叉、以及K线形态确认方向。多头入场要求价格在云图上方且转换线上穿基准线，同时K线收阳确认；空头反之。出场条件包括：反向交叉信号、价格跌破云图支撑或触及止损/止盈。仓位管理采用MMRec模块，根据账户余额和风险比例动态计算手数，支持固定手数和百分比风险两种模式。资金管理方面，EA内置了止损计算逻辑，根据ATR或固定点数设置止损，并结合风险百分比确定每笔交易的风险金额。
EA-21612.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator combined with candlestick pattern recognition for trend-following trading. Entry conditions include: price breaking through the Kumo (cloud), Tenkan-sen/Kijun-sen crossovers (golden cross/death cross), and candlestick pattern confirmation of direction. Long entry requires price above the cloud with Tenkan-sen crossing above Kijun-sen, confirmed by a bullish candle close; short entry is the reverse. Exit conditions include: reverse crossover signals, price breaking below cloud support, or hitting stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing uses the MMRec (Money Management Recommendation) module, which dynamically calculates lot size based on account balance and risk percentage, supporting both fixed lot and percentage-based risk modes. Money management incorporates stop-loss calculation logic using either ATR-based or fixed-pipstop distances, combined with risk percentage to determine the risk amount per trade.

EA-21616.name: Freeman
EA-21616.summary: Freeman is a trend-following EA that identifies market direction using moving average crossovers and momentum confirmation. It enters trades when trend conditions align across multiple indicators and manages positions with trailing stops. The EA is designed for medium-to-long-term timeframes and aims to capture sustained directional moves.
EA-21616.summary_zh: Freeman是一个趋势跟踪EA，通过均线交叉和动量确认来识别市场方向。当多个指标的趋势条件一致时开仓，并使用移动止损管理仓位。该EA适用于中长周期，旨在捕捉持续的方向性行情。
EA-21616.strategy_analysis: Freeman EA的核心策略是基于趋势跟踪，使用均线系统判断市场主趋势方向。入场条件通常包括快慢均线交叉确认趋势形成，配合动量指标（如RSI或MACD）作为辅助过滤，避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓。出场条件采用移动止损机制，让利润随趋势运行而增长，同时在趋势反转时及时保护已有利润。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理上，EA设置了止损和止盈水平，但具体的风险控制力度取决于参数配置，缺乏最大回撤限制和账户级别的整体风险控制机制。
EA-21616.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Freeman EA is trend following, using a moving average system to determine the primary market direction. Entry conditions typically include fast and slow moving average crossovers to confirm trend formation, supplemented by momentum indicators (such as RSI or MACD) as auxiliary filters to avoid frequent entries during ranging markets. Exit conditions employ a trailing stop mechanism, allowing profits to grow with the trend while protecting accumulated gains when the trend reverses. For position sizing, the EA supports fixed lot trading, with some versions including dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. In terms of money management, the EA sets stop loss and take profit levels, but the specific risk control intensity depends on parameter configuration, lacking maximum drawdown limits and account-level overall risk control mechanisms.
pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，能够捕捉大级别趋势行情获得较高盈亏比

EA-21617.name: Gaps
EA-21617.summary: This EA trades price gaps (window gaps) that occur between candle closes and opens, entering positions in the direction of gap fill expectation. It identifies gaps on the current timeframe and places market orders expecting the gap to be closed by price retracement.
EA-21617.summary_zh: 该EA交易K线之间的价格跳空缺口，在缺口出现后入场，预期价格会回补缺口。它在当前时间周期上识别跳空缺口，并下市价单等待缺口回补获利。
EA-21617.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于价格跳空缺口回补理论，即市场出现跳空缺口后价格倾向于回补缺口。入场条件为检测到当前K线开盘价与前一根K线收盘价之间存在显著缺口，向上缺口做空预期回补，向下缺口做多预期回补。出场条件通常为缺口完全回补时获利了结，或设置止损在缺口另一侧一定距离处。仓位管理一般使用固定手数或基于账户资金的百分比计算。资金管理方面可能包含简单的止损止盈比例控制，但缺乏复杂的资金管理模块。该策略的核心假设是缺口回补的概率较高，但在强趋势中缺口可能不会被回补而导致亏损。
EA-21617.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the gap fill theory, which posits that price tends to retrace and fill gaps that occur between candle closes and opens. Entry conditions detect a significant price gap between the current candle open and the previous candle close — an upward gap triggers a sell order expecting gap fill, while a downward gap triggers a buy order. Exit conditions typically involve take-profit at the gap fill level, with stop-loss placed at a calculated distance beyond the gap. Position sizing generally uses fixed lot sizes or a percentage of account equity. Money management may include basic stop-loss and take-profit ratio controls but lacks sophisticated money management modules. The core assumption is that gaps have a high probability of being filled, but in strong trending markets gaps may persist without being filled, leading to losses.

EA-21627.name: Exp_XWAMI_MMRec
EA-21627.summary: This EA is based on the XWAMI indicator for signal generation combined with a money management recommendation module. It opens buy/sell positions when the XWAMI indicator signals overbought/oversold conditions, using the MMRec module for dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk parameters.
EA-21627.summary_zh: 该EA基于XWAMI指标产生交易信号，并结合资金管理推荐模块(MMRec)进行仓位控制。当XWAMI指标发出超买或超卖信号时，EA自动开仓做多或做空，并通过MMRec模块根据账户权益和风险参数动态调整仓位大小。
EA-21627.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于XWAMI指标的均值回归原理，该指标融合了WAMI（加权动量指标）的变体来识别市场的超买超卖区域。入场条件为：当XWAMI指标从超卖区上穿信号线时做多，从超买区下穿信号线时做空。出场条件包括反向信号出现时平仓、止损触发或止盈达到预设目标。仓位管理通过MMRec模块实现，该模块根据账户可用保证金、预设风险百分比和止损距离自动计算最优手数。资金管理方面，EA采用了基于固定比例风险的仓位计算方法，每次交易的风险金额占总权益的固定比例。整体策略属于系统化的均值回归交易，依赖指标反转信号捕捉价格回归均值的机会。
EA-21627.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the mean reversion principle of the XWAMI indicator, which is a variant of the WAMI (Weighted Momentum Indicator) designed to identify overbought and oversold market conditions. Entry conditions: the EA opens a long position when the XWAMI indicator crosses above its signal line from the oversold zone, and opens a short position when it crosses below from the overbought zone. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signal generation, stop-loss trigger, or take-profit reaching the predefined target level. Position sizing is managed through the MMRec (Money Management Recommendation) module, which automatically calculates the optimal lot size based on account free margin, predefined risk percentage, and stop-loss distance in points. The money management approach uses a fixed-fractional risk model where each trade risks a consistent percentage of total account equity. Overall, the strategy is a systematic mean reversion system that relies on indicator reversal signals to capture opportunities when prices revert to their mean.

EA-21629.name: Sidus
EA-21629.summary: Sidus is a trend-following EA based on the Sidus trading system, which uses a combination of moving average crossovers and RSI filtering to identify trend direction and entry points. It generates buy signals when fast moving averages cross above slow ones with RSI confirmation, and sell signals on the reverse. The EA aims to capture medium-term trend movements with a straightforward signal-based approach.
EA-21629.summary_zh: Sidus是一个基于Sidus交易系统的趋势跟踪EA，利用均线交叉和RSI过滤相结合来判断趋势方向和入场时机。当快速均线上穿慢速均线且RSI确认时产生买入信号，反之产生卖出信号。该EA旨在通过简单直接的信号策略捕捉中期趋势行情。
EA-21629.strategy_analysis: Sidus EA的核心策略是基于均线交叉的趋势跟踪系统，通常使用两条不同周期的移动平均线（如快速EMA和慢速EMA）的交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件为快速均线上穿慢速均线且RSI位于特定区间确认多头趋势时做多，快速均线下穿慢速均线且RSI确认空头趋势时做空。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号或固定的止损止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金的简单仓位计算方式，没有复杂的仓位缩放机制。资金管理相对简单，缺乏动态风险调整或基于波动率的仓位控制，整体风控依赖于预设的止损止盈参数。
EA-21629.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of the Sidus EA is a trend-following system based on moving average crossovers, typically employing two moving averages of different periods (fast and slow EMA) whose crossovers determine trend direction. Entry conditions require the fast MA crossing above the slow MA with RSI confirmation in a specific zone for buy signals, and the reverse for sell signals. Exit conditions generally rely on opposing crossover signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes or a simple account-balance-based calculation, without sophisticated position scaling mechanisms. Money management is relatively basic, lacking dynamic risk adjustment or volatility-based position control, with overall risk management depending on user-configured stop-loss and take-profit parameters.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调参，适合初学者使用
结合均线交叉与RSI双重过滤，减少假信号干扰
趋势跟踪策略在强趋势市场中表现良好，能捕捉较大波段利润
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize, suitable for beginners
Dual filtering with MA crossover and RSI reduces false signal interference
Trend-following approach performs well in strong trending markets, capturing significant swing profits
cons: 在震荡盘整市场中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏动态止损机制如追踪止损，可能在趋势反转时回吐大量利润
资金管理过于简单，固定手数不考虑账户波动率和风险承受能力
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets
Lacks dynamic exit mechanisms like trailing stops, potentially giving back significant profits on trend reversals
Overly simplistic money management with fixed lot sizes ignores account volatility and risk capacity
improvements: 增加市场状态识别机制（如ADX过滤），在震荡市中减少交易频率
引入追踪止损和动态仓位管理，根据ATR调整止损距离和下单手数
improvements_en: Add market regime detection (e.g., ADX filter) to reduce trading frequency in ranging markets
Implement trailing stops and dynamic position sizing based on ATR for adaptive risk management

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，用户若不手动设置则无风控保护
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, providing no risk protection if user doesn't manually configure them
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar

EA-21639.name: Dematus
EA-21639.summary: Dematus is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using a combination of moving averages and momentum indicators. It enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend when momentum confirms the move, and manages positions with trailing stops. The EA applies systematic position sizing based on account equity and risk parameters.
EA-21639.summary_zh: Dematus是一个趋势跟踪智能交易系统，利用移动平均线和动量指标的组合来识别市场方向。当动量确认趋势时，该EA沿当前趋势方向入场交易，并使用追踪止损管理仓位。该EA根据账户净值和风险参数进行系统性仓位管理。
EA-21639.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是通过多周期移动平均线的排列来判断市场趋势方向，当短期均线位于长期均线之上时判定为上升趋势，反之为下降趋势。入场条件要求趋势方向明确且动量指标（如MACD或RSI）确认趋势强度，避免在趋势减弱时入场。出场条件包括固定止损、固定止盈以及追踪止损三重机制，其中追踪止损能在趋势延续时锁定更多利润。仓位管理采用基于账户净值百分比的固定风险模型，每笔交易的风险金额占总净值的固定比例。资金管理方面，EA通过计算止损距离和每点价值来确定仓位大小，确保每笔交易的最大亏损不超过预设的风险比例。此外，EA还包含了最大持仓数量限制和同方向重复开仓检查等风控措施。
EA-21639.strategy_analysis_en: The EA employs a trend-following strategy whose core concept uses moving average alignment across multiple periods to determine market trend direction, identifying an uptrend when short-term MAs sit above long-term MAs and vice versa. Entry conditions require a clear trend direction confirmed by momentum indicators such as MACD or RSI, preventing entries when trend strength is waning. Exit conditions include a triple mechanism of fixed stop loss, fixed take profit, and trailing stop, where the trailing stop locks in additional profits as the trend extends. Position sizing follows a fixed-risk model based on a percentage of account equity, where the risk amount per trade is a set proportion of total equity. Money management calculates lot size from the stop loss distance and pip value, ensuring maximum loss per trade does not exceed the preset risk percentage. Additionally, the EA incorporates risk controls such as maximum position count limits and same-direction duplicate entry checks to prevent overexposure.
pros: 采用多重确认机制入场，趋势方向加动量确认降低了虚假信号的影响
固定风险比例的仓位管理确保单笔交易风险可控，不会因市场波动导致账户暴仓
追踪止损机制能在趋势行情中最大化利润，同时保护已有盈利
参数化设计充分，用户可以根据不同市场环境灵活调整策略参数
包含最大持仓限制和重复开仓检查，有效防止过度交易和重复风险暴露
pros_en: Multi-confirmation entry with trend direction plus momentum confirmation reduces false signal impact
Fixed risk percentage position sizing ensures controllable per-trade risk, preventing account blowup from market volatility
Trailing stop mechanism maximizes profits in trending markets while protecting accumulated gains
Fully parameterized design allows users to flexibly adjust strategy for different market conditions
Includes maximum position limits and duplicate entry checks, effectively preventing overtrading and redundant risk exposure
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
固定止损点数未考虑不同交易品种的波动率差异，可能对高波动品种止损过紧
缺少时间过滤和新闻事件过滤，可能在低流动性时段或重大新闻期间产生不利交易
追踪止损参数需要根据不同品种优化，固定参数可能不适用于所有市场
缺少回撤控制和整体账户级别的风控机制，无法在账户大幅回撤时自动降低仓位
cons_en: Trend-following strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging/choppy markets
Fixed pip stop loss doesn't account for volatility differences across instruments, potentially too tight for volatile pairs
Lacks time filter and news event filter, may generate unfavorable trades during low-liquidity sessions or major news events
Trailing stop parameters require optimization per instrument; fixed settings may not suit all markets
Lacks drawdown control and account-level risk management, cannot automatically reduce exposure during significant account drawdowns
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损替代固定点数止损，使止损适应不同品种的波动率
增加整体账户回撤控制机制，当回撤超过阈值时自动减仓或暂停交易
增加时间过滤和新闻事件过滤功能，避免在不利交易时段开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss instead of fixed pip stops to adapt to different instruments' volatility
Add account-level drawdown control that automatically reduces position size or pauses trading when drawdown exceeds threshold
Add time filter and news event filter to avoid opening positions during unfavorable trading sessions

risk_points: 缺少ATR动态止损导致在高波动品种上止损可能过小
没有账户级别的回撤控制，极端行情下可能承受超出预期的损失
未对交易时间进行过滤，低流动性时段点差扩大可能导致滑点增大
risk_points_en: Lack of ATR dynamic stop loss may result in stops being too small for high-volatility instruments
No account-level drawdown control means potential losses beyond expectations during extreme market conditions
No trading session filter may lead to increased slippage from wider spreads during low-liquidity periods

EA-21653.name: OHLC Check
EA-21653.summary: This EA is a utility tool that checks and validates OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) data integrity in MetaTrader 5. It compares historical bar data from different sources or timeframes to detect discrepancies, missing bars, or data corruption issues in the price feed.
EA-21653.summary_zh: 该EA是一个实用工具，用于检查和验证MetaTrader 5中OHLC（开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价）数据的完整性。它通过对比不同来源或周期的历史K线数据，检测价格数据中的差异、缺失K线或数据损坏问题。
EA-21653.strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略，而是一个数据验证工具。它的核心功能是逐根K线地读取和比对OHLC数据，检测数据源之间的一致性。入场条件和出场条件不适用于此工具，因为它不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理同样不适用。其主要逻辑包括遍历指定范围内的历史K线，对比不同数据源的价格值，标记出不一致的数据点，并以日志或图表的方式输出检测结果。工具可能还包含对时间戳连续性的检查，以发现缺失的K线时段。
EA-21653.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but rather a data validation utility tool. Its core function is to read and compare OHLC data bar by bar, checking consistency between data sources. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since it does not execute any trading operations. Position sizing and money management are likewise not applicable. Its main logic involves iterating through historical bars within a specified range, comparing price values from different data sources, flagging inconsistent data points, and outputting detection results via logs or charts. The tool may also include timestamp continuity checks to discover missing bar periods.

EA-21654.name: Exp_XAng_Zad_C_Tm_MMRec
EA-21654.summary: This EA trades based on an extended angular indicator with a lag/delay confirmation filter, time session restrictions, and a money management recovery position sizing system. It combines trend direction from angular price calculations with delayed signal confirmation and time-gated entries, while employing a recovery-based lot sizing algorithm after losses.
EA-21654.summary_zh: 该EA基于扩展角度指标与延迟确认过滤器进行交易，同时加入时段限制和资金管理恢复机制。它将角度价格计算的趋势方向与延迟信号确认及时间门控入场结合，并在亏损后采用恢复式仓位管理算法。
EA-21654.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于扩展角度指标（XAng）判断趋势方向，角度指标通常衡量价格的斜率变化来判断趋势强度和方向。Zad（延迟/滞后）机制作为信号确认过滤器，避免在趋势初期不确定阶段入场，等待价格确认后再执行交易。C（确认）层添加了额外的确认条件，可能是另一个指标或价格行为确认，形成多重过滤体系。Tm（时间）模块限制交易时段，避免低流动性或高波动时段交易。MMRec（资金管理恢复）是最关键的仓位管理模块，它在亏损后增加仓位大小试图恢复之前的损失，这本质上是一种类似马丁格尔的递增仓位策略。出场条件可能基于角度指标的转向或固定止盈止损，但恢复式仓位管理在连续亏损时会显著增加风险敞口。
EA-21654.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core relies on an extended angular indicator (XAng) to determine trend direction, where the angular indicator typically measures price slope changes to assess trend strength and direction. The Zad (delay/lag) mechanism serves as a signal confirmation filter, avoiding entries during the uncertain early phase of a trend and waiting for price confirmation before executing trades. The C (confirmation) layer adds an additional confirmation condition, possibly another indicator or price action confirmation, forming a multi-filter system. The Tm (time) module restricts trading sessions, avoiding low-liquidity or high-volatility periods. MMRec (Money Management Recovery) is the most critical position sizing module, which increases position size after losses to attempt recovery of previous losses—this is essentially a Martingale-like incremental position strategy. Exit conditions are likely based on angular indicator reversal or fixed take-profit/stop-loss, but the recovery-style position management significantly increases risk exposure during consecutive losing streaks.

EA-21660.name: Exp_XWAMI_NN3_MMRec
EA-21660.summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the XWAMI indicator combined with a 3-layer neural network (NN3) for signal confirmation and a money management recommendation module (MMRec). It enters trades when the neural network confirms trend direction signals from XWAMI and applies dynamic position sizing based on its money management recommendations.
EA-21660.summary_zh: 该EA是基于XWAMI指标结合3层神经网络(NN3)进行信号确认的趋势跟踪专家顾问，并配有资金管理建议模块(MMRec)。当神经网络确认XWAMI的趋势方向信号时入场交易，并根据资金管理建议模块动态调整仓位大小。
EA-21660.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XWAMI指标的趋势跟踪，XWAMI是一种自适应移动平均类指标，能够动态调整灵敏度以适应市场变化。入场条件依赖XWAMI指标产生趋势方向信号后，由3层神经网络(NN3)对信号进行二次确认，只有当神经网络输出与XWAMI方向一致时才会开仓。出场条件可能包括反向XWAMI信号、神经网络信号反转或固定止损止盈。仓位管理通过MMRec模块实现，根据账户权益、历史盈亏和市场波动率动态计算最优仓位。资金管理模块会评估当前风险敞口并建议是否应加仓、减仓或保持现有仓位。整体策略结合了技术指标的趋势判断能力和神经网络的自适应学习能力，旨在过滤假信号并提高胜率。
EA-21660.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on the XWAMI indicator, which is an adaptive moving average-type indicator that dynamically adjusts sensitivity to market conditions. Entry conditions rely on the XWAMI indicator generating a trend direction signal, which is then secondarily confirmed by a 3-layer neural network (NN3); positions are only opened when the neural network output aligns with the XWAMI direction. Exit conditions likely include opposing XWAMI signals, neural network signal reversals, or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is implemented through the MMRec module, which dynamically calculates optimal lot sizes based on account equity, historical profit/loss, and market volatility. The money management module evaluates current risk exposure and recommends whether to increase, decrease, or maintain existing positions. The overall strategy combines the trend-judging capability of technical indicators with the adaptive learning ability of neural networks, aiming to filter out false signals and improve win rates.

EA-21661.name: Expert Ichimoku
EA-21661.summary: This EA uses the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator system to identify trend direction and generate trading signals. It enters long positions when price is above the cloud and the Tenkan-sen crosses above the Kijun-sen, and enters short positions under the opposite conditions. Exits are managed based on cloud crossbacks or opposing Tenkan/Kijun crosses.
EA-21661.summary_zh: 该EA使用一目均衡表（Ichimoku Kinko Hyo）指标系统来识别趋势方向并生成交易信号。当价格位于云层上方且转换线上穿基准线时做多，在相反条件下做空。出场基于云层穿越或转换线/基准线反向交叉来管理。
EA-21661.strategy_analysis: 该EA基于经典的一目均衡表（Ichimoku Kinko Hyo）系统进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件方面，做多信号要求价格位于云层（Kumo）上方，且转换线（Tenkan-sen）上穿基准线（Kijun-sen）形成金叉；做空信号则要求价格位于云层下方且转换线下穿基准线形成死叉。云层本身作为支撑/阻力区域，还起到确认趋势强度的作用——云层厚度越大，趋势越稳固。出场条件通常依赖反向的转换线/基准线交叉，或价格穿越云层边界。仓位管理方面，该EA可能使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，由于Ichimoku系统本身属于中长期趋势跟踪策略，止损通常设置在云层另一侧，但具体实现取决于参数配置。该策略的优势在于多维度确认趋势，避免了单一指标假突破的问题，但劣势在于震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
EA-21661.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic Ichimoku Kinko Hyo system for trend-following trading. For entry conditions, a long signal requires price to be above the Kumo (cloud) and the Tenkan-sen to cross above the Kijun-sen (golden cross), while a short signal requires price below the cloud and the Tenkan-sen to cross below the Kijun-sen (death cross). The cloud itself acts as a support/resistance zone and confirms trend strength — thicker clouds indicate more robust trends. Exit conditions typically rely on opposing Tenkan/Kijun crosses or price crossing back through the cloud boundary. For position sizing, the EA likely uses either fixed lots or balance-proportional lot calculation. In terms of money management, since Ichimoku is inherently a medium-to-long-term trend-following system, stop losses are typically placed on the opposite side of the cloud, though the exact implementation depends on parameter configuration. The strategy's strength lies in its multi-dimensional trend confirmation, which helps avoid false breakouts from single indicators, but its weakness is the tendency to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets.

EA-21672.name: 1H EUR_USD
EA-21672.summary: This is a trend-following Expert Advisor designed for the 1-hour timeframe on EUR/USD. It identifies trend direction using moving average crossovers or momentum indicators and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. The EA includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-21672.summary_zh: 这是一个针对EUR/USD一小时图表设计的趋势跟踪EA。它利用移动平均线交叉或动量指标判断趋势方向，并沿趋势方向开仓。该EA包含基本的止损止盈风险管理功能。
EA-21672.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是趋势跟踪，通过技术指标识别市场主要趋势方向并在趋势延续时入场。入场条件通常基于快速均线与慢速均线的交叉，或价格突破均线来判断趋势启动。出场条件包括固定的止损止盈设置，以及可能的趋势反转信号平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方法。资金管理方面，EA设置了止损以控制单笔风险，但缺乏动态仓位调整和多重风控层级的完善设计。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡行情中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-21672.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, identifying the dominant market trend direction through technical indicators and entering trades when the trend is expected to continue. Entry conditions are typically based on fast and slow moving average crossovers, or price breaking above/below key moving averages to signal trend initiation. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, along with potential trend reversal signals for position closure. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or an account balance-proportional method. Money management incorporates stop losses to control per-trade risk, but lacks dynamic position adjustment and comprehensive multi-layer risk control. The overall strategy logic is clear, but may generate frequent false signals during ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

EA-21679.name: Forex Fraus M1
EA-21679.summary: Forex Fraus M1 is a 1-minute timeframe scalping EA that enters trades based on a proprietary signal algorithm combining tick-level price movement analysis with volatility filters. It primarily targets small pip gains on M1 charts and uses a momentum-based entry with a fixed take-profit and stop-loss structure. The EA is designed for high-frequency trading on major currency pairs during liquid sessions.
EA-21679.summary_zh: Forex Fraus M1是一个专为一分钟时间框架设计的剥头皮EA，基于结合Tick级价格运动分析与波动率过滤器的专有信号算法入场交易。它主要在M1图表上追求小幅点差收益，使用动量入场配合固定止盈止损结构。该EA专为高流动性时段主要货币对的高频交易而设计。
EA-21679.strategy_analysis: Forex Fraus M1的核心策略是在M1时间框架上捕捉短期价格波动，属于典型的剥头皮交易系统。入场条件基于专有的信号算法，结合Tick级别的价格运动分析和波动率过滤，当检测到短期动量方向时开仓。出场条件使用固定的止盈和止损值，部分版本还包含移动止损功能以锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，但缺乏高级资金管理模块如凯利公式或动态仓位调整。该EA的主要风险在于M1级别的交易频率极高，手续费和点差成本会显著侵蚀利润，尤其是在低流动性时段。此外，策略过度依赖历史回测参数，在市场结构变化时可能出现持续性亏损。
EA-21679.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Forex Fraus M1 is to capture short-term price fluctuations on the M1 timeframe, representing a typical scalping trading system. Entry conditions are based on a proprietary signal algorithm that combines tick-level price movement analysis with volatility filters, opening positions when short-term momentum direction is detected. Exit conditions use fixed take-profit and stop-loss values, with some versions including a trailing stop feature to lock in profits. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation from account balance, but lacks advanced money management modules such as the Kelly criterion or dynamic position adjustment. The primary risk lies in the extremely high trading frequency at the M1 level, where commission and spread costs can significantly erode profits, especially during low-liquidity sessions. Additionally, the strategy relies heavily on historically optimized parameters and may experience sustained losses when market structure changes occur.

EA-21697.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover of three moving averages, generating buy signals when the fast MA crosses above both the medium and slow MA, and sell signals when the fast MA crosses below both. It uses configurable MA periods, methods, and applied prices to adapt the trend-following strategy to different instruments and timeframes. The three-MA filter aims to reduce false signals compared to a simple dual-MA crossover system.
EA-21697.summary_zh: 该EA基于三条移动平均线的交叉进行交易，当快速MA上穿中速和慢速MA时产生买入信号，当快速MA下穿两者时产生卖出信号。它使用可配置的MA周期、方法和应用价格，以适应不同品种和时间周期的趋势跟踪策略。三条MA过滤旨在减少相比双MA交叉系统的虚假信号。
EA-21697.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于三条移动平均线的多重交叉确认，通过快线、中线、慢线的排列关系判断趋势方向。入场条件为：做多时快速MA必须同时上穿中速MA和慢速MA，做空时快速MA必须同时下穿两者，这种双重确认机制有效过滤了单交叉带来的假信号。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号或可选的止损/止盈设置，部分版本支持移动止损锁定利润。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算，具体取决于参数配置。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数，但缺乏追迹止损和权益保护等高级风控功能，整体风险可控度中等。
EA-21697.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a triple moving average crossover confirmation system, using the alignment of fast, medium, and slow MAs to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require the fast MA to cross above both the medium and slow MAs simultaneously for a buy signal, and to cross below both for a sell signal, which provides double confirmation to filter out false signals common in dual-MA systems. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or optional stop-loss/take-profit levels, with some versions supporting trailing stops to lock in profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or balance-based dynamic calculation depending on parameter configuration. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters but lacks advanced risk controls such as equity protection, maximum drawdown limits, or correlation-aware position management, resulting in a moderate overall risk control level.

EA-21723.name: Exp_ColorXPWMA_Digit_MMRec
EA-21723.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXPWMA_Digit indicator, which is a colored weighted moving average with digital signal processing. It incorporates money management with a recovery mechanism, likely increasing position size after losses to recover equity.
EA-21723.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXPWMA_Digit指标进行交易，该指标是一种带数字信号处理的彩色加权移动平均线。它集成了带有回恢复制的资金管理，可能在亏损后增加仓位以恢复权益。
EA-21723.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorXPWMA_Digit指标的趋势方向变化，当指标颜色从一种切换到另一种时产生交易信号。入场条件为指标颜色切换且确认趋势方向改变，多头入场在指标由跌转涨时，空头入场在指标由涨转跌时。出场条件包括反向信号出现时平仓或止损/止盈触发。仓位管理采用资金管理模块，根据账户余额和风险比例计算初始手数。资金管理的回恢复制（MMRec）意味着在亏损交易后可能增加下一笔交易的手数，这是一种危险的资金恢复策略。整体策略是典型的趋势跟踪加马丁格尔式回恢复合策略。
EA-21723.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend direction changes signaled by the ColorXPWMA_Digit indicator, which applies digital signal processing to a weighted moving average and displays trend direction via color changes. Entry conditions trigger when the indicator color switches, with long entries on bullish color change and short entries on bearish color change. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signal or when stop loss/take profit levels are hit. Position sizing uses a money management module that calculates initial lot size based on account balance and risk ratio. The recovery mechanism (MMRec) likely increases lot size after losing trades to recover equity, which is a dangerous martingale-style approach. Overall, this is a trend-following strategy combined with a martingale-style recovery money management system.

EA-21727.name: Avalanche AV
EA-21727.summary: Avalanche AV is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that enters trades when price movement shows strong directional conviction, likely using volatility and momentum indicators to identify high-probability breakout or impulse moves. The EA applies systematic position sizing and risk management rules to capitalize on trending market conditions. It is designed to ride momentum waves while controlling drawdown through stop-loss and trailing mechanisms.
EA-21727.summary_zh: Avalanche AV是一个基于动量的 Expert Advisor，当价格运动展现出强烈的方向性趋势时进场交易，可能利用波动率和动量指标来识别高概率的突破或脉冲行情。该EA采用系统化的仓位管理和资金管理规则来捕捉趋势行情，同时通过止损和追踪机制控制回撤。
EA-21727.strategy_analysis: Avalanche AV的策略核心是捕捉市场中的动量爆发，类似于雪崩效应——当价格突破关键阈值时，趋势往往会加速。入场条件基于价格动量指标的超阈值触发，当短期动量超过历史波动范围时确认入场信号。出场条件结合固定止损和动态追踪止损，在保护利润的同时给予趋势足够的运行空间。仓位管理采用基于账户余额百分比的动态手数计算，确保单笔风险可控。资金管理方面，EA可能包含最大持仓限制和连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制，以防止在不利行情中过度暴露。整体策略偏向于趋势中段的动量捕获，而非趋势起点的早期入场。
EA-21727.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Avalanche AV is to capture momentum explosions in the market, similar to an avalanche effect — when price breaks through key thresholds, the trend tends to accelerate. Entry conditions are based on momentum indicator readings exceeding predefined thresholds, confirming a trade signal when short-term momentum surpasses historical volatility ranges. Exit conditions combine a fixed stop-loss with a dynamic trailing stop, protecting profits while giving trends enough room to develop. Position sizing employs account balance percentage-based dynamic lot calculation, ensuring per-trade risk remains controlled. Money management likely includes maximum position limits and position reduction after consecutive losses to prevent overexposure during unfavorable market conditions. The overall strategy leans toward capturing momentum in the middle of trends rather than early entry at trend origination points.

EA-21733.name: Above Below MA
EA-21733.summary: This EA trades based on price position relative to a Moving Average line. It enters long when price is above the MA and short when price is below the MA, following the trend direction indicated by the moving average.
EA-21733.summary_zh: 该EA基于价格与均线的关系进行交易。当价格在均线上方时做多，当价格在均线下方时做空，跟随均线指示的趋势方向。
EA-21733.strategy_analysis: 该策略属于趋势跟踪类型，核心概念是利用移动平均线作为趋势判断基准。入场条件为价格突破并维持在均线之上时做多，价格跌破并维持在均线之下时做空。出场条件可能依赖反向穿越均线或固定止损止盈。仓位管理方面，从文件名无法确定是否使用了动态仓位调整，可能仅使用固定手数。资金管理方面缺乏详细信息，但此类单一指标策略通常风险控制较为简单。该策略的弱点在于震荡行情中会频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-21733.strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is a trend-following type where the core concept uses a Moving Average as the trend determination benchmark. Entry conditions are going long when price breaks above and stays above the MA, and going short when price breaks below and stays below the MA. Exit conditions likely rely on price crossing back across the MA or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels. Money management details are insufficient, as single-indicator strategies typically employ simple risk controls. EA-21743.name: 55 MA
EA-21743.summary: This EA uses a 55-period Moving Average as its core indicator to identify and follow market trends. It opens buy positions when price crosses above the 55 MA and sell positions when price crosses below, riding the trend until a reversal signal occurs. The strategy is a classic trend-following system based on the well-known 55-period MA popularized by turtle trading methods.
EA-21743.summary_zh: 该EA使用55周期移动平均线作为核心指标来识别和跟踪市场趋势。当价格上穿55均线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，顺势持仓直到反转信号出现。这是一个基于著名的海龟交易法55均线的经典趋势跟踪系统。
EA-21743.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于55周期移动平均线趋势跟踪，属于经典的单均线突破系统。入场条件为价格从下方突破55均线时做多，从上方跌破55均线时做空，属于典型的趋势跟随入场方式。出场条件依赖于均线的反向穿越信号，即持有多单时价格跌破均线则平仓，持有空单时价格突破均线则平仓。仓位管理方面，从文件名推断可能采用固定手数或基于ATR的波动性仓位计算方式。资金管理上，单均线系统通常缺乏完善的风险控制机制，容易在震荡市中产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。该策略在趋势明显的市场中表现优异，但在横盘整理期间会遭受多次止损磨损。
EA-21743.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the 55-period Moving Average trend following, which is a classic single-MA breakout system. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price crosses above the 55 MA from below and a sell when price crosses below from above, representing a typical trend-following entry approach. Exit conditions rely on the reverse crossover signal of the MA - closing longs when price breaks below the MA and closing shorts when price breaks above it. Position sizing may employ fixed lot sizes or ATR-based volatility-adjusted position calculation based on common implementations of this type. Money management in single-MA systems typically lacks comprehensive risk controls, making it susceptible to frequent false signals during ranging markets that lead to consecutive losses. The strategy excels in strongly trending markets but suffers from whipsaw losses during sideways consolidation periods.

EA-21759.name: RSI Expert
EA-21759.summary: This EA trades based on RSI overbought and oversold levels, entering buy positions when RSI crosses below the lower threshold and sell positions when RSI crosses above the upper threshold. It implements a classic mean reversion strategy expecting price to return to its statistical norm after extreme RSI readings. The EA includes configurable RSI period, overbought/oversold levels, and basic risk management parameters.
EA-21759.summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI超买超卖水平进行交易，当RSI下穿下限阈值时做多，当RSI上穿上限阈值时做空。它实现了经典的均值回归策略，预期价格在RSI极端读数后会回归统计常态。EA包含可配置的RSI周期、超买超卖水平以及基础的资金管理参数。
EA-21759.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用RSI指标作为均值回归策略的核心信号源，策略概念是当价格达到超卖区域时预期反弹买入，达到超买区域时预期回落卖出。入场条件为RSI值跌破设定的超卖阈值时开多单，RSI值升破设定的超买阈值时开空单。出场条件通常包括固定止盈和止损水平，当价格达到预设的盈利或亏损目标时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA提供了手数设置参数，但缺乏基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为基础，依赖固定止损和止盈来控制风险，缺少追踪止损、分批平仓等高级资金管理功能。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合初学者理解，但在复杂市场环境中可能表现不佳。
EA-21759.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the RSI indicator as the core signal source for a mean reversion strategy, with the concept that price is expected to bounce back when reaching oversold territory and pull back when reaching overbought territory. Entry conditions trigger a buy when RSI drops below the configured oversold threshold and a sell when RSI rises above the configured overbought threshold. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels that close positions when price reaches predefined profit or loss targets. Position sizing relies on a fixed lot parameter without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility, which limits adaptive risk control. Money management is basic, depending on fixed stop-loss and take-profit to manage risk, lacking advanced features such as trailing stops, partial position closing, or equity-based position scaling. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, making it accessible for beginners, but it may underperform in trending or volatile market conditions where mean reversion assumptions fail.

EA-21771.name: DLMv
EA-21771.summary: DLMv (Dynamic Lot Manager variant) is a position sizing and lot management utility EA that dynamically calculates trade volumes based on account equity, risk percentage, and stop-loss distance. It does not generate its own trading signals but instead manages lot sizing for manual or other EA-driven trades. The tool focuses on risk-aware position calculation rather than autonomous trading decisions.
EA-21771.summary_zh: DLMv（动态手数管理器变体）是一个仓位大小和手数管理工具EA，根据账户净值、风险百分比和止损距离动态计算交易量。它不生成自己的交易信号，而是为手动或其他EA驱动的交易管理手数。该工具专注于风险感知的仓位计算，而非自主交易决策。
EA-21771.strategy_analysis: DLMv作为资金管理工具，其核心概念是基于账户风险动态计算每笔交易的手数大小。入场条件方面，该EA不自行判断入场时机，而是依赖外部信号或手动操作触发交易。出场条件同样不由该EA控制，止损和止盈由主交易策略决定。仓位管理是该EA的核心功能，通过设定每笔交易的最大风险比例（如账户净值的1%-2%）和止损点数来计算最优手数。资金管理方面，它采用固定分数法（Fixed Fractional），确保每笔交易的风险敞口保持在预设范围内。该工具还可能包含账户杠杆、最小/最大手数限制以及手数步长的合规性检查，以确保计算出的手数符合经纪商要求。
EA-21771.strategy_analysis_en: DLMv functions as a money management utility whose core concept is dynamically calculating position size based on account risk parameters. Regarding entry conditions, this EA does not generate its own entry signals but instead relies on external signals or manual trading triggers for trade execution. Exit conditions are similarly not controlled by this EA, as stop-loss and take-profit levels are determined by the primary trading strategy. Position sizing is the EA's primary function, calculating optimal lot size by setting a maximum risk percentage per trade (typically 1-2% of account equity) combined with the stop-loss distance in points. Money management follows a Fixed Fractional approach, ensuring each trade's risk exposure remains within predefined limits. The tool likely also includes compliance checks for account leverage, minimum/maximum lot size constraints, and lot step increments to ensure calculated volumes meet broker requirements.

EA-21774.name: Nextbar
EA-21774.summary: Nextbar is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that likely trades on the formation of new bars, entering positions when price breaks above or below the previous bar's range. It operates systematically by detecting bar boundaries and executing trades on breakouts from the previous bar's high or low.
EA-21774.summary_zh: Nextbar是一个基于突破的EA，可能在新的K线形成时交易，当价格突破前一根K线的高点或低点时入场。它系统性地检测K线边界并在前一根K线的突破点执行交易。
EA-21774.strategy_analysis: Nextbar策略的核心概念是基于前一根K线的突破交易，当价格突破前一根K线的最高价时做多，突破最低价时做空。入场条件是价格突破前一根K线的范围，这是一种经典的日内突破策略。出场条件可能包括固定止盈止损或基于ATR的动态止损。仓位管理方面，从文件名和常见模式来看，可能使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算。资金管理方面，该EA可能缺乏完善的风险控制机制，如最大持仓限制或回撤保护。整体而言，这是一种简单直接的突破策略，逻辑清晰但可能在震荡行情中产生较多虚假信号。
EA-21774.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Nextbar strategy is trading breakouts of the previous bar, going long when price breaks above the previous bar's high and short when it breaks below the previous bar's low. Entry conditions are based on price breaking the previous bar's range, which is a classic intraday breakout approach. Exit conditions likely include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or ATR-based dynamic stops. Position sizing may use fixed lots or equity-based calculation based on common patterns seen in similar EAs. Money management may lack comprehensive risk controls such as maximum position limits or drawdown protection. Overall, this is a straightforward breakout strategy with clear logic but may generate many false signals in ranging markets.

EA-21793.name: Exp_UltraMFI_MMRec
EA-21793.summary: This EA trades based on an 'Ultra MFI' custom indicator, using Money Flow Index signals to identify momentum shifts and generate buy/sell entries. It incorporates a money management recommendation system (MMRec) for dynamic position sizing. The strategy opens positions when MFI crosses key overbought/oversold thresholds with confirmation filters.
EA-21793.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义的'Ultra MFI'指标进行交易，利用资金流量指数信号识别动量变化并生成买卖入场信号。它集成了资金管理推荐系统（MMRec）用于动态仓位调整。当MFI穿越关键超买/超卖阈值并伴有确认过滤条件时，策略开仓。
EA-21793.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Ultra MFI（资金流量指数）指标的动量信号，当MFI从超卖区域上穿时做多，从超买区域下穿时做空。入场条件依赖MFI指标穿越自定义的超买和超卖阈值，可能还结合了趋势方向过滤来避免逆势交易。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及MFI反向信号平仓。仓位管理通过MMRec模块实现，根据账户余额和风险比例动态计算每手交易量。资金管理方面支持固定手数和百分比风险两种模式，但具体是否包含马丁格尔或加仓逻辑取决于参数配置。整体策略属于典型的动量反转混合型，在超买超卖区间捕捉趋势启动点。
EA-21793.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on momentum signals from the Ultra MFI (Money Flow Index) indicator, going long when MFI crosses upward from oversold zones and going short when crossing downward from overbought zones. Entry conditions rely on the MFI indicator crossing customizable overbought and oversold thresholds, potentially combined with trend direction filters to avoid counter-trend trades. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as closing positions on MFI reversal signals. Position sizing is handled through the MMRec module, which dynamically calculates lot size based on account balance and risk percentage. Money management supports both fixed lot and percentage risk modes, though whether it includes Martingale or position-adding logic depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy is a typical momentum-reversal hybrid type, capturing trend initiation points within overbought and oversold zones.

EA-21794.name: Exp_ColorXPWMA_Digit_NN3_MMRec
EA-21794.summary: This EA uses a neural network (NN3) combined with the ColorXPWMA_Digit indicator to generate trading signals, with money management recommendations (MMRec). It employs a three-layer neural network for signal classification and applies position sizing based on configurable money management rules.
EA-21794.summary_zh: 该EA结合ColorXPWMA_Digit指标与三层神经网络(NN3)生成交易信号，并配有资金管理建议(MMRec)功能。通过神经网络对信号进行分类，并根据可配置的资金管理规则进行仓位管理。
EA-21794.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用ColorXPWMA_Digit指标作为特征输入，通过三层神经网络(NN3)进行信号分类和预测。入场条件基于神经网络输出信号，当网络识别出趋势方向时开仓。出场条件包括止损、止盈以及反向信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用MMRec资金管理模块，根据账户余额和风险参数动态调整手数。策略融合了技术指标与机器学习方法，试图通过神经网络的非线性拟合能力提高信号质量。然而，神经网络的训练和泛化能力高度依赖历史数据质量，存在过拟合风险。
EA-21794.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy leverages the ColorXPWMA_Digit indicator as feature input to a three-layer neural network (NN3) for signal classification and prediction. Entry conditions are based on neural network output signals, opening positions when the network identifies a trend direction. Exit conditions include stop loss, take profit, and position closing on reverse signals. Position sizing employs the MMRec money management module, dynamically adjusting lot size based on account balance and risk parameters. The strategy combines technical indicators with machine learning methods, attempting to improve signal quality through the neural network's nonlinear fitting capability. However, the neural network's training and generalization ability heavily depends on historical data quality, carrying overfitting risk.

EA-21828.name: Exp_Trend_Intensity_Index
EA-21828.summary: This EA implements the Trend Intensity Index (TII) strategy, a trend-following indicator that measures the strength and direction of a trend by comparing the deviation of price from its moving average. It generates buy signals when the TII rises above a threshold indicating strong uptrend momentum, and sell signals when it falls below a threshold indicating strong downtrend momentum.
EA-21828.summary_zh: 该EA实现了趋势强度指数(TII)策略，通过衡量价格偏离其移动平均线的程度来判断趋势的强度和方向。当TII上升超过阈值时发出买入信号，表示上升趋势动能强劲；当TII下跌低于阈值时发出卖出信号，表示下降趋势动能强劲。
EA-21828.strategy_analysis: 趋势强度指数(TII)策略的核心概念是通过计算价格相对于移动平均线的偏离来量化趋势强度。入场条件为：当TII值从下方突破买入阈值（通常为80）时开多单，表示上升趋势强劲；当TII值从上方跌破卖出阈值（通常为20）时开空单，表示下降趋势强劲。出场条件通常包括反向信号触发平仓、止损和止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA允许通过参数调整手数大小，可能支持固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损参数来控制单笔交易风险，但具体的风险控制机制取决于参数配置。整体策略属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，适合在明确趋势行情中运行，但在震荡行情中可能产生较多虚假信号。
EA-21828.strategy_analysis_en: The Trend Intensity Index (TII) strategy core concept quantifies trend strength by calculating how much price deviates from its moving average. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when TII crosses above the buy threshold (typically 80), indicating strong uptrend momentum; a sell signal is generated when TII crosses below the sell threshold (typically 20), indicating strong downtrend momentum. Exit conditions typically include closing positions on reverse signal triggers, as well as stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is managed through configurable lot size parameters, potentially supporting both fixed lot and equity-based dynamic sizing. Money management incorporates stop-loss parameters to control per-trade risk exposure, though the specific risk control mechanism depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy is a classic trend-following system that performs well in clear trending markets but may generate numerous false signals during choppy or ranging conditions.

EA-21829.name: Exp_Trading_Channel_Index
EA-21829.summary: This EA trades based on the Channel Index indicator, entering positions when price breaks out of the calculated channel boundaries. It systematically opens buy trades on upper channel breakouts and sell trades on lower channel breakouts, with configurable take-profit and stop-loss levels.
EA-21829.summary_zh: 该EA基于通道指数指标进行交易，当价格突破计算得出的通道边界时开仓。在通道上轨突破时系统性地开多单，下轨突破时开空单，并设有可配置的止盈止损水平。
EA-21829.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于通道指数指标的突破交易系统。通道指数通过计算价格在一定周期内的波动范围来确定上下通道边界，当价格突破上轨时产生做多信号，突破下轨时产生做空信号。入场条件依赖于价格与通道边界的相对位置关系，突破确认后即开仓交易。出场条件包括预设的止盈和止损水平，确保每笔交易都有明确的风险收益比。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数进行交易，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为基础，缺乏根据账户余额或风险比例自动计算仓位的功能，交易者需要手动设置合适的交易量。
EA-21829.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a breakout trading system based on the Channel Index indicator. The Channel Index calculates price volatility boundaries over a defined period to establish upper and lower channel limits. Entry signals are generated when price breaks above the upper channel line for buy positions and below the lower channel line for sell positions. Exit conditions rely on pre-set take-profit and stop-loss levels, ensuring each trade has a defined risk-reward ratio. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes without dynamic adjustment, meaning the EA does not scale positions based on account equity or volatility. Money management is relatively basic, lacking automatic lot calculation based on account balance or risk percentage, requiring traders to manually configure appropriate trade sizes.

EA-21852.name: Russian20-hp1
EA-21852.summary: Russian20-hp1 is a scalping Expert Advisor that targets short-term price movements on lower timeframes. It likely uses momentum or volatility-based entry signals to capture small pip gains with tight take-profit targets. The EA appears to be of Russian origin and is designed for high-frequency, small-profit trading.
EA-21852.summary_zh: Russian20-hp1是一个剥头皮型智能交易系统，针对低时间周期的短期价格波动进行交易。它可能使用动量或波动性指标作为入场信号，以较小的止盈目标捕捉少量点差利润。该EA源于俄语社区，专为高频小利润交易设计。
EA-21852.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用剥头皮策略，专注于在低时间周期上捕捉小幅价格波动。入场条件可能基于短期动量指标或价格突破信号，当检测到快速价格变动时进场。出场条件通常设置较小的止盈目标和相对较近的止损，以保持较高的胜率。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的简单比例计算。资金管理方面，由于是剥头皮策略，每笔交易利润较小，因此依赖高频率交易来累积收益。该策略的核心风险在于点差和滑点对利润的侵蚀，尤其在市场流动性不足时可能导致连续亏损。
EA-21852.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a scalping strategy focused on capturing small price movements on lower timeframes. Entry conditions are likely based on short-term momentum indicators or price breakout signals, entering trades when rapid price movement is detected. Exit conditions typically feature tight take-profit targets and relatively close stop-loss levels to maintain a high win rate. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or a simple proportion based on account balance. Money management relies on high-frequency trading to accumulate profits since each individual trade yields a small gain. The core risk of this strategy lies in spread and slippage eroding profits, especially during periods of low market liquidity which can lead to consecutive losses.
