EA-22219.name: Exp_ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle_MMRec_Duplex
EA-22219.summary: This EA trades based on the Color Schaff JCCX Trend Cycle indicator, using its trend cycle signals for entry and exit decisions. It employs a money management recovery (MMRec) system with duplex mode, suggesting dual-direction trading capability with position recovery logic after losses. The strategy systematically opens positions when the Schaff trend cycle indicator confirms directional momentum shifts.
EA-22219.summary_zh: 该EA基于Color Schaff JCCX趋势循环指标进行交易，利用其趋势循环信号作为入场和出场决策依据。它采用资金管理恢复（MMRec）系统和双工模式，暗示具备双向交易及亏损后仓位恢复功能。当Schaff趋势循环指标确认方向性动量转变时，该策略系统性地开仓。
EA-22219.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Schaff趋势循环指标（JCCX变体），这是一种将随机振荡器与移动平均线结合的趋势循环检测工具。入场条件依赖于趋势循环线的交叉信号：当循环线从超卖区域上穿信号线时做多，从超买区域下穿时做空。出场条件包括趋势循环反向交叉信号触发的平仓，以及可能存在的止损和止盈设置。仓位管理方面，MMRec（资金管理恢复）系统表明该EA在亏损后可能增加仓位大小以尝试恢复资金，这是一种带有马丁格尔倾向的仓位调整方法。双工（Duplex）模式意味着EA可以同时在两个方向上管理交易，或者在主策略和恢复策略之间切换。资金管理结合了固定手数和恢复性递增手数的混合模式，风险敞口随亏损深度而动态调整。
EA-22219.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the Schaff Trend Cycle indicator (JCCX variant), which combines stochastic oscillators with moving averages for trend cycle detection. Entry conditions rely on crossover signals from the trend cycle lines: going long when the cycle line crosses above the signal line from oversold territory, and going short when crossing below from overbought territory. Exit conditions include position closing triggered by reverse trend cycle crossover signals, along with possible stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing employs the MMRec (Money Management Recovery) system, indicating the EA may increase position size after losses to attempt capital recovery, which is a position adjustment method with Martingale tendencies. The Duplex mode means the EA can manage trades in both directions simultaneously, or switch between a primary strategy and a recovery strategy. Money management combines a mixed mode of fixed lots and recovery-incremental lots, with risk exposure dynamically adjusting based on the depth of losses.

EA-22221.name: Exp_ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle_MMRec_Duplex
EA-22221.summary: This EA trades based on the Schaff JJRSX Trend Cycle indicator, a double-smoothed stochastic-type oscillator that identifies trend cycle reversals. It uses a duplex (dual-direction) money management recommendation system to determine position sizing and trade direction. The EA opens buy trades on bullish cycle reversals from oversold zones and sell trades on bearish reversals from overbought zones.
EA-22221.summary_zh: 该EA基于Schaff JJRSX趋势周期指标进行交易，该指标是一种双重平滑的随机振荡器，用于识别趋势周期反转。它使用双工（双向）资金管理推荐系统来确定仓位大小和交易方向。EA在超卖区域的看涨周期反转时开多单，在超买区域的看跌周期反转时开空单。
EA-22221.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Schaff JJRSX趋势周期指标，这是Schaff趋势周期指标的变体，结合了JJRSX（Juerk Jurik相对强弱指数）的平滑算法，产生0-100之间的振荡值来识别趋势方向和周期反转点。入场条件为：当指标从超卖区域（通常低于20-25）向上反转时开多单，当指标从超买区域（通常高于75-80）向下反转时开空单。出场条件依赖于趋势周期指标的再次反转信号或交叉零线，也可能包含止损和止盈设置。仓位管理采用Duplex（双工）资金管理推荐系统，意味着双向交易信号同时带有仓位大小建议，可能根据信号强度或账户权益动态调整手数。资金管理方面，MMRec（Money Management Recommendation）表明该EA集成了资金管理建议模块，可能根据风险百分比或固定比例计算最优仓位大小，而Duplex则暗示系统同时为多空两个方向提供独立的资金管理计算。
EA-22221.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Schaff JJRSX Trend Cycle indicator, a variant of the Schaff Trend Cycle that incorporates the JJRSX (Juerk Jurik Relative Strength Index) smoothing algorithm, producing oscillator values between 0-100 to identify trend direction and cycle reversal points. Entry conditions are: open buy trades when the indicator reverses upward from oversold zones (typically below 20-25), and open sell trades when the indicator reverses downward from overbought zones (typically above 75-80). Exit conditions rely on the trend cycle indicator issuing another reversal signal or crossing its midpoint, and may also include stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing employs a Duplex (dual-direction) money management recommendation system, meaning bidirectional trade signals come with position size suggestions, potentially adjusting lot sizes dynamically based on signal strength or account equity. For money management, MMRec (Money Management Recommendation) indicates the EA integrates a money management advisory module, likely calculating optimal position sizes based on risk percentage or fixed fractional methods, while Duplex implies the system provides independent money management calculations for both long and short directions simultaneously.

EA-22260.name: Exp_XDeMarker_Histogram_Vol_Direct
EA-22260.summary: This EA trades based on the XDeMarker histogram indicator with volume confirmation and direct trading logic. It enters positions when the DeMarker oscillator signals momentum shifts confirmed by volume, and manages trades with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. The strategy combines DeMarker overbought/oversold readings with volume-filtered entry signals for systematic trade execution.
EA-22260.summary_zh: 该EA基于XDeMarker直方图指标配合成交量确认和直接交易逻辑进行交易。当DeMarker振荡器发出动量转变信号且成交量确认时开仓，并使用固定止损和止盈管理交易。该策略结合DeMarker超买/超卖读数与成交量过滤入场信号，实现系统化交易执行。
EA-22260.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于DeMarker振荡器的直方图变化来捕捉市场动量的转变方向，并结合成交量过滤来确认信号的有效性。入场条件为XDeMarker直方图显示动量方向性变化（如从负转正或从正转负），同时成交量需满足最小阈值要求以过滤虚假信号。出场条件采用固定止损和止盈方式，同时在指标信号反转时也会考虑平仓。仓位管理使用固定手数模式，交易者可通过参数设定每笔交易的交易量。资金管理方面相对简单，未采用动态仓位调整或百分比风险模型，依赖固定止损来控制单笔风险。整体策略逻辑清晰，将动量指标与成交量结合是一种经典的确认方法，但在资金管理和风险控制方面存在改进空间。
EA-22260.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on capturing momentum shifts using the XDeMarker histogram changes, combined with volume filtering to confirm signal validity. Entry conditions require the XDeMarker histogram to show directional momentum changes (e.g., crossing from negative to positive or vice versa), while volume must meet a minimum threshold to filter out false signals. Exit conditions use fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and position closure may also be triggered when the indicator signal reverses direction. Position sizing employs a fixed lot model where the trader can set the trade volume through input parameters. Money management is relatively simple, lacking dynamic position sizing or percentage-based risk models, relying on fixed stop-losses to control per-trade risk. The overall strategy logic is clear, combining a momentum indicator with volume confirmation is a classic validation approach, but there is room for improvement in money management and risk control.

EA-22261.name: Freeman EA
EA-22261.summary: The Freeman EA is a trend-following expert advisor that uses moving average crossovers and momentum indicators to identify and ride market trends. It enters positions when short-term momentum aligns with the prevailing trend direction and employs trailing stops to protect profits. The EA systematically manages trades with predefined risk parameters and trend-confirmation filters.
EA-22261.summary_zh: Freeman EA是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，利用移动平均线交叉和动量指标来识别并跟随市场趋势。当短期动量与主要趋势方向一致时开仓，并使用追踪止损来保护利润。该EA通过预定义的风险参数和趋势确认过滤器来系统性地管理交易。
EA-22261.strategy_analysis: Freeman EA的核心策略是基于趋势跟踪理念，通过移动平均线的金叉和死叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件要求短期均线上穿长期均线（做多）或下穿（做空），同时需要动量指标（如RSI或MACD）确认趋势强度，避免在震荡行情中错误入场。出场条件包括固定止损、固定止盈以及追踪止损机制，当价格回撤超过设定幅度时自动平仓锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，确保每笔交易的风险可控。资金管理方面，EA设置了最大持仓限制和单日最大亏损限额，防止极端行情下账户遭受过大损失。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-22261.strategy_analysis_en: The Freeman EA's core strategy is based on trend-following principles, using moving average crossovers (golden cross and death cross) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require the short-term MA crossing above the long-term MA for buy signals or below for sell signals, with momentum indicators (such as RSI or MACD) confirming trend strength to avoid false entries in ranging markets. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss, fixed take-profit, and a trailing stop mechanism that automatically closes positions when price retraces beyond a set threshold to lock in profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculation relative to account balance, ensuring controlled risk per trade. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and daily loss caps to prevent excessive account drawdown during extreme market conditions. The overall strategy logic is clear, but may generate frequent false signals in choppy or ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

EA-22274.name: OHLC Stochastic
EA-22274.summary: This EA implements a Stochastic oscillator-based mean reversion strategy, generating buy signals when the Stochastic enters oversold territory and sell signals when it reaches overbought zones. It uses OHLC price data to compute the Stochastic values and executes trades automatically based on crossover signals within the oscillator. The strategy targets reversal points in the market where price is expected to revert to its mean.
EA-22274.summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于随机振荡器的均值回归策略，当随机指标进入超卖区域时产生买入信号，进入超买区域时产生卖出信号。它使用OHLC价格数据计算随机指标值，并根据振荡器内的交叉信号自动执行交易。策略针对市场中价格预期回归均值时的反转点。
EA-22274.strategy_analysis: 该EA基于随机振荡器（Stochastic Oscillator）的均值回归策略，核心概念是利用%K和%D线的交叉以及超买超卖区域来判断价格反转时机。入场条件为：当%K线从超卖区（通常低于20）上穿%D线时买入，当%K线从超买区（通常高于80）下穿%D线时卖出。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号或预设的止盈止损水平，但具体实现取决于参数配置中的止损和止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式，允许用户通过参数进行调整。资金管理方面，EA可能包含最大持仓限制和账户权益保护机制，但需注意其止损设置是否充分。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合震荡行情，但在强趋势市场中可能面临连续亏损的风险。
EA-22274.strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a mean reversion strategy based on the Stochastic Oscillator, with the core concept of using %K and %D line crossovers combined with overbought/oversold zones to identify price reversal opportunities. Entry conditions are: buy when the %K line crosses above the %D line from the oversold zone (typically below 20), and sell when the %K line crosses below the %D line from the overbought zone (typically above 80). Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or preset take-profit and stop-loss levels, depending on the parameter configuration. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size or an equity-proportional calculation method, with users able to adjust via input parameters. Money management may include maximum position limits and account equity protection mechanisms, though the adequacy of stop-loss settings should be carefully evaluated. The overall strategy logic is clear and suitable for ranging markets, but it may face consecutive losses in strongly trending conditions.

EA-22298.name: Exp_Skyscraper_Fix_Duplex
EA-22298.summary: This EA implements a duplex (bidirectional) Skyscraper trend-following strategy that opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend identified by the Skyscraper indicator. It features fixed lot sizing, stop loss and take profit management, and trades on trend signals with a duplex mode allowing both long and short entries based on indicator direction.
EA-22298.summary_zh: 该EA实现了双向Skyscraper趋势跟踪策略，根据Skyscraper指标识别的主趋势方向开仓。具有固定手数、止损止盈管理功能，支持双向交易模式，根据指标方向允许做多和做空。
EA-22298.strategy_analysis: 该EA基于Skyscraper指标进行趋势跟踪交易，核心策略是当指标判断上升趋势时做多，判断下降趋势时做空。入场条件依赖Skyscraper指标的方向信号，当指标从看空转为看多时开多单，从看多转为看空时开空单。出场条件通过设定的止损和止盈参数实现，每个仓位都有明确的风险控制目标。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，交易者通过Lots参数设定每笔交易的手数，不进行动态加仓或减仓。资金管理方面，EA依赖止损止盈比例来控制单笔风险，但没有基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。双向(Duplex)模式允许EA在同一时间根据信号方向分别处理多头和空头仓位，增强了策略的灵活性。
EA-22298.strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the Skyscraper indicator, opening long positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and short positions when it signals a downtrend. Entry conditions rely on the Skyscraper indicator's directional signals - a bullish shift triggers buy orders while a bearish shift triggers sell orders. Exit conditions are managed through configurable stop loss and take profit parameters, providing each position with defined risk and reward targets. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the trader specifies the lot size via the Lots parameter, without dynamic position scaling. Money management depends on the stop loss/take profit ratio to control per-trade risk, but lacks account-balance-based dynamic position sizing. The Duplex mode allows the EA to independently handle both long and short positions based on signal direction, adding flexibility to the strategy execution.

EA-22300.name: Exp_JFatlCandle_MMRec
EA-22300.summary: This EA trades based on JFATL (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) candle color changes, entering long when the JFATL candle turns bullish and short when it turns bearish. It incorporates money management recommendations (MMRec) for dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk parameters, and includes trailing stop functionality for trade management.
EA-22300.summary_zh: 该EA基于JFATL（Jurik快速自适应趋势线）K线颜色变化进行交易，当JFATL K线转为看涨时做多，转为看跌时做空。它集成了资金管理推荐模块（MMRec），根据账户权益和风险参数动态计算仓位，并包含追踪止损功能进行持仓管理。
EA-22300.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于JFATL指标的趋势跟踪系统。JFATL是Jurik系列指标中的快速自适应趋势线，通过对价格数据进行平滑处理来识别趋势方向，其K线颜色变化作为趋势反转的信号。入场条件为：当JFATL K线由跌转涨（颜色从红变绿）时开多单，由涨转跌（颜色从绿变红）时开空单。出场条件包括追踪止损触发和反向信号出现时的平仓。仓位管理采用MMRec模块，根据账户净值、风险百分比和止损距离动态计算每笔交易的手数。资金管理方面支持固定手数和风险比例手数两种模式，并设有最大持仓限制和反向信号时平仓再开仓的选项。整体策略逻辑清晰，但完全依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多维度确认。
EA-22300.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a trend following system based on the JFATL indicator. JFATL is the Fast Adaptive Trend Line from the Jurik indicator series, which identifies trend direction by smoothing price data, with its candle color changes serving as trend reversal signals. Entry conditions are: open long when the JFATL candle changes from bearish to bullish (color changes from red to green), and open short when it changes from bullish to bearish (green to red). Exit conditions include trailing stop activation and position closure upon opposing signal generation. Position sizing uses the MMRec module, which dynamically calculates lot size based on account equity, risk percentage, and stop-loss distance. Money management supports both fixed lot and risk-proportional lot sizing modes, with maximum position limits and an option to close and reverse on opposing signals. The overall strategy logic is clear but relies entirely on a single indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation.

EA-22304.name: Technical Trader
EA-22304.summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover combined with a statistical support/resistance detection mechanism to generate buy and sell signals. It scans historical close prices to find levels where price has touched multiple times (resistance/support clusters) and enters trades when price is near these cluster levels and the MAs confirm trend direction. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit, executing only on new bars.
EA-22304.summary_zh: 该EA使用双均线交叉结合统计支撑/阻力检测机制来产生买卖信号。它扫描历史收盘价寻找价格多次触及的聚类水平（支撑/阻力），当价格接近这些聚类且均线确认趋势方向时入场。采用固定止损止盈管理仓位，仅在新K线形成时执行交易。
EA-22304.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双移动平均线交叉与价格聚类支撑/阻力位的结合。入场条件为：买入需短期MA(25)大于长期MA(30)且当前ask价格接近并高于阻力聚类水平（距离小于0.0005）；卖出需短期MA小于长期MA且当前bid价格接近并低于支撑聚类水平。出场条件完全依赖固定止损和止盈，没有移动止损或条件出场机制。仓位管理使用品种最小交易手数，没有加仓或减仓逻辑。资金管理方面，代码尝试检查可用保证金是否充足，但存在严重逻辑错误——margin变量未初始化就与free_margin比较，导致条件判断形同虚设。此外，0.0005的硬编码阈值对不同品种（如XAUUSD）完全不适用，买入单的magic number使用了硬编码15489而非输入参数EA_Magic，止损止盈在5/3位小数品种上乘以10的处理也可能不够准确。
EA-22304.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept combines dual moving average crossover with a price cluster-based support/resistance detection mechanism. Entry conditions require: for buys, the short-period MA(25) must be above the long-period MA(30) and the current ask price must be near and above a resistance cluster level (within 0.0005); for sells, the short MA must be below the long MA and the current bid price must be near and below a support cluster level. Exit conditions rely entirely on fixed stop loss and take profit with no trailing stop or conditional exit logic. Position sizing uses the symbol's minimum lot size with no scaling or position accumulation logic. Money management attempts to check free margin but contains a critical bug—the margin variable is used uninitialized in the comparison, making the check effectively meaningless. Additionally, the hardcoded 0.0005 threshold is completely inappropriate for instruments like XAUUSD, the buy order uses a hardcoded magic number 15489 instead of the input parameter EA_Magic, and the 5/3 digit multiplier for SL/TP may not handle all broker configurations correctly.

EA-22311.name: Exp_X2MACandle_MMRec
EA-22311.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the X2MACandle custom indicator, which generates candlestick-style signals from a double moving average crossover system. It incorporates money management with position recovery (MMRec) logic, adjusting lot sizes after losses to attempt recovery of equity.
EA-22311.summary_zh: 该EA基于X2MACandle自定义指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标通过双重均线交叉系统生成K线式信号。它内置了带有仓位恢复（MMRec）逻辑的资金管理模块，在亏损后调整手数以尝试恢复权益。
EA-22311.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于X2MACandle指标，该指标本质上是一个双重移动平均线交叉系统的可视化表达，以K线形态呈现趋势方向。入场条件为：当X2MACandle指标出现看涨K线时开多单，出现看跌K线时开空单，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。出场条件依赖于反向信号的出现或止损/止盈的触发。仓位管理方面，EA集成了MMRec（资金管理恢复）模块，当交易出现亏损时，后续交易会增大手数以尝试恢复之前的亏损，这是一种渐进式加仓的恢复机制。资金管理包含固定手数和基于账户余额的百分比计算两种模式，MMRec模块则在此基础上叠加了亏损恢复逻辑。整体而言，该策略在趋势行情中表现较好，但在震荡市中可能因频繁假信号和恢复性加仓而遭受较大回撤。
EA-22311.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the X2MACandle indicator, which is essentially a visual representation of a dual moving average crossover system rendered in candlestick form to show trend direction. Entry conditions are straightforward: a buy position is opened when the X2MACandle indicator produces a bullish candle, and a sell position when it produces a bearish candle, making it a classic trend-following approach. Exit conditions rely on the appearance of a reverse signal or the triggering of stop-loss/take-profit levels. For position sizing, the EA integrates an MMRec (Money Management Recovery) module that increases lot sizes after losing trades to attempt equity recovery, which is a progressive position enlargement mechanism. Money management supports both fixed lot and percentage-of-balance calculation modes, with the MMRec module overlaying a loss recovery logic on top. Overall, the strategy performs well in trending markets but may suffer significant drawdowns in choppy conditions due to frequent false signals compounded by recovery-based position enlargement.

EA-22346.name: Exp_Skyscraper_Fix_ColorAML
EA-22346.summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the Skyscraper indicator with a fixed ColorAML (Adaptive Moving Average with color coding). It enters long positions when the ColorAML turns bullish and the Skyscraper confirms an upward trend, and enters short positions on bearish ColorAML signals with downward trend confirmation. The system uses a fixed lot size and includes basic stop loss and take profit management.
EA-22346.summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于Skyscraper指标和固定ColorAML（自适应移动平均线带颜色编码）的趋势跟踪专家顾问。当ColorAML转为看涨且Skyscraper确认上升趋势时做多，当ColorAML转为看跌且确认下降趋势时做空。系统使用固定手数，并包含基本的止损和止盈管理。
EA-22346.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，使用ColorAML自适应移动平均线作为主要趋势方向判断工具，配合Skyscraper指标作为辅助确认。入场条件为ColorAML颜色发生方向性变化（如从下跌色转为上涨色做多），同时Skyscraper指标需确认趋势方向一致才会开仓。出场条件包括触及预设的止盈或止损水平，以及ColorAML颜色反转时也可能触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动性动态调整仓位大小的机制。资金管理方面仅依赖固定止损来控制单笔风险，缺乏整体账户风险控制如最大回撤限制或连续亏损保护。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为简单，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
EA-22346.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, utilizing the ColorAML (Adaptive Moving Average with color coding) as the primary trend direction indicator, supplemented by the Skyscraper indicator for confirmation. Entry conditions require the ColorAML to change its color directionally (e.g., from bearish to bullish color for long entries), with the Skyscraper indicator confirming the same trend direction before a position is opened. Exit conditions include hitting preset take-profit or stop-loss levels, and positions may also be closed when the ColorAML color reverses direction. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management relies solely on fixed stop-loss levels to control per-trade risk, lacking overall account risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or consecutive loss protection. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively simple, performing best in strongly trending market conditions.

EA-22353.name: MA Envelopes
EA-22353.summary: MA Envelopes draws upper and lower bands around a moving average at a user-defined percentage deviation, visually identifying overbought and oversold zones. It does not open or manage trades on its own but serves as a technical reference tool for mean-reversion strategies. Traders typically use envelope touches or penetrations as signals for potential price reversals back toward the moving average centerline.
EA-22353.summary_zh: MA Envelopes围绕移动均线按用户设定的百分比偏移绘制上下轨，视觉上标识超买和超卖区域。该程序本身不开仓或管理交易，而是作为均值回归策略的技术参考工具。交易者通常以触及或突破通道边界作为价格向均线中轨回归反转的信号。
EA-22353.strategy_analysis: MA Envelopes的核心概念是基于移动均线的百分比包络线，上轨和下轨分别位于均线值的(1+deviation%)和(1-deviation%)位置。当价格触及或突破上轨时视为超买区域，暗示价格可能向下回归均线中轨，为潜在做空信号；反之触及或突破下轨视为超卖区域，为潜在做多信号。入场条件通常为价格从包络线外向内回归时进场，出场条件为价格回到均线中轨附近或达到目标利润。仓位管理与资金管理由交易者自行决定，该指标本身不提供任何仓位或资金管理功能。该指标支持多种均线类型（SMA、EMA、SMMA、LWMA）和多时间周期应用，但缺乏动态波动率调整机制如ATR，在极端行情中包络带宽可能不足。整体而言，这是一个经典但基础的均值回归参考工具，需要配合其他指标和风控手段使用。
EA-22353.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of MA Envelopes is percentage-based bands around a moving average, where the upper band sits at MA×(1+deviation%) and the lower band at MA×(1-deviation%). When price touches or breaches the upper band, it signals an overbought condition suggesting a potential reversion downward toward the centerline MA, serving as a potential short entry signal; conversably, touching or breaching the lower band signals oversold conditions for a potential long entry. Entry conditions typically involve price reversing from outside the envelope back inward, while exit conditions target the centerline MA or a predefined profit objective. Position sizing and money management are entirely left to the trader's discretion, as the indicator itself provides no trade execution or risk management capabilities. The tool supports multiple MA types (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA) and can be applied across timeframes, but it lacks dynamic volatility adjustment such as ATR-based band width, making the envelope potentially too narrow during extreme market conditions. Overall, this is a classic but foundational mean-reversion reference tool that requires complementary indicators and risk management practices to be effective.

EA-22372.summary: This EA is based on the Skyscraper trend-following indicator combined with a ColorAML (Adaptive Moving Linear Regression) filter and fixed lot sizing with money management recommendations. It enters trades in the direction of the Skyscraper trend when confirmed by the ColorAML slope, and uses ATR-based or fixed stop loss/take profit levels for exits. The 'MMRec' component provides money management recommendations for position sizing.
EA-22372.summary_zh: 该EA基于Skyscraper趋势指标与ColorAML（自适应移动线性回归）过滤器组合，采用固定手数及资金管理建议。当ColorAML斜率确认Skyscraper趋势方向时入场，使用基于ATR或固定止损/止盈水平出场。MMRec组件提供仓位管理的资金管理建议。
EA-22372.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是结合Skyscraper趋势指标和ColorAML自适应移动线性回归线进行双重过滤的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：Skyscraper指标显示上升趋势且ColorAML斜率为正时做多，Skyscraper显示下降趋势且ColorAML斜率为负时做空，双重确认降低了假信号的概率。出场条件包括固定止损止盈和ATR动态止损，能够在趋势反转时及时退出。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，但MMRec模块根据账户余额和风险比例提供手数建议，帮助控制每笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理方面，EA建议每笔交易风险不超过账户余额的1-2%，通过合理的手数计算来平衡收益与风险。整体策略逻辑清晰，双指标过滤有效减少了震荡行情中的虚假信号。
EA-22372.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a dual-filter trend following system combining the Skyscraper trend indicator with the ColorAML (Adaptive Moving Linear Regression) line. Entry conditions: go long when Skyscraper shows an uptrend AND ColorAML slope is positive; go short when Skyscraper shows a downtrend AND ColorAML slope is negative, with the dual confirmation reducing false signal probability. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss/take profit and ATR-based dynamic stops, allowing timely exits on trend reversals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot mode, but the MMRec module provides lot size recommendations based on account balance and risk ratio, helping control risk exposure per trade. In terms of money management, the EA recommends risking no more than 1-2% of account balance per trade, balancing returns and risk through proper lot calculation. The overall strategy logic is clear, and the dual-indicator filtering effectively reduces false signals during ranging markets.

EA-22384.name: BARS Alligator
EA-22384.summary: This EA trades based on Bill Williams' Alligator indicator, opening positions when the Alligator lips, teeth, and jaw lines diverge indicating a trending market. It enters long when price is above all three smoothed moving averages and short when below, exiting when the lines converge or cross. The system is a classic trend-following approach using the Alligator's sleep/awake phases to filter trades.
EA-22384.summary_zh: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标进行交易，当鳄鱼的唇线、齿线和颚线发散时表明市场进入趋势状态而开仓。价格在三条平滑移动平均线之上时做多，之下时做空，当线条收敛或交叉时平仓。该系统是经典的趋势跟踪方法，利用鳄鱼指标的沉睡/觉醒阶段来过滤交易信号。
EA-22384.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于比尔·威廉姆斯鳄鱼指标，通过三条不同周期的平滑移动平均线（颚线13周期、齿线8周期、唇线5周期）的收敛与发散来判断市场趋势状态。入场条件为：当三条线从纠缠状态开始向上发散且价格位于唇线之上时做多，向下发散且价格位于唇线之下时做空。出场条件为：当三条线开始收敛或交叉时平仓，表示趋势可能结束。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算，部分版本支持加仓逻辑。资金管理方面，该EA依赖鳄鱼指标的持续发散来持仓获利，在震荡市中三条线纠缠时会避免开仓从而减少虚假信号带来的亏损。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺乏明确的止损机制，在趋势反转时可能承受较大回撤。
EA-22384.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bill Williams' Alligator indicator, using three smoothed moving averages (Jaw 13-period, Teeth 8-period, Lips 5-period) and their convergence/divergence to determine market trend phases. Entry conditions: go long when the three lines begin diverging upward from an entangled state and price is above the Lips line; go short when they diverge downward and price is below the Lips line. Exit conditions: close positions when the three lines start converging or crossing, signaling the trend may be ending. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or a percentage of account equity, with some versions supporting pyramiding logic. Money management relies on the Alligator's sustained divergence to hold profitable positions, while avoiding entries during ranging markets when the lines are entangled, thus reducing losses from false signals. The overall strategy logic is clear, but the lack of explicit stop-loss mechanisms means the EA may suffer significant drawdowns during trend reversals.

EA-22391.name: Exp_Skyscraper_Fix_ColorAML_X2MACandle_MMRec
EA-22391.summary: This EA combines three independent signal sources — Skyscraper (trend filter), ColorAML (adaptive moving average line), and X2MACandle (dual MA crossover candles) — to generate confluence-based trade entries. It integrates a money management recommendation module (MMRec) for dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk parameters. Trades are opened only when multiple indicators align in the same direction across different analytical dimensions.
EA-22391.summary_zh: 该EA融合三个独立信号源——Skyscraper（趋势过滤）、ColorAML（自适应移动平均线）和X2MACandle（双MA交叉K线）——产生基于共振的交易入场信号。集成了资金管理推荐模块（MMRec），根据账户净值和风险参数进行动态仓位管理。只有当多个指标在不同分析维度上同向对齐时才会开仓。
EA-22391.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多重指标共振确认，要求Skyscraper趋势方向、ColorAML自适应均线方向和X2MACandle双均线K线信号三者一致才触发交易。入场条件为三个信号同向看多时做多，同向看空时做空，这种多重过滤大幅减少了虚假信号。出场条件依赖反向信号出现或固定止损止盈，具体取决于各指标的参数配置。仓位管理采用MMRec模块，根据账户余额、风险百分比和止损距离动态计算手数，实现风险可控的资金管理。资金管理方面支持固定手数和动态手数两种模式，动态模式下每笔交易的风险金额占账户的比例被严格控制。该策略的核心优势在于多维度信号过滤降低了假突破概率，但同时也意味着在趋势初期可能因等待共振确认而错过部分利润。
EA-22391.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on multi-indicator confluence confirmation, requiring alignment of Skyscraper trend direction, ColorAML adaptive moving average direction, and X2MACandle dual-MA crossover candle signals before triggering trades. Entry conditions dictate a long position when all three signals are bullish and a short position when all three are bearish, significantly reducing false signals through multiple filtering layers. Exit conditions rely on the appearance of opposing signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels, depending on each indicator's parameter configuration. Position sizing employs the MMRec module which dynamically calculates lot size based on account balance, risk percentage, and stop-loss distance, ensuring risk-controlled money management. The money management system supports both fixed lot and dynamic lot modes, with the dynamic mode strictly controlling the percentage of account equity risked per trade. The core strength of this strategy is that multi-dimensional signal filtering reduces false breakout probability, but it also means potentially missing early trend profits while waiting for confluence confirmation.

EA-22392.name: Exp_BrainTrend2_AbsolutelyNoLagLwma_X2MACandle_MMRec
EA-22392.summary: This EA combines BrainTrend2 signal indicators with AbsolutelyNoLagLwma and X2MACandle indicators to generate trend-following trade entries. It uses a money management recovery (MMRec) system that adjusts lot sizes based on previous trade outcomes. The strategy opens positions when multiple indicators confirm the same trend direction.
EA-22392.summary_zh: 该EA结合BrainTrend2信号指标、AbsolutelyNoLagLwma和X2MACandle指标生成趋势跟踪交易信号。它采用资金管理恢复(MMRec)系统，根据前次交易结果调整仓位大小。当多个指标确认同一趋势方向时开仓。
EA-22392.strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个多指标确认的趋势跟踪系统，核心策略依赖三个指标的协同信号：BrainTrend2作为主趋势方向判断，AbsolutelyNoLagLwma作为零滞后均线过滤器，X2MACandle作为MACD蜡烛图形态确认。入场条件要求三个指标同时发出同向信号才开仓，例如BrainTrend2看涨、AbsolutelyNoLagLwma向上、X2MACandle为阳线时做多。出场条件通常为指标信号反转或达到止损/止盈目标。仓位管理采用MMRec机制，在连续亏损后尝试通过调整仓位大小来恢复资金，这是一种类似于马丁格尔的递增仓位策略。资金管理方面支持固定手数和基于账户余额的动态计算两种模式。该EA的止损和止盈参数可配置，但MMRec恢复机制在极端行情下可能带来较大风险。
EA-22392.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a multi-indicator confirmation trend-following system whose core strategy relies on the synergy of three indicators: BrainTrend2 as the primary trend direction filter, AbsolutelyNoLagLwma as a zero-lag moving average filter, and X2MACandle as a MACD candlestick pattern confirmation. Entry conditions require all three indicators to emit a signal in the same direction simultaneously — for example, a long position is opened when BrainTrend2 signals bullish, AbsolutelyNoLagLwma points upward, and X2MACandle shows a bullish candle. Exit conditions are typically triggered by indicator signal reversals or reaching configured stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing employs an MMRec (Money Management Recovery) mechanism that adjusts lot sizes after consecutive losses in an attempt to recover account equity, which is akin to a martingale-style progressive position sizing approach. Money management supports both fixed lot and dynamic balance-based calculation modes. While the EA provides configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters, the MMRec recovery mechanism can introduce significant risk during extreme market conditions.

EA-22398.summary: This EA uses two Simple Moving Averages (SMA 5 and SMA 25) to generate buy signals based on the deviation between the short-period MA and close price, combined with an upward MA slope condition. It operates on new bar events, executes market buy orders with fixed stop loss and MA-based take profit, and trades at minimum volume. The sell logic is entirely commented out, making it a buy-only scalping system.
EA-22398.summary_zh: 该EA使用两条简单移动均线（SMA5和SMA25）生成买入信号，入场条件基于短期均线与收盘价的偏离值及均线上斜条件。它在新K线事件上运行，以固定止损和均线目标价执行市价买单，并以最小手数交易。卖出逻辑被完全注释掉，使其成为一个仅做多的剥头皮系统。
EA-22398.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于短期均线与价格之间的偏离作为波动性信号，当偏离值超过阈值（-0.0015）且短期均线呈上斜趋势时触发买入。入场条件为：val[0]（MA5与收盘价之差）小于-0.0015，且MA_Val1[0]大于MA_Val1[2]，表示价格低于均线且均线上升。出场条件依赖固定止损（15点，5/3位小数经纪商自动调整）和以MA5当前值作为止盈。仓位管理使用SymbolInfoDouble获取最小交易手数，未实现任何加仓或仓位调整逻辑。资金管理部分存在严重缺陷：margin变量未初始化即与free_margin比较，实际上条件判断形同虚设，几乎总是通过。卖出逻辑被完全注释掉，EA只做多不做空，策略不完整。
EA-22398.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept uses the deviation between a short-period SMA (period 5) and the close price as a volatility signal, triggering a buy when the deviation exceeds a threshold (-0.0015) and the MA is sloping upward. Entry conditions require val[0] (MA5 minus close) to be less than -0.0015, and MA_Val1[0] greater than MA_Val1[2], indicating the price is below the moving average while the MA is rising — a mean-reversion-within-trend approach. Exit conditions rely on a fixed stop loss of 15 points (auto-adjusted for 5/3-digit brokers) and the current MA5 value as take profit. Position sizing uses the broker's minimum lot size with no scaling or accumulation logic. Money management has a critical flaw: the margin variable is declared but never initialized before comparison with free_margin, making the margin check effectively useless since an uninitialized double could be anything. The sell logic is entirely commented out, leaving the EA as buy-only, making the strategy incomplete and asymmetric.

EA-22409.name: Autotrader Momentum
EA-22409.summary: This EA implements a simple momentum strategy by comparing the close price of a user-specified current bar against a user-specified comparable bar. When price rises over the lookback period it opens a buy; when price falls it opens a sell, always closing the opposite position first. It includes configurable stop loss, take profit, trailing stop with step, and margin checks before order placement.
EA-22409.summary_zh: 该EA实现了简单的动量策略，通过比较用户指定的当前K线收盘价与可比较K线收盘价来判断方向。价格上涨时开多单并平空单，价格下跌时开空单并平多单。EA包含可配置的止损、止盈、追踪止损及保证金检查功能。
EA-22409.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于纯动量比较：如果当前K线收盘价高于N根K线前的收盘价则判定为上涨动量开多，反之判定为下跌动量开空。入场条件为close_array[InpCurrentBar] > close_array[InpComparableBar]时做多，close_array[InpCurrentBar] < close_array[InpComparableBar]时做空，仅在新K线诞生时执行交易逻辑。出场条件包括固定止损止盈（默认各50点）以及追踪止损（默认5点最小距离加5点步长），开反向仓前会先平掉同品种同魔数的反向持仓。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（默认1手），通过CheckVolumeValue函数验证手数是否符合品种最小/最大手数及步长要求。资金管理方面在开仓前调用FreeMarginCheck检查可用保证金是否充足，不足则拒绝开仓。整体策略逻辑非常简单直接，缺乏趋势过滤器、波动率过滤和多时间框架确认。
EA-22409.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on pure price momentum comparison: if the close price of a user-designated current bar is higher than the close price of a comparable bar N periods ago, the EA detects upward momentum and opens a buy; if lower, it detects downward momentum and opens a sell. Entry conditions are straightforward — close_array[InpCurrentBar] > close_array[InpComparableBar] triggers a long entry, and the reverse triggers a short entry, with trading logic executed only on new bar birth. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit (both defaulting to 50 pips), plus a trailing stop mechanism with configurable minimum distance (5 pips) and step (5 pips); opposite positions are closed before opening a new directional position. Position sizing uses a fixed lot mode (default 1.0 lot) with validation through CheckVolumeValue to ensure compliance with symbol minimum/maximum lot size and lot step requirements. Money management incorporates a FreeMarginCheck call before order placement to verify sufficient available margin, rejecting orders if margin is insufficient. The overall strategy is very simple and direct, lacking trend filters, volatility filters, multi-timeframe confirmation, or any advanced momentum indicators like RSI or MACD.

EA-22429.name: Exp_TimeZonePivotsOpenSystem
EA-22429.summary: This EA calculates pivot points based on a configurable time zone session and trades the open of a new session relative to the pivot levels. It enters long when the session opens above the pivot and short when it opens below, targeting S1/R1 levels with stop losses placed beyond S2/R2, implementing a classic time-zone pivot open system.
EA-22429.summary_zh: 该EA基于可配置时区时段计算支点(Pivot)价位，并在新时段开盘时根据价格与支点的关系进行交易。时段开盘价高于支点则做多，低于支点则做空，目标为S1/R1，止损设于S2/R2之外，实现了经典的时区支点开盘系统。
EA-22429.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于时段支点理论，利用特定时区的开盘价与当日支点的关系判断方向偏好。入场条件为：新时段开盘时，若开盘价高于中央支点(Pivot)则做多，若低于支点则做空，这是一种趋势确认型的开盘突破策略。出场条件包括：盈利目标设于第一支撑/阻力位(S1/R1)，止损设于第二支撑/阻力位(S2/R2)之外，风险回报比合理。仓位管理方面，EA提供了手数参数供用户配置，但未见到基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理依赖于固定止损和止盈目标，风险可控但缺乏头寸规模化的自适应能力。整体策略逻辑清晰，结合了时段特性和支点理论，适合流动性较好的时段开盘交易。
EA-22429.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on time-zone pivot theory, using the relationship between the session open price and the daily pivot to determine directional bias. Entry conditions: at the open of a new configured time zone session, if the open price is above the central pivot, a long position is initiated; if below the pivot, a short is taken, making this a trend-confirmation open breakout approach. Exit conditions: take-profit targets are set at the first support/resistance levels (S1/R1), while stop losses are placed beyond the second support/resistance levels (S2/R2), providing a reasonable risk-reward ratio. Position sizing relies on a user-configured lot size parameter without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management depends on fixed stop-loss and take-profit targets, which keeps risk defined but lacks adaptive position scaling. Overall, the strategy logic is clear and combines session characteristics with pivot point theory, making it suitable for trading session opens in liquid markets.

EA-22458.name: RSI Expert v2.0
EA-22458.summary: This EA trades RSI overbought/oversold reversals, opening buy positions when RSI dips below a configurable oversold threshold and sell positions when RSI rises above an overbought threshold. It includes basic stop-loss and take-profit management along with position sizing controls. The strategy targets mean-reversion opportunities on trending or ranging markets where RSI extremes signal potential price reversals.
EA-22458.summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI超买超卖信号进行均值回归交易，当RSI跌破可配置的超卖阈值时开多仓，当RSI升破超买阈值时开空仓。EA包含基本的止损止盈管理和仓位控制功能，旨在捕捉RSI极端值预示的价格反转机会。
EA-22458.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于RSI指标的均值回归原理，认为当RSI进入超买或超卖区域后价格有回归均值的倾向。入场条件为RSI跌破超卖阈值时做多、升破超买阈值时做空，属于典型的逆势交易策略。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈设定，未见到移动止损或动态出场的机制。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式，缺乏根据市场波动率调整仓位的自适应机制。资金管理方面仅依靠止损设定控制单笔风险，未实现多笔交易间的总体风险控制或最大回撤限制。策略在强趋势市场中容易遭遇连续亏损，因为RSI可能长期停留在超买或超卖区域而不发生回归。
EA-22458.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is grounded in mean reversion principles of the RSI indicator, assuming that prices tend to revert to the mean after RSI reaches extreme overbought or oversold levels. Entry conditions trigger a buy when RSI falls below the oversold threshold and a sell when RSI rises above the overbought threshold, representing a classic counter-trend trading approach. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism observed. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or a balance-based percentage calculation, lacking adaptive sizing based on market volatility such as ATR. Money management is limited to per-trade risk control via stop-loss, without portfolio-level risk controls or maximum drawdown limits. The strategy is vulnerable to consecutive losses in strong trending markets where RSI can remain in overbought or oversold zones for extended periods without reverting.

It opens positions when price momentum aligns with the prevailing trend identified by its indicator calculations. The EA operates systematically with fixed lot sizing and implements basic stop loss and take profit for trade management.
EA-22465.summary_zh: Two PerBar是一个趋势跟踪型EA，每个K线最多产生两个交易信号，利用基于移动平均线的趋势检测来确定交易方向。当价格动量与其指标计算识别出的主导趋势一致时开仓。该EA采用系统化固定手数交易，并实现基本的止损止盈来管理仓位。
EA-22465.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于每根K线最多产生两个交易信号的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件依赖于移动平均线交叉或趋势方向判断，当短期均线与长期均线关系确认趋势方向时入场做多或做空。出场条件通过预设的止损和止盈水平来实现，当价格触及目标或止损时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或风险比例进行动态调整。资金管理相对简单，没有包含复杂的资金管理算法或风险控制机制，主要依赖止损来控制单笔风险。
EA-22465.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a trend-following system that generates at most two trade signals per bar. Entry conditions rely on moving average crossover or trend direction determination, entering long or short when the relationship between short-term and long-term moving averages confirms the trend direction. Exit conditions are implemented through preset stop loss and take profit levels, closing positions when price reaches the target or stop. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk ratio. Money management is relatively simple, lacking complex money management algorithms or risk control mechanisms, primarily relying on stop losses to control per-trade risk. The two-signals-per-bar limit helps prevent overtrading while still allowing the system to capture intra-bar opportunities.

EA-22471.name: Probe
EA-22471.summary: Probe is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that uses the Force Index and moving average convergence to detect impulsive market moves. It enters trades in the direction of strong momentum shifts and exits when momentum fades or a trailing stop is hit. The EA is designed for medium-term trading on major currency pairs.
EA-22471.summary_zh: Probe是一个基于动量的专家顾问，使用力度指标和均线收敛来检测市场脉冲运动。它在强动量转换方向上入场，当动量消退或触及追踪止损时出场。该EA专为主要货币对的中期交易而设计。
EA-22471.strategy_analysis: Probe EA的策略核心是基于力度指标(Force Index)的动量突破交易。入场条件为：当力度指标突破其移动平均线且价格位于关键均线之上时做多，反之做空。出场条件包括：力度指标反向穿越其均线、固定止损/止盈触发、或追踪止损被触及。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，用户可通过参数调整每笔交易的风险比例。资金管理方面，EA提供了最大持仓限制和每日最大亏损限制，以防止连续亏损导致账户大幅回撤。整体策略偏向趋势跟踪与动量确认相结合的中周期交易方式。
EA-22471.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Probe EA is momentum breakout trading based on the Force Index indicator. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the Force Index crosses above its moving average and price is above a key moving average, and vice versa for short positions. Exit conditions include the Force Index crossing back below its moving average, fixed stop-loss or take-profit being triggered, or a trailing stop being hit. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model, with users able to adjust the risk ratio per trade via input parameters. For money management, the EA provides maximum position limits and daily maximum loss limits to prevent consecutive losses from causing significant account drawdowns. The overall strategy combines trend-following with momentum confirmation for medium-term trading.

EA-22477.name: Exp_Hans_Indicator_Cloud_System
EA-22477.summary: This EA implements the Hans Indicator Cloud System, a session-based breakout strategy that trades based on price breaking above or below a cloud (channel) formed by the Hans indicator. It identifies trading ranges during specific time windows and enters positions when price breaks out of the established cloud boundaries.
EA-22477.summary_zh: 该EA实现了Hans指标云系统，一种基于时段的突破策略。它在特定时间窗口内识别交易区间，当价格突破已建立的云边界时入场交易。
EA-22477.strategy_analysis: Hans指标云系统策略基于时段突破概念，核心是在特定交易时段（通常为亚洲/欧洲时段）内确定价格波动范围形成云带。入场条件为价格突破云带上轨时做多，突破云带下轨时做空，属于典型的区间突破策略。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损或云带反向穿越。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的方式。资金管理方面存在一定不足，未见到动态仓位调整或基于波动率的头寸规模计算。该策略的优势在于逻辑清晰、规则明确，但风险在于震荡行情中可能出现频繁假突破导致连续亏损。
EA-22477.strategy_analysis_en: The Hans Indicator Cloud System strategy is based on a session breakout concept, where the core idea is to identify a price volatility range during specific trading sessions (typically Asian/European sessions) forming a cloud band. Entry conditions are going long when price breaks above the upper cloud boundary and going short when price breaks below the lower cloud boundary, representing a classic range breakout strategy. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or reverse cloud penetration signals. Position sizing employs fixed lot sizes or account equity percentage-based methods. Money management has some deficiencies as there is no dynamic position adjustment or volatility-based position sizing calculation. The strategy's strength lies in its clear logic and well-defined rules, but the risk is that frequent false breakouts in ranging markets can lead to consecutive losses.

EA-22478.name: Exp_Hans_Indicator_Cloud_System_Tm_Plus
EA-22478.summary: This EA implements the Hans Indicator Cloud System, a multi-timeframe trading strategy that uses Ichimoku-style cloud analysis across different timeframes to identify trend direction and entry points. It incorporates a time manager (Tm) module for session-based trading and a Plus module for additional signal filtering, making trading decisions based on cloud breakouts and price-cloud interactions.
EA-22478.summary_zh: 该EA实现了Hans指标云系统，一种基于多周期Ichimoku风格云图分析的交易策略，通过不同时间周期的云图判断趋势方向和入场时机。它集成了时间管理器(Tm)模块用于时段交易控制，以及Plus模块用于额外信号过滤，基于云图突破和价格与云图的关系做出交易决策。
EA-22478.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Hans指标云系统，这是一种改良的Ichimoku云图方法，通过多条移位均线构建支撑阻力云带来判断趋势。入场条件：当价格从云图下方突破云带上沿时做多，从云图上方跌破云带下沿时做空；同时结合多周期确认，要求更高时间周期趋势方向一致才入场。出场条件包括价格反向穿越云图、止损止盈触发、以及时间管理器强制平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损设置和最大持仓控制，但具体的资金管理严谨程度取决于参数配置。时间管理器模块允许用户指定交易时段，避免在低流动性或高波动时段开仓。Plus模块提供额外的信号过滤，减少假突破带来的亏损交易。
EA-22478.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Hans Indicator Cloud System, which is a modified Ichimoku cloud approach that constructs support-resistance cloud bands using multiple shifted moving averages to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: go long when price breaks above the upper cloud band from below, and go short when price breaks below the lower cloud band from above; multi-timeframe confirmation is required, meaning the higher timeframe trend must align with the entry direction. Exit conditions include price crossing back through the cloud in the opposite direction, stop-loss or take-profit being hit, and forced closure by the time manager module. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity. Money management features include stop-loss settings and maximum position controls, though the rigor of money management depends on parameter configuration. The Time Manager module allows users to specify trading sessions, avoiding opening positions during low-liquidity or high-volatility periods. The Plus module provides additional signal filtering to reduce losing trades caused by false breakouts.

EA-22479.name: Exp_TimeZonePivotsOpenSystem_Tm_Plus
EA-22479.summary: This EA trades based on time-zone pivot point levels, opening positions when price breaks above or below pivot-derived support and resistance levels calculated from a configurable time zone session. It incorporates an open system logic with trailing modification (Tm Plus) for dynamic stop management, aiming to capture intraday moves from pivot breakout and reversal setups.
EA-22479.summary_zh: 该EA基于时区支点水平进行交易，当价格突破或跌破由可配置时区会话计算的支点支撑和阻力位时开仓。它采用开放系统逻辑并带有跟踪止损修改（Tm Plus）功能，旨在捕捉支点突破和反转形态的日内波动。
EA-22479.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于时区支点计算，根据用户指定时区的开盘价、最高价、最低价和收盘价计算经典支点水平（PP、S1-S3、R1-R3）。入场条件为价格突破阻力位做多或跌破支撑位做空，属于支点突破与反转结合的策略。出场条件包括达到止盈目标、触发止损或通过Tm Plus跟踪止损机制动态平仓。仓位管理通过手数参数控制，支持固定手数或基于资金比例的下单方式。资金管理方面，EA依赖支点位的统计有效性进行交易，但未见明显的动态仓位调整或风险比例控制机制，止盈止损设置相对静态。
EA-22479.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on time-zone pivot point calculation, computing classic pivot levels (PP, S1-S3, R1-R3) from the open, high, low, and close prices of a user-specified time zone session. Entry conditions trigger long positions when price breaks above resistance levels and short positions when price breaks below support levels, combining pivot breakout and reversal logic. Exit conditions include reaching take-profit targets, hitting stop-loss levels, or dynamic closure through the Tm Plus trailing stop modification mechanism. Position sizing is controlled via lot size parameters, supporting fixed lot or balance-proportional ordering. Money management relies on the statistical validity of pivot levels for trade decisions, but lacks obvious dynamic position adjustment or risk-proportion control mechanisms, with relatively static take-profit and stop-loss settings.

EA-22480.name: Exp_XWPR_Histogram_Vol
EA-22480.summary: This EA trades based on the XWPR histogram indicator, which is an enhanced Williams' Percent Range displayed as a histogram around a zero line. Volume confirmation is required before entry, ensuring that momentum signals are supported by actual market participation. The EA opens positions when the WPR histogram crosses the zero line and volume conditions are met.
EA-22480.summary_zh: 该EA基于XWPR直方图指标进行交易，该指标是增强版的威廉百分比范围指标，以零线为中心的直方图形式展示。入场需要成交量确认，确保动量信号有实际市场参与支撑。当WPR直方图穿越零线且满足成交量条件时，EA开仓交易。
EA-22480.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于威廉百分比范围(WPR)指标的直方图模式，将传统的超买超卖指标转换为以零线为中心的动量直方图，使趋势判断更加直观。入场条件为：XWPR直方图从负值区域上穿零线时做多，从正值区域下穿零线时做空，同时要求成交量指标确认趋势的可靠性。出场条件依赖反向信号的出现，即直方图反向穿越零线时平仓，或通过止损/止盈参数控制风险。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，由用户通过InpLot参数设定，未包含动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数，但缺乏整体账户风险控制机制如最大回撤限制或账户权益保护。该策略的核心优势在于结合动量与成交量双重过滤，能有效过滤虚假突破信号。
EA-22480.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Williams Percent Range (WPR) indicator displayed in histogram mode, transforming the traditional overbought/oversold oscillator into a zero-centered momentum histogram for more intuitive trend identification. Entry conditions require the XWPR histogram to cross above the zero line from negative territory for long positions, and below the zero line from positive territory for short positions, with volume confirmation mandatory to validate the momentum signal. Exit conditions rely on the appearance of a reverse signal, meaning positions are closed when the histogram crosses the zero line in the opposite direction, or through user-configured stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach controlled by the InpLot parameter, without any dynamic lot sizing based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters but lacks comprehensive account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits, equity protection, or trailing stop mechanisms. The core strength of this strategy lies in combining momentum and volume dual filtering, which effectively reduces false breakout signals that plague single-indicator systems.
pros: 动量与成交量双重过滤机制，有效减少虚假信号
直方图模式使WPR信号更直观，零线穿越逻辑清晰
系统化执行无情感干扰，入场出场规则明确
成交量确认增加了信号的可靠性，避免低流动性市场的误导
参数设计简洁，用户可快速理解并调整

EA-22481.name: Exp_XWPR_Histogram_Vol_Direct
EA-22481.summary: This Expert Advisor trades based on the XWPR (Williams' Percent Range) histogram indicator with volume confirmation and direct signal processing. It enters long positions when the WPR histogram shows bullish momentum supported by volume, and short positions on bearish momentum with volume confirmation, using a direct trading approach without position reversal.
EA-22481.summary_zh: 该EA基于XWPR（威廉百分比范围）直方图指标配合成交量确认进行直接信号交易。当WPR直方图显示多头动量且有成交量配合时做多，显示空头动量且有成交量配合时做空，采用直接交易方式不做仓位反转。
EA-22481.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于威廉百分比范围（WPR）指标的直方图形式，结合成交量过滤来确认交易信号的有效性。入场条件为：WPR直方图从负值区域向上穿越信号线且成交量放大时开多单；WPR直方图从正值区域向下穿越信号线且成交量放大时开空单。该EA采用直接交易模式（Direct），即收到信号后直接开仓而非反转现有头寸。出场方面依赖固定止损和止盈参数，同时可能包含移动止损功能来保护利润。仓位管理通过手数参数控制，支持固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和止损保护，但具体的风控细节取决于参数配置的合理性。
EA-22481.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator displayed in histogram form, combined with volume filtering to confirm signal validity. Entry conditions are: go long when the WPR histogram crosses above its signal line from negative territory with increasing volume; go short when the histogram crosses below its signal line from positive territory with increasing volume. The EA employs a direct trading mode (Direct), meaning it opens new positions upon signal rather than reversing existing ones. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit parameters, and may include a trailing stop feature to protect accumulated profits. Position sizing is controlled through lot size parameters, supporting either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management includes maximum position limits and stop loss protection, though the effectiveness of risk controls depends heavily on the reasonableness of parameter configuration.
pros: 成交量过滤有效减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
直接交易模式逻辑清晰，避免反转交易带来的复杂性和额外风险

cons_en: WPR indicator tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to repeated stop-outs

Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
No spread filter, making stop losses vulnerable to being triggered in high-spread environments

增加点差过滤和滑点控制，避免在高成本环境下开仓

Implement market regime detection (trend/range) to automatically pause trading or reduce position size in ranging markets

EA-22489.name: Exp_VortexIndicator_Duplex
EA-22489.summary: This EA trades based on the Vortex Indicator, which identifies trend direction by comparing positive and negative directional movement. It opens buy positions when the positive vortex line crosses above the negative line, and sell positions on the reverse crossover. The 'Duplex' variant likely operates on both entry and exit signals derived from the same indicator crossover logic.
EA-22489.summary_zh: 该EA基于涡旋指标(Vortex Indicator)进行交易，通过正负方向运动线的交叉来判断趋势方向。当正方向线上穿负方向线时开多仓，反之开空仓。Duplex版本可能在入场和出场两端都使用同一指标的交叉信号。
EA-22489.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于Vortex Indicator的趋势跟踪系统。Vortex Indicator由VI+（正向运动线）和VI-（负向运动线）两条线组成，当VI+上穿VI-时表示上升趋势启动，产生做多信号；当VI-上穿VI+时表示下降趋势启动，产生做空信号。入场条件完全依赖这两条线的交叉，属于典型的趋势跟随型策略。出场条件同样基于反向交叉信号，即持有多头时VI-上穿VI+则平仓，持有空头时VI+上穿VI-则平仓，这体现了Duplex双向交易的设计理念。仓位管理方面，EA提供了手数(Lot)参数供用户设置固定交易量，但没有看到基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位计算功能。资金管理方面，EA可能提供了止损和止盈参数，但核心依赖指标反转信号出场，趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-22489.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the Vortex Indicator. The Vortex Indicator consists of two lines: VI+ (positive directional movement) and VI- (negative directional movement). When VI+ crosses above VI-, it signals the start of an uptrend and generates a buy signal; when VI- crosses above VI+, it signals a downtrend and generates a sell signal. Entry conditions rely entirely on these crossover events, making it a classic trend-following approach. Exit conditions are also based on reverse crossovers — a long position is closed when VI- crosses above VI+, and a short position is closed when VI+ crosses above VI-, reflecting the Duplex dual-direction trading design. Position sizing uses a fixed lot parameter provided by the user, without dynamic lot calculation based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management may include stop-loss and take-profit parameters, but the primary exit mechanism relies on indicator reversal signals, which means the strategy is vulnerable to whipsaw losses in ranging or choppy markets.

EA-22490.name: Exp_ColorMETRO_Duplex
EA-22490.summary: This EA is a duplex (bi-directional) trading system based on the ColorMETRO momentum indicator. It opens trades in both directions when the indicator's color changes signal momentum shifts, operating on dual signal logic for long and short entries.
EA-22490.summary_zh: 该EA是基于ColorMETRO动量指标的双向交易系统。当指标颜色变化发出动量转向信号时，EA在两个方向上开仓交易，采用双信号逻辑进行多头和空头入场。
EA-22490.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用ColorMETRO动量指标作为核心信号源，通过指标颜色变化判断动量方向的转换。入场条件为ColorMETRO指标颜色从一种状态切换到另一种状态时，分别触发多头或空头入场信号。作为Duplex（双向）系统，EA可同时在两个方向上捕捉信号，具备做多和做空的独立逻辑。出场条件依赖于指标的反向信号或内置的止损/止盈机制。仓位管理通过手数参数控制，但具体是否包含资金管理逻辑取决于参数配置。整体策略以动量跟随为核心，在指标确认趋势转向时进场，在动量消退或反转时离场。
EA-22490.strategy_analysis_en: The EA uses the ColorMETRO momentum indicator as its core signal source, determining momentum direction shifts through indicator color changes. Entry conditions are triggered when the ColorMETRO indicator switches from one color state to another, generating long or short entry signals respectively. As a Duplex (bi-directional) system, the EA can capture signals in both directions with independent long and short logic. Exit conditions rely on the indicator's reverse signal or built-in stop-loss/take-profit mechanisms. Position sizing is controlled through lot size parameters, though whether money management logic is included depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy centers on momentum following, entering when the indicator confirms a trend shift and exiting when momentum fades or reverses.

EA-22491.name: Exp_ColorMaRsi-Trigger_Duplex
EA-22491.summary: This EA trades based on a duplex (dual) signal system combining colored Moving Average trend direction with RSI momentum triggers. It opens buy positions when the colored MA indicates uptrend and RSI confirms momentum, and sells when the colored MA indicates downtrend and RSI confirms overbought momentum reversal.
EA-22491.summary_zh: 该EA基于双重信号系统进行交易，结合彩色均线趋势方向与RSI动量触发器。当彩色均线指示上升趋势且RSI确认动量时开多仓，当彩色均线指示下降趋势且RSI确认超买卖动量反转时开空仓。
EA-22491.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双重确认机制：彩色均线（ColorMa）提供趋势方向判断，RSI指标提供动量触发信号，两者结合形成入场条件。入场条件为：多头入场需要彩色均线变为上升趋势颜色且RSI从超卖区域上穿触发线；空头入场需要彩色均线变为下降趋势颜色且RSI从超买区域下穿触发线。出场条件包括：反向信号出现时平仓、止损止盈触发、或RSI背离时退出。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未发现动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，该EA依赖止损止盈比例控制风险，但未实现基于账户余额或风险百分比的动态资金管理。双工（Duplex）设计意味着可能同时处理多空信号或在两个时间框架上运行。
EA-22491.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual confirmation mechanism: a colored Moving Average (ColorMa) provides trend direction assessment, while the RSI indicator provides momentum trigger signals, and the combination of both forms the entry conditions. Entry conditions are: long entry requires the colored MA to turn to uptrend color and RSI to cross above the trigger line from oversold territory; short entry requires the colored MA to turn to downtrend color and RSI to cross below the trigger line from overbought territory. Exit conditions include: closing positions on reverse signal appearance, stop loss or take profit being hit, or exiting on RSI divergence. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic position adjustment mechanism detected. Money management relies on stop loss and take profit ratio to control risk, but does not implement dynamic money management based on account balance or risk percentage. The Duplex designation suggests the EA may simultaneously handle both long and short signals or operate across two timeframes.

EA-22516.name: Exp_UltraFatl_Duplex
EA-22516.summary: This EA implements a duplex (dual-direction) trend-following strategy based on the UltraFatl digital filter indicator, opening both long and short positions based on multi-layer digital signal processing. It uses a sophisticated cascade of adaptive filters to identify trend direction and generates entry signals when multiple filter layers align, with built-in position management and trailing mechanisms.
EA-22516.summary_zh: 该EA基于UltraFatl数字滤波指标实现双向趋势跟踪策略，通过多层自适应数字滤波器的级联处理来识别趋势方向，当多个滤波层一致时产生入场信号，内置仓位管理和追踪止损机制。
EA-22516.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于UltraFatl数字滤波器，这是一种多层级联自适应滤波技术，通过对价格序列进行多频段分解来提取趋势信号。入场条件为当所有滤波层（FATL、FTL、RFTL等）方向一致时开仓，即多头信号时买入、空头信号时卖出，实现双向交易。出场条件包括滤波器方向反转时平仓、固定止盈止损触发平仓以及追踪止损保护利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式，支持自定义仓位比例。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和单笔最大亏损比例控制，但仍缺乏整体账户风险敞口的全面管理。该策略适合在趋势明确的市场环境中运行，在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-22516.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on the UltraFatl digital filter, a multi-layer cascade adaptive filtering technology that extracts trend signals by decomposing price series across multiple frequency bands. Entry conditions require all filter layers (FATL, FTL, RFTL, etc.) to align in the same direction - buy on bullish signal alignment and sell on bearish signal alignment, enabling duplex dual-direction trading. Exit conditions include closing positions when filter direction reverses, fixed take-profit and stop-loss triggers, and trailing stop mechanisms to protect accumulated profits. Position sizing supports both fixed lots and dynamic lot calculation based on account balance with customizable position ratios. Money management implements maximum position limits and per-trade maximum loss percentage controls, but still lacks comprehensive overall account risk exposure management. The strategy performs best in clearly trending markets and may generate frequent false signals leading to consecutive losses in ranging or choppy market conditions.

pros: 多层滤波器级联设计有效过滤市场噪音，信号质量高于单一指标策略
双向交易机制能在上涨和下跌趋势中均获利，不依赖单边行情
内置追踪止损功能有效保护已有利润，降低盈利回吐风险
pros_en: Multi-layer cascade filter design effectively filters market noise, producing higher quality signals than single-indicator strategies
Duplex dual-direction trading mechanism captures profits in both uptrend and downtrend markets without relying on unidirectional movement
Built-in trailing stop functionality effectively protects accumulated profits and reduces the risk of profit givebacks
cons: 数字滤波器在震荡市场中容易产生虚假信号，导致频繁开平仓造成手续费侵蚀
滤波器参数固定缺乏自适应调整机制，无法根据市场波动率变化动态优化

cons_en: Digital filters tend to generate false signals in ranging markets, causing frequent open/close cycles that erode profits through transaction costs
Fixed filter parameters lack adaptive adjustment mechanisms, unable to dynamically optimize based on changing market volatility regimes
Potential conflict between trailing stop and fixed stop-loss logic may cause stop-loss failure during extreme volatility spikes
improvements: 增加市场状态识别模块（如ADX或波动率过滤器），在震荡市中自动暂停交易以减少虚假信号
引入自适应滤波器参数调整机制，根据ATR或市场波动率动态优化滤波器周期和阈值
improvements_en: Add market regime identification module (e.g., ADX or volatility filter) to automatically pause trading during ranging markets and reduce false signals
Introduce adaptive filter parameter adjustment mechanism to dynamically optimize filter periods and thresholds based on ATR or market volatility

risk_points: 数字滤波器在趋势转折点存在滞后性，可能导致入场延迟和出场不及时
双向交易在无明显趋势时可能同时触发多空信号造成双向亏损
缺乏整体账户风险敞口限制，极端行情下可能超出可承受亏损范围
risk_points_en: Digital filter lag at trend reversal points may cause delayed entries and untimely exits
Duplex trading may trigger both long and short signals simultaneously during directionless markets, causing losses on both sides
Lack of overall account risk exposure limits may exceed tolerable loss ranges during extreme market conditions

EA-22550.name: Three indicators
EA-22550.summary: This EA uses a combination of three technical indicators to generate trading signals and automatically open positions. It typically combines trend and momentum indicators such as moving averages, RSI, and MACD to confirm entry and exit points. The multi-indicator confirmation approach aims to filter out false signals and improve trade quality.
EA-22550.summary_zh: 该EA使用三个技术指标的组合来生成交易信号并自动开仓。通常结合趋势和动量指标（如移动平均线、RSI和MACD）来确认入场和出场点。多指标确认方法旨在过滤假信号并提高交易质量。
EA-22550.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多指标确认交易信号，通过三个不同类型指标的协同判断来减少假信号。入场条件通常要求三个指标同时发出同方向信号，例如均线金叉、RSI超卖回升、MACD柱状图转正三者同时满足时做多。出场条件可能基于反向指标信号或固定的止盈止损水平。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式。资金管理方面，若未设置严格的止损或仓位控制，可能在连续亏损时造成较大回撤。
EA-22550.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on multi-indicator confirmation of trading signals, using the协同 judgment of three different types of indicators to reduce false signals. Entry conditions typically require all three indicators to issue signals in the same direction simultaneously—for example, a moving average golden cross, RSI bouncing from oversold, and MACD histogram turning positive all confirming a long entry. Exit conditions may be based on reverse indicator signals or fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing may use fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation relative to account balance. In terms of money management, without strict stop-loss or position controls, consecutive losses could result in significant drawdowns.

pros_en: Multi-indicator confirmation effectively reduces false signals and improves entry quality

指标参数固定可能不适应当前市场波动率变化

cons_en: Simultaneous confirmation from three indicators may result in too few entry opportunities, especially in ranging markets

improvements_en: Add dynamic stop-loss and trailing take-profit functionality to lock in profits

risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss may be insufficient to cover extreme market volatility
Delayed confirmation from multiple indicators may cause missed optimal entry timing or slow exits during reversals

EA-22573.name: RNN
EA-22573.summary: This EA uses an RSI indicator feeding into a small 3-input neural network to generate trading signals. It reads three RSI values at different lookback periods, normalizes them to 0-1, and computes a probability via a weighted binary tree with 8 tunable weights (x0-x7). The probability is then transformed via linear sigmoid to produce a buy or sell signal, opening one position at a time with configurable SL/TP.
EA-22573.summary_zh: 该EA使用RSI指标输入到一个3输入小型神经网络来生成交易信号。它读取三个不同回溯周期的RSI值，归一化到0-1范围，通过8个可调权重(x0-x7)的加权二叉树计算概率，再经线性Sigmoid变换产生买卖信号，每次只持有一个仓位，支持可配置的止损止盈。
EA-22573.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA基于Reshetov的RNN（随机神经网络）概念，使用RSI指标作为3个输入信号源，分别取当前RSI、RSI周期前和2倍RSI周期前的值，归一化到0-1范围。入场条件：当神经网络输出概率经过线性Sigmoid变换后(result=result*2.0-1.0)，如果结果小于0则开多单，如果结果大于等于0则开空单。出场条件：通过固定点数的止损和止盈来退出，止损和止盈距离相同（InpSLTP参数，默认100点），也支持设置为0取消止损止盈。仓位管理：固定手数交易(InpLots默认1.0手)，每次只允许持有一个仓位(IsPositionExists检查)，新K线触发机制避免重复开仓。资金管理：通过FreeMarginCheck检查可用保证金是否充足，但没有动态手数调整或风险百分比计算。神经网络核心是GetProbability函数，8个权重参数x0-x7通过优化获得，使用加权概率二叉树结构计算空头概率，多头概率为1减去空头概率。
EA-22573.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Reshetov's RNN (Random Neural Network) approach, using three RSI values at different lookback periods as inputs, normalized to the 0-1 range. Entry conditions: after the neural network output probability is transformed via linear sigmoid (result=result*2.0-1.0), if the result is less than 0 a buy position is opened, and if the result is greater than or equal to 0 a sell position is opened. Exit conditions: positions are closed via fixed-pip stop loss and take profit (InpSLTP parameter, default 100 pips), with equal SL and TP distances; setting InpSLTP to 0 disables SL/TP. Position sizing: fixed lot size trading (InpLots default 1.0 lots), only one position allowed at a time via IsPositionExists check, with new-bar trigger mechanism to avoid duplicate entries. Money management: FreeMarginCheck verifies sufficient free margin before order placement, but there is no dynamic lot sizing or risk-percentage calculation. The neural network core is the GetProbability function with 8 weight parameters (x0-x7) obtained through optimization, using a weighted probability binary tree structure to compute the short position probability, with the long probability being 1 minus the short probability.
pros: 使用神经网络概率模型进行交易决策，比简单阈值信号更具适应性
每次只持有一个仓位并使用新K线触发，避免了过度交易和重复开仓
包含完善的保证金检查和手数验证机制，防止资金不足时下单失败
pros_en: Uses a neural network probability model for trading decisions, more adaptive than simple threshold signals
Maintains only one position at a time with new-bar trigger, avoiding overtrading and duplicate entries
Includes thorough margin checking and lot validation to prevent order failures due to insufficient funds
cons: 神经网络权重x0-x7含义不直观，需要大量优化且极易过拟合
止损止盈距离相同缺乏非对称风险回报设计，不符合专业交易实践
固定手数交易无动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险或波动率调整仓位大小
cons_en: Neural network weights x0-x7 are unintuitive, require extensive optimization and are highly prone to overfitting
Equal stop loss and take profit distances lack asymmetric risk-reward design, not aligned with professional trading practices
Fixed lot trading with no dynamic position sizing, unable to adjust lot size based on account risk or volatility
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户风险比例和ATR波动率自动计算手数
引入非对称止损止盈和移动止损机制，提高风险回报比
增加多时间框架确认和交易量/波动率过滤，减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that automatically calculates lot size based on account risk percentage and ATR volatility
Introduce asymmetric stop loss/take profit and trailing stop mechanisms to improve risk-reward ratio
Add multi-timeframe confirmation and volume/volatility filters to reduce false signals

risk_points: 神经网络权重参数高度依赖历史优化，存在严重过拟合风险，实盘表现可能大幅偏离回测
止损止盈距离相等意味着风险回报比为1:1，需要较高胜率才能盈利
固定1.0手默认手数较大，小账户可能承受过高风险
risk_points_en: Neural network weight parameters are highly dependent on historical optimization, posing significant overfitting risk; live performance may deviate substantially from backtesting
Equal stop loss and take profit distances imply a 1:1 risk-reward ratio, requiring a high win rate to be profitable
Fixed 1.0 lot default size is large and may expose small accounts to excessive risk

EA-22578.name: MAMy Expert
EA-22578.summary: This EA uses moving average-based signals to identify and follow market trends, opening positions when price crosses or confirms direction relative to one or more moving averages. It applies systematic entry and exit rules based on MA alignment and price action. The strategy is a classic trend-following approach suitable for trending markets.
EA-22578.summary_zh: 该EA基于移动平均线信号识别并跟随市场趋势，当价格与一条或多条均线发生交叉或确认方向时开仓。它应用基于均线排列和价格行为的系统性入场与出场规则。该策略是经典的趋势跟踪方法，适用于趋势明显的市场。
EA-22578.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是利用移动平均线判断市场趋势方向，当短期均线与长期均线形成金叉时做多，死叉时做空，属于经典的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件依赖于均线交叉信号以及价格相对于均线的位置确认，确保在趋势确立后才进场。出场条件通常包括反向交叉信号或固定的止盈止损水平，部分变体可能加入追踪止损来保护利润。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式，但具体参数取决于用户设置。资金管理上，止盈止损比例是风险控制的关键，缺乏动态仓位调整和资金管理算法可能是其短板。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损。
EA-22578.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses moving averages to determine market trend direction, going long on a golden cross and short on a death cross, which is a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions rely on MA crossover signals and price position confirmation relative to the averages, ensuring positions are opened only after a trend is established. Exit conditions typically include opposite crossover signals or fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with some variants adding trailing stops to protect profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or equity-proportional calculation, depending on user-configured parameters. Money management relies on take-profit and stop-loss ratios as the primary risk control, though the lack of dynamic position sizing and advanced money management algorithms is a potential weakness. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, but it is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets.

EA-22595.name: Constituents EA
EA-22595.summary: The Constituents EA is a multi-timeframe trading system that analyzes constituent technical indicators across different timeframes to generate consolidated trading signals. It combines trend, momentum, and volatility assessments from multiple periods to determine optimal entry and exit points. The EA systematically opens and manages positions based on the aggregated constituent indicator readings.
EA-22595.summary_zh: Constituents EA是一个多周期交易系统，通过分析不同时间周期的成分技术指标来生成综合交易信号。它结合了多个周期的趋势、动量和波动率评估，以确定最优的入场和出场时机。该EA根据聚合的成分指标读数系统性地开仓和管理仓位。
EA-22595.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于多周期成分指标的聚合分析，将不同时间维度的技术信号整合为统一的交易决策。入场条件通常要求多个时间周期的指标达成一致方向，例如短期和中期趋势同向且动量确认时才开仓。出场条件则包括反向信号出现、止盈止损触发或成分指标分歧时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA根据信号强度和多个时间框架的一致性程度来调整仓位大小，一致性越高仓位越大。资金管理采用了基于账户权益和风险比例的动态手数计算方式，确保单笔交易风险可控。然而，由于EA依赖多指标聚合，在市场剧烈波动时各周期信号可能产生冲突，导致信号延迟或反复。
EA-22595.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is based on aggregated analysis of multi-timeframe constituent indicators, integrating technical signals from different time dimensions into a unified trading decision. Entry conditions typically require indicator alignment across multiple timeframes, for example opening positions only when short-term and medium-term trends align and momentum confirms the direction. Exit conditions include closing positions when reverse signals appear, take-profit or stop-loss levels are hit, or constituent indicators diverge. Position sizing adjusts based on signal strength and the degree of consistency across multiple timeframes, with higher consistency leading to larger positions. Money management employs dynamic lot calculation based on account equity and risk ratios to ensure controllable risk per trade. However, since the EA relies on multi-indicator aggregation, signals from different timeframes may conflict during extreme market volatility, potentially causing signal delays or whipsaws.
pros: 多周期分析降低了假信号概率，提高了交易信号的可靠性
成分指标聚合机制提供了更全面的市场视角，避免单一指标局限性
基于信号一致性动态调整仓位大小，实现了更精细的风险控制
pros_en: Multi-timeframe analysis reduces false signal probability and improves trading signal reliability
Constituent indicator aggregation mechanism provides a more comprehensive market perspective, avoiding single-indicator limitations
Dynamic position sizing based on signal consistency enables more refined risk control
cons: 多指标聚合可能导致信号延迟，在快速行情中错过最佳入场时机
多个时间周期信号冲突时可能产生频繁的虚假信号或反复开平仓
参数较多且各时间框架参数需协调优化，增加了过拟合的风险
cons_en: Multi-indicator aggregation may cause signal lag, missing optimal entry points during fast-moving markets
Conflicting signals across timeframes can produce frequent false signals or repeated open-close cycles
Numerous parameters requiring coordination across timeframes increase the risk of overfitting
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器，在震荡和趋势市场中使用不同的成分指标权重组合
引入自适应参数优化机制，根据近期表现动态调整各时间框架的权重分配
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter to use different constituent indicator weight combinations in ranging versus trending markets
Introduce an adaptive parameter optimization mechanism that dynamically adjusts timeframe weight allocation based on recent performance

risk_points: 多周期信号冲突时缺乏明确的优先级规则，可能导致不利时机入场
未明确包含点差过滤机制，在流动性较差时段可能产生不利成交
risk_points_en: Lack of clear priority rules when multi-timeframe signals conflict may lead to entries at unfavorable timing
No explicit spread filter mechanism may result in unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods

EA-22606.name: Exp_XBullsBearsEyes_Vol
EA-22606.summary: This EA trades based on the XBullsBearsEyes_Vol custom indicator, which combines Bulls Power and Bears Power indicators with volume weighting to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when bullish momentum with volume surges is detected and sell positions when bearish momentum with volume surges is detected, using the indicator's signal changes as entry triggers.
EA-22606.summary_zh: 该EA基于XBullsBearsEyes_Vol自定义指标进行交易，该指标将牛力指标和熊力指标与成交量加权结合，用于检测动量转变。当检测到伴随成交量放大的看涨动量时开多仓，当检测到伴随成交量放大的看跌动量时开空仓，以指标信号变化作为入场触发条件。
EA-22606.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Bulls Power和Bears Power两个动量指标的成交量加权版本，通过检测多空力量的变化来判断市场方向。入场条件为当XBullsBearsEyes_Vol指标从看跌信号转为看涨信号时做多，从看涨信号转为看跌信号时做空，本质上是动量反转策略。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓，即持有多仓时出现看跌信号则平仓，持有空仓时出现看涨信号则平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，通过MoneyManagement模块可选择固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数设置，但止损止盈的合理性与否取决于用户参数配置，EA本身缺乏自适应止损机制。
EA-22606.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on a volume-weighted version of the Bulls Power and Bears Power momentum indicators, detecting market direction through changes in bullish and bearish force. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the XBullsBearsEyes_Vol indicator switches from a bearish signal to a bullish signal, and a sell when it switches from bullish to bearish, making it fundamentally a momentum reversal strategy. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals to close positions — long positions close on bearish signals and short positions close on bullish signals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with a MoneyManagement module that offers either fixed lots or balance-proportional lot sizing. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameter settings, but the effectiveness depends on user configuration as the EA lacks an adaptive stop loss mechanism.

EA-22607.name: Exp_XBullsBearsEyes_Vol_Direct
EA-22607.summary: This Expert Advisor trades based on the XBullsBearsEyes volatility indicator with a direct trading approach. It opens positions when the Bulls and Bears Eyes indicator signals a trend direction, using volume-weighted confirmation for entry. The EA manages positions with stop loss and take profit levels derived from the indicator's volatility calculations.
EA-22607.summary_zh: 该EA基于XBullsBearsEyes波动率指标进行直接交易。当牛熊之眼指标发出趋势方向信号时，使用成交量加权确认入场。EA通过指标波动率计算的止损和止盈水平管理仓位。
EA-22607.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用XBullsBearsEyes指标判断市场多空力量对比，该指标结合了波动率和成交量因素来衡量买卖双方的压力。入场条件为指标显示多头或空头力量占据主导地位时，顺势开仓。出场条件包括达到基于ATR或波动率计算的止损止盈水平，以及指标信号反转时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方法。资金管理方面，EA通过波动率调整止损距离来控制单笔风险。整体策略属于趋势跟踪类型，在趋势确立后跟随方向交易，但依赖单一指标信号可能导致震荡行情中频繁止损。
EA-22607.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the XBullsBearsEyes indicator to gauge the balance of power between bulls and bears, which incorporates volatility and volume factors to measure buying and selling pressure. Entry conditions trigger when the indicator shows either bulls or bears dominating the market, opening positions in the prevailing direction. Exit conditions include reaching stop loss and take profit levels calculated from ATR or volatility-based measurements, as well as closing positions when the indicator signal reverses. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or a balance-proportional method based on account equity. Money management is handled through volatility-adjusted stop loss distances to control per-trade risk exposure. The overall strategy falls under trend following, trading in the direction of established trends, but reliance on a single indicator signal may result in frequent stop-outs during choppy or ranging market conditions.

EA-22609.name: VR STEALS
EA-22609.summary: VR STEALS is a scalping EA that attempts to capture small price movements by entering and exiting trades quickly. The name suggests a stealth-based approach, likely targeting spread arbitrage or brief momentum impulses during low-spread conditions. It operates systematically on lower timeframes with tight take-profit targets.
EA-22609.summary_zh: VR STEALS是一个剥头皮EA，通过快速进出交易来捕获小幅价格波动。名称暗示采用隐蔽策略，可能针对低点差条件下的价差套利或短暂动量脉冲。它在较低时间周期上系统化运行，止盈目标设置较紧。
EA-22609.strategy_analysis: VR STEALS策略概念基于剥头皮交易，利用短暂的价格偏移来获取小额利润。入场条件可能依赖于点差过滤和价格动量的瞬时变化，在市场安静时段寻找微小的价格失衡机会。出场条件采用极小的止盈目标（通常几个点），止损相对较紧但可能依赖隐性退出机制。仓位管理方面，剥头皮策略通常使用固定手数或基于账户余额的线性计算，不会采用马丁格尔或网格加仓。资金管理上，由于单笔利润很小，需要高频交易来积累收益，因此交易成本（点差和佣金）对整体盈利能力影响极大。该类策略对经纪商的执行质量和流动性条件高度敏感。
EA-22609.strategy_analysis_en: VR STEALS is conceptually built on scalping, exploiting brief price displacements to capture small profits. Entry conditions likely rely on spread filtering and instantaneous momentum shifts, seeking micro price imbalance opportunities during quiet market sessions. Exit conditions use very tight take-profit targets (typically a few pips), with relatively close stop-losses or potentially relying on implicit exit mechanisms. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or linear balance-based calculation, avoiding martingale or grid augmentation. Money management is challenging since per-trade profit is minimal, requiring high frequency to accumulate returns, making trading costs (spread and commission) critically impactful on overall profitability. The strategy is highly sensitive to broker execution quality and liquidity conditions, which can dramatically alter performance across different brokers.

EA-22613.name: Executor AO
EA-22613.summary: Executor AO is an Expert Advisor that trades based on Awesome Oscillator (AO) signals, entering positions when the oscillator crosses above or below the zero line and confirming with momentum shifts. It applies systematic entry and exit rules derived from Bill Williams' Awesome Oscillator philosophy, using color changes and zero-line crossovers as primary trade triggers. The EA manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels while filtering trades based on signal strength.
EA-22613.summary_zh: Executor AO是一个基于动量震荡指标(Awesome Oscillator)信号进行交易的智能交易系统，当震荡指标穿越零线或出现动量转换时开仓。它采用比尔·威廉姆斯的动量震荡指标哲学，以颜色变化和零线交叉作为主要交易触发条件。该EA通过可配置的止损止盈水平管理仓位，并根据信号强度过滤交易。
EA-22613.strategy_analysis: Executor AO的核心策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯的动量震荡指标(Awesome Oscillator)，该指标通过计算5周期和34周期中位价的差值来衡量市场动量。入场条件为：当AO从负值区域穿越零线向上时产生买入信号，当AO从正值区域穿越零线向下时产生卖出信号，部分变体还会结合AO柱状图颜色变化（由红转绿或由绿转红）作为辅助确认。出场条件包括触及固定止盈/止损水平，以及AO出现反向交叉信号时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户设置固定手数或基于资金比例的动态仓位，但通常采用固定手数模式。资金管理依赖于止损距离与账户余额的比例关系，部分版本支持风险百分比计算仓位大小。整体策略属于典型的动量跟踪型方法，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能产生较多假信号。
EA-22613.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Executor AO is based on Bill Williams' Awesome Oscillator, which measures market momentum by calculating the difference between 5-period and 34-period median prices. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when AO crosses the zero line upward from negative territory, and a sell signal is generated when AO crosses the zero line downward from positive territory; some variants also incorporate AO histogram color changes (red-to-green or green-to-red) as supplementary confirmation. Exit conditions include hitting fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels, and closing positions when AO produces a reverse crossover signal. Position sizing allows users to set fixed lots or dynamic sizing based on account equity percentage, though fixed lot mode is more commonly used. Money management relies on the relationship between stop-loss distance and account balance ratio, with some versions supporting risk-percentage-based lot calculation. The overall strategy is a typical momentum-following approach suited for trending markets, but it may generate numerous false signals in choppy or range-bound conditions.
