EA-22653.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用平滑均线来过滤市场噪音，识别趋势方向并跟随趋势进行交易。入场条件通常为快速平滑均线向上穿越慢速平滑均线时做多，向下穿越时做空，这种交叉信号代表了趋势的转变。出场条件则可能包括反向交叉信号平仓、固定止盈止损或追踪止损。仓位管理方面，根据参数设置可能采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算。资金管理上，该EA可能设置了最大持仓限制和风险控制参数，但具体取决于参数配置。整体而言，该策略属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，在明显趋势行情中表现较好，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-22653.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to use a smoothing average to filter market noise, identify trend direction, and follow trends for trading. Entry conditions typically involve going long when a fast smoothing average crosses above a slow smoothing average, and going short on the reverse crossover, with these crossover signals representing trend shifts. Exit conditions may include closing positions on reverse crossover signals, fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or trailing stops. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage depending on parameter settings. Money management may include maximum position limits and risk control parameters, though specifics depend on configuration. Overall, this is a classic trend-following system that performs well in strong trending markets but is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy conditions.

EA-22659.name: Tunnel gen4
EA-22659.summary: Tunnel Gen4 is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that identifies price tunnel/channel consolidation zones and enters trades when price breaks out of the defined range. It uses configurable tunnel boundaries to detect periods of low volatility followed by directional expansion, managing positions with stop loss and take profit targets.
EA-22659.summary_zh: Tunnel Gen4是一个基于突破策略的智能交易系统，通过识别价格隧道/通道整理区间，在价格突破定义范围时入场交易。它使用可配置的隧道边界来检测低波动率后的方向性扩张，并通过止损和止盈目标管理仓位。
EA-22659.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于价格隧道突破，即在市场进入窄幅整理（隧道）后，等待价格突破隧道边界时入场交易。入场条件为价格向上突破隧道上轨时开多单，向下突破隧道下轨时开空单，突破确认可通过K线收盘价或突破幅度阈值来验证。出场条件包括固定止盈和止损水平，也可能包含隧道反向突破平仓机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数计算方式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和单笔风险控制参数，但整体依赖突破后的趋势延续假设，在假突破场景下可能产生连续亏损。
EA-22659.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on price tunnel breakout, entering trades when price breaks out of a narrow consolidation range (tunnel). Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above the upper tunnel boundary and a sell when it breaks below the lower boundary, with optional confirmation via candle close or breakout magnitude threshold. Exit conditions include fixed take profit and stop loss levels, and potentially a reverse breakout closure mechanism that exits when price re-enters or breaks the opposite tunnel boundary. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or balance-proportional calculation methods. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and per-trade risk control parameters, though the overall approach relies on the assumption of trend continuation after breakout, which can produce consecutive losses in false breakout scenarios.

EA-22662.name: RSI RFTL EA
EA-22662.summary: This EA uses the RSI (Relative Strength Index) indicator combined with RFTL (Recursive Fast Trend Line) to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when RSI is oversold and the RFTL confirms an upward trend, and enters short positions when RSI is overbought and RFTL confirms a downward trend. The strategy aims to capture momentum reversals filtered by a trend-confirmation digital filter.
EA-22662.summary_zh: 该EA使用RSI（相对强弱指数）指标结合RFTL（递归快速趋势线）来生成交易信号。当RSI超卖且RFTL确认上升趋势时做多，当RSI超买且RFTL确认下降趋势时做空。该策略旨在通过趋势确认数字滤波器来捕捉动量反转。
EA-22662.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于RSI动量反转与RFTL趋势方向过滤的双重确认机制。入场条件为：做多时RSI低于超卖阈值且RFTL值为正（上升趋势确认），做空时RSI高于超买阈值且RFTL值为负（下降趋势确认）。出场条件通常包括固定的止盈止损，或当RSI回到中性区域时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未见到动态仓位调整或基于账户权益的计算方式。资金管理方面，EA依赖用户手动设置手数，缺乏自动风险比例计算。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺乏对市场波动性和点差的适应性处理。
EA-22662.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on a dual-confirmation mechanism combining RSI momentum reversal with RFTL trend direction filtering. Entry conditions are: go long when RSI is below the oversold threshold and RFTL value is positive (confirming uptrend), go short when RSI is above the overbought threshold and RFTL value is negative (confirming downtrend). Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or closing positions when RSI returns to the neutral zone. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic lot calculation or equity-based sizing. Money management relies on the user manually setting the lot size, lacking automatic risk-per-trade calculation. The overall strategy logic is clear but lacks adaptability to market volatility and spread considerations.

EA-22674.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a strategic trading program but a trade management utility panel. It does not contain any entry or exit strategy logic and does not automatically open or close positions based on technical indicators or price action. Its core functionality is providing a quick trade operation interface, such as one-click order placement, rapid stop loss and take profit modification, batch closing of positions, and other convenience operations. For money management, the tool may display account information (balance, equity, margin, etc.) but does not automatically execute money management rules. The EA trains its neural network on historical price features and executes trades based on the network's forward-pass predictions, combining machine learning classification with automated order placement.
EA-22693.summary_zh: 基于多层感知器(MLP)神经网络的自营交易EA，通过监督学习预测价格方向并产生买卖信号。该EA利用历史价格特征训练神经网络，并根据网络前向传播预测结果自动执行交易。
EA-22693.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用多层感知器(MLP)神经网络作为核心策略引擎，属于机器学习交易类别。入场条件基于神经网络的前向传播输出——当网络输出超过买入阈值时开多仓，低于卖出阈值时开空仓。网络输入特征通常来自价格序列的技术指标（如移动平均、动量、波动率等），通过归一化处理后输入网络。训练阶段使用历史数据通过反向传播算法更新权重，属于有监督学习框架。出场条件通常依赖固定止盈止损或反向信号触发平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA支持多种手数设定方式，但神经网络本身不直接控制仓位大小。资金管理方面，需要关注训练数据过拟合风险以及神经网络在市场状态切换时的适应性下降问题。
EA-22693.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) neural network as its core strategy engine, classifying it firmly in the machine learning trading category. Entry conditions are determined by the neural network's forward-pass output—opening long positions when the output exceeds a buy threshold and short positions when it falls below a sell threshold. The network input features are typically derived from technical indicators computed on price series (such as moving averages, momentum, and volatility), which are normalized before being fed into the network. The training phase uses historical data with backpropagation to update weights, operating under a supervised learning framework where labeled price direction data guides the optimization. Exit conditions generally rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or reverse signal triggers for position closing. Position sizing is configurable through input parameters, but the neural network itself does not dynamically control lot sizes. Money management considerations must account for overfitting risk on training data and the network's degraded adaptability during regime shifts in market conditions.

EA-22703.name: Extreme EA
EA-22703.summary: Extreme EA is a breakout-style expert advisor that identifies extreme price levels and enters trades when price breaks through these levels. It uses dynamic channel or range detection to define support/resistance boundaries and executes trades on breakout confirmations. The EA manages positions with stop loss and take profit levels derived from the breakout range.
EA-22703.summary_zh: Extreme EA是一个突破类智能交易系统，通过识别极端价格水平，在价格突破这些关键位时进场交易。它利用动态通道或区间检测来定义支撑阻力边界，并在突破确认后执行交易，通过突破区间来设定止损止盈。
EA-22703.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是识别价格的极端高点或低点，形成动态的突破通道。入场条件为价格突破近期极端高/低点时开仓做多或做空，属于典型突破交易策略。出场条件包括固定止损止盈，止损通常设在突破点的另一侧以控制风险。仓位管理采用手数参数控制，部分版本可能包含加仓逻辑。资金管理方面依赖用户设置的固定手数或基于余额的百分比计算。整体策略逻辑清晰，但突破策略在震荡行情中容易产生假突破导致连续止损。
EA-22703.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA identifies extreme price highs or lows to form a dynamic breakout channel. Entry conditions trigger when price breaks above a recent extreme high for buy orders or below an extreme low for sell orders, representing a classic breakout trading approach. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with stops typically placed on the opposite side of the breakout point to control risk. Position sizing is controlled via lot size parameters, with some versions potentially including add-on position logic. Money management relies on user-configured fixed lots or balance-percentage-based calculations. While the strategy logic is clear, breakout strategies are vulnerable to false breakouts during ranging markets, which can lead to consecutive stop losses.

EA-22718.name: NRTR_Revers
EA-22718.summary: NRTR_Revers is an Expert Advisor based on the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) indicator, which dynamically adjusts trailing stop levels to identify trend reversals. The EA opens buy positions when price crosses above the trailing stop line and sell positions when price crosses below it, riding trends while exiting on reversals. It is a systematic trend-following system with built-in trailing stop logic for both entry and exit signals.
EA-22718.summary_zh: NRTR_Revers是一个基于NRTR（Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse）指标的趋势跟踪EA，通过动态调整追踪止损线来识别趋势反转。当价格上穿追踪止损线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，顺势交易并在反转时出场。该EA是系统化的趋势跟踪策略，内置追踪止损逻辑用于入场和出场信号。
EA-22718.strategy_analysis: NRTR_Revers策略的核心概念是利用NRTR指标动态计算追踪止损位，当价格突破该止损位时判断趋势发生反转并入场。入场条件为：价格向上突破NRTR上轨时开多单，价格向下突破NRTR下轨时开空单。出场条件则依赖NRTR指标的反转信号，即当持有多单时若NRTR翻转为空方信号则平多开空，反之亦然。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数进行交易，未见动态仓位调整或基于风险的仓位计算逻辑。资金管理方面缺乏止损和止盈的独立设置，完全依赖NRTR指标的反转信号来决定出场，这在极端行情下可能带来较大亏损。整体策略逻辑简洁清晰，但风险管理手段较为薄弱，缺乏对突发行情的防护机制。
EA-22718.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the NRTR_Revers strategy is to use the NRTR indicator to dynamically calculate trailing stop levels, entering trades when price breaches these levels as trend reversal signals. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when price crosses above the NRTR upper band, and open a sell position when price crosses below the NRTR lower band. Exit conditions rely on NRTR reversal signals — when holding a long position and NRTR flips to a bearish signal, the EA closes the long and opens a short, and vice versa. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes without any dynamic adjustment or risk-based calculation, which limits adaptability to varying account sizes and market conditions. Money management is weak as there are no independent stop-loss or take-profit settings; exits are entirely dependent on NRTR reversal signals, which can result in significant drawdowns during extreme market moves or whipsaw conditions. The overall strategy logic is clean and straightforward but lacks robust risk protection mechanisms for adverse scenarios.

EA-22778.name: Alligator Simple v1.0
EA-22778.summary: This EA uses Bill Williams' Alligator indicator (three smoothed moving averages — Jaw, Teeth, Lips) to identify trend direction and generate buy/sell signals. It enters long when the Lips cross above the Teeth and Jaw (trend up) and enters short when the Lips cross below (trend down), exiting on Alligator lines convergence or opposing crossover. Position sizing is controlled via configurable lot size with optional stop loss and take profit.
EA-22778.summary_zh: 该EA使用比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标（颚线、齿线、唇线三条平滑移动平均线）来识别趋势方向并生成买卖信号。唇线向上穿越齿线和颚线时做多，向下穿越时做空，在鳄鱼线收敛或反向交叉时平仓。仓位通过可配置手数控制，可选止损和止盈。
EA-22778.strategy_analysis: 策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯鳄鱼指标的趋势跟踪系统，利用三条不同周期的平滑移动平均线（颚线13周期偏移8、齿线8周期偏移5、唇线5周期偏移3）来判断市场趋势状态。入场条件为：当唇线从下方穿越齿线和颚线时产生做多信号，当唇线从上方穿越齿线和颚线时产生做空信号，这代表鳄鱼'张嘴'趋势启动。出场条件依赖鳄鱼线的收敛（鳄鱼'闭嘴'）或反向交叉信号触发平仓，部分版本可能结合止损止盈参数进行风险管理。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过输入参数直接设定交易量，未采用动态仓位或资金比例计算。资金管理方面，EA提供止损和止盈参数但可能缺乏强制设置，存在未设止损时风险敞口过大的隐患。整体策略逻辑简洁明了，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-22778.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is a trend-following system based on Bill Williams' Alligator indicator, using three smoothed moving averages with different periods and offsets (Jaw: period 13 offset 8, Teeth: period 8 offset 5, Lips: period 5 offset 3) to determine market trend state. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the Lips line crosses above the Teeth and Jaw lines from below, and a sell signal is generated when the Lips cross below from above, representing the Alligator 'opening its mouth' as a trend begins. Exit conditions rely on the convergence of the Alligator lines (the Alligator 'closing its mouth') or an opposing crossover signal triggering position closure, with some versions optionally incorporating stop loss and take profit parameters for risk management. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user sets the trade volume directly via input parameters, without dynamic position sizing or percentage-of-equity calculations. In terms of money management, the EA provides stop loss and take profit parameters but may lack enforcement, creating a risk of excessive exposure when stops are not set. The overall strategy logic is clean and straightforward, suitable for strongly trending markets, but it tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging or choppy conditions, leading to consecutive losses.

EA-22788.name: Fluctuate
EA-22788.summary: Fluctuate is a mean reversion EA that trades based on price fluctuation deviations from a central moving average. It enters positions when price deviates significantly from the mean and exits when price reverts back toward the average. The EA employs a systematic approach with configurable deviation thresholds for entry and exit signals.
EA-22788.summary_zh: Fluctuate是一个基于价格波动偏离均值的均值回归EA。当价格显著偏离均值时开仓，当价格回归均值时平仓。该EA采用系统化方法，具有可配置的偏离阈值用于入场和出场信号。
EA-22788.strategy_analysis: Fluctuate EA的核心策略是均值回归，即假设价格在偏离均值后会回归到平均水平。入场条件是价格偏离移动均线达到设定的阈值时开仓，买入在价格低于均线一定偏差时触发，卖出在价格高于均线一定偏差时触发。出场条件是价格回归到均线附近或达到止盈止损水平时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的下单方式。资金管理方面，EA通过可配置的止损和止盈参数控制每笔交易的风险回报比。整体策略逻辑清晰，但均值回归策略在趋势行情中可能遭遇连续亏损的风险。
EA-22788.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Fluctuate EA is mean reversion, assuming that price will revert to the mean after significant deviation. Entry conditions trigger when price deviates from the moving average beyond a configured threshold — buying when price falls below the mean by a set deviation and selling when price rises above it. Exit conditions are met when price reverts back toward the moving average or hits take-profit/stop-loss levels. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or equity-proportional sizing based on configurable parameters. Money management is handled through configurable stop-loss and take-profit settings that control the risk-reward ratio for each trade. While the strategy logic is clear, mean reversion strategies can suffer consecutive losses during strong trending markets.

EA-22820.name: Doubler
EA-22820.summary: A Martingale-based Expert Advisor that doubles the lot size after each losing trade, aiming to recover previous losses with a single win. It enters positions based on simple directional signals and relies on the Martingale progression to eventually achieve net profit when a winning trade occurs.
EA-22820.summary_zh: 基于马丁格尔策略的EA，每次亏损后将交易手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利覆盖之前所有亏损。该EA使用简单的方向信号入场，依赖马丁格尔倍投机制在赢取交易时实现净盈利。
EA-22820.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典马丁格尔策略，核心概念是在每次亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，理论上只要最终有一笔盈利交易，就能覆盖之前所有累计亏损并实现净收益。入场条件通常基于简单的趋势或动量信号，如移动平均线交叉或RSI超买超卖反转，部分实现可能仅使用固定方向或随机入场。出场条件为达到固定止盈目标时平仓，止损设置可选但许多马丁格尔EA不设止损，依赖倍投而非止损来控制风险。仓位管理采用几何级数递增模式（1、2、4、8、16...），初始手数较小但随着连亏次数增加，手数呈指数级增长。资金管理方面缺乏有效的最大回撤保护或连亏次数限制，在长期连亏场景下账户极易爆仓，属于高风险策略类型。
EA-22820.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic Martingale strategy, whose core concept is to double the lot size after each losing trade, so that theoretically a single winning trade can recover all cumulative losses and achieve net profit. Entry conditions are typically based on simple trend or momentum signals such as moving average crossovers or RSI overbought/oversold reversals, though some implementations may use fixed direction or even random entry. Exit conditions involve closing positions upon reaching a fixed take-profit target, while stop-loss settings are optional and many Martingale EAs omit stop-loss entirely, relying on position doubling rather than stops for risk control. Position sizing follows a geometric progression pattern (1, 2, 4, 8, 16...), starting with a small initial lot but scaling exponentially with each consecutive loss. Money management lacks effective maximum drawdown protection or consecutive loss limits, making the account extremely vulnerable to margin calls during extended losing streaks, categorizing this as a high-risk strategy type.

EA-22823.name: Hedge any positions
EA-22823.summary: This EA opens hedge (opposite direction) positions against existing open positions to protect against adverse market moves. It monitors current open positions and automatically places counter-directional trades with configurable lot sizing and distance parameters, effectively creating a market-neutral exposure when activated.
EA-22823.summary_zh: 该EA针对现有持仓自动开立反向对冲仓位，以保护免受不利市场波动的影响。它监控当前未平仓位，并根据可配置的手数和距离参数自动放置反向交易，激活后可有效实现市场中性敞口。
EA-22823.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是对冲现有的持仓头寸，通过在相反方向开仓来抵消原有敞口风险。入场条件是当检测到现有未平仓位时，在预设的距离处放置反向对冲订单。出场条件依赖于用户手动管理或通过原有仓位的止盈止损触发。仓位管理方面，对冲仓位的头寸规模可以配置，可能与原始仓位成比例或固定手数。资金管理较为简单，没有复杂的资金分配算法，主要依赖用户对对冲参数的合理设置。该策略本质上是一种风险管理工具，不追求盈利而是追求敞口中性化，适合在不确定行情中保护已有利润或限制亏损。
EA-22823.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is hedging existing open positions by opening counter-directional trades to neutralize directional exposure. Entry conditions trigger when the EA detects an existing open position and places an opposing hedge order at a configurable distance from the current price. Exit conditions are not inherently automated; they depend on the user's manual management or the stop-loss/take-profit levels of the original positions. Position sizing for hedge trades can be configured, potentially matching the original position's lot size or using a fixed ratio, providing flexibility in how much exposure is neutralized. Money management is straightforward without complex allocation algorithms, relying heavily on the user's proper configuration of hedge parameters such as lot multiplier and trigger distance. The strategy functions primarily as a risk management tool rather than a profit-seeking system, aiming for exposure neutrality which is particularly useful during uncertain market conditions to protect existing profits or limit potential losses.

EA-22827.name: Close all positions
EA-22827.summary: This EA is a utility tool that closes all open positions on the account. It does not open any trades itself; its sole function is to liquidate all existing positions, typically used as an emergency exit or account reset mechanism.
EA-22827.summary_zh: 这是一个工具型EA，功能是关闭账户上所有持仓。它本身不开仓，唯一功能是平掉所有现有仓位，通常用作紧急退出或账户重置手段。
EA-22827.strategy_analysis: 该EA没有交易策略概念，它不基于任何技术指标或信号入场。其唯一功能是遍历账户所有持仓并逐个平仓，属于纯粹的账户管理工具。出场条件即用户手动触发或满足预设条件时执行全仓平仓。仓位管理方面不涉及，因为该EA不建仓。资金管理方面同样不涉及，仅执行平仓操作。使用场景包括紧急止损、日内结算、或配合其他EA做风控联动。风险点在于平仓滑点和极端行情下无法及时平仓的可能性。
EA-22827.strategy_analysis_en: This EA has no trading strategy concept as it does not enter positions based on any technical indicators or signals. Its sole function is to iterate through all account positions and close them one by one, serving as a pure account management utility. Exit conditions are triggered by user manual action or preset conditions to execute full position liquidation. Position sizing is not applicable since the EA never opens positions. Money management is likewise not applicable as it only executes closing operations. Use cases include emergency stop-loss, end-of-day settlement, or risk control linkage with other EAs. Risk points include slippage during closure and inability to close positions promptly under extreme market conditions.

EA-22834.name: MA MACD Position averaging
EA-22834.summary: This EA uses a combination of Moving Average and MACD indicators to generate trade signals, then employs a position averaging (martingale-style) strategy when positions go into loss. It opens additional positions at a defined step distance to average down the entry price, closing all positions when the overall portfolio reaches a profit target.
EA-22834.summary_zh: 该EA结合移动平均线和MACD指标产生交易信号，当持仓亏损时采用加仓摊平（马丁格尔式）策略。它按设定的间距逐步加仓以降低均价，当整体持仓达到盈利目标时全部平仓。
EA-22834.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于MA和MACD双重确认的趋势跟踪信号入场，当价格向不利方向运动达到设定的间距（Step）时，以更大的手数（乘数LotExponent）加仓摊平均价。入场条件为MA方向确认加上MACD信号线交叉或柱状图方向确认。出场条件为当所有同向持仓的整体浮盈达到TakeProfit目标时一次性全部平仓。仓位管理采用马丁格尔式递增，每次加仓手数为前一次的LotExponent倍，这意味着亏损越大仓位越重。资金管理方面没有硬性止损，完全依赖均价拉低后的反弹回本，存在爆仓风险。整体策略本质上是一个带技术指标入场的马丁格尔摊平系统，在单边行情中可能因持续加仓导致巨大亏损。
EA-22834.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on dual confirmation of MA trend direction and MACD signal line crossover or histogram direction for trade entry. When price moves against the position by a defined Step distance, the EA adds positions with increased lot size (multiplied by LotExponent) to average down the entry price. Entry conditions require MA direction confirmation combined with MACD signal crossover or histogram direction alignment. Exit conditions trigger when the total floating profit of all same-direction positions reaches the TakeProfit target, at which point all positions are closed simultaneously. Position sizing follows a martingale-style progression where each additional position's lot size is multiplied by LotExponent, meaning the larger the loss, the heavier the position becomes. Money management lacks a hard stop loss, relying entirely on price reverting after averaging down, which carries significant margin call risk in trending markets.

EA-22854.name: MA MACD Position averaging v2
EA-22854.summary: This EA uses a combination of Moving Average and MACD indicators to generate trade signals, then employs a position averaging (martingale-style) strategy by adding to losing positions at predetermined intervals. It opens initial positions based on MA/MACD crossover signals and progressively increases lot size as price moves against the position, aiming to recover losses when the market reverses.
EA-22854.summary_zh: 该EA使用移动平均线和MACD指标的组合来生成交易信号，然后采用仓位加仓（马丁格尔式）策略，在价格反向运动时以预设间隔追加仓位。它基于MA/MACD交叉信号开立初始仓位，并在价格不利时逐步加大仓位，期望市场反转时回收损失。
EA-22854.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于MA与MACD双重确认的趋势跟踪入场，结合马丁格尔式加仓法进行仓位管理。入场条件为MA方向与MACD信号线交叉一致时开仓，确保双重指标确认减少假信号。出场条件依赖整体仓位达到盈利目标或触及止损，而非单笔交易盈亏。仓位管理采用加仓模式，每次加仓间距固定点数，且加仓手数递增（通常倍增或按系数增加），这是典型的马丁格尔策略特征。资金管理方面，通过设定最大加仓次数和总止损来限制极端风险，但加仓递增的本质使得亏损时风险呈指数增长。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在单边大趋势中可能因持续加仓而导致巨额亏损。
EA-22854.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept combines a dual-confirmed trend-following entry using MA and MACD indicators with a martingale-style position averaging approach for position management. Entry conditions require alignment between the MA direction and MACD signal line crossover, providing dual indicator confirmation to reduce false signals. Exit conditions depend on the overall portfolio reaching a profit target or hitting a stop loss, rather than individual trade profit/loss. Position sizing employs an averaging-down model where additional positions are opened at fixed pip intervals with increasing lot sizes (typically doubling or scaling by a coefficient), which is a classic martingale characteristic. Money management attempts to limit extreme risk by setting a maximum number of averaging steps and a total stop loss, but the inherently escalating lot sizes cause risk to grow exponentially during losing streaks. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but can suffer catastrophic losses in strong trending markets where price continuously moves against the accumulated position.

EA-22869.name: Exp_i-KlPrice_Vol
EA-22869.summary: This EA is based on the i-KlPrice_Vol indicator, which combines Kluge Price analysis with volume filtering to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when the indicator shows bullish momentum confirmed by volume and enters short positions on bearish momentum with volume confirmation. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention, executing trades based on indicator crossover signals.
EA-22869.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-KlPrice_Vol指标，该指标结合了Kluge Price分析与成交量过滤来生成交易信号。当指标显示由成交量确认的看涨动量时建立多头头寸，在由成交量确认的看跌动量时建立空头头寸。EA系统化运行，无需手动干预，根据指标交叉信号执行交易。
EA-22869.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于i-KlPrice_Vol指标，该指标将价格动量（KlPrice）与成交量（Volume）相结合，形成复合信号。入场条件为：当KlPrice指标上穿零线且成交量放大时做多，当KlPrice指标下穿零线且成交量放大时做空。出场条件依赖于指标反向交叉信号或固定止损/止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于可用保证金的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，EA没有采用马丁格尔或网格策略，而是基于信号的单向交易模式。整体而言，该策略属于动量跟踪类型，利用价格变化率与成交量的共振来确认趋势方向。
EA-22869.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the i-KlPrice_Vol indicator, which combines price momentum (KlPrice) with volume filtering to form composite signals. Entry conditions are: go long when the KlPrice indicator crosses above the zero line with increasing volume, and go short when it crosses below the zero line with increasing volume. Exit conditions rely on indicator reverse crossover signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit settings. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on available margin. Money management does not employ martingale or grid strategies, instead relying on signal-based directional trading. Overall, the strategy falls into the momentum-following category, leveraging the resonance of price rate-of-change and volume to confirm trend direction.

It enters long when the KlPrice indicator shows bullish trend alignment and volume supports the move, and enters short on bearish alignment with volume. It is a systematic trend-following system without martingale or grid components.
EA-22871.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-KlPrice指标的直接信号并结合成交量确认进行交易。当KlPrice指标显示看涨趋势且成交量支持时做多，看跌趋势且成交量支持时做空。这是一个系统化的趋势跟踪系统，没有马丁格尔或网格组件。
EA-22871.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Klimo价格指标(i-KlPrice)的趋势方向判断，结合成交量过滤来确认趋势的有效性。入场条件为：当i-KlPrice指标发出看涨信号且成交量高于阈值时开多单，当指标发出看跌信号且成交量高于阈值时开空单。Direct模式意味着信号不被反转，直接按指标方向交易。出场条件通常依赖反向信号或固定的止损止盈水平，部分版本支持尾随止损。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA使用固定风险参数，没有马丁格尔加仓机制，但缺少动态仓位调整和最大回撤控制等高级资金管理功能。
EA-22871.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Klimo Price indicator (i-KlPrice) for trend direction determination, combined with volume filtering to confirm trend validity. Entry conditions: open long when i-KlPrice generates a bullish signal and volume exceeds a threshold, open short when the indicator generates a bearish signal with volume confirmation. The Direct mode means signals are not reversed — trades follow the indicator direction directly. Exit conditions typically rely on opposing signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, with some versions supporting trailing stops. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes or percentage-of-equity calculations. Money management employs fixed risk parameters without martingale position scaling, but lacks advanced features like dynamic position adjustment and maximum drawdown controls.

EA-22875.name: BITEX.ONE MarketMaker
EA-22875.summary: BITEX.ONE MarketMaker is an Expert Advisor that implements a market making strategy by placing buy and sell limit orders around the current market price, profiting from the bid-ask spread and short-term price oscillations. It continuously manages order placement at configurable distances from the mid-price and adjusts positions based on market movement. The EA aims to capture small, frequent profits from price reversion to the mean within a defined range.
EA-22875.summary_zh: BITEX.ONE MarketMaker是一个做市商策略EA，通过在当前市场价格上下放置买入和卖出限价单来获利，从买卖价差和短期价格震荡中获取利润。它持续管理订单的放置，以可配置的距离围绕中间价调整，并根据市场走势调整仓位。该EA旨在从价格在定义范围内的均值回归中捕获频繁的小额利润。
EA-22875.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用做市商策略概念，通过在当前价格上下方对称地放置限价单来捕获价差利润。入场条件是当价格偏离中间价达到设定距离时，限价单被触发成交，买入单在价格下跌至低位时触发，卖出单在价格上涨至高位时触发。出场条件依赖止盈和止损设置，当价格回归到目标水平时获利平仓，或当价格继续朝不利方向运动时止损。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于配置参数的动态手数调整方式，围绕中间价对称布局买卖单。资金管理方面，通过最大持仓限制和止损控制总体风险敞口，但做市策略在单边趋势行情中可能面临持续亏损的风险。该策略的核心假设是价格会在短期内回归均值，但在剧烈波动或趋势行情中可能导致多笔止损被连续触发。
EA-22875.strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a market making strategy concept by symmetrically placing limit orders above and below the current price to capture spread profits. Entry conditions are triggered when price deviates from the mid-price by a configured distance — buy limit orders fill when price drops to the lower level, and sell limit orders fill when price rises to the upper level. Exit conditions rely on take-profit and stop-loss settings, closing positions profitably when price reverts to target levels or cutting losses when price continues moving adversely. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamically adjusted lot sizes based on configuration parameters, symmetrically arranging buy and sell orders around the mid-price. Money management involves maximum position limits and stop-loss controls to manage overall risk exposure, though market making strategies can face sustained losses in trending markets. The core assumption of this strategy is that price will revert to the mean in the short term, but sharp volatility or strong trends can trigger consecutive stop-losses.

The strategy is a trend-following approach that aims to capture directional moves while filtering out noise through candle-based confirmation.
EA-22881.summary_zh: 该EA基于精细调整的移动平均线信号与K线形态相结合的交易策略，在MA条件与看涨K线形态一致时做多，与看跌K线形态一致时做空。它使用可配置的MA周期和K线确认过滤器来生成系统性的入场和出场信号，属于趋势跟踪策略，旨在通过K线确认过滤噪音来捕捉方向性行情。
EA-22881.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是将移动平均线的趋势判断与K线形态确认相结合，形成双重过滤的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件方面，当价格位于MA上方且出现看涨K线形态时开多单，当价格位于MA下方且出现看跌K线形态时开空单。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发或固定的止损止盈设置，部分版本可能包含追踪止损功能。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式，允许用户通过参数灵活调整。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数的配置，但具体的风险控制强度取决于用户的参数设置。整体而言，该策略的优势在于双重确认机制减少了假信号，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的亏损交易。
EA-22881.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept combines Moving Average trend identification with candlestick pattern confirmation to form a dual-filter trend-following system. For entry conditions, a long position is opened when price is above the MA and a bullish candle pattern forms, while a short position is triggered when price is below the MA and a bearish candle pattern appears. Exit conditions rely on opposite signal triggers or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, with some implementations potentially including a trailing stop feature. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or balance-based dynamic lot calculation, allowing users to flexibly adjust through input parameters. Money management provides configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters, though the actual risk control robustness depends heavily on user-configured values. Overall, the strategy benefits from dual confirmation reducing false signals, but may generate frequent losing trades in ranging or choppy markets.

EA-22882.name: Exp_RJTX_Matches_Smoothed_Duplex
EA-22882.summary: This EA trades based on the RJTX Matches Smoothed indicator in a duplex (dual-direction) configuration, generating buy and sell signals from smoothed momentum crossovers. It opens positions when the smoothed signal line crosses key thresholds or its opposite-direction counterpart, relying on indicator-derived entry and exit logic. The duplex approach allows simultaneous monitoring of both bullish and bearish momentum shifts for systematic trade execution.
EA-22882.summary_zh: 该EA基于RJTX Matches平滑指标的双向配置进行交易，通过平滑动量交叉产生买入和卖出信号。当平滑信号线穿越关键阈值或反向对应线时开仓，依赖指标驱动的入场和出场逻辑。双向方法允许同时监控看涨和看跌动量变化，实现系统性交易执行。
EA-22882.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用RJTX Matches Smoothed指标的双向（Duplex）配置，核心策略是基于动量平滑信号的交叉来判断市场方向。入场条件为：当看涨方向的平滑信号线向上穿越看跌方向信号线或穿越零轴时做多，反之作空。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号的出现或指标值回落至阈值以下。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未发现动态仓位调整或基于ATR的自适应手数机制。资金管理方面，EA依赖外部参数设置止损和止盈，但缺少账户权益比例的风控逻辑。整体策略属于动量跟踪类型，通过平滑处理减少噪音干扰，但在剧烈行情中可能存在滞后风险。
EA-22882.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a duplex configuration of the RJTX Matches Smoothed indicator, with the core strategy based on momentum smoothed signal crossovers to determine market direction. Entry conditions: go long when the bullish smoothed signal line crosses above the bearish signal line or the zero axis, and vice versa for short positions. Exit conditions rely on the appearance of reverse crossover signals or the indicator value falling back below threshold levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic position adjustment or ATR-based adaptive lot mechanisms. Money management depends on externally configurable stop loss and take profit parameters, but lacks equity-proportional risk control logic. The overall strategy falls under momentum following, using smoothing to reduce market noise, but may suffer from lag in volatile market conditions.

EA-22884.name: LBS
EA-22884.summary: LBS (London Breakout Strategy) is an Expert Advisor designed to trade the London session open breakout. It identifies a narrow Asian session consolidation range and enters trades when price breaks above or below that range during the London session, capturing momentum-driven directional moves.
EA-22884.summary_zh: LBS（伦敦突破策略）是一个专为交易伦敦时段开盘突破而设计的EA。它识别亚洲时段的窄幅整理区间，并在伦敦时段价格突破该区间时入场交易，捕捉动量驱动的方向性走势。
EA-22884.strategy_analysis: LBS策略的核心概念是利用亚洲时段（东京时段）形成的窄幅整理区间作为参考，在伦敦开盘后价格突破该区间时入场做多或做空。入场条件为：价格突破亚洲区间上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空，属于典型的时段突破策略。出场条件包括固定止盈目标、固定止损以及伦敦时段结束前强制平仓，避免隔夜风险。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算手数方式，未发现马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损设置但未发现严格的资金比例控制或动态仓位调整机制，止损与止盈的比例相对固定。
EA-22884.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the LBS strategy is to use the narrow consolidation range formed during the Asian (Tokyo) session as a reference, entering long or short when price breaks out of that range after the London session opens. Entry conditions are: go long when price breaks above the Asian range high, go short when price breaks below the Asian range low — a classic session breakout approach. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit targets, fixed stop-loss levels, and forced closing before the end of the London session to avoid overnight risk. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage-of-balance calculation; no martingale or grid pyramiding logic was found. Money management provides stop-loss settings but lacks strict equity percentage controls or dynamic position adjustment; the stop-loss to take-profit ratio is relatively fixed.

EA-22889.name: Precipice
EA-22889.summary: Precipice is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies directional momentum and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses a combination of technical indicators to confirm trend strength before opening positions and applies trailing stops to protect profits. The EA aims to capture medium-to-long-term trend moves while managing risk through position sizing and stop losses.
EA-22889.summary_zh: Precipice是一个趋势跟踪型EA，通过识别方向性动量并沿当前趋势方向入场交易。它结合多个技术指标确认趋势强度后再开仓，并使用移动止损保护利润。该EA旨在捕捉中长线趋势行情，同时通过仓位管理和止损来控制风险。
EA-22889.strategy_analysis: Precipice策略的核心概念是基于趋势跟踪，通过技术指标判断市场的主趋势方向并在趋势确认后入场。入场条件通常依赖移动平均线的排列方向或价格突破关键水平来确认趋势成立，配合动量指标如RSI或MACD来过滤假信号。出场条件包括预设的止损和止盈水平，以及移动止损机制在趋势延续时锁定利润。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理上，EA设置了最大持仓限制和单笔风险控制，但具体参数取决于用户的配置。整体策略偏向中长线持仓，适合趋势明确的市场环境，在震荡市中可能产生连续止损。
EA-22889.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Precipice strategy is trend following, using technical indicators to determine the prevailing market trend direction and entering trades after trend confirmation. Entry conditions typically rely on moving average alignment or price breaking through key levels to confirm trend establishment, combined with momentum indicators such as RSI or MACD to filter out false signals. Exit conditions include preset stop loss and take profit levels, as well as a trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits as the trend extends. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, with some versions potentially including dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and per-trade risk controls, though specific parameters depend on user configuration. The overall strategy leans toward medium-to-long-term holding periods, performing best in clearly trending markets, while it may suffer consecutive stop losses during choppy or range-bound conditions.

EA-22898.name: Exp_FineTuningMACandle_Duplex
EA-22898.summary: This EA implements a dual Moving Average candle-based trend following strategy with fine-tuning capabilities. It generates trade signals when MA candles indicate directional shifts, opening positions in the direction of the emerging trend. The duplex architecture allows simultaneous long and short signal processing for more responsive market participation.
EA-22898.summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于双均线K线的趋势跟踪策略，具备精细调参功能。当均线K线指示方向性转变时产生交易信号，沿新兴趋势方向开仓。双工架构允许同时处理多头和空头信号，实现更灵敏的市场参与。
EA-22898.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用移动平均线构建的K线形态来判断趋势方向，核心概念是通过MA值的开高低收形成虚拟K线来过滤市场噪音。入场条件基于MA K线的颜色变化或形态突破，当均线K线由阴转阳时做多，由阳转阴时做空。出场条件依赖反向信号出现或固定止损止盈设置，部分版本可能包含移动止损功能。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于资金的动态计算两种模式。资金管理方面提供了风险百分比参数，但具体实现需要查看源码确认是否包含最大持仓限制或回撤控制。双工（Duplex）设计意味着EA可以同时跟踪两个不同参数集的均线信号，增加策略灵活性。
EA-22898.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses candlestick patterns constructed from Moving Average values to determine trend direction, with the core concept being the creation of virtual candles from MA open/high/low/close values to filter market noise. Entry conditions are based on MA candle color changes or pattern breakouts - going long when MA candles shift from bearish to bullish, and going short when they shift from bullish to bearish. Exit conditions rely on the appearance of reversal signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit settings, with some versions potentially including trailing stop functionality. Position sizing supports both fixed lot size and equity-based dynamic calculation modes. Money management provides risk percentage parameters, though the specific implementation details regarding maximum position limits or drawdown controls would need source code verification. The Duplex design means the EA can simultaneously track two different parameter sets of MA signals, increasing strategy flexibility.

趋势策略在震荡市中可能连续亏损，缺乏行情状态过滤机制
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit parameters are 0, leaving positions unprotected if users don't manually configure them
Trend strategy may incur consecutive losses in ranging markets due to lack of market state filtering mechanism

EA-22900.name: Lego EA
EA-22900.summary: This EA uses a modular 'Lego' block approach combining multiple technical indicators across different timeframes to generate trade signals. It assembles various signal components (trend, momentum, and confirmation) like building blocks, allowing flexible strategy composition. The system opens positions when enough aligned signals converge, providing a customizable multi-condition entry framework.
EA-22900.summary_zh: 该EA采用模块化'乐高'积木式方法，结合不同时间周期的多种技术指标来生成交易信号。它将趋势、动量和确认等各类信号组件像积木一样组合，允许灵活的策略构建。当足够多的对齐信号汇聚时，系统开仓，提供可定制的多条件入场框架。
EA-22900.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多时间框架多指标的模块化信号组合，将不同的技术分析模块作为独立的信号源进行加权投票。入场条件要求多个信号模块（如趋势方向、动量确认、支撑阻力位等）达到一致性阈值后才触发交易，降低了虚假信号的概率。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、反向信号出现以及可选的移动止损保护。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于账户风险比例的动态计算方式。资金管理方面提供最大持仓限制和单日最大亏损控制，但具体的杠杆和仓位比例需要用户根据自身风险偏好谨慎设置。
EA-22900.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a modular multi-timeframe multi-indicator signal combination, treating different technical analysis modules as independent weighted signal sources for voting. Entry conditions require multiple signal modules (such as trend direction, momentum confirmation, support/resistance levels, etc.) to reach a consistency threshold before triggering a trade, which reduces the probability of false signals. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, reverse signal occurrence, and an optional trailing stop protection mechanism. Position sizing supports both fixed lot size and dynamic calculation based on account risk percentage. Money management provides maximum position limits and daily maximum loss controls, but specific leverage and position ratios need to be carefully configured by users according to their own risk preferences.
pros: 模块化信号组合设计灵活，可根据不同市场环境调整信号权重和组合方式
多时间框架确认机制有效减少了低周期噪音导致的虚假信号
提供固定手数和风险比例两种仓位管理模式，适应不同交易风格需求
信号阈值参数化设计，允许用户在灵敏度和可靠性之间灵活权衡
具备每日最大亏损限制，防止极端行情下的过度亏损
pros_en: Modular signal combination design is flexible, allowing adjustment of signal weights and combinations for different market conditions
Multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism effectively reduces false signals caused by lower timeframe noise
Provides both fixed lot and risk-percentage position sizing modes to accommodate different trading style needs
Parameterized signal threshold design allows users to flexibly balance between sensitivity and reliability
Includes daily maximum loss limit to prevent excessive losses during extreme market conditions
cons: 多指标组合可能导致信号滞后，在快速反转行情中入场延迟
参数较多且相互关联，优化不当容易导致过度拟合历史数据
缺乏对市场波动率和点差的动态适应机制，在高点差环境下可能表现不佳
模块间的权重分配缺乏自适应机制，无法根据市场状态动态调整
未考虑流动性因素，在低流动性时段可能产生滑点较大的成交
cons_en: Multi-indicator combination may cause signal lag, resulting in delayed entry during rapid market reversals
Numerous interdependent parameters make the system prone to overfitting historical data if improperly optimized
Lacks dynamic adaptation to market volatility and spread, may perform poorly in high-spread environments
No adaptive mechanism for inter-module weight distribution, unable to dynamically adjust based on market state
Does not consider liquidity factors, may experience significant slippage during low-liquidity sessions
improvements: 增加自适应信号权重机制，根据近期各模块表现动态调整贡献度
加入波动率过滤和点差检查模块，避免在不利交易条件下开仓
improvements_en: Add adaptive signal weighting mechanism that dynamically adjusts each module's contribution based on recent performance
Incorporate volatility filter and spread check module to avoid opening positions under unfavorable trading conditions

risk_points: 多指标信号组合在极端行情中可能全部失效导致无效止损
缺乏对黑天鹅事件的特殊防护机制，如跳空缺口可能越过止损位
risk_points_en: Multi-indicator signal combination may fail entirely during extreme market conditions leading to ineffective stop-losses
Lacks special protection against black swan events, such as gap openings that could skip past stop-loss levels

EA-22909.name: Exp_XFisher_org_v1
EA-22909.summary: This EA is based on the XFisher_org_v1 indicator, a Fisher Transform variant that maps price data into a Gaussian normal distribution to identify momentum reversals. It generates buy signals when the Fisher value crosses above its signal line from oversold territory and sell signals when it crosses below from overbought territory. The EA automates trade entry and exit based on these crossover signals with configurable lot sizing and stop loss parameters.
EA-22909.summary_zh: 该EA基于XFisher_org_v1指标，这是Fisher Transform的一个变体，将价格数据映射为高斯正态分布以识别动量反转。当Fisher值从超卖区域上穿信号线时产生买入信号，从超买区域下穿信号线时产生卖出信号。EA根据这些交叉信号自动执行入场和出场操作，并支持可配置的手数和止损参数。
EA-22909.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用Fisher Transform的数学变换特性，将非正态分布的价格序列转换为近似正态分布，从而更清晰地识别价格动量的转折点。入场条件为：当Fisher指标线从负值区域（超卖）上穿其信号线时开多单，从正值区域（超买）下穿信号线时开空单。出场条件依赖反向交叉信号或预设止损止盈水平，部分实现可能包含跟踪止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户可通过参数设定交易量。资金管理方面缺乏基于账户余额的动态仓位调整机制，风险控制主要依赖止损参数。整体策略属于动量反转类型，在震荡行情中表现较好，但在强趋势行情中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-22909.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy leverages the mathematical transformation property of the Fisher Transform, converting non-normally distributed price series into an approximately Gaussian distribution to more clearly identify momentum turning points. Entry conditions are: open a long position when the Fisher line crosses above its signal line from negative territory (oversold), and open a short position when it crosses below from positive territory (overbought). Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or preset stop loss and take profit levels, with some implementations potentially including a trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user sets the trade volume through a parameter. Money management lacks dynamic position sizing based on account equity, and risk control primarily depends on stop loss parameters. The overall strategy falls under the momentum reversal category, performing better in ranging markets but potentially generating frequent false signals during strong trending conditions that can lead to consecutive losses.

策略逻辑清晰简洁，信号明确基于指标交叉，易于理解和验证
参数较少，减少了过拟合的风险，便于参数优化和实盘调优
pros_en: The Fisher Transform has a solid statistical foundation, effectively smoothing price noise and highlighting momentum reversal points
The strategy logic is clear and concise with explicit crossover signals, making it easy to understand and verify
Fewer parameters reduce the risk of overfitting and facilitate optimization and live trading tuning
cons: 在强趋势行情中容易产生频繁的虚假反转信号，导致连续止损
缺乏动态仓位管理机制，固定手数无法根据市场波动性自适应调整
没有包含点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在流动性差或点差过大时产生不利成交

添加趋势过滤机制（如更高时间周期的均线方向），避免在强趋势中逆势交易
加入点差过滤和交易时段控制，提高成交质量和减少滑点损失
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and position sizing to automatically adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Implement a trend filter mechanism (e.g., higher timeframe moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend trades during strong trends

risk_points: 固定手数缺乏资金管理，在小账户中可能导致单笔风险过大
Fisher Transform在趋势行情中信号频繁翻转可能造成连续亏损
缺少点差和流动性过滤可能在不利条件下成交
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks money management, potentially causing excessive per-trade risk on small accounts
Fisher Transform signal whipsaws during trending markets can cause consecutive losses
Absence of spread and liquidity filters may result in unfavorable execution conditions

EA-22914.name: Contrarian trade MA
EA-22914.summary: This EA implements a contrarian mean-reversion strategy using moving averages. It enters trades against the prevailing trend when price deviates significantly from a moving average, anticipating a reversion to the mean. The strategy opens positions on pullbacks and manages exits via take-profit and stop-loss levels.
EA-22914.summary_zh: 该EA使用移动平均线实现逆势均值回归策略。当价格显著偏离移动平均线时，它逆势开仓，预期价格将回归均值。策略在回撤时建仓，并通过止盈止损水平管理出场。
EA-22914.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是逆势交易，即当价格偏离移动平均线达到一定幅度时，反向开仓预期价格回归均值。入场条件是价格相对于均线的偏离度超过预设阈值，可能在均线上方过度延伸时做空，在均线下方过度偏离时做多。出场条件依赖固定点数的止盈和止损，止盈设于均线附近或回归目标位，止损设于偏离继续扩大的位置。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未见动态仓位调整或基于ATR的自适应手数计算。资金管理方面缺乏风险百分比控制，没有根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位大小的机制，整体风控较为简单。
EA-22914.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is contrarian trading, entering positions against the prevailing move when price deviates significantly from a moving average, anticipating a mean reversion. Entry conditions are triggered when price deviation from the MA exceeds a predefined threshold — going short when price is overextended above the MA and going long when price is oversold below the MA. Exit conditions rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels in points, with TP set near the mean reversion target and SL placed where the deviation would continue to widen. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic lot calculation or ATR-based adaptive sizing. Money management lacks percentage-based risk control and does not adjust position size based on account balance or volatility, making the overall risk management relatively simplistic.

EA-22933.name: Bruno
EA-22933.summary: Bruno is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossover logic combined with momentum filters to identify and ride market trends. It enters positions when fast and slow moving averages cross in the direction of the prevailing trend, confirmed by momentum indicators. The EA applies trailing stops and fixed take-profit levels to manage open positions.
EA-22933.summary_zh: Bruno是一个趋势跟踪型EA，利用均线交叉逻辑结合动量过滤器来识别并跟随市场趋势。当快慢均线在主趋势方向上交叉并得到动量指标确认时开仓。该EA使用移动止损和固定止盈来管理持仓。
EA-22933.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于均线交叉与动量确认的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为快均线上穿慢均线且动量指标（如RSI或MACD）确认趋势方向时做多，反之为做空。出场条件包括达到固定止盈目标、移动止损被触发或均线反向交叉时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算手数。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和每日最大亏损额度来控制风险。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-22933.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a trend-following system using moving average crossover with momentum confirmation. Entry conditions require the fast MA crossing above the slow MA with momentum indicators (such as RSI or MACD) confirming the trend direction for longs, and vice versa for shorts. Exit conditions include reaching a fixed take-profit target, trailing stop being triggered, or an opposing MA crossover signaling trend reversal. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage of account balance to calculate lot size. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and daily maximum loss thresholds to control overall risk exposure. The strategy logic is coherent but is prone to generating frequent false signals in ranging or choppy markets, leading to consecutive losses during sideways conditions.

趋势行情中能够有效捕捉中长期波段利润

EA-22971.name: Vlado
EA-22971.summary: Vlado is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using moving average crossovers and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses fixed lot sizing and implements basic stop loss and take profit levels for trade management. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention, placing trades when its trend conditions are met.
EA-22971.summary_zh: Vlado是一个趋势跟踪型EA，通过均线交叉识别市场方向，并在趋势方向上开仓交易。它使用固定手数，并实现基本的止损和止盈水平进行交易管理。该EA系统性运行，无需人工干预，在趋势条件满足时自动下单。
EA-22971.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过快速均线与慢速均线的交叉来判断趋势方向。当快速均线向上穿越慢速均线时，产生做多信号；当快速均线向下穿越慢速均线时，产生做空信号。入场条件依赖于均线交叉的确认，属于典型的趋势跟随入场逻辑。出场条件采用固定止损和止盈点数，部分版本可能包含移动止损功能。仓位管理使用固定手数，未根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面较为简单，缺乏基于风险百分比的仓位计算机制，存在过度暴露风险的可能性。
EA-22971.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, using crossover of fast and slow moving averages to determine trend direction. A buy signal is generated when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, and a sell signal when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. Entry conditions rely on MA crossover confirmation, representing a classic trend-following entry logic. Exit conditions use fixed stop loss and take profit in points, with some versions potentially including a trailing stop feature. Position sizing uses fixed lots without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or volatility. Money management is relatively simplistic, lacking risk-percentage-based position calculation, which may lead to overexposure risk.

EA-22977.name: Secwenta
EA-22977.summary: Secwenta is a trend-following Expert Advisor that opens trades when a configurable number of consecutive bullish or bearish bars appear, assuming that consecutive same-direction candles indicate trend continuation. It maintains a maximum of one open position at a time, operates only on new bar formation, and uses the WPR Custom indicator. BUY open signals simultaneously act as SELL close signals and vice versa, with optional direction-only trading modes.
EA-22977.summary_zh: Secwenta是一个趋势跟踪EA，当出现可配置数量的连续看涨或看跌K线时开仓，假设连续同方向K线预示趋势延续。它始终最多保留一个持仓，仅在新K线形成时操作，并使用WPR自定义指标。买入开仓信号同时也是卖出平仓信号，反之亦然，支持仅做多或仅做空模式。
EA-22977.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：基于连续同方向K线的趋势跟踪策略，核心逻辑是当出现指定数量的连续看涨或看跌K线时，认为趋势将会延续并顺势入场。入场条件：当连续出现Number of bull bars根看涨K线时开多仓，当连续出现Number of bear bars根看跌K线时开空仓。出场条件：买入开仓信号即为卖出平仓信号，卖出开仓信号即为买入平仓信号，也支持仅单方向交易时用反方向信号平仓。仓位管理：始终最多只持有一个持仓，可在净额账户和锁仓账户上运行。资金管理：通过手数参数控制仓位大小，但未见明确的止损止盈或资金百分比管理机制。策略还集成了WPR自定义指标作为辅助判断。
EA-22977.strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: A trend-following strategy based on consecutive same-direction candles, with the core logic that when a specified number of consecutive bullish or bearish bars appear, the trend is expected to continue and the EA enters in that direction. Entry conditions: Open a long position when Number of bull bars consecutive bullish candles appear, open a short position when Number of bear bars consecutive bearish candles appear. Exit conditions: A BUY open signal simultaneously serves as a SELL close signal and vice versa; when trading only one direction, an opposite-direction single bar can serve as the close signal. Position sizing: Always maintains a maximum of one open position, compatible with both netting and hedging accounts. Money management: Position size controlled via lot size parameter, but there is no explicit stop loss, take profit, or percentage-based money management mechanism. The EA also integrates the WPR Custom indicator as an auxiliary signal filter.

EA-22985.name: Tengri
EA-22985.summary: Tengri is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies and trades in the direction of established market trends using technical indicators. It enters positions when trend conditions are confirmed and manages trades with defined risk parameters. The EA aims to capture sustained directional moves across multiple timeframes.
EA-22985.summary_zh: Tengri是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，通过技术指标识别并跟随已建立的市场趋势方向进行交易。当趋势条件确认后入场，并使用定义的风险参数管理交易。该EA旨在捕捉多个时间周期上的持续方向性行情。
EA-22985.strategy_analysis: Tengri策略的核心概念是趋势跟踪，通过技术指标判断市场当前趋势方向并在趋势确认后顺势入场。入场条件基于趋势指标的共振信号，当多个指标同时指向同一方向时触发交易信号。出场条件包括固定止损和止盈设置，以及趋势反转信号出现时的动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式，确保单笔交易风险可控。资金管理方面，EA通过止损距离和账户风险百分比来计算每笔交易的下单量，避免过度杠杆。整体策略追求在趋势行情中获取大波段利润，以较小的试错成本捕捉大趋势。
EA-22985.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Tengri strategy is trend following, using technical indicators to determine the current market trend direction and entering positions after trend confirmation. Entry conditions are based on confluence signals from trend indicators, triggering trade signals when multiple indicators align in the same direction. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, as well as dynamic exit mechanisms when trend reversal signals appear. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or proportional calculations based on account balance, ensuring controlled risk per trade. In terms of money management, the EA calculates order size based on stop-loss distance and account risk percentage to avoid excessive leverage. The overall strategy aims to capture large trend moves while keeping trial-and-error costs small, following the classic trend-following philosophy of letting profits run and cutting losses short.

EA-23027.name: Pendulum
EA-23027.summary: Pendulum is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that captures market swings by identifying overbought and oversold conditions using oscillator indicators. It enters trades when momentum signals a reversal from extreme levels, aiming to profit from the natural oscillation of price like a pendulum. The EA employs a systematic approach with defined entry and exit rules based on momentum extremes.
EA-23027.summary_zh: Pendulum是一个基于动量的智能交易系统，通过震荡指标识别超买超卖条件来捕捉市场摆动。它在动量信号显示从极端水平反转时入场交易，旨在从价格的自然摆荡中获利。该EA采用系统性方法，基于动量极值制定明确的入场和出场规则。
EA-23027.strategy_analysis: Pendulum EA的核心策略概念基于市场动量的摆荡特性，类似于钟摆运动——价格在极端位置会产生回归力量。入场条件依赖于动量震荡指标（如RSI或随机指标）触及超买或超卖区域后出现反转信号，在超卖区向上反转时做多，在超买区向下反转时做空。出场条件包括止盈目标设定在动量回归均值的位置，以及止损保护以防动量持续朝不利方向发展。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户风险的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA通过止损与止盈比例控制每笔交易的风险敞口，但具体的资金管理严格程度取决于参数配置。
EA-23027.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of the Pendulum EA is based on the oscillating nature of market momentum, analogous to pendulum motion where price at extreme levels generates a restoring force. Entry conditions rely on momentum oscillator indicators (such as RSI or Stochastic) reaching overbought or oversold zones followed by reversal signals—going long when an upward reversal occurs from oversold territory and going short when a downward reversal appears from overbought territory. Exit conditions include take-profit targets set at levels where momentum reverts to its mean, along with stop-loss protection against sustained adverse momentum moves. Position sizing may employ fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot calculation based on account risk parameters. Money management is handled through stop-loss to take-profit ratio controls that manage risk exposure per trade, though the strictness of money management depends on parameter configuration.

EA-23037.name: Breakeven v3
EA-23037.summary: This EA is a breakeven/trailing stop utility that automatically moves the stop loss of open positions to the breakeven price once a specified profit threshold is reached. It does not open any trades itself but manages existing positions by protecting profits through breakeven and optional trailing stop functionality.
EA-23037.summary_zh: 这个EA是一个保本/移动止损工具，当持仓利润达到指定阈值时，自动将止损移动到保本价位。它本身不开仓，而是通过保本和可选的移动止损功能来管理已有仓位、保护利润。
EA-23037.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是保护已有利润，而非产生交易信号。入场条件方面，该EA本身不进行任何入场操作，它只是监控已有持仓的浮盈状态。出场条件方面，当持仓浮盈达到用户设定的保本触发点（Breakeven Trigger）时，EA将止损调整至开仓价加上小幅偏移量（Breakeven Offset），实现保本。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及仓位大小决策，仅管理已有仓位的止损水平。资金管理方面，该EA通过保本机制间接实现资金保护，防止盈利单变成亏损单。此外，该EA可能支持可选的移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，在保本之后继续跟随价格移动止损以锁定更多利润。
EA-23037.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this EA is profit protection rather than trade signal generation. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not open any trades itself; it only monitors the floating profit of existing positions. For exit conditions, when a position's floating profit reaches the user-defined breakeven trigger level, the EA moves the stop loss to the entry price plus a small offset (breakeven offset), effectively making the trade risk-free. In terms of position sizing, this EA does not make any lot size decisions as it only manages stop loss levels of existing positions. For money management, the EA indirectly protects capital through the breakeven mechanism, preventing winning trades from turning into losers. Additionally, the EA likely supports an optional trailing stop feature that continues to follow price movement after breakeven is achieved, locking in progressively more profit.

EA-23039.name: Parabolic SAR EA
EA-23039.summary: This EA uses the Parabolic SAR indicator to generate trend-following trading signals. It opens buy positions when the SAR dots flip below the price and sell positions when they flip above. The strategy is a classic trend-following system that rides sustained directional moves while using the SAR as both entry and trailing stop mechanism.
EA-23039.summary_zh: 该EA使用抛物线SAR指标生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当SAR点翻转到价格下方时开多仓，翻转到上方时开空仓。这是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统，利用SAR作为入场和追踪止损机制来捕捉持续的方向性行情。
EA-23039.strategy_analysis: 该EA基于抛物线SAR指标构建趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是利用SAR指标的方向翻转作为趋势转换信号。入场条件为：当SAR点从价格上方翻转到下方时做多，从下方翻转到上方时做空。出场条件同样依赖SAR指标的再次翻转，即持仓方向与SAR信号相反时平仓，SAR本身起到追踪止损的作用。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式，具体取决于参数配置。资金管理上，该策略依赖SAR的加速因子来动态调整止损距离，随着趋势发展止损会逐步靠近价格，实现利润保护。然而，SAR指标在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号，导致连续止损，这是该策略的主要弱点。
EA-23039.strategy_analysis_en: This EA builds a trend-following strategy around the Parabolic SAR indicator, with the core concept of using SAR dot flips as trend reversal signals. Entry conditions are: go long when SAR dots flip from above price to below, and go short when they flip from below to above. Exit conditions also rely on SAR flip signals, closing positions when the SAR reverses against the held direction, effectively using SAR as a trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or an equity-proportional approach depending on parameter configuration. Money management leverages the SAR's acceleration factor to dynamically adjust stop-loss distance, progressively tightening the stop as the trend advances to protect profits. However, the Parabolic SAR indicator is prone to generating frequent false signals in ranging or choppy markets, leading to consecutive stop-outs, which is the strategy's primary weakness.

EA-23040.name: Simple EA MA plus MACD
EA-23040.summary: This EA combines a Moving Average crossover or filter with the MACD indicator to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long positions when the MA signals an uptrend and MACD confirms bullish momentum, and enters short positions under the opposite conditions. The strategy is a classic dual-indicator trend-following system suitable for trending markets.
EA-23040.summary_zh: 该EA结合移动均线交叉或过滤与MACD指标来生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当均线信号显示上升趋势且MACD确认看涨动能时做多，反之做空。这是一个经典的双指标趋势跟踪系统，适用于趋势行情。
EA-23040.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用移动均线判断趋势方向，同时用MACD指标确认动量，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件方面，当价格位于MA之上（或快线上穿慢线）且MACD柱状图为正或信号线上穿时做多；做空条件相反。出场条件通常依赖MACD反向交叉或MA趋势反转信号，也可能设有止损和止盈参数。仓位管理方面，EA提供固定手数参数，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，该EA通常设有最大持仓限制和止损设置，但基础的移动均线加MACD组合缺乏自适应仓位调整和回撤控制机制。整体策略在强趋势市场中表现良好，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-23040.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept uses a Moving Average to determine trend direction and the MACD indicator to confirm momentum, representing a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions involve going long when price is above the MA (or a fast MA crosses above a slow MA) and MACD histogram is positive or the signal line crosses upward; short conditions are the reverse. Exit conditions typically rely on MACD reverse crossovers or MA trend reversal signals, and may also include configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing uses fixed lot parameters, though some variants may include balance-based dynamic lot calculation. Money management includes maximum position limits and stop-loss settings, but the basic MA plus MACD combination lacks adaptive position adjustment and drawdown control mechanisms. The overall strategy performs well in strong trending markets but is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging or choppy conditions.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试，适合初学者学习EA开发
双指标确认机制（MA+MACD）减少了单一指标产生的虚假信号
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和周期灵活调整指标参数
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and debug, suitable for beginners learning EA development
Dual indicator confirmation mechanism (MA+MACD) reduces false signals from a single indicator
Highly configurable parameters allow users to flexibly adjust indicator settings for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 在震荡行情中移动均线和MACD都会产生大量虚假信号，导致频繁开平仓亏损
缺乏高级资金管理机制，如动态仓位调整、最大回撤控制和新BAR检查
默认止损和止盈为零，用户必须手动设置否则交易风险极高
cons_en: Both MA and MACD generate numerous false signals during ranging markets, leading to frequent opening and closing of losing trades
Lacks advanced money management mechanisms such as dynamic position sizing, maximum drawdown control, and new bar checking

improvements: 增加趋势过滤器和震荡识别机制，如ADX指标，在低趋势强度时暂停交易以避免震荡行情中的虚假信号
实现基于账户权益的动态仓位管理和最大回撤限制，提高资金安全性和策略鲁棒性
improvements_en: Add a trend filter and ranging market detection mechanism, such as the ADX indicator, to pause trading during low trend strength and avoid false signals in sideways markets
Implement equity-based dynamic position sizing and maximum drawdown limits to improve capital safety and strategy robustness

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，若用户未手动配置则交易无任何保护，存在无限亏损风险
缺乏新BAR检查机制，可能在同一K线内反复开仓平仓造成过度交易
趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中会产生连续亏损，缺少整体回撤控制
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, creating unlimited loss risk if users do not manually configure them
Lacks new bar checking mechanism, potentially causing excessive trading by repeatedly opening and closing positions within the same candle
Trend-following strategy produces consecutive losses in ranging markets with no overall drawdown control

EA-23061.name: FT CCI MA
EA-23061.summary: This EA combines the CCI (Commodity Channel Index) indicator with a Moving Average to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when CCI crosses above a threshold while price is above the MA, and enters short positions when CCI crosses below a threshold while price is below the MA. The strategy aims to capture momentum shifts confirmed by trend direction.
EA-23061.summary_zh: 该EA结合CCI（商品通道指数）指标与移动平均线生成交易信号。当CCI上穿阈值且价格在均线上方时做多，当CCI下穿阈值且价格在均线下方时做空。该策略旨在捕捉由趋势方向确认的动量转换。
EA-23061.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是动量跟踪，结合CCI指标的超买超卖区域和移动平均线的趋势方向过滤来决定入场。入场条件方面，多头信号为CCI从低位上穿买入阈值且价格位于移动平均线之上，空头信号为CCI从高位下穿卖出阈值且价格位于移动平均线之下，双重条件过滤减少了假信号。出场条件通常依赖固定止盈止损或反向信号触发平仓。仓位管理方面，EA支持手数参数设置，但具体是否有动态仓位调整取决于参数配置。资金管理方面，止损设置是策略的重要组成部分，但需关注止损距离是否合理以及是否考虑了点差影响。整体而言，该策略逻辑清晰，但作为动量策略在震荡市中可能产生较多亏损交易。
EA-23061.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum tracking, combining CCI overbought/oversold zones with Moving Average trend direction filtering for trade entries. For entry conditions, a long signal requires CCI crossing above the buy threshold while price is above the MA, and a short signal requires CCI crossing below the sell threshold while price is below the MA; this dual-condition filtering reduces false signals. Exit conditions typically rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or reverse signal triggers to close positions. Position sizing is handled through configurable lot size parameters, though the absence of dynamic lot calculation based on account equity is a potential limitation. Money management relies on stop-loss settings as a key component, but the adequacy of stop distances and whether spread impact is considered need scrutiny. Overall, the strategy logic is clear and well-structured, but as a momentum system it may generate excessive losing trades in ranging markets.
pros: 双重条件过滤（CCI+MA）有效减少假信号，提高入场质量
策略逻辑简洁清晰，参数可调性强，便于优化和适应不同品种
CCI作为动量指标配合趋势方向确认，符合趋势交易的基本原理
pros_en: Dual-condition filtering (CCI + MA) effectively reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Clear and concise strategy logic with highly configurable parameters, easy to optimize and adapt to different instruments
CCI as a momentum indicator combined with trend direction confirmation aligns with fundamental trend trading principles
cons: 动量策略在震荡行情中容易频繁止损，缺乏横盘市场识别机制
固定手数交易缺乏基于账户资金的比例仓位管理，风险控制不够灵活
未发现明确的点差过滤和交易时段过滤机制，可能在不利条件下开仓
cons_en: Momentum strategy tends to generate frequent stop-losses in ranging markets due to lack of sideways market identification
Fixed lot sizing lacks proportional position management based on account equity, making risk control inflexible
No explicit spread filter or trading session filter detected, potentially opening positions under unfavorable conditions
improvements: 增加横盘市场识别机制（如ADX过滤器），在震荡行情中暂停交易或切换策略
引入基于账户净值比例的动态仓位管理和点差/交易时段过滤，提升风险控制能力
improvements_en: Add sideways market identification (e.g., ADX filter) to pause trading or switch strategies during ranging conditions
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage and add spread/trading session filters to enhance risk control

risk_points: 动量策略在震荡市中可能连续亏损，缺乏市场状态自适应机制
若止损设为0或过大，单笔交易可能承受较大亏损
risk_points_en: Momentum strategy may incur consecutive losses in ranging markets due to lack of market state adaptation
If stop-loss is set to 0 or excessively wide, a single trade may suffer significant losses

EA-23073.name: Bronze Warrior
EA-23073.summary: Bronze Warrior is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that uses a combination of technical indicators to identify trend direction and momentum shifts for trade entries. It generates buy and sell signals based on indicator crossovers and threshold conditions, with built-in stop loss and take profit management. The EA operates systematically on specified timeframes and instruments without manual intervention.
EA-23073.summary_zh: Bronze Warrior是一个基于动量的EA交易程序，结合多种技术指标来识别趋势方向和动量变化以进行交易入场。它根据指标交叉和阈值条件生成买入和卖出信号，并内置止损和止盈管理。该EA在指定的时间周期和品种上系统化运行，无需人工干预。
EA-23073.strategy_analysis: Bronze Warrior的策略核心是基于动量指标的交叉信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件依赖于多个技术指标的组合确认，当短期动量指标穿越长期指标或突破关键阈值时触发交易信号，多头和空头分别有各自的入场逻辑。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈设置，以及可能的追踪止损机制来保护已有利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式，允许用户通过参数调整每笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理方面，EA提供了最大持仓限制和账户风险控制参数，但在极端行情下仍存在滑点和缺口风险。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺乏对市场状态（震荡或趋势）的自适应切换机制。
EA-23073.strategy_analysis_en: Bronze Warrior's strategy core is based on momentum indicator crossover signals for trend-following trades. Entry conditions rely on the combined confirmation of multiple technical indicators, triggering trade signals when short-term momentum indicators cross long-term ones or break through key thresholds, with separate entry logic for long and short positions. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit settings, along with a possible trailing stop mechanism to protect accumulated profits. Position sizing adopts either fixed lots or a proportional calculation based on account balance, allowing users to adjust risk exposure per trade through configurable parameters. In terms of money management, the EA provides maximum position limits and account risk control parameters, but still faces slippage and gap risks during extreme market conditions. The overall strategy logic is clear, but lacks an adaptive mechanism to switch between ranging and trending market states.

EA-23086.name: Executer AC
EA-23086.summary: Executer AC is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that uses the Accelerator Oscillator (AC) indicator by Bill Williams to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when the AC indicator shows positive momentum shifts and enters short positions on negative momentum shifts, typically operating on medium timeframes. The EA applies systematic signal-based entries with the AC oscillator as its sole decision driver.
EA-23086.summary_zh: Executer AC是一个基于动量的智能交易系统，使用比尔·威廉姆斯的加速振荡器(AC)指标生成交易信号。当AC指标显示正向动量转变时做多，负向动量转变时做空，通常在中周期时间框架上运行。该EA以AC振荡器作为唯一决策驱动因素进行系统性信号入场。
EA-23086.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念基于比尔·威廉姆斯的加速振荡器(AC)指标，该指标衡量价格动量的加速或减速变化。入场条件为：当AC指标从负值区域转为正值并连续出现更高柱状时做多，从正值区域转为负值并连续出现更低柱状时做空。出场条件通常依赖于反向AC信号或固定的止损止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户自定义手数大小，但没有看到基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，缺乏复杂的资金管理策略，如根据波动率调整仓位或基于权益的仓位缩放。整体策略逻辑简单直接，依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多重确认和过滤机制，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
EA-23086.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is based on Bill Williams' Accelerator Oscillator (AC) indicator, which measures the acceleration or deceleration of price momentum. Entry conditions are: go long when the AC indicator shifts from negative to positive territory and shows consecutive higher histogram bars, and go short when it shifts from positive to negative with consecutive lower bars. Exit conditions typically rely on opposing AC signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. In terms of position sizing, the EA allows users to customize lot size but lacks dynamic position adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management is rudimentary with no sophisticated strategies such as volatility-based position scaling or equity-linked sizing adjustments. The overall strategy logic is simple and direct, relying on a single indicator signal without multi-confirmation or filtering mechanisms, making it prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets.

EA-23090.name: Open Close
EA-23090.summary: This EA trades based on the relationship between the current bar's open and close prices, entering positions when the open and close price difference meets a specified threshold. It is a simple price-action scalping strategy that operates on lower timeframes, opening trades in the direction of the candle body magnitude.
EA-23090.summary_zh: 该EA基于当前K线开盘价与收盘价的关系进行交易，当开收盘价差达到指定阈值时进场。这是一个简单的价格行为剥头皮策略，在低周期运行，根据K线实体大小方向开仓。
EA-23090.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于K线开盘价与收盘价的差值作为入场信号，当差值超过设定阈值时认为存在方向性动量。入场条件为当前K线的开收盘价差超过指定参数值，差值为正则做多，差值为负则做空。出场条件依赖止盈和止损参数，没有复杂的跟踪止损或移动止盈机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面缺乏风险百分比计算，仅依赖用户手动设置合理手数。该策略逻辑极其简单，没有考虑市场结构、趋势过滤或多时间框架确认。
EA-23090.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the difference between a candle's open and close prices as an entry signal, assuming directional momentum exists when the body exceeds a threshold. Entry conditions trigger when the current bar's open-close difference surpasses a specified parameter value - positive difference for buy, negative for sell. Exit conditions rely solely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss parameters, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanisms. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management lacks percentage-based risk calculation, depending entirely on the user manually setting reasonable lot sizes. The strategy logic is extremely simplistic, failing to consider market structure, trend filtering, or multi-timeframe confirmation.

EA-23108.name: E-Friday
EA-23108.summary: E-Friday is a session-based Expert Advisor that trades specifically on Fridays, exploiting end-of-week market patterns and potential gap opportunities. It opens positions based on price action and momentum conditions that occur during the Friday trading session, with positions typically held over the weekend to capture Monday gap moves. The EA implements systematic entry and exit rules tied to Friday's unique market dynamics.
EA-23108.summary_zh: E-Friday是一个基于时段的专家顾问，专门在周五交易，利用周末市场模式和潜在的缺口机会。它根据周五交易时段出现的价格行为和动量条件开仓，头寸通常持有过周末以捕获周一缺口行情。该EA实现了与周五独特市场动态相关的系统性入场和出场规则。
EA-23108.strategy_analysis: E-Friday的策略概念基于周五特有的市场行为模式，利用周末前流动性变化和持仓调整带来的价格波动特征。入场条件通常包括周五特定时段的价格动量信号、移动均线交叉或支撑阻力位突破，部分版本还结合了波动率过滤条件来确认交易机会。出场条件可能采用固定止盈止损、周一开盘平仓或追踪止损方式，核心逻辑是捕获周末持仓调整和周一开盘缺口带来的利润。仓位管理方面，EA提供固定手数和基于资金的动态仓位计算两种模式，但具体参数取决于版本配置。资金管理方面，该EA通常使用百分比风险模型或固定手数方式，部分版本包含最大持仓限制和连续亏损后的交易暂停机制。策略的关键假设是周五尾盘和周一开盘之间存在可预测的价格行为规律，但这种假设在市场流动性突变或重大新闻事件发生时可能失效。
EA-23108.strategy_analysis_en: E-Friday's strategy concept is based on Friday-specific market behavior patterns, exploiting price volatility driven by pre-weekend liquidity changes and position adjustments by institutional traders. Entry conditions typically include Friday session momentum signals, moving average crossovers, or support/resistance level breakouts, with some versions incorporating volatility filters to confirm trade opportunities. Exit conditions may use fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, Monday open closing, or trailing stops, with the core logic aimed at capturing profits from weekend position adjustments and Monday opening gaps. Position sizing offers both fixed lot and equity-based dynamic calculation modes, though specific parameters depend on version configuration. Money management typically employs a percentage risk model or fixed lot approach, with some versions including maximum position limits and trading pause mechanisms after consecutive losses. The strategy's key assumption is that predictable price behavior exists between Friday's close and Monday's open, but this assumption can fail during sudden liquidity shocks or major news events.
pros: 利用周五特有的市场时段效应，具有统计可验证的日内模式基础
交易时段明确限制，避免非预期时段的随意开仓，降低了过度交易风险
结合周末缺口逻辑，策略具有清晰的持仓周期和盈利假设
参数化设计允许用户根据不同品种和市场条件调整策略
持仓过周末的策略逻辑与日内交易形成互补，提供了差异化的收益来源
pros_en: Exploits Friday-specific session effects with a statistically verifiable intraday pattern foundation
Trading hours are clearly limited, preventing unintended entries during off-hours and reducing overtrading risk
Weekend gap logic provides clear holding period and profit assumptions for the strategy
Parameterized design allows users to adjust the strategy for different instruments and market conditions
Over-weekend holding logic complements intraday strategies, providing a differentiated return source
cons: 周末持仓面临跳空风险，周一开盘价格可能大幅偏离周五收盘价导致超出预期的亏损
周五时段效应并非在所有市场环境下都有效，趋势性行情或重大新闻可能完全改变周末行为模式
缺少流动性过滤和点差检查机制，在低流动性周五尾盘可能遭遇滑点和报价异常
策略对周五特定时段的依赖意味着每周仅有一次交易窗口，机会频率较低
过周末持仓增加了隔夜融资成本和不可控的黑天鹅事件风险
cons_en: Over-weekend positions face gap risk; Monday's opening price may deviate significantly from Friday's close, causing larger-than-expected losses
The Friday session effect is not effective in all market conditions; trending markets or major news can completely alter weekend behavior patterns
Lacks liquidity and spread filtering mechanisms, potentially encountering slippage and quote anomalies during low-liquidity Friday late sessions
Strategy dependence on Friday-specific sessions means only one trading window per week, resulting in low opportunity frequency
Over-weekend holding increases swap costs and uncontrollable black swan event risk exposure
improvements: 增加周末重大新闻事件日历过滤，避免在已知高风险事件前持仓过周末
引入波动率自适应的止损止盈机制，根据ATR动态调整风险参数而非使用固定点数
添加周五流动性指标和点差监控，在流动性不足时自动暂停交易
improvements_en: Add economic calendar filtering for major weekend news events to avoid holding positions over high-risk weekends
Introduce volatility-adaptive stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms using ATR-based dynamic risk parameters instead of fixed pip values
Add Friday liquidity indicators and spread monitoring to automatically pause trading when liquidity is insufficient

risk_points: 周末持仓面临不可控的缺口风险，周一开盘可能出现与预期方向相反的大幅跳空
周五尾盘流动性下降可能导致滑点增大和止损执行不力
缺少重大新闻事件过滤机制，在周末突发事件下风险敞口不可控
risk_points_en: Over-weekend positions face uncontrollable gap risk; Monday's open may show a large adverse gap opposite to the expected direction
Declining Friday late-session liquidity may cause increased slippage and poor stop-loss execution

EA-23139.name: Flat Channel
EA-23139.summary: This EA identifies flat/ranging channel periods in the market and trades breakouts from those channels. It detects consolidation zones using high/low price boundaries over a defined lookback period, then enters trades when price breaks out of the channel, targeting momentum continuation moves.
EA-23139.summary_zh: 该EA识别市场中的横盘/盘整通道区间，并在价格突破通道时进行交易。它通过定义回溯期内的最高价和最低价边界来检测盘整区域，当价格突破通道时入场，目标捕捉动量延续走势。
EA-23139.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是通道突破策略，即在市场处于横盘整理阶段时识别出价格通道的上下边界，等待价格突破通道后入场交易。入场条件为价格收盘突破通道上轨时做多，收盘跌破通道下轨时做空。出场条件通常依赖固定止盈止损或通道宽度的倍数来设定目标位。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于通道宽度计算的手数进行交易，未发现明显的马丁格尔或网格特征。资金管理方面，止损通常设置在通道对侧或固定点数，但具体的风控措施取决于参数配置。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于经典的区间突破交易方法，但在震荡市中容易出现假突破导致的连续亏损。
EA-23139.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a channel breakout system that identifies the upper and lower boundaries of a price channel during ranging/consolidation periods, then enters trades when price breaks out of the channel. Entry conditions are: go long when price closes above the upper channel boundary, and go short when price closes below the lower channel boundary. Exit conditions typically rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or multiples of the channel width to set profit targets. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or lots calculated based on the channel width, with no martingale or grid characteristics detected. Money management sets stop-losses at the opposite side of the channel or at a fixed pip distance, though specific risk controls depend on parameter configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear and represents a classic range-breakout trading approach, but it is susceptible to consecutive losses from false breakouts during choppy markets.

EA-23141.name: Exp_Slow-Stoch_Duplex
EA-23141.summary: This EA trades a duplex (dual) Slow Stochastic strategy, generating buy signals when the stochastic is oversold and crosses upward, and sell signals when it is overbought and crosses downward. It operates systematically on the Slow Stochastic indicator with configurable overbought/oversold thresholds and applies to any symbol and timeframe. The EA opens positions based on stochastic crossover signals in overbought/oversold zones.
EA-23141.summary_zh: 该EA使用双慢速随机指标策略，在随机指标超卖区向上交叉时产生买入信号，在超买区向下交叉时产生卖出信号。它系统性地基于慢速随机指标的交叉信号开仓，适用于任意交易品种和时间周期。
EA-23141.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于慢速随机指标的均值回归原理，认为价格在超买超卖区域会回归均值。入场条件为：当%K线在超卖区（默认20以下）向上穿越%D线时开多单，当%K线在超买区（默认80以上）向下穿越%D线时开空单。出场条件依赖于固定的止盈止损设置，或反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过Money参数直接设定交易手数。资金管理方面缺乏动态仓位计算，没有基于账户余额或风险百分比的自动调整机制。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在强趋势行情中可能频繁止损。
EA-23141.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the mean reversion principle of the Slow Stochastic indicator, assuming that prices in overbought and oversold zones will revert to the mean. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the %K line crosses above the %D line in the oversold zone (default below 20), and a sell signal is generated when the %K line crosses below the %D line in the overbought zone (default above 80). Exit conditions rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss settings, or closing positions when a reverse signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user directly sets the trade volume via the Money parameter. Money management lacks dynamic position calculation with no automatic adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but may suffer frequent stop-outs during strong trending conditions.
