时间过滤器配置不当可能错过重要交易机会或在不当时段开仓
risk_points_en: Single indicator dependency may cause consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lack of spread filter may erode profits in high-spread environments
Improper time filter configuration may miss important trading opportunities or open positions during unfavorable sessions

EA-23443.name: Breakdown Catcher
EA-23443.summary: Breakdown Catcher is a breakout-type Expert Advisor that monitors price consolidation ranges and enters trades when a breakdown (breakout) of the range boundary occurs. It identifies periods of price compression and aims to capture the momentum expansion that follows a decisive breakout. The EA systematically places trades in the direction of the breakout with predefined stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-23443.summary_zh: Breakdown Catcher是一个突破类EA，监控价格整理区间，当价格突破区间边界时入场交易。它识别价格压缩阶段，旨在捕捉突破后的动量扩张行情。该EA系统性地在突破方向下单，并设置预定义的止损和止盈。
EA-23443.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于价格整理区间突破，即当价格在一段时间的窄幅波动后出现方向性突破时入场。入场条件为价格突破识别到的区间上轨或下轨，通常需要收盘价确认突破有效。出场条件包括固定止盈目标和止损水平，部分版本可能包含移动止损以锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方式。资金管理方面，该EA通过止损控制单笔风险，但需注意突破失败时的假突破风险。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的区间突破交易方法，适合波动率扩张的行情阶段。
EA-23443.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on range breakout trading, entering positions when price breaks out of an identified consolidation range after a period of narrow price fluctuation. Entry conditions require price to break above the upper boundary or below the lower boundary of the detected range, with some implementations requiring candle close confirmation to validate the breakout. Exit conditions consist of fixed take profit targets and stop loss levels, with some variants including trailing stops to lock in profits as the move extends. Position sizing typically uses either fixed lots or a balance-proportional approach to scale trade size with account equity. Money management relies on stop losses to cap per-trade risk, but traders should be aware of false breakout risk where price briefly pierces the range boundary before reversing. The overall strategy logic is straightforward and belongs to the classic range breakout trading methodology, best suited for volatility expansion phases in the market.

包含移动止损功能，可在趋势延续时锁定利润

pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic based on the well-established range breakout methodology

Features a trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits as the breakout trend extends

固定手数仓位管理未根据市场波动率动态调整，可能在不同行情下风险不均

缺乏账户级别风险控制：没有最大回撤限制或日亏损限额，极端行情下可能遭受较大损失

risk_points_en: False breakout risk: Range breakout strategies inherently face the risk of price briefly piercing the boundary before reversing, which can lead to consecutive stop losses
Lack of account-level risk controls: No maximum drawdown limit or daily loss cap, meaning significant losses could occur during extreme market conditions
Fixed position sizing not adjusted for volatility: Position size may be too large in low-volatility periods and too small in high-volatility periods

EA-23445.name: AutoSet SL TP
EA-23445.summary: AutoSet SL TP is a utility EA that automatically sets Stop Loss and Take Profit levels for trades that are opened without them. It monitors open positions and applies predefined SL/TP values based on user configuration, ensuring no trade is left unprotected.
EA-23445.summary_zh: AutoSet SL TP是一个实用工具型EA，自动为没有设置止损和止盈的持仓添加止损止盈水平。它监控未平仓位并根据用户预设参数应用SL/TP值，确保没有交易缺乏保护。
EA-23445.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略型EA，而是一个仓位管理工具。其核心功能是持续监控所有未平仓订单，检测缺少止损或止盈的仓位，并自动为这些仓位设置预设的SL和TP值。入场条件方面，该EA不产生交易信号，而是作为辅助工具在交易已经开仓后介入。出场条件方面，它通过设置SL/TP间接管理出场，但自身不执行平仓操作。仓位管理方面，它不涉及开仓手数的计算，仅对已有仓位的风险参数进行补全。资金管理方面，该EA通过确保每笔交易都有止损保护来间接实现资金管理，防止因遗漏止损而导致的无限亏损风险。整体设计思路偏向防御性，旨在弥补手动交易或其它EA交易时遗漏止损止盈的风险。
EA-23445.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but rather a position management utility. Its core function is to continuously monitor all open positions, detect those missing stop loss or take profit levels, and automatically apply predefined SL/TP values to them. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not generate trading signals but acts as a supplementary tool after trades have already been opened. For exit conditions, it indirectly manages exits by setting SL/TP levels but does not execute closures itself. In terms of position sizing, it does not calculate lot sizes for new entries, only supplementing risk parameters for existing positions. For money management, the EA indirectly supports capital preservation by ensuring every trade has stop loss protection, preventing unlimited loss exposure from trades opened without SL. The overall design philosophy is defensive, aimed at mitigating the risk of trades left unprotected without proper stop loss and take profit levels.

EA-23450.name: Close panel
EA-23450.summary: This is a trade management utility panel that provides a graphical interface for quickly closing positions on the current chart symbol. It does not open trades based on any strategy signals; it serves as a convenient order management dashboard for traders to manually close all or specific positions.
EA-23450.summary_zh: 这是一个交易管理工具面板，提供图形界面用于快速平仓当前图表品种的持仓。它不基于任何策略信号开仓，而是作为订单管理仪表盘方便交易者手动平仓。
EA-23450.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略型EA，而是一个纯工具类面板。其核心功能是提供一键平仓操作界面，允许用户通过点击面板按钮快速关闭当前品种的所有持仓或多空分类持仓。入场条件不适用，因为此EA不会自动开仓。出场条件由用户手动触发，通过面板按钮执行平仓操作。仓位管理方面，该EA仅负责关闭现有仓位，不涉及开仓仓位计算。资金管理同样不适用，因为没有任何自动下单逻辑。整体而言，这是一个辅助性工具，旨在提升交易者的操作效率，减少手动逐个平仓的繁琐步骤。
EA-23450.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy EA but a pure utility panel. Its core function is to provide a one-click close position interface, allowing users to quickly close all positions or filtered long/short positions on the current symbol via panel buttons. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not open trades automatically. Exit conditions are manually triggered by the user through panel buttons to execute close operations. Position sizing is not relevant as the EA only handles closing existing positions, not opening new ones. Money management is similarly not applicable since there is no automated order placement logic. Overall, this is an auxiliary tool designed to improve trader operational efficiency and reduce the tedious steps of manually closing positions one by one.
pros: 提供一键平仓功能，大幅提升操作效率，尤其在行情剧烈波动时能快速响应

Add selective closing features, such as filtering positions by profit/loss ratio, lot size, or other conditions

EA-23452.name: Bill Williams
EA-23452.summary: This EA implements the Bill Williams trading system, utilizing Alligator, Fractals, Awesome Oscillator, and Accelerator Oscillator to identify momentum-based trading opportunities. It enters trades when multiple Bill Williams indicators align to confirm trend direction and momentum shifts. The system follows Bill Williams' Chaos Theory principles for market analysis and trade execution.
EA-23452.summary_zh: 该EA实现了比尔·威廉姆斯交易系统，利用鳄鱼指标、分形指标、动量震荡指标和加速震荡指标来识别基于动量的交易机会。当多个威廉姆斯指标同向确认趋势方向和动量转变时入场交易。该系统遵循比尔·威廉姆斯混沌理论原则进行市场分析和交易执行。
EA-23452.strategy_analysis: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯混沌理论，综合运用多个指标进行交易决策。入场条件：鳄鱼指标嘴唇、牙齿、下巴排列确认趋势方向，分形突破作为入场触发信号，动量震荡指标(AO)和加速震荡指标(AC)同向确认动量方向。出场条件：当鳄鱼指标收敛或分形反向突破时平仓，也可设置固定止损止盈。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算。资金管理方面，该EA依赖多指标协同确认以降低虚假信号风险，但缺少动态仓位调整和追踪止损等高级资金管理功能。整体策略逻辑清晰，但指标滞后性可能导致入场延迟，在震荡行情中容易产生虚假信号。
EA-23452.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is based on Bill Williams' Chaos Theory, combining multiple indicators for trading decisions. Entry conditions: Alligator indicator's Lips, Teeth, and Jaw alignment confirms trend direction, Fractal breakout serves as the entry trigger, and Awesome Oscillator (AO) and Accelerator Oscillator (AC) align to confirm momentum direction. Exit conditions: Positions close when the Alligator lines converge or when an opposite fractal breakout occurs, with optional fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or percentage-based calculation on account balance. Money management relies on multi-indicator confluence to reduce false signals, but lacks advanced features like dynamic position sizing and trailing stops. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-structured, but indicator lag may cause delayed entries, and false signals are common during ranging markets without clear trend direction.

EA-23484.name: JS Signal Baes
EA-23484.summary: This EA generates trade signals based on momentum indicators, likely combining RSI or MACD-style oscillators to identify overbought/oversold conditions and trend strength. It opens positions when momentum conditions align, targeting short-to-medium term price movements. The strategy appears to be a signal-based systematic approach with fixed or configurable lot sizing.
EA-23484.summary_zh: 该EA基于动量指标生成交易信号，可能结合RSI或MACD类振荡器来识别超买超卖状态和趋势强度。当动量条件对齐时开仓，瞄准短中期价格波动。该策略似乎是基于信号的系统化方法，采用固定或可配置的手数管理。
EA-23484.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于动量信号的判断，当动量指标达到特定阈值时触发交易入场。入场条件通常依赖RSI超买超卖交叉或MACD信号线交叉，结合趋势过滤器确认方向。出场条件可能采用固定止盈止损或反向信号平仓机制。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数计算方式。资金管理方面缺乏动态风险调整机制，可能未考虑最大回撤限制或连续亏损后的仓位缩减策略。整体策略逻辑相对简单直接，但在极端行情下可能面临较大回撤风险。
EA-23484.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum signal evaluation, triggering trade entries when momentum indicators reach specific thresholds. Entry conditions typically rely on RSI overbought/oversold crossovers or MACD signal line crossovers, combined with trend filters for directional confirmation. Exit conditions may use fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or reverse signal closing mechanisms. Position sizing employs fixed lots or balance-proportional lot calculation without dynamic risk adjustment. Money management lacks drawdown limits or position reduction after consecutive losses, which exposes the account to significant drawdown during extreme market conditions. The overall strategy logic is relatively straightforward but may face large drawdown risks in volatile markets.

EA-23487.name: WE TRUST
EA-23487.summary: This EA is a trend-following trading system that uses moving average crossovers and momentum indicators to identify and ride market trends. It enters positions when short-term momentum aligns with the prevailing trend direction and manages exits through a combination of trailing stops and fixed take-profit levels. The system applies position sizing based on account equity and includes basic risk management features.
EA-23487.summary_zh: 该EA是一个趋势跟踪交易系统，利用移动平均线交叉和动量指标来识别并跟随市场趋势。当短期动量与主要趋势方向一致时开仓，通过移动止损和固定止盈的组合来管理出场。系统根据账户权益进行仓位管理，并包含基础的风险管理功能。
EA-23487.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过快速和慢速移动平均线的交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件要求短期均线穿越长期均线，同时动量指标（如RSI或MACD）确认趋势强度，避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓。出场条件采用双重机制：固定止盈锁定利润，移动止损保护已获利润并让盈利奔跑。仓位管理基于账户净值的固定百分比计算，每笔交易的风险暴露可控。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓数量限制，防止过度交易。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在趋势反转时可能存在较大回撤风险，因为移动止损在剧烈行情中可能滑点较大。
EA-23487.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, using crossovers between fast and slow moving averages to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require the short-term MA to cross the long-term MA while momentum indicators (such as RSI or MACD) confirm trend strength, avoiding frequent entries during ranging markets. Exit conditions employ a dual mechanism: fixed take-profit to lock in gains and trailing stops to protect profits while letting winners run. Position sizing is calculated based on a fixed percentage of account equity, keeping risk exposure per trade controlled. Money management includes a maximum open position limit to prevent overtrading. The overall strategy logic is clear, but there is potential for significant drawdowns during trend reversals, as trailing stops may experience slippage in volatile market conditions.
pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，容易理解和验证

EA-23499.name: Ingrit
EA-23499.summary: Ingrit is a trend following EA that uses moving average crossovers and momentum indicators to identify and ride market trends. It enters positions when short-term moving averages cross above long-term ones with confirming momentum signals, and exits on trend reversal or stop conditions. The EA incorporates trailing stops and risk management rules to protect capital.
EA-23499.summary_zh: Ingrit是一个趋势跟踪EA，利用均线交叉和动量指标来识别并追随市场趋势。当短期均线穿越长期均线且动量信号确认时开仓，在趋势反转或止损条件下平仓。该EA集成了移动止损和风险管理规则以保护资金。
EA-23499.strategy_analysis: Ingrit EA的核心策略是基于均线交叉的趋势跟踪系统，通过快速均线与慢速均线的金叉和死叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件要求均线交叉信号得到动量指标（如MACD或RSI）的确认，避免虚假信号。出场条件包括反向交叉信号、固定止损和移动止损三重保护机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式，确保每笔交易的风险可控。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和每日亏损上限，防止极端行情下的过度亏损。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡市中可能产生较多虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-23499.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Ingrit EA is a trend following system based on moving average crossovers, using golden cross and death cross of fast and slow moving averages to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require MA crossover signals to be confirmed by momentum indicators such as MACD or RSI to avoid false signals. Exit conditions include triple protection: reverse crossover signals, fixed stop loss, and trailing stop mechanisms. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or proportional calculation based on account balance to ensure controllable risk per trade. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and daily loss caps to prevent excessive drawdowns during extreme market conditions. The overall strategy logic is clear, but it may generate numerous false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

EA-23511.name: Hedger
EA-23511.summary: Hedger is an Expert Advisor that implements a hedging strategy by opening opposing positions to protect existing trades from adverse market movements. It monitors open positions and dynamically creates hedge orders when certain loss thresholds or market conditions are met, aiming to limit downside risk through correlated offsetting trades. The EA manages both the original and hedge positions with configurable parameters for hedge triggers and exit logic.
EA-23511.summary_zh: Hedger是一个实现对冲策略的智能交易系统，通过开立反向仓位来保护现有交易免受不利市场波动的影响。当达到特定亏损阈值或市场条件时，它会监控持仓并动态创建对冲订单，旨在通过相关抵消交易来限制下行风险。
EA-23511.strategy_analysis: Hedger EA的核心策略是对冲，即在现有持仓出现浮亏达到预设阈值时，自动开立反向仓位以对冲风险。入场条件基于持仓的浮亏金额或比例触发，当浮亏超过设定阈值时，EA会在相关品种或反向方向开立对冲仓位。出场条件通常是对冲仓位达到盈利目标或原始仓位风险解除后同时平仓。仓位管理方面，对冲仓位的规模可以与原始仓位成比例，也可以根据用户设定的参数进行调整。资金管理依赖于对冲比例和最大对冲次数的配置，以控制总体敞口。该策略的优势在于可以有效限制单边风险，但劣势是对冲仓位本身也可能产生亏损，且在震荡行情中可能导致双向亏损。
EA-23511.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of the Hedger EA is hedging, which automatically opens opposing positions when existing positions accumulate floating losses beyond a preset threshold. Entry conditions are triggered based on the floating loss amount or percentage of the open position, and when the threshold is exceeded, the EA opens a hedge position in the opposite direction or on a correlated instrument. Exit conditions typically involve closing the hedge position when it reaches a profit target or when the original position's risk is mitigated, sometimes closing both simultaneously. Position sizing for the hedge can be proportional to the original position or configured via user-defined parameters to control the hedge ratio. Money management relies on hedge ratio settings and maximum hedge count limits to control overall exposure. The strategy effectively limits directional risk but carries the danger that hedge positions can also accumulate losses, and in choppy markets both sides may lose.

EA-23540.name: Ilan iMA
EA-23540.summary: Ilan iMA is a Martingale-style grid EA that uses the iMA (Moving Average) indicator as its entry signal. When a trade goes against the position, it opens additional orders with increasing lot sizes at fixed pip intervals, aiming to recover losses on a reversal. It is a classic Ilan-family EA adapted for MQL5 with MA-based trend filtering.
EA-23540.summary_zh: Ilan iMA是一个基于马丁格尔策略的网格EA，使用iMA（移动平均线）指标作为入场信号。当持仓亏损时，它会在固定间距加仓并倍增手数，期望价格反转时整体回本获利。这是经典Ilan系列EA的MQL5版本，加入了MA趋势过滤。
EA-23540.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是马丁格尔加仓法，即每次亏损后加倍下注以期回本。入场条件基于iMA移动平均线指标判断趋势方向，当价格被认为处于有利趋势时开首仓。如果市场走势不利，EA会在设定的固定点数间隔（Step参数）后再次开仓，手数按Multiplier倍数递增。出场条件是当所有同向持仓的整体浮动利润达到TakeProfit设定值时全部平仓。仓位管理采用典型的马丁格尔倍增公式：第N层手数=初始手数×Multiplier^(N-1)。资金管理方面缺乏硬性止损，完全依赖价格最终回归来解套，这在强单边行情中可能导致爆仓。整体策略属于高风险类型，适合震荡行情但极度惧怕单边趋势。
EA-23540.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is the Martingale position-sizing method, which doubles the lot size after each losing trade in hopes of recovering all losses on a single winning reversal. Entry conditions are based on the iMA (Moving Average) indicator to determine the trend direction, opening the first position when price aligns with the perceived trend. If the market moves against the position, the EA opens additional orders at a fixed pip interval (Step parameter), with lot sizes multiplied by the Multiplier factor each time. Exit conditions trigger when the combined floating profit of all same-direction positions reaches the TakeProfit target, at which point all positions are closed simultaneously. Position sizing follows the classic Martingale formula: Nth level lot = Initial Lot × Multiplier^(N-1). Money management lacks a hard stop-loss, relying entirely on eventual price mean-reversion to escape drawdowns, which can lead to account blowout during strong trending markets.

EA-23542.name: Plan X
EA-23542.summary: Plan X is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using moving average crossovers and momentum confirmations, entering trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It employs a systematic approach with defined entry and exit rules, incorporating trailing stops for trade management. The EA is designed to capture medium-to-long-term trend movements across multiple currency pairs.
EA-23542.summary_zh: Plan X是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，利用均线交叉和动量确认来判断市场方向，顺势入场交易。它采用系统化方法，具有明确的入场和出场规则，并结合追踪止损进行仓位管理。该EA旨在捕捉多个货币对的中长期趋势行情。
EA-23542.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于趋势跟踪原则，通过移动平均线的交叉来判断市场趋势方向，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时产生做多信号，反之产生做空信号。入场条件要求均线交叉必须得到动量指标（如RSI或MACD）的确认，以避免假突破导致的错误入场。出场条件包括固定的止盈止损设置以及追踪止损机制，当价格朝有利方向移动时自动调整止损位以锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比进行仓位计算，确保每笔交易的风险可控。资金管理方面，该EA通过最大持仓数量限制和单笔最大亏损比例来控制整体账户风险，但仍缺乏针对极端行情的额外保护措施。
EA-23542.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend-following principles, using moving average crossovers to determine market trend direction — a buy signal is generated when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, and vice versa for sell signals. Entry conditions require the MA crossover to be confirmed by a momentum indicator such as RSI or MACD, filtering out false breakouts that could lead to premature entries. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels along with a trailing stop mechanism that automatically adjusts the stop level as price moves favorably to lock in profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculations derived from account balance, ensuring risk per trade remains controlled. On the money management side, the EA limits overall account exposure through maximum open position counts and per-trade maximum loss percentages, though it still lacks additional protective measures for extreme market conditions such as flash crashes or gap events.
pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势行情中获取较大利润
动量确认机制有效过滤假突破，减少不必要的亏损交易
追踪止损机制能够锁定浮动利润，让利润充分奔跑
最大持仓限制和固定风险比例有助于控制账户整体风险敞口
参数设计合理可调，便于根据不同市场环境优化
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic well-suited for capturing substantial profits during trending markets
Momentum confirmation filter effectively reduces false breakouts and unnecessary losing trades
Trailing stop mechanism locks in floating profits while allowing winners to run
Maximum position limits and fixed risk ratios help control overall account exposure
Reasonable and adjustable parameters allow optimization for different market conditions
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏对市场波动率和点差的过滤机制，在高波动或高点差环境下可能不利
固定止损止盈未考虑ATR等动态指标，无法适应不同货币对的波动特征
没有新闻事件过滤功能，重大数据公布时可能遭遇滑点或跳空风险
缺少回撤控制和紧急平仓机制，极端行情下账户可能承受较大损失
cons_en: Trend-following strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging markets
Lacks volatility and spread filters, potentially unfavorable in high-volatility or high-spread environments
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit ignore dynamic indicators like ATR, failing to adapt to varying pair volatility
No news event filter, exposing trades to slippage and gap risks during major economic releases
Absence of drawdown control and emergency close mechanisms may lead to significant losses in extreme conditions
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡市中自动暂停交易以避免频繁止损
引入基于ATR的动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动自动调整盈亏比
添加资金回撤百分比熔断机制，当账户回撤超过阈值时自动停止新交易并平仓
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to automatically pause trading during ranging markets and avoid frequent stop-outs
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that automatically adjusts risk-reward ratios based on market volatility
Implement a drawdown percentage circuit breaker that halts new trades and closes positions when account drawdown exceeds a threshold

risk_points: 趋势策略在震荡市中容易反复止损，造成资金持续消耗
固定止损未考虑市场波动率，低波动时止损过宽、高波动时止损过窄
缺少极端行情保护机制，跳空和流动性枯竭时可能承受超出预期的损失
risk_points_en: Trend strategy susceptible to repeated stop-outs in ranging markets, causing continuous capital erosion
Fixed stop-loss ignores market volatility — too wide in low volatility, too tight in high volatility
Lacks extreme market protection, risking larger-than-expected losses during gaps and liquidity dry-ups

EA-23553.name: Horizontal Line Levels
EA-23553.summary: This EA trades based on horizontal line levels drawn on the chart, triggering buy or sell orders when price interacts with user-defined horizontal lines. It acts as a level-based trading assistant where traders manually place horizontal lines and the EA automates order execution at those levels.
EA-23553.summary_zh: 该EA基于图表上绘制的水平线进行交易，当价格与用户定义的水平线交互时触发买入或卖出订单。它充当基于水平的交易助手，交易者手动放置水平线，EA自动执行订单。
EA-23553.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于支撑阻力水平线，交易者在图表上手动绘制水平线作为关键价格位，EA监控价格与这些水平线的交互来决定入场。入场条件是价格触及或突破水平线时自动开仓，可在水平线上方设置买入、下方设置卖出，具体方向取决于线的属性或命名约定。出场条件通常依赖止盈止损参数，也可能在价格到达另一条水平线时平仓。仓位管理通过固定手数或基于资金的动态手数参数控制，没有看到马丁格尔或网格机制。资金管理方面提供止损和止盈参数，但依赖于交易者正确放置水平线，缺乏自动化的水平线生成逻辑，整体策略高度依赖交易者对关键价格水平的判断能力。
EA-23553.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on support and resistance horizontal levels, where traders manually draw horizontal lines on the chart as key price levels and the EA monitors price interaction with these lines to determine entries. Entry conditions trigger when price touches or breaks through a horizontal line, with buy orders placed above the line and sell orders below, depending on line attributes or naming conventions. Exit conditions typically rely on take-profit and stop-loss parameters, or may close positions when price reaches another horizontal line. Position sizing is controlled through fixed lot or risk-based dynamic lot parameters, with no martingale or grid mechanisms observed. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters but depends heavily on the trader correctly placing horizontal lines, lacking automated level generation logic. The overall strategy is highly dependent on the trader's ability to identify key price levels correctly.

EA-23556.name: Plateau
EA-23556.summary: This EA identifies plateau or consolidation phases in price movement and enters trades when a breakout from the plateau occurs. It combines plateau detection logic with trend-following entry to capture momentum shifts after periods of sideways price action. The system manages positions with stop loss and take profit levels derived from the plateau range.
EA-23556.summary_zh: 该EA识别价格走势中的平台期或盘整阶段，并在平台突破时入场交易。它结合平台检测逻辑与趋势跟踪入场，捕捉横盘整理后的动量突破。系统通过平台区间推导的止损和止盈水平来管理仓位。
EA-23556.strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是检测价格进入平台期（盘整区域），即价格在一定范围内窄幅波动形成平台，然后等待突破方向确认后入场。入场条件为价格从平台区域向上或向下突破时开仓，做多对应向上突破，做空对应向下突破。出场条件包括基于平台高度计算的止盈和止损，以及可选的移动止损来锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式，确保每笔交易的风险可控。资金管理方面，EA根据平台区间的波动幅度来动态调整止损距离，但总体风险控制依赖于用户合理设置参数。策略还包含了一定的过滤机制，避免在虚假突破时入场。
EA-23556.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is detecting when price enters a plateau phase—a consolidation zone where price oscillates within a narrow range—and then entering on a breakout from that plateau. Entry conditions trigger when price breaks above the plateau upper boundary for long positions or below the lower boundary for short positions, confirming a directional momentum shift. Exit conditions include a stop loss placed on the opposite side of the plateau boundary and a take profit calculated as a multiple of the plateau height, plus an optional trailing stop to lock in profits as the trade moves favorably. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a balance-proportional method to keep per-trade risk consistent and manageable. Money management dynamically adjusts stop loss distance based on the measured plateau range height, though overall risk control depends heavily on user-configured parameters being set prudently. The strategy incorporates some filtering logic to reduce the likelihood of entering on false breakouts from the consolidation zone.

止损和止盈基于平台高度动态计算，适应不同波动率环境
设有最大持仓限制，避免过度开仓导致风险失控
包含移动止损功能，能有效保护已获利润
策略概念清晰，参数可调性强，便于优化和适应不同品种
pros_en: Plateau detection logic is sound—capturing breakouts after consolidation has high win-rate potential
Dynamic SL/TP calculation based on plateau height adapts well to varying volatility environments

缺乏虚假突破的深度过滤机制，可能在窄幅震荡中被反复止损
没有考虑交易成本（点差和佣金）对盈利的影响，在低波动平台中问题尤为突出

Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage to replace the fixed lot approach

risk_points: 缺乏虚假突破深度过滤，可能在震荡行情中连续止损造成资金回撤

Spread and commission costs are not factored in, which may erode profits on low-volatility instruments

EA-23595.name: ADX MACD Deev
EA-23595.summary: This EA combines the ADX indicator to measure trend strength with the MACD oscillator for momentum-based entry signals. It opens buy trades when MACD crosses above its signal line while ADX confirms a strong trend, and sells on the opposite conditions. The strategy aims to capture momentum moves only in confirmed trending markets, filtering out weak or sideways conditions.
EA-23595.summary_zh: 该EA结合ADX指标衡量趋势强度与MACD振荡器提供动量入场信号。当MACD上穿信号线且ADX确认趋势强劲时开多单，反之开空单。策略仅在确认的趋势市场中捕捉动量行情，过滤弱势或震荡市场。
EA-23595.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于ADX趋势强度过滤与MACD动量交叉的双重确认机制。入场条件为：MACD主线与信号线交叉（金叉做多、死叉做空），同时ADX值需超过阈值以确认趋势存在。出场条件依赖MACD反向交叉信号平仓，部分版本可能加入固定止盈止损。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理较为基础，缺乏动态风险调整机制，未根据波动率或账户权益变化进行仓位缩放。整体而言，策略逻辑清晰但较为传统，ADX过滤有效减少了震荡市场的假信号，但MACD滞后性可能导致入场偏晚，错过趋势初段利润。
EA-23595.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is built on a dual-confirmation mechanism combining ADX trend strength filtering with MACD momentum crossover signals. Entry conditions require MACD main line crossing above the signal line for buys (and below for sells), while simultaneously ADX must exceed a threshold to confirm a trending market exists. Exit conditions rely on MACD reverse crossover signals for closing positions, with some versions potentially including fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing typically uses fixed lot sizes or a balance-based calculation method. Money management is relatively basic, lacking dynamic risk adjustment mechanisms that scale position size based on volatility or account equity changes. Overall, the strategy logic is clear but conventional; ADX filtering effectively reduces false signals in ranging markets, but MACD's inherent lag may cause late entries, missing the initial portion of trend moves.

EA-23628.name: Back kick
EA-23628.summary: This EA implements a momentum-based 'back kick' reversal strategy, entering trades when price sharply reverses after a strong directional move. It identifies exhaustion in trend momentum and trades the counter-move, using built-in stop loss and take profit levels. The strategy is fully systematic with no discretionary elements.
EA-23628.summary_zh: 该EA实现了一个基于动量的'回踢'反转策略，在价格经历强势方向性移动后急剧反转时入场交易。它识别趋势动量的衰竭并交易反向运动，内置止损和止盈水平。该策略完全系统化，无主观判断成分。
EA-23628.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于动量衰竭反转，即价格在经历一段强劲的单边走势后出现'回踢'现象——类似于踢球后的反弹。入场条件是检测到价格的急剧反向运动，表明原趋势动能耗尽、反向力量介入。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，止损设于近期极值之外，止盈基于风险回报比计算。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，未采用马丁格尔或网格加仓策略。资金管理方面，EA使用固定风险比例模式，每笔交易的风险金额占账户余额的预设百分比。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的动量反转类型，适合在波动较大的市场环境中运行。
EA-23628.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum exhaustion and reversal, detecting a 'back kick' phenomenon where price sharply reverses after a strong unidirectional move — analogous to a rebound after a kick. Entry conditions involve detecting a sharp counter-directional price movement that signals the original trend momentum has been depleted and opposing force has entered the market. Exit conditions rely on pre-set stop loss and take profit levels, with stop loss placed beyond recent price extremes and take profit calculated based on risk-reward ratios. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-of-balance calculation, without using martingale or grid-based position addition strategies. Money management follows a fixed-risk-percentage model where the risk amount per trade is a preset percentage of account balance. Overall the strategy logic is clear, belonging to the typical momentum reversal category, and is best suited for operation in highly volatile market environments.

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 每笔交易风险占账户余额百分比
parameters.description_en: 每笔交易风险占账户余额百分比

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于动量衰竭反转的经典理念，具有统计学依据
采用固定风险比例的资金管理模式，有效控制单笔交易风险敞口
止损止盈设置合理，风险回报比明确，有利于长期正期望收益
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on the classic concept of momentum exhaustion reversal with statistical foundation
Fixed risk-percentage money management effectively controls per-trade risk exposure
Reasonable stop loss and take profit settings with clear risk-reward ratio, conducive to long-term positive expected returns
cons: 动量反转策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认机制，单一时间框架的信号可靠性有限
未包含点差过滤和市场流动性检测，在高点差或低流动性时段可能遭受滑点损失
cons_en: Momentum reversal strategies tend to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, limiting signal reliability from a single timeframe
No spread filter or market liquidity detection included, potentially suffering slippage losses during high-spread or low-liquidity sessions
improvements: 增加多时间框架趋势确认，仅在大周期趋势方向上交易反转信号，提高胜率
添加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在低流动性时段入场
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend confirmation, only trading reversal signals in the direction of the higher timeframe trend to improve win rate
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid entering during low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 反转策略在强趋势延续时可能逆势入场，导致较大亏损
缺少对持仓数量的检查，可能在高频信号下同时开多个仓位
risk_points_en: Reversal strategy may enter against strong trend continuation, leading to significant losses
Lacks open position count check, potentially opening multiple positions simultaneously under high-frequency signals

EA-23632.name: MA Trend 2
EA-23632.summary: MA Trend 2 is a trend-following Expert Advisor that trades based on Moving Average signals, likely using MA crossovers or price-MA relationships to identify and follow market trends. It opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend and manages them with configurable parameters. The EA is designed for medium-to-long term trend capturing on various currency pairs and timeframes.
EA-23632.summary_zh: MA Trend 2是一个基于均线信号的趋势跟踪EA，可能使用均线交叉或价格与均线的关系来识别和跟随市场趋势。它沿着当前趋势方向开仓，并通过可配置参数进行管理。该EA设计用于在各种货币对和周期上捕捉中长线趋势。
EA-23632.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于移动平均线的趋势跟踪，通过均线方向或均线交叉来判断市场趋势方向。入场条件通常是短期均线上穿长期均线时做多，短期均线下穿长期均线时做空，或者价格突破均线时入场。出场条件可能包括反向均线交叉、固定止盈止损、或均线走平反转信号。仓位管理可能使用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位。资金管理方面，典型的MA趋势EA会设置止损但可能缺乏动态止损调整机制，止盈通常大于止损以追求正期望值。该策略的优势在于顺势交易，但缺点是震荡行情中会产生频繁的假信号和连续亏损。
EA-23632.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend following using Moving Averages, determining market trend direction through MA direction or MA crossovers. Entry conditions typically involve going long when a fast MA crosses above a slow MA, going short when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA, or entering when price breaks through the MA. Exit conditions may include opposite MA crossovers, fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or MA flattening/reversal signals. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-balance-proportional sizing. Money management typically includes stop-loss placement but may lack dynamic trailing stop adjustment, with take-profit usually larger than stop-loss to pursue positive expectancy. The strategy's strength lies in trading with the trend, but its weakness is frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging markets.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证，适合初学者使用
顺势交易理念正确，在趋势明显的行情中能获取较大利润
均线是经过长期验证的经典指标，具有统计学上的可靠性
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and verify, suitable for beginners
Correct trend-following philosophy, capable of capturing large profits in strong trending markets
Moving Averages are time-tested classic indicators with statistical reliability
cons: 在震荡行情中会产生大量假信号，导致频繁开平仓亏损
均线具有滞后性，入场和出场时机偏晚，可能错过行情的起始和末端
缺乏对市场状态的判断（趋势vs震荡），无法自动切换策略模式
cons_en: Generates numerous false signals in ranging markets, leading to frequent opening and closing losses
MAs have inherent lag, causing late entries and exits, potentially missing the start and end of moves
Lacks market state detection (trend vs range), cannot automatically switch strategy modes
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或ATR），在震荡行情中减少交易或暂停交易
加入移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，以保护已有利润并改善盈亏比
improvements_en: Add a market state filter (e.g., ADX or ATR) to reduce or pause trading during ranging markets
Implement a trailing stop feature to protect existing profits and improve risk-reward ratio

risk_points: 均线策略在震荡市中可能连续亏损，缺乏市场状态识别机制
若未设置止损或止损过宽，单笔亏损可能过大
risk_points_en: MA strategy may incur consecutive losses in ranging markets without market state detection
If stop-loss is not set or too wide, single trade loss may be excessive

EA-24015.name: The Singleton
EA-24015.summary: This EA implements the Singleton design pattern for MQL5 Expert Advisors, ensuring only one instance of the EA can run on a terminal at a time. It prevents duplicate instances from executing simultaneously, which could cause conflicting trades or resource conflicts. The core functionality is a protective utility mechanism rather than a trading strategy.
EA-24015.summary_zh: 该EA实现了MQL5 Expert Advisor的单例设计模式，确保终端中同一时间只能运行一个EA实例。它防止重复实例同时执行，避免冲突交易或资源冲突。核心功能是保护性工具机制而非交易策略。
EA-24015.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是实现单例模式的工具类EA。其核心概念是通过全局变量、文件锁或图表检查机制确保只有一个EA实例在运行。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用，该EA仅监控和阻止重复实例。仓位管理不涉及，因为不存在开仓行为。资金管理方面无需考虑，该EA不处理任何资金相关逻辑。整体而言，这是一个架构级别的保护工具，用于防止多实例冲突导致的风险。
EA-24015.strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements the Singleton design pattern rather than a trading strategy, ensuring only one EA instance runs per terminal. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute any trades. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable; the EA only monitors and blocks duplicate instances. Position sizing is not involved as there is no trade-opening behavior. Money management is irrelevant since the EA does not handle any capital-related logic. The mechanism typically uses global variables, file-based locks, or chart scanning to detect and prevent duplicate instances from running simultaneously, protecting against conflicting orders or resource contention.

parameters.description_en: 是否启用单例模式保护

架构层面提供保护，减少人为操作失误风险
实现简单有效，不增加交易逻辑复杂度
pros_en: Prevents trade conflicts caused by multiple EA instances running simultaneously
Provides architectural-level protection reducing risk of human operational errors

improvements_en: Add a whitelist feature allowing multiple instances on specific symbols or charts
Add logging functionality to record instance creation and blocking events

risk_points: 阻止机制失效可能导致多实例冲突
缺乏对阻止事件的持久化记录
risk_points_en: Failure of the blocking mechanism could lead to multi-instance conflicts
Lack of persistent logging for blocked instance events

EA-25009.name: Explosion
EA-25009.summary: Explosion is a breakout EA that identifies sudden volatility expansion (explosive price moves) and enters trades in the direction of the momentum surge. It uses a combination of volatility filters and momentum indicators to detect high-probability breakout opportunities, entering when price action exceeds dynamic thresholds. The EA employs fixed or dynamic stop-loss and take-profit levels to manage risk on each trade.
EA-25009.summary_zh: Explosion是一个突破类EA，通过识别突然的波动率扩张（爆炸性价格移动）来顺势入场交易。它结合波动率过滤器和动量指标来检测高概率的突破机会，当价格行为超过动态阈值时入场。该EA采用固定或动态止损止盈水平来管理每笔交易的风险。
EA-25009.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是捕捉波动率突然放大的突破行情，类似于布林带收缩后的突破。入场条件通常基于价格突破动态计算的通道或波动率阈值，并配合动量指标确认方向。出场条件包括固定点数止损止盈、追踪止损或指标反转信号。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能加入基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，止损设置相对明确但缺乏对最大回撤或连续亏损的保护机制。整体策略在趋势启动阶段表现较好，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损。
EA-25009.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is to capture explosive volatility expansion breakouts, similar to Bollinger Band squeeze breakouts. Entry conditions are based on price breaking through dynamically calculated channels or volatility thresholds, confirmed by momentum indicators for direction. Exit conditions include fixed-pip stop-loss and take-profit, trailing stops, or indicator reversal signals. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, with some versions potentially including dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management has clearly defined stop-losses but lacks protection mechanisms for maximum drawdown or consecutive losses. The strategy performs well during trend initiation phases but is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets.
pros: 捕捉波动率扩张的突破策略逻辑清晰，在趋势启动阶段盈亏比优势明显
具有明确的止损止盈设置，每笔交易风险可控
参数化设计灵活，交易者可根据不同品种和市场环境调整突破阈值和波动率周期
追踪止损功能有助于锁定浮动利润，避免盈利回吐
pros_en: Clear breakout logic capturing volatility expansion with favorable risk-reward ratios during trend initiation
Well-defined stop-loss and take-profit settings provide controlled risk per trade
Flexible parameterized design allows traders to adjust explosion thresholds and volatility periods for different instruments and market conditions
Trailing stop feature helps lock in floating profits and prevents giving back gains
cons: 在震荡盘整行情中容易产生大量虚假突破信号，导致频繁止损
缺乏最大回撤控制和连续亏损保护机制，极端行情下风险较大
未加入点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在高点差时段入场可能降低胜率
固定手数模式未考虑账户净值变化，不利于长期复利增长
cons_en: Prone to frequent false breakout signals in ranging/consolidating markets, leading to repeated stop-loss hits
Lacks maximum drawdown control and consecutive loss protection, posing significant risk during extreme market conditions
No spread filter or trading session filter, entering during high-spread periods may reduce win rate
Fixed lot sizing does not adapt to account equity changes, hindering long-term compounding growth
improvements: 增加震荡行情识别过滤器（如ADX或布林带宽度），在低波动率盘整期减少交易频率
加入基于账户风险的动态仓位计算和最大回撤保护机制，提高资金管理安全性
improvements_en: Add ranging market identification filters (such as ADX or Bollinger Band width) to reduce trade frequency during low-volatility consolidation periods
Implement risk-based dynamic position sizing and maximum drawdown protection mechanisms to improve capital management safety

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡行情中易产生连续虚假信号导致多次止损
缺乏最大回撤保护和连续亏损限制机制
未设置点差和交易时段过滤，可能在不利时段入场
risk_points_en: Breakout strategy prone to consecutive false signals causing repeated stop-losses in ranging markets
No maximum drawdown protection or consecutive loss limiting mechanism
No spread or trading session filter, potentially entering during unfavorable periods

EA-25249.name: Lavika100
EA-25249.summary: Lavika100 is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average-based signals to identify and trade with the prevailing market trend. It enters positions when momentum confirms the trend direction and manages trades with trailing stops. The EA is designed for medium-term timeframes and aims to capture sustained directional moves.
EA-25249.summary_zh: Lavika100是一个趋势跟踪型EA，使用均线信号识别并追随市场主流趋势。它在动量确认趋势方向时入场，并通过移动止损管理持仓。该EA适用于中周期时间框架，旨在捕捉持续的定向行情。
EA-25249.strategy_analysis: Lavika100策略的核心概念是趋势跟踪，通过移动均线的交叉或价格与均线的关系来判断趋势方向。入场条件通常为短期均线上穿长期均线做多，下穿做空，或价格突破均线后顺势入场。出场条件包括固定止损止盈、移动止损（trailing stop）以及均线反向交叉信号。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA可能使用风险百分比来决定每笔交易的仓位大小，但具体是否包含马丁格尔或网格机制需源码确认。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-25249.strategy_analysis_en: Lavika100's core concept is trend following, using moving average crossovers or price-to-MA relationships to determine trend direction. Entry conditions typically involve a short-term MA crossing above a long-term MA for long positions, and vice versa for short positions, or entering on price breakouts above/below key MAs. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, trailing stops that lock in profits as the trade moves favorably, and reverse MA crossover signals. Position sizing may use fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation tied to account balance. Money management likely incorporates a risk-per-trade percentage to determine lot size, though the presence of martingale or grid mechanisms cannot be confirmed without source code. The overall strategy logic is straightforward but may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和参数优化
趋势行情中能够有效捕捉大波段利润
使用移动止损保护已获利润，降低回吐风险
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize parameters
Effectively captures large trend moves during trending market conditions
Uses trailing stop to protect profits and reduce drawdown risk
cons: 震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号，可能导致连续亏损
缺乏市场状态过滤器，无法区分趋势市和震荡市
固定止损止盈可能不适应不同波动率的市场环境
cons_en: Generates frequent false signals in ranging markets, potentially leading to consecutive losses
Lacks market regime filter to distinguish between trending and ranging conditions
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit may not adapt well to varying market volatility environments
improvements: 增加市场状态识别过滤器（如ADX或ATR），在震荡市中减少交易频率
使用ATR动态调整止损止盈，适应不同波动率环境
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (such as ADX or ATR) to reduce trading frequency in ranging markets
Use ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt to different volatility environments

risk_points: 缺乏多周期确认，可能在逆势中入场
固定止损可能在高波动行情中被扫损后行情继续朝有利方向发展
未确认是否具备仓位检查和重复开单保护
risk_points_en: Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, may enter against the larger trend
Fixed stop-loss may get hit by volatility spikes before the trade moves favorably
Cannot confirm presence of position checks and duplicate order protection without source code

EA-25774.name: GbpChf
EA-25774.summary: This EA trades the GBP/CHF currency pair using a trend-following strategy based on moving average crossovers and momentum confirmation. It opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend when short-term and long-term moving averages cross, with additional filters for trend strength. The EA includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-25774.summary_zh: 该EA交易英镑/瑞郎货币对，采用基于均线交叉和动量确认的趋势跟踪策略。当短期和长期均线交叉时，沿趋势方向开仓，并附带趋势强度过滤条件。EA包含基于止损和止盈的基本风险管理功能。
EA-25774.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过快速均线与慢速均线的交叉来判断趋势方向和入场时机。当快速均线上穿慢速均线且动量指标确认上升趋势时开多仓，反之当快速均线下穿慢速均线且动量确认下降趋势时开空仓。出场条件包括达到预设止盈目标、触发止损或出现反向交叉信号。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面设置了硬性止损和止盈，但缺乏追踪止损机制来保护已有利润。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-25774.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, using crossover signals between fast and slow moving averages to determine trend direction and entry timing. It opens long positions when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA with momentum confirmation of an uptrend, and short positions on the reverse crossover with momentum confirming a downtrend. Exit conditions include reaching predefined take profit targets, triggering stop loss levels, or receiving an opposite crossover signal. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management incorporates hard stop loss and take profit levels, but lacks a trailing stop mechanism to protect accumulated profits. The overall strategy logic is clear, but it may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

设置了明确的止损和止盈，风险可控
趋势市场中表现较好，能捕捉中长期趋势行情
均线交叉配合动量确认，减少了虚假信号
代码结构规范，参数可配置性强

Explicit stop loss and take profit settings provide controllable risk
Performs well in trending markets, capturing medium to long-term trends
MA crossover with momentum confirmation reduces false signals

缺乏追踪止损机制，无法在趋势延续时锁定更多利润

EA-26315.name: Moving Averages
EA-26315.summary: This EA is a classic moving average crossover system that generates buy signals when a fast moving average crosses above a slow moving average, and sell signals when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. It opens positions based on these crossover events and typically includes configurable MA periods and lot sizing. The strategy is a foundational trend-following approach suitable for trending markets.
EA-26315.summary_zh: 该EA是一个经典的均线交叉系统，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时产生买入信号，快速均线下穿慢速均线时产生卖出信号。它基于这些交叉事件开仓，通常包含可配置的均线周期和手数设置。该策略是基础的趋势跟踪方法，适用于趋势市场。
EA-26315.strategy_analysis: 该EA基于均线交叉策略，属于经典趋势跟踪类型。入场条件为快速均线与慢速均线的金叉做多、死叉做空，信号产生于均线方向变化的那一刻。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号或固定的止损/止盈水平，部分版本可能包含追踪止损功能。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，默认手数较小，缺乏根据账户余额动态调整的机制。资金管理方面较为简单，没有动态风险比例计算或资金曲线保护逻辑。整体策略逻辑清晰易懂，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-26315.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is based on a moving average crossover strategy, which is a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions are a golden cross (fast MA crossing above slow MA) for buy signals and a death cross (fast MA crossing below slow MA) for sell signals, triggered at the moment of crossover. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse crossover signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels, with some versions potentially including trailing stop functionality. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with a small default lot size, lacking dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management is relatively simple, with no dynamic risk ratio calculation or equity curve protection logic. The overall strategy logic is clear and easy to understand, but it tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses.

EA-26317.name: RSI Levels
EA-26317.summary: This EA trades based on RSI overbought and oversold levels, entering buy positions when RSI dips below the oversold threshold and sell positions when RSI rises above the overbought threshold. It aims to capture mean reversion moves as price is expected to return to neutral RSI levels. The EA includes configurable RSI period and level parameters for customization across different instruments and timeframes.
EA-26317.summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI超买超卖水平进行交易，当RSI跌破超卖阈值时买入，当RSI突破超买阈值时卖出。其核心逻辑是均值回归，预期价格会从极端水平回归中性区域。EA提供可配置的RSI周期和水平参数，适用于不同品种和时间框架。
EA-26317.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RSI指标的均值回归原理，认为当RSI进入超买或超卖区域后，价格有回归均值趋势。入场条件为RSI跌破超卖水平（默认30）时开多单，RSI突破超买水平（默认70）时开空单。出场条件依赖于RSI回到中性区域或达到止盈止损目标。仓位管理通常采用固定手数方式，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，EA依赖RSI水平参数的合理设置来控制交易频率和风险敞口，但缺乏对市场趋势环境的过滤，可能在强趋势行情中产生连续逆势信号导致亏损。
EA-26317.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is rooted in mean reversion using the RSI indicator, assuming that when RSI enters overbought or oversold zones, price tends to revert toward the mean. Entry conditions trigger a buy when RSI drops below the oversold level (default 30) and a sell when RSI rises above the overbought level (default 70). Exit conditions rely on RSI returning to neutral territory or hitting predefined take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots, though some variants may include dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management depends on the proper configuration of RSI level thresholds to control trade frequency and exposure, but the strategy lacks a trend environment filter which can result in consecutive counter-trend signals and losses during strong trending markets.

EA-26333.name: Parabolic SAR
EA-26333.summary: This EA uses the Parabolic SAR indicator to identify trend direction and generate entry signals. It opens buy positions when SAR dots flip below price and sell positions when dots flip above price, riding trends until the SAR reverses. The strategy is a classic trend-following system that uses the built-in MT5 Parabolic SAR indicator for both entry and exit signals.
EA-26333.summary_zh: 该EA使用抛物线SAR指标识别趋势方向并生成入场信号。当SAR点翻转到价格下方时开多单，翻转到上方时开空单，跟随趋势直到SAR反转。这是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统，利用MT5内置的抛物线SAR指标同时作为入场和出场信号。
EA-26333.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于抛物线SAR（Stop and Reverse）指标，这是一种经典的趋势跟踪工具。入场条件为：当SAR指标点从价格上方翻转到下方时产生买入信号，从下方翻转到上方时产生卖出信号，这代表趋势方向发生了转变。出场条件同样依赖SAR指标：当持仓方向与SAR信号相反时平仓，即SAR反转时既是旧仓位的出场也是新仓位的入场，形成Stop and Reverse机制。仓位管理方面，从参数命名来看使用固定手数（Lots参数），没有动态仓位调整或基于资金比例的下单逻辑。资金管理方面，该EA可能依赖SAR作为跟踪止损来实现风险控制，但若无独立的止损设置则风险较大。SAR的步长（Step）和最大值（Maximum）参数直接决定了指标的灵敏度，步长越大指标对价格变化越敏感，但也更容易产生虚假信号。
EA-26333.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Parabolic SAR (Stop and Reverse) indicator, a classic trend-following tool. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when SAR dots flip from above price to below, and a sell signal when they flip from below to above, indicating a trend direction change. Exit conditions also rely on the SAR indicator: positions are closed when the SAR signal reverses against the held position, meaning the SAR reversal serves as both the exit for the old position and entry for a new one, forming a Stop and Reverse mechanism. Position sizing typically uses a fixed lot size (Lots parameter), with no dynamic position adjustment or equity-proportional sizing logic. Money management relies on the SAR as a trailing stop mechanism for risk control, but without an independent stop loss the risk exposure could be significant. The SAR Step and Maximum parameters directly determine the indicator's sensitivity — a larger step makes the indicator more responsive to price changes but also increases the likelihood of false signals.

EA-26418.name: Grid
EA-26418.summary: This EA implements a classic grid trading strategy that places buy and sell pending orders at fixed price intervals above and below the current market price. It aims to profit from price oscillations within a range by closing positions when they reach a configurable take-profit target, while continuously maintaining the grid of orders.
EA-26418.summary_zh: 该EA实现了一种经典的网格交易策略，在当前市场价格上方和下方以固定价格间隔放置买入和卖出挂单。它通过在价格震荡区间内平仓获利来盈利，同时持续维持网格订单。
EA-26418.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用网格交易策略，核心概念是在价格上下方按固定间隔布置买卖挂单，形成价格网格。入场条件是基于预设的网格间距(GridStep)，在当前价格上下方等距放置买入限价单和卖出限价单。出场条件是当任一网格订单的盈利达到设定的止盈目标(TakeProfit)时平仓，部分实现会设置止损但许多网格EA不设止损。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或根据网格层级递增手数的方式下单。资金管理方面，大多数网格EA缺乏有效的回撤控制机制，依赖价格在区间内震荡来获利。该策略在震荡市中表现良好，但在单边趋势行情中可能因不断加仓而导致严重亏损甚至爆仓。
EA-26418.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a grid trading strategy where the core concept is placing buy and sell pending orders at fixed intervals above and below the current price, forming a price grid. Entry conditions are based on a predefined grid step distance, placing buy limit orders below and sell limit orders above the current market price. Exit conditions trigger when any grid order reaches a configurable take-profit target, though many grid EAs lack proper stop-loss mechanisms. Position sizing typically uses either fixed lot sizes or incrementally increasing lots at deeper grid levels. Money management is generally weak, as most grid EAs lack effective drawdown control and rely on price oscillating within a range to generate profits. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but can lead to catastrophic losses or account blow-up during strong trending conditions due to continuously adding positions in the losing direction.

EA-26451.name: Range Breakout
EA-26451.summary: This EA identifies a defined price range (consolidation period) and places pending orders or enters market orders when price breaks out above or below that range. It is a classic range breakout strategy that aims to capture momentum moves following periods of low volatility and price compression.
EA-26451.summary_zh: 该EA识别一段明确的价格区间（盘整期），当价格突破该区间上轨或下轨时进场交易。这是一个经典的区间突破策略，旨在捕捉低波动率和价格压缩后的动量行情。
EA-26451.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于区间突破，EA首先在指定的时间窗口内计算价格的高低点形成交易区间。入场条件是当价格突破区间上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空，利用突破后的动量延续获利。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损，或当价格重新回到区间内部时止损出场。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户风险的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，EA可能包含最大持仓限制和每日亏损限制等保护机制，但具体实现取决于参数配置。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于趋势启动初期的捕捉策略，但在假突破频繁的市场环境中表现不佳。
EA-26451.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on range breakout, where the EA first calculates the high and low of price over a specified time window to form a trading range. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above the range high and a sell when price breaks below the range low, capitalizing on momentum continuation after the breakout. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or a stop-out when price re-enters the range, invalidating the breakout signal. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot calculation based on account risk percentage. Money management may include maximum position limits and daily loss caps, though the specific implementation depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear and belongs to the early trend-capture category, but it tends to underperform in markets with frequent false breakouts.

EA-26624.name: SudokuUI
EA-26624.summary: This is a Classic Sudoku puzzle game implemented as an MQL5 Expert Advisor with a graphical user interface. It allows users to generate, import, solve, and play Sudoku directly on the MetaTrader 5 chart. The EA includes an auto-assistant feature and configurable random seeds for puzzle generation and shuffling.

EA-26624.strategy_analysis: 这不是一个交易策略EA，而是一个运行在MetaTrader 5平台上的数独游戏工具。它没有入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理逻辑，因为它不执行任何交易操作。该EA的核心功能是创建一个SudokuDialog对话框，通过图形界面与用户交互。它支持通过随机种子参数控制谜题的生成和洗牌过程，确保谜题的可重复性。自动更新功能可以作为助手帮助玩家完成数独。整体来说，这是一个纯娱乐/工具性质的EA，与交易策略无关。
EA-26624.strategy_analysis_en: This is not a trading strategy EA but rather a Sudoku puzzle game tool running on the MetaTrader 5 platform. It has no entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management logic since it does not execute any trading operations. The EA's core functionality is creating a SudokuDialog object that interacts with users through a graphical interface. It supports configurable random seed parameters to control puzzle generation and shuffling, ensuring puzzle reproducibility. The auto-update feature serves as an assistant to help players solve Sudoku puzzles. Overall, this is a purely recreational/utility EA with no relation to trading strategies whatsoever.

EA-27286.name: MultiMartin
EA-27286.summary: A multi-currency martingale EA that opens an initial BUY or SELL order and, upon a loss, reverses direction with a multiplied lot size. It uses virtual stop-loss/take-profit with optional trailing stops and supports per-symbol configuration via a compact string syntax for running multiple instruments simultaneously.
EA-27286.summary_zh: 这是一个多货币马丁格尔EA，首先开一个初始买入或卖出订单，亏损后反转方向并将手数乘以倍数。它使用虚拟止损/止盈，支持可选的移动止损，并通过紧凑的字符串语法支持多品种同时运行的独立配置。
EA-27286.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是马丁格尔反转策略：初始按StartType方向开仓，若订单以亏损平仓则反转方向并将手数乘以Factor倍数，若盈利则重置为初始手数继续同方向开仓。入场条件为：无持仓时按StartType开首单；前单盈利平仓后同方向重新开初始手数订单；前单亏损平仓后反方向开Factor倍手数订单。出场条件采用虚拟止损止盈：当价格触及开仓价±止损/止盈点数时市价平仓，也支持移动止损（盈亏平衡或直线跟踪模式）。仓位管理上，手数每次亏损后乘以Factor并用lots_step取整，但受限于Limit设定的最大倍数和最大手数限制。资金管理方面，有checkFreeMargin检查可用保证金，不足时回退到初始手数，若仍不足则不开仓并触发SkipBadTime机制暂停交易。支持时间过滤（HourStart到HourEnd）和坏时段跳过机制。
EA-27286.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a martingale reversal system: it opens an initial order in the StartType direction, and upon a losing close, reverses direction with the lot size multiplied by the Factor. On a profitable close, it resets to the initial lot size and continues in the same direction. Entry conditions are: when no position exists, open the first order per StartType; after a profitable close, re-open in the same direction with initial lots; after a losing close, open in the opposite direction with Factor-multiplied lots. Exit conditions use virtual stop-loss and take-profit: market close when price hits open price ± SL/TP points in price terms, with optional trailing stop support (breakeven or straight trailing modes). Position sizing multiplies lots by Factor on each loss, rounded to the lot step, but capped by the Limit parameter (max multiplications) and the broker's maximum lot size. Money management includes a checkFreeMargin function that verifies available margin before opening, falling back to initial lots if insufficient, and skipping the trade entirely if margin is still inadequate while triggering the SkipBadTime pause mechanism. The EA also supports time filtering (HourStart to HourEnd) and a bad-time skipping mechanism to avoid repeatedly hitting margin errors.

Includes margin check mechanism that falls back to initial lots when insufficient, helping prevent account blow-up
SkipBadTime mechanism pauses trading after order failures, preventing resource waste from repeated errors
Virtual stop-loss/take-profit implementation is flexible with trailing stop support
Clean code structure using object-oriented design (Settings/ExpMartin/ExpMartinPool classes)
cons: 马丁格尔策略本质风险极高，连续亏损时手数指数增长，可能在几次亏损后就达到最大手数或爆仓

增加最大回撤百分比限制和最大连续亏损次数限制，作为资金管理的硬性保护
修复init中订单扫描逻辑，应收集所有相关订单而非只取第一个就break

增加点差过滤，避免在高点差时段开仓
improvements_en: Place real stop-loss orders on the server instead of virtual SL/TP, ensuring protection even when the EA is disconnected
Add maximum drawdown percentage limit and maximum consecutive loss count limit as hard capital protection guards
Fix the order scanning logic in init() to collect all relevant orders rather than breaking after finding the first one
Add new bar detection mechanism to avoid repeated trade execution within the same tick
Add spread filter to avoid opening positions during high-spread periods

risk_points: 马丁格尔策略：连续亏损时手数指数增长，可能导致爆仓

No spread filter: high-spread periods may cause unnecessary losses

EA-27440.name: VR Smart Grid Lite
EA-27440.summary: VR Smart Grid Lite is a grid trading Expert Advisor that places pending orders at fixed price intervals around the current market price, aiming to profit from price oscillations within a range. The EA systematically opens buy and sell limit/stop orders at predetermined grid levels, managing multiple positions simultaneously. It is a lite version of the full VR Smart Grid product with reduced configuration options.
EA-27440.summary_zh: VR Smart Grid Lite是一款网格交易EA，在当前市场价格周围按固定间隔放置挂单，利用价格在区间内震荡获利。该EA系统性地在预设的网格水平开设买入和卖出限价/止损单，同时管理多个仓位。它是完整版VR Smart Grid的精简版，配置选项有所减少。
EA-27440.strategy_analysis: VR Smart Grid Lite采用经典网格交易策略，在价格上下方按固定间距布置买卖挂单网格。入场条件为：当价格触及预设网格水平时，对应的限价单或止损单自动触发成交，买入单设在价格下方，卖出单设在价格上方。出场条件主要依赖止盈设定，每个网格层级有独立的止盈目标，当价格回归到目标水平时平仓获利。仓位管理采用固定手数或可配置手数方式，每个网格层级使用相同或递增的交易量。资金管理方面，该EA允许用户设置最大网格层数以控制总敞口，但精简版可能缺少高级资金管理功能。网格策略在震荡行情中表现良好，但在单边趋势行情中面临连续亏损和仓位累积的严重风险。
EA-27440.strategy_analysis_en: VR Smart Grid Lite employs a classic grid trading strategy, placing buy and sell pending orders at fixed intervals above and below the current market price. Entry conditions are triggered when price reaches a predefined grid level, where corresponding limit or stop orders are automatically filled — buy orders below price and sell orders above. Exit conditions primarily rely on take-profit settings, where each grid level has its own profit target that closes the position when price reverts to the target level. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or configurable lot sizes, with each grid level potentially using the same or incrementally increasing trade volume. Money management allows users to set the maximum number of grid levels to control total exposure, though the lite version may lack advanced money management features. While the grid strategy performs well in ranging markets, it faces serious risks of consecutive losses and position accumulation during strong trending conditions.

EA-27546.name: Testinator v1.30a
EA-27546.summary: Testinator v1.30a is a testing and utility Expert Advisor designed for MetaTrader 5, likely serving as a strategy tester helper, trade panel, or debugging tool rather than an autonomous trading system. It provides auxiliary functionality to assist traders in analyzing, configuring, or managing other trading operations without opening positions based on its own signals.
EA-27546.summary_zh: Testinator v1.30a是一个用于MetaTrader 5的测试辅助工具型EA，主要功能是帮助用户进行策略测试、参数调试或交易管理辅助，而非基于自有策略信号自动开仓交易。
EA-27546.strategy_analysis: 该EA属于工具类程序，不具备独立的策略入场和出场逻辑。其主要功能围绕测试辅助展开，可能包括参数优化、数据记录、信号模拟或交易环境配置等。由于不执行自主交易，因此没有传统意义上的入场条件、出场条件或仓位管理逻辑。资金管理方面同样不适用，因为它不直接控制交易仓位。整体而言，Testinator更像是一个开发者和交易者的调试工具，用于验证其他策略或监控市场状态。
EA-27546.strategy_analysis_en: This EA falls under the utility category and does not possess independent strategy entry or exit logic. Its core functionality revolves around testing assistance, which may include parameter optimization, data logging, signal simulation, or trading environment configuration. Since it does not execute autonomous trades, there are no conventional entry conditions, exit conditions, or position sizing mechanisms. Money management is similarly inapplicable as it does not directly control trading positions. Overall, Testinator functions more as a debugging and analysis tool for developers and traders to validate other strategies or monitor market conditions.

EA-27938.name: Rapid Doji EA
EA-27938.summary: This EA identifies Doji candlestick patterns on the daily chart and places two opposing pending stop orders around the Doji bar's high and low. It uses ATR for stop loss placement and manages risk with a fixed trailing stop. When one pending order fills, the other is automatically deleted.
EA-27938.summary_zh: 该EA在日线图上识别十字星K线形态，并在十字星高低点两侧放置两个对向止损挂单。使用ATR确定止损距离，并通过固定追踪止损管理风险。当一侧挂单成交后，自动删除另一侧挂单。
EA-27938.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于十字星(Doji)K线形态的突破交易，十字星表示市场犹豫不决，随后的突破方向可能决定趋势方向。入场条件是当日线出现十字星（实体不超过整根K线3%）时，在前一K线高点放置Buy Stop挂单，低点放置Sell Stop挂单，形成双向突破策略。止损设置在十字星低点减去1.75倍ATR（买入）或高点加上1.75倍ATR（卖出），止损距离较大以容纳市场噪音。出场条件依赖固定追踪止损（2700点），当价格朝有利方向移动且距离超过固定点数时，止损跟随前一日收盘价移动，但不会在亏损时移动止损。仓位管理使用固定手数0.10手，没有动态仓位计算。资金管理方面有保证金检查和手数规范化处理，但缺少最大持仓限制和回撤控制。
EA-27938.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on breakout trading from Doji candlestick patterns, where a Doji signals market indecision and the subsequent breakout direction may determine the trend. Entry conditions trigger when a Doji appears on the daily chart (body size is 3% or less of the total bar range), placing a Buy Stop at the Doji high and a Sell Stop at the Doji low, creating a dual-direction breakout setup. Stop loss is set at the Doji low minus 1.75x ATR for buys or the Doji high plus 1.75x ATR for sells, providing wide stops to accommodate market noise. Exit conditions rely on a fixed trailing stop of 2700 points, where the stop loss follows the previous day's close once the position is profitable beyond the spread, but the stop never moves when the position is unprofitable. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size of 0.10 with no dynamic calculation based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management includes margin checking and lot normalization but lacks maximum position limits, equity drawdown controls, or daily loss limits.

EA-28029.name: Position Size Calculator / Profit Calculator / Swap Calculator
EA-28029.summary: A suite of three calculator utilities for MetaTrader 5: a Position Size Calculator that determines optimal lot size based on risk percentage and stop-loss distance, a Profit Calculator that estimates potential profit or loss at a target price, and a Swap Calculator that forecasts overnight swap charges for holding positions. These tools assist traders in pre-trade planning and risk assessment without executing any trades.
EA-28029.summary_zh: 包含三个计算器工具的MetaTrader 5实用程序套件：仓位大小计算器根据风险比例和止损距离确定最佳手数，利润计算器估算目标价位潜在盈亏，掉期计算器预测持仓过夜的掉期费用。这些工具辅助交易者在交易前进行规划和风险评估，不会执行任何交易操作。
EA-28029.strategy_analysis: 该EA套件不执行任何交易策略，而是一组纯计算工具。仓位大小计算器根据用户设定的风险比例（如账户净值的1%-2%）和止损点数来计算建议的手数，确保每笔交易的风险可控。利润计算器允许用户输入目标价位，计算在该价位平仓时的盈亏金额，帮助评估风险回报比。掉期计算器根据品种的掉期率和持仓方向预测隔夜持仓成本，辅助判断中长期持仓的可行性。这三个工具均不涉及自动入场或出场逻辑，也不执行任何订单操作。它们的核心价值在于帮助交易者在下单前进行定量分析，从而做出更理性的交易决策。
EA-28029.strategy_analysis_en: This EA suite does not execute any trading strategy; it is a set of pure calculation utilities. The Position Size Calculator determines the recommended lot size based on a user-defined risk percentage (e.g., 1-2% of account equity) and stop-loss distance in points, ensuring each trade's risk is controllable. The Profit Calculator allows users to input a target price and calculates the profit or loss if the position were closed at that level, helping evaluate the risk-reward ratio. The Swap Calculator forecasts overnight holding costs based on the instrument's swap rate and position direction, aiding decisions on medium-to-long-term position holding viability. None of these three tools involve automated entry or exit logic, nor do they execute any order operations. Their core value lies in helping traders perform quantitative analysis before placing orders, enabling more rational trading decisions. The suite serves as a pre-trade analysis companion rather than an automated trading system.

EA-29115.name: CoupleHedgeEA v3.0
EA-29115.summary: A multi-currency couple hedging EA that uses 3-5 currencies to form 3-30 pair groups, opening correlated hedge positions (plus/minus suites) on each group. It manages positions with configurable step progressions (statical/geometrical/exponential), multiple close-in-profit modes (side-by-side, both-sides, hybrid), and includes session control, spread filtering, and auto lot sizing.
EA-29115.summary_zh: 这是一个多货币对冲EA，使用3-5种货币组成3-30个货币对组，在每个组上开立相关性对冲仓位（正向/反向组合）。它支持可配置的步进递增（静态/几何/指数）、多种获利平仓模式（逐侧、双侧、混合），并包含时段控制、点差过滤和自动手数计算功能。
EA-29115.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于货币对之间的相关性对冲，从3-5种货币中组合出多个货币对组（couple），每组包含两个货币对。入场条件是当两个货币对形成特定方向组合时同时开仓——如果两对共享相同基础货币或报价货币则一买一卖，否则同向开仓，形成Plus和Minus两个对冲组合。出场条件支持五种获利平仓模式（逐侧平仓、双侧平仓、混合1、混合2、混合1+2）以及亏损平仓模式。仓位管理采用递进式加仓，支持三种步进模式（静态步长、几何步长、指数步长）和四种手数递进模式（静态手数、几何递增、指数递增、递减手数），在亏损时按设定步长逐步加仓。资金管理提供自动手数计算和风险因子控制，同时设有最大手数限制、最大订单数限制、点差过滤和交易时段控制（周一开盘等待、周五收盘前停止）来管控风险。
EA-29115.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on correlation hedging between currency pairs, combining 3-5 currencies into multiple pair groups (couples), each containing two pairs. Entry conditions open positions simultaneously on both pairs in a group — if the two pairs share the same base or quote currency, one buys and one sells; otherwise both trade in the same direction, forming Plus andMinus hedging suites. Exit conditions support five profit-close modes (side-by-side, both-sides, hybrid 1, hybrid 2, and hybrid 1+2) along with configurable loss-close modes (whole side, partial side, or no loss close). Position sizing uses progressive scaling with three step progression modes (statical, geometrical, exponential) and four lot progression modes (static, geometrical, exponential, decreasing lot), adding positions at set step intervals when in loss. Money management offers auto lot sizing with a risk factor, maximum lot size limits, maximum order count limits, spread filtering, and session control (waiting after Monday open, stopping before Friday close) to manage overall risk exposure.

EA-29116.name: RingSystemEA v4.0
EA-29116.summary: A multi-currency ring hedging EA that creates triangular currency pair groups from 3-8 currencies, generating up to 56 ring combinations. It opens simultaneous buy/sell positions across each ring's three pairs (Plus and Minus suites) to exploit temporary pricing imbalances, with configurable step progression, lot progression, and basket/single close logic.
EA-29116.summary_zh: 多货币环形对冲EA，从3至8种货币中构建三角货币对组合（最多56个环），对每个环的三对同时开立买/卖仓位组合（正套与反套），利用临时价格失衡获利，支持步进递进、手数递进及篮子/单笔平仓逻辑。
EA-29116.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是三角套利/环形对冲：从用户指定的货币中按组合数学生成所有三元组，每个三元组构成一个'环'（3对货币对）。对每个环同时开立'Plus套组'（Buy/Sell/Buy）和'Minus套组'（Sell/Buy/Sell），本质是对冲三对间的汇率关系偏差。入场条件为初始开仓后，若浮亏达到设定步进值则加仓（支持静态、几何、指数步进）。出场支持单笔获利平仓和篮子获利平仓两种模式，也可设定亏损平仓。仓位管理支持手动手数、自动手数（基于风险因子）、公平手数分配，以及静态/几何/指数/递减手数递进。资金管理包含最大手数限制、最大订单数限制、点差过滤、交易时段控制和滑点控制。
EA-29116.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is triangular arbitrage/ring hedging: from user-specified currencies it generates all 3-currency combinations (rings), each containing 3 currency pairs. For each ring it simultaneously opens a 'Plus suite' (Buy/Sell/Buy) and a 'Minus suite' (Sell/Buy/Sell), essentially hedging exchange rate relationship deviations across the three pairs. Entry involves initial positions, then adding positions when floating loss reaches a configured step threshold (supporting static, geometric, and exponential step progression). Exit supports both single-ticket and basket-ticket profit closing, with optional loss closing. Position sizing supports manual lot, auto lot (based on risk factor), fair lot distribution, and static/geometric/exponential/decreasing lot progression. Money management includes maximum lot limits, maximum order limits, spread filtering, trading session control, and slippage control.

EA-29362.name: Currency Strength EA 3.0
EA-29362.summary: This EA calculates the relative strength of individual currencies by analyzing multiple currency pairs simultaneously, then trades the strongest versus weakest currency pairs based on momentum divergence. It uses a systematic approach to identify imbalances in currency strength across the forex market and enters trades when the strength differential exceeds configurable thresholds.
EA-29362.summary_zh: 该EA通过同时分析多个货币对来计算各个货币的相对强度，然后基于动量背离交易最强货币对最弱货币的组合。它使用系统性方法识别外汇市场中的货币强度失衡，当强度差异超过可配置阈值时入场交易。
EA-29362.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是货币强度分析，通过计算各个主要货币（如USD、EUR、GBP、JPY等）在多个相关货币对中的表现来衡量其相对强度。入场条件是当最强货币与最弱货币之间的强度差异超过预设阈值时，买入强势货币/卖出弱势货币形成的货币对。出场条件包括达到止盈目标、止损触发或货币强度差异收敛到某个水平以下。仓位管理通常基于固定手数或根据账户余额百分比计算，具体取决于参数设置。资金管理方面，EA支持可配置的风险比例和最大持仓限制。策略本质上是一种跨市场动量策略，利用多个货币对之间的相关性背离来发现交易机会，属于中长期趋势跟踪与动量结合的系统化交易方法。
EA-29362.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is currency strength analysis, which measures the relative strength of each major currency (such as USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, etc.) by evaluating its performance across multiple related currency pairs. Entry conditions are triggered when the strength differential between the strongest and weakest currencies exceeds a configurable threshold, buying the strong currency and selling the weak currency to form a trade. Exit conditions include reaching take profit targets, stop loss triggers, or when the currency strength differential converges below a certain level. Position sizing is typically based on either fixed lot sizes or a percentage of account balance, depending on parameter configuration. In terms of money management, the EA supports configurable risk ratios and maximum position limits. The strategy is fundamentally a cross-market momentum approach that exploits correlation divergences between multiple currency pairs to identify trading opportunities, combining medium-to-long-term trend following with momentum in a systematic trading methodology.

EA-29607.name: Basket Close 2
EA-29607.summary: Basket Close 2 is a utility EA that monitors the net profit/loss of all open positions (the 'basket') and automatically closes all trades when a user-defined profit target or loss limit is reached. It serves as a portfolio-level risk management tool rather than a signal-based trading system.
EA-29607.summary_zh: Basket Close 2是一个工具型EA，用于监控所有持仓的净盈亏（即'篮子'），当达到用户设定的盈利目标或亏损限额时自动平仓所有订单。它是一个组合级别的风险管理工具，而非基于信号的交易系统。
EA-29607.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于篮子盈亏的整体仓位管理，而非基于技术指标的开仓策略。入场条件不适用，因为此EA不自行开仓，仅监控已有持仓。出场条件为：当所有持仓的净浮动利润达到设定的盈利目标时全部平仓，或当净浮动亏损达到设定的止损限额时全部平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅管理已存在仓位的批量关闭。资金管理通过设定篮子级别的盈亏阈值来控制整体账户风险敞口，防止单方向过度浮亏或锁定整体盈利。该工具适合同时运行多个策略或多个订单的交易者，帮助其实现账户级别的盈亏控制，避免情绪化手动平仓决策。
EA-29607.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is basket-level position management based on aggregate profit/loss, rather than an indicator-driven entry strategy. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not open trades on its own; it only monitors existing positions. Exit conditions are triggered when the net floating profit of all open positions reaches a user-defined profit target (closing all for profit) or when the net floating loss hits a user-defined loss limit (closing all to stop further loss). Position sizing is not handled by this EA as it does not calculate lot sizes for new orders; it only manages the batch closure of existing positions. Money management is implemented through basket-level profit/loss thresholds that control overall account risk exposure, preventing excessive drawdown in one direction or locking in aggregate profits. This tool is well-suited for traders running multiple strategies or orders simultaneously, helping them implement account-level profit/loss control and avoid emotionally driven manual closure decisions.

如果与多个策略同时运行，关闭所有订单可能干扰其他策略的正常运作
risk_points_en: Batch closure during extreme market conditions may result in actual losses exceeding the configured loss limit due to slippage
When running alongside multiple strategies, closing all orders may disrupt the normal operation of other strategies

EA-29797.name: my_ts15
EA-29797.summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that modifies existing position stop-losses based on a Moving Average line and price distance parameters. It does not open any new positions itself but can close positions when the stop-loss exceeds a maximum allowed distance. The trailing logic dynamically adjusts between MA-based and price-based trailing depending on whether the position is in profit or loss.
EA-29797.summary_zh: 这个EA是一个追踪止损工具，根据移动平均线和价格距离参数来修改已有持仓的止损位。它本身不开仓，但在止损超过最大允许距离时可以平仓。追踪逻辑根据持仓是否盈利，在MA追踪和价格追踪之间动态调整。
EA-29797.strategy_analysis: 这个EA的核心策略概念是利用移动平均线作为动态支撑/阻力来追踪止损，实现趋势跟踪式的利润保护。入场条件方面，该EA不负责开仓，仅管理已有持仓的止损。出场条件有两个：一是当价格触及动态追踪止损位时由止损单触发平仓，二是当持仓亏损超过max_sl点数且pre_init开启时强制平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数设置，仅修改已有仓位的止损和止盈。资金管理方面，max_sl参数提供了最大止损限制功能，防止单笔亏损过大。追踪止损逻辑区分盈利和亏损两种状态：盈利时使用较紧的trail_behind_price距离追踪，亏损时使用较宽的trail_behind_negative距离追踪，同时MA线作为另一个追踪基准，取两者中较优者。
EA-29797.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is using a Moving Average as dynamic support/resistance to trail stop-losses, implementing trend-following profit protection. Regarding entry conditions, this EA does not open positions; it only manages stop-losses of existing positions. Exit conditions are twofold: first, when price hits the dynamically trailed stop-loss level, the position is closed by the SL order; second, when a position's loss exceeds max_sl points and pre_init is enabled, the position is forcibly closed. For position sizing, this EA does not handle lot sizes for new trades; it only modifies stop-loss and take-profit of existing positions. For money management, the max_sl parameter provides a maximum stop-loss cap to prevent excessive single-trade losses. The trailing stop logic distinguishes between profitable and losing states: when profitable, a tighter trail_behind_price distance is used; when in loss, a wider trail_behind_negative distance is applied, while the MA line serves as an alternative trailing benchmark, choosing the more favorable of the two.
